title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description:
Aurify is looking for a visionary, hands-on CTO to lead our engineering team and scale our B2C visual AI platform.

🌍 Location: Fully Remote (Strong preference for Seoul, South Korea) 
💼 Type: Full-time, Executive 
🎯 Core Requirement: Proven experience building B2C consumer-facing apps (Visual AI, image/video generation, or AI avatars).
🛑 Quick Filter — Read Before Applying

This role is specifically for someone who has built consumer-facing apps or websites where users generate images, videos, or AI avatars. If your background is primarily B2B, enterprise software, or internal tooling—this likely isn't the right fit for us.

💻 About Aurify
Aurify is a B2C platform where users upload a photo and instantly get back a high-quality AI video or avatar—no prompts, no editing, no technical knowledge required. We move fast, integrating and leveraging the latest image generation, video synthesis, and digital human models. Our product lives and dies on output quality and seamless UX.

See what we're building: 👉 https://www.aurify.com

🛠️ You’ve Probably Worked On Something Like:
An AI avatar or digital human platform enabling users to generate AI versions of themselves.
A consumer image generation app (photo-to-image, style transfer, personalized AI photos).
An AI video creation tool turning photos or prompts into short-form video content.
A social or UGC platform with AI-powered media features built for everyday users.
You know the technical challenges firsthand: generation quality, latency, user expectations, API costs, and keeping up with a model landscape that changes every few weeks.

📈 What You’ll Own:
AI Integration: Integrating and managing AI APIs for image, video, and avatar generation.
Architecture: Building a scalable architecture that handles high content volume reliably and cost-effectively.
Team Leadership: Leading a small, agile engineering team (currently front-end and back-end developers).
Agile Strategy: Making fast decisions when new models or competitors change the landscape.
Cost Optimization: Keeping infrastructure and token costs in check as our user base grows.
Quality Control: Collaborating with marketing and content teams to ensure output quality matches consumer expectations.

⭐ What Matters Most:
You have shipped a B2C product where the core output is AI-generated visual content.
You’ve worked hands-on with image or video generation APIs—not just read about them.
You're highly comfortable in a small, fast-paced startup team without established processes.
You understand consumer behavior—retention, virality, and why users share content.

Learn More About Aurify
Before applying, we encourage you to explore our platform and learn more about what we're building.
Website: https://aurify.com

How to Apply
Send your resume, cover letter, and portfolio (if available) to careers@aurify.com.
Email subject line format: Chief Technology Officer – [Your Name

title: Software AI/ML Intern | 3.5k pm | 3 months
description:
Work From Home | Internship Certificate | Mentorship (During & After Internship) | Join a Team of 10 | Flexible Hours | IST Timezone

We support 5 apps across Web, iOS, and Android.

Join a dynamic team supporting a suite of 5 applications across Web, iOS, and Android. We utilize a modern stack—Expo/React Native for frontend, Node.js/MongoDB for backend, and AWS for infrastructure. We are now embedding AI/ML capabilities into our products to deliver smarter user experiences.

About the Internship
Are you passionate about building intelligent systems and eager to apply machine learning to real-world, cross-platform applications? We are looking for an AI/ML Intern to help us integrate predictive features, automate decision-making, and extract insights from user data.

You will gain hands-on experience in:

Data Engineering: Collecting, cleaning, and labeling data from our backend (Node.js/MongoDB) and user interactions across Web/iOS/Android.

ML Deployment: Packaging and deploying models as microservices on AWS (Lambda, SageMaker, or ECS) and exposing them via REST APIs.

Integration: Working with our React Native and Node.js teams to embed AI features (e.g., smart search, personalization, anomaly detection) into live apps.

Model Development: Building and fine-tuning ML models (classification, regression, recommendation, or NLP) using Python and modern frameworks.

You will work alongside experienced mentors, receive an Internship Certificate, and contribute to impactful projects. 

What We Offer
Deep Technical Growth: From understanding ML theory to production-ready deployment on AWS.

Mentorship: Direct guidance during and after the internship – including code reviews, model tuning sessions, and career advice.

Exposure: Full-stack visibility – Frontend, Backend, DevOps, and now AI/ML.

Career Path: After 3 months of paid internships, you are eligible to apply for paid full-time AI/ML or full-stack roles within the team.
*(Note: 4 out of 12 interns from our Jan 2025 cohort transitioned to full-time in July.)*

Requirements
Technical Skills:

Strong logical reasoning and a problem-solving mindset.

Proficiency in Python (required); familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript is a plus.

Basic understanding of ML concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, overfitting).

Experience with at least one ML framework: TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.

Familiarity with data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy) and REST APIs.

Exposure to AWS (S3, Lambda, or SageMaker) or MongoDB is a significant plus.

Availability:

Able to join daily sync-ups at 7 AM IST.

Open to working on Saturdays.

Commitment of ~5 hours per day.

Must have less than or equal to 4 hours of daily college/travel commitments to ensure focus.

Available for a 3-month duration; can join within 1 week.

Responsibilities
Data Pipeline: Assist in collecting, cleaning, and annotating datasets from our 5 apps (web + mobile).

Model Building: Implement and train ML models for use cases like user behavior prediction, content recommendation, or image/text classification.

Evaluation: Measure model performance, run A/B tests, and iterate to improve accuracy and latency.

Integration: Wrap models into simple APIs (using Flask/FastAPI) and collaborate with backend engineers to ship features.

Monitoring: Track model drift and data quality in production, suggest retraining schedules.

Documentation: Write clear, reproducible notebooks and technical guides for future interns.

Hiring Process
Offline Coding/Logic Exercise (3–10 hours)
A task focused on data manipulation, a simple ML model, or a logic puzzle relevant to AI/ML.

Live Debugging/Coding (GMeet) (1–3 hours)
Modify and discuss your solution in a live session – we’ll test your understanding of the code and ML concepts.

Final Interview (30 minutes)
Phone round with our CEO to discuss your motivation, learning goals, and fit.

Note: We respect your time. If our rigorous 0.3% selection rate or the effort required feels excessive for this role, we encourage you to apply elsewhere. We provide constructive feedback to those who reach the live round but are not selected.

How to Apply

This role is for those who want to build a career in applied AI/ML engineering or ML-driven product development.

You will gain significant experience working on real-world projects, from data wrangling to production deployment. Pre-Placement Offers (PPOs) may be extended to exceptional interns in the final month, based on performance, team needs, and company capacity. The 5 paid team members we have now were all interns earlier.

After 3 months of internship, you get to apply for paid full-time roles within the team.

title: Head of Hardware & Supply Chain
description:

basil & friends (Paws Limited) is an AI-enabled emotional tech company, incubated by HKSTP.

Starting with a little rescue mutt Basil at heart, we are mapping out an ecosystem of physical and digital products—celebrating the time we share together, and bridging every separation in between. ### The Role
We are looking for a creator to navigate the physical world. You will own the end-to-end delivery of our next-generation ambient hardware, acting as the crucial bridge between our software ecosystem and physical manufacturing.

### What You Will Do
* **0 to 1 Hardware R&D**: Lead the mechanical and electronic integration for our upcoming tabletop devices, translating software architecture into physical reality.

### Why This Role
* **A global stage from Day 1:** Your products will ship directly to high-net-worth users worldwide.
* **Zero bullshit culture**: Work alongside a capable, passionate, and rationally idealistic team that obsesses over the product and moves fast. No corporate red tape.
* **Founding-level ownership**: Meaningful equity (ESOP) + competitive early-stage salary.
A real product with real demand: Organic global traction in 26+ countries, profitable from month one.

title: Fundraising & Investor Relations Co-Founder / Partner
description:
Nixora is building the **autonomous control plane for AI-generated software and AI agents**.

AI coding agents are making it dramatically easier to build applications and autonomous agents. But once those systems need to be deployed, operated, monitored, scaled and maintained in production, the infrastructure and operational complexity increases significantly.

Nixora is building the infrastructure layer that helps take AI-generated software from **creation to deployment, operation, growth and eventual retirement**.

We are currently building the product, validating the market and preparing for our next stage of growth. We are now looking for a **Fundraising & Investor Relations Co-Founder / Partner** to take ownership of the capital side of the company.

This is **not a traditional finance, accounting or analyst role**.

We are looking for someone who understands early-stage startups, fundraising and venture capital, and who can help Nixora build relationships with the right investors and successfully raise capital.

### What you would own

- Build and execute Nixora's fundraising strategy
- Identify and prioritize relevant angels, founders, seed funds, VCs, family offices and strategic investors
- Build and manage the investor pipeline from initial outreach through meetings, follow-ups and due diligence
- Develop and continuously improve Nixora's investment narrative and fundraising materials
- Help refine our pitch deck, financial narrative, market opportunity and use-of-funds strategy
- Research investors and understand their investment thesis, portfolio and stage preferences
- Build meaningful relationships with investors rather than relying solely on cold outreach
- Coordinate investor conversations and help move interested investors through the fundraising process
- Help us understand what traction, metrics and milestones investors will expect at our stage
- Work closely with the founders to translate investor feedback into concrete business and product priorities
- Support fundraising negotiations, term discussions and closing processes
- Build relationships that can support future funding rounds and strategic opportunities
- Where relevant, identify strategic partnerships that can accelerate Nixora's growth

### What we are looking for

We are particularly interested in people with experience in:

- Pre-seed or seed fundraising
- Venture capital or angel investing
- Startup accelerators or venture development
- Investor relations
- Startup strategy and business development
- Fundraising outreach and investor pipeline management
- Pitch development and investment storytelling
- Building relationships with founders, angels, VCs and family offices

Existing investor relationships are valuable, but **a large contact list is not what we are looking for**.

We care much more about your ability to identify the right investors, get meaningful conversations started, build conviction around Nixora and move a fundraising process forward.

### Who this role is for

This role is a strong fit if you:

- Understand how early-stage fundraising actually works
- Can independently research and identify high-quality investors
- Are comfortable reaching out to investors and starting conversations
- Can communicate a technical startup's vision in a simple and compelling way
- Understand what investors look for at the pre-seed and seed stage
- Are persistent and comfortable with rejection
- Think like a founder rather than an employee
- Want meaningful ownership and responsibility in an early-stage company
- Are willing to build the fundraising function from the ground up

You do **not** need to be a traditional finance professional.

If you are a founder, former founder, VC/angel professional, accelerator operator, startup business development professional, or someone who has successfully helped an early-stage company raise capital, we would be interested in speaking with you.

### Current Stage

Nixora is currently in the early stage of building and validating the product.

Our immediate priorities are:

1. Build and launch the product
2. Validate strong developer demand
3. Establish measurable traction
4. Build relationships with the right investors
5. Raise our next round of capital
6. Build the foundation for a larger venture-scale company

### Compensation

This is currently an **equity-first Co-Founder / Partner opportunity**, rather than a conventional salaried position.

The equity structure will depend on:

- Relevant fundraising experience
- Level of commitment
- Investor network and ability to create fundraising opportunities
- Long-term involvement
- Responsibilities and contribution to the company

The final structure will be discussed transparently and documented formally before the partnership is finalized.

**Strong bonus skills**
- Existing relationships with Indian and international VCs
- Experience raising $500K+
- Previous founder experience
- VC or accelerator experience
- Experience with AI/SaaS/developer tools
- Experience with US investors
- Experience taking a startup from pre-seed to seed
- Strong LinkedIn presence and investor network
- Experience preparing data rooms and handling due diligence

### Why Nixora

The rise of AI coding agents is fundamentally changing how software is created.

We believe the next major infrastructure opportunity is not only helping AI build software, but helping that software **actually run reliably in the real world**.

Nixora aims to become the infrastructure and autonomous operations layer for this new generation of AI-generated software and agents.

This is an opportunity to join very early and help shape both the company and its fundraising strategy from the ground up.

If you have genuine early-stage fundraising experience, strong investor instincts, or a track record of helping startups raise capital, we would like to hear from you.

title: Backend & Data Engineer
description:
## About the Role

Avenrix Services is hiring a Backend & Data Engineer to contribute to an active enterprise technology project involving backend services, data processing, enterprise search, and AI-assisted workflows.

The role is primarily focused on **Node.js/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, APIs, data synchronization, production troubleshooting, observability, and reliability**.

You’ll work within an existing production environment and collaborate with engineers across backend, data, search, and AI-related areas. The project also involves close collaboration with data-science engineers working on areas such as retrieval, chunking, re-ranking, and AI-assisted knowledge workflows.

## Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain backend services using **Node.js and TypeScript**
- Build and maintain REST APIs and backend integrations
- Work with **PostgreSQL and SQL**
- Investigate slow queries and backend/database performance issues
- Support ETL, data pipelines, and synchronization between systems
- Investigate inconsistent data, failed jobs, retries, and production issues
- Help improve data consistency, reliability, and failure handling
- Work with AWS-based services and environments
- Use logs, metrics, and distributed tracing to troubleshoot production behavior
- Work with search and retrieval systems such as OpenSearch/Elasticsearch
- Collaborate with engineers working on AI/search and data-science workflows
- Support approved local AI inference, evaluation, embedding, and retrieval experiments
- Write automated tests and participate in code reviews
- Participate in technical meetings and clearly communicate progress, blockers, technical decisions, and recommended solutions
- Identify opportunities to improve existing implementations rather than simply following predefined tasks

## Required Skills

- **2+ years of software development experience** or strong equivalent practical experience
- Good JavaScript / TypeScript fundamentals
- Backend development experience with **Node.js**
- Good knowledge of **SQL and relational databases**
- Experience with **PostgreSQL** or a comparable database
- Experience developing or integrating REST APIs
- Familiarity with Git and standard development workflows
- Strong debugging and problem-solving ability
- Ability to understand and work within an existing codebase
- Comfortable investigating unfamiliar technical problems
- Ability to work independently on assigned engineering work
- Reliable communication and follow-through
- Receptive to technical feedback and willing to learn quickly
- Able to clearly explain your own implementation and technical decisions in English

## Local GPU Requirement

Candidates must have reliable access to a development computer equipped with an **NVIDIA RTX 4060, RTX 4070, or higher-class NVIDIA GPU**.

The GPU will be used for approved local development workloads such as:

- Local model inference
- Embedding generation and experimentation
- Retrieval/RAG experiments
- Model and prompt evaluation
- Search and re-ranking experiments
- Testing AI-assisted application workflows
- Other GPU-accelerated engineering and development tasks

**Client-sensitive or restricted production data must not be processed on personal hardware unless specifically authorized for that environment.**

## Data, Search & AI

You do not need to be a machine-learning researcher.

However, familiarity with some of the following is valuable:

- RAG / retrieval systems
- Embeddings
- Vector search
- Chunking
- Re-ranking
- OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
- LLM applications
- Local/open-source models
- Python-based AI tooling
- Working with data-science or ML engineers

The client team specifically works with data science around re-ranking, chunking, search, and AI-assisted knowledge retrieval.

## Observability & Reliability

Experience with production monitoring and troubleshooting is valuable.

Relevant technologies include:

- OpenTelemetry
- Datadog
- Prometheus
- Grafana
- Splunk
- Structured logging
- Metrics and alerting
- Distributed tracing

You do not need experience with every tool. What matters is being able to use logs, metrics, traces, and application/database information to investigate real production problems.

Data and observability were specifically emphasized during the client engineering discussion.

## Nice to Have

- AWS
- Kafka or another event-streaming / messaging system
- ETL or data-pipeline experience
- OpenTelemetry
- OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
- Python
- Docker
- GitHub Actions / CI/CD
- Distributed systems
- Data synchronization and reconciliation
- CUDA or GPU-based development
- Hugging Face or local LLM tooling
- RAG / embeddings / vector databases
- Experience collaborating with AI or data-science teams

Kafka and OpenTelemetry are valuable for this environment, but they are **not absolute requirements**; the underlying role places greater emphasis on data pipelines, distributed-system concepts, synchronization, troubleshooting, and observability generally.

## What We Value

We’re looking for someone who:

- Takes ownership of their work
- Is dependable and honest
- Learns quickly
- Accepts technical feedback well
- Communicates blockers early
- Investigates problems rather than guessing
- Is comfortable asking questions when something is unclear
- Can explain why they chose a particular technical approach
- Is willing to suggest improvements when they identify a better solution

The client engineering manager specifically emphasized that engineers should question existing approaches and suggest improvements rather than simply following instructions when they see a better solution.

## About Avenrix Services

Avenrix Services supports businesses through project-based engineering and technology delivery across software, backend systems, data, cloud, AI, and related technology initiatives.

For this engagement, you’ll contribute to an active enterprise technology project while working with engineering and project leadership.

## Engagement Details

**Job Type:** Contract  
**Level:** Junior–Mid Level  
**Location:** Remote — India / Pakistan  
**Compensation:** **$800–$1,200 USD per month**, depending on experience and technical capability  
**Schedule:** Regular availability with some overlap for technical meetings  
**Start:** As soon as available

title: Lead Engineer - Hardware & Thermal Systems
description:
Coherence Labs is seeking an exceptional, deeply hands-on hardware and thermal systems leader to help take a novel wearable platform from a well-developed technical framework to the first functional prototype.

Our platform sits at the intersection of neuroscience, thermal engineering, embedded systems, and consumer hardware. Over the past year, we have developed the scientific and technical framework underlying the technology and filed a comprehensive provisional patent covering the platform.

The core engineering challenge is thermal: achieving controlled thermal performance within a compact, power-constrained wearable while preserving the form factor, safety, and user experience expected of a refined consumer product.

We are looking for an engineer who wants meaningful ownership in solving that problem and building the technology around it.

**The first objective**
Your immediate focus will be development and validation of Coherence Labs’ first functional bench prototype.

You will be starting from a developed technical framework and thesis—not a fixed specification. We expect you to challenge assumptions, refine the technical approach, identify risk, and own the engineering decisions required to make the system work.

We are looking for someone who can move efficiently from technical evaluation into hands-on prototyping, testing, instrumentation, debugging, and iteration. Progress toward a validated prototype matters more to us than a prescribed weekly schedule.

**Who we’re looking for**
We are specifically seeking an established engineer with substantial experience in thermal systems, heat transfer, or compact thermal management.

Additional relevant experience may include:

Thermoelectric or other actively controlled thermal systems
* Wearables, consumer hardware, or miniaturized electromechanical systems
* Embedded control, power, sensing, and integrated hardware systems
* Productization, validation, DFM, or manufacturing
* We value systems thinkers who understand how these disciplines interact, recognize the important engineering tradeoffs, and know when additional expertise is needed.

Most importantly, we care about what you’ve personally built and the difficult technical problems you’ve solved.

**The opportunity**
Coherence Labs is pre-seed and has resources allocated for prototype development.

Prototype materials, components, testing needs, and development resources will be funded by the company; we are not asking the person who joins us to finance the build.
This role is equity-based until financing.

The level of equity, title, responsibility, and long-term scope will reflect the individual’s technical capability, experience, involvement, and mutual fit.

For an exceptional candidate with the technical depth, leadership ability, and long-term interest to become a true technical counterpart to the existing team, we are open to a founder-level structure. Other strong candidates may join in a senior technical leadership capacity with meaningful equity and ownership of the engineering function.

As the company grows, the role may expand from hands-on development into ownership of technical strategy, product development, manufacturing, engineering recruiting, and the broader technical organization.

**Structure & location**
We are flexible about how the role begins. It may start part-time or on a more substantial basis and evolve with the company and the relationship. We care more about capability, momentum, and execution than a predetermined number of hours.

Coherence Labs is based in Los Angeles. Proximity is helpful, but we are open to remote or hybrid arrangements for an exceptional candidate when the engineering setup makes sense.

**The team**
Coherence Labs is being built around the convergence of neuroscience, business, and engineering.

Lauren Salminen, PhD in behavioral neuroscience (USC)
President and Chief Science Officer — leads the scientific and perceptual foundation of the platform.

Dan Fetzner, MBA (Google, WebMD, NBC)
CEO — leads company strategy, commercialization, operations, and business development.

We’re now looking for the engineering leader who can become the third foundational element of our team.

title: Events Marketing Manager
acceptedRemoteLocations: Europe; United States; Netherlands; England, United Kingdom
description:
### About i-Genie.ai ### 

[i-Genie.ai](https://i-genie.ai) is the most exciting emerging technology platform in the consumer insights industry, upending the multi-billion-dollar consumer survey industry with modern AI and NLP techniques that gather rich data from the billions of Google searches, social media and video posts, and product reviews online. Founded by consumer insight industry legend Stan Sthanunathan, who headed Consumer Insights for Unilever, i Genie.ai is already working with Coca-Cola, Haleon, Bayer, Danone, L'Oréal, Unilever and Kenvue, where over 1,500 employees gather i Genie.ai insights and query its data via LLM every week. i Genie.ai is a growing team of the most accomplished technologists and business minds in the retail and consumer insights industry, and is growing rapidly across sales, engineering, data and marketing roles.

### **The Role** ### 
As Events Marketing Manager, you will own i Genie.ai's entire events programme: the industry conferences where our buyers gather, the events we host ourselves and the webinar series that puts our clients, partners and experts in front of senior insight, marketing and brand leaders. Your mission is to make i Genie.ai the most visible and credible voice in AI-powered consumer intelligence, and to turn that visibility into measurable pipeline. Marketing already originates half of our new pipeline, and events are how we grow that further. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales and our leadership team, and shape how events run at i Genie.ai as the program scales.

### Key Responsibilities ###

**Industry Events**
* Build and run an annual industry events plan across the US, Europe and APAC, prioritising the conferences that matter most to our buyers, including IIEX, Esomar, Quirk's and Greenbook
* Win speaking slots and panel places for i Genie.ai leaders and clients, so we are on the stage as well as on the floor
* Negotiate sponsorship packages and own on-site presence end to end, from stand and collateral to team briefings and on-site meeting schedules with Sales

**Owned Events**

* Design and deliver a programme of i Genie.ai hosted events, including executive roundtables, client dinners and in-person briefings, that bring senior buyers and clients together
* Own every event end to end: concept, budget, venue, invitations, run-of-show, logistics and post-event follow-up
* Fill every room with the right people through targeted invitations, partner co-promotion and paid amplification where relevant

**Webinars**
* Run a regular webinar series that consistently attracts senior insight, marketing and brand leaders from enterprise consumer brands
* Take each webinar from idea to on-demand asset: topic development with Marketing, speaker sourcing, promotion, rehearsal and production
* Grow registrations, live attendance and on-demand views quarter on quarter

**Speakers**
* Build a bench of external speakers, including client practitioners, industry experts and partners, who want to share a stage with i Genie.ai
* Source, secure and brief speakers for conference sessions, owned events and webinars, and prepare our internal leaders to present with confidence

**Awards & Recognition**
* Identify the awards and rankings where i Genie.ai should be recognised, such as the Esomar Awards, Quirk's Awards and GRIT Business & Innovation Report, and build an annual submissions calendar
* Own every entry, from story selection to sign-off, and turn every shortlisting or win into content
* Spot wider opportunities, such as judging panels, that raise i Genie.ai's profile

**Pipeline & ROI**
* Deliver a consistent flow of qualified leads for Sales, making sure every conference, hosted event and webinar opens new conversations with the right buyers at our target accounts
* Hand Sales a graded lead list within 48 hours of every event, with context on intent signals gathered on the day
* Own the events budget and calendar, planning at least two quarters ahead, and report pipeline sourced, pipeline influenced and cost per qualified lead to decide where we invest next

### Outcomes
* Double webinar audiences, growing average registrations from 150 to 300 per webinar while increasing the percentage that are in our ideal customer profile (ICP)
* Double i Genie.ai from 15 to ~30 events per year (industry events, client dinners and webinars) while increasing follow-up meetings and pipeline by 50% per event.
* Create a clear business case for the right-sized investment in each event type for years 2 and beyond
* Secure 8 speaking slots for i Genie.ai leaders and clients at tier-one industry conferences

### Experience
* 6+ years of B2B events marketing experience, including owning a multi-format events program (industry conferences, hosted events and webinars) end to end
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field
* Experience in market research, consumer insights or B2B SaaS is very much valued
* Experience at major insights industry events such as IIEX, Esomar, Quirk's and Greenbook, with an existing network of organisers and industry contacts
* A proven track record of building webinar programs that attract senior enterprise audiences
* Demonstrated ability to source, secure and brief senior speakers, including client-side practitioners at enterprise brands
* Experience owning an events budget, negotiating sponsorships and managing agencies and suppliers across multiple markets
* A track record of connecting events to pipeline, with confidence in lead capture, attribution and ROI reporting.  Hubspot experience a plus.   
* Strong understanding of how insight, marketing and brand teams at enterprise consumer companies work, and what they want from an event is preferable.

### Skill Requirements 
* Excellent written and verbal communication, from a crisp speaker brief and a compelling invitation to a confident run-of-show
* Exceptional project management, with the ability to run several events across time zones at once without dropping detail
* Proficiency in HubSpot (or similar CRM), webinar platforms (Zoom, Teams) and event registration tools is preferable
* Willingness to travel for industry and hosted events
* Self-motivated, with the ability to work remotely and independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and accel passed set goals as a default mindset
* A self-starter who can build and scale an events function, knowing when to draw on executives and subject-matter experts
* Genuine curiosity about AI and consumer insights

title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
description:
PeakMetrics is a narrative intelligence platform that protects enterprises and government agencies from social media manipulation, influence campaigns, and emerging narrative threats. Using advanced machine learning, our platform transforms millions of cross-channel media signals into actionable intelligence — giving customers the context and clarity they need to detect threats early and respond effectively.

# **The role**

Our commercial sales team is growing, and every Account Executive needs a strong pipeline behind them. We are hiring a Sales Development Representative to own the top of the funnel: prospecting, qualifying, and generating opportunities with enterprise decision-makers in crisis communications, PR, and corporate communications.

We are a Series A company, so this seat comes with real autonomy. You will be part of the sales organization, working toward clear goals in close partnership with an Account Executive, but you will own how you get there: your accounts, your outreach, and the ideas you test. The role is built for someone who wants a clear path to becoming an Account Executive.

# **What you’ll own**

- **The top of the funnel.** Prospect, qualify, and generate opportunities with enterprise-level decision-makers.
- **First conversations with senior buyers.** Start conversations with leaders in crisis communications and PR, learn their challenges, and qualify where PeakMetrics can help before handing off to your Account Executive.
- **Multi-channel outreach.** Run structured outbound sequences by email, phone, and LinkedIn with precision and creativity. Use AI and sales tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, and test what works.
- **Partnership with your Account Executive.** Align on target accounts, hand off well-qualified opportunities with clear context, and share feedback so every meeting counts.
- **Events and conferences.** Help drive attendance and represent PeakMetrics at key industry events and conferences that expand our market presence and generate new leads.
- **Cross-team collaboration.** Partner with marketing, growth, and product to align messaging and optimize campaigns.
- **Your pipeline reporting.** Track activity and progress in the CRM, with clear, consistent reporting on leads, conversions, and pipeline health.
- **New ideas and market insight.** Bring ideas for new plays, messaging, and channels, and share what you hear from prospects to help shape go-to-market strategy and product.

# **What we’re looking for**

You understand what it is like to work at a small company: things change quickly, not everything is defined, and the people who thrive find a way forward. You are hungry for the win, you bring ideas, and you work well with autonomy while staying in sync with your team.

- **1–3 years of SDR or BDR experience.** Ideally selling AI, analytics, or other B2B software, with a record of meeting or exceeding your targets.
- **Startup experience.** Preferred. You know what it is like to work on a small team where priorities shift and everyone wears several hats.
- **Comfort with ambiguity.** You adapt and pivot quickly when plans change. You experiment, fail fast, and learn faster.
- **Solutions-oriented.** You bring ideas, not just problems, and you look for a way forward when something is not working.
- **Self-directed.** You manage your own day and pipeline without close supervision, and you ask for help when it matters.
- **Hungry for the win.** You are competitive, you celebrate team wins, and you build trust with prospects and teammates through integrity.
- **Understanding of consultative selling.** You know how to run discovery, ask good questions, and qualify real need.
- **Strong communication and tools.** Your writing and speaking are clear and engaging, and you are comfortable with CRM and sales tools.
- **Nice to have:** Experience selling to communications, PR, or crisis management leaders; familiarity with narrative intelligence, threat intelligence, media monitoring, or reputation risk; and a passion for AI and the information landscape.

# **Benefits**

- **Remote-first.** Do your best work from wherever you are in the U.S. Remote is how we operate by default, not an exception.
- **Health and retirement.** Health insurance, a 401(k), and other benefits that support you beyond the workday.
- **Flexible schedule and unlimited time off.** Shape your week around your life, and take the time you need to recharge.
- **Room to grow.** Real opportunities for professional growth and development, starting with the chance to build a new function from the ground up.
- **A culture worth joining.** A vibrant, inclusive team working on how narratives move across the world’s information.
- **Competitive compensation.** Pay that reflects the impact of the role and the value you bring.

PeakMetrics is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Help Desk Technician
description:
TMAI Global is seeking a motivated, customer-focused, and technically capable Help Desk Technician to join our growing team. The Help Desk Technician will serve as a key point of contact for employees and users who require technical assistance, troubleshooting, and support with hardware, software, networks, systems, and other IT-related issues.

The ideal candidate is a problem solver who enjoys helping people, communicates clearly, and can confidently diagnose and resolve technical problems. This role requires someone who can balance technical expertise with excellent customer service while maintaining professionalism, patience, and attention to detail.

If you are passionate about technology and enjoy finding practical solutions to technical challenges, we encourage you to apply.

Job Summary

The Help Desk Technician will provide first-level technical support to users by responding to support requests, diagnosing issues, resolving problems, and escalating complex incidents when necessary. The successful candidate will ensure that users receive timely and effective assistance while maintaining accurate records of support activities.

You will support a variety of IT systems and devices, including computers, laptops, mobile devices, printers, applications, user accounts, and network connectivity. You will also contribute to maintaining a reliable and secure IT environment across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

    Provide first-level technical support to employees and users through phone, email, chat, ticketing systems, or in-person assistance.

    Respond promptly to IT support requests and ensure incidents are properly documented and tracked.

    Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, connectivity, and application issues.

    Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktop computers, laptops, printers, monitors, mobile devices, and other IT equipment.

    Assist users with password resets, account access, software installation, system configuration, and basic security-related issues.

    Troubleshoot network connectivity problems, including Wi-Fi, VPN, internet, and basic LAN-related issues.

    Assist with onboarding and offboarding employees by preparing equipment, configuring accounts, granting or removing access, and recovering company assets.

    Maintain accurate records of IT equipment, software licenses, user accounts, and assigned devices.

    Escalate complex or unresolved technical issues to senior IT personnel, system administrators, vendors, or other appropriate teams.

    Follow established IT policies, procedures, security standards, and service-level requirements.

    Monitor open tickets and follow up with users to ensure issues are resolved satisfactorily.

    Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and knowledge-base articles.

    Assist with software updates, operating system upgrades, patches, backups, and routine maintenance as required.

    Identify recurring technical problems and recommend solutions that can improve system reliability and user productivity.

    Support IT projects, system implementations, equipment upgrades, and other technology initiatives when required.

    Maintain confidentiality and protect company data and systems from unauthorized access.

    Stay informed about emerging technologies, IT best practices, and tools relevant to the organization.

Required Qualifications

    Diploma, associate degree, bachelor's degree, or relevant technical certification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

    Previous experience in a help desk, service desk, desktop support, technical support, or similar IT role is preferred.

    Strong understanding of Windows operating systems and common desktop applications.

    Basic knowledge of computer hardware, networking, printers, peripherals, and troubleshooting techniques.

    Familiarity with IT ticketing or service management systems.

    Understanding of basic cybersecurity principles, including password security, phishing awareness, access control, and data protection.

    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.

    Strong customer-service orientation and a professional attitude.

    Ability to prioritize multiple support requests and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

    Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with other IT team members.
		

Preferred Qualifications

    CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft, or other relevant IT certifications.

    Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, or similar cloud-based technologies.

    Experience supporting remote users and virtual private networks (VPNs).

    Familiarity with ITIL principles and service management practices.

    Experience with remote desktop and endpoint management tools.

    Knowledge of basic network troubleshooting, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN technologies.

Key Skills

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

    Technical troubleshooting

    Customer service

    Communication and interpersonal skills

    Critical thinking and problem solving

    Time management and prioritization

    Attention to detail

    Documentation and record keeping

    Team collaboration

    Adaptability and willingness to learn

    Professionalism and confidentiality

What We Offer

At TMAI Global, we believe in creating an environment where employees can develop their skills, contribute meaningful ideas, and grow professionally. Depending on the position and location, benefits may include competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, training and certification support, career advancement opportunities, and a collaborative working environment.

Equal Opportunity Statement

TMAI Global is committed to providing an inclusive and respectful workplace. We consider qualified candidates based on their skills, qualifications, experience, and ability to perform the role, without discrimination based on legally protected characteristics.
How to Apply

If you are a dependable and enthusiastic IT professional who enjoys solving technical problems and providing excellent user support, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to join TMAI Global as a Help Desk Technician and become an important part of our technology support team.

title: Founding Product Designer
description:
# Founding Product Designer

**vWorka**
**Location:** Remote
**Type:** Founding Team / Part-time initially
**Compensation:** **5% equity**
**Vesting:** 4 years with a 1-year cliff
**Cash compensation:** Unpaid initially

## About vWorka

vWorka is a mobile-first hiring marketplace helping businesses find suitable local workers while helping workers discover jobs that fit their skills, location, and preferences.

We're starting in Lagos, with the goal of building a better way for businesses and workers across emerging markets to connect.

We're currently building the MVP and looking for a **Founding Product Designer** to join us at this early stage.

## The Role

As the Founding Product Designer, you'll have significant ownership over how vWorka looks, feels, and works.

You'll work directly with the founding team to turn product ideas into simple, intuitive experiences for both workers and employers.

This isn't a role where you'll simply receive requirements and design screens. You'll be involved in **shaping the product itself**.

### What you'll do

* Design the worker and employer mobile experiences
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs
* Design core experiences including onboarding, job discovery, job posting, applications, profiles, and subscriptions
* Build and maintain a consistent design system
* Work closely with the development team to ensure designs are implemented well
* Participate in product discussions and help make UX decisions
* Use user feedback to continuously improve the product
* Help establish vWorka's visual and product design direction

## What we're looking for

* Strong UI/UX and product design skills
* Strong Figma skills
* Good understanding of mobile-first design
* Ability to think about user problems, not just visual design
* Comfortable working independently in an early-stage environment
* Strong attention to detail
* Willingness to take ownership and iterate quickly
* Genuine interest in joining an early-stage startup and building from the ground up

You don't need years of experience. **What matters most is your ability, product thinking, ownership, and willingness to build.**

## Why join vWorka?

You'll be joining at a very early stage, which means you'll have real influence over the product.

You'll work directly with the founding team, help define the design system, contribute to product decisions, and see your work go from idea → design → production → real users.

This is intended to be a **long-term founding-team opportunity**, not a short-term freelance role.

## Equity

The role comes with **5% equity**, subject to the final equity agreement.

The equity will vest over **4 years with a 1-year cliff**.

There is no cash compensation initially. As vWorka grows and funding/revenue allows, the role can transition into a paid position.

## Commitment

We're looking for someone who can consistently contribute alongside the founding team.

The exact weekly commitment can be discussed based on the right candidate, but we're looking for someone who is genuinely interested in building with us rather than simply completing a design assignment.

## How to Apply

Please send the following to **[vworka.business@gmail.com](mailto:vworka.business@gmail.com)**:

* Your portfolio
* Your Figma/design work
* A short introduction about yourself
* Why you're interested in vWorka
* Your current availability and expected commitment

If you're excited about joining early, having real ownership, and helping build a product from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
***Note:** Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.*

##   
🚀 Our Story

Partly's mission is to connect the world's parts and we're doing that by building the first global platform for replacement parts, starting with auto parts. Our big vision is to accelerate the world towards a sustainable future where waste is eliminated and all replacement parts are universally searchable, accessible and available to all.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we utilise bleeding-edge technology to solve challenging but exciting problems that make a huge impact in a $1.9 trillion industry. We've more than tripled our team over the last 12 months and expect to double in size again over the coming 12 months. We're a global team spanning both Europe and Australasia.

We provide a scalable digital infrastructure solution to some of the world's largest businesses and the most exciting startups. Partly's solutions are integrated across hundreds of companies globally, providing the backbone for cataloguing and managing parts online.

Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co-Founder).

We're continuing to build a world-class team and ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built at Partly, and our [values](https://www.partly.com/careers) are lived throughout every experience.

## The opportunity

Repairers train for years to be on the tools, then spend half their day on quotes, paperwork and finding parts. Partly's product aims to automate the admin so repairers can focus on their craft. The products we've launched this year start with a conversation, and behind it a system generates the interface the moment needs. So we no longer design a set of pages. We design components, and then we design the brain the AI uses to assemble them. Very few designers have done this yet. That's the opportunity: to work out what product design becomes at an AI company, in a domain where a wrong answer is a $1,000 part that can't be returned.

The problems are real and unsolved. How does someone who's never used a chat interface know what to ask when they land on an empty box between phone calls? How does a task you do forty times a day become one tap, not one more sentence to type, with the same result every time? How much of the agent's reasoning do you show before trust turns into a wall of text? Where should the interface be opinionated, and where should it be generated? We don't have the answers yet. You'll own finding Partly's.

#   
🖍️ The role

Our product teams are organised around a product, each led by a Product Lead (Principal Product Manager) with a Product Engineer and a mix of engineers. Design is not embedded in those teams. We're building a global design team that works across all of our products and is focused on three things: the design system everything is built from, coherence across the whole product family, and the quality of the experience wherever a repairer or supplier meets us. Our customers range from repairers and parts admins in a single independent workshop to multi-billion-dollar repair groups, and the suppliers who provide their parts. The team exists to drive adoption and stickiness through experiences that feel magical, in a way that works for our customers. We work collaboratively with the Product Leads who drive their products.

This is a senior design role for someone with incredible judgement and hands-on experience with AI surfaces and experiences. You lead with design: problem framing, systems thinking, interaction and craft. And you make things real, with working prototypes built inside our design system.

You won't sit in a product team's backlog. Product Leads own their products and what ships. You own the principles, patterns and system they build from, and you set your own agenda for where those need to go next. When something ships below the bar, you're the one who says so.

This role is based in one of our offices: Auckland or Christchurch in New Zealand, London in the UK, or Austin, Texas in the US. The design team works across all of them.

## 💻 What you'll do

- **Own the design system that engineers and coding agents build our AI experiences from.** Components, patterns, rules and guidance that read correctly to an engineer and to a coding agent, so the right choice is the default even when you're not in the room.
- **Shape and ship the patterns for agentic and generative experiences.** Natural language where conversation fits, generated UI where the data is dense, and agents that take on the admin, verification and sourcing around a repair while the person keeps the decisions that matter.
- **Define how the product behaves when it's uncertain.** When the agent acts, proposes or asks, in line with the cost of being wrong. How it shows its work, how a person corrects it, and who's right when they disagree.
- **Give the product its character.** How our agents speak to a repairer, their tone, when they're brief and when they explain. A personality people recognise on every surface where they meet us.
- **Hold the bar across every product.** Notice when the same job looks different in two products and fix it at the source, in the system rather than page by page. Measure adoption and quality, and hold teams to them.
- **Work with real prototypes.** Build working versions with AI tools inside our design system, test them on real data, and put them in front of repairers and suppliers.
- **Pair with engineers, no hand-offs.** Work directly with Product Engineers and their teams, polish the details together, and review the UI that coding agents produce from the system.
- **Spend real time with customers.** In the workshop, on the phone and in the product, running research alongside the Product Leads who hold the deep customer context in each region.
- **Write the principles and rules.** How the experience behaves on behalf of a person, written clearly enough that an engineer and a model can both follow them.

## 🥷 What you bring

- **Senior experience, evidenced.** You've been trusted to run a project end to end and can point to the user behaviour that changed because of it. Typically 5+ years designing complex software; the evidence matters more than the years.
- **You've designed agentic experiences, and can show the work.** Shipped at work or built seriously on your own time. Tasks, tools, autonomy, human-in-the-loop, evaluation: you've made real calls on what an agent does alone, what it proposes and what it asks, and you can tell us which of those calls were wrong.
- **Systems thinking.** You've contributed to or built a design system that engineers reached for without being told to, and you have a view on what a system needs to be when its heaviest user is a coding agent.
- **Craft that holds up in production.** Real states, real edge cases, real data. Deep fluency in interaction design, copy that carries its weight, and the visual taste to make a dense, technical tool look considered.
- **Product judgement.** You can take a fuzzy brief and produce the problem, the constraints and the first testable version, and you can explain a trade-off you made and who disagreed. You build to learn, and you know when your prototype is lying to you.
- **Comfort working with several product teams at once,** respecting that each Product Lead drives their product while bringing a view that spans all of them, and comfortable telling them when it isn't good enough yet.
- **Curiosity about our customers.** Professionals with high expectations, low tolerance for friction, and workflows shaped by decades of industry convention.
- **Clear written, verbal and visual communication.**

## **Nice to have**

- Experience designing workflow-heavy, data-dense or technically complex B2B products.
- Marketplace, catalogue, e-commerce or supply chain domains. Automotive is a bonus, not a requirement.
- High-growth startup and scale-up environments.
- Experience working in a global, distributed design team.

We're not looking for a designer whose strength is producing a hundred screens in a traditional SaaS model, or one who is apprehensive about AI. If half the work makes you nervous, this isn't the role.

## How we build

We're an AI research company and we build like one. In discovery mode, anyone, designers included, can use Claude Code to build a working version inside our design system, run it against real data, and show a customer the feature with their own jobs in flight. In scale mode, engineering rebuilds what's proven. We don't ship prototype code to production; we use it to decide what production should be. Designers work in both.

## 🎁 Our Benefits

- **Healthy, Catered Lunches** - Enjoy fresh, healthy lunches every workday in our Auckland, Christchurch, London and San Francisco offices. With no meal prep needed, you can eat, connect, and refuel with your team. (And yes, snacks and drinks are always on hand.)
- **Healthy Body, Healthy Mind** - We care about performing at our peak. Every team member gets a $1,500 annual wellness allowance (or local equivalent) on a Partly-branded card. Use it on things such gym memberships, rock climbing, physio, massage, GP visits, prescriptions; anything that you or your family, need!
- **Family Comes First** - Primary caregivers receive 3 months of fully paid parental leave, plus a flexible return-to-work (four days on full pay for your first three months back).
- **Getting Here Is On Us** - If you commute to a Partly office or co-working space, choose from a paid 24/7 car park or commute allowance. One less thing to think about!
- **Workspaces That Inspire** - Our brand new, architecturally designed offices are built for collaboration and creativity, with great coffee, social spaces, and some of the best cafes a few steps away.
- **Office-First with Flexibility** - In cities where we have an office (Christchurch, Auckland, London, San Francisco), we default there every day. This let's us move faster, make better decisions and build strong relationships. We also operate with a very high trust environment, so you can manage your time around your life, and flex your schedule to get your best work done.
- **We Celebrate Together** - From weekly happy hours and monthly lunches to quarterly season openers and an annual global offsite, we make time to connect, celebrate, and have fun as one team.

title: Senior Designer
description:
## About Nen Creative

Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.

Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.

We're growing quickly and looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company alongside us.

## About the Role

We're looking for a **Senior Designer** to create exceptional brand and digital work for some of the most ambitious companies in technology.

This is a senior, hands-on design role for someone with exceptional craft, strong conceptual thinking, and the ability to take meaningful ownership of projects from early exploration through final delivery.

You'll work across brand identities, websites, campaigns, and launch moments — developing ideas, building visual systems, and pushing the work beyond the obvious. You'll collaborate closely with creative leadership, project managers, strategists, and other designers while owning significant portions of the creative process yourself.

You'll also work directly with clients, presenting concepts, explaining creative decisions, responding thoughtfully to feedback, and helping move projects toward strong outcomes.

We're looking for someone who wants to do career-defining work, move quickly, push creative boundaries, and help raise the standard of what Nen puts into the world.

## What You'll Do

**Design & Craft:** Create exceptional work across brand identity, visual systems, websites, campaigns, and launch experiences. Bring a high level of taste, detail, and polish to everything you touch.

**Concept Development:** Develop distinctive creative directions from early exploration through fully realized systems. Push beyond the first idea, challenge conventions, and find solutions that feel ownable and memorable.

**Project Ownership:** Take meaningful ownership of projects and workstreams from concept through delivery. Manage your own work effectively, anticipate what needs to happen next, and make sure details don't fall through the cracks.

**Client Collaboration:** Present work clearly and confidently, articulate the thinking behind creative decisions, respond thoughtfully to feedback, and build trust with founders and senior stakeholders.

**Creative Collaboration:** Work closely with creative leadership, strategists, developers, project managers, and other designers to make the work stronger. Give thoughtful feedback and contribute actively to critiques.

**Raise the Bar:** Help improve the quality of our work, our creative process, and the way we present ourselves as a studio. Bring new references, ideas, techniques, and perspectives into the team.

## What We're Looking For

- **3–7 years of experience** as a designer, ideally within a strong branding, design, or creative agency environment.
- **Exceptional design craft and taste.** You have a strong portfolio demonstrating excellent typography, composition, visual systems, identity work, and digital design.
- **Strong conceptual thinking.** You can develop ideas, not just execute layouts, and know how to turn a strong concept into a cohesive visual system.
- **High ownership and reliability.** You do whatever it takes to get important work over the line, stay calm under pressure, and don't need someone chasing you to make things happen. This is not a role for someone looking for a strictly 9–5 mindset.
- **Strong with clients and presentations.** You're comfortable presenting your work, explaining your thinking, receiving feedback, and navigating creative conversations professionally.
- **Able to move fluidly between thinking and making.** You can zoom out to understand the bigger creative idea and zoom all the way into the details required to make the final work exceptional.
- **Driven to raise the bar.** You're ambitious about your craft, curious about what's happening in design and culture, and constantly looking for ways to make the work more distinctive.

## Why Join Nen Creative

- Be part of a small, fast-growing studio trusted by world-class startups and investors
- Work directly with top founders shaping the future of tech
- Clear growth path as we scale — you’ll help define the design practice itself
- Remote-friendly, flexible, and entrepreneurial environment
- Healthcare, PTO, 401K

* Help us build an authentic Chaser community throughout Southern California.

**Who We’re Looking For**

You’re outgoing, resourceful and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**You should be:**

* Highly energetic, personable and confident meeting new people.
* Naturally relationship-driven with strong communication skills.
* Organized, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.

title: Meta Ads Specialist (Paid Social & Performance Growth)
description:

title: Fractional Account Executive – B2B SaaS / RegTech (Australia)
description:
Shieldflow is a certified Xero app helping Australian accounting firms automate AML/CTF ongoing monitoring, surface explainable exceptions, and retain audit-ready evidence.

We’re looking for an experienced fractional Account Executive to own qualified opportunities from SDR handoff through to close.

This is not a cold-calling or lead-generation role. We already have an SDR prospecting Australian accounting firms and conducting first-pass qualification. Your job is to take credible opportunities, determine whether there is a genuine buying case, run deeper discovery, progress the right prospects, disqualify weak ones, and own the commercial process through to won, lost, or nurture.

You’ll run discovery and sales meetings, establish pain, affected-client volume, urgency, decision process and competitive context, maintain HubSpot, manage follow-up, present pricing and proposals, handle objections and negotiation, and keep every opportunity moving toward a clear decision.

The founder will join selected calls where product, AML/CTF, integration or founder-level credibility materially helps the deal. We do not want someone who simply books prospects into founder demos, you will remain the owner of the opportunity before and after the founder becomes involved.

We’re looking for someone who has personally owned B2B SaaS opportunities end-to-end, ideally selling into SMB or mid-market customers. Experience in fintech, regtech, accounting software or professional-services technology is valuable but not essential. HubSpot experience and strong CRM/follow-up discipline are important.

This is initially a fractional role of approximately 5–10 hours per week, with relatively low but growing opportunity volume. It would suit an experienced AE building a fractional portfolio or someone with capacity alongside other non-competing engagements.

This is a fractional role, not a full-time salaried position. Compensation will be structured as a modest monthly retainer plus success-based commission, or potentially commission-only for the right candidate.

The key outcome is simple: qualified opportunities are professionally owned from handoff to decision, while the founder only steps in where his involvement materially increases the probability of closing.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Product Expansion Team
description:

Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

## **What We’re Looking For**

We're seeking a talented Senior Software Engineer to join our mission of revolutionizing payments for service-based companies by building the robust, scalable infrastructure that powers our accounts receivable automation platform.

You’ll join our Product Expansion team, which owns two of our core products: Accounts Payable, where we’re currently building multi-use virtual cards, and Analytics.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on architecting and developing core backend services, design event-driven data pipelines, and ensuring the reliability and performance of systems that process critical financial transactions for our clients.

Working closely with Product and Operations teams, you'll leverage your expertise in Go (or other similar language) and distributed systems to deliver high-quality features rapidly while maintaining the transparency, dependability, and partnership values that define Alternative Payments.

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on how businesses manage their payment processes, contributing to a platform that reduces costs and complexity for companies while working alongside a global, diverse and collaborative team.

This role is available to candidates who are eligible to work in Brazil, fully remote.

## **What You’ll Do**

- **Build backend services:** Develop and maintain core services that handle data processing, transformations, and business logic.
- **Design event-driven pipelines:** Craft idempotent, queue-based workflows (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.) to process messages without duplication.
- **Write clean, maintainable code:** Author services in Go (or a similar language) and SQL (Postgres or equivalent), following clear coding standards and review practices.
- **Drive quality & reliability:** Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; instrument metrics (throughput, latency, error rates) and alerts; rapidly diagnose and resolve issues.
- **Collaborate & iterate:** Partner with Product and Operations to deliver features quickly; pair with teammates to share knowledge and continuously refine our tooling and processes.

## **What You’ll Bring**

- Strong in Go (or comparable backend language) and SQL (Postgres or equivalent).
- Experience working on payment platforms or with payments/financial transactions.
- Comfortable with event buses/queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
- Solid testing discipline: unit, integration and end-to-end.
- Familiarity with Git workflows, code reviews and CI/CD pipelines.
- 4–7 years in professional software development, with senior-level responsibilities.

## **Nice-to-Haves**

- Data lake or analytics engineering experience (ClickHouse, dbt, Dagster, Spark/Databricks, Snowflake or similar).
- Experience working on analytics products.
- Frontend experience with TypeScript.
- Prior work on financial/data reconciliation.
- Hands-on experience integrating with QuickBooks Online, Xero, Netsuite or similar APIs
- Understanding of accounting principles (e.g. double-entry).
- Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana).
- Basic compliance/security exposure (encryption, audit trails).
- Track record of mentoring, leading projects, or driving organizational improvements.
- Comfort working in fast-paced, dynamic, and high-impact environments.

## **What we offer**

- **Competitive salary** tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.
- **The total compensation range for this role i**s $90,000 - $105,000, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, and education/training.
- **Equity opportunities** so you can share in our growth and success.
- **Unlimited PTO** and flexibility when you need it the most.
- **Yearly learning & development** stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

## **Why Choose Alternative Payments?**

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

- Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.
- Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.
- Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.
- Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

***Want to see what we're actually building?***

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

## **Our Values**

- **Transparency & Honesty:** We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.
- **Resourcefulness:** We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.
- **Partnership:** We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.
- **Revolutionary & Boldness:** We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.
- **Accountability**: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

## **Applying to Alternative Payments**

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.
