title: Staff Engineer, Web
description:
**About Us:**

 

[_Ground News_](https://ground.news/) is a news comparison platform that makes it easy to compare sources, read between the lines of media bias, and break free from algorithms. We provide our subscribers the tools to navigate the information ecosystem with clarity and independence, rather than retreat into echo chambers or outsource their judgment.

In a world where political polarization and media distrust are at an all-time high, Ground News offers people a better way to stay informed and see every side of the story. Our mobile app, web app, and browser extension are home to a community of mindful readers who use our news comparison platform to engage critically with the news and beyond their filter bubble.

 

Unlike most news companies, our values do not align with any specific political ideology. Unlike most tech platforms, we don’t rely on algorithms to keep users on our platform to sell ads. We are supported by our readers who pay for a subscription to build a more nuanced understanding of the news, the world, and themselves.

**Highlights:**

- [_#1 on Product Hunt_](https://www.producthunt.com/products/ground-news-from-the-source#ground-news-bias-checker)
- [_#2 on 2025 Apple Design Awards in the Social Impact category_](https://developer.apple.com/design/awards/#social)
- 3-time winner of US App of the Day
- Winner of Mobile Apps Showdown at CES
 

**The Opportunity:**

 

As a Staff Engineer, you'll own the technical direction of the web properties that convert curious visitors into paying subscribers. You'll sit in the Frontend chapter, working day-to-day in the Growth & Monetization pod alongside Revenue Growth, Marketing, Sponsorships, and CRO.

 

This is not a design role. You won't be doing visual/UX design work; our design partners own that. You’ll own the engineering layers: architecture, experimentation infrastructure, performance, and making non-engineers self-sufficient to ship experiments safely.

 

Within 90–180 days, success means a marketing or growth teammate can ship a landing-page change, a modal, or a pricing experiment without an engineer in the loop.

  

**Before you apply:**

 

This is a staff-level role centered on growth engineering; a great fit if you've spent **8+ years** building production frontend experience, including 3+ years operating at a senior or staff level, and you've owned user or revenue growth on a web property. It's not the right fit if your background is mainly visual/UX design, or if you're earlier in your career and working toward that senior step, but we'd love to have you watch for future roles that match where you are.

**What You’ll Do:**

- Technical strategy for Ground News' web properties, with a direct mandate on user growth and subscription revenue.
- The marketing-tech stack (currently Unbounce, likely migrating to Framer): you'll lead that migration and set the guardrails.
- The web experimentation program end-to-end.
- Web performance, accessibility, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for a consumer property serving millions of readers.
- Senior voice in code review and architecture across the frontend chapter.
- Safe rollout practices on Flightcontrol for revenue-critical surfaces.

**What You’ll Bring:**

- 8+ years building production web applications, with 3+ years at a senior or staff IC level.
- Deep, hands-on expertise in Next.js, React, and TypeScript. You’ve built and shipped at scale.
- A specific, quantifiable track record of growing user base or revenue from a web property.
- Hands-on experience running A/B or multivariate experiments end-to-end: hypothesis framing, sample sizing, clean measurement, honest read of results.
- Direct experience working inside or alongside a CRO function, fluent in marketing-tech tooling (Unbounce, Framer, Webflow, or similar).
- Experience with PostHog, Amplitude, or Segment, and building trustworthy funnel instrumentation from scratch.
- Experience shipping to production on revenue-critical surfaces with feature flagging, monitoring, and rollback discipline.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to our Kitchener, Ontario HQ and for company-wide All Hands meetups.

**Bonus Points:**

- Experience technically coaching engineers.
- Experience with a subscription or consumer-media product.

**Why Work at Ground?**

 

Co-founded by a former NASA engineer and Bain consultant, a position with Ground News provides an unparalleled learning experience both personally and professionally. At Ground, we prioritize growth: both for our business and team members. You’ll have the freedom to work remotely and play a key role in the development of Ground News products.

 

This is an opportunity to work with a growing and mighty team that is committed to building a world where cooperative, civil debate is the norm, media is accountable, and critical thought is the baseline of our information consumption. Ground is based in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada, but this role is remote.

  

**What You’ll Enjoy at Ground News:**

💰 **Competitive total rewards**: A market-benchmarked base salary, calibrated to your location.

🌍 **Remote-first environment**: Work from anywhere in Canada, on your own time zone plus enjoy in-person meetups and team gatherings.

🩺 **Health & Wellness that matter:** Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage for you and your family.

📈 **Keep growing:** Access to professional development opportunities to keep expanding your skills and career.

🚀 **Mission-driven team:** Join a group of smart, dedicated people who are building meaningful products with real-world impact.  
  
  
*Our culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding accessibility needs, please contact* [*talent@ground.news*](mailto:talent@ground.news)*, and a member of our team will be happy to help.*

title: Data Engineer | Data Scientist — Unstructured Data & AI Pipelines
description:
## About the project *(description, duration, stage)*

Join Neurons Lab as a **Data Engineer** (part-time) on a flagship engagement with a **European private investment group** — a holding company with a C-level executive team, an investment/portfolio function and an affiliated family office.

The programme builds one private, access-scoped **context layer** over the group's data, then AI skills and agents on top of it. You build the plumbing underneath: **Phase 1 (Capture)** — turn on ingestion across calls, email, Slack and messengers, board protocols, decks and portfolio updates, live *and* historical; **Phase 2 (Connect)** — land it all in the context layer with identity resolved, access scope attached and lineage intact.

This is deliberately an **unstructured-first data-engineering role**. There is no clean warehouse to model: the raw material is transcripts, threads, attachments and years of archive, and the hard problems are entity resolution across people and entities, deduplication, incremental sync, PII handling, and keeping cost sane at volume.

Roughly **eight to ten two-week sprints** overall, with your load **front-weighted to the first four or five** — allocation may flex above 0.5 FTE during Capture and Connect and settle back afterwards.

**Stage**: active project, start ASAP.

**Part-time, 20 to 30 hours-a-week engagement.**

## What you'll actually do *(example tasks)*

- Stand up **capture by default**: notetaker on every call with speaker attribution, plus ingestion from mail, Slack and messengers — designed as opt-out, not opt-in, and reversible if the client changes their mind.
- **Backfill the archive**: years of historical email, Slack, board protocols, decks and portfolio updates — parsed, deduplicated and dated correctly.
- Build **document parsing** for the awkward long tail: PDFs, scanned board packs, spreadsheets, slide decks, forwarded attachments.
- Implement **identity / entity resolution**: the same person across Slack handle, mail alias and calendar invite; the same portfolio company across a deck, a mail thread and a CRM record.
- Build **chunking and embedding pipelines** and load the vector + graph stores behind the ontology the architect defines.
- Implement **incremental sync** through the connector layer (MCP / Composio-class) — no full re-crawls, no silent drift, clear handling of edits and deletions.
- Attach **access scope and provenance to every record at ingestion**, so permission-aware retrieval and audit are possible downstream rather than bolted on.
- Run **PII detection, redaction and retention** logic; evidence to the client's security function what is stored, where, and for how long.
- Orchestrate with **Airflow / Step Functions**; build **repeatable, monitored pipelines rather than scripts**, with alerting when a source stops flowing.
- Keep **cost and latency under control** at volume — batching, incremental embedding, storage tiering — and report the unit economics.
- Write **runbooks** so the client's own team can operate this after handover.

## Skills

- Strong **Python** and solid **SQL**
- **Unstructured-data pipelines**: transcripts, mail, chat, documents — parsing, normalisation, deduplication
- **Embedding / retrieval infrastructure**: chunking strategies, vector stores (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone-class), plus loading a graph store
- **API and connector integration** at scale: Google Workspace / M365, Slack, CRM; rate limits, pagination, incremental cursors, webhooks
- **Entity resolution / record linkage** (deterministic + fuzzy) without a clean shared key
- **Orchestration**: Airflow, Step Functions or equivalent; idempotent, restartable jobs
- **AWS and/or GCP** data stack; comfortable in a private / VPC deployment
- **PII detection, redaction, encryption and retention** in practice
- Clear written English; documents for handover and works well async in a small distributed pod

## Knowledge

- **GDPR** applied to employee-generated data (mail, chat, meeting recordings) and EU data residency across multiple jurisdictions
- Data **lineage, provenance and audit** patterns — and why an AI system needs them more, not less
- How **retrieval quality depends on ingestion quality** — enough understanding of RAG to make the right upstream choices
- **Well-Architected** security and cost practice; awareness of financial-services expectations — a plus

## Experience

- **4+ years** in data engineering, with real **unstructured / semi-structured** work (not only warehouse modelling)
- Demonstrated experience **integrating many third-party APIs** into one coherent store, including historical backfill
- Experience building pipelines feeding an **LLM / retrieval system** — strong plus
- Experience handling **sensitive personal data** in a regulated or security-sensitive environment
- Comfortable being the **only data engineer** on a small (2.5-FTE) pod, at part-time allocation, without hand-holding

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description:
### General Information 

- **Job Code:** PRO-BD-04T
- **Location:** [Ripple Effect Headquarters – Rockville, MD](https://rippleeffect.com/find-us/) 
- **Employee Type:** Exempt/Full-Time Regular
- **Telework:** Full-time (this role is fully remote)
- **Salary Range:** $92,565 - $113,245 (how we [pay and promote](https://rippleeffect.com/hiring-process/#section-pay)) 

 

### Position Overview 

**Are you passionate about opening doors to new opportunities?**

Ripple Effect is seeking a Senior Pricing Analyst to lead this activity across multiple projects, ensuring compliance with government regulations and company policies. This role involves developing pricing proposals, analyzing information to support bid pricing, and continuously monitoring and updating our pricing processes for optimal performance to achieve our business objectives. You will collaborate closely with executive leadership, business development, project and finance teams, applying strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to drive effective pricing strategy and processes while building strong internal and external relationships. 

**Responsibilities**

- Independently lead the development of compliant, competitive, and financially sound cost and price proposals for federal government, non-profit and commercial opportunities from solicitation review through final submission.

- Analyze solicitation requirements, contract structures, pricing instructions, assumptions, and proposal risks to develop effective pricing strategies and recommendations.
- Develop, maintain, and enhance complex pricing models, cost estimates, and financial analyses to support labor estimates, indirect cost recovery, profitability assessments, pricing scenarios, and business decision-making.
- Prepare cost volumes, Basis of Estimate (BOE) documentation, pricing narratives, assumptions, schedules, and supporting proposal documentation aligned with technical and management solutions.
- Evaluate subcontractor and vendor proposals, perform cost and price analyses, and ensure supporting documentation meets solicitation, compliance, and organizational requirements.
- Perform detailed reviews of pricing models, cost estimates, and proposal submissions by validating formulas, conducting cross-footing and reasonableness testing, and performing vertical and horizontal analyses to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
- Play a key role in our evolution to revise our pricing processes and enable our data to leverage AI assisted tools to best position the company to win its bids.
- Drive continuous improvement through the development of pricing tools, templates, standardized methodologies, and responsible use of analytical and AI-enabled technologies to improve efficiency and proposal quality.
- From time to time, analyze contract plans and financial performance vs. the bid, identify risks and trends, and provide financial insight to support successful contract execution and business outcomes.
- Other related duties as assigned

**Requirements**

**Minimum Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, or a related field
- 6 years of relevant professional experience.

 

**Basic Requirements**

- Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling skills.
- Strong knowledge of FAR, DFARS, CAS, and government contracting principles.
- Experience leading pricing on FFP, T&M, Cost-Reimbursement, IDIQ, and other federal contract types.
- Experience developing pricing strategies and cost proposals for federal contract vehicles (e.g., GSA MAS, GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, and agency-specific contract vehicles).
- Experience developing labor rates, pricing models, subcontractor pricing, contract profitability and price-to-win analyses.
- Experience with Labor Category pricing including GWAC and IDIQ schedule pricing.
- Experience preparing cost volumes, BOEs, pricing narratives, and supporting proposal documentation.
- Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent proposal efforts and meet aggressive deadlines.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
- Exceptional attention to detail, demonstrated ability to execute instructions, and commitment to quality and compliance.
- Intermediate experience with Microsoft Office productivity software and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint.

 

**Skills That Set You Apart**

- Experience designing, implementing, and improving pricing processes, estimating methodologies, pricing standards, and supporting documentation.
- Intermediate experience applying generative AI, automation tools, and structured data techniques to support labor estimating, pricing analytics, proposal benchmarking, and decision-making while maintaining appropriate human oversight and quality controls.
- Experience supporting contracts management function (e.g., NDA, TA, contract negotiation).
- Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning tools (Jamis Prime preferred)
- Experience supporting program financial management, including forecasting, EVMS, EACs, variance analysis, and other program control activities.

**About Ripple Effect**

Ripple Effect is a woman-owned, 200-person company of communicators, scientists, researchers, and analysts. Established in 2003, and [named as](https://rippleeffect.com/recognitions-awards/) one of the “Best and Brightest Companies to Work For” in 2024 and 2025 by the NABR, Ripple Effect has earned acclaim for delivering unparalleled consulting services and top-tier talent across federal, private, and non-profit sectors.

**Benefits**

At Ripple Effect, we reward our employees for their contributions to our mission. Our comprehensive total rewards package includes [competitive pay, exceptional benefits](http://rippleeffect.com/Ripple_Effect_Total_Rewards_Package.pdf), and a range of programs that support your work/life balance and personalized preferences.  

[Learn more about our benefits and culture here.](https://rippleeffect.com/life-at-ripple/#section-careers)

title: Project Manager
description:

***Needing healthcare can be hard — getting care shouldn’t be.***

**We built**[ Luma Health](https://www.lumahealth.io/) **because we are all patients. We believe it should be easy to see and connect with our doctor. To get the care we need, when we need it.**

**So, we’ve created solutions to fix this problem. Our technology makes messaging easier, scheduling appointments more efficient, and it modernizes care delivery from beginning to end.**

In this role, you will act as the central point of contact for our customers during implementation, ensuring a seamless and impactful experience without stepping into solution design or technical architecture.

As a Project Manager, your primary responsibility is to drive successful project execution from kickoff through go-live and transition. You will work in close partnership with our Solution Consultants—who are responsible for system configuration and solution design—to ensure the delivery of value-driven solutions that align with our customers’ goals.

Your focus will be on managing timelines, resources, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout the implementation lifecycle. You are a strong relationship builder who knows how to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and guide stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership.

title: Go-To-Market Manager
description:
**About [AgentShelf](https://agentshelf.ai)**

AgentShelf is an AI operations platform that helps businesses build, run, and govern specialized AI agents across their operations, without writing code or losing control of model costs.

Most companies experimenting with AI hit two immediate roadblocks: unpredictable LLM invoices and a lack of operational boundaries around what models, tools, and sensitive data can touch. AgentShelf solves this by providing a unified control plane. Teams get dedicated agent workspaces, approved business context, and tool connectors, backed by an enterprise LLM gateway with hard token budget caps, prompt versioning, and usage observability.

Alongside our flexible platform, we provide turnkey operational agents—including AI Front Desk, an omnichannel digital receptionist for websites and inbound phone lines that handles visitor questions, captures lead context, and escalates complex calls directly to human staff.

We have live customer deployments in production, strong foundational traction, and we are looking for an entrepreneurial Go-To-Market (GTM) Manager to drive customer acquisition across both our turnkey solutions and the broader AI operations platform.

**The Role**

As our GTM Manager, you will own the commercial execution behind AgentShelf's products. You will sit at the intersection of sales, product marketing, growth experiments, and community distribution.
This is not a traditional corporate management role with layers of delegation—you’ll be rolling up your sleeves to talk directly with early customers, launch on new distribution platforms, test acquisition loops, and turn early product traction into repeatable revenue.

**What You’ll Do**

* Drive Dual-Track Acquisition: Run targeted campaigns for turnkey entry products (AI Front Desk for web + phone) while identifying mid-market accounts that need broader agent workspace governance and LLM cost controls.
* Own Platform Launches & Channel Distribution: Lead launches across Product Hunt, directory ecosystems, developer platforms, LinkedIn, and specialized AI communities to generate high-intent trial signups and demo requests.
* Run Full-Cycle Outbound & Discovery: Reach out to operational leaders, marketing heads, and founders; conduct discovery calls to understand their workflow bottlenecks; and guide them through onboarding and deployment.
* Refine Positioning & Commercial Messaging: Test messaging variants, landing page narratives, case studies, and collateral that clearly communicate the difference between single-purpose AI wrappers and a secure AI operations platform.
* Build Partnership & Agency Channels: Establish relationships with marketing agencies, IT consultants, and automation builders who can deploy AgentShelf workspaces for their clients.
* Inform the Product Roadmap: Act as the voice of the market by synthesizing customer feedback, feature requests, and conversion data directly into product priorities with the founders.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–5+ years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS go-to-market, growth marketing, tech sales, or product marketing (early-stage or founding GTM experience is a major plus).
* Working Understanding of Modern AI: You grasp how LLMs, agentic workflows, API connectors, and model token costs operate, and you understand the real operational concerns businesses face around security and budget.
* Execution Bias: You don't wait for a manual—you test channels, analyze data, iterate on copy, and double down on what works.
* Crisp, Persuasive Communication: Exceptional writing and speaking skills. You can explain technical platform governance to non-technical operators and demo product capabilities with confidence.
* Metric-Driven: Comfortable managing conversion funnels, trial-to-paid velocity, pipeline health, and customer acquisition costs

**Why Join Us?**
* High-Impact Stage: You will directly shape the commercial foundation and trajectory of an early-stage AI company.
* Real Technology, Real Utility: We build software businesses actually use to solve daily operational bottlenecks—not speculative wrapper toys.
* Autonomy & Speed: Work directly with the founding team with minimal red tape, rapid decision-making, and significant ownership.

title: Graduate Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
AiCore helps ambitious organisations move AI from experimentation to execution. That means redesigning real workflows, building practical automations and agents, and helping teams become genuinely AI-capable.

The AiCore Academy is how we grow our Forward-Deployed Engineers. We hire smart graduates who are already building with AI, train them alongside our experienced AI engineers, and then put them in front of enterprise clients to deliver real AI transformation.
You won't spend years in the background. You'll learn fast, with real support, and then do the work: building automations with client teams, running hands-on sessions and helping people use AI in their day-to-day jobs.

We're looking for graduates who can build, explain and bring people with them. You don't need years of client experience. You do need genuine hands-on AI curiosity and the confidence to work with people who aren't technical.

**How the Academy works**
- Learn: structured training with AiCore's AI experts across LLMs, agents, automation tools, workflow redesign and client delivery.
- Shadow: join live client programmes alongside experienced FDEs to see how delivery works in practice.
- Deliver: take on your own client work, building automations, coaching learners and running sessions, with ongoing support from the team.

**What you'll do**
- Help redesign real client workflows into AI-enabled ways of working.
- Coach and support clients one-to-one, from technical teams to people using AI for the first time.
- Run practical, hands-on sessions that turn AI awareness into real adoption.
- Help track the progress clients make, from client outcomes to business results.
- Keep up with new models, tools and techniques, and bring what's newly possible into client work.

**What success looks like**
- You get up to speed quickly and are confidently delivering client work after the Academy.
- Client teams can do AI-enabled work they couldn't do before.
- What you design is adopted, understood and used by the client, not left as a black box.
- Clients rate their experience with you highly.

**You'll be a great fit if you have**
- A strong degree in a STEM subject (Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Engineering, Maths, Physics or similar) from a top uni.
- Evidence of something you've personally built with AI, such as an agent, automation, LLM app or AI-enabled tool. University, personal or internship projects all count.
- Real curiosity about AI, and the habit of testing new models and tools as they come out.
- The ability to explain technical ideas clearly to non-technical people.
- Confidence in front of people, or a strong desire to build it. This role is client-facing.
- Honesty about what you've built, including what didn't work and what you'd change.
- Fluent English and the right to work in the UK.

**Nice to have**
- Internships or project work with real users or clients.
- Tutoring, mentoring, teaching or society leadership experience.
- AI certifications (for example DeepLearning.AI or Anthropic courses).

**What you'll get**
- Structured training from experienced AI engineers
- Real client delivery early in your career
- Competitive graduate salary: 40 - 80k base
- Remote-first working
- A front-row seat in a fast-moving AI transformation market

**Why join**
- Organisations no longer need generic AI awareness. They need people who can redesign workflows, build working automations and help teams actually adopt AI. The Academy gives you the training to do that properly, and the client exposure to do it for real.

**Hiring process**
- Intro call with our Talent Partner, Kris
- Show us what you've built with Haron: walk us through something you've built with AI, including your decisions, trade-offs and what you'd do differently.
- Final Interview with Christian.
- Offer

We aim to move from first call to offer in around two weeks.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
location: Amsterdam; Paris; Berlin; Prague; Tallinn; Warsaw
description:
Hey, I'm [Adrian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/adrian-m-957224153). I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

### Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our [Engineering Blog](https://www.modash.io/engineering).

### What you'll actually own

**1. Make creator search meaningfully better.**

You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them.

**2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence.**

You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience.

**3. Ship new search capabilities into production.**

You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters.

**4. Own the system end to end.**

You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks.

### What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

- **Monday.** A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement.
- **Tuesday.** Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost.
- **Wednesday.** You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators.
- **Thursday.** You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production.
- **Friday.** You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch.

**Requirements**

### What you've done before

- **Built large-scale data or backend products.** You have solid experience working with systems where volume, latency, reliability, and cost all matter.
- **Shipped products from concept to production.** You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, measurement, and iteration—not just one layer of the solution.
- **Designed distributed systems.** You can reason clearly about throughput, failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational tradeoffs.
- **Built LLM-powered or agentic features in production.** You understand the practical differences between models and can balance capability against latency and cost.
- **Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems.** You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and turn incomplete context into forward motion.
- **Communicated clearly across teams.** You can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.
- **Worked in a fast-moving product environment.** You’re comfortable learning quickly, shipping incrementally, and changing direction when the evidence does.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with multimodal embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, ranking algorithms, model deployment, self-hosted models, or GPU infrastructure. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

### Our stack

- AWS and GCP, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
- Python, TypeScript, and Node.js
- PySpark on AWS EMR
- Airflow
- Milvus Vector DB through Zilliz
- Elasticsearch
- LLM batch APIs
- Apache Iceberg
- SageMaker, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora
- Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

### The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

1. Intro chat
2. Coding interview
3. System design interview
4. Team interview
5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

**Benefits**

### What we offer

- **Fully remote in Europe** 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
- **Compensation.** Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 100,000€ - 130,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
- **Flexible hours** ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
- **Unlimited paid vacation** 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
- **Personal development support** 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
- **Real ownership** 💡 Take difficult search problems from idea to production without layers of unnecessary process.
- **Regular offsites** ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a [$12M series A investment](https://techcrunch.com/2024/10/30/modash-is-flipping-the-influencer-marketing-script-by-connecting-brands-with-the-long-tail-of-creators/), and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.

title: Forensic Regulatory Data Analyst
description:
**Forensic Regulatory Data Analyst – Utility Cost Recovery**

UtiliSave's forensic billing analysts find actionable savings in 94% of the accounts they audit — including clients who were previously reviewed by another firm and believed nothing remained. If you have the instincts to absorb complex rules, spot the flaw no one else noticed, and relentlessly pursue a claim you know is right, you will thrive here.

Consider this: a large commercial building billed for peak electricity demand on the wrong interval meter. A university's water charges calculated under a rate code that hasn't applied to its account type for three years. A hospital's natural gas tariff with a weather normalization adjustment misapplied for 18 months. These are not hypotheticals — they are the types of claims our analysts have made, won, and been paid for. Join the team that has recovered over $700 million for large commercial and industrial clients across the U.S. and help us break through One Billion.

UtiliSave has been an industry leader in utility bill auditing services for over 35 years and is still growing rapidly. We are seeking curious, analytical action-takers with strong Python skills to join the team at the heart of our success — playing a key role in deep, forensic utility bill analysis for large commercial and industrial clients.

The core talent this role demands is the ability to rapidly absorb and master detailed billing rules, tariff schedules, demand charge structures, rider provisions, regulatory codes, and client usage data — and then deploy that knowledge creatively to find refunds and savings others miss. The ideal candidate thinks beyond established frameworks: constructing novel, sustainable claim theories that withstand regulatory scrutiny, and expressing those claims persuasively in writing and verbally to utilities, regulators, and clients.

On a typical day, you might write a Python script to flag demand charge anomalies across 40 accounts in the morning and draft a formal claim letter to a state utility commission in the afternoon. This is an ideal entry-level role for someone who wants to become an expert in a rare, financially consequential discipline and to see that expertise translates directly into personal earnings.

**What You Will Build Here**

**UtiliSave is not a lateral move — it is a launchpad:**

·         **3–6 months:** Generating your first confirmed refund claims on live client accounts, guided by senior analysts and our proprietary platform.

·         **12–18 months:** Independently managing a portfolio across multiple utility jurisdictions with a growing track record of recoveries.

·         **24+ months:** High performers advance to Senior Analyst, Practice Lead, or Client Relationship Manager — with expanded compensation and client ownership.

***The expertise you build here — utility tariff law, regulatory billing, forensic financial analysis — is rare and directly monetizable. Few entry-level roles put this much earning power in your own hands this quickly.***  
  
To apply, email your resume and optional cover letter to [recruiting@utilisave.com](mailto:recruit@utilisave.com) with the job title in the subject line. Please include your state of residence, work authorization status, and compensation expectations.

**Requirements**

Please confirm you meet all the following before applying:

·         Full-time remote; core hours 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

·         Must reside in the Eastern Time Zone or Central Time Zone (Missouri, Arkansas, Mississippi, Alabama).

·         U.S. Citizens and active Green Card holders only. Visa sponsorship is not available.

·         Python proficiency required.  
 **Responsibilities**

·         Apply analytical skills and general business knowledge to identify cost savings using UtiliSave's proprietary tools and those you help build in real time — then initiate action to recover those savings for clients.

·         Rapidly absorb and master the billing rules, tariff schedules, demand calculations, rider provisions, tax codes, and regulatory frameworks across each client's utility jurisdictions — using that knowledge to uncover billing errors, misapplied rates, and overlooked credits.

·         Conduct retroactive audits across the full statute of limitations — often six years or more — to maximize the recoverable amount on every client account.

·         Interface with clients, utility companies, tax authorities, and regulatory agencies to implement savings. When utilities dispute or delay valid claims, pursue every available administrative and regulatory channel until the matter is resolved. When escalation is warranted, coordinate with UtiliSave's outside utility-specialized law firm retained at no additional cost to clients to bring the full weight of the firm's resources to bear.

·         Develop novel but defensible claim theories going beyond standard audit playbooks by combining deep tariff knowledge with creative pattern recognition across billing history, meter data, and account classifications.

·         Draft clear, persuasive written claim submissions, client summaries, and regulatory correspondence that make complex billing issues accessible to non-technical readers.

·         Pivot quickly across accounts, jurisdictions, and claim types as opportunities surface, deadlines shift, or utility responses require a change in approach.

·         Maintain meticulous records of all open claims, supporting data, utility correspondence, and recovery outcomes from identification through payment.

·         Collaborate with our MIS group to build tools that improve account review and drive revenue.  
  
**Requirements**

·         1–3 years of experience — or equivalent academic, project, or internship work — demonstrating the ability to rapidly master complex rule-based systems (regulatory codes, tariff schedules, tax law, legal frameworks, accounting standards) and translate that mastery into actionable opportunities.

·         Undergraduate degree completed (or within six months of completion). STEM, economics, finance, regulatory affairs, or pre-law preferred — but candidates from any field are welcome. What matters most: a proven ability to absorb dense, rule-laden material and apply it creatively. Strong hires have included engineers who spot meter anomalies, accountants who catch tax misclassifications, and economists who identify misapplied rate tiers.

·         Proficiency in Python — used daily to extract, clean, and interrogate billing data and to automate anomaly detection across large client portfolios. UtiliSave has invested over $10 million in proprietary analytics infrastructure; your Python skills will extend these systems. Other languages a plus.

·         Intellectually tenacious: you pursue a well-founded claim until it is resolved, do not accept a utility's first "no" as final, and find alternative angles when the obvious path is blocked.

·         Creative and analytically precise: able to construct novel but technically sound claim theories that hold up under regulatory scrutiny — not just surface-level billing corrections.

·         Strong written and oral communicator: persuasive claim letters, client reports, and regulatory filings on the written side; confident presenting findings to utility representatives, regulators, and senior client personnel verbally.

·         Comfortable with ambiguity: utility tariff language is often dense, contradictory, or silent on the precise situation. The best analysts are energized by that gap — because it is often where the opportunity lives.

·         Agile: able to shift rapidly between accounts, jurisdictions, and issue types without losing precision or momentum.

·         Experience with a regulated public utility — especially in rate billing analysis or customer interaction — is a material advantage.

·         Ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.

**Additional Information**

·         **Training:** New analysts complete a paid three-month intensive onboarding process, one of the most comprehensive programs in the utility auditing industry. It is a paid apprenticeship in one of the most arcane and financially valuable corners of regulatory billing law. The pipeline is rigorous by design: every claim we make must be technically sound and built to withstand utility scrutiny. Analysts who commit fully emerge with a rare, market-differentiated skill set.

·         **Growth:** High-performing analysts have advanced to Senior Analyst, Practice Lead, and Client Relationship Manager within two to three years.

**Benefits**

**Compensation & Benefits:**

o    Base: $40,000/year, increasing to $45,000 upon successful completion of auditing skills benchmarks

o    ***Monthly performance bonus beginning after onboarding completion:*** UtiliSave's bonus is tied directly to the refund and savings claims you generate. Successful established analysts regularly earn $1,000–$3,000+ per month in bonuses — bringing total annual compensation for strong performers to $55,000–$76,000 or more. Earning potential grows directly with the depth of your knowledge and the creativity of your claims.

o    Health, dental, and vision insurance

o    401(k) with company match

o    3 weeks PTO plus 11 paid holidays

o    Full-time remote

title: Personal Assistant (Client Relations) 私人助理（客戶關係）
description:
**Location:** Hong Kong  
**Vacancies:** 2  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 09:30–18:30. As the role is home-based, short breaks such as a school pick-up are fine, as long as client calls and meetings are covered  
**Work arrangement:** Mostly work from home, with about 2–4 in-person client meetings in Hong Kong each month, arranged in advance  
**Monthly salary:** HK$15,000–30,000, depending on experience  
**Benefits:** MPF, paid annual leave and medical insurance  
**Equipment:** Laptop and mobile phone provided

**About Wistkey**

Wistkey Technologies Limited is a Hong Kong technology company specialising in private, on-premises AI and digital solutions. We help organisations put technology to practical use while keeping control of their sensitive data and infrastructure.

**The role**

**Ready to return to work? We value your warmth, attention to detail and life experience.**

Wistkey is looking for a friendly, dependable colleague who enjoys communicating with people and follows through on commitments. You will work mostly from home, maintaining client relationships through calls, messages and occasional face-to-face meetings in Hong Kong. Monthly salary is HK$15,000–30,000. Our team handles the AI work, so no AI experience is required. We warmly welcome mums returning after a career break to care for their families; a gap in your CV is no barrier to applying.

Your main focus will be understanding clients’ concerns and making sure they feel heard and supported.

At Wistkey, our team uses AI to handle much of the routine preparation, drafting and administration. You do not need to use AI tools yourself. Your time goes into work that needs a human touch: taking calls, attending face-to-face meetings, building trust and exercising judgement when a client needs help.

As Personal Assistant, you will assist our Director with these client relationships: keeping in touch with clients, attending meetings with or on behalf of the Director, and making sure every commitment is followed up.

This is a mostly work-from-home role. You must be based in Hong Kong and able to attend client meetings locally, which are arranged in advance. Appointment at Executive or Manager level will depend on your experience and ability to take ownership of client relationships.

**What you will do**

- Maintain regular contact with clients through calls, messages and meetings.
- Listen carefully to client needs, answer questions and provide clear, thoughtful updates.
- Attend about 2–4 face-to-face client meetings in Hong Kong each month.
- Understand concerns, manage expectations and coordinate responses with our technical team.
- Follow up on commitments and make sure requests reach the right person and receive a response.
- Work from meeting briefs and summaries prepared by our team, so you can focus on the conversation.
- Handle sensitive conversations and situations that require empathy, context and judgement.
- Recognise opportunities to support clients further and share them with the team.

**What we are looking for**

- A warm, professional communication style and confidence speaking with clients by phone and in person.
- Good listening skills, empathy and sound judgement.
- Reliable follow-through and the ability to stay organised while working from home.
- Native-level spoken Cantonese is essential; conversational English is sufficient. Mandarin is an advantage.
- Discretion when handling confidential client details.
- No technical or AI experience needed.
- Experience in account management, client relations, customer service or a related role is an advantage.

We warmly welcome mums returning to the workforce after a career break, as well as other returners and career changers. You do not need an uninterrupted employment history, and previous work experience is valued even if your career was paused. We value communication, organisation, patience and problem-solving skills developed through previous work, caring responsibilities, volunteering and everyday life.

Manager-level candidates should demonstrate independent ownership of client relationships and confidence handling more complex client situations.

**Onboarding and training**

You will receive structured onboarding and ongoing training on our services, our clients and how we work, so you can settle in with confidence, including after a career break.

**Why join Wistkey**

Full-time work, Monday to Friday, mostly from home, so a school pick-up fits into your day. Enjoy MPF, paid annual leave and medical insurance, with a laptop and mobile phone provided. Build relationships with clients and gain exposure to practical AI and digital projects, while our team takes care of the routine work behind the scenes.

**How to apply**

Apply through the job platform or email your CV to **info@wistkey.com**, using the advertised title as your subject line. Include a short example of how you built trust, handled a difficult conversation or followed through on someone’s request. Examples from previous work, family responsibilities or volunteering are welcome.

Learn more: https://wistkey.com

- 每月約 2–4 次在香港出席客戶面對面會議。
- 了解客戶的顧慮，協調雙方期望，並與技術團隊跟進回覆。
- 跟進已承諾的事項，確保客戶要求交由合適同事處理並獲得回應。
- 運用團隊預備的會議資料及摘要，讓你專注與客戶溝通。
- 處理需要同理心、了解背景及判斷力的溝通情況。
- 留意客戶的進一步需要，並與團隊分享可提供協助的機會。

- 親切、專業的溝通方式，能自在地與客戶通電話及面對面交流。
- 良好的聆聽能力、同理心及判斷力。
- 做事可靠、有交帶，能在家工作時妥善安排及跟進事項。
- 必須具備母語程度的廣東話口語能力；英語能應付日常對話即可。懂普通話更佳。
- 謹慎處理客戶機密資料。
- 毋須具備技術或 AI 經驗。
- 有客戶管理、客戶關係、客戶服務或相關經驗者優先。

**歡迎重返職場的媽媽**

我們歡迎因照顧家庭而暫停工作、現在希望重返職場的媽媽，也歡迎其他重返職場人士及轉職人士。履歷有空白期並不影響申請，即使事業曾經暫停，你過往的工作經驗同樣寶貴。我們重視你在過往工作、照顧家人、義工服務及日常生活中累積的溝通、組織、耐性及解難能力。

申請經理職級的人士，應能展示獨立維繫客戶關係及處理較複雜客戶情況的能力。

**入職培訓**

我們會提供完善的入職安排及持續培訓，讓你了解我們的服務、客戶及工作方式，即使暫別職場一段時間，也能安心投入。

**加入 Wistkey 的機會**

全職、星期一至五、主要在家工作，接送子女放學也可兼顧，並享有強積金、有薪年假及醫療保險，公司提供手提電腦及手提電話。與客戶建立關係，接觸實際的 AI 及數碼項目，日常例行工作則由團隊在背後支援。

**申請方法**

請透過招聘平台申請，或將履歷電郵至 **info@wistkey.com**，並以所申請的職位名稱作為電郵主旨。

請簡單分享一次你建立信任、處理較難的對話，或妥善跟進他人要求的經歷。例子可以來自過往工作、家庭照顧或義工服務。

description:
**Location:** Hong Kong  
**Vacancies:** 2  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
**Working hours:** Monday to Friday, 09:30–18:30. As the role is home-based, short breaks such as a school pick-up are fine, as long as client calls and meetings are covered  
**Work arrangement:** Mostly work from home, with about 2–4 in-person client meetings in Hong Kong each month, arranged in advance  
**Monthly salary:** HK$15,000–30,000, depending on experience  
**Benefits:** MPF, paid annual leave and medical insurance  
**Equipment:** Laptop and mobile phone provided

**About Wistkey**

Wistkey Technologies Limited is a Hong Kong technology company specialising in private, on-premises AI and digital solutions. We help organisations put technology to practical use while keeping control of their sensitive data and infrastructure.

**The role**

**Ready to return to work? We value your warmth, attention to detail and life experience.**

Wistkey is looking for a friendly, dependable colleague who enjoys communicating with people and follows through on commitments. You will work mostly from home, maintaining client relationships through calls, messages and occasional face-to-face meetings in Hong Kong. Monthly salary is HK$15,000–30,000. Our team handles the AI work, so no AI experience is required. We warmly welcome mums returning after a career break to care for their families; a gap in your CV is no barrier to applying.

Your main focus will be understanding clients’ concerns and making sure they feel heard and supported.

At Wistkey, our team uses AI to handle much of the routine preparation, drafting and administration. You do not need to use AI tools yourself. Your time goes into work that needs a human touch: taking calls, attending face-to-face meetings, building trust and exercising judgement when a client needs help.

This is a mostly work-from-home role. You must be based in Hong Kong and able to attend client meetings locally, which are arranged in advance. Appointment at Executive or Manager level will depend on your experience and ability to take ownership of client relationships.

**What you will do**

- Maintain regular contact with clients through calls, messages and meetings.
- Listen carefully to client needs, answer questions and provide clear, thoughtful updates.
- Attend about 2–4 face-to-face client meetings in Hong Kong each month.
- Understand concerns, manage expectations and coordinate responses with our technical team.
- Follow up on commitments and make sure requests reach the right person and receive a response.
- Work from meeting briefs and summaries prepared by our team, so you can focus on the conversation.
- Handle sensitive conversations and situations that require empathy, context and judgement.
- Recognise opportunities to support clients further and share them with the team.

**What we are looking for**

- A warm, professional communication style and confidence speaking with clients by phone and in person.
- Good listening skills, empathy and sound judgement.
- Reliable follow-through and the ability to stay organised while working from home.
- Native-level spoken Cantonese is essential; conversational English is sufficient. Mandarin is an advantage.
- Discretion when handling confidential client details.
- No technical or AI experience needed.
- Experience in account management, client relations, customer service or a related role is an advantage.

We warmly welcome mums returning to the workforce after a career break, as well as other returners and career changers. You do not need an uninterrupted employment history, and previous work experience is valued even if your career was paused. We value communication, organisation, patience and problem-solving skills developed through previous work, caring responsibilities, volunteering and everyday life.

Manager-level candidates should demonstrate independent ownership of client relationships and confidence handling more complex client situations.

**Onboarding and training**

You will receive structured onboarding and ongoing training on our services, our clients and how we work, so you can settle in with confidence, including after a career break.

**Why join Wistkey**

Full-time work, Monday to Friday, mostly from home, so a school pick-up fits into your day. Enjoy MPF, paid annual leave and medical insurance, with a laptop and mobile phone provided. Build relationships with clients and gain exposure to practical AI and digital projects, while our team takes care of the routine work behind the scenes.

**How to apply**

Apply through the job platform or email your CV to **info@wistkey.com**, using the advertised title as your subject line. Include a short example of how you built trust, handled a difficult conversation or followed through on someone’s request. Examples from previous work, family responsibilities or volunteering are welcome.

Learn more: https://wistkey.com

title: Games For Change - Game Development Internship (Unity & Unreal Engine)
description:
**🌌 The Verse — Games & Digital Therapeutics for a Healthier, More Connected World**

The Verse builds games and digital experiences that improve mental health, emotional wellbeing, and human connection. We’re a global community of creators, game designers, developers, artists, scientists, storytellers, and students; united by a shared purpose: to make games that make people healther, happier and more hopeful.

**✨ What We Do**
We design game-based therapeutics, immersive experiences, and playful tools that help people breathe better, feel better, relate better, and grow. Our work blends:
* Game Design + Wellbeing Science
* Emotional Regulation + Prosociality
* Ritual, Story, and Play + 
* Community + Co-creation
**Our philosophy is simple: Human-first. Collaborative. Holistic.**

**💡 The Problem We’re Solving**
We live in a time of polycrisis: rising mental health challenges, loneliness, and disconnection. People need tools that are not only effective, but engaging, inspiring, and accessible. 

**🚀 How We Create Impact**
We move ideas from research → prototypes → tested game experiences in partnership with clinicians, academics, and organizations. Every project aims to foster empathy, prosocial behavior, emotional regulation, and collective wellbeing.

**🎮 What We’re Building**
The Verse builds three transformative game worlds that use play to improve wellbeing and human connection.
* **WalkXR** is an immersive Unreal Engine platform that turns real human challenges into embodied gameplay through storytelling, emotional-regulation mechanics, and ritual-based interaction, with themed “walks” like Power of Music, Diabetes Journey, and Bridging Differences.
* **Adventures in Breath** introduces a new genre of breath-powered play, where players use breathing and humming to explore the magical world of Harmonia, regulate their nervous systems, and unlock sonic abilities.
* **Karma: The Six Realm Game** is a choice-based prosocial RPG that rewards empathy, cooperation, and compassion, inviting players to grow by building relationships, repairing conflict, and using kindness as a core game mechanic.

### Games For Change - Game Development Internship (Unity & Unreal Engine)
**We are an early stage startup with lots of  gaming hats to wear. **
* Game Design 
* Game Development
* Unity or Unreal programmer: able to code/program. Contribute to existing projects and work with The Verse team to create new games and game mechanics. We are always open to new ideas! 
* Story Telling.
* Graphic Design.
* Art Direction.
* Digtal Art & Animation.
* Artists.
* Philosophers.

**Requirements & Skills**
* Technical Mastery: Experience with Unity or Unreal Engine (C# / C++ or Blueprints) to program, refine, and iterate on game mechanics.
* Creative Vision: Skills in storytelling, art direction, 2D/3D digital art, animation, or narrative game design.
* Agile & Multidisciplinary Mindset: Comfortable wearing multiple startup hats—from game design and philosophy to graphic design and user experience.
* Proactive Collaboration: Strong communication skills and an eagerness to contribute fresh ideas, prototype new concepts, and build collaboratively with a team.
 
**🌍 Who Thrives Here**
The Verse attracts people who want their work to mean something:
* Undergrads searching for purpose
* Grad students applying research to real-world impact
* Technologists seeking mission-driven creativity
* Artists & Healers wanting to inspire healing
* Academics craving applied practice
* Builders who want to help shape a “metaverse for human flourishing”

**We receive 100+ applications a month from around the world. People join The Verse because they want to grow, collaborate, and create games for good.**

**💫 Why Work With Us**
At The Verse, you’ll get:
* Impact --> Build games and digital therapeutics that help real people.
* Creative Range --> Work across game design, XR, behavioral science, narrative, data, and more.
* Access --> Collaborate with neuroscientists, clinicians, technologists, and transformative tech leaders.
* Community --> Join a distributed team of 50+ innovators, artists, and entrepreneurs.
* Growth --> We support your development with mentorship, hands-on experience, and strong recommendations.
 
**📣 We’re Looking For People Who…**
Are passionate about gaming for good, prosocial design, XR, wellbeing, art, storytelling, neuroscience, Buddhism, psychedelics, transformative technology, or building a metaverse that actually benefits humanity. If that’s you, we’d love to meet you.

**To apply, send your resume and a note about what excites you about The Verse.**
 🌐 More info: versebuilding.com
 📩 Contact: team@versebuilding.com
**Join us. Let’s build the future of wellbeing—through play.**

Ben Simon-Thomas - Founder The Verse
*Contact team@versebuilding.com for more info and/or with any questions! We are always interested in connecting with the right people*

title: AI Engineer (Agentic)
description: SuiteGrowth builds AI patient communication for UK dental practices. Emma, our WhatsApp receptionist, follows up after appointments, handles reminders and treatment-plan follow-ups, and routes a patient to a human when something is wrong. Eight practices use the live product every day. A wrong answer reaches a real patient, and practice managers tell us about it quickly. We are hiring an AI Engineer to take a reported failure from screenshot to verified fix. You will reconstruct what happened, separate evidence from guesses, direct a coding agent with a tightly scoped brief, review its change, build the regression fixture, and ship through the release checks. The result we need is fewer repeat failures and safer patient messages, not a count of tickets closed or code written. You will work directly with the current engineer and the dentist founders. The product uses TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase Postgres, Vercel, Claude, 360dialog and Dentally. You should have at least two years of professional software experience, be comfortable reading code you did not write, use coding agents as a normal part of your work, and write clear English. A degree is not required. Every shipped change needs a test proved to fail on the old code, a full suite pass, a typecheck at or below baseline, a named rollback command written before deploy, and an adversarial review. You will explain what the evidence proves and what remains uncertain. Passing tests alone do not settle a patient-facing decision. Remote, full time; India preferred. Work is measured by completed tasks and agreed deadlines, which may change during development. Coordinate with the UK team when a task needs it; there is no fixed daily hours block. We will share the current pay range privately before asking you to complete a written exercise. The cross-border working arrangement will be agreed before an offer or paid work. To express interest, do not send a CV. Send (1) a link to one product or code change you personally built, (2) what broke in it and how you proved the cause or fix, and (3) a brief note on how you use coding agents and review their output. Tell us your professional experience and whether you can coordinate with the UK team when needed. If the role and pay fit, the next step is a short hypothetical no-code exercise about a patient conversation, followed by a discussion of your existing work. We will not ask you to do unpaid product work. Any real product task will have its scope and payment agreed before it begins.

description:
### **About Frontier**

**Frontier** is a subsidiary of **Fresh Prints**. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it **Frontier**.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through a couple of internal interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

**Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application!** 😊

**About Bundle**

[Bundle](https://bundleskills.com/) delivers live 1:1 leadership and manager training with expert instructors. No micro-lessons, no click-through tutorials, just real conversations that build skills people actually use. We work with enterprise and mid-market companies across manufacturing, healthcare, construction, and beyond, and we’ve hit our goals six quarters in a row. Now we’re building toward where performance management meets live leadership development.

**Role Overview**

We’re hiring our second SDR hire, and this role is built for a hunter. You will own outbound prospecting at Bundle: greenfield territory, a proven playbook built and validated by our founder, and full ownership of the pipeline you create, from first touch to booking qualified meetings.

This is not a role where leads land in your lap. Marketing generates strong inbound today, but we’re hiring you to build the other engine. The majority of your pipeline will be self-sourced through cold outreach to CHROs, CPOs, and L&D leaders at mid-market and enterprise companies. You’ll work directly with our founder and CEO and our Head of Sales, source alongside them, and shape how outbound works here for everyone who comes after you. If you’ve done the early-stage thing before and want to do it again with a company that’s already working, this is your seat.

**What You’ll Do**

- Build and own your pipeline. Prospect daily through cold calls, email, and LinkedIn; the majority of your opportunities should be self-sourced.
- Drive top-of-funnel engagement: identify target accounts, reach decision-makers, run discovery, and hand off qualified opportunities to senior sales leaders.
- Work from and improve our proven outbound playbook, including message templates, target lists, and pain-point-led outreach.
- Partner with marketing on shared target accounts so outbound and inbound warm the same buyers.
- Hit daily, weekly, and quarterly activity and pipeline metrics.
- Meet and exceed quarterly meeting and pipeline generation goals.
- Track and update all sales activities and contacts in the CRM.

**What You Bring**

- 2+ years of outbound sales or SDR experience where you sourced most of your own pipeline. Be ready to walk us through what percentage of your pipeline you personally generated and how.
- Proven success with cold outreach (calls, email, LinkedIn) and a track record of new logo acquisition in an underdeveloped or under-penetrated territory.
- Experience selling to HR, People, or L&D buyers (CHRO, CPO, Head of L&D, or similar).
- Startup experience at a company under 100 people, ideally as one of the first few salespeople, and a genuine preference for early-stage building over big-company infrastructure.
- Proven track record of meeting activity and pipeline targets.
- Independent work ethic with the ability to problem-solve; outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
- Experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

**Desired Requirements**

- You were an early or founding sales hire somewhere before.
- Past experience at a performance management, leadership development, coaching, or L&D technology company.

**Why Join Bundle?**

- Six straight quarters of hitting our goals, with a validated playbook waiting for you
- Greenfield outbound territory and a direct line to the founder and CEO
- Uncapped Commission
- 100% remote
- Flexible Work Schedule

A fast-paced, high-ownership product team focused on building scalable products that power Tribe's consumer products. The team collaborates closely with cross-functional partners to solve complex problems through clean, efficient, and maintainable code.

As a Product Manager at Tribe

* You strive for excellence
* Good isn’t good enough. You bring focus, precision, and a passion for quality.

High-volume outbound prospecting
Speaking with business owners and decision-makers
Handling gatekeepers and objections
Asking discovery questions rather than delivering a scripted pitch
Qualifying prospects aggressively but intelligently
Booking qualified demos
Consistently following up
Working towards clear activity and pipeline targets

**Must-Have**

1. 1–4 years of experience in B2B Inside Sales, SDR, Lead Generation, Appointment Setting, or a similar hunting role. 
2. At least 6months-1 year of experience making outbound calls to the US market. 
3. Experience selling, supporting, or working with POS systems is required, preferably with exposure to restaurant, retail, or other local-business customers. 
4. Strong understanding of outbound sales and prospecting.
5.  Excellent spoken and written English communication. Strong active listening and discovery skills. Comfortable speaking directly with business owners, operators, and decision-makers. 
6. Strong CRM discipline and ability to maintain an accurate pipeline. 
7. Own laptop/PC or Mac and reliable high-speed internet as its a remote role.

title: Account Management Executive -SaaS
description:
As an **Account Management Executive**, you will own the **entire sales journey start to finish and beyond.** You will take qualified opportunities through discovery, demos, relationship-building, negotiation, closure, and ongoing account management.

There’s no passing the baton here. **Once an account is yours, you own it.** From closing the deal to keeping the relationship strong and the customer engaged, you’ll be the go-to person throughout the journey.

We’re looking for someone who is **sharp, persuasive, commercially savvy, and great with people** someone who communicates with confidence, builds trust, thinks on their feet, stays driven through challenges, and knows how to turn opportunities into wins.

**High ownership. High impact. One person. One account. End to end.**

**What You'll Do:**

- **Take It From “Hello” to “Closed”:** Own the entire sales journey from first conversation and discovery to demos, negotiations, follow-ups, and the final handshake.
- **Sell the Problem, Not Just the Product:** Understand what’s keeping the prospect up at night and show them how Outbox can solve it.
- **Keep the Deal Moving:** Chase the right follow-ups, handle objections, negotiate smartly, and make sure promising opportunities don't go cold.
- **Keep Your Pipeline Clean:** Own your CRM like it’s your dashboard. Keep leads, conversations, next steps, and follow-ups updated—**no lead left behind.**
- **The Deal Doesn't End at “Yes”:** Once the deal closes, **the account is still yours.** Be the primary point of contact, build the relationship, coordinate with internal teams, and make sure the customer gets value.
- **Close. Retain. Grow:** Own your targets and turn customers into long-term accounts.

**The Outbox Rule**

**You don't just close accounts. You own them.**

**From the first “Hey” to “Let’s renew” the account is yours end-to-end.**

**Candidate Profile**

- 1–3 years of B2B SaaS sales experience with a proven ability to own the sales journey end-to-end, from prospecting and discovery to demos, negotiation, closure, and beyond.
- A natural communicator and relationship builder confident in conversations, sharp at uncovering customer needs, and skilled at building trust, influencing decisions, and creating lasting relationships.
- Commercially driven with a strong bias for action you set ambitious targets, create momentum, stay persistent through the sales cycle, and consistently look for ways to move the needle.
- Tech-savvy and sales-stack fluent comfortable using CRMs, sales engagement platforms, automation tools, and data to stay organised, efficient, and ahead of the pipeline.
- Startup-ready mindset curious, adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership, move fast, and bring the energy to figure things out rather than wait for them to be figured out.

**What are we looking for**

- Own it, don’t outsource it. You take responsibility, follow through, and see things to the finish line no handoffs, no “someone else will handle it.”
- Bias for action, with results in mind. You’re proactive, resourceful, and always looking for the smartest way to turn a problem into progress.
- Think fast, communicate clearly. You can navigate challenges, ask the right questions, and keep everyone aligned without creating unnecessary noise.
- Comfortable with the unexpected. Priorities can shift, plans can change, and sometimes the job description goes out the window — you’re happy to step up, adapt, and contribute wherever the team needs you.
- Team-first, growth-minded. You enjoy collaborating, learning on the fly, sharing ideas, and celebrating wins together. You bring the energy, curiosity, and drive to make things happen.

**Screening Process**

We value **transparency, open communication, and a great attitude** just as much as technical skills. We look for people who are curious, adaptable, and excited to take on challenges. Our screening process is designed to assess the **whole person ,not just the resume.**

- **Resume → First Look,**  We’ll look beyond job titles to understand your B2B SaaS sales experience, impact, and what you’ve actually owned.
- **Screening → Let’s Talk,** A conversation around your sales approach, problem-solving, communication style, and how you think on your feet.
- **Sales Deep Dive → Show Us Your Game** , Expect real-world scenarios around selling, pitching, demos, negotiation, and handling the unexpected.
- **Final Round → The Big Picture,** A two-way conversation to see if there’s a strong fit between **you, the role, and the Outbox way of working.**

**The capsule for you to get a call**

- You are a doer, not just a planner.
- Curiosity is your default setting.
- You thrive in chaos (the productive kind).
- You are always looking for a smarter way to do things.
- You would rather create impact than count hours.

**Think you are a fit? Prove it. We are excited to meet the people who don't just dream big, they build bigger.**

**Lets get started!**

title: AI/ML Intern: Agentic AI Systems (Remote - Internship)
description:
### **🎸 AI/ML Intern: Agentic AI Systems (Remote - Internship)**

**Title:** AI Intern: Agentic AI Systems

**Description:**

### **AI/ML Intern: Agentic AI Systems (Remote - Internship)**

Location: Remote (Internship) Duration: **2 months**

**This is a 2-month internship designed to provide you with hands-on experience and professional growth. Upon successful performance evaluation, there is potential to transition into a paid position with Wubble.ai with competitive compensation packages.**

**About Us**
Wubble.ai is redefining the future of music generation with our cutting-edge AI solutions. We have developed a groundbreaking foundation model for generative music—one that is transforming the way enterprises worldwide create and integrate original soundscapes. Our clientele includes global leaders such as Disney, Starbucks, Microsoft, and HP, and we are backed by renowned supporters like Antler, Google, NVIDIA, and more. We are also one of the top 5 startups in Asia!

---

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Agent Architecture & Development** – Design, build, and iterate on core agentic loops, including planning, memory management, and tool integration for our generative music platform.
* **System-Prompt Engineering** – Design and run experiments that improve helpfulness, safety, persona consistency, and latency of our AI agents.
* **Custom Tooling** – Craft utilities (CLI / micro-services) that streamline development workflows and enable new agent capabilities.
* **API Development & Hardening** – Design, version, document, and test the RESTful APIs that power our agents, using FastAPI and enforcing schema via OpenAPI.
* **Agent Validation & Testing** – Build reproducible, data-driven test rigs (unit + simulation) to ensure agent reliability and correctness as part of the development lifecycle.
* **Cloud & CI/CD** – Package components into Docker images, write CI/CD jobs, and manage deployments in GKE / Cloud Run.
* **Documentation** – Maintain clear, detailed docs for every agent, API, and experiment so others can reproduce and build on your work.
* **Collaboration** – Pair with research and product teams to translate high-level goals into functional, shipped agentic features.

---

#### **What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in CS, AI, Data Science, or related field.
* **≥ 1 year hands-on experience building LLM-powered agentic systems** and experimenting with multiple model families (GPT-4o, Claude 3, Gemini, Llama 3, etc.).
* Proficient in Python (type hints, pytest) and FastAPI (or Flask) for production REST services.
* Solid grasp of API design principles: versioning, idempotency, pagination, request/response schemas.
* Comfortable with Docker (multi-stage builds, image optimisation) and basic Kubernetes/GKE or Cloud Run workflows.
* **Builder's Mindset:** A strong problem-solving and product-oriented approach. You are driven to not just analyze problems, but to build and ship solutions that work.
* **Bonus Points:** exposure to fine-tuning pipelines, direct experience with agentic frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex, or building front-end dashboards (React/Tailwind) for internal tooling.

---

#### **Why Join Wubble.ai?**

* **High-Impact Projects**: Work on innovative AI solutions used by leading global brands.
* **Top-Tier Backing**: Collaborate within a well-funded ecosystem supported by industry giants like Antler, Google, and NVIDIA.
* **Cutting-Edge Technology**: Gain hands-on experience building a large-scale generative agent in a real-world production environment.
* **Professional Growth**: Develop your AI engineering skill set under the mentorship of experts, with the potential for a future full-time role.
* **Remote Flexibility**: Enjoy the convenience of a remote internship.

---
### 
### Compensation & Structure:
This is a paid internship with a stipend in the range of $1000-$2000 (SGD) depending on skills, expertise and results


We look forward to hearing how you can help us orchestrate the next revolution in AI-driven music!
