title: Senior Health Economics and Outcomes Scientist
description:
Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people.

As a Senior HEOR Scientist at Virta, you will play a pivotal role in proving and improving real-world health and economic outcomes for millions of patients. You will bridge cutting-edge outcomes research with commercial strategy by analyzing rich clinical and claims datasets to generate publication-grade evidence. Working cross-functionally across the data science, sales, marketing, and product teams, your work will directly shape how health plans, employers, and policy makers perceive and adopt virtual metabolic care.

# Responsibilities

- Lead the strategy, development, and execution of real-world evidence (RWE) programs and health economics models to demonstrate Virta's clinical and economic value proposition.
- Translate complex real-world data (RWD) from health plans, employers, and external data warehouses into actionable operational and health economic insights that drive commercial growth, market adoption, and product innovation.
- Publish findings in peer-reviewed scientific journals and present scientific evidence at national/international conferences, client presentations, and internal meetings.
- Partner cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and product teams to integrate real-world evidence into commercial messaging, clinical care, and product development.
- Serve as an internal subject matter expert, teaching HEOR methodologies to colleagues and advancing organizational research capabilities.

# 90 Day Plan

Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following:

- **First 30 Days:** Onboard with the Clinical Research and Data Science teams, establish an understanding of Virta's data pipeline and existing evidence, and review current research compliance and privacy protocols.
- **First 60 Days:** Take ownership of a claims dataset analysis project, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (Sales/Marketing) to align on evidence needs, and draft an updated HEOR strategy roadmap.
- **First 90 Days:** Complete initial real-world evidence analyses, begin drafting a peer-reviewed publication or conference submission, and establish repeatable, AI-enabled workflows to streamline research and reporting tasks.

# Must-Haves

- Master’s degree or equivalent (PhD preferred) in Health Economics, Public Health, Pharmacoeconomics, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience analyzing claims/clinical datasets, publishing in peer-reviewed journals, and presenting economic outcomes of clinical programs.
- 3+ years of business experience in a startup or high-growth environment, with proven ability to translate scientific evidence for commercial and marketplace applications.
- Proficiency in SQL, Python, R, or SAS for conducting advanced claims analysis and data modeling.
- Successfully designed and implemented repeatable AI-enabled workflows that address team bottlenecks and improve efficiency. For more information about AI usage in our hiring process, see Virta's AI Interview Resources page.

# Values-driven culture

Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if:

- You put **_people first_** and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally
- You have a strong sense of **_ownership_** and take initiative while empowering others to do the same
- You prioritize positive **_impact_** over busy work
- You have **_no ego_** and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience
- You appreciate **_transparency_** and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information
- You are **_evidence-based_** and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma
- You **_take risks and rapidly iterate_**

Is this role not quite what you're looking for? [_Join our Talent Community_](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/virtahealth/form/talent-community-form) and [_follow us on Linkedin_](https://www.linkedin.com/company/virta-health) to stay connected!

Virta has a location based compensation structure. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience. For this role, the compensation range is $172,000-222,000/year. Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at: [https://www.virtahealth.com/careers](https://www.virtahealth.com/careers).

*As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided.*

*As a remote-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco.*

*Clinical roles: We currently **do not hire** in the following states: AK, HI, RI*

*Corporate roles: We currently **do not hire** in the following states: AK, AR, DE, HI, ME, MS, NM, OK, SD, VT, WI.*

title: Junior Product Support Engineer
description:
About the Role:

We're looking for a Junior Product Support Engineer to be the first line of technical support for our customers and internal teams. You'll manage our shared support inbox in Front and help troubleshoot issues with our application, including our proctored exam workflows, which have their own edge cases and time-sensitive stakes.

This is a great fit for someone early in their career, fresh out of school with a degree in computer science, engineering, or math, who wants hands-on exposure to a real production product, direct customer interaction, and a real path toward software development. You'll handle triaging, diagnosing, and resolving support requests, and you're expected to use AI tools to do that faster and better, not just as a novelty. Beyond support, this role is meant to leave real room for engineering work: writing scripts, fixing bugs, building internal tools, and growing your development skills, with AI tools as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


What You'll Do:

* Own and triage the shared support inbox in Front. Respond to customer and internal requests, assign and tag conversations, and keep response times tight.
* Troubleshoot application issues reported by customers, reproducing problems and identifying root cause before escalating.
* Provide real-time support during proctored exam sessions, where issues are time-sensitive and require calm, clear communication under pressure.
* Document recurring issues, known fixes, and workarounds to build out an internal knowledge base and reduce repeat tickets.
* Escalate confirmed bugs to engineering with clear reproduction steps, logs, and context.
* Track patterns across tickets (common bugs, confusing UX, frequent requests) and flag them to the product team.
* Follow up with customers to confirm resolution and close the loop.
* Use AI tools day to day to speed up troubleshooting, draft responses, summarize tickets, and spot patterns across the inbox.
* Spend the rest of your time on the engineering team: fixing bugs, building internal tools, writing scripts, and taking on real development work, using AI tools to move faster and learn faster as you go. This is a genuine, ongoing part of the role, not just a someday perk.


What We're Looking For:

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a related technical field is preferred, but a coding bootcamp or equivalent demonstrated skill also works. Recent grads welcome, this is an entry-level role.
* Solid working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, the language most of our codebase is written in. You don't need production experience, but you should be able to read, write, and debug code on your own, not just with an AI assistant driving.
* Strong written communication. You can explain a technical problem clearly and patiently to someone non-technical.
* Comfort with troubleshooting: reading error messages, isolating variables, forming and testing a hypothesis.
* Flexibility and adaptability. This role spans proctoring support, customer communication, meetings, and coding work, often in the same day, and priorities can shift quickly.
* A calm, methodical approach under pressure. Proctored exams are time-sensitive, and a clear head matters more than raw speed.
* Organized and detail-oriented. This role involves tracking many concurrent conversations without letting things slip.
* Curiosity and a genuine interest in moving toward software development, with real intent to spend spare time building.
* Familiarity and excitement about AI-based development, and genuine interest in using AI tools (coding assistants, agents, LLM-powered workflows) to solve problems faster, both in support and in engineering work.


Nice to Have
* Familiarity with Front, Zendesk, Intercom, or any shared-inbox / help-desk tool.
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) for real projects, not just casual use.
* Experience with a modern frontend framework (Next.js, React, Vue.js, Svelte) and Node.js.
* Modern CSS best practices (CSS Grid, Flexbox, CSS Variables, etc.).
* Experience with SQL, MongoDB, or basic scripting (Python, JavaScript) for digging into data or automating small tasks.
* Any prior customer-facing role (support, tutoring, retail, etc.). Shows you can handle people, not just code.


Why This Role
* Direct, daily exposure to how a real product actually gets used (and breaks) in the field.
* A real path from support into development, with dedicated room to build and grow your engineering skills, AI tools included as a core part of the workflow.
* Small team, high visibility. Your fixes and observations directly shape the product roadmap.

title: FRONTEND ENGINEER
description:
### WHO ARE WE?

https://www.recollab.io

REcollab is the first-ever networking and collaboration platform designed exclusively for the real estate industry. Every deal in real estate requires a rotating cast of varying professionals and coordinators all working in confluence and yet every product in the industry was built for one professional working alone.

Our vision is to unify professional networking, collaboration tools, and a purpose-built CRM into a single integrated platform that should have been built decades ago for one of the most foundational pillars of the American economy. We believe that by equipping professionals with the essential tools they actually need to broadcast their businesses and get transactions done securely, we will empower them to not only expand into new networks, but also operationalize their current ones in a more effective way than they ever have before. We intend to redefine the way professionals connect, collaborate, and close while simultaneously preserving the privacy and best interests of their clients.

### WHERE WE ARE

REcollab is pre-funding. We're building our founding team now so that development begins immediately when our raise closes rather than months later. Candidates we select will receive a written contingent offer, specifying salary, equity, and start date, effective upon close of our funding round. We're being upfront about this because we want people who are energized by building something from the ground floor, and because we'd rather you evaluate that honestly now than discover it later.

### POSITION SUMMARY

The Frontend Engineer is a web development professional with years of experience in building responsive and beautiful frontend applications. This person is a highly-creative individual who is excited to create fast & secure web apps and manage frontend infrastructure. This individual has a strong resolve, excellent communication ability, the initiative to solve problems in a fast-paced startup environment, and is a positive highly-collaborative influence within our lean and motivated engineering team. 

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, self-motivated, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues, and is capable of wearing many hats.

*We are not accepting applicants who do not reside in the United States of America.*

**REQUIRED SKILLS - TECHNICAL**

Below is a summary of the technology skills we need, ordered from highest to lowest priority:

*Vue/Next.js | GIS | NGINX | MongoDB/NoSQL | AWS S3*

For each item below, please be prepared to explain how much of the work you personally performed and in what setting.

* Ability to provide unique, creative strategies for improving UX and UI in a way that makes them feel proud of their work
* Deep familiarity building single-page applications in Vue or Next.js
* Familiarity with building map-based web applications that make use of geographical information systems
* Experience configuring NGINX
* Knowledge of website infrastructure security and scalability in the world of frontend applications (CDNs, caching, etc.)
* Exposure to backend systems
* Experience translating business requirements into beautiful and responsive user interfaces


**REQUIRED SKILLS - PERSONAL**
* Clear written and verbal communication in the English language
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
* Attention to detail and pride in clean, maintainable work
* Self-motivated; works well independently and on a team, capable of collaborating with other engineers and stakeholders on shared technical projects
* Capable of wearing many hats

**IDEAL CANDIDATE WOULD ALSO HAVE**
* Experience designing systems from the ground up
* The willingness to relocate to Chattanooga, TN


*All application decisions will be made by a human.*

title: Software Engineering Intern (Part-Time)
description:
**About Equated**
Equated builds AI accounting software for contractors. We handle sales taxes, job costing, and all the automated bookkeeping that small businesses hate doing by hand. We're hiring a part-time intern to build and refine the AI workflows behind the product.

**Why work here**
A lot of this job is about learning. You'll work hands-on with the founder, see how a startup actually runs from the inside, and sit on the line between engineering and accounting. We'll teach you double-entry, debits and credits, and why sales tax is somehow different in every state. What you bring is the building. And you get real mentorship along the way: weekly 1:1s with the founder to go over your work, talk through what you're learning, and figure out what's next.

**What you'll do**
- Write and refine prompts that do real bookkeeping: categorizing transactions, reconciling accounts, chasing down the numbers that don't add up. When the output is wrong, figure out why and fix the prompt.
- Build and improve AI workflows around messy real-world data from actual businesses. Job costing so a painting company can see what it made on each job. Invoices that don't match. Receipts that make no sense.
- Spot where the automation breaks, dig into the failure, and make it robust.
- Help shape the product. If a workflow is dumb, say so and help redesign it.

**Who should apply**
- Studying computer science, engineering, or something similar, any year. You don't need accounting experience. We'll teach you the accounting part.
- You've refined a prompt, a script, or some automation that wasn't working right, and you enjoyed the debugging more than you'd admit.
- Comfortable with messy data. You've cleaned up an ugly dataset before and lived to tell the tale.
- Big bonus if you've used ChatGPT or Claude to do your homework for you so you could go have fun with your friends instead.
- Can handle confidential info and follow a written review process.

**Logistics**
- $20/hour, W-2, 20 hours per week.
- Hybrid in NYC. Some in-person days each week, the rest remote.
- Ongoing part-time role, not just a summer gig.
- Weekly review with the founder

title: Staff Software Engineer (AI)
description:
## **About Onos Health**

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, 30% of total U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the largest AI-driven healthcare data platform. Our models enables payers to make faster, more accurate decisions across their populations. By guiding members to the right care, Onos is channeling more dollars to high-quality care that drives better outcomes while making healthcare more affordable.

Onos is well-funded by some of the best healthcare investors and is working with the nation’s largest health plans. Come join a category-defining company and help reimagine healthcare for the better.

- Meaningful impact: Help fix what is fundamentally broken in healthcare
- Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep healthcare and data expertise
- Culture: Join a high-performing, transparent, and results-oriented team
- Ownership: Significant responsibility and autonomy from day one
- Opportunity: Play a pivotal role in building a fast-growing, category-defining healthcare AI company

You'll take ownership of developing a significant part of the Onos platform, including the development of models for assessing the level of appropriate care for patients. As an early team member, you'll be expected to wear multiple hats, including acting as a backend/data engineer, while ensuring excellent outcomes for our customers. title: Founding AI/ML Engineer —  AI Broker
description:
At **AI Broker**, we are not just adding AI features—we are building a new way for people to work with financial intelligence, automation, and better decision-making.

Our goal is to create a platform that helps users analyze opportunities, discover useful insights, automate workflows, and make smarter decisions across investing, brokerage, and business operations. AI sits at the center of that experience: helping users understand complex data, interact naturally with information, and execute high-value workflows faster.

We are looking for a **Founding AI/ML Engineer** to help make that vision real.

This is a founder-stage opportunity for someone who wants genuine ownership, technical influence, and the chance to build a company from the ground up—not simply implement features on someone else’s roadmap.

---

## The Founder Offer

### Current Compensation: 10% Founder Equity

This role begins as an **equity-only founding role**. The selected Founding AI/ML Engineer will receive **10% equity ownership in AI Broker**, subject to a formal written founder agreement, company formation documents, customary vesting terms, and intellectual-property assignment.

The equity grant is intended to reflect that this is not a conventional early employee position. You would be joining at a stage where your technical work, product judgment, execution speed, and ownership can materially shape the company’s future.

The founder agreement will clearly document:

- Equity ownership and capitalization treatment
- Vesting schedule and any applicable cliff
- Founder responsibilities and expected commitment
- Intellectual-property assignment and confidentiality
- Decision-making rights and governance expectations
- What happens if a founder leaves or materially changes involvement
- The process for future compensation, fundraising, and dilution

This is a calculated, high-upside opportunity to build something valuable together—not a traditional salaried role with equity attached.

### Target Post-Funding Compensation: Approximately $150,000 Annually

AI Broker’s intention is to transition this role to paid founder compensation once the company has secured sufficient financing and operating runway.

If AI Broker is accepted into an accelerator and/or raises capital sufficient to support founder salaries, the company’s target is to provide this Founding AI/ML Engineer with compensation of **approximately $150,000 per year**, subject to:

- Accelerator acceptance, investment, or external fundraising
- Available company cash, runway, and budget
- The company’s stage, traction, and hiring plan
- Formal approval by the company and its governing body
- Continued active involvement and performance in the founding role

This is a target compensation plan, not a guarantee of future payment before capital is raised or revenue supports it. The company will communicate transparently about fundraising, runway, milestones, and the timeline for moving from equity-only work to paid founder compensation.

### Build as an Owner

Most engineers join after the largest product, architecture, and business decisions have been made. They receive tickets and contribute to a limited part of a larger machine.

At AI Broker, you would help define the machine.

You will have a direct voice in:

- The AI product strategy and technical roadmap
- The architecture behind AI-powered financial intelligence and automation
- The model, data, evaluation, and deployment stack
- What user problems are worth solving first
- Product quality, security, reliability, and scalability standards
- How AI Broker hires and grows its technical organization

You are not joining to add “AI features.” You are joining to help build an AI-native company.

### Early Technical Work Creates Leverage

A strong founding AI/ML engineer can fundamentally change a startup’s direction:

```text
High-leverage AI systems
        ↓
More useful product experiences
        ↓
Better decisions and workflow automation for users
        ↓
User adoption, retention, and differentiation
        ↓
Revenue, funding, and company value
        ↓
Meaningful founder upside
```

The work you do early can have a disproportionate impact on the product, the company, and the value of your equity.

### Shape a Product From Zero to One

This is an opportunity to build real systems that users depend on—from the first prototype through production scale.

You will help create a product you can credibly say you helped found:

> “I built the AI foundation, helped define the product, and turned an early idea into a company.”

---

## What You’ll Build

As a Founding AI/ML Engineer, you will help build the AI foundation behind AI Broker’s products and internal systems.

Your work may include:

- Partnering with product, design, and engineering to identify high-impact AI/ML opportunities
- Building AI systems that feel simple to users while solving difficult problems underneath
- Developing recommendations, natural-language interfaces, agentic workflows, research tools, and decision-support systems
- Creating infrastructure for data ingestion, evaluation, model deployment, monitoring, and iteration
- Designing AI experiences that make financial and business data easier to understand and act on
- Prototyping quickly, then productionizing the systems that prove valuable
- Helping define the long-term AI architecture, model strategy, and technical direction of AI Broker
- Solving novel problems at the intersection of AI, finance, automation, product design, and user trust

---

## What You Bring

We are looking for someone with strong technical judgment and a founder mindset.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

- Deep experience building and deploying production-grade AI/ML systems
- Strong knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, LLMs, and applied AI
- Experience across the full ML lifecycle: data curation, training or adaptation, evaluation, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement
- A track record of shipping challenging systems in recommendations, search, language systems, automation, analytics, or decision support
- Experience adapting, fine-tuning, evaluating, or orchestrating foundation models, language models, or multimodal systems
- The ability to move from ambiguous product ideas to working, user-facing systems
- Comfort making technical tradeoffs among quality, speed, reliability, latency, privacy, and cost
- High ownership, direct communication, and the ability to work effectively in an early-stage environment

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field is welcome, but demonstrated technical ability and execution matter more than credentials.

---

## Bonus Points

- You have built agents that can plan, retrieve context, use tools, and complete multi-step workflows
- You have worked with financial products, market data, brokerage workflows, or decision-support systems
- You understand cloud infrastructure such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloudflare, or comparable platforms
- You have built startup products from zero to one
- You have experience with data-intensive systems, real-time pipelines, evaluation frameworks, or AI safety and reliability practices
- You care about building AI systems users can understand, trust, and use responsibly

---

## How We’ll Work

We want the founder relationship to be ambitious, transparent, and fair.

- **Formal founder agreement:** Ownership, vesting, IP, responsibilities, and departure terms will be documented.
- **10% founder equity:** The role begins with a 10% ownership grant, subject to the final founder agreement and customary vesting.
- **Equity-only at the outset:** Until AI Broker has sufficient revenue or external funding, this is not a salaried role.
- **Target of approximately $150,000 after funding:** If AI Broker is accepted into an accelerator and/or raises sufficient capital, the target salary for this role is approximately $150,000 annually, subject to company runway and formal approval.
- **Shared product ownership:** Founders contribute beyond their narrow function and care about company outcomes.
- **Clear early milestones:** We align on the MVP, launch goals, user feedback loops, traction targets, and fundraising readiness.
- **Technical autonomy:** You will have meaningful authority over the AI/ML systems you build.
- **Honest communication:** We will discuss progress, risks, disagreements, runway, priorities, and compensation timing directly.

---

## The Ask

Join AI Broker as a **Founding AI/ML Engineer** and help create the intelligence layer behind the company.

In return, you will receive **10% founder equity**, subject to a formal written founder agreement and customary vesting terms. You will have meaningful ownership, technical influence, and the opportunity to share in the long-term value created by the founding team.

The role is **equity-only initially**. If AI Broker is accepted into an accelerator and/or raises sufficient funding, the company intends to transition the role to compensation targeted at **approximately $150,000 per year**, subject to funding, runway, company approval, and the terms of the final founder agreement.

**We are not looking for someone to complete a backlog.**  
**We are looking for someone to help build the company.**

•	Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and comfort discussing disagreements constructively.
•	Interest in the business and its users, as well as its technology.

Technology and technical experience
Core skills

Phantom units would provide a contractual right to cash compensation linked to company value or appreciation, subject to agreed conditions. Our intention is to introduce salary when the business has sufficient sustainable revenue or funding. The amount and start date will be mutually agreed upon. No salary start date is guaranteed, and any incentive payout will depend on the conditions in the signed agreement.

title: Deal Operations Consultant
description:
## **About Us**

Sydecar is on a mission to transform the world of private markets. Our goal is to make these markets more accessible, transparent, and liquid, and we're achieving this by revolutionizing the way investment vehicles are created and executed.

At Sydecar, we're not just a platform; we're a trusted partner in venture capital. We're dedicated to simplifying and standardizing the private investing experience, empowering capital allocators to discover and support visionary entrepreneurs who are shaping the future.

Our platform is designed with ease and efficiency in mind. We take care of all the behind-the-scenes tasks, from automating banking, ensuring compliance, handling contracts, managing taxes, to streamlining reporting. This leaves investors the freedom to concentrate on what matters most: making valuable deals and nurturing meaningful relationships.

Join us at Sydecar, as we lead the charge in revolutionizing private investing.

**Location: New York City/San Francisco, CA** (hybrid, 2-3 days/week in office)

## **About the Team**

The Deal Operations team owns the full lifecycle of every deal launched on Sydecar. We are responsible for making sure every deal on our platform runs smoothly. We work directly with fund managers and investors to solve problems, keep timelines on track, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks. We’re the first point of contact when something needs fixing, and we work closely with teams across Sydecar to get the right outcome.

## **About the Role**

As a **Deal Operations Consultant,** you’ll take the lead on some of the most complex or time-sensitive deals on the platform. You’ll work closely with fund managers, support your teammates when questions come up, and help improve how we work. This is a hands-on role where good judgment, clear communication, and follow-through matter. You’ll also help shape how we train, review, and scale this function over time.

This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys staying close to the work, but who also wants to play a role in improving the system around them.

## **What You’ll Do**

As a Deal Operations Consultant, you will:

- Build relationships with our largest and most important customers to execute their deals as smoothly as possible.
- Triage and resolve time-sensitive customer issues—especially those that block deal execution—using judgment, urgency, and clear communication.
- Make fast, responsible decisions in ambiguous situations—and know when to escalate or pull in the right cross-functional partner.
- Identify product and process improvements that will shape the future of our product and our workflow.
- Liaise with senior members of the team, as well as our Legal, Tax, and Product teams to answer customer questions and educate first-time Deal Organizers.
- Develop an expert knowledge of our product, our customers, and our industry.
- Support customer-facing projects and product discovery.

## **About You**

- 4-6 years of experience working in deal operations, customer support, fund accounting, or a similar role that required accuracy, communication, and time management.
- Excited about working directly with customers, especially when something’s urgent.
- Interest and/or familiarity in venture investing and/or back office VC administration.
- Excellent and professional written and verbal communication skills.
- You thrive in fast-paced, customer-facing environments and are energized—not stressed—by helping unblock critical moments in a deal, even when they fall outside the usual schedule.
- Ability to effectively evaluate problems and propose sensible, scalable solutions.
- Comfortable working under pressure and context-switching across dozens of tasks, customers, and workflows in a single day.

## **Bonus if you have**

- Experience working in a startup, fintech, or investment operations role.
- Exposure to fund administration, deal execution, or compliance workflows.
- Experience mentoring or onboarding team members.

## **Sydecar’s values**

***Our values are important to the way we live and work at Sydecar. They guide our priorities, behaviors and interactions.***

**Be Committed**

As a team, we rise to meet challenges and recognize that we become stronger and develop character when facing adversity.

**Be Excellent**

We measure our success not just by what we achieve, but by how we achieve it—through integrity, creativity, elegance, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Excellence is not just doing things well—it's looking for ways to do them better.

**Be Humble**

Humility is our key to personal and professional growth. We appreciate that great ideas can come from anywhere, regardless of seniority, pedigree, or experience. We care more about collective outcomes than who gets credit or who does what. We try to not let our ego cloud our judgment.

**Win Together**

Winning is no accident. It is the result of collective hard work, perseverance, sacrifice, and most of all, loving what we do. Winning requires that we give extra—sometimes winning calls for late nights or extra effort, and we show up for clients and each other with urgency and heart. While excellence is a journey, winning is a destination.

*Sydecar is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Sydecar are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Sydecar will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Sydecar encourages applicants of all ages.*
