**Why Join Crosstie**
Insurance is undergoing one of the largest technology transformations in its history, and Crosstie is helping carriers, TPAs, and self-insured organizations modernize how claims and service work gets done. In this role, you'll have a direct impact on the experience of the people who rely on our platform every day, work closely with an experienced and collaborative team, and enjoy the flexibility of a remote, part-time position with a growing company.

**To Apply**
Please email info at crosstietech dot com, letting us know why you believe you'd be a great fit for this opportunity.

Thanks,

Sean (Co-founder / CEO)

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) & Co-Founder for Quantum computing company
description:
About QuLattice
QuLattice is building foundational software and architectural tools to accelerate practical quantum computing. Focused at the intersection of quantum error correction (QEC), lattice surgery, fault-tolerant compiler design, and hardware-software co-design, QuLattice enables the transition from noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices to scalable, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

As an early-stage co-founder, you will partner directly with the founding team to establish the core technical vision, architect our core IP, recruit elite technical talent, and build the software stack powering the next generation of quantum computing infrastructure.

The Role
As CTO & Co-Founder, you will own QuLattice’s technical strategy, architecture, and engineering execution. You will bridge advanced quantum theoretical frameworks (topological codes, stabilizer formalism, syndrome decoding) with high-performance software engineering (C++, Rust, distributed systems).

Beyond writing code and designing algorithms, you will be a strategic partner in company building—pitching to deep-tech venture capitalists, shaping commercial product roadmaps, and representing QuLattice in the scientific and industrial quantum ecosystem.

Core Responsibilities
1. Technical Vision & Product Architecture
Architect and lead the development of QuLattice’s core software stack, including fault-tolerant quantum compilers, real-time syndrome decoders, and lattice-surgery simulation engines.

Translate theoretical breakthroughs in quantum error correction and topological quantum codes into robust, performant, and production-ready software tools.

Define technical standards, CI/CD pipelines, benchmarking suites, and software architecture to support fast iteration.

2. Team Building & Technical Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead an exceptional engineering team spanning quantum information scientists, compiler engineers, and high-performance computing (HPC) developers.

Foster a rigorous, collaborative, and mission-driven engineering culture focused on scientific precision and rapid prototyping.

3. Strategic Execution & Fundraising
Partner with co-founders on company strategy, milestone planning, and resource allocation.

Co-lead technical due diligence and pitches for venture capital, strategic grants, and non-dilutive deep-tech funding (e.g., NSF, DARPA, DOE).

Establish technical relationships with quantum hardware providers, research institutions, and national quantum initiatives.

4. Ecosystem & Thought Leadership
Serve as a public technical voice for QuLattice at top-tier industry conferences (e.g., QCE, APS March Meeting, IEEE Quantum Week).

Oversee patent filings, IP strategy, and selected scientific publications in relevant peer-reviewed venues.

Minimum Requirements
Education: Ph.D. in Quantum Information Science, Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related quantitative field.

Postdoctoral Experience: At least 1 year of postdoctoral research experience focused directly on quantum computing (e.g., quantum error correction, fault tolerance, topological codes, quantum algorithms, or quantum hardware-software interfaces).

Work Authorization / Citizenship: Must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent Resident (Green Card holder) (required due to export controls, ITAR/EAR regulations, and eligibility for federal research grants/programs).

Technical & Software Rigor: Demonstrated track record developing high-performance scientific software (C++, Rust, or Python) applied to quantum simulations, tensor networks, decoding routines, or quantum circuit compilation.

Builder Mindset: Strong passion for early-stage venture creation, comfort operating with high autonomy under ambiguity, and the ability to balance rigorous scientific theory with rapid MVP engineering.

What We Offer
Founding Equity: Substantial equity stake commensurate with a co-founder role.

Impact: Direct ownership in defining the technical backbone of fault-tolerant quantum computing.

Autonomy: Full authority over technology stack selection, hiring decisions, and engineering methodology.

title: Remote Customer Service Representative
description:
Cali Jewels is a customer-focused jewelry brand dedicated to providing beautiful, high-quality pieces and an exceptional shopping experience. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a friendly, reliable, and detail-oriented Remote Customer Service Representative to join our team.

The ideal candidate enjoys helping people, communicates clearly, and understands the importance of creating positive customer experiences. In this role, you will be one of the primary points of contact between Cali Jewels and our customers, helping shoppers before, during, and after their purchases.

Job Summary

As a Remote Customer Service Representative, you will be responsible for responding to customer inquiries, resolving concerns, assisting with orders, and providing accurate information about Cali Jewels products and services.

You will communicate with customers through channels such as email, live chat, social media, and other customer-support platforms. The successful candidate will be professional, patient, organized, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

This position is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys customer interaction and takes pride in turning questions and problems into positive customer experiences.

Key Responsibilities

    Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries through email, live chat, social media, and other communication channels.

    Assist customers with product questions, sizing, availability, pricing, shipping, delivery, and order-related concerns.

    Help customers select jewelry products based on their preferences, needs, and questions.

    Process and follow up on customer orders while ensuring information is accurate.

    Track orders and communicate relevant updates to customers.

    Handle returns, exchanges, refunds, and other customer requests in accordance with company policies.

    Investigate customer complaints and work toward appropriate resolutions.

    Escalate complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate team member when necessary.

    Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, requests, and resolutions.

    Follow established customer service procedures, brand guidelines, and communication standards.

    Provide a warm, personalized experience that reflects the Cali Jewels brand.

    Identify recurring customer concerns and communicate useful feedback to management.

    Assist with other customer experience and administrative tasks as needed.

    Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and a positive attitude when handling difficult situations.

Qualifications and Skills

The ideal candidate should have:

    Previous experience in customer service, retail, e-commerce, hospitality, or a related field.

    Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.

    A friendly, patient, and professional communication style.

    The ability to listen carefully and understand customer needs.

    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

    The ability to manage multiple conversations or tasks efficiently.

    Basic computer literacy and confidence learning new software and online tools.

    Familiarity with email, live-chat platforms, social media, and customer service systems.

    The ability to work independently while remaining responsive and accountable.

    Reliable internet access and a suitable remote working environment.

    A willingness to learn about jewelry products, company policies, and customer service procedures.

Previous experience with an e-commerce or jewelry brand is a plus, but it is not required.
What We’re Looking For

At Cali Jewels, we believe excellent customer service is about more than simply answering questions. We are looking for someone who is genuinely interested in helping customers and creating memorable interactions.

The right candidate will be:

Customer-focused: You put the customer's needs at the center of every interaction.

Professional: You communicate clearly, respectfully, and positively—even when handling challenging situations.

Reliable: You can be trusted to complete tasks, respond on time, and follow through on customer requests.

Detail-oriented: You pay attention to order information, customer details, product specifications, and company policies.

Solution-oriented: Instead of simply identifying a problem, you look for practical ways to help resolve it.

Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new tools, processes, products, and responsibilities as the company grows.

Team-oriented: Although this is a remote position, you understand the importance of communication, collaboration, and supporting your colleagues.

Remote Work Requirements

Because this is a remote position, candidates must have:

    A reliable internet connection.

    A computer capable of handling customer service and communication platforms.

    A quiet and professional workspace.

    The ability to maintain consistent availability during scheduled working hours.

    Strong time-management skills and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

Depending on business needs, the role may require availability during specific shifts, including weekends or holidays.

Why Join Cali Jewels?

Joining Cali Jewels means becoming part of a growing brand where customer experience plays an important role in our success. You will have the opportunity to work remotely, develop valuable customer service and e-commerce skills, and contribute directly to the relationship between our brand and our customers.

We value professionalism, initiative, reliability, and a genuine commitment to helping others. If you enjoy connecting with customers and want to build your experience in a growing jewelry and e-commerce environment, we would love to hear from you.

How to Apply

If you are enthusiastic about customer service, communicate exceptionally well, and believe you would be a great fit for Cali Jewels, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your resume/CV along with a brief introduction explaining your customer service experience and why you are interested in joining Cali Jewels.

Cali Jewels is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing a respectful and inclusive working environment.

title: Global Client Director (Media, Entertainment, Gaming, & Sports)
description:
Qumulo's cloud data platform manages exabytes of the world's most demanding data, unifying files, objects, and every workload across edge, core, and cloud - including for many of the biggest names in Media, Entertainment, Gaming, and Sports.  
  
**About the Position:**  
Qumulo is growing our global Media, Entertainment, Gaming, and Sports business, and we're looking for an experienced leader for our MEGS sales team.

In this role you'll set the go-to-market plan for the vertical while stay in the deals as a player-coach, working with your reps in front of CTOs and the broadcast, production, and infrastructure leaders who buy at studios, broadcasters, post houses, sports leagues, and teams.

9 of the world's top 10 media and entertainment companies already trust Qumulo because it makes the cloud feel local - we give distributed creative teams real-time access to one shared copy of their media, from ingest to playout, whether it lives on-prem or across any cloud. Qumulo has been a Magic Quadrant Leader for File & Object Storage Platforms for 7 years running, won Best of Show at NAB 2026, and recently had a great turnout at IBC.

**As our Global Client Director for MEGS, you will:**

- Own and grow the global number for our Media, Entertainment, Gaming, and Sports business, including the forecast, the coverage model, and the headcount plan.
- Manage our MEGS vertical as if it was your own business, down to the P&L
- Hire, retain, and coach a small team of senior account executives working through long enterprise sales cycles in a niche space
- Build and grow executive relationships at studios, broadcasters, leagues, and teams, and sell as a player-coach on new-logo pursuits
- Drive complex HW/SW, cloud, and hybrid cloud sales involving OEMs, resellers, and cloud partners.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to align customer needs with the roadmap and run targeted account-based marketing.
- Be the face of Qumulo in the MEGS vertical and at industry events such as NAB, SVG, and SMPTE.

**And our ideal Global Client Director will have:**

- 10+ years experience selling complex technology (such as storage, cloud, infrastructure, data management or data protection, video, streaming, broadcast, or media asset management) into sports, media, broadcast, entertainment, or production organizations.
- Direct experience managing high-performance sales teams with a hands-on, player/coach model, including a track record of beating quotas
- A track record of landing major new logos through generated demand, not just partner-led or inbound pipelines.
- Fluency in how broadcast and production environments actually work, from ingest to playback, ideally with a focus on media workflows.
- Existing relationships with global media, entertainment, sports leagues or teams, or broadcast organizations
- The ability to travel across North America and globally for customer meetings and industry events.
- Bonus points for being active in NAB, SVG, or SMPTE, and/or having sold file or unstructured data storage solutions

The annual On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this role is $400,000 - $500,000 USD on an uncapped commission plan that leads the industry. Individual pay depends on various factors, such as role level, relevant experience and skills.

**Benefits & Perks:**

- Pre-IPO stock options
- Flexible time-off policy
- HSA and PPO health insurance options
- Dental and Vision insurance
- 401(k) plan

**About Qumulo:**  
Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations.

With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission-critical workloads anywhere real-time access to massive file datasets is non-negotiable. Qumulo delivers radical simplicity, hardware freedom, exceptional customer support, and a true hybrid-cloud architecture.  
  
**Our Values:**   
At Qumulo, we are building an open and collaborative culture where people can do their best work with customers as our magnetic field. We act as owners, we share by default, we are data driven and experimental and as an inclusive workplace, we encourage and celebrate multiple points of view. As part of our culture we believe diversity drives innovation.  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**  
Qumulo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law. For more information on Qumulo's Applicant Privacy Policy, please visit: [https://qumulo.com/applicant-employee-privacy-notice](https://qumulo.com/applicant-employee-privacy-notice)

title: React Native Developer
description:
**About Us**

As a company, we provide product development for startups and high-growth companies. This means you’ll work with multiple cutting-edge technologies while enjoying a stable job. We value our employees and offer an intellectually stimulating, no-nonsense environment where everyone's ideas and contributions are encouraged and respected. 
We are looking for a talented and passionate React Native Developer with a strong foundation in native Android and/or iOS development to join our team. You will work on exciting projects across both mobile platforms, using technologies like React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, and more.

**About You**

* You have 3+ years of experience in Android and/or iOS development and 2+ years of production-level experience with React Native.
* You are highly proficient in JavaScript/TypeScript and have a strong understanding of asynchronous programming, the JavaScript event loop, promises, async/await, and modern state management patterns.
* You have hands-on experience with modern React Native architecture and best practices, including Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Context API, React Query/TanStack Query, and scalable project structures such as Clean Architecture, modular architecture, or feature-based architecture.
* You understand platform-specific behaviours on Android and iOS and are comfortable integrating React Native with native code using Native Modules, TurboModules, and JSI when required.
* You have experience working with native Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and/or native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) development, and understand how React Native integrates within hybrid or existing native applications.
* You are comfortable building responsive and adaptive mobile user interfaces across different screen sizes and devices, with experience optimizing layouts for phones and tablets.

**You have worked with:**
* RESTful APIs (including authentication flows such as OAuth, JWT)
* GraphQL (nice to have)
* Third-party SDKs and payment gateways
* Push notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging / APNs)
* You have experience interfacing with device capabilities such as:
* Camera, media handling
* GPS and geolocation services
* Background services and permissions
* Bluetooth / NFC (nice to have)
* You understand mobile app performance optimization (rendering performance, memory usage, frame drops, Flipper, Hermes profiling, Android Studio Profiler, Xcode Instruments).
* You have built apps supporting offline-first functionality, local persistence (AsyncStorage, MMKV, SQLite, or Realm), and data synchronization strategies.

**You are familiar with:**
* CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Codemagic, Fastlane, or similar tools.
* Automated builds and store deployment (Google Play Console, App Store Connect)
* Code signing and store compliance requirements
* You write clean, maintainable, testable code and have experience with:
* Unit testing (Jest)
* Component testing (React Native Testing Library)
* End-to-end testing (Detox or Maestro)
* You are proficient with Git-based workflows (GitFlow or trunk-based development).
* You understand the complete mobile development lifecycle: discovery, architecture design, development, QA, release, monitoring, and post-launch iteration.
* You are comfortable working in agile environments and collaborating with designers, backend engineers, QA, and product stakeholders.
* You demonstrate strong communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.

**Nice to have:**
* Experience with Hermes for performance optimization and debugging.
* Experience with Expo and the Expo ecosystem (where applicable).
* Familiarity with deep linking and universal/app links.
* Experience integrating Firebase services, including Analytics, Crashlytics, and Remote Config.
* Experience implementing over-the-air (OTA) updates using CodePush or Expo Updates.

**What do we offer?**
* We have an open and honest culture. As part of our team, you will get to contribute to our ideas, our plans, and our success
* We treat you with respect (and trust you will do the same to your team members)
* We hire carefully - our hiring process results in getting people with the right attitude on board
* Your credentials are not as important as your skills, your attitude, and your motivation
* We promise you opportunities to master new and interesting technologies

title: Solutions Consultant
description:
# **Solutions Consultant**

*Location: Remote (Canada or U.S.)*

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.  
  
We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement.

We're hiring an experienced **Solutions Consultant** to be the technical and domain authority on our sales team. This is the person who can walk into a room with a VP of Finance or a Controller, diagnose their procurement and AP pain points in minutes, and show (not just tell) why Procurify is the better platform. The role partners closely with our CRO, VP of Sales, and Executive Leadership Team to help shape how we win competitive deals.

##   
**About the Role**

This is not an entry-level pre-sales seat. We're looking for someone who has already sold or consulted against the players in our space or similar procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation providers. You'll know how to position a challenger platform to win, and you'll own the technical and domain narrative across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in the mid-market and lower-enterprise segment, partnering closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing.

This role sits at the intersection of deep domain expertise, competitive strategy, and consultative selling. Success looks like shorter sales cycles, higher win rates against named competitors, and a Sales org that is measurably sharper because of the enablement and positioning you bring.

## **What You'll Do**  

### **Domain & Competitive Expertise**

- Serve as the subject-matter expert on Procurify's platform and on the broader procure-to-pay, spend management, and AP automation landscape.
- Maintain current, detailed knowledge of key competitors and translate that intelligence into sharp, defensible competitive positioning for Sales and Marketing.
- Codify win/loss themes, battlecards, and objection-handling assets so the whole Sales team benefits from what you learn in the field.
- Partner with Product Management to relay competitive gaps, market feedback, and integration needs, and help prioritize what gets built next.

### **Discovery & Demo Excellence**

- Lead structured, consultative discovery to uncover a prospect's procurement and AP workflows, technical environment, and business drivers.
- Design and deliver compelling, story-driven demos that connect Procurify's capabilities to the prospect's stated business case.
- Build and maintain a reusable library of demo environments, vertical-specific narratives, and proof points that scale across the team.
- Conduct technical scoping for both out-of-the-box integrations and custom API integrations to client ERP and accounting systems (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks).

### **Sales Cycle & Deal Support**

- Partner with Account Executives through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, acting as the technical and strategic co-pilot on every deal that needs one.
- Own RFP/RFI responses, security and IT questionnaires, and solution documentation that build prospect confidence and speed up procurement decisions.
- Present to and influence economic buyers and executive stakeholders, including CFOs, Controllers, and VPs of Finance and Procurement, translating technical capability into strategic, financial value.
- Qualify potential customers while understanding and solving their complex workflow and approval-routing questions.

### **Cross-Functional Impact & Enablement**

- Help ramp new Sales hires on demo delivery, discovery technique, and competitive positioning.
- Get new clients set up for success by enhancing their understanding of the platform and services ahead of handoff to Customer Success.
- Contribute market, competitive, and win/loss perspective to Procurify's Product Team
- Other related duties as assigned.

## **Who We're Looking For**

- **4+ years** in a Solutions Consultant, Sales Engineer, or Pre-Sales Consultant role in B2B SaaS, with strong preference for candidates coming from a procure-to-pay, spend management, or AP automation provider
- Deep, hands-on domain knowledge of procurement and accounts payable workflows, purchase-to-pay cycles, approval routing, and financial controls.
- A proven track record running discovery and delivering demos that have influenced complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise or mid-market deals.
- Direct experience competing against, or working at, the providers named above, with the ability to speak credibly and specifically to how Procurify differentiates.
- A consultative, curious, quick-thinking approach: diagnose the business problem first, then map the technical solution.
- Experience owning technical workstreams within full sales cycles, including RFPs, security reviews, technical scoping, and executive-level presentations.
- Comfort with ERP and accounting system integrations and API concepts; able to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the presence to influence a room of executive stakeholders.
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.

## **Why Procurify?**  

### **Help us modernize spend management**
 

Procurify is redefining how organizations manage spend - transforming a historically manual, reactive process into a strategic advantage. Today, hundreds of companies trust us to manage billions in spend, and we’re just getting started.

 

Powered by our $50M Series C funding, we are actively expanding our core offering, launching new payment capabilities, and building an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience for our customers. Read the press release [_here_](https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/). With fresh investment, a strong product foundation, and big ambitions in AI and payments, we’re entering our next phase of growth. That means a real opportunity to shape what we build, how we scale, and the impact we have on our customers.

 

The best part? The team. We’re a group of builders who move fast, think big, and show up for each other. No egos, no passengers, just people who want to do great work and win together.

 

If you’re looking for a place where you can make a real impact alongside a team that raises the bar, you’ll fit right in.

### **Be empowered to do your best work**

We've created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

- **Flexible working:** We're a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada or the US!
- **Responsible time off:** We trust our team to take the time they need to rest and recharge while staying accountable to their commitments.
- **Extended health benefits:** We prioritize our team's health and well-being with a competitive health, vision, and dental package, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.
- **Community initiatives:** A strong commitment to giving back, including regular volunteer days, our Donate Your Day program, and education lunch and learns.
- **Stock options:** Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.
- **On Target Earnings Range:** $100,000-110,000 CAD OTE & $105,000-115,000 USD OTE (Range is dependent on experience, with a component of these earnings made up of variable pay, and not inclusive of any benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package.)

### **Work with an amazing team**

We've welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we're here to embrace them!

## **Learn More**

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

 

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.

 

Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.

 

To learn more about Procurify, check out these resources:

- Check out [_what our customers are saying about us_](https://www.procurify.com/testimonials)
- Learn more about our [_procure-to-pay platform_](https://www.procurify.com/product/)

title: GTM Lead
description:
# **GTM Lead**

Latitude is an early‑stage payments fintech building modern infrastructure for global money movement. We help businesses move value instantly, securely, and with full compliance-leveraging blockchain rails while delivering a seamless, enterprise‑grade experience.

Our team has built and scaled payments and financial infrastructure at Uber, Coinbase, Stripe, Amazon, and Facebook-bringing deep experience across fintech, marketplaces, and global‑scale systems. In January 2025, we [raised an $8M seed round](https://fortune.com/2026/03/31/exclusive-former-stripe-and-coinbase-employees-raise-8-million-for-latitude/?for40f=) led by NEA, with participation from Lightspeed Faction, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, Bitso, Solana Ventures, and others. We've since raised a $35M Series A led by [Oak HC/FT](https://www.linkedin.com/company/oak-hc-ft-partners/), with participation from existing investors [New Enterprise Associates (NEA)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/new-enterprise-associates/), [Coinbase](https://www.linkedin.com/company/coinbase/), and [Faction VC](https://www.linkedin.com/company/factionvc/), and new investors [Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati](https://www.linkedin.com/company/wilson-sonsini-goodrich-&-rosati/) and [OpenFX](https://www.linkedin.com/company/openfx/) -bringing our total raised to $43M.

We're looking for our first GTM hire: a senior, well-connected hunter who can open doors, run a technical sale end-to-end, and close new business.

**Location: NY**

## **The Role**

To date, the founders have led sales, but from here, you’ll lead with their support. You'll own new business: sourcing, qualifying, building the technical case, negotiating, and closing.

There is no SDR team; you will be responsible for building the pipeline and writing the playbook as you go.

Our buyers are technical. On a first call, you may be talking to a founder, a CTO, or a payments lead who wants to understand our funds flow in a specific corridor and which entity is the transmitter of record. You should be able to hold that conversation credibly on your own and pull in engineering for depth vs initial scoping.

You'll have the opportunity to:

- **Own new business.** Source, qualify, and close. Carry a number against a pipeline you built yourself.
- **Sell to technical buyers.** Speak fluently about APIs, settlement timing, corridor coverage, FX pricing, and compliance requirements. Know when the honest answer is that we don't support something yet.
- **Work your network.** Our best pipeline comes from relationships. You should arrive with real ones across fintech, marketplaces, and crypto, and be willing to use them in week one.
- **Shape the commercial motion.** Pricing, terms, ICP, and what a repeatable deal actually looks like. You'll be building the motion while you're running it.
- **Drive Product Feedback.** What you hear in deals should shape roadmap, corridor prioritization, and partner strategy. You'll have a direct line to the people who can act on it.
- **Represent Latitude externally.** Conferences, panels, and partner meetings. You'll often be the first person a prospect meets.

## **What We're Looking For**

### **Required**

- **5+ years in enterprise or platform sales,** with a documented record of closing new logos, not managing renewals, and not managing a team.
- **Domain expertise in a few of our core areas:** cross-border payments, crypto on/off ramps or infra, FX, domestic payment rails, and card issuing/acquiring.
- **Technical fluency.** You can run a technical discovery call without an engineer in the room and are leveraging the latest AI tools to supplement your sales process.
- **A real network.** Relationships you can activate among fintechs, neobanks, marketplaces, PSPs, remittance companies, and crypto platforms.
- **Hunter mentality.** You're energized by developing a pipeline and a lack of support functions.
- **Gravitas.** You can hold a room with a founder or a CFO and be taken seriously: strategic in the meeting, not just personable.
- **Startup Experience.** You've sold somewhere small and fast, where the collateral you needed didn't exist yet.
- **Strong writing.** Proposals, follow-ups, and deal memos that build the buyer's internal case.

### **Preferred**

- Experience selling global products
- One of the first sales hires at an early-stage company
- Experience selling licensed or regulated infrastructure, where compliance is part of the pitch
- Existing relationships in crypto, fintech, PEO and payroll platforms, marketplaces, and remittance providers.
- Disciplined with CRM hygiene and modern sales tooling

## **Why Latitude?**

- **Rare leverage.** Early hires at companies like this are rare. You'll own your function from day one, with direct access to the founders and no layer between you and the decisions.
- **Infrastructure that matters.** We're taking on a massive market with real traction behind us, building the rails that make global payments faster and more accessible. And you'll do it alongside a team that has already built this category of system at Stripe, Coinbase, Uber, and other great companies.

## **Benefits**

At Latitude, we believe success starts with our people: healthy, inspired, and empowered to thrive both in and outside of work. We offer:

- Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance with generous company contributions
- Meaningful early-stage equity and a 401(k)
- Unlimited PTO and 10 paid federal holidays
- Flexible remote work within the United States

Latitude is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

title: Software Engineer, Engineering Acceleration
description:
## **Our Mission**

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: **procurement** – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger **50+ emails**, and pull in **Finance, Legal, Security, and IT** just to get something approved.

We’ve raised **$75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners,** and **Accel** to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. **Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it**. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the [**_4th fastest growing startup_**](https://sifted.eu/leaderboards/sifted-future-50-2025) in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

**Our team previously scaled Tessian** (**cybersecurity tech,** backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel**,** acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like [**_Ben_**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ben-freeman-a8542166/), [**_Abs_**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhirukt/), [**_Sabrina_**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/scastiglione/), and [**_Rebe_**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rebecatristan/).

## **Find out more about the team and life at Omnea** [**here**](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb)**.** 

## **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for software engineers to join Engineering Acceleration, one of the teams in Omnea's Platform Engineering department, building the tools and infrastructure that help Omnea's engineers develop, test and ship software.

Engineering Acceleration develops and operates the systems that support AI-assisted software development: agent tooling, context management, development environments and automated validation. You'll work across application code and infrastructure, improving existing systems and building new capabilities.

You'll likely come from product or backend engineering, though developer tooling experience is a plus. What matters is strong software engineering ability, practical infrastructure experience and an interest in making other engineers more effective.

## **What You'll Do**

- **Build systems for AI-native software engineering.** Develop the tooling and infrastructure that enable engineers to delegate substantial engineering work to agents, spanning investigation, implementation, testing and code review. Improve the context, execution environments and feedback available to agents so they can complete increasingly complex tasks reliably.
- **Improve development and testing environments.** Develop the infrastructure that allows engineers and agents to reproduce problems, run applications and verify changes. Improve development environments, previews and automated validation.
- **Evaluate quality and impact.** Build evaluations for agent behaviour and test changes to context, tools and configuration against representative engineering tasks. Measure the effect on correctness, review effort, reliability and cost before wider rollout.
- **Identify and address engineering bottlenecks.** Work with engineers across Omnea to identify friction in development, testing and delivery. Prioritise improvements based on their impact on engineering productivity and software quality, and measure the results.
- **Lead tooling selection and adoption.** Assess emerging tools and make build-versus-buy decisions based on capability, integration effort and long-term maintenance. Spearhead the selection and rollout of an agentic development platform (ADP), giving engineers a single interface for tooling and agent management.
- **Own systems through delivery and operation.** Take responsibility for technical design, implementation, deployment and ongoing operation. Build for reliability and maintainability, with appropriate observability, access controls and recovery mechanisms.

## **What Can You Expect?**

- **Join the team early.** Help shape and invent how engineers and agents design, build and verify software at Omnea. You'll be an integral part of deciding the team's technical direction, develop new approaches and own projects from experimentation through to adoption across engineering.
- **Work directly with your users.** You'll collaborate with Product engineers and the other Platform Engineering teams to understand their requirements and evaluate the impact of your work.
- **Work across the stack.** Our stack includes TypeScript, React, Postgres and AWS serverless infrastructure, with SST, Pulumi, GitHub Actions and Datadog.

##   
**About You**

- **Strong software engineering fundamentals.** You have experience designing, shipping and operating production software. You bring sound judgement to system design, testing and reliability, and can diagnose failures across application and infrastructure boundaries.
- **Practical AWS serverless experience.** You've built or maintained serverless infrastructure on AWS, deployment pipelines or development environments. You understand the trade-offs around access control, isolation, observability, reliability and cost.
- **Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development.** You've applied coding agents to software development and understand their capabilities and failure modes. You have practical experience with the context, tools and verification needed to use them effectively.
- **Product engineering background.** You've worked as a product engineer shipping user-facing features, and you bring that mindset to internal tooling. You can translate developer needs into well-designed tools and services. You evaluate success through adoption, user feedback and measurable improvements to the development process.
- **Independent execution.** You can scope ambiguous technical problems, assess alternatives and deliver projects without a detailed specification. You make considered trade-offs between delivery speed, reliability and long-term maintenance.
- **Effective collaboration.** You communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, work constructively across team boundaries and incorporate feedback into your approach. You share knowledge and contribute to the engineering practices of the wider team.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

## **A few things to note:** 

- We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our [**UK Benefits Package** here](https://www.notion.so/omnea/UK-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781c39d08ee947693506f) and our[**US Benefits Package** here](https://www.notion.so/omnea/US-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781b49890e725794c0af1).
- We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move [here](https://www.omnea.co/documents/why-omnea-is-not-fully-remote)
- We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really **impressive**. You can see our values [here](https://www.omnea.co/careers) and our Omnea Future Founder's fund [here](https://news.crunchbase.com/startups/omnea-funding-employees-future-founders-freeman/)!
- We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

### Legal note: if you are viewing this posting outside of the Omnea careers' page, this may be an auto-generated advertisement and may lack the full range of advertised information - please click through to the posting at [https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/omnea](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/omnea) to view additional advertised information on this posting.   
Additionally, where roles have hard-specified requirements (e.g. [x] days in office, unable to provide visas, etc), if in your application you provide deterministic check-box confirmation that you do not meet the hard-specified requirements, deterministic (not AI or subjective) automatic rejection criteria are in place.

title: Graph Data Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Vieu is building a best-in-class knowledge graph; collecting, analyzing, and indexing billions of entities and relationships to power revolutionary experiences in the Sales space. Engineers at Vieu contribute across the stack from data pipelines to user interfaces to deliver powerful, intuitive experiences which unlock new opportunities for our customers. 

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Graph Data Engineer to design and build large-scale data pipelines that transform unstructured web data into structured, searchable knowledge systems. 

You will be foundational in architecting our data platform from scratch. You will help scale our data systems to handle millions of data points daily. 

You’ll work at the intersection of: 

* Data engineering 
* Distributed systems (Spark/Flink) 
* NLP & entity extraction 
* Web scraping & automation 
* Vector search & graph-based intelligence 

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building scalable pipelines that power intelligent data products. 

 **What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain scalable ETL/data pipelines for large-scale structured & unstructured datasets 
* Design distributed processing workflows using Apache Spark or Apache Flink 
* Develop web scraping and crawling frameworks using Selenium, Puppeteer, or similar tools 
* Implement entity extraction, NLP pipelines, and feature engineering workflows 
* Integrate data into Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Vector Databases 
* Design data models for graph-based and search-based applications 
* Optimize pipeline performance, reliability, and monitoring (Airflow or equivalent orchestration) 
* Collaborate with ML engineers to support model training & evaluation workflows 
* Ensure data quality, cleaning, and validation at scale 

 **What We’re Looking For**

**Core Requirements:**

* 3–7+ years in Data Engineering & backend systems. 
* Build multiple systems from scratch in a fast-paced environment 
* Experience working with large-scale data processing of 100M+ nodes 
* Hands-on experience building ETL pipelines 
* Experience with Airflow or workflow orchestration systems 

**Strong Plus**

* Experience with Python/Typescript
* Experience with NLP / entity extraction pipelines 
* Strong experience with Apache Spark or Apache Flink 
* Experience building web scraping / crawling systems 
* Familiarity with Elasticsearch / OpenSearch 
* Experience with Vector Databases 
* Exposure to graph data modeling or knowledge graph systems 
* Experience with ML lifecycle: feature engineering, model evaluation, deployment & monitoring of the final system  

**What Makes This Role Interesting**

* Work on real-world unstructured data at scale 
* Build graph-powered intelligence systems 
* High ownership across data ingestion → extraction → indexing → ML enablement 
* Opportunity to shape foundational data infrastructure

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Who We Are:**

We build infrastructure that delivers massive amounts of web data to the companies training the world’s most powerful AI models.

We're the team that helps to power and support Grass, a bandwidth-sharing network that lets us operate a massive distributed crawler, giving us unique access to high-quality public web data at global scale. On top of that, we’ve built pipelines for ingesting, segmenting, and annotating billions of videos, transcripts, and audio files, powering dataset creation for frontier labs.

We’re lean, technical, and move fast. No red tape, no slow decision-making; just a team of builders pushing to expand what’s possible for open web data and AI.

**The Role:**

We are seeking a Data Engineer to support and improve large-scale data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll work across data collection, processing, transformation, validation, and delivery, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.  
This is a hands-on role where you’ll work with distributed systems, large datasets, web scraping infrastructure, and production data workloads.

**Please note: This role requires a work schedule that overlaps sufficiently with EST business hours to collaborate effectively with the team.**

**Who You Are:**

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
- **Python (advanced)** — strong grasp of async programming, multiprocessing, and writing production-grade code for long-running data jobs
- **Web scraping at scale** — hands-on experience with high-volume scraping (proxies, rate limiting, anti-bot evasion). Experience with platform APIs and large media/metadata datasets (video platforms, social media)
- **Distributed data pipelines** — experience designing and operating pipelines across many workers/servers using task queues (Celery, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar)
- **Data warehousing** — practical experience with columnar/analytical warehouses; Databend, ClickHouse, or BigQuery strongly preferred; comfortable with complex analytical queries, partitioning strategies, cost-aware querying on cloud warehouses
- **Docker & Kubernetes** — containerizing workloads, writing Helm charts/manifests, managing deployments, autoscaling scraping/processing workloads
- **Linux & bare-metal ops** — comfortable managing services on Linux servers, debugging performance issues (disk I/O, network, memory) without managed-cloud abstractions
- CI/CD for data workflows (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD)
- Writing Scalable API

**What You'll Be Doing:**

- Maintain, optimize, and troubleshoot database queries and related data systems to support efficient data access, processing, and reliability.
- Assist in creating, maintaining, and improving data pipelines used to collect, process, transform, validate, and deliver large-scale datasets.
- Support web scraping and data collection initiatives, including developing, testing, and maintaining scripts or tools used to gather publicly available data in accordance with Company requirements.
- Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline issues, identify data quality concerns, and help implement timely fixes to maintain data accuracy and operational continuity.
- Document engineering work, including database queries, pipeline processes, scraping workflows, technical decisions, issues encountered, and resolutions implemented.
- Participate in research and development projects to improve the Company’s data products and workflows.

**Why Work With Us:**

- Opportunity. We are at the forefront of developing a web-scale crawler and knowledge graph that improves access to public web data and extends the value of AI to the people.
- Culture. We're a lean team with a high bar. We come to work not to be comfortable, but to find out what we're capable of and to do work that matters. We're not calling for people who keep things moving. We're calling for people who make everyone around them better.   
We prioritize low ego and high output. This is a fully remote team.
- Compensation. You’ll receive a competitive salary, benefits and equity package.

title: Head of Content - 1.8M+ Subscriber (The Trading Geek)
description:
About The Trading Geek

The Trading Geek is a global trading and personal development brand built by entrepreneur and trader Brad Goh, with 1.8M+ YouTube subscribers and content reaching millions of people around the world.

We’ve already built the audience.

Now we’re looking for an exceptional Head of Content to take the brand to its next level.

Think about the content organizations behind creators and entrepreneurs like Alex Hormozi, Codie Sanchez and Dan Martell.

At that level, the founder isn’t personally managing every content decision, chasing editors, planning every upload or figuring out what to post tomorrow. There is a strong content leader behind the scenes who understands the founder deeply, owns the strategy and turns their ideas, experiences and expertise into a world-class media machine.

That’s the person we’re looking for.

What You’ll Own

You will take ownership of the entire content operation around Brad Goh and The Trading Geek.

That includes:

* Own the overall content and personal brand strategy
* Build the roadmap to take an already established 1.8M+ subscriber brand to its next stage of growth
* Own YouTube long-form strategy from idea → packaging → production → publishing → analysis
* Own short-form strategy across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok and other relevant platforms
* Develop content pillars, recurring formats and series around Brad’s trading, entrepreneurship, investing, lifestyle and personal journey
* Turn Brad’s raw ideas, experiences and expertise into compelling content
* Develop world-class hooks, titles, thumbnails and packaging
* Work with editors, videographers, designers and other creatives to execute the vision
* Build systems that allow one piece of content or one founder idea to become content across multiple platforms
* Own the content calendar and publishing cadence
* Analyze retention, CTR, views, audience growth and other performance metrics
* Constantly study what is working across the creator economy and adapt winning formats to the brand
* Recruit and manage additional creative talent as the content operation grows
* Build systems that reduce the founder’s involvement in day-to-day content operations while preserving his voice and authenticity

Ultimately, you own the growth and quality of the personal brand.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who has already helped build or scale a major creator, founder or personal brand.

You should have:

* Proven experience growing a large YouTube channel, creator brand or founder-led media company
* A portfolio of content you’ve personally helped take from idea to millions of views
* Deep understanding of YouTube long-form
* Strong understanding of Shorts, Reels and TikTok
* Exceptional instincts for storytelling, hooks and audience retention
* Strong understanding of titles, thumbnails and packaging
* Experience building repeatable content systems around a founder
* Experience managing editors, videographers, designers and other creatives
* Strong understanding of analytics including CTR, retention, watch time and content conversion
* The ability to understand a founder’s voice and amplify it without turning the content generic
* Strong creative judgment combined with analytical thinking

Trading experience is not required.

Understanding how to build a massive personal brand is far more important. We can teach you the trading industry.

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a social media manager position.

We’re not looking for someone whose primary experience is scheduling posts, writing captions or maintaining a content calendar.

We’re looking for someone capable of sitting beside the founder and saying:

“Here’s where we’re taking the brand. Here’s what we’re filming. Here’s why it will work. Here’s how we’re packaging it. And here’s what the data tells us to do next.”

You should be comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for instructions.

Location

We are headquartered in Singapore. While we are open to exceptional candidates globally, this role works closely with Brad in person, so we strongly prefer candidates who are based in Singapore or are open to relocating.

For the right person, we are open to discussing relocation.

What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, you should:

* Develop a clear content strategy for the next stage of The Trading Geek
* Audit existing content and identify the biggest opportunities
* Establish clear content pillars and repeatable winning formats
* Improve our ideation, storytelling, packaging and distribution systems
* Establish a consistent long-form and short-form production engine
* Build a clear performance dashboard for content
* Take increasing ownership of content decisions currently handled by Brad
* Create a roadmap for scaling the personal brand significantly beyond its current reach

The long-term goal is simple:

Build The Trading Geek into one of the biggest founder-led media brands in the trading and finance space.

title: Head of Growth (B2C SaaS) - EdgeFlo
description:
EdgeFlo is a trading performance and discipline platform built to help traders execute better, stay accountable to their rules, and improve through data.

We launched in 2026 and are now looking for an exceptional Head of Growth to build and own our growth engine as we scale.

This is not a role for someone who only manages campaigns or coordinates agencies. We are looking for a hands-on growth leader who has helped scale a B2C SaaS or subscription product and understands the entire customer journey from acquisition to activation, conversion and retention.
What You’ll Own

* Own EdgeFlo’s overall growth strategy and key growth metrics
* Diagnose the biggest bottlenecks across acquisition, activation, trial-to-paid conversion and retention
* Build and manage the growth roadmap based on data, not assumptions
* Own and improve the funnel from visitor → signup → trial → activation → paid → retained user
* Lead paid acquisition strategy and determine when/how to scale spend
* Improve landing pages, funnels, positioning and conversion rates
* Build lifecycle and CRM strategies across onboarding, activation, retention and win-back
* Work closely with Product to improve activation and retention
* Build attribution and reporting so we understand exactly where growth is coming from
* Develop the existing marketing team and identify which additional hires, agencies or capabilities are actually needed
* Run structured growth experiments and establish a high-velocity testing culture
* Ultimately take ownership of EdgeFlo’s growth so the founder no longer needs to act as CMO

Who We’re Looking For

You have:

* Proven experience scaling a B2C SaaS, subscription or consumer technology company
* Personally owned meaningful growth metrics, not just managed a marketing team
* Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including CAC, LTV, activation, conversion, churn, retention and payback
* Experience with paid acquisition and creative testing
* Experience with lifecycle/CRM, onboarding and retention
* Strong funnel/CRO instincts
* Strong analytical ability and experience using product/marketing data to make decisions
* Experience working closely with product teams
* A track record of identifying growth bottlenecks and systematically removing them
* The ability to both think strategically and execute hands-on

Experience in fintech, trading, financial products or prosumer SaaS is a plus, but strong B2C SaaS growth experience matters more than trading experience.

What Success Looks Like

Your first job isn’t to spend more money on ads.

It’s to understand the business, identify where growth is constrained, and build the system to remove those constraints.

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to have:

* Established a clear growth model and reporting system
* Identified EdgeFlo’s biggest growth constraints
* Built a prioritized experimentation roadmap
* Improved key activation/conversion/retention metrics
* Established a clear acquisition strategy
* Defined what the next version of the growth team should look like

About You

You are highly analytical, commercially minded and obsessed with growth.

You don’t need a founder to tell you what campaign to launch next. You look at the numbers, identify the constraint, develop a hypothesis, test it and iterate.

We want someone who can eventually look at EdgeFlo’s growth number and say:

“This is mine.”

title: Entry Level Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title: **Entry-Level Business Analyst

**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented Entry-Level Business Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will analyze business processes, gather requirements, and work with cross-functional teams to help improve efficiency and business operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

title: Meta Media Buyer & Growth Strategist - GLP-1 / Telehealth
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Meta media buyer who understands GLP-1 and telehealth advertising and can contribute to the wider growth strategy, from customer acquisition through to conversion.

You should be confident managing campaigns, navigating Meta’s health and wellness tracking restrictions, and identifying opportunities across positioning, offers and the customer journey.

What you’ll do

- Launch, manage and scale Facebook and Instagram campaigns.
- Develop and test creative angles, messaging and audience strategies.
- Refine customer personas and identify opportunities to reach new customer segments.
- Review landing pages, checkout flows and follow-up sequences to improve conversion rates.
- Help shape pricing, offers and positioning through research and testing.
- Review Meta Pixel, Conversions API and event setups, recommending compliant improvements.
- Measure performance from initial click through to paying patient.
- Work with our team to prioritise tests and turn insights into clear actions.

What we’re looking for

- Proven experience running GLP-1, weight loss or telehealth campaigns.
- Hands-on knowledge of Meta’s health and wellness pixel and conversion event restrictions.
- Strong understanding of customer research, funnel optimisation and creative strategy.
- Experience testing offers, pricing and messaging across different customer segments.
- Familiarity with LegitScript-certified advertisers and Meta’s advertising requirements.
- Someone proactive who can look beyond Ads Manager and take ownership of growth.

To apply, please include

1. Your relevant experience and monthly advertising budgets managed.
2. Campaign results or anonymised case studies related to GLP-1 / Telehealth only.
3. An example of how you improved results through changes to a funnel, offer or customer positioning.
4. Your experience handling health and wellness tracking restrictions.

title: Director of Growth - Open Pool
description:
Margin Department is hiring a senior, hands-on growth operator to lead a small portfolio of high seven- to low nine-figure consumer brands.

You will serve as the primary growth lead for each brand in your portfolio – owning P&L-connected media strategy, day-to-day paid media decisions, performance creative strategy, forecasting, and communication with clients.

You will have meaningful autonomy, direct support from the broader Margin Department team, and proprietary infrastructure through MarginOS. As your portfolio reaches full capacity, you will have the opportunity to hire and develop a Growth Analyst to support execution.

This role is built for someone who wants to remain close to the craft while taking full responsibility for business outcomes.

**About Margin Department**
Margin Department is an embedded growth partner for product-led consumer brands, specializing in direct-to-consumer e-commerce businesses generating high seven- to low nine-figure annual revenues.

The company was founded by a growth marketer and an engineer with years of experience growing brands from the inside. We are turning that experience into a software-enabled service that gives growing consumer businesses access to technology and talent they could not otherwise justify building in-house.

MarginOS is our proprietary growth operating system. Built and maintained by our engineering team, it brings financial data, marketing performance, customer behavior, product analytics, and other critical signals into one place. It allows our team to understand the full picture of a business and make better decisions more quickly. You will use MarginOS every day and will have a meaningful voice in shaping what it becomes.

As a small but rapidly growing team, we are looking for someone excited by the opportunity to help build a company – not simply step into a job that has already been fully defined.

**About the Role**
You will own strategy, client relationships, and performance outcomes across a small portfolio of growth-stage consumer brands.

For each brand, you will be responsible for connecting the economics of the business to the decisions being made in its ad accounts. You will determine where the next dollar should be invested, what creative should be made, how budgets map to margin and cash flow priorities, and what the client needs to hear when performance is strong (or when it is not).

This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will work directly in the accounts, build models, review performance, lead client calls, and make consequential decisions yourself. You will not be delegating the core work to a large execution team at the outset.

You will be supported by MarginOS, integrated AI tooling, and the broader Margin Department team. That infrastructure will make you faster and more informed, but the ownership remains yours. You will run the accounts in your portfolio and be accountable for their results.

As your portfolio reaches sufficient scale, you will have the opportunity to hire and develop a Growth Analyst to support day-to-day execution.

 **What You’ll Do**

**Own Growth Strategy and Planning**
- Build P&L-connected media plans covering channel allocation, budget pacing, funnel structure, product lines, and customer segments.
- Translate a brand’s financial objectives into clear acquisition, revenue, and contribution-margin targets.
- Lead strategy across core channels like Meta and Google while also identifying when additional channels belong in the mix.
- Understand how new and returning customers, order volume, average order value, conversion rate, traffic, CPMs, and product margins interact.
- Build models that make these relationships understandable and actionable.
- Evaluate how paid media, organic demand, retail, marketplaces, and other sales channels influence one another.
- Develop offers and acquisition funnels that can drive growth while preserving healthy unit economics.
- Make structural account decisions—including campaign architecture, bidding strategy, audience strategy, and budget allocation—and clearly explain the reasoning behind them.
- Understand the strengths and limitations of multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, incrementality testing, and in-platform attribution.
- Adapt the measurement approach to each client’s stage, data, and decision-making needs.

**Stay Close to Execution**
- Buy media and manage budgets, bids, and campaign structures directly.
- Monitor performance and respond quickly when results diverge from the plan.
- Build financial projections and media plans that can withstand scrutiny from a founder or investor.
- Produce and QA weekly performance reporting, owning its accuracy, clarity, and delivery to the client.
- Identify risks early and take action before they become larger problems.
- Build repeatable systems that improve the quality and efficiency of work across the portfolio.

**Performance Creative Strategy**
- Define core creative angles, messaging frameworks, offers, and content themes to guide performance-focused creative.
- Use available advertising and customer insights to inform clear recommendations for what to make next.
- Conduct targeted customer, category, and competitive research to support creative direction.
- Review creative performance across relevant signals to identify what is working and what to test next.
- Provide a practical creative strategy foundation that helps clients make more informed creative decisions.

**Own the Client Relationship**
- Serve as the primary strategic point of contact for each client in your portfolio.
- Lead recurring calls and participate in periodic in-person visits.
- Translate complex performance and financial data into clear decisions and recommendations.
- Build trust through competence, candor, consistency, and sound judgment.
- Push back when a requested direction is unlikely to serve the client’s business goals.
- Communicate difficult news directly and arrive with a clear point of view about what should happen next.



**Who This Is For**
*You may be a strong fit if:*
- You typically have at least 5 years of relevant growth-marketing experience on the brand side, agency side, or both. Demonstrated scope and judgment matter more to us than a precise number of years.
- You have deep, hands-on experience with Meta and Google advertising.
- You understand the complete e-commerce growth model, not only the advertising channel layer.
- You are fluent in contribution margin, CAC, payback period, retention rate, and customer lifetime value.
- You can connect platform decisions to business outcomes.
- You have owned meaningful budgets and made decisions where the answer was not obvious.
- You understand performance creative and can turn data, customer insight, and business context into a useful creative direction.
- You can earn a client’s trust through clarity, candor, and sound judgment.
- You are comfortable doing both strategic and detailed work, sometimes within the same hour.
- You communicate clearly in writing and conversation.
- You take initiative, build systems, and are excited to solve unresolved problems.
- You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and helping create structure where none exists yet.
- You care about the quality of your work and notice the details that compound over time.
- You actively learn, experiment, and revise your views when the evidence changes.
- You are excited by the opportunity to build within a small, ambitious team.

**What We Offer**
- $130,000 base salary + uncapped revenue share
- New business commission on clients you help bring into the firm
- Health, vision, and dental insurance
- Flexible PTO
- Full access to MarginOS, our proprietary and rapidly evolving growth infrastructure that makes you faster and sharper than you'd be on your own
- A team of passionate marketers and engineers operating at the cutting edge of the field, plus a network of passionate and interesting founders and brand operators that you get to interface with and learn from constantly
- Our goal is to build an institution for consumer brand building, anchored in Austin and serving clients around the country. Along the way,  we’d like to make working at Margin Department more fruitful, fulfilling, and fun than anywhere else.

**Why Margin Department**
Our goal is to build an institution for consumer-brand building – anchored in Austin and serving ambitious companies around the world.

We believe the best growth work happens when media, creative, customer behavior, and business economics are understood together. title: AI-Native SDR, AdAI
description:
About AdAI

AdAI recreates winning reference ads in a brand's own look, with verbatim pricing and product details built in by design. Upload a reference ad, pick a product, and get on-brand creative in minutes. Our tagline: Any winning ad, made yours.

We sell to seed through Series A DTC and consumer health founders spending $15K to $100K a month on Meta without an agency. AdAI was built at Revolution Venture Studios and is led by co-founder Kevin Bartley (CEO).

The role
You will be AdAI's first SDR, and you will run outbound like an operator, not a dialer. Agents handle research, list building, enrichment, first drafts, and CRM logging. You handle judgment: who is worth contacting, what angle lands, and how to turn a reply into a booked demo.

You will report to the CEO and work directly alongside him on founder-led sales. The goal is a pipeline engine that one person plus a fleet of agents can run at the output of a small team.

• Build and run the prospecting machine. Use agents to source, enrich, and score DTC and consumer health brands against our ICP, then hand-review the shortlist before anything sends.
• Write outbound that sounds human. Use LLMs to research each account (recent ads, offers, funding, hiring) and draft personalized openers. You own the final edit and the voice.
• Run multichannel sequences. Manage LinkedIn, email, and call touches across our sequencing tools, and keep deliverability healthy on our sending domains.
• Book qualified demos. Work replies fast, qualify on fit and Meta spend, and put meetings on the CEO's calendar.

• Daily, hands-on use of LLMs in your own work, with examples you can show us (prompts, workflows, agents you built)

• Strong writing. You can tell when AI copy sounds like AI copy, and you fix it

Nice to have

Compensation, logistics, and how to apply
