title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
# Our Mission and Vision

Unlearn exists to transform clinical development by making every trial smarter. We harness data, AI, and digital twins to enable faster, more robust studies that bring life-saving treatments to patients faster. This mission drives everything we do as we partner with biopharmaceutical companies to redesign how clinical trials are planned, run, and analyzed.

We are defining the future of clinical development with unmatched scientific credibility, replacing uncertainty with AI-powered precision so decisions are clearer and trials are stronger. We don’t just disrupt the pharmaceutical industry, we create lasting change.

We believe AI will define the future of medicine, and we are committed to building that future responsibly, rigorously, and in close collaboration with our partners in clinical development.

# About Our Team

We come from a variety of backgrounds ranging from machine learning to marketing—but regardless of where we come from, Unlearners share some common traits:

- **Unlearners are ambitious**; we aren’t intimidated by big, challenging goals.
- **Unlearners are disciplined experimenters**; we break down our big goals into smaller chunks and meet as often as necessary to track our velocity and iterate quickly.
- **Unlearners are gritty**; we never give up, setbacks just make us try harder.
- **Unlearners are receptive to new ideas**; in fact, we hate being stuck with the status quo
- **Unlearners are storytellers**; sharing information with each other and with the world is super important, too important to be boring. And, last but not least,
- **Unlearners are team-oriented**; we put the mission first, the company second, the team third, and individuals last.

Headquartered in San Francisco, Unlearn was founded in 2017 by a team of world-class machine learning scientists. We have raised venture capital from top tier investors such as Altimeter, Insight Partners, Radical Ventures, 8VC, DCVC, and DCVC Bio, and completed our $50 million Series C in January 2024.

**If our purpose and culture resonate with you, we invite you to apply.**

**Your Role**

Leading pharma and biotech companies trust Unlearn to deliver scientifically rigorous work on clinical studies where the stakes are high and the timelines are real.

As our Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll lead full-cycle recruiting to build the teams that do this work. You'll report to the Director of HR on the Finance & Operations team and partner closely with our Clinical Delivery, Commercial, Engineering, Product and R&D teams to understand what each role needs and what great looks like.

This role is execution-focused and metrics-driven, with a strong emphasis on quality and values alignment. Many of our roles are niche, so a rigorous hiring process is key to finding the right match. You won't be starting from scratch: we have a solid talent acquisition foundation in place and a compelling organization brand. We're always looking to improve it, though, and we'd welcome your ideas for shaping the role and the function to grow.

This is a remote role. If you live in the San Francisco Bay Area, you are welcome to come to our office on a hybrid schedule. If you are remote, we would require an initial 1-week onboarding in San Francisco and visiting the office 1-2 times per year in addition.  
  
If this role sounds interesting to you, we encourage you to apply!  
  
**Responsibilities**

- Run full-cycle recruiting for technical, scientific and operations roles, from sourcing and intake through scheduling, candidate experience, offer and close
- Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, build strategy and structured interview plans
- Proactively source strong candidates
- Manage offers using our compensation philosophy and market-based pay bands, and walk candidates through compensation, equity and benefits clearly and transparently
- Track metrics in our hiring and onboarding processes and recommend measurable improvements
- Build our employer brand and a candidate experience that reflects our values
- Help shape our approach to fair, equitable, and inclusive hiring
- Lead onboarding sessions with new hires
- Contribute to ad-hoc HR projects

**Requirements**

- 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including technical roles
- Experience recruiting at a startup or growth-stage healthtech, biotech, life sciences, or clinical research company
- Experience hiring scientific or technical roles such as Data Science and Machine Learning as well as people manager roles
- A strong sourcing toolkit and a track record of closing competitive candidates
- Track record of using data to run the funnel, with specific metrics named: time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer acceptance, source quality
- Proven ability to learn/understand scientific and clinical concepts well enough to describe technical roles credibly to candidates
- Experience leveraging AI tools in sourcing and outreach
- Clear, warm communication style; ability to build trusting relationships; and handle confidential information with appropriate discretion.

**Nice to have**

- Experience at a high-growth AI company
- Experience with Ashby
- Track record of implementing improvements in hiring systems
- Interest in HR and broader project scopes

## Benefits & Perks

*The following benefits and perks are for full time roles only.*

- Meaningful equity participation
- 100% company-covered medical, dental, & vision insurance plans
- 401k plan with matching
- Flexible PTO plus company holidays
- Annual company-wide break December 24 through January 1
- Commuter benefits
- Paid Parental Leave

Unlearn is an equal opportunity employer. 

At Unlearn, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, because inclusion and diversity are essential to achieving our mission. If you’re excited about this role, and your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply nevertheless.

title: AI Agent Quality Engineer
description:
**About ApexNeural**
ApexNeural is a Hyderabad based enterprise AI studio building agentic systems for global clients. We are expanding our delivery team and are looking for quality engineers who can test both conventional software behaviour and the less deterministic behaviour of AI agents and agentic workflows.
**About the role**
You will own quality engineering for AI-enabled applications, with particular focus on testing AI agents, agent workflows, tool integrations, guardrails and LLM-generated outputs. The role combines conventional software and API testing with specialised testing and evaluation of agentic systems.
**What you will do**
•	Design and execute test strategies for AI agents and agentic workflows.
•	Test agent behaviour, tool selection, tool inputs and outputs, workflow execution and failure handling.
•	Validate agent pipelines and orchestrated workflows, including different execution paths, retries, failures and edge cases.
•	Test guardrails, permissions, policy enforcement and unsafe or unexpected agent behaviour.
•	Evaluate LLM outputs for correctness, consistency, relevance, instruction following and safe failure behaviour.
•	Develop test cases for hallucination, prompt injection, unexpected inputs, malformed tool responses and other adversarial scenarios.
•	Validate API integrations and external service interactions used by agents.
•	Analyse agent traces, logs and intermediate outputs to identify the source of failures.
•	Build automated regression and evaluation suites for agent workflows and APIs.
•	Establish repeatable evaluation criteria for AI outputs and track regressions across prompts, models and application changes.
•	Perform conventional functional, integration, regression and API testing where required.
•	Work with engineers to reproduce, diagnose and resolve defects.
**Must have**
•	2+ years of software QA or testing experience, preferably including automation.
•	Strong understanding of API, integration and distributed-system testing.
•	Strong test design skills including boundary, negative, adversarial and risk-based testing.
•	Hands-on experience testing AI, LLM or agentic applications, or strong practical understanding of how such systems are built and evaluated.
•	Ability to analyse agent execution, tool calls, intermediate results and final outputs.
•	Python, JavaScript or TypeScript for test automation.
•	Comfortable working with APIs, JSON, SQL, logs and basic Linux commands.
•	Strong attention to edge cases and failure scenarios.
•	Experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and/or AWS Step Functions.
•	Experience with agent frameworks, MCP or tool-calling systems.

title: Commission Only Sales Partner, Offensive Security Services
description:
This role pays commission only. No base salary, no retainer, no benefits, no expense budget. You get paid a percentage of every engagement you bring in, and you get paid after the client pays us. If you need predictable monthly income, this is not the role. If you already have a network in security or IT buying and you want to monetise it without leaving whatever else you do, keep reading.

### Who we are

Black Hat Brew is a small offensive security crew. Three practitioners, no account managers, no handoffs. The people who scope an engagement are the people who run it, which is not how most firms this size work and is usually the thing that closes the deal.

### What you would be selling

Four things, all scoped per client:

**Scenario CTF Ranges.** Full attack chain labs built on realistic corporate infrastructure, Active Directory, edge services, cloud identity. Mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Sprints run three to seven days. Buyers are security teams who want to prove their people can handle a live attack chain instead of a checklist.

**Red Team Simulations.** Adversary emulation against a client's live environment with detection gaps documented. Two to four weeks. Buyers are SOC and detection engineering leads who need to know what their tooling misses.

**Web Application Pentesting.** Web apps, APIs, business logic flaws. One to three weeks.

**Android Pentesting.** APK teardown through runtime exploitation. One to two weeks.

Every engagement ships a report with findings, risk scores, remediation guidance and retest validation.

### Who actually buys this

The people who sign are heads of security, CISOs at mid sized companies, security engineering leads, and founders of companies that just got told by a customer or an auditor that they need a pentest. Anything driven by SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI or a client security questionnaire is a fast conversation, because the budget already exists and there is a deadline attached.

We are not chasing enterprises with eighteen month procurement cycles. We want companies that can decide in weeks.

### What we want from you

You bring the clients. That is the whole job. You find them, you open the conversation, you qualify whether it is real, and you bring us in to scope it. We do not hand you a lead list, and we do not have an SDR feeding you appointments. If your plan is to work our pipeline, this will not work out.

You do not need to be technical enough to run a test. You do need to be technical enough to hold a credible first conversation with a security lead and not get dismissed in the first two minutes.

### What we do

We take every technical call with you. We scope, price and write the proposal. We deliver the work, and we deliver it well, because your commission depends on the client paying and clients pay for work they are happy with. You get case material, sample reports and a walkthrough of each service so you can speak to it properly.

### Commission

[COMMISSION]% of the contract value on every engagement you source, paid within [PAYMENT WINDOW] of the client's payment clearing. If a client pays in stages, you get paid in the same stages.

Recurring work counts. If a client you brought in comes back for a second engagement or a retest, you get paid on that too for [RENEWAL PERIOD].

Typical engagements run [DEAL SIZE RANGE], so a single closed deal is worth roughly [EXAMPLE COMMISSION] to you.

Refunds and chargebacks reverse the commission. That has never happened, but the term needs to be in the agreement.

### The arrangement

Independent contractor. You invoice us, you handle your own taxes. Not exclusive, so you can sell other things as long as it is not directly competing. We will send a short agreement covering commission, payment timing, client attribution and confidentiality before you touch any client conversation.

Attribution is settled by who introduced the client first, in writing, on our shared record. We will not have an argument about this six months later.

### How to apply

Do not send a generic pitch. Send:

1. Two or three sentences on the security or IT buyers you already have access to and how you know them.
2. One deal you closed on your own sourcing, roughly what it was worth, and how you found it.
3. What commission percentage you would consider fair, and why.

Applications without those three things will not get a reply.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:

**A Note on Our Hiring Process**

At Tradeify, we use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruiting process, which may include resume screening, application review, and candidate communication. We want all applicants to be aware of this upfront so you can make an informed decision about applying. Final hiring decisions are always made by a member of our team.

title: Co-Founder / Partner - Commission + Equity
location: Dubai; New York City; San Diego; London; Abu Dhabi; Mumbai
description:
TITLE

Co-Founder / Partner - Commission + Equity


ABOUT GROVYN

Grovyn is building an AI-first technology company helping businesses turn complex technology needs into real, scalable solutions.

We work across AI, SaaS, automation, custom software, digital transformation, enterprise applications, integrations, and product engineering.

We have the technology and execution capability.

Now we are looking for someone exceptional to help build the commercial side of Grovyn.


THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a traditional sales job.

We are looking for a Co-Founder / Partner who can help Grovyn build meaningful revenue through relationships, market access, partnerships, and business opportunities.

You may already have strong relationships with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, enterprises, technology companies, system integrators, or decision-makers.

You know where real technology opportunities come from.

Your role is to open the right doors, develop those relationships, help shape opportunities, and work with the Grovyn team to turn them into successful engagements.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

• Build and develop Grovyn's commercial pipeline
• Identify high-quality IT, SaaS, AI, automation and software opportunities
• Leverage your existing network and industry relationships
• Build relationships with founders, CXOs and technology decision-makers
• Develop strategic partnerships and channel opportunities
• Participate in discovery, solution and commercial conversations
• Help shape Grovyn's go-to-market strategy
• Turn relationships into long-term accounts, not one-off leads
• Work directly with the founder to build the revenue engine


WHAT GROVYN BRINGS

You will not be expected to build or deliver technology yourself.

Grovyn handles:

• AI strategy & implementation
• AI agents & intelligent workflows
• SaaS product development
• Custom software
• Enterprise applications
• CRM / ERP solutions
• Cloud & system integrations
• Digital transformation
• Product engineering
• Architecture & technical execution
• Implementation & long-term support

Simply:

YOU bring the relationships, market access and commercial leadership.

GROVYN brings the technology, team and execution.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This is for someone experienced, entrepreneurial and commercially driven.

Strong fit if you are:

• A technology consultant or advisor
• A former SaaS / IT services sales leader
• A technology partnerships professional
• An enterprise software professional
• A system integrator
• A digital transformation consultant
• A founder / operator with a strong B2B network
• A senior business development professional
• Someone who already has access to meaningful technology opportunities

We care more about the relationships you can activate than the number of connections you have.

10 people who trust you can be more valuable than 10,000 people who don't.


COMPENSATION

This is a founder-level opportunity with no fixed salary initially.

The structure is:

• Commission / revenue share on business you help originate and close
• Minimum 10% revenue share on successfully closed business originated by you
• Equity participation for the right long-term partner
• Larger or strategic opportunities can have a mutually agreed commercial structure

Example:

$10K closed project → minimum $1K revenue share

$50K closed project → minimum $5K revenue share

The more value you help create, the more you participate in that value.

As Grovyn reaches a sustainable revenue stage, we can also discuss transitioning the role into a more structured compensation model.


WHY THIS IS DIFFERENT

You are not joining to hit cold-call quotas.

There is:

• No fixed salary initially
• No cold-call targets
• No scraped lead lists
• No activity-for-the-sake-of-activity
• No requirement to build an engineering team

Instead, you get the opportunity to help build a company and participate directly in the upside you create.


WHAT WE'RE REALLY LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner.

Someone who can say:

"I know the market."

"I know the decision-makers."

"I know where technology budgets are being spent."

"I can open doors."

"I can build trust."

"I want to build something, not just take a job."


IMPORTANT

This is not a conventional employment opportunity.

It is an entrepreneurial Co-Founder / Partner engagement with commission-based earnings and potential equity.

If you are looking for a guaranteed fixed salary from day one, this will not be the right fit.

If you are looking for meaningful ownership, autonomy and upside tied to the business you help create, we'd like to meet you.


LOCATION

Remote / Global

We are open to strong candidates across India, GCC, US, UK, Australia and other key technology markets.


EXPERIENCE

5+ years preferred in technology, SaaS, IT services, consulting, enterprise software, partnerships, business development or a related field.

More important than years:

• Quality of network
• Commercial judgment
• Market access
• Ability to build trust
• Ability to create and close opportunities
• Entrepreneurial mindset


HOW TO APPLY

Tell us briefly:

1. What do you currently do?
2. Which industries / markets do you have the strongest relationships in?
3. Which decision-makers can you realistically reach?
4. What kind of technology opportunities do you typically encounter?
5. Tell us about one meaningful deal or opportunity you helped create.
6. Which geographies are strongest for you?
7. Why does building Grovyn with us interest you?
8. What would you want to build or own as a partner?


THE SIMPLE VERSION

You have the relationships.

Grovyn has the technology and execution.

The market has the problems.

Together, we build the business.

You participate in the revenue you create.

And for the right person, you can participate in the company itself.

If you are looking for a job, this probably isn't it.

If you are looking for a company to help build, let's talk.

title: Training Associate (Philippines)
description:
# About the Training Team

Training is how Possible keeps Operations ready for new hires, ready for new products, and ready for the shift AI is bringing to how the work itself gets done. We run the live training and close the loop between QA and coaching so agents improve, faster.

#   
The Role

The Training Associate leads facilitated training delivery across Operations, including training and facilitating alongside BPO partner trainers. You'll lead live onboarding, refresher, and product-launch training for internal teams and BPO partners. You'll turn QA referrals into real 1:1 coaching. And you'll help build the LMS courses and microlearning that let the team's output scale without scaling headcount.

This is a delivery role, not a strategy role. You'll report to the QA Manager and work in close, day-to-day partnership with the Documentation & Training Manager, who owns facilitated training delivery, sets its strategy and direction, and will train you into the role. The Manager owns the function; you lead the sessions, get training in front of people, and make sure it lands.

##   
Key Responsibilities

Facilitated Training Delivery

- Lead live onboarding, refresher, and product-launch training for Operations team members, BPO partner trainers, and cross-functional audiences.
- Maintain expert-level knowledge of Possible's products, processes, compliance policies, and brand tone.
- Partner with BPO trainers so their agents get product-expert-level training.
- Support the eventual build-out of a structured internal trainer program (selection criteria, calibration standards, train-the-trainer cadence) as training scales.

QA-Driven Coaching & Remediation

- Partner with QA Analysts to translate quality trends into targeted retraining, for individual agents and for groups identified through QA review.
- Deliver 1:1 coaching on referral from QA, focused on closing skill and knowledge gaps, not performance management.
- Feed coaching observations back to the Training Manager to inform curriculum updates and new course design.

Program Operations & Collaboration

- Coordinate training schedules, learner enrollment, and completion tracking across the Ops org. Capture facilitator feedback and knowledge-check results to feed program improvement.
- Liaise with Product, Compliance, and Customer Operations leadership to keep training aligned with launches, policy updates, and regulatory changes, and surface recurring learner questions and knowledge gaps back to the Training Manager.

##   
LMS & Course Development

- Build standard course content, microlearning, and upskilling programs in the LMS under the Documentation & Training Manager's direction.
- Apply AI-assisted course development workflows: SCORM generation, source material conversion, scenario design.
- Maintain and update existing courses on a structured review cadence.

#   
What We're Looking For

##   
Requirements

- 2+ years facilitating training in a customer support, operations, or contact-center environment.
- Strong instructional delivery skills, including comfort facilitating to ESL audiences and BPO partner trainers.
- Experience coaching; preferably within a QA-driven feedback loop.
- Comfort using AI tools as part of a content-creation and training-preparation workflow.
- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing deadlines.

## Preferred

- 2+ years of experience in instructional design or course development, with working knowledge of a structured design process (e.g., ADDIE) and the learning principles that drive retention and reduce cognitive overload.
- Hands-on experience building courses in an LMS authoring tool such as Articulate Rise or Storyline.
- Familiarity with SCORM.
- Experience in a regulated industry, ideally financial services or fintech.
- Exposure to designing upskilling or reskilling programs tied to evolving job roles.

title: Bilingual Nurse Practitioner - Ontario (Remote)
description:
## **About Phoenix**

Founded in 2019, Phoenix is building the most trusted telehealth platform in Canada, making specialist healthcare accessible to every Canadian, wherever they are. Our platform breaks down barriers to care, empowering patients to take control of their health with personalized treatment options and the guidance of licensed providers.  
  
If you thrive where big ideas turn into real impact, you'll fit right in here. We're a team of creative problem-solvers who move deliberately and collaborate in person, because we think the best work happens that way. At Phoenix, you'll find autonomy over your work, people who care about each other's success, and a mission that's making healthcare better for Canadians.

## **About the Role**

We are looking for a remote **Bilingual Nurse Practitioner** to join the team. We’re setting the bar for asynchronous telemedicine to deliver a better experience for both patients and healthcare providers.

## **What You’ll Do**

- **Deliver Virtual Care with Impact:** Review patient-submitted medical histories through our intelligent, graded online platform and determine candidacy for treatment. Most consultations take under 5 minutes to complete.
- **Support and Prescribe:** If appropriate, issue prescriptions. If more information is needed, communicate directly with patients via our secure messaging platform.
- **Collaborate Onsite with a Multidisciplinary Team:** You’ll play a pivotal role in helping refine clinical workflows, ensuring we’re delivering seamless, high-quality care at scale.
- **Improve Patient & Provider Experience:** Work closely with our Customer Experience, Product, and Engineering teams to identify friction points and co-design solutions that elevate healthcare delivery.
- **Lend Your Clinical Expertise to Innovation:** Contribute to new product launches and protocols as Phoenix expands into new conditions and offerings.

## **What We Treat Today**

Our current focus includes health conditions such as:

- Erectile dysfunction
- Hair loss
- Weight loss
- Premature ejaculation
- Testosterone therapy

## **Who You Are**

- Bilingual in French and English
- Registered in good standing with the **Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers du Québec (OIIQ)**, with eligibility for licensure in additional Canadian provinces **(support available for the licensing process if needed)**
- Technologically savvy with experience or comfort in digital care platforms.
- Excellent communicator who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
- Able to respond to patient needs in a timely and empathetic manner.
- Passionate about improving the Canadian healthcare landscape.
- Curious, innovative, and excited to work cross-functionally with non-clinical teams.
- Previous experience in men’s health is a plus, but not required.

## **Why this opportunity is exciting**

- **Flexible Clinical Work:** Patients are privately billed, no insurance paperwork or complex billing systems. The asynchronous nature of our platform means no live appointments with patients via video or phone call.
- **Seamless Technology:** Our asynchronous platform was built by engineers who deeply understand provider pain points. It’s designed to support, not slow you down.
- **Innovate at the Frontlines:** Your clinical voice will directly inform how we build, improve, and expand our services.
- **No Additional Coverage Needed:** You’re already covered through your existing CMPA or equivalent malpractice coverage.

# **Why Work at Phoenix?**

- **A Rewarding Mission:** Through our asynchronous care model, Phoenix is reimagining patient-centric care for Canadians across the country by making diagnoses and treatment delivery faster, more accessible, and completely discreet.
- **Impact & Autonomy:** You’ll work directly with passionate, experienced leaders who’ve seen the ups and downs of building a business and genuinely care about your growth. You won’t just execute — you’ll help shape the future of Phoenix and Raven.
- **Collaborative On-Site Culture:** Our Operations, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams work together on-site from our downtown Toronto HQ. We thrive on quick feedback loops, spontaneous brainstorms, and actually knowing the people we work with. Bonus points if you're into the occasional foosball tournament or have strong opinions about the best lunch spot nearby.
- **Clinical Excellence:** All Phoenix & Raven telehealth clinicians work remotely, providing the highest quality care for even the most sensitive of health topics. Medications are delivered directly (and discreetly) to patients via our pharmacy warehouses, where our diligent Pharmacy team packages each treatment with care.
- **Competitive Pay, Real Benefits:** Our compensation bands are backed by real market data, so offers are competitive and fair. Our benefits package includes standard healthcare coverage, a remote-first holiday season, and holistic wellbeing support for when life just happens.

*Phoenix is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 and the Ontario Human Rights Code, Phoenix will provide accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment, selection, and/or assessment process. If selected to participate in the recruitment, selection, and/or assessment process, please inform Human Resources staff of the nature of any accommodation(s) that you may require.*

*Phoenix uses artificial intelligence (AI) to help review applications and screen resumes during the early stages of our hiring process. These tools assist our recruitment team, and all final hiring decisions are made by real people — not by automated systems.*

*Phoenix will only contact applicants using a* [*@phoenix.ca*](https://phoenix.ca) *email address or a verified LinkedIn account. We encourage applicants to be vigilant in responding to inquiries from unverified sources.*

**PINION - Tinder for Politics meets WIkipedia for Public Opinion**
About Pinion (https://www.pinionvote.com/):

We have been working on something big and transformative for politics and civic engagement. We are preparing to launch our go to market plans and seeking a broadly experienced legal professional, with both practical experience and genuine interest in our mission, to join our leadership team.

The Problem: Civic engagement is way too hard! We want to fix that. And positively impact global democracy and the political-media landscape in the process.

The Mission: Transform civic engagement! Create a platform where everyone can easily find, vote, and track results for pending legislation they care about, at local/state/national/global levels. And one that government customers rely on to improve their civic engagement performance!

Our Vision: Make Pinion the global democracy platform that brings it all together so people everywhere can easily find, vote on, and track the same legislation their elected representatives are voting on, and then see results - so they can easily get engaged, feel their voice is heard and their vote counts. Enable our users and customers to see living results and enlightening analytics for their self, organization, city, county, state, and nation. See how their friends voted, their communities, legislatures, and of course their elected representatives – PLUS candidates hoping to replace them at the next election. Imagine voting for candidates who have voted with you based on your votes on topics/legislation you care about, rather than political spin. Pinion makes engaging with politics easy, engaging and enlightening for better democracy.

The Team: Pinion is a group of motivated professionals who believe in the power of public opinion to improve civic engagement, democracy, and make our world better. We are looking for a team player who is an independent, friendly, and self-motivated professional. Our team is small, currently 15-ish, but growing so we prefer someone who is comfortable in a "many hats" culture where we all are willing to work on whatever needs attention. We are all remote with weekly team meetings to keep up on track and then expect to work asynchronously.

•	Deliver documentation with prioritized features and corresponding justifications.  Define the collaboration required between sales, promotional, and technical requirements - from idea to code.
•	Work with our User and Customer Community Managers to run beta, pilot programs, and other product demonstrations for feedback and validation as the product progresses.  
•	Support partnership and third party integration opportunities. 
•	Work with our User and Customer Community Managers to satisfy requests and build a product feedback pipeline.

•	Work with the Pinion development team to integrate customer requests and new features and refine the product end user experience.

•	Demonstrated success defining and launching excellent products
•	Experience working with PM tool sets like Confluence and website blueprinting tools—wire framing, UX design tools, mockups, etc.

### Compensation
**PLEASE NOTE** - We are a true early stage start up (pre-funding/pre-revenue). title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
🐦 **About Birdie**

At Birdie, we’re reimagining care for older adults. We’re building the technology that powers the future of home healthcare, empowering care teams with tools to deliver better, more dignified care, and enabling older people to thrive in their own homes for longer. Our all-in-one solution powers millions of care visits every month, equipping care providers with the tools they need to deliver exceptional, efficient care.

**We’re not here to tinker at the edges. We’re here to radically transform a broken system.**

That’s why we’ve built an all-in-one platform that supported over [**60 million care visits** and **enabled care for 116,000 individuals in 2025**](https://www.birdie.care/blog/birdies-year-in-review-2025), and we continue to grow our impact. We’re scaling fast, but staying true to our purpose. That’s why we’re proud to be a **B Corp**, using business as a force for good.

Founded in 2017, Birdie is backed by world-class investors like Index Ventures, Sofina and Omers. In 2023, we ranked [**#6 in the Deloitte Fast 50**](https://www.birdie.care/awards), making us one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK. You can check out more about our impact and recognition [**here**](https://www.birdie.care/awards).

But speed isn’t the point. **Impact is.**

**⚡ Your mission**

Your mission as a Customer Care Consultant - internally known at Birdie as a Partner Care Consultant - is to ensure our partners and their caregivers enjoy an exceptional experience with Birdie. This is fundamentally a customer support role, but it goes far beyond handling queries; it’s about building strong, trust-based relationships through proactive, human-centred engagement.

You will not just be reacting to issues via live chat, but actively anticipating our partners' needs. Through scheduled check-in calls and regular touch points across our live chat, email, and phone channels, you will seek to understand their goals, uncover hidden challenges, and provide tailored guidance to help them unlock the full value of the Birdie platform.

You’ll be the voice of our partners internally, becoming an expert on their needs and gathering crucial feedback that you will share with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams. Your ability to act as a trusted advisor, providing both expert technical support and genuine proactive care, will be instrumental in boosting partner satisfaction, retention and success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to stay close to the action while helping us build - you’ll get to own our knowledge strategy and lead internal projects that directly drive your career progression as we scale.

It is a 40 hour working week, 8 hours a day, 5 days a week working between Monday to Friday (7am-8pm) as well as the occasional weekend day (9am till 6pm). Weekend shifts are worked on rotation within the team with time given back in lieu in the week.

**🦸‍♀️ How you will contribute:**

- You will be the first point of contact for care agencies, care providers, and family members, providing them with exceptional support and advice through various communication channels including live chat, email, and phone
- Through proactive scheduled and outbound calling activities, you will conduct structured check-ins and escalation support with partners to uncover hidden issues and opportunities, ensuring they get the most value from Birdie
- You’ll not only solve issues with confidence and empathy but proactively anticipate needs, helping to prevent problems before they arise and turning challenges into opportunities for growth
- As you develop deep product knowledge, you'll confidently support partners with their queries, offering guidance and reassurance that supports both immediate resolution and long-term retention
- You will contribute to the maintenance and ongoing development of our internal knowledge base, creating clear and helpful resources for both our partners and the wider Birdie team
- Achieve all Partner Care Team related KPI's including response times, satisfaction ratings, handling time, chats closed per hour along with high call connection rates and quality assurance scores to ensure our partners receive the care they deserve.

**🤩 You’ll thrive here if...**

- You have experience working in a fast-paced SaaS support role and you’re comfortable jumping between live chat and email. You’re used to keeping up with high-volume targets like quality assurance (QA) scores, customer satisfaction (CSAT) and average handle time (AHT) – and you know how to work efficiently without letting the quality of your support dip.
- You’re comfortable making proactive outbound calls to check in on customers, digging deeper to uncover hidden issues and patiently guiding them through the platform.
- You have a track record of identifying and solving process gaps. You have specific examples of when you noticed a recurring issue and proactively updated a help guide or internal document to prevent it from happening again.
- You have a proven ability to break down technical software problems into clear, easy-to-follow steps for non-technical users.
- You’re driven by feedback and personal growth, and you have experience working with QA reviews and performance coaching. You can point to times where you’ve used that feedback to sharpen your skills, and you enjoy diving into your own data to find ways to level up
- You’re a proactive learner who flags blockers early. You have experience working in fast-moving environments where you’ve had to speak up and seek answers when stuck. You take ownership of your learning – whether it's mastering a new product feature or asking for help – to ensure your knowledge stays sharp and the team moves forward.

🧠 **Imposter syndrome is real** — and we don’t expect you to tick every box. If you're excited about our mission and think you could make a difference here, we want to hear from you.

**🌈 What you’ll get from us**

We believe people do their best work when they’re supported, trusted and inspired. Here’s how we build a world-class employee experience:

💸 **Compensation**

- Competitive base salary, reviewed against benchmarks annually
- Generous stock options - because we’re building this together
- Bi-annual performance cycles with individual compensation reviews

🧠 **Learning & Growth**

- Annual personal learning budget and access to training, coaching and mentorship
- Time and space for growth - you set your development goals, we back them

🏡 **Flexible Working**

- Ideally we’d love for this person to be in our London HQ twice per week. If you can’t make that work but you’re happy to come a couple of times per month, and you fit our requirements, please still pop in an application!
- Budget to set up your home workspace
- Regular in-person meetups, socials and offsites

🏖 **Time Off**

- 33 days holiday (25 days + public holidays)
- Extra day off on your birthday (use it whenever you like!)
- Company shutdown between Christmas and New Year
- 2 volunteering days each year to give back to causes that matter

👶 **Family-first Policies**

- Industry leading paid primary and secondary caregiver leave
- 5 paid days for fertility treatments for those who need it
- Private health insurance with AXA
- Wellbeing perks via Happl (gym discounts, mental health support, and more)

🚲 **Other Perks**

- Cycle to work scheme
- 4% employer pension contribution when you contribute 5% (UK)
- A deeply human, radically transparent culture

❓**Why Birdie?**

Because you want to do meaningful work that improves lives - and grow at speed while doing it. We’re building more than a product - we’re building a movement. A movement to show that tech, when built with empathy and integrity, can change lives.

We’re a team of **entrepreneurs**, **dreamers**, and **doers**. Join us to shape the future of care, work alongside ambitious, kind people, and help reimagine how society cares for its older adults. We dream big, act fast, and work collaboratively with one goal in mind: to create a world where we all age with confidence.

⚖️ **Equal Opportunities Statement**

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture. That means creating a hiring process that gives everyone a fair chance regardless of background, identity or lived experience.

Need adjustments or support during the application process? Let us know. We’re here to help.

✨ **Ready to build the future of care?**

*Apply now. Be part of something that matters.*

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
**Company Description**
AYC IT Healthcare is a healthcare technology and delivery services company that helps independent pharmacies and small pharmacy chains modernize their businesses. The organization designs customized digital solutions for pharmacies with limited or outdated web presence, including websites, mobile apps, online ordering, and integrated payment and delivery systems. Its scalable platform connects customers, pharmacies, and delivery operations through tools such as management dashboards, driver applications, route optimization, real-time tracking, and analytics. In addition to technology development, AYC IT Healthcare offers pharmacy technician delivery services across Los Angeles County, Orange County, and the Coachella Valley. The company’s mission is to strengthen pharmacies’ digital presence, improve customer accessibility, and support their competitiveness in a technology-driven healthcare environment while preserving their unique brands and customer relationships.

**Role Description**
This is a unpaid remote internship role for a Software Engineer at AYC IT Healthcare. The intern will support the design, development, testing, and deployment of technology solutions for pharmacy clients, including web and mobile applications, online ordering systems, and delivery management tools. Day-to-day tasks may include assisting with system configuration, troubleshooting technical issues, implementing integrations (such as payment and tracking), and documenting technical processes and workflows. The role will involve collaborating with senior engineers, product managers, and operations teams to refine requirements, improve system performance, and enhance the user experience for pharmacies, customers, and delivery personnel. The intern will also help monitor system reliability, analyze basic performance data, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the technology platform.

**Required Skills**
Basic proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, JavaScript, Java, or TypeScript.
Understanding of fundamental software engineering concepts, including variables, functions, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.
Basic knowledge of web development and RESTful APIs.
Familiarity with Git and GitHub or another version-control system.
Basic understanding of databases and SQL.
Ability to read, understand, and modify existing code.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Ability to write clear, organized, and maintainable code.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Willingness to learn new technologies and development tools.

**Preferred Skills**
Experience developing web applications or APIs.
Familiarity with Python, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, or similar back-end frameworks.
Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or other relational databases.
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience working with third-party APIs and integrations.
Familiarity with cloud platforms or deployment tools.
Understanding of authentication, data security, and API security.
Experience with testing, debugging, or writing unit tests.
Coursework or project experience in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field.

title: Bilingual Customer Support & Operations Analyst
description:
**Role**

We're looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and customer-focused Bilingual Customer Support & Operations Analyst to join the NiaHealth team.
This role will be a first point of contact for our existing customers and an important part of ensuring every customer has a smooth experience with NiaHealth. You'll develop an in-depth understanding of our product, programs, processes, partners, and internal tools so you can confidently answer questions, investigate problems, coordinate testing, and help customers navigate their health journey.
This is more than a traditional customer support role. You'll work at the intersection of customer experience, operations, and product — piecing together information from multiple people, systems, and processes to understand what happened, determine what needs to happen next, and drive an issue through to resolution.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer Support & Product Expertise**
→ Serve as a primary point of contact for existing NiaHealth customers.
→ Act as NiaHealth's key lead for customer support and operations across our Quebec customer base, providing fluent French-language support and helping shape how we serve French-speaking customers as we grow in Quebec.
→ Become a subject-matter expert on the NiaHealth product, customer journey, testing process, programs, and services.
→ Respond to customer questions through Intercom and other support channels with clear, friendly, and accurate information.
→ Troubleshoot customer issues and determine the appropriate next steps.
→ Help customers understand what happens next in their NiaHealth journey and proactively address anything that could create delays or confusion.
→ Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism when handling sensitive, complex, or time-sensitive situations.
→ Take ownership of customer issues through their resolution.
Investigative Problem-Solving & Cross-Functional Resolutions
A major part of this role is being able to investigate when something doesn't go according to plan. Customer issues aren't always straightforward or contained within one system or team — you'll need to be comfortable digging into an issue, tracing it through multiple processes, and connecting with the right people across the organization.

**You will:**
→ Investigate complex or unclear customer issues by gathering information across internal tools, customer communications, partner systems, and internal teams.
→ Trace issues through the full customer journey to identify where a process may have broken down.
→ Work directly across Customer Experience, Operations, Product, Engineering, Clinical, laboratory partners, and other teams to gather context and resolve issues.
→ Distinguish between one-off customer issues and problems that may indicate a broader product or operational issue.
→ Provide clear, useful context when escalating an issue so other teams can quickly understand what has already been investigated.
→ Follow an issue across teams and systems until there is a clear resolution, and communicate that resolution back to the customer in a simple, accurate way.
→ Identify recurring issues and help surface opportunities to improve our product, processes, documentation, and customer experience.
Blood Draw & Partner Coordination
→ Help customers navigate scheduling and completing their blood draw appointments.
→ Troubleshoot appointment, requisition, testing, and result-related issues.
→ Communicate clearly with customers when delays, recollections, scheduling changes, or other issues occur.
→ Work proactively with our clinical and laboratory partners to troubleshoot ongoing issues and streamline day-to-day scheduling and logistics, not just react to one-off problems as they come up.

**Internal Operations**

→ Use NiaHealth's internal tools and processes to keep each customer's journey moving smoothly. This may include:
→ Reviewing and updating customer information.
→ Confirming that requisitions, orders, appointments, and testing information are accurate.
→ Investigating missing, delayed, or mismatched results.
→ Processing refunds, credits, or other adjustments according to established policies.
→ Documenting actions and customer issues accurately so other team members have the context they need.
→ Identifying cases that require involvement from Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, or other teams.
→ Help identify gaps in our existing support processes and contribute to improving, documenting, and scaling them as NiaHealth grows and customer volume increases.

**Communication & Collaboration**
→ Use Intercom to communicate with customers and manage support conversations.
→ Use Slack to communicate, investigate issues, and coordinate with internal teams.
→ Build strong working relationships across the organization so you know who to involve when investigating different types of issues.
→ Translate technical, clinical, or operational information from internal teams into clear, approachable customer communication.
→Keep customers appropriately informed while an investigation or resolution is underway.

**What We're Looking For**
You're someone who likes figuring things out. You're naturally curious and don't need every problem to come with a predefined solution — when something looks wrong, you're comfortable investigating, asking questions, checking multiple systems, and working across teams until you understand what happened.
You also take ownership. You don't consider an issue resolved simply because you've passed it to someone else — you follow through and make sure the customer ultimately gets an answer.

You'll be successful in this role if you have
→ Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
→ Strong customer service instincts and the ability to communicate with empathy, patience, and confidence.
→ Excellent investigative and problem-solving skills.
→ Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and confidence working directly with multiple teams.
→ Exceptional attention to detail.
→ The ability to learn a complex product and its underlying processes deeply, and understand how different systems connect across the customer journey.
→ Strong judgment and the ability to make decisions within established policies and escalation guidelines.
→ Strong organizational and follow-through skills, with comfort managing multiple issues and investigations at once.
→ A process-improvement mindset — you notice patterns and look for ways to prevent the same issue from happening again.
→ Comfort working in an environment where products, processes, and procedures continue to evolve.

**What Makes This Role Different**
This isn't a role where success is simply measured by how quickly you close a support ticket. You'll become one of the people who knows the NiaHealth experience inside and out — not only what customers see, but what happens behind the scenes to make that experience work.
When something goes wrong, you'll often be the person connecting the dots across the organization: starting with a customer question, investigating their account and activity, checking an internal process, speaking with Operations, getting additional context from Product or Engineering, coordinating with an external partner, and ultimately bringing it all together into a solution for the customer.
We're looking for someone who thrives in that environment: curious, detail-oriented, resourceful, collaborative, and determined to get to the bottom of a problem. Your work won't just help resolve individual customer issues — the patterns and insights you uncover will help NiaHealth improve our product, operations, and overall customer experience as we scale.

[Apply Here](https://niahealth.co/careers/customer-support-analyst)

title: Co-founder, Capital, Institutional Development & Strategic Partnerships | Commercial Strategy & Company Building | Equity Only
location: Dubai; New York City; San Francisco; London; Gurgaon; Mumbai; San Francisco Bay Area; Bangalore Urban; Singapore
description:
I’m building **Whitebrinjal**, an enterprise high tech market network focused on the journey from technology discovery to enterprise adoption.

I’m looking for a **co-founder to build and execute the capital side of the company with me from zero.**

This is a **founder level opportunity**, not a CFO role, fundraising advisory role, fractional position or strategy only role.

Whitebrinjal is currently **pre MVP, pre revenue and pre institutional funding.**

You will **own the capital problem end to end**, from identifying where the money should come from and opening the right conversations to handling diligence, solving roadblocks, structuring the financing and driving the process through to completion.

## What Whitebrinjal is building

The ambition is **not to build another marketplace.**

Whitebrinjal is exploring the infrastructure around how enterprise technology gets **discovered, evaluated, commercialized and ultimately adopted.**

The journey runs from discovery and qualification through matching, evaluation, POC, pilot and deployment.

Technology can exist for years without becoming adopted by the enterprises that need it.

**That is the gap Whitebrinjal is going after.**

## Capital is not just about raising money

At this stage, an investor may ask for stronger market validation, customer evidence, research, technology validation, financial benchmarks or strategic relationships.

I do not want someone whose answer is simply that **we need to do those things first.**

The expectation is to **understand what is actually required, determine the most efficient way to establish it, find the right people to help, make the calls, build the relationships and get the work done.**

If we need customer validation, **you help get it.**

If we need an expert, **you find one.**

If we need a strategic investor, **you open the conversation.**

If a diligence issue comes up, **you work through it.**

If the financing structure is wrong, **you fix it.**

**Think. Decide. Act.**

That is the operating model.

## Who I’m looking for

You may have come from investment banking, VC, PE, corporate development, strategic finance or entrepreneurship.

**The background matters less than what you have actually done.**

This role is for someone who has **personally executed fundraising, financing or strategic transactions**, not someone looking to learn fundraising by joining a startup.

I want someone who has **personally been in the room when money was being raised, deals were being structured and difficult questions had to be answered.**

Someone who can **pick up the phone and get a serious investor, strategic partner, customer or expert into the conversation.**

Someone who has **built relationships over years**, not someone whose value is a spreadsheet of contacts.

Someone who understands **technology businesses, marketplaces and network effects.**

Someone who can **look at a problem and work out how to get it solved** instead of explaining why it cannot be solved yet.

Someone who is comfortable operating across **India and international capital markets**, including the US, Singapore, Greater China, the Middle East and Europe.

And most importantly, someone who **wants to build, not simply advise.**

A large network is not enough.

A good fundraising résumé is not enough.

A strategy deck is not enough.

**I need someone who can turn relationships and judgment into action.**

## Why Whitebrinjal

There are platforms for discovering products.

There are platforms for reviewing software.

There are platforms for professional networking.

There are marketplaces for buying and selling.

But **enterprise technology adoption is much more complicated.**

A technology can be technically ready and still have no clear path into an enterprise.

The buyer may not know what to ask.

The right stakeholders may not be aligned.

The technology may not be properly evaluated.

The business case may not be clear.

Procurement may not know how to structure the engagement.

And the seller may not know how to navigate the organisation.

**That is the space Whitebrinjal is going after.**

If we get this right, we are not simply building a marketplace.

We are building a **network around enterprise technology adoption**, with the potential to extend into **workflow, intelligence and infrastructure.**

That is the company we are trying to build.

## The founder opportunity

I’m building the **vision, product and market thesis.**

I want a co-founder who will take the same level of ownership of **capital, investors and the institutional side of the company.**

You will not be joining an existing finance team.

**You will build this with me from zero.**

Whitebrinjal is currently **pre revenue and pre funded**, so there is **no initial cash compensation.**

The opportunity is **meaningful founder equity** and the chance to build something from the earliest stage.

The initial working arrangement can be structured around where we are today, with the expectation that the role grows into **full time founder involvement** as the company reaches the right funding and operating milestones.

The exact equity structure will depend on **the person, the commitment and the scope of responsibility.**

We are building from Gurugram. I care more about **founder level commitment and getting important work done together** than about where someone sits every day. Regular in person time will matter, particularly around major decisions, fundraising and company building.

If you have spent your career **financing, investing in or helping build companies** and now want to build one yourself, I’d like to hear from you.

title: BEBURAS Channel Owner
description:
Build & Own a Revenue-Generating Growth Channel Inside BEBURAS

BEBURAS is building a global venture studio and business platform across capital, technology, venture building, real assets and operational services.

We are now opening a different kind of partnership.

We are looking for Channel Owners.

This is not a Social Media Manager role.

It is not an hourly job.

It is not a position where you are told what to post, when to post it, or how to run the channel.

Instead, we give you access to a BEBURAS-owned growth channel and the freedom to build it.

You own the channel's operational growth, experiment with formats and audiences, build conversations, generate attention and, most importantly, turn that attention into qualified commercial opportunities.

---

What is a Channel Owner?

A Channel Owner takes responsibility for developing one specific growth channel inside BEBURAS.

This could be:

- LinkedIn
- YouTube
- Instagram
- Facebook
- TikTok
- X
- Online communities
- Or another channel you believe has strong potential for BEBURAS

You decide how to build it.

You can test different content formats, audiences, campaigns, conversations, partnerships and acquisition strategies.

The objective is not simply to grow followers.

The objective is to build a real commercial channel.

That means attention → conversations → qualified opportunities → revenue.

---

What BEBURAS provides

You will not be building the channel from zero.

BEBURAS can provide access to:

- An established BEBURAS brand
- Our B2B website and commercial offers
- Managing Partners across different verticals
- Subject-matter experts and specialists
- Business and market knowledge
- Existing content and company materials
- Team members for interviews, videos and other content
- Relevant events, opportunities and business developments
- A growing international network across multiple industries

You bring the channel expertise, creativity, execution and growth strategy.

---

What you would own

As a Channel Owner, you would have broad operational ownership of your channel.

Depending on the channel, this may include:

- Developing the channel strategy
- Creating and testing content formats
- Building and engaging an audience
- Starting relevant conversations
- Identifying potential clients and partners
- Driving traffic to BEBURAS
- Generating inbound opportunities
- Creating campaigns and experiments
- Building channel-specific partnerships
- Identifying commercial opportunities
- Continuously improving the channel based on results

You are not expected to simply execute someone else's content calendar.

You own the channel.

---

Performance-Based Partnership

This is a performance-based partnership.

There is no fixed hourly compensation and no traditional 9–5 structure.

Instead, the economics are connected to the commercial results generated through the channel you build.

The exact percentage, attribution model and commercial structure would be agreed individually.

The principle is simple:

If you build a channel that makes money, you participate in the money it makes.

We want this to work as a genuine entrepreneurial opportunity, where your upside grows together with the channel you build.

---

Who we are looking for

We are interested in people who:

- Understand how to grow at least one digital platform deeply
- Have experience building audiences, communities or commercial channels
- Know how to create conversations, not just impressions
- Can identify commercial opportunities behind audience activity
- Think independently and experiment
- Prefer ownership over instructions
- Are comfortable with performance-based economics
- Want to build something rather than simply manage a content calendar

You do not need to be an expert across every platform.

We are more interested in someone who can say:

“Give me this channel and let me build it.”

---

Our First Channel: LinkedIn

BEBURAS already has an established LinkedIn presence and an international professional audience.

We want to turn that existing asset into a much more structured growth and commercial acquisition channel.

The first Channel Owner opportunity is therefore focused on LinkedIn.

However, if you believe another platform could create significant value for BEBURAS, tell us which one and why.

---

How to Apply

Please tell us:

1. Which channel would you like to own?

2. Why are you particularly good at that channel?

3. What would you do with the BEBURAS channel?

4. What have you previously built or grown?

5. How would you turn the channel into qualified commercial opportunities?

We are interested in how you think, not just your CV.

---

This is not a traditional job.

There is no fixed schedule and no requirement to sit online from 9 to 5.

There is no predefined content calendar that you simply execute.

We are looking for people who want to own a channel, build something meaningful and participate in the commercial upside they create.

BEBURAS | Capital & Global Ventures

Results over rules.

title: German Audio & Content Editor
description:
AVIEW helps top creators and entertainment brands reach audiences around the world by translating, dubbing, subtitling, and distributing their content across international markets.

We are currently looking for German-speaking Audio & Content Editors to support our growing German localization team. This role is focused on editing German dubbed content and making sure the final videos sound natural, clean, and engaging for German-speaking audiences.

**About the Role** 
We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented editor with a strong ear for German dialogue, tone, timing, and natural delivery. You’ll work on international versions of creator and entertainment content, helping refine dubbed audio, sync dialogue, and improve redubs so they feel native and polished.

This is a great opportunity for German-speaking editors, sound designers, dubbing editors, and creative freelancers who want to work in the fast-growing world of multilingual media and content localization.

**What You’ll Do**

* Edit and refine German dubbed audio tracks to match the original creator’s tone, rhythm, and pacing.
* Sync German dialogue with video content for a natural viewing experience.
* Review German redubs and improve timing, flow, pronunciation, and emotional delivery.
* Apply minor audio adjustments including trimming, timing, volume balancing, EQ, and cleanup.
* Collaborate with translators, reviewers, voice talent, and editors to deliver polished final videos.
* Help maintain quality consistency across episodes, series, and ongoing creator projects.
* Flag any issues with translation flow, voice performance, timing, or audio quality.

**Who You Are**

* You are fluent in German and have a strong understanding of natural spoken German.
* You have a sharp ear for tone, rhythm, pronunciation, and emotional delivery.
* You can tell when German audio sounds natural versus robotic, rushed, or awkward.
* You are comfortable using audio editing tools such as ElevenLabs, Adobe Audition, Reaper, Audacity, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.
* You can work independently, follow feedback, and meet deadlines.
* You care about making dubbed content feel native, not just translated.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience in dubbing, localization, post-production, or sound design.
* Experience editing German content.
* Familiarity with AI audio tools such as ElevenLabs, Adobe Enhance Speech, iZotope RX, or similar tools.
* Experience working with subtitles, SRT files, or translated scripts.

**Why Join AVIEW**

* 100% remote — work from anywhere.
* Flexible hours — fit projects around your schedule.
* Work with a creative team helping top global creators reach new audiences.
* Gain experience in dubbing, localization, and international content distribution.
* Growth opportunities as AVIEW expands its German and multilingual production teams.

**Compensation**
This role is paid on a piecework basis at $0.05 CAD per redub / dubbing line. And $1.00 per minute of edits (if applicable)

Workload is flexible and will depend on project volume, availability, and quality of work.

How to Apply If you are fluent in German, have a strong ear for natural dialogue, and want to help creators bring their content to global audiences, apply now to join AVIEW’s team.

title: Patient Care Coordinator (Part-time)
description:
**About Evolvinn**
At Evolvinn, we believe mental healthcare should feel deeply human. We are a virtual practice committed to creating a thoughtful, personalized experience for every patient who entrusts us with their care.

Many of our patients come to us during some of the most vulnerable seasons of their lives. Others stay with us for years, sharing updates about milestones, family vacations, and life's everyday moments. We value building genuine relationships, not simply checking boxes — making people feel seen and known and cared for.

As our practice continues to grow, we're looking for a Patient Care Coordinator who shares that philosophy and wants to help create an exceptional patient experience from the very first interaction.

This always remote position begins as a part-time role (approximately 20 hours per week), with the potential to grow into a full-time opportunity as the practice expands.

**Position Overview**
The Patient Care Coordinator is often one of the first people our patients connect with. You'll serve as a trusted guide throughout their journey and a safe landing pad where patients can take a deep breath as you answer questions, coordinate appointments, manage communication, and ensure every patient feels seen, heard, and cared for.

This role blends organization, communication, technology, and compassion. The ideal candidate enjoys creating order behind the scenes while making every interaction feel warm and personal.

**What You'll Do**
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to*:

* Respond to patient emails, phone calls, and text messages with warmth, professionalism, and empathy.
* Schedule appointments and manage provider calendars.
* Coordinate the onboarding process for new patients, including sending and tracking intake forms.
* Assist patients with scheduling questions, Zoom links, paperwork, and general navigation of our practice.
* Regularly communicate with our team of clinicians around the coordination of patients’ care.
* Answer billing questions and follow up regarding outstanding balances or payment issues.
* Enter and maintain accurate patient information within our electronic medical record (SimplePractice).
* Prepare and organize patient documentation and administrative materials.
* Navigate and balance communication dynamics with both clinicians and patients, using discretion, compassion, and understanding.
* Monitor multiple Outlook inboxes and communication platforms to ensure timely follow-up.
* Help maintain smooth daily operations through task management, coordination, and various administrative projects.
* Support continuous improvements to workflows and internal systems as our practice grows.

*When we say “not limited to” — we do not mean that there are hidden tasks not mentioned in this list, rather that this role and this practice are always evolving so this role and it’s duties will inevitably evolve, sustainably, with it.*

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**
You might be a great fit if you:

* Naturally lead with kindness, empathy, and curiosity.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Can make people feel genuinely cared for, even through email or text.
* Can balance warmth and professionalism, while setting clearly communicated expectations.
* Are thoughtfully organized and thrive on keeping many moving pieces aligned.
* Pay close attention to details and follow through consistently.
* Take initiative without waiting to be asked.
* Are comfortable learning new technology and troubleshooting independently.
* Remain calm, thoughtful, and compassionate during emotionally sensitive conversations.
* Enjoy improving processes and finding more efficient, sustainable ways to work.
* Value confidentiality and professionalism.
* Comfort managing competing/shifting priorities, while knowing when questions or priorities need to be escalated — and knowing when to ask for support.
* Comfort working independently, while being able to take ownership of making sure details, questions, and tasks  don't fall through the cracks.
* You are someone with high emotional intelligence. You aren’t just organized; you’re someone who notices that a patient mentioned their daughter's wedding three months ago and remember to ask how it went. You can read between the lines of communications — knowing when someone needs reassurance versus a concise answer.

**Preferred Experience**
We're more interested in finding the right person than checking every box. Who you are as a person is more important than previous job titles, degrees, career gaps, or exact-matching experience.

Helpful experience or related-experiences include:

* Customer service or client-facing roles.
* Administrative or executive support.
* Healthcare, wellness, or medical office experience (can be helpful but not required).
* Experience working remotely.
* Experience managing multiple communication channels simultaneously, but sustainably.

**Technology You'll Use**
You'll receive training, but familiarity with technology in general is important. Our team uses:

* SimplePractice
* Microsoft Outlook
* Microsoft Teams
* Microsoft OneDrive
* Notion
* Spruce Health

If you're someone who enjoys learning new software and isn't afraid to search for a tutorial when needed, you'll do well here.

**Schedule**

* Approximately 20 hours per week to start.
* Monday through Friday.
* While there is some flexibility in scheduling, this position requires consistent weekday availability within our core business hours of 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time.

**Our Culture**
We're a small but growing team that believe people matter—both our patients and each other.

We strive to create a workplace where kindness, transparency, trust, work-life balance, and collaboration are valued just as much as efficiency or productivity. We believe this work can be both highly organized and deeply compassionate.

If you're looking for a role where your work genuinely impacts people's lives and where relationships matter more than rushing through a task list, we'd love to hear from you.

# Application Requirements:
Email the following to info@evolvinn.com
* Resume
* Cover Letter with Prompt: In a cover letter (*this does not need to be fancy or formal, just human*), please write to the following prompts:
    **1. Tell us about a time you made someone feel genuinely cared for.**
    This can be at work or outside of work.
   
    **2. What part of this job description stood out to you most, and why?**
    
    **3. Tell us about a process you've improved from a thoughtful, compassionate place, even if it was something small.**
    At the end of your cover letter, please include the phrase:
    "*Relationships matter more than rushing through a task list.*"

title: B2B SDR | SaaS & Technology | Cold Calling | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
I’m building a small outbound sales operation supporting several growing B2B companies, and I’m looking for a strong SDR who can become a long-term part of the operation.

This is not a script-reading appointment setter role.

I’ll handle the overall sales strategy, ICP, positioning, targeting, and initial playbooks. I need someone who can take that strategy, learn an offering quickly, get on the phone, and turn cold prospects into real conversations and qualified opportunities.

Current work ranges from SaaS and emerging technology to professional services and nonprofit technology. You may speak with a law firm owner about marketing one day and a technology executive about a sophisticated software product the next.

You do not need to be an expert in every industry. You do need to be able to understand a new business quickly, identify why a buyer should care, and have an intelligent conversation without sounding like you're reading a script.

What you'll be doing:

High-volume B2B cold calling and outbound prospecting
Speaking directly with founders, owners, executives, and other decision-makers
Learning multiple products, industries, and buyer personas
Qualifying prospects and booking meetings
Handling objections and navigating conversations naturally
Maintaining accurate CRM notes, dispositions, and follow-up activity
Working with tools such as Trellus, HubSpot, Apollo, and similar sales technology
Providing feedback on what you're hearing so we can continuously improve messaging, targeting, and sales strategy

Who I'm looking for:

Ideally, you have 1–3+ years of experience as an SDR, BDR, or in another role where you personally conducted significant B2B cold outreach.

I'm specifically looking for someone who:

Enjoys hunting for new business Is comfortable spending significant time on the phone
Can think and adapt during a conversation rather than blindly follow a script
Is comfortable speaking with senior decision-makers
Can quickly understand unfamiliar products and industries
Doesn't get rattled by rejection or objections
Is technologically sharp and comfortable learning new software
Has experience with CRMs and modern outbound sales tools
Is highly coachable and interested in improving
Can move between multiple campaigns while keeping each client's message straight

I'm not looking for someone whose primary experience is customer service, inbound sales, virtual assistance, or scripted call-center work. I need someone who has personally hunted for B2B opportunities.

Structure & Opportunity

This will start at approximately 15–20 hours per week, with the potential to grow substantially.

Target compensation: $20–$30/hour depending on experience, with the potential for performance-based upside as the role develops.

For the right person, I want this to become much more than a short-term freelance project. As we add clients and campaigns, there is an opportunity to take on considerably more responsibility and hours.

Interview Process

I'm going to keep the interview process practical.

If selected for an interview, I'll give you a short briefing on a B2B company, its product, and its target customer. You'll have a few minutes to digest it, and then we'll role-play a cold call.

I'm not testing whether you can memorize a script.

I'm looking at how quickly you understand the offering, how you open the conversation, whether you ask intelligent questions, how you handle objections, and whether you can actually sell.

Finalists may then be offered a paid live-calling trial on a campaign.

When applying, answer these 4 questions:
1)  What products or services have you personally sold through B2B cold calling?
2)  Approximately how many outbound calls were you personally making per day or week?
3)  What sales and prospecting technology have you used? Please be specific.
4)  Tell me about a product or industry you had to learn quickly in order to sell effectively.
