title: Business Development Partner: Control & Embedded Systems
location: California; Washington; Austin; Dallas; Houston; Boston; Chicago; Detroit; Pittsburgh; Raleigh; Atlanta; Denver; Phoenix; New York City; Salt Lake City; Minneapolis
description:
**Commission-only · Independent contractor · Remote / worldwide · Ongoing**

Read this first

This role is only open to people already working in the automation, robotics, control or embedded systems industry, with live contacts there. We are not hiring general salespeople, and a network built in another sector will not work here. If that is not you, this post is not for you.

About us

Integrated Core Systems builds ICore Blocks, a block-diagram simulator and code generator for control, robotics and machine-learning systems.

* A block library covering control systems, machine learning, robotics and system identification.
* Exports a model to ten languages: C, C++, Rust, Python, MATLAB, Java, VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog and PLC Structured Text. The generated code runs on PLCs, microcontrollers, FPGAs and robotics stacks.
* Verifies its own output. The exported code is built, run, and compared against the simulation sample by sample.
* Imports and exports MATLAB/Simulink models.
* Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux, and is also available as a C++ SDK that customers link into their own software.

Product and documentation: systemsicore.com · docs.systemsicore.com

What you would be selling

* Licenses, each up to USD $28,000. Desktop licenses, either for individual engineers or for engineering teams.
* SDK and integration agreements, USD $30,000 to $500,000. The customer embeds the engine inside their own product. These include redistribution rights, floating seats, and our engineers fitting it to the customer's toolchain.
* Integration deals are the large ones, and the main reason this role exists.

All pricing is public, including every axis a quote is built from, so you can talk numbers openly from the first call.

The role

We are looking for people with existing relationships in engineering organisations to open doors and close business for us. This is a partner arrangement, not a staff position. You work your own network, on your own schedule, and you are paid on results.

What you would be doing

* Find companies that would embed the engine in their own product. Industrial automation and robotics platform vendors, machine builders, OEMs, test and tooling companies, systems integrators. These are the largest deals.
* Find engineering teams that would license it. Groups deploying control, robotics or embedded ML to PLCs, MCUs, FPGAs or robotics stacks, across aerospace, automotive, industrial automation, energy, medical devices, defence, robotics and universities.
* Qualify them: what they build, what they deploy onto, what tools they use now, and what it costs them.
* Arrange and support technical demos. Our engineers handle deep technical questions. You own the relationship and the commercial thread.
* Negotiate and close, from single seats to site licences to SDK and enterprise agreements.
* Resell, refer or co-sell alongside your own consulting or training practice, if you have one.
* Compensation: read this part carefully

This role pays commission only. There is no salary, no base, no retainer, and no payment for time, activity or effort. You are paid when a deal closes and we are paid.

*  15% to 20% of everything you sell. The exact rate within that band is set in your partner agreement and reflects deal type and volume.
*  Licences run from USD $24/month up to USD $28,000, depending on configuration and seat count.
*  Integration contracts run USD $30,000 to $500,000.
*  Recurring subscriptions pay you the same 15% to 20% on every renewal, for as long as your partner contract with us is active and your name is assigned to the subscription account.
*  Payment terms. We pay commission only after the customer has paid us. No commission is issued in advance of cleared funds, on any deal type.
*  Licence and subscription sales: paid within 15 days of the customer's payment reaching us. Where a customer pays in instalments, your commission is paid pro rata as each instalment arrives.
*  Integration and contract engagements: paid 30 days after the invoice date, or within 15 days of the customer's payment reaching us, whichever is later. Payment is also conditional on the engagement not having been cancelled by us or by the customer before it falls due.
*  No cap, no territory ceiling, no quota.
*  On those numbers, a single integration contract is worth USD $4,500 to $100,000 to you, and a licence sale up to USD $5,600, with the subscription trail on top of it.

What we provide at no cost to you: a full software licence for demos, product and technical training, sales materials, pricing authority within an agreed band, engineering support on calls, and a registered-lead system so two partners never work the same account.

What we do not provide: expenses, travel, equipment, leads, a territory guarantee, or any payment before a closed sale. You cover your own costs of doing business.

Who this fits

* Independent sales agents, manufacturers' reps and channel partners already selling engineering software, tooling or automation hardware into these industries.
* People who have sold OEM, embedded or licensed-component deals before, where the customer puts your technology inside their own product. This is our largest deal type and the hardest to find people for.
* Consultants and trainers in control systems, embedded development or model-based design with a client base that already has this problem.
* Former Simulink, dSPACE, Vector, NI or PLC-vendor salespeople who kept their contacts.
* Distributors and resellers of engineering tooling looking to add a line.
* Who this does not fit

Anyone who needs predictable income while ramping up. Anyone starting from zero contacts in these industries. Anyone expecting us to supply leads. Commission-only works when you bring an existing network, and it is a poor deal for you if you do not.

Requirements

* A demonstrable network among engineers or technical decision-makers in at least one of the industries above.
* A track record closing technical or capital-goods sales.
* Enough technical fluency to hold a credible first conversation about simulation, code generation, embedded deployment, and what it means to link an SDK into someone else's product. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should know what a solver, a control loop and a build toolchain are, and not be thrown by the words PLC, FPGA or redistribution licence.
* Legally able to operate as an independent contractor or registered business in your country, and to invoice us.
* Fluent English is required. Experience with any additional language is a great asset, as the market is global.

How to apply

Email careers@systemsicore.com with:

* Your CV. Required. Applications without one are not considered.
* A short note on the network you would be working and which industries it sits in.
* What you have sold before and to whom. Deal sizes welcome.
* Your best guess at which three organisations you would approach first, and why.
* We reply to everyone who sends all four.

Equal opportunity and accommodation

In keeping with the British Columbia Human Rights Code, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, ancestry, place of origin, political belief, religion, marital status, family status, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or a criminal conviction unrelated to the role.

If you need an accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, write to careers@systemsicore.com and we will arrange it. Accommodation requests are kept confidential and play no part in our decision.

title: Staff AI Product Engineer
description:
GoodParty.org is looking for a Staff AI Product Engineer to help scale frontier AI to empower tens of thousands of Independent candidates and elected officials who are putting people over parties. This is a role for an engineer who nerds out about the latest in AI, tests what actually works, and turns the best ideas into durable, high-impact features for our users.

You will lead technical projects without needing to be a people manager: shaping architecture, setting patterns, building across the stack, and pushing our AI-native products into the hands of civic leaders who are solving real problems for their communities.

**About GoodParty.org:**

A majority of voters, including more than half of Millennials and Gen Z, say that neither major party represents them. GoodParty.org is the solution.

We're on a mission to make people matter more than money in our democracy by empowering Independent candidates to run, win, and serve.

Since 2024, 13,000+ Independent candidates have won their races across all 50 states using our tools, training, and support. Our AI-powered platform provides free tools to launch and run campaigns, connect with voters, and serve their communities effectively — without needing a political party or big donors. What our users have in common is that they prioritize people over parties and community over special interests. We're not a political party, we're a platform and a movement to democratize democracy.

Founded by serial entrepreneur Farhad Mohit ($1B+ in exits, including Flipagram/TikTok and Shopzilla), GoodParty.org is building solutions so we can have a truly representative democracy where society's biggest problems are solved.

**What you'll do:**

- You will single-handedly build and own large parts of the GoodParty.org products that serve independent candidates and elected officials every day.
- You will iterate extremely quickly. You’ll regularly take rough product ideas (a sentence or two) and transform those into a working MVP in 1-2 days. Then, you’ll ask “how could I have done this in 1-2 hours?”
- You won’t manually write code, and you won’t manually review code.
- You will push the boundaries of what is possible with agents, both in GoodParty.org products and in your day-to-day-work.  
  
**Who we're looking for:**
- You have hard experience shipping and iterating on production AI systems with real usage. You have hands-on experience designing eval systems, building agent graphs, and doing general agent engineering.
- You are bored by most blog posts on AI and agentic engineering. You’re past that, and are interested in personally pushing the envelope by designing, building, and measuring processes and systems that *actually* work on your team.
- You have a hard track record of single-handedly delivering internal improvements that meaningfully and measurably increase the output of everyone on your team. You obsess over projects like this that create leverage for the whole team.
- You are skilled at the whole remote communication thing. In chaotic situations, you are a clarity-creator.

**Bonus if:**

- You have professional or volunteer experience in civic tech, democracy reform, political campaigns, or social impact initiatives.

**Why you should work at GoodParty.org:**

- Join a passionate team with diverse political views focused on one mission. Our values are: People First. Direct, Open, and Honest. Empowered Ownership. Iterate for Impact. Fun Is Fuel.
- We're a Public Benefit Corporation that prioritizes social impact over profit.
- Innovative Bitcoin denominated deferred bonus plan, allowing you to have the amazing upside of being in a startup while working on a truly meaningful mission.
- Work where and how you like, on a fully remote team spread across the country.
- 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents.
- We encourage you to take time off to recharge and have an unlimited PTO (sick and vacation) policy. This is a marathon, not a sprint. We believe a work-life balance is needed to get there.
- 401(k) program available so you can contribute toward retirement savings (no employer match).
- Individual learning & development budget to fund your growth.
- We'll make sure you've got what you need to work remotely through our workspace setup stipend.
- If you work from home, we give $50/month to help with your internet and other expenses. If you prefer co-working, that's an option we can discuss too.
- Fully funded for our mission. No stressing over whether the next round of funding will come through. Focus on making an impact. That's what matters here.

The salary range is $200,000 - 235,000 for this remote, full-time position with excellent benefits. This range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, seniority, education, qualifications, certifications, and organizational needs. We reserve the right to modify this pay range at any time.

We are not considering candidates currently based outside of the US, so please only apply if you are physically located in the US. Unfortunately, we are not able to provide sponsorship for any of our roles at this time.

**Ready to learn more or apply?**

We hope you'll apply! You can also keep up with the latest by signing up at [GoodParty.org/about](http://GoodParty.org/about). If you know anyone else who may be interested, please share this job posting — thanks!

title: Senior Technical Marketing Engineer
description:
## Senior Technical Marketing Engineer

Remote, U.S. (Travel up to 25%)

**Reports to:** Lab Lead, FarmGPU AI Lab

**Employment status:** Full-time

### About FarmGPU

FarmGPU operates bare-metal NVIDIA GPU clusters (H100, H200, and B200) for AI developers, enterprises, and research organizations through RunPod Secure Cloud and direct enterprise deployments. From our facility in Rancho Cordova, we own the full stack: datacenter networking, RDMA fabrics, GPU server operations, and high-performance storage built for AI training and inference.

The **FarmGPU AI Lab** is our independent validation lab. Storage vendors, silicon makers, and ISVs bring us their hardware and software, and we put it through its paces on production-grade infrastructure. Most engagements end in published work: whitepapers, reference architectures, and technical and solutions briefs, plus industry benchmark submissions such as MLPerf Storage v3.0.

We're building a small, senior team dedicated to a flagship validation program with a strategic storage partner. The team builds the systems, runs the tests, and stands behind the numbers when they go public.

---

## The Role

This is a technical marketing role for someone who has done the testing. You'll turn benchmark data and engineering findings into blogs, benchmark reports, whitepapers, reference architectures, and solutions briefs that land with infrastructure buyers and hold up under expert scrutiny. You'll also get your hands dirty: running tests, validating results, and building real understanding of every platform you write about.

The best technical content comes from people who have done the work. If you've spent years testing servers, storage, GPUs, and networking gear, and writing about what you found in a way people actually want to read, this role was built for you.

---

## What You'll Do

### Content & Collateral

- **Own the lab's content pipeline**: blog posts, benchmark reports, whitepapers, reference architectures, technical briefs, and solutions briefs.
- **Find the story in the data**: turn raw results and engineering analysis into a clear narrative without overstating what the data shows.
- **Build collateral for partners and events**: slide decks, one-pagers, demo scripts, and conference presentations.
- **Write for every audience**: methodology for the engineers, the takeaway for the executives, and the judgment to know which piece needs which.

### Hands-On Testing & Validation

- **Test platforms yourself**: servers, SSDs, GPUs, networking, and software stacks, in the lab and alongside the engineering team.
- **Validate every claim**: reproduce key results, check configurations, and make sure every published number traces back to a run.
- **Get in early**: evaluate new hardware and software early so the content is ready when the product is.

### Partners & Go-to-Market

- **Coordinate co-marketing with partners and ISVs**: joint content, review and approval cycles, embargoes, and launch timing.
- **Know the rules of the road**: benchmark disclosure requirements, embargo terms, and results-usage guidelines from bodies like MLCommons.
- **Represent the lab publicly**: at industry events, on panels and podcasts, and across social channels.
- **Work with FarmGPU marketing** to keep messaging, brand, and distribution consistent.

---

## What You Bring

- **8+ years in technical marketing, technical writing, or technology journalism** covering enterprise infrastructure, storage, compute, or networking, with a published portfolio to prove it.
- **Extensive hands-on testing experience** across many platforms (servers, storage systems, SSDs, GPUs, networking), including building test setups and running industry-standard benchmarks.
- **Marketing instincts**: you know how to position a result, build a campaign around it, and measure whether it worked.
- **Technical depth** to talk NVMe, PCIe, RDMA, GPU architecture, and AI workloads credibly with engineers.
- **Data literacy**: comfortable with benchmark data, charts, and basic statistics. You catch a misleading chart before it ships.
- **Editorial judgment and speed**: clean, confident copy on deadline, in a voice people want to read.
- **Comfort presenting** on stage, on camera, and in partner briefings.
- **Willingness to travel** up to 25% for lab time in Rancho Cordova, partner meetings, and industry events.

---

## Preferred Qualifications

- Hardware review or technical media background, running lab-based product evaluations.
- Technical Marketing Engineer experience at a storage, server, silicon, or networking vendor.
- AI infrastructure experience: GPU servers, training and inference workloads, and AI storage.
- Familiarity with MLPerf, SPEC, or other industry benchmark programs and their publication rules.
- Video, podcast, or livestream production.
- Web publishing and analytics: CMS, SEO, and content performance tracking.
- An existing audience or network in the storage, HPC, or AI infrastructure community.
- Fluency with AI tools for research, drafting, and editing, with the judgment to keep your own voice.

---

## What Success Looks Like

- A steady, predictable cadence of published lab content, with partner approvals landing in one or two review rounds.
- Every published claim traces to data and holds up under expert scrutiny.
- Content that drives measurable engagement and partner demand.
- A recognizable voice for the FarmGPU AI Lab across the storage and AI infrastructure community.

---

## Why FarmGPU?

- **A story worth telling.** Next-generation hardware, production GPU infrastructure, and results worth writing about.
- **A real lab behind you.** You're remote, but you can book time on the hardware and test it yourself.
- **Work that goes public.** Your content gets published by FarmGPU and our partners and presented at major industry events.
- **Industry reach.** FarmGPU leads the OCP neocloud workgroup, and your work reaches the people building AI infrastructure.
- **Small, senior team.** A direct line to the engineers producing the data, and real latitude on voice and format.

---

## Compensation

- $120,000 to $200,000 base salary, depending on experience.
- Full-time, **remote position (U.S.)**, with travel up to 25% to Rancho Cordova, CA, partner sites, and industry events.

---

## Culture & Fit

FarmGPU is a small team running serious infrastructure. We value people who are close to the work, communicate directly, and close the loop, not people who create process for its own sake.

**AI-first by default.** We use AI to move faster across every function. For this role that means using AI to research, outline, and accelerate drafts, while the voice, the judgment, and the accuracy stay yours.

**High agency.** You see a gap, you own it end to end: identify → decide → execute → document.

**Direct communication.** If the data doesn't support the headline, we change the headline.

**Builders, not tourists.** You understand what we publish because you've run it yourself.

**Radically transparent.** Results, methodology, and partner context are visible internally, and we expect you to use them.

title: Product Engineer, UX
description:
# Product Engineer, UX

**Bespoke is building the operating layer for the modern asset management firm.**

Asset management is heading into its largest structural change in decades. The work that defines advisory firms today is research, client service, operations, and compliance, and more and more of it will run on systems. Bespoke brings market intelligence, firm context, and workflow automation into one platform. The work runs on rails, the advisor makes the decisions, and every step is recorded.

Software like this only works if people want to use it. That's what this role is for.

## The role

We're hiring a product engineer who is, at heart, an exceptional UX builder. You'll own the full experience of Bespoke:

- **The first mile.** Onboarding and first-run experiences that make a complex platform feel obvious within minutes.
- **Novel workflows.** Interaction patterns that don't exist yet, for how advisors review, approve, and act on work the system prepares for them.
- **The design system.** You'll evolve our design language and component library so every surface feels consistent, fast, and considered.
- **Much more.** Work in a tight-knit team where dialogue is encouraged, a sense for design and aesthetic it essential. 

You'll work directly with the founders and our Head of Product. You'll take ideas from sketch to production and ship full-stack when a feature needs it. Most of your time goes to the experience. The rest goes to making sure it's built well.

## What we're looking for

**Exceptional attention to detail.** You notice the 2px misalignment, the loading state nobody designed, and the empty state that reads wrong. You fix them before anyone asks.

**Deep UX craft.** You have a portfolio of interfaces people love using. You think in flows, states, and edge cases, not just screens. You have strong taste and can explain the reasoning behind it.

**Builder's range.** You're fluent in React and TypeScript and comfortable in the backend (Node.js or Python, SQL, APIs). You can ship a feature end to end.

**Opinions, openly held.** You'll push back on a flow that doesn't work and propose a better one.

**Modern tooling.** You use AI coding and prototyping tools every day to move faster and explore more ideas.

## Experience

- 3+ years building web applications, with a clear focus on front-end and UX
- A portfolio or shipped work that shows product and interaction design judgment
- Experience owning or contributing to a design system
- Startup or B2B SaaS experience is a plus; fintech is helpful, not required

## In your first year

- Rebuilt onboarding so new firms reach value on day one
- Shipped workflow experiences customers describe as a step change
- Established a design system that raises the bar across the whole product

## Why Bespoke

You'll be joining a small, senior team at the moment an industry rebuilds itself. You'll have real ownership from day one. Everything you ship goes straight to advisors who use it every day. If you care about the details as much as we do, we'd like to meet you.

---

A couple of notes. I retitled it "Product Engineer, UX" so the emphasis shows up before anyone reads a word. If you'd rather keep "Full Stack Product Engineer" for search visibility, "Design Engineer" is another strong option. I also asked for a portfolio, since that's the fastest way to screen for this profile. Want me to put this in a doc?

title: Trading Infrastructure Engineer
description:
# Trading Infrastructure Engineer

We’re looking for an experienced software engineer to help bring an existing trade execution infrastructure into production and extend it for a new generation of trading workflows.

The core system is substantially built. This role is about understanding the existing architecture, refactoring it to fit our current infrastructure, connecting new order-generation endpoints, integrating new asset classes, and deploying the algorithms that will ultimately drive execution.

For the right candidate, we'd be open to trying new architectures and experimenting. You’ll work closely with the PM and CEO on a lean team, with significant ownership over the system and its evolution. 

We will move quickly. 

### What You’ll Do

**Trading & Execution Infrastructure**

* Take ownership of an existing trade execution system and bring it up to current production standards.
* Refactor existing services and code to integrate cleanly with our current infrastructure.
* Build and maintain interfaces for receiving orders from new endpoints and upstream systems.
* Integrate equities and ETFs into the execution stack, initially through Interactive Brokers.
* Develop, deploy, and maintain execution algorithms and associated order-management logic.
* Build the monitoring, logging, error handling, and controls required for reliable live trading.

**Systems Engineering**

* Work across the full execution stack, from order generation and routing through broker connectivity and execution.
* Improve system architecture, reliability, observability, and operational resilience.
* Work with APIs, databases, queues, services, and cloud infrastructure as required.
* Diagnose and resolve issues across an existing codebase rather than treating the system as a greenfield build.
* Establish clean interfaces and abstractions that allow additional asset classes, brokers, and execution strategies to be added over time.

**Research → Production**

* Work directly with the PM to translate trading logic and strategies into production execution systems.
* Collaborate closely with the CEO on system architecture, priorities, and product requirements.
* Help bridge the gap between research, signal generation, order construction, and live execution.
* Iterate quickly as strategies and requirements evolve.

### Who You Are

* **Experienced engineer.** You have several years of professional software engineering experience and are comfortable taking ownership of an existing production system.
* **Strong systems instincts.** You care about reliability, clean interfaces, failure modes, observability, and writing software that behaves predictably under real-world conditions.
* **Python proficient.** Strong Python experience is important; experience with TypeScript/JavaScript or other systems languages is useful.
* **Comfortable with APIs and integrations.** You have worked with REST APIs, external services, authentication, asynchronous processes, and third-party infrastructure.
* **Able to work in an existing codebase.** You enjoy understanding what is already there, identifying what needs to change, and making targeted improvements rather than rebuilding everything from scratch.
* **Interested in markets.** You don't need to be a quant, but you should be genuinely interested in trading, market structure, and how software connects investment decisions to execution.
* **Independent and pragmatic.** This is a small team. You should be comfortable taking an ambiguous problem, figuring out what needs to happen, and driving it through implementation.
* **High attention to detail.** In an execution environment, correctness matters. You understand that seemingly small issues around state, timing, retries, order status, or data can have meaningful consequences.

### Particularly Relevant Experience

Experience with any of the following is highly relevant:

* Interactive Brokers / IBKR APIs or other broker connectivity
* Order management or execution systems
* Algorithmic trading or electronic trading infrastructure
* Equities and ETF execution
* Trading APIs and FIX
* Portfolio or order-management systems
* Market data systems
* Python-based trading infrastructure
* PostgreSQL or other relational databases
* AWS or other cloud infrastructure
* Docker / containerized services
* Event-driven or asynchronous systems
* Monitoring, logging, and production observability

### The Role

This is a **part-time engineering role** with substantial ownership and direct exposure to the PM and CEO.

The majority of the core infrastructure already exists. The immediate mandate is to understand it, revive it, modernize it where necessary, and extend it into a reliable execution platform supporting new order endpoints, equities and ETFs, Interactive Brokers connectivity, and algorithmic execution.

**Compensation: Negotiable.

title: Software Engineering Manager (Core Workspaces)
description:

You’ll guide technical direction while growing the team and keeping execution sharp. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design across the agent harness, integrations, and developer workflows.

**What you’ll do here**

- Lead and grow a team within our Workspaces organization.
- Set technical direction across the agent harness, integrations, and workflows.
- Stay close to the code and contribute to architecture and implementation decisions.
- Evolve agent execution, tool use, context management, streaming, and long-running workflows.
- Extend our provider-agnostic architecture as models and capabilities change.
- Partner with Product and Design to turn agent capabilities into useful developer experiences.
- Improve reliability, performance, and operability across agentic systems.
- Coach engineers, raise the technical bar, and create clarity around priorities and tradeoffs.

**What we’re looking for**

- Experience managing and growing software engineering teams.
- Strong hands-on engineering experience with **React and TypeScript**.
- Experience with **Go**.
- Hands-on experience building systems around LLMs and agentic workflows.
- Experience with model APIs, tool calling, context management, or agent loops.
- Strong distributed systems knowledge.
- Working knowledge of **AWS**.
- Strong technical judgment and comfort working through ambiguity.
- A track record of helping engineers grow while maintaining a high execution bar.

**Bonus tacos if you have**

- Experience building coding agents, developer tools, or cloud development environments.
- Experience with **MCP**, agent tools, or multi-agent systems.
- Experience with remote execution, sandboxing, or isolated compute.
- Experience building abstractions across multiple model providers.
- Deep experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, or Linux.
- Open-source contributions or experience working directly with customers.

**Our tech stack**

- **Backend:** Go, Postgres
- **Frontend:** TypeScript, React
- **Infrastructure:** AWS, Kubernetes
- **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions

Coder’s agentic architecture is provider-agnostic. The foundation is built; this team is focused on making it more capable, reliable, and extensible as the space evolves.

## **About Coder**

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at [_coder.com_](http://coder.com).

## **Interview process** 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

## **AI use during the interview process**

**Permitted**: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for [Ashby](https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf).

title: Director of Product
description:
**Why Tenna?** 

We take pride that our roots are in the construction industry. With this experience and knowledge, we have built a platform revolutionizing construction equipment fleet operations. We provide innovative solutions to customers looking for competitive ways to better manage and track their assets, such as heavy and light equipment, large fleets, tools, and materials.    

At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible.  

When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets on one comprehensive platform anytime, anywhere. 

 

**Position Description **

Tenna is searching for a Director of Product to translate our product vision and strategy into clear, actionable plans that drive execution across multiple product teams. This leader will manage and develop a global team while remaining closely involved in the day-to-day work required to deliver sophisticated B2B SaaS, mobile, and hardware-enabled products. 

The ideal candidate is a practical, low-ego product leader who can move easily between setting direction and ensuring work gets done. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership to establish priorities, communicate progress, remove obstacles, and deliver products that solve meaningful problems for customers. 

This is not a strategy-only position. You will stay connected to execution, regularly assess product progress, use data to inform decisions, and hold teams accountable for delivering high-quality outcomes. 

 

**Your Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, establishing clear expectations and creating accountability for results.
* Turn product goals and business priorities into clear roadmaps, requirements, timelines, and executable plans
* Partner with Software Engineering, Hardware, Design, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop coordinated solutions across products.
* Communicate product priorities, performance, risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines clearly to executives and cross-functional leaders.
* Synthesize customer feedback, product usage data, market insights, and business needs into informed product decisions.
* Engage directly with prospective and existing customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and needs related to current and future product offerings.
* Develop and maintain product requirements, roadmaps, supporting documentation, and executive-level reporting using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Use product, project-management, analytics, and reporting tools to organize work, monitor progress, and make timelines and performance visible.
* Partner with Design to create intuitive product experiences; provide thoughtful feedback on user flows, concepts, prototypes, and mockups.
* Balance long-term product direction with near-term business needs, technical realities, customer commitments, and delivery deadlines.
* Support products deployed at scale across thousands of users and complex customer environments.
* Promote a culture of strong listening, clear communication, analytical decision-making, collaboration, and continuous improvement. 

**Qualifications**
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of success in launching and scaling B2B technology products in a fast-paced environment.
* 4+ years of experience leading Product Managers.
* Experience managing the entire product lifecycle from ideation to launch and beyond. 
* A record of translating product vision and business strategy into practical plans that teams successfully execute. 
* Experience supporting native mobile deployments across large user populations, ideally using technologies such as Swift and Kotlin.  
* Working knowledge of Agile product development practices, multi-tenant systems, cloud-based platforms, and microservices architecture.  
* Strong experience directly engaging prospective and existing customers regarding current and future product offerings.  
* Proven ability to creatively solve problems, influence product improvements, and interpret business/technical requirements. 
* Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies.  
* Strong analytical thinking and decision-making abilities.  
* Sufficient technical fluency to collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how technologies and languages such as JavaScript, Java, and Python support product development; direct coding experience is not required.  
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with a proven ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.  
* Experience within the construction technology industry or IoT is strongly preferred.  
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Design, Information Technology, Economics, or a related STEM degree program is required or equivalent.  

**Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information:**
* Full-time opportunity.
* Opportunity is remote – nationwide.
* Competitive compensation package.
* Travel is required, up to 20%.
* Robust, low-cost benefit packages.
* Benefit coverage begins the first date of employment.
* Dependent Care.
* 401k match.
* Employee referral bonuses.

title: Senior Account Executive, Life Sciences
description:

Manufacturing accounts for almost 20% of the global economy and one in every seven workers on Earth, yet remains among the least digitized. More than a decade ago, we created the category to close that gap: AI-native software that puts cutting-edge tools directly in the hands of the people on the manufacturing front lines. Because we are human-centered and tech-obsessed, we are building a future of work where human ingenuity is amplified with the latest technology.

In January 2026 we became one of Boston's few new AI unicorns, reaching a $1.3B valuation. We're growing double digits in revenue year over year. The world's best manufacturers run on Tulip - turning inventory 10x faster, releasing gene therapies in hours instead of weeks, and training master craftspeople to forge engagement rings 5x more rapidly. In Life Sciences, 7 of the top 10 pharmaceutical companies trust Tulip. Pharma and biotech teams use our platform across manufacturing, quality, labs and warehouses - with applications ranging from electronic batch records, equipment logbooks and weigh-and-dispense, to QC sample management, deviation handling and material tracking. Built to support FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11, Tulip helps customers release batches faster and improve right-first-time rates without disrupting validated operations. Headquartered in Somerville, MA with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Japan, and Israel, we've been consistently named a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a Gartner leader, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work."

We run the way we build: AI-forward, humanistic, and high ownership. We're looking for builders who are energized by complex problems, rapid cycles, and the unique opportunity to see their impact on a global scale.

**About You:**

- You are on the front lines working with large strategic customer accounts from the life sciences industry.

Mapping and navigating complex relationships with multiple stakeholders each with individual interests and responsibilities will be key to your success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Experience navigating complex company procurement processes.

- Manage multiple customer opportunities with multiple partners at once while maintaining a high level of attention to detail.

- Drive referenceable customer satisfaction in your accounts

We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**About AirGarage**

AirGarage is on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with parking.

We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.

By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities.

AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time.

We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before.

Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online.

We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking.

We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more.  
  
Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling?   
  
Check out these podcasts:   
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4)  
[https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7](https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7)

# The Role 💼

You'll be AirGarage's first dedicated performance marketing hire, reporting to the Head of Marketing. You own paid media and campaign channels end to end: LinkedIn Ads, paid publications, Google Ads, and structured tests of emerging channels. Your job is to turn paid media into a predictable, scalable source of pipeline for a company selling to commercial real estate owners and leaders.

You're inheriting a nascent program where we’ve seen early signs of success, but the engine needs work. We know we're reaching the right accounts, but not enough of the right people are taking action. We’re looking for someone who can close that gap with fast, rigorous experiments on offers, creative, landing pages, and CTAs, and scale what works.

This is a build role. You'll work alongside a small marketing team that has spent the last few months building the inbound funnel from scratch. This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on.

You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out.

## What You Will Do 📊

Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion.

Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient.

Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. Manage the relationships, the creative, and the measurement. Scout the next publications and opportunities worth testing.

Build the measurement layer. Partner with sales ops and the data team on attribution as we move from first-touch to multi-touch. Make sure every dollar you spend is measured. Own reporting on spend, MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline influence, and be honest about what the data does and doesn't show.

Run campaigns as part integrated plays, partnering with our ABM marketer. Paid media at AirGarage runs in tandem with newsletter sponsorships, outbound sequences, and ABM programs pushing the same message. You'll coordinate paid with the rest of the campaign so prospects see one story.

Automate the minutiae. Build workflows with AI and tools like n8n so audience syncing, suppression, reporting, and creative production take less of your time each month.

Produce your own creative with limited support from an in-house designer. Use templates and AI design tools to create static, video, and gif variations so testing velocity is never gated on design capacity.

## Who You Are 🦚

- You've run paid B2B ad programs with pipeline accountability. You can walk us through a channel you scaled, the tests that got it there, and the ones that failed.
- LinkedIn Campaigns Manager is your second home. You understand how to target with precision, how to run effective tests, and understand how to solve for its attribution quirks.
- You're rigorous about testing. You form a hypothesis, isolate a variable, set the success criteria before launch, and kill things that don't work without getting attached.
- You're fluent in the full funnel. You care about what happens after the click as much as the click itself, and you can diagnose whether a problem is the audience, the creative, the offer, or the landing page.
- You're scrappy. This is a build-it-yourself role at a startup. You can use templates and tools to design your own ads, write your own copy, and build your own [campaigns.You](http://campaigns.You)'d rather test five rough variations this week than wait two weeks for one polished one.
- You're comfortable in the data, can pull metrics yourself, report out on them, and explain the difference between influence and causation.
- You use AI tools and want to build workflows with them, not resist them. You think about AI as leverage on your judgment, not a replacement for it.
- You're commercially minded. You measure yourself on qualified pipeline and revenue, not impressions.

## ⭐️ Nice To Have:

- Experience marketing to commercial real estate, proptech, or another long-cycle B2B category with a small, high-value buyer universe.
- Experience managing paid newsletter and publication partnerships.
- Experience running ABM air cover and retargeting programs tied to a sales team's target accounts.
- Early experience with ChatGPT ads or other emerging channels

## 🚨 Why This Role May Not Be for You 🚨 

Please review this section before applying. We are sharing this information up front because we don't expect this job to be appealing to everybody and we do not want to waste your time if you are not on board with all of the following. Below are some of the reasons you might not want this job:

- You want a strict 9-5. We work long hours at AirGarage, including nights and occasional weekends, because we love what we do.
- You don't operate quickly. We work at a fast pace and value iteration and experimentation.
- You need a fully built playbook. This is the first performance marketing hire, so you'll be building the testing framework, the reporting, and the channel processes, not inheriting them.
- You want to set it and forget it. The channels that work here are the ones that get tested and refined every week. Managing spend without changing anything is not the job.
- You're uncomfortable with imperfect data. Our attribution is still maturing, and part of your job is improving it while making decisions with what we have.
- You only want to run ads. This role includes managing publication partnerships, coordinating with outbound and ABM, and building reporting. A lot of the job is cross-functional.
- You need a large cross-functional team. Marketing at AirGarage is lean, and you'll be the only person dedicated to paid media.
- You need a dedicated designer. There is no full-time brand designer on this team. You'll build your own ad creative using Claude Design, templates you work with our in-house designer on, and AI tools for testing video and gif variations. If you can't ship a new ad without a design ticket, you'll be stuck.

**IMPORTANT NOTE 🚨**

AirGarage is a remote-first company, but we also value in-person collaboration to strengthen trust and teamwork. Team members should expect ~6 weeks of travel per year for:

- 2–3 full company offsites, “Remote Weeks”
- Lending a hand to support one new location launch
- In-person onboarding as well as supporting other onboarding sessions for new team members

The rest of the year, team members can work remotely from wherever (US time zones) they’re most comfortable as long as they are performing well in their role. Attendance at in-person events throughout the year is expected—if you’re not open to traveling ~6 weeks per year for work, our team won't be a good fit for you.

 

**THE UPSIDE 📈**

- 📈 Equity: Have a stake in the business that you’re helping to build and grow.
- 🌴 Work remotely: Live and work wherever you like! We believe in folks working where they are happiest and most productive. We currently hire teammates that are located anywhere within North America.
- 🏥 Health insurance: We offer health insurance and currently cover 85% of the cost of medical, dental, and vision plans for the primary employee and 50% of the cost of plans for dependents.
- 🍼 Parental Leave: We offer 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave to all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. The 12 weeks can be taken as a continuous leave or intermittently over the first 18 months of the child's life.
- 💻 Home office setup: Get a laptop + additional equipment needed to set you up for success.
- ⛺ Time to recharge: We have an unlimited PTO policy with a minimum requirement of 10 days per year.
- 🤑 401k: Make financial planning right for you with a 401k retirement savings program.
- ✈️ Team Off-sites: ~2 times per year our team comes together for a full week in places like Tahoe, Charleston, San Diego, Park City, and Austin.
- 📚 BookGarage: Our team loves to learn and grow together, so join us for our optional recurring book club.
- 🪴Room to grow: Our team will be orders of magnitude larger within a few years; as a part of our foundational team, you'll have opportunities to grow with us.
- 🏙️ Transform our cities: The opportunity to change the way that the world thinks about real estate use in our cities.
- 👐 Work with a diverse team: At AirGarage, we've always been committed to building a thriving team that represents the communities we serve. Our team is currently 40% female and 30%+ from underrepresented communities.

**Note**: Employment with AirGarage is contingent upon successful completion of a background check and employment verification conducted in compliance with applicable laws. Background checks are completed only after a conditional offer of employment has been made.

*We understand that there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for someone passionate, with grit and determination, who is excited to face the challenges of a rapidly growing startup. AirGarage is the type of company where you can grow exponentially, and we encourage you to apply to us even if you don't 100% match the candidate description.*

AirGarage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.  Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance.  We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Data Scientist
description:
## About the Role

We are seeking a **Data Scientist** as a foundational member of our new "Applied Measurement" team.  In this role, you will help scale Northbeam's incrementality and measurement products directly with customers, to help customers answer some of their most important marketing measurement questions.  You’ll work at the intersection of data science, causal inference, predictive modeling, and customer problems, contributing across Northbeam’s measurement products.  This can include experimentation and incrementality products, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and other predictive or machine learning products.

This is an **applied Data Science role** with direct exposure to real-world customer problems.  You’ll work closely with experienced Data Scientists and cross-functional partners across Media Strategy, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.  As you develop deeper product and methodological expertise, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to new methodology, tooling, and scalable measurement capabilities.  You will also act as a trusted technical partner to clients: explaining statistical methodology, diagnosing measurement issues in their specific account, and clearly communicating experimentation results to drive actionable recommendations.

This role emphasizes customer partnership and applied communication as much as statistical methodology and production rigor.  **The ideal candidate combines strong statistical foundations with a service-oriented mindset, and is comfortable moving between modeling, software development, and direct customer conversations.**

## Your Impact

- Partner with customers and internal teams to understand important marketing measurement questions and translate them into data science problems.
- Work with real-world customer data to ensure it is reliable and appropriate for modeling and measurement.
- Analyze model and experiment results, investigate unexpected outcomes, and identify potential data, modeling, or measurement issues.
- Translate complex statistical and modeling results into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
- Partner with Senior Data Scientists on more complex methodological and modeling problems. Collaborate with cross-functional peers to support clients with the practical application.
- Identify recurring challenges and opportunities to improve our models, diagnostics, tooling, and processes.
- Build reusable analysis and diagnostic tools that make measurement more reliable and scalable.
- As you grow in the role, contribute to the development of new methodologies, models, and production measurement capabilities.

## What You Bring

- Bachelor's degree (MS preferred) in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another highly quantitative field.
- 2+ years of experience building and deploying data science, machine learning, or AI systems in production, ideally including direct client- or customer-facing work.
- Strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and causal inference, with genuine enthusiasm for explaining these methods to non-technical audiences.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills—comfortable leading a customer conversation, explaining a modeling tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder, and writing up findings clearly.
- Strong coding and debugging skills, with the ability to write production-quality code and diagnose issues across the full stack, including source data, pipelines, model logic, and customer-facing outputs.
- A service-oriented mindset: energized by direct, hands-on customer problem-solving, not only methodology for its own sake.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment and driving projects from concept to production with a high degree of autonomy.
- Growth mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to learn new domains, customer verticals, and measurement methodologies.
- Strong preference for candidates with a robust statistical background and prior experience in digital marketing or eCommerce analytics.

description:

Background in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure products
Open-source contributions

How Success Is Measured

Why Mattermost

Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide
Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership
AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty
End-to-end ownership: Ship and own complex software across the full stack with real accountability for what you build
Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant developer community shaping the future of secure collaboration
Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

U.S. Eligibility & Compliance

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR. For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

 

 

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.
 
We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.
 
Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**_About Monte Carlo_**

Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that unifies data and agent observability to monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production AI systems. As enterprises prepare to deploy thousands of agents across business-critical use cases, Monte Carlo provides the reliability infrastructure to support them along this AI transformation, from human-guided agents to fully autonomous operations. Founded in 2019 and backed by leading investors, Monte Carlo empowers data and AI teams to ship trusted AI at scale. Learn more at [_montecarlo.ai_](https://montecarlo.ai)

## The Role

We're hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to build the core of our agent trust platform: the backend services, distributed systems, and agentic workflows that let enterprises monitor and trust AI in production. You'll get a problem statement, not a spec, and take it from prototype to architecture to a tested, deployed product. The role is mostly backend, and you'll ship the React surfaces that go with it when the work calls for it.

## What You'll Do

- Take vague problem statements to production: prototype fast, pick the architecture, build it, test it, deploy it, and own it after launch.
- Build and run production-grade backend services and APIs in Python that power Monte Carlo's core platform and agentic systems.
- Design and scale distributed systems that stay reliable, observable, and fast as customer data and agent volume grow.

- Build and maintain data pipelines behind analytics, ML, and customer-facing features.

- **0-to-1 ownership.** You've taken ambiguous problems from a blank page to a deployed product: prototype, architecture, build, testing, and deploy. You move with urgency and treat outcomes as yours.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
## About Check

Payroll is broken. It's still running on decades-old infrastructure. **We're rebuilding it.**  
  
We don't run payroll ourselves — we power the businesses that do. As the inventors of embedded payroll, we're redefining how people get paid and making it easier for those businesses to launch, grow, and thrive.

 

On our team, you'll use creative problem-solving, critical thinking, and grit to simplify the complexity of payroll for thousands of employers of every size, across all industries. We ignore conventional role boundaries in favor of the unique strengths and values each builder brings to our mission: ***make paying people simple**.* [_Check out our origin story!_](https://app.notion.com/p/checkhq/The-Generalist-Check-Solving-the-150-Billion-Payroll-Problem-3b24274a2e75804e9141cfac60476d25?source=copy_link)

 

Check is far more than just API infrastructure. We’re a springboard for building and scaling payroll businesses. [See how it works for our partners.](https://www.checkhq.com/partners)

 

**The Work**

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Payouts — how employees and contractors actually get paid across Check's infrastructure. It's a well-scoped, high-trust domain: ACH is live and stable today, and we're gearing up for bigger swings next year. You'll partner closely with a dedicated engineering counterpart, Check leadership, and our partners — software companies across diverse verticals — to keep payouts rock-solid while building what's next.

**In this role, you will:**

- Own execution on Payouts end-to-end, from ACH today toward same-day pay and new payment methods
- Take a well-scoped problem and run with it — you'll be trusted to execute thoroughly and with strong judgment, not just to check boxes
- Sweat the details: catch edge cases before they ship and hold a high bar for quality, with minimal need for rework
- Know when to make the call yourself and when to loop in your manager — escalation judgment matters as much as independent execution
- Partner closely with your dedicated engineering counterpart and cross-functional teams (engineering, operations, partners) to ship reliably
- Connect directly with Check's partners to understand how payouts show up in their day-to-day, and translate that into product decisions

**Many backgrounds could fit this role, but ideal candidates will have some or all of the following:**

- Product management experience in technology companies
- A track record of thorough, low-iteration execution on well-scoped work — you ship things that don't come back for rework
- Good judgment about when to escalate versus handle something yourself
- Payments experience is a plus, but not required — payroll and tax knowledge isn't required either; we consider it learnable
- Comfort partnering closely with engineering, operations, and external partners to drive a project to completion
- Willingness to attend our annual 3-day company offsite in the spring

## Travel & Office Policy

The Check team is distributed across the US. Roles can be remote, hybrid, or based in one of our offices in **New York City** or **San Francisco**. We offer ample opportunities and encourage employees to attend team offsites, events, and hackathons throughout year. All Checketeers gather in the spring for our annual 3-day company retreat.

For our in-office and hybrid employees, our offices are open all week. We provide meals on **Tuesdays** and **Thursdays** and there are regular happy hours, game nights, and other in-person events.

Remote work at Check requires the ability to perform all responsibilities without distraction or disruption, while maintaining quality, effective communication, and productivity.
