title: Data Scientist
description:
## **About Oden:**

Manufacturing is undergoing its fourth industrial revolution, with factory operations increasingly driven by real-time applications that combine process and context data with advanced ML and AI algorithms. This is unlocking a staggering opportunity to improve the efficiency and productivity of existing manufacturing processes. 

As a Manufacturing AI company, Oden is at the forefront of this revolution. We combine large-scale data processing architectures and advanced AI and ML algorithms within the Oden platform so manufacturing operations teams can continuously monitor, analyze, and optimize their production, across a diverse set of processes and conditions. Our goal is to maximize efficiency, sustainability, and competitiveness in the manufacturing domain - to help True Makers Make Things Better!

## Culture

- We obsess over customers. Everything we do is to create profound results and delight for our customers. Every Viking cares about the purpose of the product and company, and prioritizes work based on customer end results. When in doubt, we go to the Gemba – we’re happy to put on steel toe boots and hit the factory floor to work with the production manager.
- We move fast and follow through – we live by transparent and scientific thinking, act with urgency, and put in the work to find the best ideas with those around us.
- We elevate each other by giving and receiving direct, honest feedback and holding ourselves and others to a high standard to help the team rise, deliver, and win together.
- “Be True Makers to Serve True Makers.” We’re building a community that fuels innovation and accelerates our pace and impact. We always ask if there’s a better way to do something, even if it's unconventional – then we try it. We aim for bold yet simple solutions that cut through complexity and drive meaningful progress.

## 

## **The Role:**

As a Data Scientist on our Customer Solutions team, you'll build the models and algorithms that turn customer manufacturing data into real answers, think predictive quality models, machine failure prediction, and pattern discovery in time-series data. Your work drives real-time solutions we deploy directly with customers, and it feeds back into Oden's core product and roadmap.

You'll dig into real-time process measurements, external context data, outcomes like quality, cost, and yield, and process knowledge from both structured and unstructured sources, drawing on data science, machine learning, and statistics to solve the problem in front of you. With an AI-first mindset, you'll also work with agentic AI models and frameworks that let customers interact with their data and results through natural language, including Oden's own Agentic Root Cause Analysis methodology, which you'll help extend.

You'll partner closely with Customer Success, Product, and customers themselves, defining problems, running trials and proofs of concept, and delivering finished work through the Oden platform. This is an end-to-end role: you'll carry projects from first concept through development and deployment, and act as the bridge between Oden's technical team and customer stakeholders.

## **Responsibilities Include But Not Limited To:**

- Work directly with Oden customers to scope data analysis and modeling needs for real manufacturing problems
- Develop and validate models, algorithms, and methods delivered through the Oden platform
- Validate results in live, real-world customer deployments
- Partner with engineering to implement and ship solutions
- Generalize one-off solutions into the next generation of product features
- Work with Product to translate customer problems into roadmap requirements
- Engage with the technical community: share results externally, stay current on the field, and help advance the state of the art

## **Required Experience:**

- 1-3 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or ML Engineer, with a B.S. or M.S. in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Economics, or a related field
- Strong Python skills, including common ML and statistics libraries
- Strong SQL skills
- Familiarity with process improvement and exploratory techniques (design of experiments, optimization)
- Hands-on familiarity with generative AI models, for code development, experimentation, and generating insights for customers and end users on the Oden platform
- Comfort directing frontier AI models and AI agents as tools you steer, not magic you wait on
- A drive to own projects end-to-end, from first experiment to customer delivery
- Ability to travel at least once a month

## **Compensation**

We anticipate the base salary band for this role (Data Scientist) will be between $95,000 and $155,000, in addition to equity and benefits. The salary at offer will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.

**At this time, we cannot offer visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship**

### At Oden, we are deeply committed to ensuring that every team member is engaged in work they are passionate about and find fulfilling. We prioritze your career development, offering personalized pathways for growth and advancement. Our approach is to align your strengths and interests with the company’s goals, ensuring that you not only contribute meaningfully but also progress steadily in your professional journey, reaching new heights in your career.

### We’re an equal opportunity employer (EOE). 

### Diversity at Oden means building a team that is rich across all boundaries of race, ethnicity, gender identification, sexual orientation, disability, religion, age and thinking style. We welcome all backgrounds, life experiences, and worldviews as these are the catalyst for the rapid evolution of our product and our organization. Diversity allows us to tackle new challenges, embrace change, make well-informed decisions, and ultimately Make Things Better. In alignment with our “People First” company value, Oden has a passionate internal team dedicated to the promotion of diversity and inclusion initiatives as a core component of our culture.

### Our diversity initiatives apply to our practices and policies on recruiting, compensation and benefits; professional development; promotions; social activities and the ongoing development of a psychologically safe work environment.

title: Data Analyst (Entry-Level)
description:
## **Data Analyst**

**Location:** Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA

- Travel is encouraged approximately once per year to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required. We expect these trips to include visits to prisons and parole offices.

**Role Type:** Full-time

**Compensation:** $85,000

**Visa sponsorship:** Not available

**Hires remotely in:** United States

**Experience:** 6+ months of professional work experience, including internships or research

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Data Analyst to join our team! We're a small, fast-moving group that works with complex criminal justice data from our state partners and develops analyses and tools that target the drivers of incarceration. That's where you come in. We're looking for someone early in their data career who brings attention to detail to our analyses, curiosity to dig into unfamiliar and messy data, clarity in explaining what they find, flexibility to adjust in a rapidly evolving environment, and above all else, a collaborative, kind nature to add to our culture.

### **About us**

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we've been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

### **About the role**

This role works alongside experienced analysts and teammates across several teams on work that targets the drivers of incarceration. Our Data Analysts work with diverse data (criminal justice data both raw and processed from across the country, reports and policy documents from government agencies, and much more) to develop our understanding of the criminal justice system and to motivate change. In this role, you'll carry out well-defined analyses, build clear visualizations with our existing tools, and support product launches by preparing the data each product needs in each state. You'll share your findings with teams across Recidiviz and, alongside teammates, with our state partners.

### **Core responsibilities**

- Exploring our datasets to find patterns and insights about American criminal justice systems
- Carrying out well-scoped analyses with guidance from senior analysts and our State Engagement team
- Supporting product launches in the states where we work by following established launch processes, preparing the analytical data each launch needs, and flagging data discrepancies as they come up
- Building clear, well-documented visualizations and dashboards using our existing tools
- Communicating findings to internal teams, and presenting to state partners alongside teammates
- Analyzing trends in areas related to our own work to understand how our products function

### **Wild success**

A year from now:

- **You've contributed to real impact.** Your analyses have supported product launches in the states you work with and have helped measure the impact those tools are having on the justice system.
- **You've become a go-to analyst for your states.** You know their data, policies, and products well, and you answer new questions with growing independence and the right tool for each job.

### **Minimum qualifications**

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, to help nurture a knowledgeable, data-oriented culture
- Enthusiasm for working with internal and external partners from diverse backgrounds and worldviews, such as government staff, researchers, journalists, technical staff, and practitioners in criminal justice reform
- Care and curiosity in inspecting source data and checking results closely, so the data and analyses you prepare can be trusted and reused
- 6 or more months of practical experience exploring, analyzing, and cleaning real-world datasets. Internships and research count, and part-time roles count when their hours add up to roughly 6 months of full-time work.
- Working proficiency in SQL, including joins, aggregations, and window functions
- Familiarity with Python, specifically the Pandas package, for data analysis and visualization

### **Preferred qualifications**

- Interest in criminal justice or public policy, or experience working with public-sector data
- Experience with a BI or dashboarding tool such as Looker or Tableau
- Familiarity with any part of our data stack, which includes Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker, Jupyter notebooks, and Python/Pandas

### **Compensation**

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The annual compensation for this role is: $85,000.

### **What we offer**

- Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
- 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
- Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays
- 12 weeks of paid parental leave
- 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
- Complimentary One Medical membership (depending on location)
- Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
- Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
- Free mental health support via Talkspace
- Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
- An annual company offsite each spring and other ad-hoc gatherings
- All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

### **More about Recidiviz**

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we've built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator's 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 19 state partners – big and small, red and blue – and covers more than 45% of the US incarcerated population. We have helped to get tens of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably, and saved states nearly $1 billion. In the next five years, Recidiviz plans to partner with 40 states and help 250,000 people who are stuck in the system to get out and stay out. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our[ 2024 Year in Review](https://files.recidiviz.org/recidiviz24.pdf), read some[ press coverage](https://www.recidiviz.org/press), or watch our[ TED Talk](https://www.recidiviz.org/updates/how-bad-data-traps-people-in-the-u-s-justice-system). And if you're really keen to see our work, you can dive into our[ Github](https://github.com/Recidiviz) :).

### **An important note**

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

title: Founding Engineer / Technical Lead, AI Platform
description:
Trade Titus is building an AI-driven platform for the contractor and home services industry, a massive market still running on outdated tech. Led by the founder of Contractor Gorilla, with 18+ years of industry experience, we’re looking for a Founding Engineer to join as a true technical partner. You will own the architecture from day one, turn deep industry insight into a tangible product, and eventually build the engineering team to scale it. If you want to build from the ground up in a market hungry for modernization, let's talk.

### Position Summary
The Founding Engineer / Technical Lead will drive the hands-on development of Trade Titus from concept through beta testing and full production release. Working directly with the founder, you will translate deep industry workflows into a secure, reliable, and highly scalable platform.

This role demands a blend of full-stack engineering, AI agent development, and technical leadership. You will drive the technology stack selection in close partnership with the CEO, own the delivery roadmap, and build the core product. As the product gains traction, your role will expand to recruiting and leading the engineering team that takes us to the next level.

### Key Responsibilities
* Define the technical architecture, partner with the CEO to select the technology stack, and translate industry workflows into an executable product roadmap.
* Drive the development lifecycle from concept through beta and production release, taking ownership of milestones, dependencies, and delivery momentum.
* Proactively identify technical risks, vendor constraints, or scope creep, and bring clear options to the table to keep development moving efficiently.
* Build and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and responsive frontend interfaces.
* Develop AI agents, implement MCP and A2A capabilities, and integrate deeply with third-party systems.
* Establish automated testing, AI evaluations, deployment pipelines, and monitoring; troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
* Implement robust authentication, authorization, and data protection throughout the platform.
* Track AI, API, and infrastructure costs per customer and key workflow. Architect for economical growth by implementing cost monitoring and usage controls.
* Coordinate beta testing with the founder, rapidly incorporate user feedback, and demonstrate progress through working software.
* Document core technical decisions, establish foundational engineering standards, and eventually recruit, mentor, and lead a growing engineering team.


### Required Qualifications
* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ownership of complex production platforms (including SaaS architecture and product launches).
* 2+ years of hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including production AI agents and tool calling.
* Strong knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A), with hands-on implementation experience in at least one and demonstrable practical capability in the other.
* Strong full-stack development skills, including backend services, API design, database modeling, and responsive web interfaces.
* Deep experience integrating third-party APIs using OAuth, webhooks, and background processing—specifically handling retries, duplicate prevention, and recovery from partial failures.
* Experience testing AI accuracy, tool execution, and failure handling in production environments.
* Experience operating production software, covering automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, troubleshooting, and application security.
* A proven track record of shipping reliable production software at a high velocity.
* Prior experience as a technical lead for a shipped product, including guiding and mentoring other engineers.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs to the founder and early customers.

### Preferred Qualifications
* Experience as an early engineering hire at a startup, helping establish the initial platform and engineering culture.
* Production implementation experience with both MCP and A2A.
* UI/UX design experience, with the ability to create functional, intuitive beta interfaces from raw product requirements.
* Experience recruiting engineers or formally managing an engineering team.

### How to Apply
Please include:

* Your cover letter and resume.
* One relevant platform you helped take from concept through beta and production launch. Please include your personal contribution, the launch outcome, and a product link where available.
* A summary of your AI agent, MCP, and A2A experience, clearly distinguishing production implementations from prototypes.
* Your expected annual base salary.
* Your US location and earliest available start date.

*Public code is welcome but not required. If your previous work is confidential, please describe your contribution and results without sharing proprietary information.*

title: Technical Co-Founder
description:
Here's the pitch:

I’m Patrick McKee, founder of Anise Operations Advisors. We’re building an AI hub specifically for commercial insurance account managers, the people who keep a retail insurance agency running.

I’m a Senior Commercial Lines Account Manager and Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC), with a background in agency leadership, sales, and technology services. I know this work firsthand: account managers coordinate renewals, service requests, documents, carrier communications, and client follow-up. They sit at the center of agency operations, yet much of their day is spent moving information between emails, files, and disconnected systems.

That is where Anise starts. Our product is designed as an extension of the account manager, bringing their work into one hub that understands the account, tracks what needs to happen, and prepares work for their review. Renewal comparisons, proposals, document organization, and follow-up are connected parts of that experience. The opportunity is to support the person responsible for the entire workflow.

I’m actively building the product, and we have pilot customers and early revenue. We’re already working with agency email access and turning incoming emails and documents into workflow deliverables. We’re bootstrapped and have not raised seed funding.

I’m looking for a technical cofounder who wants to help shape the product and build the company with me. You would lead engineering and architecture, bringing strong product judgment and the ability to turn working pilots into reliable software. I’ll lead go-to-market, sales, partnerships, and customer relationships, while contributing the insurance expertise and detailed understanding of the workflows.

Let me know if you'd like to hear more.

title: FOUNDING PRODUCT DESIGNER, BRAND & PRODUCT
description:
**ABOUT ZAHLN**
Zahln, by Zysygy, is building a zero-fee payment network for Germany on European banking rails. Merchants pay no transaction fees. No card networks, no hardware, just a phone.
Nearly every digital payment in Germany today moves over infrastructure owned outside Europe, and a share of each one leaves the continent as fees. We are building the alternative: a fully software-based merchant POS and a consumer app that settle account to account over SEPA Instant, with European data residency by design. Think what UPI did for India. We are doing it for Germany, on infrastructure Europe controls.

**THE ROLE**
You are our first designer. You own how Zahln looks, feels and works, everywhere it appears: the consumer app, the merchant app, the web dashboard, our website, and every post, deck and poster that carries our name. There is no design team, no design system and no brand book. You build all three, and you bring the experience to do it without being told how.
We want a product that feels as sleek and trustworthy as the best consumer apps in the world. When someone pays with Zahln, it should feel effortless, and they should never wonder whether the payment went through.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
*1. Product design*

* End-to-end flows: Design complete flows for our consumer and merchant apps and the web dashboard, including every state: loading, success, failure, empty and first use.

* Design system: Build our design system in Figma from scratch, with tokens, components and documentation our engineers actually use.

* Interaction and motion: Design the micro-interactions that make the product feel alive, and specify them precisely enough to build.

* Engineering handoff: Work directly with our engineers, deliver clean specs, and make sure what ships matches what you designed.

* Testing: Put designs in front of real users, watch where they hesitate, and fix it.

*2. Brand and marketing*

* Visual identity: Create or refine our logo, color, typography and brand guidelines so they work everywhere, from an app icon to a poster.

* Website: Design our website for consumers, merchants and institutions.

* Templates: Build social media, pitch deck and one-pager templates simple enough for non-designers to use without breaking the brand.

* Print and physical: Design the materials that live in the real world: QR stands, stickers and posters.

**WHO YOU ARE**
* 5+ years in design, with at least 3 in consumer product design (UI/UX).

* You have designed at least one consumer app end to end that is live in the App Store or Play Store.

* Experience in fintech, payments or another product where users trust you with something important.

* Exceptional visual craft: typography, spacing, hierarchy, and the restraint to leave things out.

* You have built a design system from scratch, not only worked inside one.

* Brand work in your portfolio alongside product work, in a consistent visual language.

* Expert in Figma, with prototyping and motion skills.

* You design for accessibility (WCAG AA) and for more than one language, including long German words.

* You turn a vague brief into options, reasoning and a recommendation.

* Strong written English for a team that works async across Germany and India.

* You want to build a company, not fill a position.

**STRONG BONUS (NOT REQUIRED)**
* Design experience at a well-known consumer fintech.

* Worked on a product with both a merchant side and a consumer side.

* Built a website yourself in Framer or Webflow.

* Front-end understanding (HTML, CSS, React Native), so your designs are buildable.

* You use AI tooling seriously in your design work, and know where it helps and where it doesn't.

**HOW WE WILL MEASURE YOU**
A product people can use without thinking, a brand that is recognisable on every surface, and a design system solid enough that engineers and non-designers can build on it without you in the room.

**HOW TO APPLY**
Send your portfolio with at least one shipped app. Shortlisted candidates complete a short  design task.

**WHAT YOU GET**
* Real ownership. Every pixel of the brand and product is yours to define from day one. Not a component inside someone else's system.

* Something that matters. You design how people pay every day, on European payment infrastructure, instead of polishing a product that already exists.
 
* Your work, visible fast. No layers of approval between your design and the store.
 
* A seat at the table. You work directly with the founders on product and brand decisions, and you are in the room when they are made.
 
* Room to grow with the company. As we grow, the design function you build grows with you, and so does your role in it.

* A small team that moves. People who left stable paths to build a faster, simpler way to move money in Germany. Less bureaucracy, more momentum.

**Connect with the Founder**
www.linkedin.com/in/shabbir-maimoon

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
**Why We Exist**

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.  
  
[Jerry.ai](http://Jerry.ai) is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.   
  
We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

**Why We’re Hiring**

Our Data Science & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

 

Every business unit has a Data Science team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

 

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Data Science team members. We are hiring 4-6 people to drive impact in these areas:

- Growth Marketing
- Product Development
- AI & Automation
- Strategic Partnerships
 

**On leveling:** You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

**Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here**

- **No slides:** If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
- **No corporate fluff:** The Data Science & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
- **Hands-on:** This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.
 

**What You'll Own**

You'll sit on our central Data Science & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

- **Define the right problems:** Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
- **Data and insights:** Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
- **Drive outcomes:** Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.
 

**Who You Are**

- **First principles thinker:** You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
- **Direct communicator:** You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
- **Owner:** You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.
 

**What You'll Bring**

- 6+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
- Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
- Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
- Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.
 

**Our Tools**

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

  

*While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.*

***Please note:*** [***Jerry.ai***](http://Jerry.ai) ***is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.***

*Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

*Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at* [*recruiting@jerry.ai*](mailto:recruiting@getjerry.com)

*The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.*

*We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.*

**About Jerry.ai**

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We are a remote-first company, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

title: Member of Technical Staff: Junior AI Researcher
description:
## Member of Technical Staff: AI Research & Engineering in Media Integrity

## **About Synhawk**

Synhawk builds **omnimodal foundation models for communication integrity**, aimed at infrastructure-side deployment in telco and banking sectors. Our platform analyzes the integrity of audio and video, and protects platforms against AI threats. This currently includes detecting synthetic speech & voice cloning, video & image manipulation, social engineering, and identity impersonation. We’re building our models in a way that generalizes to future AI threats yet to come, especially as AI agents get integrated into the workforce and society.

We're past the initial research phase. We're **actively deploying with major telco customers**, working with and building our own GPU clusters, air-gapped environments, and strict production SLAs. Your work with us will have an immediate, measurable impact on systems that defend real communications infrastructure.

We're a **small, highly technical, founder-led team**. You'll play an integral part in shaping our research agenda while **building foundation models to help real customers from day one.**

## **The Role**

You'll own and advance Synhawk's core engine - spanning the **development of foundation model** and media integrity methods in a **full research-to-production pipeline**. This isn't a pure research role, as the models and methods you build will directly feed into production with our telco partners. That is to say, you’ll be working under real latency and reliability constraints. But no pressure.

While practical, real-world applicability grounds how we build, we also invest deeply in forward-looking research into emerging AI communication threats. In practice, we balance both: staying focused on protecting customers today while preparing for threats that don’t yet exist.

You'll have **direct influence over our research agenda from day one**. As we scale beyond early deployments, this role also provides opportunities to publish novel research and engage with the broader community through conferences and events.

## What You'll Work On

**Foundation Models**

- **Running and scaling training experiments** on multi-GPU setups
- Data curation: filtering, deduplication, and building training data mixtures
- **Fine-tuning and post-training** (SFT, preference optimization), and evaluating how models behave under distribution shift
- **Multimodal data augmentation** strategies

**Media Integrity & Deepfake Detection**

- Implementing and testing detection architectures for audio, video, and images
- **Signal processing**: codecs, compression artifacts, forensic fingerprints
- **Adversarial robustness**: testing models against attacks, re-compression, and downsampling
- Hands-on red teaming with open-source and proprietary deepfake generators, integrated into the R&D cycle

### Who We're Looking For

You're finishing a Master's or PhD, or recently graduated, with strong foundations in machine learning and a real interest in audio, video, or media forensics. You don't need years of industry experience, but we'd love to see something that shows how you work: a thesis, a paper, open-source contributions, a research internship, or side projects you're proud of.

You're comfortable in Python and PyTorch, you've trained models yourself, and you enjoy the messy parts too - data, debugging, and figuring out why an experiment didn't work.

Most importantly, though, we're looking for folks who are curious and purpose-driven. Even if you don't meet all of the criteria above, but are eager to become an expert in them, we want to hear from you!

### What We Offer

- Hands-on work on core AI research at an early-stage company with real traction
- Mentorship from experienced researchers and room to grow fast
- H100 GPU clusters and serious compute
- Competitive comp
- Small, founder-led team - minimal process, maximum trust

title: Structural Health Monitoring & Critical Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company**  **Hypotenuse Analytics**
**Type**  Full-Time · Remote-Hybrid
**Team**  Critical Infrastructure Intelligence


**ABOUT HYPOTENUSE ANALYTICS**
Hypotenuse Analytics is building an AI-powered infrastructure intelligence platform for monitoring critical assets using structural sensors, InSAR, LiDAR, drones and BIM data. We combine these signals with construction and environmental context to understand structural condition, detect anomalies and support predictive maintenance.

**AI AT HYPOTENUSE**
AI tools are part of how we work. Use them. We evaluate judgment, engineering fundamentals and the quality of your reasoning, not whether you can produce polished AI-generated documents.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
We are looking for a Civil/Structural Engineer with hands-on SHM or infrastructure monitoring experience. You will work between the engineering, ML and product teams, helping translate real structural behaviour into data, monitoring and AI requirements.

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**
Design and review SHM strategies for bridges, buildings, highways and other critical infrastructure.
Work with accelerometers, strain, displacement, tilt, temperature and other structural sensors.
Analyse sensor time-series data and define baselines, thresholds and meaningful anomalies.
Support InSAR-based displacement monitoring and correlation with ground sensors.
Work with LiDAR, BIM and digital-twin/FEM workflows.

Correlate structural behaviour with construction activities, weather and site conditions.
Work with ML engineers to validate model outputs against structural and physical behaviour.
Support pilot deployments, site surveys, sensor validation and technical reporting.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
B.Tech/B.E. in Civil or Structural Engineering; M.Tech/M.S. is a plus.
1–4 years of experience in SHM, structural monitoring, instrumentation or structural engineering.
Good understanding of structural behaviour, loads, stress/strain, vibration and deformation.
Experience working with structural sensor data or monitoring systems.
Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation.
Strong analytical skills and ability to work with ML/software teams.

**GOOD TO HAVE**
InSAR / SAR, LiDAR, GIS or drone photogrammetry.
FEM/FEA, structural dynamics or modal analysis.
BIM / Revit / Civil 3D.
Python, MATLAB or basic time-series/signal processing.
Experience with bridges, tunnels, dams, rail/metro, buildings or construction monitoring.

**WHAT WE VALUE**
We care about engineering judgment more than a long list of tools. You should be able to look at a sensor anomaly and ask what physical mechanism could have produced it, rather than assuming every threshold breach means the structure is failing.

**Who we are**

Getting benefits shouldn't feel like a part-time job. For too many families, it does: a stack of forms, a wall of deadlines, and one missing document standing between them and help they already qualify for.

[Mirza](https://www.heymirza.com) is changing that. We build public benefits infrastructure that matches people to the programs they're eligible for, helps them apply once across programs, and keeps them covered as the rules shift. That's 200+ programs across all 50 states, including Medicaid, SNAP, WIC, and childcare subsidies.

Government agencies, health plans, health systems, employers, community colleges, and unions use Mirza to reach the people they serve. Unfortunately, the stakes are about to get higher. New federal Medicaid requirements take effect January 1, 2027, affecting roughly 20 million adults, and states need a better way to make sure eligible people don't lose coverage over paperwork. We're building exactly that and we would love for you to join us.

**About the role**

As a Forward Deployed Product Manager at Mirza, you will own the product and operational outcomes of complex customer deployments from solution shaping through launch, adoption, and ongoing evolution.

You will work directly with customers to understand their workflows, policies, systems, data, constraints, and goals; translate that complexity into an executable solution; and lead a small forward-deployed delivery team in bringing that solution into production.

You will be operationally accountable for the success of the engagement. You will lead priorities, scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and customer alignment day-to-day, while partnering closely with a forward-deployed Tech Lead who owns technical decisions and engineering execution.

The role sits at an important intersection between our customers, commercial organization, and core Product & Engineering teams. You will partner closely with account managers to identify opportunities to deepen customer value and expand relationships, while bringing high-quality product signal from the field back into Mirza’s core R&D organization.

This is not a traditional roadmap-focused Product Manager role or a project management role. Success means turning complex customer commitments into successful production deployments, measurable customer outcomes, and insights that make Mirza’s platform increasingly scalable and reusable.

**What you’ll do**
* Partner with Sales and account leads before contracts are signed to assess feasibility, clarify customer needs, and flag delivery risks, so what we sell can actually be delivered.
* Turn signed commitments into executable delivery plans with clear outcomes, scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies, governance, and launch expectations.
* Run deep discovery across a customer's business processes, users, policies, systems, integrations, data, and edge cases, and separate what they asked for from the problem they actually need solved.
* Decide whether each need is best met through configuration, integration, customer-specific engineering, or a reusable platform capability.
* Lead the delivery team day-to-day: set priorities, sequence work, manage scope and dependencies, and turn complex workflows into clear requirements and prioritized backlogs.
* Make fast, thoughtful tradeoffs across customer needs, technical feasibility, platform integrity, security, compliance, timeline, and capacity, and keep delivery health, risks, and scope changes visible.
* Own the product side of QA, customer UAT, and launch readiness, making sure training, documentation, and operational workflows are in place before go-live.
* Stay accountable after launch: coordinate production triage and customer communication, track adoption with real data, and keep iterating until the solution works in practice.
* Give account managers a clear view of delivery health, outcomes, and unmet needs, and support renewal and expansion conversations with evidence. They own the commercial relationship; you own delivery.
* Bring high-quality signal from the field back to core Product and Engineering, spotting patterns across deployments and separating real platform opportunities from one-off customer exceptions.
* Help build the playbooks, templates, and operating rhythms for Mirza's new Forward Deployed Customer Engineering and Delivery team, and turn each deployment's lessons into repeatable patterns.

**What we’re looking for**
* 6+ years in product management, solutions, implementation, technical delivery, or a similar customer-facing technology role.
* A proven track record of owning complex customer-facing software implementations from discovery through production.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into clear, pragmatic solutions.
* Experience leading engineers and cross-functional teams through influence and day-to-day delivery leadership, even when you're not their manager.
* Strong technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data flows, cloud-native systems, and automation, plus the discipline to keep product accountability separate from technical decision-making.
* Commercial instincts: you can spot where technology creates more customer value and shape credible expansion opportunities without turning every request into custom development.
* Excellent customer-facing communication, including building trust with senior stakeholders, navigating hard tradeoffs, and speaking up early when delivery is at risk.
* Strong scope, prioritization, dependency, and risk-management skills, and experience measuring adoption and customer outcomes after launch.
* Comfort in an early-stage, fast-scaling environment where the operating model itself is still being built.
* Consulting experience, especially structured problem solving, rapid learning, and executive communication in ambiguous customer environments.
* Familiarity with security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance requirements in regulated software environments.
* Experience with AI-powered products, intelligent automation, document processing, conversational interfaces, or LLM-enabled workflows.

*We aren't expecting you to be an expert in everything described above. If you check most of the boxes, and are ready to roll up your sleeves and learn, we’d love to hear from you.*

**What We Offer**
* $150,000-$160,000 base salary
* Stock options
* Healthcare, Dental, Vision, Life
* 401k with company contribution
* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing + optional 8 week ramp-up period at 80% pay
* Fully remote and flexible hours
* Plus more!

**To Apply**

If you’re passionate about joining a mission-driven company, email careers@heymirza.com with:
* A short explanation about why you want to join Mirza
* Your CV
* Interview availability in the next 7 days

We’ll be in touch to schedule an interview!

*Please note, applicants must be located in the United States and be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship at this time.*

title: Chief of Staff
acceptedRemoteLocations: Virginia, United States; Washington DC, District of Columbia; Maryland, United States
description:
*This position requires U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance.*

## We build workers for the work that keeps the country running.

At Statecraft, we are building a synthetic workforce to help keep the US Government running. Our AI Operatives are trained on government workflows, operate reliably and compliantly, and build their own tools and software to help achieve outcomes and digitally transform outdated processes.

**America is not short on forms, policies, or good people. It is short on hours.** Our public servants are overworked and understaffed. For too long, contractors and consultants have made empty promises to solve this problem. Instead, they've wasted **billions** in taxpayer dollars. We're changing this with an AI workforce that works around the clock and improves over time. On average, we save taxpayers 80% while helping agencies deliver on initiatives and their mission 10x faster.

**We've raised a seed round, worked some pilots, and are aggressively pursuing major contracts** that put us in direct competition with staffing behemoths like Accenture, Deloitte, and Booz Allen. Our product offering also brings agentic coding to the government, with our AI Operatives capable of building software in minutes at virtually no cost to drive out overcharging software companies like Palantir, SAP, and Salesforce.

## We're hiring a Chief of Staff to help drive this work forward.

We’re looking for someone to serve as an extension of our founding team. You may be early in your career, with a record of learning quickly and finishing work that matters. Doing well here means keeping recurring operations on schedule, giving leadership clear recommendations, and delivering projects without someone chasing the next step.

You'll work directly with the executive team on research and special projects across the company. You'll turn open questions into recommendations and take projects through to completion. You'll also own the daily operations that keep the team working, across people, finance, legal administration, and vendors.

As you build judgment and trust, you'll take on larger projects with more independence and help decide how the company runs.

**Responsibilities include:**

- Owning research and special projects across the company: define the question, investigate options, recommend a course of action, and carry it through
- Preparing executive briefings and tracking decisions, owners, and commitments so projects move forward
- Running people operations, including recruiting, onboarding, offboarding, employee records, and coordination with payroll and benefits providers
- Managing operating deadlines, routine agreements and renewals, vendors and purchasing within approved budgets, and invoice, payment, expense, and bookkeeping records with outside advisors
- Supporting event planning, coordinating PR, and driving marketing campaigns
- Managing executive scheduling, travel, correspondence, and follow-ups, and organizing company meetings, events, and offsites

**We are still incredibly early.** Processes will be missing and priorities will change. You'll help build those processes while running them, raise problems early, and know when a decision needs leadership or an outside adviser.

**Statecraft is fully AI-native**. You'll have room to automate our own operations, using AI to prepare briefings, organize records, track follow-ups, and reduce repetitive work. Bring an idea for what should run itself, and you'll have the agents and budget to make it happen.

Of course, there are some requirements for this opportunity:

- **Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance**
- **Must be based in the Washington, D.C., Maryland, or Virginia (DMV) area**
- **Evidence that you take responsibility and finish what you start, through work, internships, campus leadership, military or public service, or substantial projects**
- Strong organization and discretion; you'll handle sensitive company and employee information
- Clear written communication and comfort with spreadsheets and checking numbers
- Comfort working independently, handling administrative details, and managing competing priorities

And these are some additional nice-to-haves:

- You already use AI tools daily and have automated parts of your own workflow
- Experience supporting an executive or coordinating people, finance, or administrative operations
- Experience at a startup or working with government organizations
- Experience with tools such as Justworks, Ramp, and Notion

## We want you to join us.

We can offer you a fantastic career opportunity:

- **Base salary: $100k-$140k**
- **Remote work from the DMV area (until we open an office, at which point in-office attendance will be required), with occasional travel for company events**
- Amazing medical, dental, vision, and life insurance + 401(k) matching
- Unlimited PTO + 10 standard holidays + end-of-year holiday break
- Touch Grass policy: must take at least 2 weeks of PTO every year!

You will love working here:

- Fix the bureaucracy and automate the government
- Work with exited founders and talent from Google, Palantir, AWS, and the Federal Government
- Help build the company that delivers this work for government
- Work on the frontier of AI
- Learn how to build an AI-native startup from experienced founders

And there are amazing perks:

- Generous budget for your work from home setup
- Monthly coworking stipend
- Phone plan or internet bill is on us
- Annual L&D budget
- Regular team offsites and plentiful opportunities to touch grass
- Max tier AI subscriptions and enormous AI token budgets

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

As a Customer Success Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring customer satisfaction and driving revenue growth. This hybrid role combines the responsibilities of a traditional Customer Success Manager with the added duty of conducting sales demonstrations to showcase product or service capabilities to potential customers. You will be the bridge between the customer's needs and the company's solutions, helping to retain and expand the customer base through excellent service.**

**Pre Sales**

Responding to online inquiries primarily through the company’s Intercom channel. Conducting high level (inbound) sales demonstrations to showcase Mapme’s capabilities and popular use cases. Tailoring sales demos to the unique requirements of the customer.

**Customer Service**

* Address and resolve customer issues, inquiries, and concerns promptly, or escalate them to the appropriate team members.
* Collect and relay customer feedback to the product development and marketing teams to help enhance product offerings.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and sales demos.

**Marketing**

Support creation of marketing content.

**Professional Services**

* Basic usage of design tools (we need this a lot for map creation).
* Knowledge of integrated software's such as QGIS, Maptiler, Google Sheets. 

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Proven experience in customer success, account management, or a related role.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage customer relationships effectively and to drive sales.
* Bachelor's degree.

**Attributes**

* Have a natural interest in the world of maps and an appreciation of how interactive maps are being used by companies and organizations.
* Possess a keen sense of visual aesthetics and an appreciation for design, style, and graphic elements.
* Customer-centric mindset.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with fluent English (Spanish a bonus)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Goal-oriented with a focus on achieving customer satisfaction and sales targets.
* Ability to work very independently (position is 100% remote) and in a team.
* A fast learner, technically minded and eager to learn and master working with multiple mapping tools.

Proficiency using sales and customer relationship management (CRM) tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace etc.

title: Editor/Proofreader
description:
Cali Jewel is a growing, creative, and digitally focused brand committed to producing high-quality content that connects with its audience. As our content operations continue to expand, we are seeking a detail-oriented and highly skilled Editor / Proofreader to join our remote team.

This position is ideal for someone with an exceptional command of written English, strong attention to detail, and a genuine passion for words. The successful candidate will ensure that written materials are clear, accurate, engaging, consistent, and aligned with Cali Jewel's brand voice before they are published or distributed.

The Editor / Proofreader will work across a variety of content formats, including website copy, blog articles, social-media content, marketing materials, email campaigns, product descriptions, press materials, internal documents, and other digital communications
.
Position Overview

As an Editor / Proofreader, you will review written content from initial drafts through final publication. You will identify and correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, sentence structure, formatting, clarity, consistency, and factual or stylistic issues.

Beyond correcting mistakes, you will help strengthen the quality of our content. You should be comfortable suggesting improvements to wording, organization, tone, and readability while preserving the original purpose and personality of each piece.

The ideal candidate is meticulous without losing sight of the bigger picture. You should be able to identify a misplaced comma, but also recognize when an entire paragraph needs restructuring to communicate an idea more effectively.
Key Responsibilities
Editing & Proofreading

    Review and edit written content for grammar, spelling, punctuation, syntax, clarity, consistency, and overall readability.

    Proofread content carefully before publication to identify errors that may have been missed during the editing process.

    Ensure content follows established brand guidelines and editorial standards.

    Improve sentence structure, flow, word choice, and organization while maintaining the writer's intended message.

    Check headlines, captions, calls-to-action, product descriptions, emails, articles, and other marketing copy.

    Identify inconsistencies in terminology, capitalization, formatting, tone, and style.

    Review final versions of documents and digital content before publication.

Content Quality & Brand Voice

    Maintain a consistent Cali Jewel voice across written communications.

    Ensure content is professional, engaging, easy to understand, and appropriate for the intended audience.

    Work with writers and marketing team members to strengthen content without unnecessarily changing the author's voice.

    Help develop and maintain editorial guidelines, style guides, and content standards.

    Identify recurring writing issues and provide constructive feedback to content creators.

Fact-Checking & Accuracy

    Verify names, dates, figures, statistics, product information, quotations, links, and other important details when required.

    Flag questionable or potentially inaccurate information for review.

    Check hyperlinks and references for accuracy and functionality.

    Ensure claims and statements are presented clearly and responsibly.

    Maintain high standards of accuracy across all published materials.

Collaboration

    Work closely with writers, social-media managers, designers, marketing specialists, and leadership.

    Provide clear and constructive editorial feedback.

    Participate in content planning and review meetings when necessary.

    Manage multiple editing assignments while meeting established deadlines.

    Communicate promptly when additional information or clarification is needed.

    Help establish efficient editorial workflows for remote collaboration.

Digital Content

    Edit content intended for websites, blogs, newsletters, social media, email campaigns, and other digital platforms.

    Review content for online readability, including headings, paragraph structure, formatting, and calls-to-action.

    Assist with basic SEO editing, including keyword placement, headings, metadata, and readability where applicable.

    Adapt content for different platforms while preserving the core message and brand identity.

Qualifications

    Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, Writing, or a related field preferred.

    2+ years of professional editing, proofreading, writing, journalism, publishing, marketing, or related experience preferred.

    Exceptional knowledge of English grammar, spelling, punctuation, and sentence structure.

    Excellent written communication skills.

    Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

    Ability to maintain consistency across large amounts of content.

    Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

    Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.

    Comfortable working remotely with digital collaboration and project-management tools.

    Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Google Docs, Grammarly, or similar editing tools.

Preferred Skills

Experience with digital marketing, social media, e-commerce, lifestyle, beauty, fashion, jewelry, or consumer brands is a plus.

Knowledge of SEO, content marketing, AP Style, Chicago Manual of Style, or other recognized editorial standards is also beneficial.

Candidates should be comfortable providing editorial recommendations and explaining changes professionally and constructively.

What We Offer

    Fully remote position

    Competitive U.S. compensation based on experience and qualifications

    Flexible working environment

    Opportunity to work with a growing creative brand

    Professional development opportunities

    Collaborative remote team

    Opportunity to contribute to brand strategy and content development

    Potential performance-based incentives

Compensation

Estimated Salary Range: $55,000–$80,000 per year, depending on experience, qualifications, location, and scope of responsibilities.

Highly experienced candidates with specialized editorial, publishing, technical, or marketing expertise may be considered for higher compensation.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit a resume/CV, brief cover letter, and writing or editing portfolio demonstrating their experience.

Applicants are encouraged to provide before-and-after editing samples or examples of published work where appropriate. Please include relevant experience editing digital content, marketing materials, articles, social-media copy, or other professional communications.

Cali Jewel is committed to creating a professional and collaborative workplace. We value accuracy, creativity, integrity, clear communication, and respect for diverse perspectives. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

title: Account Manager (West Coast) - Cloud / Data / Infra
description:
Qumulo's cloud data platform manages exabytes of the world's most demanding data, unifying files, objects, and every workload across edge, core, and cloud.

**About the Account Manager role:**  
Qumulo is growing Account Management team, and we're looking to add an Account Manager focused on growth and expansion across a portfolio of commercial and mid-market customers in the Western USA territory. This quota-carrying, post-sales role will have you growing revenue through add-on capacity, cross-sell, upsell, new workloads, and expansion-tied term extensions.

As the primary commercial point of contact for assigned accounts, you'll own whitespace strategy, qualify expansion opportunities, lead proposals and negotiations to close, and own the expansion forecasts. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Renewal Managers, and help define Qumulo's install-base growth motion.

We're looking for a commercially disciplined closer, with cloud experience, who can farm whitespace, maintain forecast rigor, and work smoothly across CS, Renewals, Sales Engineering, and Support.

**Responsibilities:**

- Manage a portfolio of around 100 existing commercial and lower mid-market customers, owning account plans and whitespace strategy based on current footprint, utilization, growth signals, and vertical fit
- Prioritize and act on CSQLs and proactive expansion signals, converting account insight into qualified commercial pursuits
- Identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities: add-on capacity, cross-sell, upsell, new workloads, and expansion-tied term extensions
- Build direct relationships with technical, business, and economic stakeholders without over-relying on partner-led access
- Own proposals, quotes, negotiation, and commercial close within approved pricing and discount guardrails
- Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, commit, and CRM hygiene across your assigned book
- Partner with CSMs to translate adoption and risk context into expansion plans, and coordinate with Renewals Management on timing, term, and commercial packaging
- Work with Sales Engineering, Support, and specialist overlays to progress opportunities and deliver customer outcomes

**Qualifications:**

- Must have experience with Data Management, Data Protection, or Enterprise Data Storage products in Cloud and Hybrid Cloud environments
- 4+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales or account management experience (SaaS / Cloud / Storage preferred)
- 2+ years in expansion, upsell, cross-sell, install-base selling, or renewals-plus-growth motions
- Track record of identifying, qualifying, negotiating, and closing expansion opportunities within an installed customer base
- Experience owning forecast and commit reporting
- Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills

**This role can be fully remote or hybrid from our Seattle HQ, but candidates must reside within Pacific or Mountain time zones.**   
  
The annual On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this role is USD $180,000 - $200,000 with uncapped commissions, strong accelerators, and benefits including pre-IPO equity. Individual pay depends on various factors, such as role level, relevant experience and skills.

## **Benefits & Perks:**

- Pre-IPO stock options
- Flexible time-off policy
- HSA and PPO health insurance options
- Dental and Vision insurance
- 401(k) plan

**About Qumulo:**  
Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations.

With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission-critical workloads anywhere real-time access to massive file datasets is non-negotiable. Qumulo delivers radical simplicity, hardware freedom, exceptional customer support, and a true hybrid-cloud architecture.  
  
**Our Values:**   
At Qumulo, we are building an open and collaborative culture where people can do their best work with customers as our magnetic field. We act as owners, we share by default, we are data driven and experimental and as an inclusive workplace, we encourage and celebrate multiple points of view. As part of our culture we believe diversity drives innovation.  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**  
Qumulo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law. For more information on Qumulo's Applicant Privacy Policy, please visit: [https://qumulo.com/applicant-employee-privacy-notice](https://qumulo.com/applicant-employee-privacy-notice)

Once you complete your interviews and sign your offer, you can begin onboarding in as little as 7 days!

title: Customer Production Manager
description:
**Application Note: To be considered, please submit your application through the Asana application form linked at the bottom of this posting. Applications submitted through Wellfound alone will not be considered complete or monitored.**

About Us 
Talkoot is the most powerful and complete AI product storytelling platform for ecommerce. Content produced in Talkoot helps generate billions of dollars of revenue for hundreds of the world's most loved brands across fashion, outdoor, food & bev, and CPG industries.

We are a hardworking and supportive team that encourages personal ownership, initiative, and professional growth. We are looking for a talented, determined and organized Customer Production Manager who can collaborate with our Creative Studio and Customer Success team to manage and deliver complex content projects for customers.


About the Role
As a Customer Production Manager, you will be responsible for managing a variety of content projects and deliverables for our customers. You’ll work cross-functionally, facilitating assignments with our Studio team and partnering with Customer Success to ensure that project deliverables meet exact internal quality standards and customer requirements and are delivered on-time or ahead of schedule.  

You will also play an important role in managing customer SEO and GEO resources by reviewing and validating keyword and intent lists, making informed optimization decisions, and ensuring content is positioned to perform across both traditional search engines and AI-powered shopping platforms. You’ll partner closely with our AI and Product teams to ensure deliverables align with evolving industry best practices.
‍

Key Responsibilities
Creating schedules, managing project timelines, and ensuring that client commitments are met, keeping both customers and internal team members informed throughout the process.
Reviewing deliverables (particularly optimized ecommerce product copy and keywords) and providing feedback to Studio team to ensure deliverables meet expectations.  
Building and maintaining internal style guides to capture customer feedback and ensure it is being consistently and accurately applied.
Proactively engaging with Customer Success to communicate project risks and address potential problems before they arise.
Managing project resourcing tasks, including briefing freelancers and working with the wider producer team to balance resources based on company and customer priorities.  
Maintaining a deep understanding of customer goals and Studio standards to ensure all deliveries exceed expectations and align with Talkoot’s commitment to quality.  
Accurately estimating time, effort, and complexity of tasks. Reliably ensuring commitments are realistic.
Proactively identifying ways to streamline and improve production processes.  
Technical & data-driven tasks including project configuration in Talkoot and managing digital project resources like keyword lists, product imagery and product data validation.
Collaborating with AI & Product teams on SEO and GEO workstreams, including validating keyword lists and providing feedback on keyword outputs.
‍

Requirements
4 or more years of experience managing deliverables in ecommerce, software, or content production environments.  
A strong proficiency in Excel, including writing formulas and using pivot tables.
Excellent writing and communication skills.  
Experience working directly with customers and interacting with a wide range of personas.
Basic understanding of generative AI.  
Experience managing ecommerce content or digital projects for brands in CPG, food & beverage, apparel and fashion, outdoor, electronics, or beauty is strongly preferred.
Experience with SEO and/or GEO strongly preferred.  
‍

Who you are
A strong project manager. You can manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and keep work moving even as needs and priorities shift.
A cross-functional collaborator. You know how to influence and coordinate across teams, build strong working relationships, and bring the right people together to get to an outcome.
Independent and adaptable. You’re comfortable operating with autonomy while knowing when to pull others in. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can change quickly.
Highly proficient with AI. You know how to use AI thoughtfully to increase productivity, improve your work, and simplify processes—not create unnecessary complexity or extra work for others.
Detail-oriented. You take ownership of the quality, accuracy, and completeness of customer deliverables.
A thoughtful, clear communicator and good listener. You connect dots, learn quickly from exposure, and communicate effectively with different audiences.
Skilled with software and technology. You’re comfortable learning new tools and finding better ways to use technology to get work done.
‍

Compensation
Salary Range: $70,000-$90,000 / year. Starting salary for this role is based on experience and typically begins at the lower end of the range.  
Equity Options: This role is eligible for participation in Talkoot’s equity program, offering the opportunity to share in the company’s long-term success.

‍
Benefits
Work from home with the flexibility to manage your day, paired with high expectations for ownership, responsiveness, and getting great work done
5 weeks vacation for all (plus 10 holidays) available the day you start   
Shares of the company – You’ll have a stake in what we build together.
Direct input into the growth and trajectory of Talkoot. You’ll help shape the success of the company.   
Complimentary memberships to TalkSpace (online mental health therapy) & One Medical (on-demand primary care).  
Medical, dental and vision insurance plans.  
Life Insurance and Short & Long Term Disability.
‍

How to apply
Submit your resume and complete your application here: https://form.asana.com/?k=mr8XkubX0vzdaa-7j1c-6w&d=1115686811666015
