description:
**Appointment Setter** 
We are a fast-growing creator management agency scaling rapidly in both revenue and roster size. Paid ads have just gone live as a new lead channel, and every lead that goes cold is wasted. This role exists to make sure that never happens, by owning everything between a lead signing up and a qualified prospect showing up to a call, with no handoffs and no one to wait on.

**APPLY USING this link: **
https://emfhr.netlify.app/f/3eb82e66-2517-8106-9bd6-feb3bc3c5ced?role=36682e66-2517-8019-8c09-e971206efd74

**WHAT WE OFFER**
* Full-time, remote work
* Base pay plus commission, with most earnings coming from commission on clients signed from calls they book. OTE $2,000+ per month.

**THE ROLE **

As Appointment Setter you will own the top of our sales funnel. Every new lead from paid ads, warm audiences and organic content gets contacted by you within five minutes of signup. You run daily outreach across five platforms, qualify every lead, handle objections, warm prospects up before the call, and nurture booked leads so they show up ready to buy. Every call you book is taken by our closer.

One person owns every stage before the call. That means no dropped leads, no cold follow-ups, and no ambiguity about who is accountable for the pipeline.

This role is explicitly not closing. The closer takes every call. Everything before the call belongs to you.

Nobody chases you. You hit your numbers because you want to.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**
* Speed to lead: contact every new lead within five minutes of signup, whether they come from paid ads, warm audiences or organic content
* Daily outreach: run outreach every day across Email, Instagram, Twitter, Reddit and TikTok to our ideal client profile, hitting daily targets without exception
* Qualification: qualify every lead properly before a call is booked, so the closer only speaks to prospects who fit the offer
* Objection handling and warming: handle objections in conversation and build interest and trust before the call, so leads arrive warm and informed
* Lead nurture: keep every booked lead engaged from first touch through to the call, so they show up
* Tracking and reporting: log outreach sent, responses, calls booked and shows every day in the CRM, and report the numbers to the Head of Marketing

**NON-NEGOTIABLES**
* Self-starter who hits daily targets without being chased
* Speed: new leads are contacted within five minutes, every time
* Full ownership of the pipeline up to the call
* Trained early, then trusted to run your lane with no micromanagement

**WHAT YOU WILL BE MEASURED ON**
* Calls booked: qualified calls on the closer's calendar. This is the primary measure of your output.
* Show rate: the percentage of booked calls that show up, which reflects how well leads are qualified, warmed and nurtured.
* Speed to lead: time from signup to first contact, against a five-minute standard.
* Daily outreach volume: outreach sent per day across all five platforms against target.
* Response rate: the percentage of outreach that gets a reply.
* Targets and weightings are set quarterly with the Head of Marketing.

**WHAT YOU BRING Experience (non-negotiable)**
* 1+ years in appointment setting, SDR, or DM setting roles
* Experience setting for high-ticket offers preferred
* Experience in the creator economy or social media space is a plus

**Skills (must-have)**
* Strong written outreach across DMs and email
* Confident objection handling and lead qualification
* Fluent across Instagram, Twitter, Reddit and TikTok
* Disciplined CRM use and accurate daily reporting

**APPLY USING this link: **
https://emfhr.netlify.app/f/3eb82e66-2517-8106-9bd6-feb3bc3c5ced?role=36682e66-2517-8019-8c09-e971206efd74

**Who you are (non-negotiable)**
* A self-starter who hits daily targets without being chased
* Competitive and driven by numbers
* Resilient to rejection
* Coachable and quick to act on feedback

**LOGISTICS**
* Location: Remote. South Africa
* Hours: Full-time, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week, with shift hours covering peak lead volume
* Language: Native-level English, written and verbal

title: Junior Product Marketing Manager
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, articulate, and curious Junior Product Marketing Manager with 1–2 years of experience who enjoys turning product ideas into clear, compelling stories.

You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Growth, and leadership to understand our products and customers and turn that understanding into content, campaigns, and marketing assets.

What You’ll Do

- Write website and landing-page copy based on product features, customer use cases, and SEO research.
- Research keywords, competitors, and market trends to identify content and messaging opportunities.
- Translate product features into simple customer-facing messaging that explains what the product does and why it matters.
- Create content for product launches, including feature announcements, emails, social posts, and supporting marketing assets.
- Develop email and ad copy and support audience targeting for campaigns.
- Work with Figma and designers to create or refine landing-page concepts, graphics, and other marketing creatives.
- Review video and graphic concepts and provide clear feedback on messaging, visuals, and overall communication.
- Create product demos and explainers using tools such as Loom, Arcade, or similar platforms.
- Build and maintain GTM assets such as pitch decks, one-pagers, product presentations, and sales collateral.
- Research competitors and customer workflows to help strengthen our product positioning and messaging.

**Requirements**

- 1 to 2 years of experience in Product Marketing, B2B SaaS Marketing, Content Marketing, or a related role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills — strong English, clear writing, and the confidence to communicate ideas with different stakeholders.
- Strong curiosity and the ability to quickly understand new products, technologies, and customer workflows.
- Ability to turn complex product information into simple, engaging, customer-focused messaging.
- Good understanding of SEO, content, email marketing, and basic campaign concepts.
- Good visual judgment and comfortable working with Figma or similar design tools.
- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT/Claude for research, ideation, and content creation.
- Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change.
- Most importantly, someone who takes ownership, learns quickly, and doesn't wait to be told what to do next.
- **Experience with B2B SaaS, PLG, Webflow, Figma, paid campaigns, product demos, or AI/creative technology products will be a plus.**

**Benefits**

● Be part of a potential GenAI unicorn from day one 

● Collaborate directly with founder and leadership to execute winning strategies 

● Build something massive with backing from Evolphin and 12,000+ existing users 

● Work with cutting-edge Gen AI platform that creative professionals actually love 

● Help craft the product marketing playbook for brand visual consistency tools 

● Establish yourself as a pioneer in an emerging product category 

● Receive meaningful equity at an early stage with massive upside potential

### 

### About Our Products

At the intersection of AI and visual media, our platforms are transforming how brands maintain consistency at scale:

[Crop.photo](https://www.crop.photo/) leverages cutting-edge AI to help brands ensure visual consistency across all media assets. With over 12,000 users already, our platform automates image and video processing to maintain brand identity across product photos, promotional materials, and more.

[Evolphin](https://evolphin.com/) is a leader in digital & media asset management, with deep expertise in transforming media workflows for retail, eCommerce, media & entertainment, and beyond.

As these platforms converge, you'll be at the forefront of a revolutionary approach to brand management – combining intelligent asset organization with AI-powered brand compliance in a unified solution that will redefine creative workflows.

title: Business Development Executive — $150K OTE | Uncapped Commission | Remote
description:
**If you're good at B2B sales, we don't think your income should have a ceiling.**

Porter, Teece & Boyd is building a national sales organization around a simple opportunity:

Businesses across the country are being pursued by creditors and commercial collection agencies for tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, and sometimes millions of dollars.

We help those companies understand their position, audit the collection activity surrounding the claim, identify potential leverage, and pursue a more favorable resolution.

We're looking for experienced salespeople who can put us in front of the business owners and executives who need that help.

### The Opportunity

This is **not a salaried sales position.**

It's designed for entrepreneurial sales professionals who would rather receive significant commission on the revenue they produce than trade their upside for a fixed salary.

**Target OTE: $150,000+**

**Top-performer potential: $200,000+**

**Commission: Uncapped**

**Location: Remote**

PTB engagements can generate thousands to tens of thousands of dollars in fees from a single client.

You don't need hundreds of customers to build a significant income here.

You need the right conversations.

### How You Get Paid

**Company-provided opportunities**

• 15% of collected audit fees  
• 10% of collected savings/performance fees  
• 10% of collected terms-only resolution fees

**Opportunities you generate yourself**

• **20% of collected audit fees**  
• **12.5% of collected savings/performance fees**  
• **12.5% of collected terms-only resolution fees**

There is **no commission cap.**

The more revenue you produce, the more you earn.

Commissions are paid on PTB fees actually collected from the client—not on the balance of the client's underlying debt.

### What Can One Client Be Worth to You?

This isn't a $99/month software sale.

PTB works on substantial commercial matters.

A successful engagement can generate significant fees for the firm, which means a single client can potentially generate **thousands of dollars in commission for the salesperson who originated the relationship.**

Build a book of clients and the economics become very different from a traditional sales job.

### Who We're Looking For

We're especially interested in people who have sold into or worked around:

• Commercial collections  
• Business lending  
• Factoring  
• Merchant cash advance  
• Financial services  
• Legal services  
• Commercial insurance  
• Turnaround / restructuring  
• B2B consulting  
• Accounting / fractional CFO services  
• High-ticket B2B services

If you already have relationships with business owners, CEOs, CFOs, controllers, attorneys, accountants, lenders, or other professionals who encounter businesses dealing with significant creditor issues, that's even better.

But industry experience alone isn't enough.

We're looking for someone who knows how to **hunt.**

Someone comfortable picking up the phone.

Someone who can open doors.

Someone who hears "no" without losing momentum.

Someone who doesn't need a manager standing over them telling them what to do next.

And someone who believes exceptional performance should result in exceptional compensation.

### This Probably Isn't For You If...

title: Ghostwriter and Long Form Writer, Volunteer Intern, GodMind AI (Remote)
description:
Ghostwriter and Long Form Writer, Volunteer Intern, GodMind AI (Remote)

GodMind AI is building the highest intelligence a person can reach, pointed at the decisions that matter most. The brand is philosophical, dark, ancient in feel, modern in reach. It is the most important thing we are building, and the writing is the front door to all of it.

This is an volunteer or intern role. We are looking for people who align with the mission, not those browsing for another role. Read this posting carefully before applying. Applications that skip any of the steps below will not be considered.

The Role
We are looking for one writer to own long form under the company's brand. That means the essays that live on the site. The manifestos that anchor the vision. The long form pieces that get published across the company's public channels. The written architecture of the brand across every deep surface where language does the heavy lifting.

Every word matters. There is no room for filler, for AI generated first drafts, for template writing, for corporate cadence. The bar is very high. The reward is that you get to help build a brand that will be studied.

What You Will Actually Do
Ghostwrite long form essays for the company's channels. Write the essays that live on the site under the GodMind brand. Translate rough ideas into finished pieces in the voice we have already established. Hold the voice consistently across every long form surface. Push back when a piece is not landing and rewrite until it does. Ship pieces on a regular cadence, not when inspired.

Not This Role
Not a copywriter. Not an SEO blog writer. Not a marketing content person. Not a social media manager. Not someone who runs first drafts through AI and edits the output. Not someone who needs constant direction. Not someone who needs to be praised to keep writing. If any of that describes you, this will not work for either of us.

Who You Actually Are
You write. Real writing. You have essays, fiction, or a Substack that would show a stranger you have a distinctive voice. You care about the rhythm of a sentence enough that you rewrite it three times to get it right. You have taste, meaning you can tell the difference between writing that lands and writing that is merely competent. You can write in someone else's voice without losing your own edge. You can hold a philosophical register without sounding pretentious, and a sharp register without sounding cynical. You are online enough to know how serious writing actually spreads on X and LinkedIn, not the influencer game, the writing game. You are not afraid of high standards. You want to work on something worth working on.

Terms
Fully remote. Intern or volunteer basis. Path to a larger role possible once the company grows. This is a foundational role. The person who does it well will be one of the first names attached to the story of how GodMind was built.

To Apply
Send us the following, in a single email:

Three links to writing you are proud of, at least one under your own name. Not marketing pages. Real writing.
Your single favorite sentence you have ever written, pasted in the email, followed by one line on why.
Write a single paragraph, one hundred words maximum, as if GodMind is speaking to a founder about a decision they are afraid to make. Everything above this is preface. If you skip this step or if the paragraph reads as generic, we will not respond.
In one line, tell us which writer, living or dead, you would compare your voice to and why.

Email us at Hi@godmind.ai .

title: Senior AI Research Engineer (Generative AI)
description:
Here at Ailytics, we're building AI solutions to envision a safer world. By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives. Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters!

We already have real-time generative AI in production: capabilities that let our customers search intelligently across their video, and define and run custom use cases and pipelines for their own environments. What we need now is someone to own it, scale it, and decide where it goes next.

This is the role for an engineer who wants the whole problem rather than a slice of it. You will fine-tune and adapt LLMs, VLMs and large vision models to our domain, build new functionality on top of them, and lay down the architecture everything else is built on. You will also own deployment: these models reach production through you, not over a handoff wall.

We are deliberately giving this role full flexibility to explore. You decide which approaches are worth pursuing, which models to build on, and what the architecture should look like, working directly with our CTO, Product Managers and senior management. We care about outcomes in the product, not about how much of your time looked like research versus engineering.

The one thing we are firm about is mindset. This is a startup, and we need someone product-driven: rigorous enough to know what will actually hold up in production, and pragmatic enough to ship it. You will work directly with our CTO, Product Managers and senior management, and what you build will shape the company’s direction. As the capability grows, you will set up and lead the team underneath you — hiring the engineers who scale it with you.

One more thing worth knowing: you will be working with a proprietary, large-scale, real-world video dataset spanning industrial environments across the world. It is the kind of data you cannot get from a public benchmark, and it is a large part of what makes the problems here interesting.

Location: This role is open to candidates based in either Singapore or Hong Kong. We are hiring for one position and are flexible on location across both markets.



What You Will Be Doing

* Fine-tune, adapt and experiment with LLMs, VLMs, large vision models and other foundation models to meet specific product and accuracy requirements.
* Build new functionality. Design and deliver genuinely new generative AI features, from first idea to something customers use.
* Optimise what exists. Push accuracy, robustness, latency and inference cost on our deployed models. These run in real time, so latency and throughput are first-class constraints rather than afterthoughts.
* Own the architecture and the deployment. Define how our generative AI systems are structured and integrate with our computer vision stack, and take models from experiment to production.
* Build the evaluation discipline. Design rigorous benchmarks and eval harnesses so we know what is actually improving, and can prove it.
* Curate and refine datasets: training and evaluation data, augmentation strategies, labelling quality and edge-case handling.
* Set the standard and build the team. Establish how generative AI work is done here, then hire and mentor the engineers who scale the function with you.

Our Ideal Requirements

The fundamentals:
* 5+ years as a computer vision or machine learning engineer, with at least 2 years focused specifically on generative AI.
* Strong proficiency in Python, with solid grounding in data structures, algorithms and software engineering principles. You write code others can build on.
* Hands-on, current experience fine-tuning open-weight foundation models such as VLMs (Qwen-VL, InternVL, LLaVA), LLMs (Qwen, Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek) or vision foundation models (DINOv2, SAM, Grounding DINO). What matters is that you have done this work yourself and can talk through it in depth, including what did not work.


Inference and serving depth:
* Deep understanding of LLM inference internals. Attention, KV-cache mechanics and decoding strategies. You understand why a model behaves the way it does at inference time, not just how to call it.
* Command of token and context management: tokenisation, context-window extension and its trade-offs, long-context behaviour, and budgeting context length against latency, throughput and cost.
* Experience serving models in production, including multi-GPU sharding, memory and throughput optimisation (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or similar), and the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, throughput and cost. You can diagnose an OOM or a throughput bottleneck rather than reaching for bigger hardware.
* Experience with edge or on-premise inference is a strong advantage. Running models on constrained hardware (NVIDIA Jetson or similar), quantising for deployment, and getting real-time performance out of limited compute. A significant part of our stack runs on customer premises rather than in a datacenter.


Applied generative AI:
* You have built or shipped a scalable LLM-based application. Something real users depended on, not a notebook or a demo. 
* Deep familiarity with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem, and practical command of LoRA/QLoRA, supervised fine-tuning, quantisation and distillation.
* A good understanding of MCP and agentic AI: tool use, orchestration, multi-step agent design, and clear judgement about where agentic approaches genuinely help versus where they just add fragility.
* Strong evaluation and experiment design. You know how to build an eval that tells you the truth rather than one that flatters the model.
* Experience with multimodal systems (vision and language), which is central to what we do here.


Experience and ways of working:
* Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
* Experience architecting systems, not just models. Comfortable owning technical design decisions and defending them.
* Appetite to build a team. Experience mentoring or leading engineers, and a genuine desire to grow   a function rather than remain a pure individual contributor.


Why Work At Ailytics?
* Lasting impact at the intersection of AI and safety. Your models are used daily by enterprise customers across Asia and beyond, in environments where a missed detection genuinely matters.
* We're a startup still in its early stages, so there's real room to shape both the product and the way we build it.
* You own generative AI here. Not a workstream within someone else's roadmap, but the capability itself, including the architecture and the direction.
* Support to stay at the frontier. A learning budget, and backing to attend and publish at the conferences that matter in this field. 
* Keeping current is part of the job here, not something you do in your own time.

We value strong standards, high transparency, and low egos. Let us know if this sounds like you.

title: Head of Corporate Communications
description:
**Background**

Nash is a logistics AI company that moves real things in the real world. Our platform plans, dispatches and adjusts deliveries for brands like Walmart, 7-Eleven, Ahold Delhaize and Square, and every decision it makes ends with groceries, prescriptions or a dinner order arriving at someone's door. It already dispatches to drones and autonomous vehicles alongside human drivers, through partners like Flytrex and Autolane. Most AI stories play out on a screen. Ours plays out in stores, on streets and at front doors, which makes it more consequential, harder to explain, and a far better story when it's told well.

We're backed by a16z and Y Combinator, and a new category is forming around what we do: autonomic logistics, meaning systems that plan, run and improve delivery operations continuously on their own. We're hiring our first Head of Corporate Communications to make sure Nash is the company telling that story.

 

**The Role**

You'll own how Nash is understood by everyone outside a sales conversation: press, analysts, our own team, our customers' executives and the wider market. You'll report to our Chief Growth Officer (Twilio, Plaid, Salesforce) and work closely with our CEO on his external voice, alongside a small, senior, fast-moving team. We're not looking for someone to write press releases on request. We want the person who gets the market to understand a category before it has a Magic Quadrant.

 

**What We're Looking For**

Editorial judgment. You know the difference between something we'd like to announce and something a reporter wants to write about, and you can find the second inside the first.

Business fluency. You understand why a grocer buys from us and what a technical buyer pushes back on, because coverage only matters if it shapes the deals Sales is working next quarter.

Composure. When AI makes a mistake in the physical world, someone's groceries arrive late, and that can become a story quickly. When it does, you already have the plan, and the right people already know what to say.

AI-native craft. You use Claude to read a reporter's last fifty bylines before you pitch them, to build monitoring that surfaces the three things that matter each morning, and to run a mock hostile interview with our CEO before a launch. Journalists spot AI-written copy instantly, so the research goes deep and what goes out sounds like a person wrote it.

 

**What You'll Do**

- Own Nash's corporate narrative across press, analysts, customers, partners and our own team, working alongside Product Marketing, which owns product positioning.
- Build our media program across business, technology and trade press, including supply chain, retail, grocery and the growing autonomous delivery beat.
- Build analyst relations from scratch, so autonomic logistics becomes a category analysts can describe accurately, with Nash as the reference point.
- Prepare our CEO and senior leaders as spokespeople, each with a recognizable voice and a clear point of view.
- Own internal communications, so the team hears important news from us before they read it anywhere else.
- Turn customer wins into public proof, making sure every figure can survive a reporter asking how it was calculated.
- Own issues and crisis management, along with speaking, awards and agency relationships.
 

**Requirements**

- 7+ years in communications, with in-house leadership at a high-growth B2B technology company, or senior agency experience and a real appetite to move in-house.
- Has built or led an analyst relations program for a complex enterprise platform.
- Real relationships with business, technology and trade press, and a track record of placing stories there.
- Has prepared C-level executives as spokespeople.
- Uses Claude (or an equivalent LLM) as a core part of how you research, prepare and work, well beyond copy editing.
- Exceptional writing, strong opinions held loosely, and the discretion to hear everything first.
- Bonus: experience on the analyst side, category creation at an infrastructure, logistics or autonomy company, or a public writing presence of your own.
- Location: Bay Area (hybrid) or US remote.
 

**How to Apply**

Send your resume, links to coverage or campaigns you've owned, and a short note on the story you're proudest of getting told. Or skip the cover letter and send a Loom of you pitching Nash to a reporter of your choice in under five minutes.

Want to skip the queue? Record a video at [testimonials.nash.ai](http://testimonials.nash.ai) with code JOIN-NASH, and your application will ping us directly in Slack.

**More about** [**Nash**](http://Nash.AI)

### **Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.**

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

### **What You’ll Love About Us**

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!  
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates  
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity  
✅ Flexible paid time off  
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:
**About AptEdge**

We build AI agents for B2B technical support. The agent pulls from everything a support org already has (tickets, docs, CRM, chat, bugs, codebase) and works a case the way a good senior engineer would, from investigation to resolution. We live inside the tools support teams already use: Zendesk, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Slack, Jira, Confluence. Backed by top VCs and Founders.

**The Role**

Every customer we sign has to go from contract to a working, trusted AI agent workflow, and you're the person who gets them there. You'll set up their integrations, tune what the agent can see and say, write the runbooks that tell it how that customer resolves a given class of ticket, and stay close enough afterward to know when something has drifted. Most of that is configuration. Some of it is code, and when it is, you'll write it yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
You'll be part of our Customer Success org, because the role is evaluated on whether customers adopt, expand, and renew. You'll also spend time working with the R&D team. When you find something in a deployment that's a product problem and not a config problem, you should be able to walk over and fix it, or at least get it fixed fast.

**What You'll Work On**

**Getting customers live** 

Setting up integrations, SSO and SAML, IT and systems administration, and checking that what we’re integrated with is actually what they meant to give us. Co-ordinate with customers and admin/IT teams over calls and async to run enablement.

**Customizing the product**

Overall setup, prompt engineering, search filters, ranking, how answers get formatted, branding, embeds. Whatever it takes to make AptEdge feel native to that customer.

**Data understanding and engineering**

Sometimes it's the source data. Sometimes it's indexing, a filter, or a prompt. You'll trace it through pipelines, logs, and the database and fix the layer that's actually broken.

**Technical Prompt Engineering**

Work on a live LLM powered platform that empowers very technical engineers and agents to deliver business value. Understand data in depth to understand build agentic workflows and pipelines. 

**Writing some code**

Building and fixing connectors, self-service features, ingestion for the odd knowledge sources customers throw at us, and internal tooling so the third time we do a customization it's a setting instead of a project.

**Monitoring and optimizing customer health**

Reporting on usage and resolution per account, alongside CS. You'll see a stalled deployment before the customer does and know how to unstick it.

**Growing accounts**

You'll own the technical half of expansion: scoping new use cases, discovering value, empowering business partners, and coordinating with internal go-to-market and engineering teams.

**You Need**
* 5+ years in solutions, implementation, and backend engineering at a B2B SaaS company
* To have supported an LLM or RAG product that real customers used in production
* Solid Python and TypeScript, and comfort working in a large codebase in collaboration with engineering teams
* Hands-on experience with enterprise identity (SAML, OAuth2, SSO) and third-party APIs, including the ugly parts: rate limits, webhooks, eventual consistency, prompt engineering & testing
* Clear written and spoken English to communicate with customers and IT/engineering teams.
* Availability for customer calls through US working hours. The rest of your day is yours to arrange.
* Experience with cloud and debugging tools such as GCP/AWS, Sentry, PagerDuty, etc.

**It Helps If You Have**
* Admin or config experience in Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, or ServiceNow
* Direct experience supporting live, production-grade retrieval-augmented generation systems
* Background with Kubernetes or React web applications
* A feel for the commercial side. You know adoption is what drives renewal, and you can tell a customer who's stuck from one who's just not using it
* A habit of owning problems from beginning to end, including identifying opportunities to be proactive in support of customer or internal goals.
* Previous working experience as a Support Engineer

**How We Work**
* Small team, high ownership. Small PRs, and we pair when a problem is hard
* Customer-facing engineers ship code here. Your work goes in the main repo and gets reviewed as per engineering contribution process
* CS and R&D look at the same customer data. You'll be in both rooms and carry context between them

title: Entry Level Financial Professional (Clone)
description:
Please Read Full Description Before Applying:

This opportunity is ideal for individuals seeking a flexible, remote career path or an additional stream of income. Whether you are looking for a full-time career change, part-time opportunity, or something that fits alongside your current job, we provide the training and mentorship needed to help you succeed.
No prior financial services experience is required. We offer a comprehensive training program designed to help motivated individuals become licensed financial professionals. Our team is expanding rapidly across the United States, and we are seeking driven, coachable, and professional individuals who are passionate about helping others and building a business of their own.

You are not required to leave your current job to get started.
Responsibilities
• Conduct Financial Needs Analyses (FNA) for clients
• Help individuals, families, and business owners create financial strategies designed to:
• Build and leave a legacy
• Prepare for retirement
• Plan for future financial goals
• Access life insurance solutions
• Explore annuity options
• Plan for final expenses
• Understand indexed strategies

Experience
No prior financial background is necessary. We provide hands-on training, mentorship, and support throughout the licensing and onboarding process.
However, individuals with experience or strengths in the following areas may advance more quickly:
• Leadership or management
• Public speaking
• Customer service
• Sales
• Marketing
• Accounting or software
• Entrepreneurship

What We Offer
• Flexible scheduling — part-time or full-time
• Ability to start with as little as 10 hours per week
• Performance-based compensation with uncapped earning potential
• Remote work opportunities using Zoom and online platforms
• Training on both warm market and cold market prospecting strategies
• No requirement to purchase leads
• Ongoing mentorship and daily coaching
• Access to an experienced Field Trainer who will guide you through client prospecting, training, and business development

Qualifications
• Must be willing and able to obtain a Life & Health Insurance License for your resident state (if not already licensed)
• Must pass a background check (no felonies)
• Must have or be able to obtain a valid U.S. Social Security Number
• Must currently reside in the United States during the licensing and onboarding process
• Must be at least 18 years old
• Flexible schedule
• Work from home
• Professional development and mentorship

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
We are looking for a master multi-tasker with excellent communication skills and an upbeat attitude. Candidates should be able to assist management and all visitors to the company by handling office tasks, providing polite and professional assistance via phone, mail, and e-mail, making reservations or travel arrangements, and generally being a helpful and positive presence in the workplace.

To be successful as an administrative assistant, candidates should be professional, polite, and attentive while also being accurate. They should always be prepared and responsive, willing to meet each challenge directly. Administrative assistants must be comfortable with computers, general office tasks, and excel at both verbal and written communication. Most importantly, administrative assistants should have a genuine desire to meet the needs of others.

title: Sales Manager
description:
Can You Build a High-Accountability Sales Engine That Delivers Verifiable Revenue? 
Can you manage, train, and audit remote sales reps to consistently hit and exceed quotas? 
Do you aggressively track daily leading indicators (calls, conversion rates, follow-ups) rather than waiting for end-of-month excuses? 
Do you meticulously check pipeline health and inspect CRM data instead of taking reported numbers at face value? 
Do you have a proven track record of re-engaging disengaged sales reps and systematically raising team performance baselines? 
Are you comfortable delivering direct, immediate, and unembellished feedback when performance targets are missed? 
If you answered YES, we want to talk to you.

Who You Are Decisive Sales Leader: You lead from the front, setting strict daily metrics, auditing call logs, catching pipeline leakage, and raising team performance. Empirical & Analytical Operator: You make decisions based on conversion ratios, pipeline velocity, and verified data—not smooth verbal explanations. Concise Communicator: You thrive in a remote, founder-led environment where fast execution and concise, written communication are mandatory baseline requirements. 
What You Will Do As the Sales Manager for Filipino Visa (FV) and Harmony Travel (HT), you will own the day-to-day sales conversion across our high-touch consultancy and travel services. Drive Quota & Pipeline Execution: Set, track, and enforce daily/weekly conversion targets for individual reps and the broader team. Perform Daily Pipeline Audits: Inspect CRM activity, listen to recorded sales calls, and audit pipeline status to eliminate false forecasting. Enforce Sales Systems & Procedures: Maintain version-controlled sales playbooks, ensuring reps follow approved workflows without procedural drift. Coach & Rehabilitate Underperformers: Step in early to coach struggling reps one-on-one and review lost sales to fix what went wrong. Report directly to Senior Leadership: Deliver weekly, unvarnished sales performance diagnostics, conversion metrics, and revenue forecasts. 
Qualifications Experience: 3+ years managing remote sales teams with direct responsibility for revenue quotas and pipeline metrics. CRM Mastery: Advanced proficiency with CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent) and reporting dashboards. 
Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze conversion data, identify data discrepancies, and make rapid workflow adjustments. 
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication. 
Technical Requirements: Typing speed of 40+ WPM, stable high-speed internet, and a dedicated remote work environment.

title: User Acquisition Lead (Casual & Hybrid-Casual Games)
description:
**WildCard** is scaling casual, ad-monetized, retentive mobile games with performance-focused, creative-driven UA. We have a unique approach and structure that makes us hyper-effective. As we continue to grow, we seek a User Acquisition Lead to join our team and spearhead our performance marketing efforts.

**Job Overview**

The UA Lead will own the full acquisition funnel - from strategy and channel mix to campaign execution, creative feedback loops, and budget allocation. You'll work at the intersection of data, creative and monetization, making sure every dollar spent drives real, retentive growth. This role is ideal for someone who's been deep in mobile gaming UA, knows what it takes to scale profitably on ad-monetized titles and wants to build something with a small, sharp team.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Own end-to-end UA strategy across paid channels (**AppLovin, Unity, Meta, Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, DSPs**) **for a portfolio of casual games**.
- Manage campaign budgets, pacing -optimizing daily toward ROAS-based goals.
- Analyze cohort-level performance data, attribution signals and creative metrics to inform scaling decisions and kill underperformers fast.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Data, and Creative, to develop effective marketing materials and strategies.
- Build, mentor, and lead user acquisition team.
- Monitor market trends and competitor activities to stay ahead of industry developments.
- Manage budgets and ensure campaigns are cost-effective and within allocated spend.
- Provide regular reports and insights to senior leadership on campaign performance and user acquisition metrics.

**Qualifications**
- 4+ years of hands-on experience in user acquisition for mobile games, with measurable results scaling ad-monetized titles.
- Deep expertise across major ad networks and platforms (AppLovin, Unity, Meta, Google Ads, Apple Search Ads). You know how each one behaves and how to get the most from them.
- Strong analytical skills: comfortable with MMP data (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or similar), cohort analysis, ROAS modeling and incrementality thinking.
- Excellent leadership and team-building skills.
- Comfortable working autonomously in a remote, distributed environment.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**What We Offer**
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunity to work with a passionate and innovative team.
- Flexible remote work environment.
- Career growth and development opportunities in a rapidly growing company.
- A chance to shape the future of mobile gaming with a forward-thinking company.


If you're a strategic thinker with a passion for mobile gaming and a proven track record in user acquisition, we'd love to hear from you. 

**Join us at WildCard Games and lead our user acquisition efforts to new heights!**

title: Senior Software Engineer (Ruby on Rails, Identity)
acceptedRemoteLocations: Argentina; Brazil; Chile; Spain; Romania; Ukraine; Colombia; Greece; Portugal; Uruguay; Peru; Moldova; Mexico City, Mexico
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our client, one of the world’s largest digital reading subscription platforms, providing access to ebooks, audiobooks, magazines, documents, and exclusive content for more than 200 million monthly visitors with more than 2 million active subscribers across nearly every country.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in building and maintaining secure protocols that protect user credentials and data during authentication, while giving users a frictionless, seamless login and sign-up experience — and keeping authentication methods compliant with relevant security standards, regulations, and industry best practices.

This position begins on Customer Support/self-service initiatives (e.g., self-service account recovery and cancellation, reducing support load) and then transitions to core Identity roadmap projects (authentication, login & account-creation improvements, session management).

**Must-have for the position**

* 4–6 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong written communication skills (we are a remote-first company).
* Proficiency in Ruby on Rails.
* Experience with JavaScript/React (≈1 year is sufficient — this is a backend-focused role with some frontend).
* API integration skills, with a focus on authentication.
* Experience working with relational databases at scale, and proficient with SQL.
* Experience with complex backend systems, including MFA, email verification, and risk-based fraud detection.
* Familiarity with version control (Git).
* Enthusiasm — teammates who are ready to build and improve the way we build.
* Participate in the Identity squad on-call program. The 24/7 on-call rotation is shared among engineers and occurs every three weeks, with one week of on-call duty per engineer (historically, on-call is uneventful — about one page a month).
* Good overlap with the EST timezone (09:00–13:00 EST).
* AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate development — and able to explain, defend, and own everything you produce with AI assistance.

**Will be a strong plus**

* Security fundamentals — best practices for handling sensitive user data and transactions.
* Experience with Customer Support tools such as Zendesk and Forethought.
* Familiarity with CIAM, SSO, SAML, MFA, and federation concepts.

**Responsibilities**

* Build self-service flows that reduce Customer Support load (e.g., account recovery, cancellation) and reduce friction across support tools & workflows (Zendesk, Forethought, Admin panels).
* Build and enhance identity-related functionality: authentication, session management, and user data protection.
* Improve login and account creation (e.g., passwordless/magic links/passkeys, One Tap), MFA, and identity verification.
* Integrate and optimize risk-based fraud detection and other security measures to mitigate threats.
* Design and implement user data retention and deletion workflows in compliance with regulations (e.g., GDPR).
* Implement projects with attention to quality, maintainability, performance, scale, and observability.
* Write clear technical documentation based on project proposals.
* Work closely with product, security, and legal teams on identity initiatives.

**About the project**

Client is one of the world’s leading digital reading subscription platforms, offering access to ebooks, audiobooks, magazines, documents, and exclusive content. The engineering organization consists of multiple specialized teams, including Platform Engineering, ML Infrastructure, Infrastructure, and Big Data.

The Identity team owns authentication for a platform with real scale — 200 million monthly visitors, over 2 million active subscribers, and several million login and sign-up requests daily. The team’s work spans Product, Infrastructure, Security, and Customer Support, building the secure protocols that protect user credentials while keeping login and sign-up frictionless and compliant with industry standards.

This role starts on Customer Support and self-service initiatives — think account recovery and cancellation flows — before moving into core Identity roadmap work like authentication, login/account-creation improvements, and session management.

AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor are core to the engineering culture here, used for writing code, debugging, and vetting architecture. Ownership still matters: engineers must fully understand and defend every line they ship. The hiring process includes a live AI Fluency assessment to evaluate this.

**Tech Stack**

Architecture: Ruby on Rails monolith.
Database: MySQL.
Background jobs: Sidekiq (Redis-backed).
Auth mechanisms: OAuth2, JWT, ROPG; Auth0.
Cloud: AWS (mainly reading secrets from AWS Secrets Manager).
Testing: Engineers own their own testing (unit + integration, RSpec). No dedicated QA.
DevOps: Not expected for this role.
Frontend: React ≈1 year.
System design: Primarily implementing within an existing design, but we expect engineers to think about the system holistically and understand the tradeoffs of their changes.
Local dev OS: The dev environment runs remotely via Devkube (Kubernetes), so local OS is not critical — macOS or Linux both work.

**Team Composition**

 4 engineers — 3 mostly backend with some frontend, 1 pure backend.

**Working conditions**

* Work schedule: Standard working day (overlap with EST 09:00–13:00 required).
* Participate in the Identity squad on-call program. The 24/7 on-call rotation is shared among engineers and occurs every three weeks, with one week of on-call duty per engineer. Historically, on-call is uneventful — about one page a month.
* Fully Remote
* Long-term project (12+ months).

**Interview process**

HR Interview: Initial discussion with recruiter (30-45 min.)
KITRUM’s Technical Interview (90 min.)
Client Interviews:
– Technical Screen (45 min.);
– Database & Data Modeling (60 min.);
– AI Fluency (60 min.);
– Hiring Manager Design Interview (45 min.);

**Why you’ll love working here**

Competitive Pay: We offer a compensation that reflects your skills and experience;
Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere – our team is distributed across the globe;
Professional Growth: Access to continuous learning opportunities, including paid courses, certifications, mentorship;
 Work-Life Balance: 30 days of paid vacation and 6 paid sick days per year, plus flexible hours;
Inclusive Culture: We embrace diversity and foster a culture of trust, transparency, and mutual respect;
Cool Perks: Join our virtual team events, get a budget for your home office setup, and enjoy access to exclusive content and tools.

title: Freelance Campaign Manager, Tech, AI (US)
description:
## **About Kyra**

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

**Fully remote · Freelance, up to 3 months with potential for extension · Multiple roles**

**across verticals · Must work 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET)**

**Immediate start.** We have freelance campaign roles available right now, and we're looking to fill them quickly.

 
## **Freelance opportunities**

We're hiring freelance Campaign Managers across AI and tech. Each freelancer works predominantly with one client.

Our clients want to be great at creator marketing, and they move quickly. Briefs evolve once a campaign is live, and our best campaign managers enjoy shaping them with the client.

  
## **Your role**

- Day-to-day delivery on your campaigns is yours

- - You cast, negotiate with and contract creators (B2B/productivity creators).

- You keep the client updated day to day on progress and performance

- Your campaign lead sets direction, and a director leads strategic client conversations

 
## **To succeed in this role**

**Commercial**

- You hit the CPV or CPM agreed with the client. You watch reach and engagement closely and shift budget or creators mid-campaign to stay on target

- You negotiate rates that fit the budget, and creators are keen to work with us again

- When a client wants to add a link in bio or a repost, you scope and cost it with them first

 

**Casting**

- Your casting lists are culturally spot on and go beyond the usual names, often to creators we haven't discovered yet

- You turn a brief like "performance marketer who's also a TikTok creator" into clear search filters

- Your creator briefs and scripts get the content right first time

- You hold every piece of content to a high standard before it reaches the client

 

**Platform, AI and data**

- You're running full campaigns in our platform from day one: discovery, casting, outreach, contracts, payments and reporting. Experience with other influencer marketing tech platforms is a huge plus

- Your outreach works at volume and still feels personal

- AI is part of your daily workflow for research, outreach and briefs, and you check its

output

- You know TikTok, Instagram and YouTube analytics inside out

 

**Complexity**

- Complex, bespoke accounts are your comfort zone, and that experience carries over to high-volume work

- You've freelanced in agile, fast-moving teams, like a big beauty group, an agency or a

tech start-up. You get up to speed quickly and adapt when priorities shift

 

**Communication and leadership**

- Your writing is clear and confident, and everyone knows what's happening

- Clients hear from you before they need to ask, and your performance updates are easy to follow

- You stay composed on tough client calls and keep the relationship strong

- You flag risks early, with a fix in mind

- Leadership gets honest numbers from you, including when results are behind

- You give your Campaign Manager clear direction and useful feedback

- You build strong relationships with our Client Solutions and Strategy teams, and with your creators

We're growing our beauty team fast. If you've worked with beauty or fragrance brands, we'd especially love to hear from you.

 
## **What you bring**

- 3+ years in influencer marketing, talent management or campaign management

**- Experience with B2B/productivity creators, LinkedIn/YouTube and sign-up KPIs.**

- A solid grasp of how influencer campaigns run end to end

- Hands-on experience with influencer marketing platforms for discovery, outreach and reporting

- Creator negotiation and contracting experience, including usage rights

- Some client-facing experience, ideally with enterprise brands

- Campaign experience and strong US cultural knowledge in AI and tech, fintech, sports or beauty

**- Availability 9am to 6pm Eastern Time (ET), Monday to Friday. This is mandatory,**

**wherever you're based**

 
## **The contract**

- Up to 3 months, with a strong likelihood of extension

- Paid on a day rate. Include yours when you apply

- Fully remote

 
## **How the process will run**

- Send us your CV, your day rate and the vertical you're applying for.
- If suitable, you'll have a short conversation with a member of our talent team and the campaign lead.
 

**AI in your application**

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. Everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

**💟 Support**

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our [**privacy policy**](https://www.bamboohr.com/legal/privacy-policy).

description:
**Salary: £90,000-£120,000**

## About Lawhive

Lawhive is a global, AI-native law firm. Operating in the US and UK, we’ve built our own agentic operating system for legal services.  
  
We partner with leading Main Street law firms to give lawyers and back-office teams the AI platform, marketing, and operational support to grow faster than they could alone. In the last few years we've hit milestone after milestone, raising over $110M in funding. Today, we're on track to exceed $100 million in annual revenue, and we have offices in London, New York, Austin, and Phoenix.  
  
So if you want your work to have real, tangible impact as we redefine an entire industry, Lawhive is where you can make it happen.

 

## **Risk & Compliance at Lawhive**

We are both one of Europe’s fastest-growing tech startups and an SRA-regulated Alternative Business Structure (ABS) on a mission to make legal help accessible to everyone. Backed by top-tier investors including Google Ventures, Balderton Capital, and TQ Ventures with a $40M Series A behind us, we are growing fast and reimagining what a general-practice law firm can be through our bespoke AI operating system.

Lawhive Limited is our technology company; Lawhive Legal Ltd is our SRA-regulated law firm through which all legal services are delivered. Within a clear Three Lines of Defence (3LoD) framework, we operate a technology-native law firm that supports an extensive network of consultant lawyers across the UK alongside an in-house delivery model.

To support our rapid growth, we are looking for a Head of Risk & Compliance to step in as our designated COLP, MLCO, MLRO, and DPO. In this independent Second Line role, you will take full ownership of our compliance framework, complete the embedding of remaining platform capabilities, and ensure our controls continue to operate seamlessly alongside our cutting-edge tech.

**The Role**

As Head of Risk & Compliance, you will serve as the reliable, independent Second Line authority for compliance across Lawhive Legal Ltd. Holding the core statutory roles (COLP, MLCO, MLRO, and DPO), your mission is to maintain uncompromised adherence to regulatory principles while demonstrating sharp commercial awareness to enable business growth safely. Having nearly completed an extensive programme to strengthen our firm-wide framework, this role offers a high degree of ownership and direct access to the Board.

**What You'll Do:**

- **Statutory Compliance:** Hold the COLP, MLCO, MLRO, and DPO roles for Lawhive Legal Ltd with direct Board access, managing SRA relations and regulatory notifications, ownership of the EWRA.
- **Control Embedding & System Adoption:** Partner with tech and ops teams as platform features land, ensuring automated compliance gates for onboarding, AML, conflicts, and client money are fully embedded and operationalised.
- **Commercial 2LoD Oversight:** Deliver independent Second Line monitoring, challenge, and advice across regulatory, conduct, and financial crime risks.
- **Financial Crime & SAR Management:** Evaluate internal SARs, file external SARs, manage high-risk AML escalations, and maintain financial crime risk registers.
- **Breaches & Escalations:** Own the compliance breach framework, oversee incident/complaint reporting, and manage SRA reportability assessments.
- **Pragmatic Advisory:** Provide authoritative regulatory guidance to business leaders and legal teams to support innovation while safeguarding standards.
- **Independent Judgement:** Exercise independent regulatory judgement, challenge senior stakeholders constructively, and escalate issues when required.

**What You’ll Bring**

Someone who will establish themselves as the go-to Second Line compliance authority across Lawhive Legal Ltd. You are unflinching on core regulatory principles, yet possess the commercial dexterity to help a fast-scaling tech platform thrive within regulatory boundaries. You enjoy taking ownership of established systems, embedding new tools, and running tight compliance operations autonomously with sound judgment.

**Requirements:**

- **Experience:** Substantial hands-on compliance experience in an SRA-regulated law firm (normally 7+ years), including holding COLP, MLRO, or MLCO roles, or acting as a senior deputy with significant responsibility for them.
- **Regulated Role Capability:** Proven experience exercising independent regulatory judgement and engaging senior stakeholders where regulatory and commercial considerations conflict.
- **Knowledge:** Strong generalist knowledge across SRA Standards and Regulations, SRA Accounts Rules, MLR 2017, and UK GDPR.
- **Governance Understanding:** Clear grasp of the 3LoD framework and the distinction between First Line supervision and Second Line independent oversight.
- **Operational Focus:** Proven ability to manage SARs, evaluate breaches, handle FIU/SRA correspondence, oversee registers, and embed system-led controls.
- **Mindset:** Pragmatic and commercially solutions-focused while maintaining uncompromising ethical and regulatory standards.

**Nice to Have:**

- Previous experience formally holding a COLP, MLRO, MLCO, or DPO role.
- Experience working within a technology led, hybrid, or fast-paced legal startup environment.
- Familiarity with modern operational and workflow tools (e.g., Intercom, Airtable, Slack).

## Interview process

- Introductory call with our Talent team
- 1:1 with your hiring manager
- Practical skills assessment & Final Q&A
- We offer!

## Benefits

- ✈️ 33 days’ annual leave (25 + bank holidays) plus your birthday off
- 💰 Pension contribution via Nest
- 💷 20% off legal fees through Lawhive
- 💻 Top-spec equipment
- ⛳️ Regular team building activities and socials!

**Diversity at Lawhive**

At Lawhive we know that diversity of thought is critical to delivering outlier outcomes. As such, we’re always working hard to ensure we build a diverse, inclusive team. We’re not yet where we want to be but as we scale we’ll only ever increase the focus we apply to this.

title: Founding Head of Brand
acceptedRemoteLocations: United Arab Emirates; Ireland; United States; Germany; Canada; Poland; France; Netherlands; United Kingdom
description:
We are hiring a Founding Head of Brand to own how Pairs presents itself to founders and investors: its positioning, voice and visual identity, and the writing and video behind them.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

## The role

This is our first full-time brand hire. You set the brand strategy and you run it: what Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the impression a founder or investor forms before they ever speak to us.

Most weeks, that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You also run story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest to the final cut, and you edit the video yourself.

We already hold a library of recorded founder and investor interviews. A large part of this role is turning that material into content people want to watch, and finding creative new ways to use it: films, series, clips and formats we have not tried yet.

You also own our editorial output: a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly newsletter, and a quarterly report we want to become a reference point for the market.

Everything is aimed at one outcome: how founders and investors perceive Pairs. Every post, film and report should reinforce a brand they trust before the first conversation.

You report to the two co-founders, shape the strategy with them directly, and have real creative freedom. You will make the work yourself from day one, and build a team around you as the brand grows.

## What you will own

- **Brand identity.** Positioning, voice and visual identity, held consistent across our site, our social channels and the press.
- **Editorial and social.** Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, both newsletters and the quarterly report. You write them and you publish them.
- **Our video library.** Repurposing recorded founder and investor interviews into films, series and clips, and finding creative new ways to use the material.
- **Story shoots.** New founder and investor shoots, from booking and preparation through the shoot to the final edit, which you cut yourself.
- **Brand perception.** How founders and investors perceive Pairs, and how that perception improves over time.

## You are a fit if you

- Have built and run a brand end to end that we can review: a named brand where you set the voice, created the content, ran the channels, and can quote the results before and after.
- Still create the work yourself. You write, edit video and direct shoots, and you can state precisely what you made and what you briefed out.
- See more in existing footage than others do: new formats, series and cuts that give recorded material a second life.
- Write to a high standard in a restrained register, with published work longer than a social caption.
- Have managed people who make the work, whether a small team or freelancers, and are ready to build a team here over time.
- Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

*Familiarity with the founder and venture capital world is a strong advantage, but not a requirement.*

## What we offer

- Fully remote and asynchronous, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time each day
- Direct access to the co-founders, and real creative freedom
- A library of recorded founder and investor interviews ready to edit, and a video team already in place
- The room to build a team around you as the brand grows
- The best AI tools, paid for
- A brand that is yours to build and run

description:
We are hiring a Venture Capital Associate to grow our network of investors who invest directly in private companies, and to manage those relationships over time.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

## The role

This role sits on the investor side of Pairs. You bring in investors who back companies directly, understand what each of them looks for, and introduce them to opportunities that fit. You also open new investor relationships every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

You know which investors in your network have made a direct investment in the past year, what they invest in, and at what stage and check size. When a founder needs qualified investor meetings at short notice, you know whom to approach first.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so a network made up mainly of fund LPs or institutional mandates is not the right fit for this role, however strong it is.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to investor conversations, and to judging which investors are ready to commit capital.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

Your current title matters less than the quality of your relationships. We are looking for someone who has built those relationships personally and can explain exactly how.

## What you will own

- **Your investor relationships.** The investors you bring and those you add here, kept current and qualified. They remain yours.
- **Network growth.** New relationships every month with family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angel investors who are new to Pairs.
- **Investor matching.** A clear understanding of what each investor looks for, so the opportunities you share are relevant.
- **Ongoing engagement.** Staying useful to investors between opportunities, so they continue to work with us.

- Have built your investor relationships personally, and can explain how each one began: direct outreach, referrals you cultivated, or events and networks you engaged with deliberately.
- Have taken at least one investor from a first conversation to a direct investment in a private round, and can walk us through the process.
- Understand what your investors invest in: stage, check size, sector, and the reasons they decline.

- Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

- Direct access to the co-founders and our investor team
- Close collaboration with our internal team
- Live mandates from your first week, and access to the opportunities that clear our diligence

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Product and Warehouse Management Systems)
description:
**Location:** Fully Remote (US Eastern time zone overlap)

**Engagement:** Contract (Full-time hours, ongoing engagement with long-term scope)

**Reports to:** CTO

Build software the people using it can point to. Here, one engineer writes the Postgres trigger and the screen the warehouse runs on that same day and gets to watch it work on the floor by the end of the week. Short loop, real impact, no layers in between.


**About The Many Company & Manymoons**

Most apparel overstock and retail returns in America end up in landfills or sitting idle in warehouses. At The Many Company, we build the circular technology and logistics that let global brands turn overstock and returns into sustainable profit centers. Through our consumer destination, Manymoons, and our live-selling operations, we give quality products a second life.

As a certified B Corp, our mission is to scale circular retail and prove that sustainability and business growth can work hand in hand. We sell across many platforms, including Shopify, Whatnot, TikTok, and eBay, and the engine behind our operations is a product and warehouse management system we built in-house — it powers our products data and core warehouse operations, including receiving, binning, picking, packing, returns, and inventory tracking end to end.

We're a small, distributed, high-trust engineering team. We value clear writing, practical experimentation, and building software that visibly empowers internal teams and outside partners.



**About the Role**

We're looking for a full-stack engineer to own our core product and warehouse management platform. Over the past year, we migrated our inventory system from Airtable onto a custom Postgres + Retool architecture. You'll lead the next phase: finishing the last stages of the migration, including finalizing the product management system, and growing the platform as our daily operating engine. The core is already in production and this is ownership of a living system, with plenty of new enhancements still ahead.

It's full-stack in the truest sense. You'll design relational schemas, build event-driven inventory ledgers and craft the operator interfaces that sit on top of them. We treat modern low-code builders like Retool and AI coding tools like Claude Code as leverage. They skip the routine boilerplate, so you can spend your attention on the interesting architecture problems. We'd rather you reach for the best tool for the job than do things the hard way for tradition's sake.




**Who You'll Work With**

A tight-knit team where technical decisions happen quickly, without bureaucratic layers:

- **Engineering Manager:** Reviews backend architecture, pairs on complex schema designs and helps unblock technical challenges.

- **Product Owner:** Defines operational logic, business goals and workflow priorities.
Warehouse Operations Team: You will work with the team at our New Jersey warehouse to understand core warehouse operations and build software that makes a material impact for the team’s daily workflows.

- **Product and Demand Team:** You will collaborate with this team to continuously improve our process for creating, enhancing, maintaining and syndicating products across our many sales platforms.  



**What You'll Own**

- **The core data engine.** A ~30-table Postgres schema, migrations, database functions, and an append-only event ledger that keeps inventory counts honest. No stored counts; everything is derived from events, and correctness here is the heart of the job.

- **The operator interfaces.** The Retool apps and custom UI our teams live in all day. You'll design and iterate on them with the people who use them.
The integration surface. The sync flows that keep everything in step, webhook ingest, marketplace integrations, and n8n automation pipelines.

- **Real-world problem solving.** When the shelf says 2 and the system says 3, you're the person who figures out which one is lying, and you’ll write the safe, targeted script to fix it.
AI-assisted development. Use Claude Code daily to write tests, draft runbooks, and move features faster. We actively support building with modern AI tooling.

- **Core tech stack**
Our stack, plus the modern ecosystem around it. We're looking for someone fluent across most of this. Not every box needs to be ticked but we’re looking for a broad understanding of how to navigate our current full-stack toolkit. 

- **Database & Data Layer:** PostgreSQL (Supabase, Drizzle ORM, triggers, RPCs, materialized views)
- **Backend Runtime:** TypeScript, Node.js, Deno, Hono
- **Frontend & Internal Tools:** Retool, React, Tailwind CSS
- **Integrations & Workflows:** Shopify Admin API (GraphQL), n8n, Fly.io, Webhooks
- **Collaboration Tools:** Slack, GitHub Issues, Notion, Google Workspace / Meet



**Helpful Skills & Experiences**

You don't need to tick every box. If you like building tools for real physical operations and enjoy working with data systems, we'd love to see your application.

- **Full-stack TypeScript.** Comfortable building production web apps end to end. Moving fluidly between React on the frontend and Node/Deno services on the backend and designing the APIs between them.

- **Relational-database instincts.** A solid grasp of SQL, table design, transactions, and data integrity. Experience with audit logs or event sourcing is a nice bonus not a prerequisite.
A practical tooling mindset. You happily combine custom code with platforms like Retool (or Appsmith / Superblocks) to get working software into users' hands quickly and you enjoy trying newer tools to see if they make the work better.

- **Operational curiosity.** You care how your code lands for real people. You measure success by how much smoother an operator's day gets, not by stars on a repo.
Clear written communication. You naturally include brief write-ups, decision records, or runbook updates alongside your pull requests. Our docs are load-bearing, and good writing is part of the craft here.

- **A solid track record of delivering impactful results to the business.** You develop solutions that provide real impact to internal teams. You understand pain points and how teams actually work in practice, so that software enables teams to be more successful. Strong history of strong performance for 3+ years. 


**How We Work**

- **High trust, high autonomy.** We care about outcomes and clear communication, not micromanagement. You own your work.

- **Experiment with modern tools.** We keep our stack current and we're happy for you to propose and try new tools, patterns, and libraries. Curiosity is a feature, not a distraction.

- **AI-first, humans accountable.** We build with Claude Code daily and expect you to. AI is leverage but a human stands behind every line that ships. If AI-assisted development isn't for you, this won't be a fit.

- **Practical discipline.** Light but rigorous: PR templates, migrations tested locally before staging and clear safety checks around database changes. The process exists because this system moves real inventory not for its own sake.

- **Remote-First with Real Connection:** You can work remotely day-to-day but we occasionally get together for team meetups, company gatherings and visits to our New Jersey office and warehouse.
- **Low-Meeting Culture:** We keep syncs on Google Meet brief and purposeful. We don't like unnecessary meetings and respect your focus time.


**Logistics & Compensation**

- **Engagement:** Contract engagement, full-time hours (40 hrs/week), remote, ongoing.
- **Compensation:** $55 - $75/hour (based on experience and skill set)
- **Location & Hours:** Fully remote with required overlap during US Eastern time zone warehouse hours (approx. 9 AM to 5 PM ET).
- **Environment:** All code, schemas and documentation are developed directly within company repositories from day one.



**What We Offer**

- **Real System Ownership:** You own an entire operational platform, not just isolated tickets in a queue. Your architectural decisions ship quickly and stay yours to maintain and evolve.

- **Modern Stack with Room to Experiment:** A clean toolkit with genuine freedom to propose and try new tools, patterns, and libraries. Evaluating better ways to build is treated as part of the job, not a distraction.

- **AI-First Workflow:** Claude Code and modern AI tooling are built directly into our daily routine, with our entire repository instrumented for AI-assisted development.

- **Work That Matters:** A certified B Corp mission to eliminate retail overstock, paired with a tight feedback loop from the code you write to the operators using it on the warehouse floor.
Small, High-Trust Team: Direct access to engineering leadership and product owners, with zero bureaucratic layers and fast decision-making.

- **Genuine Flexibility:** Fully remote work focused on outcomes rather than rigid hours (within US Eastern time zone overlap) so you can structure your workday productively.
Long-Term Stability: An ongoing contract engagement with continuous scope, not a short-term, one-and-done gig.

**Perks & Stipends** (Customizable depending on final package)

- **Product Discount:** Employee discount across the Manymoons marketplace.
- **Learning Budget:** Dedicated annual stipend for books, courses and technical conferences.
- **Setup Stipend:** Home office equipment, hardware and software tooling allowance.



**Hiring Process**

We want our hiring process to be straightforward, friendly, and respectful of your time:

- **Async Tech & Experience Screening:** A quick review of your application, GitHub/work samples and practical exercise and questions about your database, TypeScript background.

- **Initial Conversation (30 min):** A relaxed chat on Google Meet to get to know each other, discuss your background and answer your questions about the team.
- **Technical & Architecture Discussion and Assessment (1 hr):** A conversation with our Engineering Manager covering system design, database modeling and full-stack TypeScript.

- **Product Systems Chat (30 min):** A conversation with our Sr. Product Systems Architect to discuss operational requirements, system workflows and mutual team alignment.

- **Final Logistics Chat (30 min):** A brief wrap-up call to confirm contract details, hourly rate, and your start date.

At The Many Company we value different perspectives and experiences. If your background is close to what we've described even if it's not an exact match, please reach out. We'd rather hear from you than not.
