title: Territory Partner (Field Sales)
description:
# **The Role**

Omada AI is the AI marketing platform built for small businesses — and we grow the old-fashioned way: in person, face to face, business by business. Territory Partners are the front line of that motion.

This is a true field sales role. You'll walk into local businesses, pitch owners directly, and get them live on Omada the same day. You find your own prospects, build your own pipeline, and close your own deals. There's no cold-call center behind you and no calendar of pre-booked meetings waiting when you log in — the TPs who win here are the ones who don't need one.

If you've done outside sales before and you know the feeling of turning an empty morning into three signed customers by dinner, keep reading.

# **What You'll Do**

- **Prospect your territory relentlessly.** Identify, approach, and pitch local SMBs — walk-ins, door pulls, referrals, local networking, whatever works. You own your pipeline end to end.
- **Sell in person.** Pitch business owners face to face and get them started in a live free trial on the spot — we don't do demos or demo accounts. You build their system on their real business, with their real content, in front of them.
- **Run the full sales cycle.** From first conversation through trial activation to paid conversion, the deal is yours.
- **Master the product fast.** Omada is straightforward to learn and pitch — most reps are confidently selling within their first day or two. The hard part isn't the product; it's the hustle. That's why we hire for the hustle.
- **Report and improve daily.** Track your activity, present your accounts in team reviews, and sharpen your close rate week over week.

# **How We Set You Up to Win**

- **Two-week apprenticeship.** You start paired with a veteran Territory Partner: shadow their pitches, then prospect together, then close your own deals with their help (with commission split during the ramp). No classroom fluff — you learn this job by doing this job next to someone who's great at it.
- **Proving Ground.** Our performance-gated ramp structure rewards producers quickly. Hit your numbers and your earnings and territory opportunities grow with you.
- **A real career ladder.** TP → Vanguard → City Captain → State Director → Regional Director → Country Manager. We promote from the field, full stop.
- **A product that sells.** SMB owners need marketing help, most can't afford an agency, and Omada does the work of one for a fraction of the price. When you get in front of the right owner, this sells.

# **Who We're Looking For**

**Required:**

- Proven field / outside sales experience — you've sold face to face before (D2D, B2B field, territory sales, retail energy/telecom/payments, or similar) and you have the numbers to show for it
- Demonstrated self-prospecting ability — you've built your own pipeline from zero and you're comfortable walking into a business cold
- Closer's mentality — you ask for the business, handle objections in the moment, and don't leave without a next step
- Self-managed and disciplined — you run your day like a business owner, because as a 1099 contractor, you are one
- Reliable transportation and the ability to work your territory in person daily

**You'll thrive here if:**

- You'd rather be paid for what you produce than for showing up
- You like small business owners and can talk to a plumber, a salon owner, and a realtor in the same afternoon
- You're energized (not intimidated) by rejection volume
- You want a shot at building and leading a market, not just working one

**This is not for you if:**

- You're looking for a role where meetings are booked for you
- You need warm leads handed over to get going
- You've only sold over the phone or by email and aren't sure about face-to-face

# **Compensation**

Commission-based with performance-gated ramp compensation through our Proving Ground structure. Top producers earn well above typical field sales roles — your income is a direct function of your production. Full details shared during the interview process.

# **About Omada AI**

Omada AI is a Seattle-headquartered AI marketing platform for small businesses, backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital. We're growing fast across the US and promoting our field leaders as we go.

**Ready to own a territory?** Apply now — our hiring process moves quickly, including a short async video interview and a conversation with a field leader in your region.

Human Computer Lab is a research lab building character robots that feel alive and responsive. Our first robot, LeLamp, explores a new category of consumer robotics where everyday objects become interactive and help us reshape our attachment to technology.

Our goal is to push the frontier of human-robot interaction by making technology more legible, emotionally intuitive, and human-centered. We are building the foundation for a new generation of robots designed for everyday environments.


**What to Expect**
The Chief of Staff Intern works directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff during one of the highest-leverage stretches in the company's life — the run-up to our first ~1,000-unit production run. This is not a shadowing internship. You will own real workstreams: hiring pipeline hygiene, investor and partner communication drafts, vendor and manufacturing coordination, event and content execution. *Hiring*

*Ops and vendor coordination*

*Growth and content*

* Whatever the company needs that week. At this size, scope moves fast.

 We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. title: Fractional Chief of Staff
description:
**About the job**

We are seeking a hands-on, highly organized Fractional Chief of Staff to help run the weekly operations of a fast-growing sustainability and cost analytics firm. This person will work closely with the CEO and Product and Research Teams. The Fractional Chief of Staff will keep the CEO focused on key aspects of growing and developing the business and product, help manage the day-to-day operations and projects deadlines and requirements. 

The ideal candidate will bring order and follow-through to a small, fast-moving team: making sure the trains run on time, that commitments are met, and that projects are delivered on schedule and on budget. We are seeking a smart, pragmatic operator with strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a passion for climate solutions. Project skills, emotional intelligence, and business- and technical-savvy are all priorities for this position. 

**Who We Are**

Boundless Impact Research & Analytics provides precise life cycle and techno-economic impact data for advanced technology companies, sustainable brands, and investors. Our analytics validate and differentiate sustainable products, reduce investment risk, and support credible reporting. Boundless blends science-based impact analysis, industry-specific benchmarks, and AI-driven data to deliver the insights companies need to prove their impact and thrive in the market. 

Boundless has completed assessments of dozens of cleantech products and projects —ranging from renewable energy, circular economy, HVAC and disinfection technologies, bioenergy and bioproducts, and innovative water and wastewater technologies. The resulting company reports frequently influenced investor decisions. 

**Responsibilities **

**Business Operations and Management **
* Ensure research projects are delivered on budget and schedule including accurate time tracking, proper utilization of resources, and high-quality documentation. 
* Support Management and Research and Product Teams with ongoing resource planning and allocation, adjusting goals and expectations with project tracker, and managing budget. 
* Onboard and manage vendors and experts. Manage contracts to ensure delivery and quality of services are within established terms. 
* Execute administrative processes that enable organizational efficiency, profitability, and growth. 
* Maintain robust contracts management and reporting system; ensure that the contract billing and collection schedule is adhered to and that financial data and cash flow are consistent and support operational requirements 
* Track and manage budget, forecasting. Provide financial reporting for Boundless management as well as external stakeholders. 
* Establish and maintain an operating cadence—regular check-ins, clear priorities, and action tracking—that keeps the team aligned and accountable. Give the CEO concise, regular visibility into status, progress, and risks. 
* Create and maintain systems, processes, and SOPs as decided with the CEO to streamline operations and capture institutional knowledge. 
* Review, redline, and edit customer and partner agreements (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, and partnership and vendor contracts), identifying risks and non-standard terms, proposing suggested edits for the CEO's review, and coordinating with outside counsel when specialized legal review is needed. 
* Administer and coordinate contracts end-to-end—client, vendor, and partner—ensuring that deliverables, terms, and timelines are met. 
* Track and manage budgets and forecasting; provide financial reporting for Boundless’ management, research projects, and investors.

**Technical Systems, Processes & Administration **
* Help answer inbound technical and security requests—e.g., customer IT/security risk assessments and vendor technical questionnaires.Triage requests, ask the right questions internally, pull in the product/tech team, and assemble a complete response. 
* Maintain and oversee changes to the company's operational tool stack (e.g., HubSpot); manage user onboarding and offboarding and access across business platforms. 
* Oversee upgrades in technical systems, software, and hardware, and train team members on new system functionality. 
* Help establish and maintain systems and processes to streamline operations. 
* Maintain accurate, confidential files and data records. 

**Human Resources **
* Assist with hiring needs including expansion of research team, tech support and an ongoing class of interns 
* Administer all HR functions including full talent acquisition cycle, employee relations, data management, payroll, benefits planning and administration, visa sponsorship, compensation, and performance management 
* Collaborate with onboarding and transitioning team members, managing user onboarding onto business platforms - e.g., HubSpot, ClickUp, JustWorks 

**Qualifications**

* 5–7+ years of operations and/or program management, ideally at a fast-growing startup, scale-up, or small business. 
* Track record of running day-to-day operations for a small team and keeping projects on time and on budget. 
* Demonstrable experience supporting scalable, efficient processes that bring structure to a rapidly growing environment. 
* Strong contract administration and financial-operations skills: budgets, forecasting, and reviewing, redlining, and editing customer and partner contracts. Experience with government contracts (FAR / DCAA-aware processes) is a plus. 
* Ability to understand company financial projections and costs, and to interpret and analyze project budgets and revenue models. 
* Excellent people-coordination skills—able to influence without managing, drive accountability, and foster a collaborative, results-oriented environment. 
* Comfortable working independently with little direction, exercising sound judgment and discretion with highly confidential information. 
* Strong technology skills and an entrepreneurial attitude; able to learn new tools and applications quickly. Advanced MS Office and/or Google Workspace skills. 
* Technically savvy—comfortable engaging with IT, technical, and systems topics; able to interpret requests such as IT risk and security assessments, ask the right internal questions, and coordinate a strong response without being the subject-matter expert. 
* Superior written and verbal communication. 
* Personal integrity and a team-first mindset. 
* Passion for environmental data and analytics, and for building a company that makes the world a better place. 
* Bachelor's degree from a well-respected accredited college or university, or equivalent experience. 

This is a flexible, high-impact role for an experienced operator who is curious about the world of climate and venture, and who thrives on bringing order to a fast-growing firm. You must be: 
* Highly organized, with excellent judgment as well as strong project-management and problem-solving skills. 
* Able to step into an unstructured world and provide that structure effectively. 
* An amazing multitasker with laser focus, highly intuitive, and able to anticipate needs. 
* Able to see the big picture clearly and understand the long-term goals of the business. 
* Friendly and professional in demeanor, with exceptional interpersonal skills. 
* Able to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels. 
* Someone who enjoys opportunities to pitch in and help when necessary, even if it means shuffling your own priorities on the fly and stepping outside your job description. 

**About the Position**

This is a fractional, contract (1099) position—approximately 2-3 days per week—performed remotely, with occasional availability in New York as needed. Compensation is commensurate with experience. Please send your resume, rate and availability, and a short letter of interest to: jobs@boundlessimpact.net

title: Research Intern
description:
**About Sanctory ** 

At Sanctory, we are on a continuous quest to source the finest products from every corner of the world. Our mission is to provide these products to our patrons in their purest, natural, and most authentic form. Our partners in this journey—winemakers, farmers, and artisans—craft their products with the highest skills and traditions, fearlessly expressing their craft without bowing to market demands. Sanctory is a space for this beautiful interaction between our like-minded customers and these dedicated producers. 

 

**Position Overview **

Sanctory is seeking a highly motivated Research Intern to join our team. This role is ideal for someone curious about food systems, agriculture, and the stories behind what we grow and make. As a Research Intern, you will work closely with our marketing, brand, and product teams to build the knowledge base that informs Sanctory's decisions, from understanding our producers and their craft to identifying market opportunities and consumer needs. Your role will involve gathering, analyzing, and synthesizing information into clear insights that shape our products, campaigns, and partnerships. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in market research, consumer insights, and strategic analysis for a company rooted in heritage and authenticity. 

**Key Responsibilities: **

* Plan and conduct primary and secondary research on market trends, consumer behavior, and the food, agriculture, and wellness landscape. 
* Research the origins, practices, and heritage behind Sanctory's products, from farm to table, to support accurate and compelling brand and product narratives. 
* Support the development of research briefs, reports, and presentations aligned with campaigns, product launches, and seasonal moments. 
* Collaborate with the marketing, brand, and product teams to turn research findings into actionable recommendations. 
* Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, regulatory updates, and shifts in consumer preferences to inform business decisions. 
* Collect, organize, and analyze data (surveys, customer feedback, social listening, sales and engagement metrics) to identify patterns and insights. 
* Conduct customer and community research through surveys, interviews, and review analysis to understand what resonates with our audience. 
* Identify and evaluate potential collaborators, suppliers, partners, and industry experts aligned with Sanctory's values. 

**What We're Looking For: **

* A strong interest in market research, business, economics, agriculture, food science, communications, or a related field. 
* A naturally curious and analytical thinker with the ability to turn complex information into clear, relatable insights. 
* Basic understanding of data and presentation tools such as Excel or Google Sheets, Google Forms, Canva, PowerPoint, or similar (advanced skills are not mandatory, but a plus). 
* Strong writing and synthesis skills, with an eye for structure, accuracy, and audience. 
* Good understanding of current consumer, food, and wellness trends and what drives purchasing decisions. 
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with excellent attention to detail and source verification. 
* A portfolio or examples of past work (academic, personal, or professional), such as research papers, reports, case studies, or presentations, demonstrating analytical thinking and clarity.

title: Founder's Office Intern (Remote) GrantSnap · Part-time Internship · India (Remote)
description:
**About GrantSnap**
GrantSnap is an AI-powered Chrome extension that helps startups find and apply to grants, accelerators, and funding programs. We're early and moving fast. This isn't a structured corporate internship — it's a front-row seat to how a product gets built, sold, and scaled from zero.

**The Role**
This role doesn't have a clean job description. That's the point.
You'll work directly with the founder across whatever needs to happen — some days that's talking to users, some days that's breaking the product on purpose, some days that's figuring out why a landing page isn't converting. You'll context-switch fast, own things end-to-end, and be expected to think, not just execute.
If you need a structured task list every morning, this isn't the role for you.

**What You'll Actually Do**

1. Talk to existing users — understand how they use GrantSnap, what's frustrating them, what they wish existed
2. Manage user accounts and make sure people are getting value from the product
3. Help users actually get more out of GrantSnap — show them features, walk them through use cases, improve their workflow
4. Find bugs before users do. Break things. Document what you find.
5. Test the end-to-end user experience and flag anything that feels off
6. Build and iterate on landing pages — copy, layout, basic design
7. Reach out to prospects and follow up with warm leads
8. Sit in on or review sales and user calls and tell us what patterns you're seeing
9. Do the research no one else has time to do — competitors, strategies, opportunities
10. Contribute to long-term thinking on product, growth, and positioning when you've earned the context


**What We're Looking For**

1. Genuinely curious about how early-stage products get built
2. Can write clearly — emails, messages, notes, briefs, whatever the situation needs
3. Comfortable figuring things out without being told exactly how
4. Some familiarity with tools — Notion, Figma, basic web stuff, or a willingness to learn fast
5. Bonus: you've used a SaaS product and thought about why it works or doesn't
6. Bonus: you've done any kind of user-facing work — support, community, sales, onboarding

No specific degree required. No specific major. We care about how you think.

**Compensation**

This is a Paid Role 


**What You'll Get**

Direct access to the founder — you'll see every decision being made and why
Real ownership, not busywork
Experience across product, growth, sales, and strategy in one role
A honest reference if you do good work


**To Apply**
Tell us about something you fixed, improved, or figured out — at a job, a college project, or just in your own life. What was broken, what did you do, what happened? Keep it under 200 words.
Same rule as always: if it sounds like AI wrote it, it's a reject.

title: Property Acquisition & Leasing Executive
description:
Location: Bengaluru
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience: 1–3 years preferred
Reporting to: Founder

About the Role
We are looking for a proactive and digitally savvy Property Acquisition & Leasing Executive to work closely with the Founder in growing our property management business.
The role will have two key responsibilities:
1.	Onboarding new properties into our managed-property portfolio.
2.	Marketing and leasing available properties by generating tenant enquiries through property portals, social media, WhatsApp, community networks and other relevant channels.
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, working independently and figuring out how to generate results rather than simply following a fixed process.

Key Responsibilities
1. Property Onboarding
•	Work closely with the Founder to onboard new properties into the portfolio.
•	Collect and maintain complete property information, including rent, deposit, availability, furnishing, amenities, photographs and other details.
•	Coordinate property visits, photography and creation of marketing material.
•	Ensure every property is properly documented and ready for marketing.
•	Maintain an accurate and up-to-date inventory of available and occupied properties.

2. Rental Marketing & Lead Generation
•	Create and publish attractive property listings across relevant property portals and marketplaces.
•	Promote properties through WhatsApp, social media, apartment/community groups and other relevant channels.
•	Identify new platforms and creative ways to generate tenant enquiries.
•	Regularly refresh listings, photographs, descriptions and pricing to maximise visibility.
•	Track which channels generate enquiries and continuously improve the marketing approach.

3. Tenant Lead Management
•	Respond promptly to tenant enquiries through calls, WhatsApp and online platforms.
•	Understand tenant requirements and recommend suitable properties.
•	Share property details, photographs, videos and other relevant information.
•	Maintain a structured database of enquiries and follow-ups.
•	Follow up consistently with prospective tenants until the lead is closed or lost.

4. Property Visits & Leasing
•	Coordinate and schedule property visits with prospective tenants.
•	Conduct or coordinate property viewings where required.
•	Address basic tenant queries and coordinate with owners when necessary.
•	Support rent and deposit negotiations between owners and prospective tenants.
•	Coordinate documentation and other activities required to complete the rental transaction.
•	Ensure a smooth tenant move-in experience.

5. New Property Acquisition
•	Identify potential property owners who may require professional property management.
•	Generate leads through local networks, online channels, referrals, communities and other sources.
•	Qualify prospective property owners and understand their requirements.
•	Coordinate property assessments and meetings with the Founder.
•	Follow up with prospective owners and help convert them into managed properties.

What We're Looking For
•	1–3 years of experience in real estate, property management, rentals, sales, hospitality, customer acquisition or a similar role.
•	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
•	Comfortable making calls and following up with customers.
•	Strong interest in digital marketing and online lead generation.
•	Comfortable using property portals, WhatsApp, Google Workspace and social media.
•	Comfortable working directly with the Founder and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities.
•	Willingness to travel locally for property visits when required.

What Success Looks Like
In this role, success will be measured by your ability to:
•	Keep all available properties actively and effectively marketed.
•	Generate a consistent flow of qualified tenant enquiries.
•	Convert enquiries into property visits and rentals.
•	Minimise vacancy periods.
•	Maintain excellent follow-up discipline.
•	Generate new property-owner leads.

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to work closely with the Founder and play a direct role in building and scaling a growing property-management business.
You will have significant ownership of the property acquisition, marketing and leasing engine, rather than being limited to routine administrative property-management tasks.
If you are entrepreneurial, organised, good with people and comfortable using digital tools, do apply.

title: AI/ML Research Engineer
description:
VectorStackAI · Applied research that ships as product.

Full-time · Amsterdam or remote (Netherlands preferred) · Competitive salary, set by experience

## Who we are

VectorStackAI is a research-led team building vertically integrated GenAI products for legal and finance. We tune the whole stack, embeddings, retrieval, rerankers, and agent runtimes, against the metric that actually ships, and we beat public leaderboards in our domains along the way. We were founded by an ex-Apple ML and ex-Cerebras Principal Research Scientist.

## The role

We are hiring our first Research Engineers, and this is one posting on purpose: we care more about the shape of the person than the title. You can do real applied research (form a hypothesis, read the literature, design the experiment, invent the objective) and you can ship the result into production against a hard metric. If you only do one of those two well, this is not the role. If you do both, the seniority sorts itself out in conversation.

You own problems the whole way: from a target metric to a feature running in production. And because we build our reputation in public, you write about what you find.

## What you'll work on

The work spans the full stack, and the mix shifts with whatever moves the metric. Recent and near-term problems include:

- Fine-tuning LLMs with LoRA, QLoRA, and full fine-tunes for domain accuracy in legal and finance.
- Training best-in-class domain embedding models and rerankers, and beating public leaderboards in our domains.
- Model compression: distillation, pruning, and quantization to hold accuracy while cutting latency and cost.
- Tuning agentic harnesses end to end (our AgentGrad line): turning an agent runtime into something you can genuinely optimize against a KPI.
- Building retrieval stacks (PreciseSearch): hybrid search, index design, and the full pipeline tuned together rather than one component at a time.
- Frontier bets, for the person who wants to push there. One example: distilling diffusion models toward autoregressive-level capability.

You will not do all of these. You go deep on the ones that move the number in front of you.

## What we're looking for

- Genuine applied-research ability. You take a vague target and a stack of papers and produce a method that works, not just a re-implementation.
- Strong ML engineering. You write clean, fast PyTorch, you profile before you optimize, and you train and serve models without hand-holding.
- Fluency with modern fine-tuning and efficiency techniques (LoRA, distillation, quantization, pruning), or the ability to get there fast.
- You measure everything, you are suspicious of leaderboard numbers, and you know why a single-component benchmark can lie.
- You can write. A result you cannot explain to a reader is half a result.
- Ownership. Small team, high trust, you drive problems to done.
- Communication that holds up across a remote team. Tight collaboration matters to us more than being in one room.

## Nice to have

- Publications, strong technical writing, open-source models or libraries, or competitive leaderboard entries.
- Depth in legal, finance, or another regulated domain.
- Production experience with agent frameworks or RAG systems.
- Large-scale or hardware-aware training and inference optimization.

## How we work

We are small, senior, and research-led. Your research lands as features in our own vertically integrated products, in production. The wins you produce become public writing that builds the company. If you want a pure lab with no shipping, or pure engineering with no research, we are not the fit. If you want the loop where research, product, and reputation are the same motion, that is exactly what we are.

## Who you'll work with

You will work directly with the founder: a PhD from INRIA, then four years at Apple as a Senior ML Research Scientist shipping machine learning end to end across products, then Principal Research Scientist at Cerebras working on hardware-aware optimization of large-scale ML. It adds up to a decade learning the same lesson, the one this role is built on: vertical integration beats tuning and competing one layer at a time. This is a small, senior team, so you ship alongside that experience directly, not through three layers of management.

## To apply

Email shreyas@vectorstack.ai with something real: a paper, a repo, a benchmark you beat, a model you compressed, a writeup you are proud of. Tell us the metric you moved and how you moved it. Skip the generic cover letter.

title: Outbound Growth Marketer
description:
**HelplineSoftware.com**

# Outbound Email Marketer

## **Compensation: \$1,050–\$1,450/month**

## **Location: 100% Remote**

## **Hours: 6:00 AM–3:00 PM CST**

# Role Overview

We’re hiring an Outbound Email Marketer to book qualified sales meetings through cold email. Your job is to learn our ideal customer profile (ICP), find the right prospects, test messages, and improve campaigns quickly based on what you learn.

You’ll own email outbound from targeting and prospect lists through campaign execution, replies, follow-up, and meeting booking. Success means a consistent flow of meetings with relevant buyers at organizations that fit our ICP and have a problem Helpline Software can help solve.

The three things we care about most:

1. Learn our ICP: understand which organizations need us, who owns the problem, and what makes them likely to buy.  
2. Test and learn quickly: try clear messaging ideas, learn from responses, and improve the next campaign.  
3. Book qualified meetings: turn email conversations with the right prospects into sales meetings.

## **What You'll Do**

* Learn our product and ICP from customer conversations, sales feedback, and prospect research. Refine your understanding as you run campaigns.  
* Build or source targeted prospect lists, identify the right buyers, and group them by the problem your email will address.  
* Write and test concise cold emails and follow-up sequences, including different subject lines, problem statements, offers, and calls to action.  
* Launch and manage email campaigns, monitor delivery and bounces, and keep outreach relevant to each audience.  
* Review replies and meeting results, identify what worked and why, and quickly adjust targeting or messaging for the next test.  
* Manage replies and follow-up, qualify interested prospects against our ICP, and book meetings with the sales team.

### 

### You write cold emails that get the right people interested.

You can explain a relevant problem in plain English and give a busy buyer a clear reason to reply. Your emails are specific, credible, and concise, with an angle that fits the prospect.

### You test, learn, and improve quickly.

You learn how our buyers work, launch focused tests, and use replies and sales feedback to improve. You can explain what you tried, what you learned, and what you will change next.

### You measure success by qualified meetings.

You track positive replies, meetings booked and held, and whether those meetings fit our ICP. You use delivery and bounce rates to spot sending issues, and compare results across audiences and messages to decide what to improve or scale.

## **Requirements**

* Strong written English and the ability to write concise, credible cold emails that lead to qualified ICP meetings.  
* Ability to learn our ICP quickly and improve targeting and messaging through testing and feedback.

 Proficiency in using essential communication tools like Slack, Google Workspace, and CRM platforms.

**4. Bengaluru, India. Field-based across Bengaluru and surrounding regions, with in-person meetings and events.**

**ENGAGEMENT TYPE: Commission-only, independent consultant. Flexible hours, fully results-
driven**.

**COMMISSION Up to 30% of first-year contract value on deals you close in your first 12
months, roughly double the industry standard. Industry-standard rates apply
thereafter.**

**EXPERIENCE 3+ years in B2B enterprise sales, business development or procurement,
with an active network of procurement leaders. **

**01 ABOUT HOLMES AI**

Holmes is an AI-native procurement intelligence and orchestration platform. It goes past categorising spend: it tells a company where its money is going wrong, what to do about it, and then runs the agentic workflows to act, from sourcing and supplier discovery to negotiation, contracting and settlement.

The problem is enormous. The Fortune 2000 alone put $45 to 50 trillion into third-party spend, and an estimated 9 to 11% of it leaks away through inefficient contracting, maverick spend and weak analytics. Legacy procurement software has not fixed this: long deployments, low adoption and processes that are still mostly manual. Holmes deploys in days, is enterprise-ready (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA), and is the only procurement AI that publishes its accuracy every month.

We started go-to-market in May 2026 from a standing start. Since then, procurement, finance and private equity teams across financial services, healthcare, pharma, logistics, real estate and manufacturing have taken demos, asked for follow-ons and started contracting. The product is proven. What we need now is reach.

**02  ROLE PURPOSE**

You will be one of the first people outside the founding team to take Holmes to market in India, with a focus on the city's strongest sectors: banking and financial services, pharma, conglomerates, FMCG and media. Your job is simple to state and hard to do well: get Holmes in front of procurement leaders, fast, and help turn those conversations into signed customers.

This is not a seat on a scripted outbound floor. We are looking for people who already have relationships with Chief Procurement Officers, VPs and Directors of Procurement, sourcing leads and finance leaders at small, mid-sized and large enterprises, and who can open doors with a phone call rather than a sequence. The strongest candidates will not stop at the meeting; they will stay with the deal through to signature, in person where it helps.

**03  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Open Doors and Book Meetings, Starting Now**
1. Activate your existing network of procurement and finance leaders and set up qualified discovery meetings and demos from your first weeks.
2. Tell the Holmes story with confidence: the value leakage problem, what makes Holmes different, and the measurable outcomes it delivers.
3. Qualify opportunities on real need, spend, urgency and decision-making structure, so the team's time goes to deals that can close.
4. Work across company sizes, from fast-growing mid-market firms to India's largest enterprises, multinationals' India operations, global capability centres and private equity portfolios.

**B. Find Leads Where Others Don't Look**
1. Go beyond the standard playbook of Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and cold sequences. Bring your own ideas for reaching buyers.
2. Use channels such as procurement communities, CPO roundtables, industry associations, consultants and advisors, PE operating partners, alumni networks and referrals from satisfied contacts.
3. Spot trigger events that create buying moments: new CPO appointments, acquisitions, cost-reduction programmes, ERP migrations and supplier disruptions.
4. Test new approaches quickly, measure what works, and share the winning plays with the team.

**C. Be in the Room and Drive to Close**
1. Meet prospects in person in your region: offices, dinners, local procurement forums and industry events across the city.
2. Represent Holmes at CPO roundtables, industry chamber events and procurement leadership summits, and turn event conversations into pipeline.
3. Stay involved after the first meeting: coordinate follow-ups, pilots and stakeholder alignment with the founders, and help carry deals through to signed contracts.

**D. Shape the Go-to-Market**
1. Bring back what you hear in the field: objections, competitor mentions, pricing signals and unmet needs.
2. Help sharpen our messaging, target lists and ideal customer profile by segment and industry.
3. Keep pipeline, activity and deal status up to date so the whole team can see what is moving.

**04  SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

1. **Network:** real, warm relationships with procurement leaders and teams, people who take your call.
2. **Hustle:** a bias for action. You would rather book the meeting today than plan it for next week.
3. **Creativity:** you find unconventional routes to buyers and enjoy inventing new plays.
4. **Credibility:** comfortable in a room with a CPO or CFO. You speak the language of spend, savings, suppliers and risk.
5. **Ownership:** you treat pipeline as your own business, follow through relentlessly and close loops.
6. **Resilience:** you stay positive through long enterprise cycles and the rejections that come with them.
7. **Languages:** excellent written and spoken English; working knowledge of Hindi and Marathi is an advantage.
8. **Curiosity:** genuine interest in AI and how it is changing procurement and finance.

**05  QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

1. 3+ years in B2B enterprise sales, SDR, BDR, account executive or business development roles, ideally selling software or services into procurement, finance or operations. We value network and results over years on a CV.
2. Alternatively, a background inside procurement, sourcing or procurement consulting, with a desire to move into sales.
3. A demonstrable network of procurement decision-makers in companies across specified locations. 
4. A track record of generating pipeline and contributing to closed deals. Closing experience is a strong plus.
5. Based in specified locations and willing to travel across the city and to key industry events.
6. Familiarity with procurement technology such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Oracle Procurement or Jaggaer is helpful but not required.

**06  HOW YOU WILL EARN**
Holmes is an early-stage company, and we have chosen to put our resources where they create the most value: into the people who bring customers in. This role is commission-only, with no fixed salary. In return, we are offering a commission rate well above what the market pays.

**Commission rate**
Up to 30% of first-year contract value on deals you bring in, around twice the industry standard.

**Launch-year offer**
The enhanced rate applies to deals closed in your first 12 months with Holmes. After that, commission moves to industry-standard rates.

**What drives your share**
The more of the deal you own, from first introduction through meetings, pilot and signature, the closer you get to the full 30%.

**When you are paid**
As the customer pays. No cap on the number of deals or total earnings.

**Deal size**
Our enterprise contracts are substantial, so a single closed deal can be a significant payout.

**Flexibility**
You set your schedule and approach. We care about outcomes, not hours.

**Why this model**

We would rather share generously with the people who grow Holmes than spend on overhead. The enhanced launch-year rate is our thank-you to the people who take an early bet on Holmes, and we want that bet to pay off for you.
Exact commission terms, eligible deals and payment timing are set out in a written agreement before you start.

**07  WHY JOIN HOLMES NOW**

Holmes is at the start of a big journey, and the people who join now will shape how it grows. You will not be one of hundreds of reps working a territory someone else built. You will be one of the first voices of a company that is rewriting how enterprises buy.

1. **A product that wins:** ranked first in a Fortune 50 evaluation against vendors that have raised hundreds of millions. You are selling something that holds up in the room.
2. **A market that is ready:** procurement leaders are under pressure to deliver savings and adopt AI, and legacy tools have let them down. The timing is right.
3. **Earn like an owner:** around double the industry-standard commission on every deal you close in your first year, with no cap, in a market where contracts are large.
4. **Build the playbook:** the prospecting plays, stories and relationships you create now become how Holmes sells for years.
5. **A path to lead:** as Holmes builds out its presence in India, early team members who deliver will be first in line to lead their city, region or sector.

title: US Customs Specialist (Europe)
description:
***Location:** Fully remote in Europe*

***Working Hours:** Mon - Fri, 9AM - 6PM*

## **About Nivoda 🚀**

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

## **Our Mission 🎯**

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

## **About the Role 🤔**

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.

It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.

## **What will you be doing? 😎**

- Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform
- Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product
- Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework
- Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found
- Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately
- Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission
- Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane
- Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping
- Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India)
- Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance

## **What do we need from you? 💪**

- Proven experience in global trade compliance or customs operations, with a track record on US, UK, EU import/export specifically
- Extensive US import-export experience is required.
- Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume
- Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims
- Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy
- Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook
- Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally
- Strong stakeholder management skills, coordinating external brokers/carriers/manufacturers and internal Legal, Fulfilment, and Ops teams
- A commercial mindset, you connect compliance work back to cost savings and business impact

## **Nice to have ✨**

- Experience with free trade agreements and preferential duty schemes (e.g. India–UK, EU–UK, EU–India, UAE–India)
- Experience in jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, or other high-value/luxury goods logistics
- Experience with Indian export processes
- Background in a fast-scaling, international e-commerce or marketplace business

## **Our culture and what we offer 😉**

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

## **Our current benefits**

🕰️ Flexible working and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

## **Equal Opportunity**

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts - don't let it stop you. We are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

*Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international. We kindly ask you to submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.*

## **Not quite the right fit?**

If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we'd encourage you to join our [_Nivoda Talent Pool_](https://nivoda.net/talent-pool) so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.

location: Coimbatore; Bengaluru; Shanghai; Manila; Tokyo; Seoul; Osaka; Taipei; Shenzhen; Pune; Hyderabad; Chandigarh; Chennai; Hangzhou; Bangkok; Bandung; Guangzhou; Mumbai; Beijing; Davao City; Hanoi; Mangaluru; Cebu City; Bhubaneswar; Dumaguete; Noida; Ho Chi Minh City; Can Tho; Penang; New Delhi; Jakarta; Hong Kong; Kuala Lumpur; Busan; Yogyakarta; Mysuru; Da Nang; Surabaya; Singapore; Gurugram
description:
I’m building Whitebrinjal, an enterprise high tech market network focused on the journey from technology discovery to enterprise adoption.

**I’m looking for a co-founder to take ownership of technology and platform execution and take Whitebrinjal from its current product foundation to a working MVP and beyond.**

This is a **founder level opportunity**, not a CTO-for-hire role, engineering management role, fractional position or technology advisory role.

Whitebrinjal is currently **pre MVP, pre revenue and pre institutional funding
There is no initial cash compensation. This is a full-time, equity-only founder opportunity**

Where we are today
This is not a blank-sheet idea.
We already have a substantial product foundation with **50+ product modules and flows**, along with the frontend, product designs and core UX direction.
The immediate mission is to take what exists and **turn it into a robust, working MVP**.
You will own the backend, system architecture, APIs, data layer, integrations, infrastructure, security and the technical decisions required to make the product real and scalable.

What you will own
**MVP → Platform**
Take the existing frontend and product foundation through backend completion, integration, deployment and MVP launch.
**Architecture**
Define the technical architecture and make the right tradeoffs between speed, quality, scalability and maintainability.
**Backend & APIs**
Build the services, business logic, APIs, workflows, integrations and data layer behind the product.
**AI & Intelligence**
Determine where AI, ML, generative AI, matching, recommendation and agentic workflows can create genuine product leverage.
**Cloud, Infrastructure & Security**
Build the foundations for reliability, scalability, observability, identity, access control, data protection and enterprise readiness.
**Engineering**
Write and review critical code, establish engineering standards and eventually build the engineering team.

This is a builder role
I’m not looking for someone who only manages engineers.
At this stage, you will build.
You should be able to move from product problem → architecture → code → working system.
If something is missing, build it.
If something is wrong, fix it.
If something does not need to be built yet, say so.
**Think. Decide. Build**

Who I’m looking for
You may have come from a high growth technology company, product company, AI company, infrastructure company, enterprise software company, startup or have built your own products.
Experience at companies such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Apple, Adobe, Salesforce, Uber, Stripe, Atlassian, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Anthropic, Databricks, Flipkart, Razorpay, PhonePe, Freshworks, Postman, BrowserStack or another strong technology company can be relevant.
But pedigree matters less than what you have actually built.
I want someone who has **shipped real products** and can own technology end to end.
Someone strong in backend and system architecture.
Someone comfortable across full stack systems.
Someone who understands cloud, APIs, databases, distributed systems and security.
Someone who understands AI beyond simply calling an LLM API.
Someone who can work directly with a founder on product and technical decisions.
Someone who can eventually build and lead an exceptional engineering organisation.
A big company title is not enough. A long technology list is not enough. I need someone who can turn technical judgment into working product.

The founder risk
Whitebrinjal is pre revenue and pre funded.
There is no initial salary.
The opportunity is meaningful founder equity and the chance to build from an already developed product foundation.
This is not a side project or part-time advisory opportunity.
I’m looking for someone who can commit full time without initial salary and has the personal runway, conviction and appetite for uncertainty to make that decision responsibly.
You should be comfortable choosing ownership and long term upside over a conventional salary at this stage.
The exact equity structure will depend on the person, commitment and scope of responsibility.

Why Whitebrinjal
Enterprise technology adoption is fragmented.
The buyer may not know what to ask. Stakeholders may not be aligned. Technology may not be properly evaluated. The business case may not be clear. Procurement may not know how to structure the engagement.
Whitebrinjal is building the network around how enterprise technology **gets discovered, evaluated, commercialized and ultimately adopted.**
The long term opportunity is:
**Market Network → Workflow → Intelligence → Enterprise Platform**
The more the network grows, the more structured data it creates. The more intelligence the platform develops, the more valuable the network becomes.

The founder opportunity
I’m building the vision, product and market thesis.
The product foundation, frontend and design direction are already substantially developed.
I want a co-founder who will take the same level of ownership of technology, platform and engineering execution.
Your immediate mission is simple:
**Complete the backend. Connect the system. Ship the MVP. Then build the platform**
We are building from Gurugram. I care more about founder level commitment and getting important work done together than about where someone sits every day. Regular in person time will matter around major product, architecture and company building decisions.
If you have spent your career building technology and now want to build the company behind it, I’d like to hear from you.

title: Product Owner
description:
We are Topflight Apps! An innovative group of product strategists, designers, and developers. Together we create custom app solutions for startups and mid-sized businesses, and what we do best is tackle some of the biggest problems in healthcare, fintech, blockchain technology, and on-demand.

Due to our expansions, we’re currently looking for a Product Manager and Project Manager to join our family. As a hybrid product/project manager with us, it is essential to understand that you are a central hub for critical information about our products, the market, our competitors and customers, prospects, and fundamental industry analysts.

**What’s in it for you:**
* 100% remote: this is a WFH opportunity. 
* Annual re-evaluation of salary and bonuses based on a mix of individual and company financial performance. 
* Flexibility in taking your vacation and sick days off
* Work-life balance: We try to get things done efficiently, then enjoy the rest of our lives, especially on weekends. 

**Projects You’ll Be Working On:**
As an agency, you will be working on a variety of innovative products aiming to push the limits in healthcare, fintech, edtech, crypto, and on-demand space.

**Your Responsibilities Include:**
* Meeting the product manager KPIs for individual products (e.g. average app store review, average end-user NPS score, churn rate, DAU/WAU/MAU ratios, average client NPS score, etc.) so that we’re measured by what truly matters to clients.
* Analyze bottlenecks and areas needing improvement by studying behavioral analytics, crash analytics, UX recordings, and talking to end-users and negative reviewers in particular. 
* Conducting user testing (quantitative and qualitative) for clickable design prototypes and live products. 
* Executing product discovery with the technical team to map user journeys, identifying key system components and recommending tech stack, recommending MVP feature set, writing features PRDs.
* Making recommendations on product improvements to the rest of the product team.
* Following the CPO’s best practices and using the latest behavioral analytics, UX monitoring, and other product management tools available in the market. 
* Working with the CPO on weekly Professional Development Plans to ensure your professional and personal success. 
* Serving as subject matter experts (SMEs) on chosen efforts of agency focus (e.g. after deciding we should become SMEs on remote patient monitoring in 2021, the product management team would be tasked with up-skilling and follow-through.)
* Collaborating with UI/UX designers, technical project managers, developers, and QA team to align technical teams toward product KPIs.
* Be the go-to Project Manager responsible for the delivery of work products.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders and project discipline leads to identify requirements, determine project scope and deliverables, set priorities, and establish milestones.
* Develop project plans, status reports, estimates, and schedules.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions.
* Collaborating with UI/UX designers, business analysts, developers, and QA team to align the technical team toward product KPIs.
* Serve as a conduit between project/team members in all cross-functional groups (Operations, Project Management, Regulatory, Product, etc.).

**The key characteristics we're looking for are:**
* 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Senior Product Manager. Digital Product experience is a must.
* 2+ years of experience as a Project Manager.
* Experience working in all phases of the SDLC for medium to large projects.
* Experience in healthcare/medical devices is a plus.
* A knack for consulting others on how to best achieve a feature for scalability and their business goals (as opposed to waiting for instructions on how to build a feature, or building something the first way that comes to mind).
* The ability to "figure it out" when you hit inevitable roadblocks.
* Desire for team-first approach, radical transparency, thoughtful disagreement, and constructive feedback (both giving and offering).
* Desire for constant learning and a dynamic change-up in project opportunities.
* Accountability for deadlines, matched with a proactive discussion of deadline adjustments.
* Mental fortitude to handle a relatively high-stress environment that comes from tighter deadlines and rapid development cycles.
* Best-in-class communication skills.

**Desirable characteristics:**
* Inclination towards usage of AI tools to speed up work-related tasks.
* Prior experience working with agencies.
* Hands-on experience shipping AI-enabled products in and outside of the healthcare space. 

**Important to know:**
* Since we are fully remote and our team is across the globe, you are expected to interact with different teams and need to be flexible with different time zones. All our employees must overlap at a minimum between 7 AM and 11 AM Pacific Standard Time
* All New Joiners with Topflight Apps go through a 1 Month Trial at the start of their employment journey; which requires working part-time. This is to ensure your onboarding goes smoothly and that both parties are aligned on future expectations.
* Preference will be given to candidates who are based in the US. 
* The workload for this role will vary between 30 to 40 hours per week, depending on the number of projects the person will be assigned to.

**Annual Salary**: 
*In the U.S., the base pay range for this role is $77,500.00 – $93,600.00 annually. These figures reflect the expected range across all U.S. locations and are based on factors including relevant experience, skills, and performance. Your specific offer will be determined during the hiring process. While we strive to make competitive offers, new hire compensation is negotiable.*

**To Apply:**
* We strongly encourage applicants to complete the AI Interview assessment on Wellfound. We will prioritize candidates who submit an application with an AI interview. 
* Please ensure all outreach and applications are submitted through the designated job posting platform. Note that any use of alternative platforms will lead to automatic disqualification.

title: Founding Data Engineer
location: Austin; Boston; Chicago; Dallas; Los Angeles; New York City; Seattle; Washington DC; San Francisco; Irvine
description:
To be considered, [please apply directly via our careers page.](https://jobs.gem.com/snout/am9icG9zdDptSk2y1uZpQZZRtkIT6cs8)

### 🐶 Our mission

Every pet should get the care they need, regardless of cost. Vet med prices are up 40% since 2020, and pet owners are stuck having to pick between their bank account and furry friend. At Snout, we aim to solve this by enabling clinics to offer pet wellness plans, that actually work.

### 🚀 The opportunity

Snout is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space, trusted by clinics across the U.S. We’re a small but mighty startup team. We’re looking for a remote, U.S. based **Founding Data Engineer** to build the data foundation the rest of the company will run on.

### 💻 The role

This is Snout’s first dedicated data hire, reporting directly to the CTO. You’re inheriting a real, working system — a Postgres operational database and a dbt-modeled analytics warehouse that already powers internal reporting and our LLM/AI tooling — but one that’s grown faster than anyone’s had time to organize. Your job is to turn it into a firm, documented, trustworthy foundation.

That means first understanding what data we actually have and where it lives, then making it coherent. We ingest hundreds of millions of rows from multiple veterinary practice-management systems (Cornerstone, AllyDVM, and others) alongside our own application data — today the same concept can live in several places with different shapes, and part of your early work is reconciling those lineages into definitions people can trust. From there you’ll own and extend the warehouse, harden the pipelines and the nightly rebuild, and shape a model that makes analysis fast and reliable.

You’ll do the up-front work of a founding hire: talk to stakeholders across the company, understand what they need, present options and clear recommendations with their trade-offs and cost, and then execute on the path we choose. We’re hiring a data analyst after you — you’ll set them up to succeed and be the technical backbone they lean on. Do this well and you put Snout in a genuinely data-driven position and grow a team underneath you.

*Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of “what we’re looking for” including the first bullet point. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.*

### 🛠 What you’ll do

* Map Snout’s data landscape end to end — what exists, where it lives, what’s canonical vs. stale — and document it so it’s no longer tribal knowledge
* Reconcile data from multiple source systems (application data + multiple PIMS ingests) into conformed, trustworthy models where a term like “appointment” or “invoice” means one thing
* Own and extend our dbt warehouse: model the source-system activity that isn’t modeled yet, and raise the bar on tests, documentation, and data freshness
* Own the ingestion pipelines and the warehouse rebuild — keep them reliable, and recommend where to simplify or consolidate
* Keep clean, well-modeled data flowing to the tools that consume it, including our internal LLM/AI tooling
* Run early discovery with stakeholders across GTM, CX, finance, and product; turn business questions into a build plan; present options with clear trade-offs and cost before executing
* Set up and support the data analyst we hire next — be the technical foundation they build analysis on

### 💡What we're looking for

* 6+ years building and maintaining production data systems as a data or analytics engineer
* Deep SQL and hands-on PostgreSQL experience
* Strong dbt and dimensional/data-modeling experience in production — you’ve built warehouses people actually trust
* A track record of taming large, messy datasets from multiple source systems and turning them into something coherent
* A pragmatist’s bias toward simplicity — you reach for the simplest thing that works, can justify every tool and layer you’d add, and can tell the difference between complexity that earns its keep and complexity that doesn’t
* Strong communication: you can make a clear recommendation, back it with reasoning and cost, and commit wholeheartedly to a decision even when it isn’t the one you argued for
* Comfortable being the first and only data person for a while — self-directed, and happy building the foundation before there’s a team

### 🌟 What will make you stand out

* Experience as an early or first data hire who later grew a function or team
* Python (or similar) for pipelines and tooling
* Experience modeling data for LLM/AI consumption
* Familiarity with veterinary or healthcare data, or PIMS systems (Cornerstone, AllyDVM, etc.)
* Experience at a subscription or technology startup (Series A/B), on AWS

### 💖 Why you should join Snout

* Fast growing, venture capital backed technology company focused on improving access to veterinary care
* Ability to have a meaningful impact from Day 1, where your voice and opinion matters
* Unlimited potential to grow in your career, learn and expand your skillsets
* Collaborative, flexible, and friendly culture

### ❌ Why this role might not be a fit for you

* You believe every problem needs a new tool, and you’d want to stand up a large modern-data-stack (many SaaS tools, heavy infrastructure) before proving it’s needed — we optimize hard for simplicity and cost
* You’d rather be the analyst producing dashboards and insights than the engineer building the foundation those depend on
* You need an established data team and mature infrastructure around you to be productive
* A fast-moving startup culture feels overwhelming, or you’re uncomfortable with ambiguous, messy data from multiple source systems
* You prefer working in a silo rather than collaborating across GTM, CX, finance, and engineering
* You don’t live near an airport or have the flexibility to travel quarterly

### 💸 Compensation

*  $165 000 - $185 000 base salary
*  Equity

### ⚕️Benefits

* Day 1 medical/dental/vision benefits
* Flexible time off + 11 Snout calendar holidays
* Paid parental leave

title: Director, Payments Risk
location: Denver; Seattle; Vancouver; British Columbia; Arizona
description:
##   
Who we are:

Founded in 2013, Ignition is the leading revenue and billing automation platform for firms and agencies. We automate proposals, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering businesses to sell, bill and get paid faster.  
  
Ignition automates proposals, engagement letters, invoicing, payments and workflows in a single AI-powered platform, empowering 8,500+ businesses to sell, bill and get paid for their services with ease.   
  
To date, Ignition customers have managed relationships with over 2.4 million clients and earned $13b in revenue via the platform. Ignition's global workforce spans Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the Philippines, US and the UK.

## Company Values:

- We are better everyday
- We work without ego
- We are smarter together
- We hero our customer

## **About the Role**

Payments is one of Ignition’s biggest, highest-stakes, and fastest-scaling areas - shaping how tens of thousands of professional services get paid. With that scale comes complexity, ambiguity, and risk. We’re looking for a leader who can bring trust, clarity, and decisiveness to it.

As Director of Payments Risk, you’ll own the engine that helps Ignition grow boldly and responsibly. Reporting to the VP of Payments, you’ll own the risk agenda and build the operating system behind it: the people, processes, and technology that enable scalable, balanced risk management without compromising the exceptional experience Ignition delivers every day.

You’ll lead the team responsible for day-to-day risk execution while setting the strategy for where the function goes next. You’ll bring a clear point of view on the risks we face, how to prioritize and address them, and what they mean for the business.

This is a role for an autonomous, systems-minded leader who can see around corners, create structure in a fast-moving environment, and make decisive calls when the path isn’t obvious. Your work will protect Ignition and its customers while giving the business the confidence to keep moving forward.

## **What You’ll Do**

### **Risk Strategy & Coverage**

- Develop your own point of view on risk strategy — where the function needs to go, what risks matter most, and how we address them — and collaborate with the VP of Payments to shape it into the roadmap.
- Define risk coverage for new capabilities ahead of launch: identify the risks introduced as the product set broadens, design controls and monitoring, and set success criteria.
- Evolve our risk appetite and control frameworks; know when to tighten and when to give room based on what the data and the business need.
- Proactively look for how risk can increase customer value and drive business growth, not just protect against downside.

### **Execution & Operations**

- Run the day-to-day: own the team’s queue and escalation workflow, make the call on cases the playbook doesn’t cover, and maintain the operating rhythm that keeps the function tight.
- Get hands-on when it counts — tune rules, review cases when patterns shift, and treat false positives and missed catches as signal to improve the system.
- Own incident readiness — build and maintain the playbooks, escalation paths, and decision frameworks your team executes when fraud spikes, new attack vectors, or processing anomalies surface.

### **Cross-Functional Partnership**

- Partner with product and engineering to build risk requirements into the roadmap, and with Finance/Data to build dashboards and reporting that serve as the single source of truth.
- Track portfolio-level losses and supply the risk perspective that informs forecasting, business cases, and decisions on launches, pricing, and partners.
- Act as the internal champion for payments risk — help non-specialist teams understand how risk affects their roles in selling, supporting, and operating our payments capabilities.

### **Automation & Team**

- Design for scale — make AI and tooling the default so the team manages exceptions, not volume. Continuously test new tools and raise the bar for AI-forward payments risk.
- Develop and coach the Risk team — set a high bar, build capability, and foster a culture where the team takes initiative and owns its outcomes.

## **What You’ll Bring**

- 8+ years in payments and/or fintech, including 3+ years leading teams and owning outcomes.
- Deep, hands-on command of the payments stack — onboarding, underwriting, processing, settlement, reconciliation, and disputes — with strong Stripe fundamentals (or comparable infrastructure). Embedded payments at a software platform that carries liability is what we're really after.
- A track record in fraud and risk — building or running detection, monitoring, and controls; balancing loss prevention against customer experience and growth.
- Commercially minded — you understand how risk decisions affect growth, and your instinct is to enable it, not stifle it. You can build the reporting leadership relies on to make informed decisions.
- Automation-first — you have stood up new processes or products and treat AI and tooling as genuine force multipliers.
- High autonomy, sound judgment, and meticulous attention to detail — you think in systems, run without day-to-day guidance, and get the details right in a domain where a missed edge case has real financial consequences.
- A clear communicator who translates payments and risk complexity into guidance non-specialist teams can act on.

## **Compensation Information:**

Our salary bands are designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and to allow room for growth. The final offer amount for this role will be dependent on state/location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

This role has a minimum annual base of CAD $170,000 and maximum annual salary of CAD $190,000 in Canada / USD $160,000 and maximum annual salary of USD $190,000 in the United States.

We may use AI enabled tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as improving efficiency in scheduling and note taking. These tools are used responsibly and never replace human decision-making, all hiring decisions are made by our people.

We aim to keep the process transparent, respectful of your time, and as smooth as possible.

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement, experience comes in many forms, and diverse perspectives make our teams stronger.

Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process or need materials in an alternative format, please contact **careers@ignitionapp.com**.

title: Strategic Business Development Representative, OEM and Lender
description:
## Strategic Business Development Representative, OEM and Lender

## About Trnsact

**We're building the digital rails for commercial equipment.**

Every truck, excavator and tractor sold in North America moves through a dealer, a lender and a stack of paperwork. Credit applications get re-keyed into lender portals. Approvals come back by email. F&I products get quoted on spreadsheets. Commercial equipment is one of the largest markets in the economy, and it still runs on phone calls, PDFs and faxes.

Trnsact is the transaction operating system that fixes that. Dealers, lenders, OEMs and protection providers use one platform for credit, lender orchestration, F&I, OEM visibility and digital retailing. Dealers reach 280+ lenders from one place. OEMs see what's selling and financing across their networks.

We work with Penske, Ryder, Daimler and CAT dealers. We're about $3M ARR, cash-flow positive, and customers rarely leave.

### About the Role

Our largest partnerships start with the right first conversation with the right executive. Your job is to start those conversations.

You'll book first meetings with OEMs, lenders, insurers, warranty providers and enterprise dealer groups for our CEO and senior leadership team. You won't close deals. You'll open the doors that lead to six-figure partnerships, and you'll learn how enterprise deals get done by working next to the people who close them.

### Key Responsibilities

- **Account Research:** Map target accounts and buying committees using our dealer and lender datasets, AI tools and LinkedIn.
- **Executive Outreach:** Run multi-channel outreach by phone, email and LinkedIn to director, VP and C-level buyers.
- **Meeting Quality:** Book and confirm meetings so they actually happen. We measure meetings held, not meetings booked.
- **Executive Briefs:** Prepare our leaders before every meeting with account context and the angle to lead with.
- **Events:** Set meetings at trade shows and industry events, and follow up afterward.

### Qualifications and Requirements

- **Experience:** 2+ years in outbound SDR or BDR work, ideally reaching senior or enterprise buyers.
- **Research and Writing:** Sharp, concise writing and research. You use AI and data tools well, not just a dialer.
- **Executive Presence:** Confident and unhurried on the phone with senior leaders.
- **Curiosity:** You want to understand how lending, OEM dealer programs and F&I actually work.
- **Industry Knowledge:** Equipment finance, trucking, OEM or lender experience is a strong plus.

### Earning Opportunity and Benefits

- **Compensation:** Competitive base plus variable pay for qualified meetings held, and a bonus when the deals you source reach contract.
- **Equity:** An early-stage equity grant.
- **Exposure:** Work directly with our CEO and leadership on the company's biggest opportunities.
- **Career Path:** A clear track into an AE or partnerships role.

**Expected Range:** $65,000 to $80,000 base; $95,000 to $120,000 OTE; plus equity
