description:
As a **Senior Software Engineer** at Postscript, you'll be a high-ownership contributor to one of our core product or platform teams — owning meaningful systems end-to-end, driving technical quality, and helping shape how we build across the organization. Our engineering teams operate at the intersection of scale and product velocity, which means you'll be working on distributed systems that matter to the business while also influencing the technical standards that allow Postscript to grow sustainably.

This is a high-autonomy role for engineers who are energized by ambiguity, take genuine ownership of their work, and bring a strong point of view on how to build things well — without sacrificing speed or pragmatism. AI isn't a nice-to-have here — it's central to how we work. We expect our engineers to be active practitioners of AI-first development: fluent with the latest agentic coding tools, curious about what's emerging, and constantly pushing the boundary of what's possible with AI in their day-to-day craft. If you're the kind of engineer who's already experimenting with new models and tooling before anyone asks you to, you'll feel at home here.

As a senior engineer at Postscript, you’ll no longer be only writing code but orchestrating it.

**This position is fully remote and can be based in the US or Canada.**

## **Primary Duties**

- Take deep ownership of systems and product areas on your team — becoming the go-to technical expert for what you own
- Independently investigate, design, and execute solutions across distributed systems with a high degree of ambiguity
- Architect, build, and maintain highly available, scalable REST APIs and backend services for internal and external use
- Drive system decoupling, modularization, and technical debt reduction — improving long-term maintainability without blocking near-term delivery
- Build agentically as your default: leveraging concurrent autonomous agent workflows, owning the output, and keeping a steady queue of aligned work moving
- Stay at the forefront of emerging AI tooling and practices, bringing new techniques back to the team and helping raise the floor for how Postscript engineers work
- Contribute to how we think about integrating AI into our systems and workflows — not just using AI tools, but helping shape where and how AI creates leverage across the engineering org
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, data, and go-to-market teams — communicating clearly and proactively in an async-first environment
- Identify and eliminate single points of failure, improving system resilience and knowledge redundancy across your team
- Improve how engineering gets done: bring better tools, fix workflow friction, build internal utilities when the leverage compounds

## **What We'll Love About You**

- 6+ years of experience building large-scale backend systems and APIs
- You are an active, daily user of AI coding tools and are using them to maximize your output — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent — and can speak concretely to how they've changed your output and your workflow
- Tech stack: Python, Go, React, and TypeScript; experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Datadog, and relational/NoSQL databases. You run agentic workflows autonomously and concurrently.
- You follow the AI tooling landscape closely: new model releases, emerging agentic workflows, and evolving best practices aren't things you catch up on eventually — they're things you're tracking in real time
- You think critically about AI output — you know where it accelerates you, where it introduces risk, and how to verify what it produces
- You are able to context switch extremely quickly across concurrent workstreams
- Experience working on both 0-to-1 initiatives and complex existing systems — and knowing how to balance building new things with improving what's there
- Strong command of relational and NoSQL databases, SQL, and thoughtful database modeling
- Familiarity building and observing applications on AWS, and ideally with Datadog or comparable observability tooling
- Clear, direct communication — cross-functional partners and async teams can count on you to surface information proactively
- Strong instincts for technical tradeoffs informed by both engineering best practices and business priorities

## **What You'll Love About Us**

- Salary range of USD $175,000–$205,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo-based salaries)
- High growth startup — plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career
- Work from home (or wherever in US / Canada)
- Fun — we're passionate and enjoy what we do
- Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
- Flexible paid time off
- Health, dental, vision insurance

title: Senior Front End Software Engineer (Autofill)
description:
Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts. 

One of the most critical parts of the Bitwarden product is our autofill and form detection. These features are a part of the Bitwarden browser extension, and they enable the extension to fill form fields with the user’s data and detect new logins to store in Bitwarden. We are looking for a Front-End Engineer to join a team that is responsible for maintaining and continually improving these parts of our product, ensuring that they grow to provide seamless integration with the latest web UI patterns across all browsers.

This is an all-remote team, and we are looking for someone based in North America. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time. 

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Become an expert and authority on Bitwarden’s browser extension autofill and form change detection
- Develop and maintain a full suite of browser UI automation tests
- Continually improve the autofill and form detection experience as new UI patterns emerge
- Participate in code reviews, learning, and spreading technical knowledge
- Occasionally contribute bug fixes submitted by the user community

**WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN**

- Deep understanding of browser UI behavior, including familiarity with DOM manipulation and content scripts
- Proficiency in both vanilla JavaScript and with a modern framework like Angular (preferred), React, or Vue
- Understanding of browser extension development
- Excellent problem-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution
- Experience with documenting complex technical solutions and conveying knowledge to other members of the Engineering team
- Proficiency using source control such as Git, SVN, Subversion, TFS, etc.
- Collaborative and adaptable mindset
- Openness and authenticity combined with excellent communication skills
- Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security
- Excellent problem-solving skills – you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution

**WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS**

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

- Meeting with our Recruiting Manager
- Interview with (hiring manager)
- Interview/s with team members
- Reference calls

**A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US**

- Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
- Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
- We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world and take part in productive and fun meetups.
- Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

We recognize and understand that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the position, you should still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. Please let us know if you require accommodations during the interview process.

*A note to outside sourcers: We do not accept solicitations from recruiters, recruiting agencies, headhunters, or outsourcing organizations. Please remove us from all such contact lists. *

*In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $140,000 - $200,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.*

title: Staff AI Product Engineer
description:
Deeply is building a **Relationship Operating System for couples** — an AI agent that helps couples turn what matters into shared understanding, constructive action, follow-through, and real relationship improvement.

We’re looking for an exceptional **product engineer** who wants to help invent the product, not just implement tickets.

## What you’ll do

You’ll own important customer outcomes end-to-end:

**user problem → product model → UX → architecture → implementation → real-world usage**

You’ll work across the stack: React/Next.js, backend/domain logic, Postgres/Supabase, AI agents, SMS, notifications, background jobs, memory, and product instrumentation.

You’ll also work directly from customer evidence: understand where couples get stuck, decide what should change, ship it, watch what happens, and keep iterating until it works.

## What we’re looking for

You:

* Have exceptional agency and ownership.
* Are a strong full-stack engineer with strong product judgment.
* Can take a vague goal and independently figure out what needs to exist.
* Think in systems, not isolated features.
* Naturally simplify, reuse, consolidate, and delete.
* Are highly effective with AI coding tools without outsourcing your judgment to them.
* Are comfortable challenging assumptions, including the founder’s.
* Care deeply about UX, language, trust, and human behavior.
* Move extremely fast once the problem is understood.

You probably won’t enjoy this role if you want detailed specs, stable requirements, narrow ownership, or your responsibility to end when the PR merges.

## How we work

**Own outcomes.**
**Start from the user.**
**Exercise judgment.**
**Understand the whole system.**
**Simplify relentlessly.**
**Once clear, move extremely fast.**

The bar is simple:

> Give you an important customer problem, and you can independently understand it, decide what should be built, ship it, get it used, learn from reality, and leave the product better than you found it.

title: Founding Software Engineer
description:
**Location**: US/Canada (Remote)
**Type**: Full-time,
**Compensation**: Lean cash base paired with significant founding-team equity, designed for high-conviction builders who want real ownership upside.

**About Us**

Inaccuracies (bias, hallucination, non-determinism, etc.) from AI models, stemming from flawed data, imperfect prompts, or misinterpretations, can cause significant harm and erode trust across many industries. The impact ranges from just not quite correct and inconvenience in less critical applications to serious financial losses, safety risks, legal liability, and discrimination in high-stakes fields like healthcare, finance, and autonomous vehicles. In an enterprise, a minor error/deviation at each step in a multi-step agentic workflow can lead to a huge drift from the expected final outcome.

We are an early-stage AI startup assembling a world-class team to shape the future of robust AI. We are researching, experimenting, and developing practical solutions to make AI applications robust. Currently, we are a small team of experienced engineers and researchers passionate about making AI usable in mission critical applications. If the problem resonates with you, and you want to be part of the team, join us.

As a **Founding Engineer**, you’ll work directly with the founders, play a pivotal role in defining our technology, and have significant ownership of the product, architecture, and culture from the ground up. You will not only build, but will also participate in the decision making of what to build. This is an opportunity for exceptional software engineers who want to build robust AI systems/platform/applications from 0 -> 1, and have an appetite for some risk. 

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and scale core AI-driven systems and products.
* Collaborate with the founding team on product strategy and technical direction.
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on APIs and end-to-end applications.
* Establish engineering best practices, including testing, deployment, and CI/CD.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging AI/ML technologies into our stack.
* Wear multiple hats: full-stack engineering, infrastructure, ML engineering, and occasional customer-facing problem-solving.
* Help recruit and mentor early team members as we grow.

**What We’re Looking For**

* ~5 years of professional software engineering experience (startup experience a plus).
* Strong background in Python and modern backend development.
* Experience building and shipping production-grade software (ideally involving AI/ML systems).
* Comfortable across the stack (backend, cloud infrastructure, APIs, some frontend if needed).
* Experience in using Google Cloud Platform (GCP) extensively.
* Deep curiosity and hands-on experience with LLMs and/or agent frameworks.
* Ability to thrive in uncertainty and take ownership.
* Capable of architecting and implementing complex software systems with optimal efficiency.
* A collaborative mindset and good communication skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior startup or small-team experience.
* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects.
* Experience with DevOps.
* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js).
* Familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow).

**What We Offer**

* Lean cash base paired with significant founding-team equity.
* Direct influence over technical, product, and cultural decisions.
* Opportunity to shape a company from day one.
* Fast-paced, collaborative environment with significant autonomy.
* Access to advisors, investors, and industry networks in AI.

**Why Join Us?**

This is not just another engineering role. As a Founding Engineer, you’ll be a builder, owner, and decision-maker. You’ll shape not only our product but also the DNA of the company. If you want to have an outsized impact in an early-stage AI venture, we’d love to talk.

title: Senior GO developer
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

Independently drive project delivery within defined architecture, demonstrating autonomy and accountability in all stages from conceptualization to deployment.

Actively participate in accurate planning and estimation efforts, utilizing project methods and tools.

title: Group Product Manager, Data Feeds
description:
**About Us:**

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by *Inc.* as a [Best Workplace](https://www.inc.com/profile/yipitdata) for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

**What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:**

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

- **Ownership That Matters**: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
- **Rapid Growth**: We compress years of learning into months
- **Merit Over Titles**: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
- **Velocity with Purpose:** We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

**About The Role:**

YipitData is building the default intelligence platform for anyone evaluating companies and markets. Our data feeds are central to that ambition, bringing proprietary and exclusively licensed data directly into our clients’ research, investment, and business workflows.

We’re looking for a Group Product Manager to lead and grow our Data Feeds product management team. You will own the strategy and performance of a portfolio of data products, develop a strong team of PMs, and help build a more connected, scalable feeds business serving fundamental investors, quantitative and systematic funds, and corporate customers.

This is a **player-coach role**. Alongside managing the team and setting portfolio direction, you will directly own a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative - from customer discovery and product strategy through development, launch, and ongoing performance. You should enjoy moving between portfolio decisions, coaching PMs, and working through the details of a product yourself.

Our opportunity extends beyond bringing more datasets to market. We are building differentiated products around clear customer problems, combining data and capabilities where they create greater value, and making our feeds easier to evaluate, integrate, and use. You will help determine where we invest, how our products fit together, and how we translate our data advantage into durable growth.

**As Our Group Product Manager, Data Feeds, You Will:**

**Lead and Develop the Product Team**

- Manage, coach, and grow a team of product managers, strengthening their customer discovery, strategic judgment, execution, and commercial ownership.
- Establish clear product responsibilities, goals, and decision-making expectations, giving PMs the autonomy and support to own their products.
- Build effective practices for planning, roadmap reviews, customer feedback, and performance measurement.
- Recruit and develop talent as the team grows, while maintaining a high bar for product thinking and accountability.

**Lead Product Portfolio Strategy and Execution**

- Own a cohesive product portfolio strategy aligned with the broader business direction set by the Head of Data Feeds, defining how our feeds fit together, serve customer needs, and deliver differentiated value.
- Guide PMs in developing product visions and roadmaps that strengthen both their individual products and the overall portfolio.
- Prioritize across product roadmaps and shared capabilities, balancing customer value, commercial opportunity, and available resources; partner with the Head of Data Feeds on broader investment decisions.
- Work with PMs to validate use cases and commercial demand early, including during the evaluation of new data sources.
- Identify portfolio gaps, overlap, and opportunities to combine datasets, reuse methodologies, and extend products across customer segments.
- Use customer feedback and product performance to recommend which offerings to scale, improve, consolidate, or retire, and lead execution of agreed decisions.

**Directly Own and Build Products**

- Serve as the hands-on PM for a strategically important data feed or quant-focused feed initiative, owning its vision, roadmap, requirements, and outcomes.
- Lead customer discovery, investigate the underlying data, and translate customer needs into clear product decisions.
- Partner with Data, Engineering, Data Science, and Quant Research to assess feasibility, shape requirements, and bring products to market.
- Stay close to client evaluations and integrations, using feedback to improve the product and establish practices the broader team can reuse.

**Drive Commercial Performance**

- Share accountability with commercial partners for portfolio revenue growth, retention, expansion, and product economics.
- Partner with Revenue, Client Strategy, Product Marketing, and Solutions Consulting on pricing, packaging, positioning, and effective sales and evaluation processes.
- Build a clear portfolio story that helps customers understand which products meet their needs and how those products work together.
- Balance near-term client requests with repeatable market opportunities, ensuring commitments inform a scalable roadmap.
- Define and track success through customer adoption, evaluation conversion, time to value, retention, and commercial results.

**Build a Consistent, Reliable Client Experience**

- Establish product expectations for data quality, coverage, timeliness, documentation, and delivery across the portfolio.
- Partner with Data and Engineering on quality controls, monitoring, change management, and issue resolution.
- Improve how customers discover, evaluate, onboard, integrate, and receive ongoing support for feeds, working with Applications and client-facing teams.
- Ensure clients can understand each product’s methodology, limitations, historical changes, and appropriate use cases.
- Help build a repeatable experience for quant and systematic customers, including the data history, consistency, and transparency required for rigorous evaluation.

**Connect Teams Around Shared Outcomes**

- - Align priorities and responsibilities across Product, Data, Engineering, Research, Quant, Applications, and commercial teams.
  - Partner with Quant Research on systematic investor requirements and research-informed product improvements.
  - Work with data sourcing and partnerships teams to evaluate opportunities against customer needs, licensing constraints, quality, and economics.
  - Communicate strategy, tradeoffs, progress, and risks clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners.

**You Are Likely To Succeed If:**

- Significant product management experience, typically 7+ years, including ownership of commercial data products, data feeds, or similarly data-intensive B2B products.
- Experience directly managing and developing product managers, with evidence of improving both team performance and individual growth.
- A track record of taking products from customer discovery through launch and scaling, with measurable customer and business outcomes.
- Strong portfolio judgment: you can prioritize across products, allocate investment, and make difficult tradeoffs.
- Commercial fluency, including experience contributing to pricing, packaging, revenue growth, retention, or product economics.
- Hands-on analytical ability, including proficiency in SQL and comfort using Python to investigate data and assess product questions.
- Technical fluency in data products, including schemas, methodologies, quality, delivery mechanisms, and the implications of product changes for clients.
- Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align teams you do not directly manage.
- A desire to remain a hands-on product owner while building and leading a team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience with alternative data, financial data, or investment research products.
- Familiarity with fundamental, quantitative, or systematic investment workflows, including dataset evaluation, backtesting, and integration.
- Experience building a portfolio that serves multiple customer segments or combines multiple data sources.
- Experience with third-party data partnerships, licensing considerations, and vendor dependencies.
- Familiarity with APIs, cloud-based data delivery, and data quality and operational reliability practices.

**What We Offer:**

**Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:**

- We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
- Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
- **Base Salary + Performance-Based Bonus:** The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be **$190k - 205k,** with eligibility for an annual performance-based bonus of up to **15%**. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
- The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

*We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Full Stack Mobile Developer — iOS, Android & SaaS

title: Content Marketing Manager - SaaS, SEO & Personal Brand
description:
**Overview**
We operate multiple software and real-estate-related businesses and are looking for a talented, hands-on Content Marketing Manager to own content and organic growth across our SaaS products, company websites, and founder/personal brands.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can combine strong writing with product marketing, SEO, content strategy, and execution. You will work directly with company leadership and our development team to turn products, customer problems, industry knowledge, and founder expertise into content that attracts attention, ranks in search, builds trust, and contributes to qualified demand.

We are not looking for someone who only schedules social posts or produces generic AI content. We want a marketer who understands the purpose behind the content, can recommend what we should create, and can personally execute high-quality work.

**Key responsibilities**

- SaaS product marketing: Develop positioning, messaging, landing-page copy, feature-launch content, use cases, product education, and conversion-focused content.

- Content creation: Write articles, case studies, guides, newsletters, social posts, video scripts, website copy, and other marketing assets.

- Content repurposing and distribution: Turn strong ideas into multiple formats and distribute them across the channels where they are most useful.

**Role requirements**

- Excellent written English and strong marketing/copywriting ability.
- Demonstrated SEO experience with measurable results such as ranking improvements, organic traffic growth, Search Console performance, or qualified conversions.
- Experience marketing SaaS, software, technology, or another complex product that requires customer education.
- A portfolio containing work you personally created or materially owned.
- Ability to explain the target audience, objective, distribution strategy, and success metric behind your work.
- Working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console, SEO tools, CMS workflows, Canva or Figma, basic video editing, and modern AI tools.
- Strong ownership and judgment. You should be comfortable making recommendations and moving projects forward without waiting for detailed step-by-step instructions.

title: SaaS/B2B Customer Success Manager (Fully Remote)
description:
Drive Success. Build Relationships. Make Every Customer a VIP.

Customer Success Manager
Location: Fully Remote (USA)

As a remote-first company, we foster a mission-focused and performance-driven culture where integrity, initiative, and innovation thrive.

If you’re passionate about creating standout experiences, energized by fast-paced SaaS environments, and skilled at blending strategy with service — you’ll thrive here.

title: Senior AI/ML Architect — Human-Centered LLM Systems
description:
Digital Renovations LLC is seeking a Senior AI/ML Architect to join the proposed team for The Veteran’s Companion™, a human-centered AI project being developed by a veteran for veterans. The concept is intended to help veterans navigate difficult moments and connect with people in their support circle. It is not being designed as a diagnostic or treatment service.

Our immediate goal is to identify a qualified AI/ML collaborator for an NIH/NIMH Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) Phase I application. Before submission, we would discuss the proposed technical role, scope, effort, and compensation with the selected candidate. We would then ask them to provide a signed letter documenting their intent to participate if the project is funded, consistent with the applicable NIH application instructions. The letter would describe a genuine proposed collaboration; it would not be a general endorsement.

This is a funding-contingent opportunity. An award has not been made, and a paid position or start date is not guaranteed. Work requiring pre-award deliverables would be subject to a separate written agreement.

If funded, responsibilities may include:

• Designing the LLM architecture and advising on model selection, grounding, retrieval, and context management.
• Defining evaluation methods for reliability, safety, and behavior in sensitive conversations.
• Planning privacy and security controls, failure handling, and clear handoffs to human support.
• Working with the founder, clinical advisors, and veteran advisors to translate project requirements into a feasible prototype and research plan.
• Documenting technical decisions, tradeoffs, and measurable Phase I milestones.

We are looking for substantial hands-on AI/ML experience, including the design or deployment of LLM systems. The strongest candidates can show specific work in evaluation, safety, retrieval or grounding, and privacy-aware system design. Clear communication and sound judgment matter as much as technical depth.

Funding and compensation: The posted $130,000–$170,000 range is an estimated annualized base salary for a full-time funded role. It is not a guaranteed offer or a commitment to a full year of work. Phase I work may be fractional and limited to the funded project period. Actual duties, hours, duration, and compensation will be set in a written agreement after the award amount and project scope are known.

Confidentiality and intellectual property: Candidates advancing to discussions involving nonpublic technical or business information will be asked to sign a nondisclosure agreement (NDA) before receiving those materials. Before any substantive project work begins, the selected candidate will be required to sign a written agreement covering confidentiality, ownership and assignment of project-specific work product and inventions, treatment of pre-existing intellectual property and third-party tools, and permitted use of project materials.

This is a U.S.-based remote opportunity. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, reside in the United States, and pass a background check before engagement.

title: Analytics Engineer
location: Austin; Boston; Chicago; Dallas; Los Angeles; New York City; Seattle; Washington DC; San Francisco; Irvine
description:
To be considered, [please apply directly via our careers page](https://jobs.gem.com/snout/am9icG9zdDrduAknc-RPtyXH9ap4pVSJ). 

### 🐶 Our mission

Every pet should get the care they need, regardless of cost. Vet med prices are up 40% since 2020, and pet owners are stuck having to pick between their bank account and furry friend. At Snout, we aim to solve this by enabling clinics to offer pet wellness plans, that actually work.

### 🚀 The opportunity

Snout is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space, trusted by clinics across the U.S. We’re a small but mighty startup team of <50 employees. We're on the lookout for an experienced and remote **Analytics Engineer** based in the U.S. to help organize and integrate our databases and software to connect veterinary client data and other sources into powerful, actionable insights.

### 💻 The role

As our sole Analytics Engineer, you'll be hands-on building and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers Snout — from BI integrations with our veterinary customers to the pipelines and models that make our data reliable and useful. You'll partner closely with teams across GTM, marketing, CX, and engineering to translate business questions into analytics assets that actually get used.

Your impact will be felt across the entire organization. The insights and reporting infrastructure you build will directly shape how Snout's clinic partners experience our product and how our internal teams make decisions. This is a foundational role at a critical stage of our growth.

If you're someone who loves working with data, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to build something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you!

*Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of “what we’re looking for” including the first bullet point. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.*

### 🛠 What you’ll do

* Integrate with our veterinary partners' software to develop data pipelines and dbt models to support Snout's data offering, ensuring our infrastructure reliably delivers data to analytics and business systems
* Understand and translate business needs into executable data transformation models that deliver key technology assets across the organization
* Provide analytics modeling, data testing, data engineering, and reporting
* Create algorithms to determine relationships between various data sources and surface insights for end users
* Discover and deliver insights and reporting to our customers and internal stakeholders

### 💡What we're looking for

* 5+ years of experience in data analytics, building and maintaining data infrastructure
* Experience across data and analytics, reporting/visualizations, data warehousing, data testing, and analytics engineering
* A proven track record of data integration for data model consumption
* Experience analyzing large datasets from multiple source systems for reporting consumption
* Hands-on experience with Looker, dbt, SQL, Snowflake, and Fivetran (or similar) and coding with python (or similar)
* Ability to to collaborate with various departments in a cross-functional environment to deliver useable insights

### 🌟 What will make you stand out

* Experience with real-time data streams, cohorting, data classification, and data lineage
* Experience with cloud-based AWS ecosystems and products
* Experience at a subscription and/or technology startup

### 💖 Why you should join Snout

* Fast growing, venture capital backed technology company focused on improving access to veterinary care
* Ability to have a meaningful impact from Day 1, where your voice and opinion matters
* Unlimited potential to grow in your career, learn and expand your skillsets
* Collaborative, flexible, and friendly culture

### ❌ Why this role might not be a fit for you

* You don't live near an airport or have the flexibility to travel quarterly
* A fast-moving, startup culture feels overwhelming to you and you aren't comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go
* You have limited experience with data infrastructure, warehousing, or analytics engineering
* You prefer working in a single-team silo rather than collaborating across functions like GTM, marketing, and engineering
* You're not comfortable working with ambiguous or messy data from multiple source systems

### 💸 Compensation

*  $100 000 - $160 000 base salary

### ⚕️Benefits

* Day 1 medical/dental/vision benefits
* Flexible time off + 11 Snout calendar holidays
* Paid parental leave

title: Technical Implementation Associate
description:
**About Embark**

Since 1995, Embark has been a leading provider of online application and admissions software to colleges, universities, and fellowship programs around the world. We've powered more than 17 million applications for clients including Harvard, Stanford, NYU, and the Rhodes Scholarships. Embark is investing in the next generation of our platform, including AI-powered features for applicants and admissions teams.

**The Role**

This is a hybrid technical role that sits between our clients, their applicants, and our engineering team. You'll configure and build application workflows for universities and fellowship programs, and you'll also write code to build the software that enables them to create those workflows. 

You'll also be the voice of Embark for clients. We're looking for someone with a computer science background who enjoys coding and wants to grow their technical skills, and who can also explain things clearly to non-technical people.

The balance of activities can vary during the application season, but a rough daily balance could be approximate: 

* About 3 hours of client and applicant support by email and chat. You'll diagnose issues, explain solutions clearly, and advise clients on how to configure the platform to improve their processes.
* About 3 hours on technical configuration and coding. You'll build and modify application forms, logic, and workflows in JSON and JavaScript, and contribute to smaller development tasks alongside our engineers.
* About 1 hour on testing and QA. You'll verify releases and fixes, including issues surfaced through support, and help maintain our automated test coverage.
* About 1 hour of project work. This could be AI feature configuration, internal tooling, process improvement, or other initiatives based on your interests.

Ideally, the candidate would be online from 9 AM EST - 6 PM EST but, for the right candidate, we would consider a shorter amount of overlap with the US-based team (e.g. working 5 AM EST - 2 PM EST). 


**What we’re looking for **

* A degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable programming experience
* Working knowledge of JavaScript and JSON; familiarity with HTML/CSS, SQL or MongoDB, or Git is a plus
* Genuine interest in coding and in growing as a developer
* Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be writing to university administrators and applicants across the globe, so clarity, tone, and professionalism matter a great deal to us
* Strong attention to detail and a habit of thinking one step ahead
* The ability to manage several tasks at once and see them through independently
* An interest in education technology

title: Principal Solutions Consultant
description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Assured builds the software carriers use to modernize claims processing, from digital FNOL intake to fraud detection to adjuster tooling. Our Solutions team owns the technical relationship with named carrier accounts. We run discovery, map data between Assured and the carrier's systems, monitor production data for issues, and make sure the carrier gets full value out of what we build.

We're looking for a Solutions Consultant to join the team. This is a hands on, execution focused role. You'll take on the recurring technical work that keeps our carrier accounts healthy, including defect tickets, documentation, QA, and account monitoring, while partnering closely with a Client Engagement Manager on the carrier accounts you support.

## **What You'll Do**

- Run discovery and solution design for deployments and integration strategy, partnering with a Client Engagement Manager along the way.
- Embed during critical phases, including initial deployment, major expansions, and FDT opportunities.
- Own the technical narrative across your carrier accounts.
- Write defect tickets that engineering can act on directly, with clear repro steps, sample payloads, and a description of expected versus observed behavior.
- Review API payloads for mistranslations and data loss, and run smoke tests to confirm changes meet the carrier's requirements before they ship.
- Maintain versioned workflow documentation and field level mapping specs as processes and integrations evolve.
- Help monitor account health, including some SQL work against production data to track capture rates and flag anomalies before the carrier does.
- Handle internal incident management across your carriers, raising critical information and knowledge up to the Client Engagement team.
- Take on more ownership as you ramp up, picking up a growing slice of the technical relationship for one or more carrier accounts directly.

## **What You'll Bring**

- 🔢 Comfort with SQL, JSON, and APIs. You can read a payload, write a query, and reason through a relational data model.
- 🔍 Sharp attention to detail. You notice the small discrepancy in a payload or a data table that others miss.
- ✍️ Clear written communication. You can write a defect ticket or a doc update that a teammate can act on without follow up questions.
- 💼 5 to 10 years of experience in a technical, analytical, or client facing role such as solutions engineering, technical account management, or implementation consulting, ideally at a SaaS company.
- 🤖 Some exposure to AI or machine learning powered products, and comfort learning how AI features work well enough to explain them to a carrier.
- 🚀 A proactive, low ego builder's mindset, with real motivation to grow and take on more.
- 📋 P&C insurance or insurtech exposure is a plus but not required.

**Benefits:**

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

****We have been made aware of individuals falsely posing as recruiters from Assured Insurance Technologies Inc. Please note that we only contact candidates from official @**[**assured.claims**](http://assured.claims) **email addresses and all interviews are conducted through verified company channels. If you are unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly at recruiting-ops@assured.claims before sharing any personal information****

**Our Commitment:**  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.*

description:

* 2+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role (e.g., SaaS startup, ERP integration, implementation, technical account management, IT operations).
* Hands-on technical skills: SQL, Python
* Proven ability to lead and own end-to-end projects, balancing both technical depth and client-facing communication.
* Highly organized with strong project management skills; able to meet deadlines in fast-paced environments.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
**Salary:** £40,000 - £50,000 per year

**Contract:** full time, permanent

At Substrakt, we help arts and cultural organisations create exceptional digital experiences, and we’re looking for a Backend Engineer to help us do just that.

As part of our Engineering and Design team, you’ll build reliable, high quality backend solutions that power our clients’ websites and digital products. From Substrakt’s own products, new website builds and custom integrations to performance improvements and ongoing support, you’ll work on varied technical challenges alongside colleagues who enjoy sharing ideas and solving problems together.

### What you’ll do

- **Build, deploy and maintain backend solutions:** Work across new website builds, updates to existing websites, API integrations and server-side development, primarily in Python, Django and Wagtail, and contributing to our existing PHP and WordPress websites where needed. . Deploy to staging and production environments, following release processes and carrying out checks after deployment.
- **Ensure quality, security and performance:** Write clear, efficient code following secure development practices. Use manual and automated testing and take part in peer code reviews. Investigate bugs, optimise database queries and help keep our websites and applications reliable, responsive and secure.
- **Collaborate and share knowledge:** Work closely with other Backend Engineers, Frontend Engineers, Designers and Client Success Managers. Contribute to scoping, technical planning and solution reviews, maintain useful documentation and join client conversations when your technical input is needed.
- **Take ownership of your work:** Estimate tasks, communicate progress and flag issues early. Take responsibility for delivery and technical quality, with support from senior engineers on more complex challenges, and contribute ideas that improve how we work.
- **Support our live services:** Troubleshoot issues affecting live websites and applications, and participate in our out-of-hours on-call rota to respond to urgent incidents. You’ll cover up to eight one-week rotations per year, with an additional payment equivalent to 5% of your normal hourly rate for each hour of on-call cover, plus one additional day of annual leave per rotation.

**Requirements**

### What you’ll bring

- Solid, practical experience building and maintaining Python web applications, ideally using Django and/or Wagtail.
- Experience working with APIs and relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.
- An understanding of automated testing, Git and maintainable software design.
- Awareness of secure development practices, performance optimisation and application reliability.
- Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to learn, share knowledge and support others.
- A thoughtful approach to troubleshooting, knowing when to investigate independently and when to ask for support.
- Clear, friendly communication and an enthusiasm for collaborating in a primarily remote team.

**It would also be useful to have**

- Experience with PHP and WordPress, and confidence supporting and developing existing sites built with them.
- Familiarity with Heroku, AWS or Cloudflare.
- Experience with CRM systems, databases and ticketing platforms used by arts and cultural organisations, particularly how they integrate with websites.

You don’t need experience with every technology we use, or to have followed a particular career path. What matters most is that you have practical Python experience, care about the quality of your work and enjoy solving problems with others.

If this sounds like you, and you like the sound of us, we’d love to hear from you.

**Benefits**

### What Substrakt brings

We’re a B Corp certified team that values creativity, openness and continual improvement. We believe in creating work we’re proud of and supporting each other to grow along the way. You’ll have the chance to work with inspiring arts and cultural organisations, contributing to websites and products that help people discover and experience their work.

- **Flexible working:** A primarily remote role, with a Birmingham office and flexibility that supports autonomy and work-life balance.
- **Time off:** 25 days’ annual leave, increasing with every two years of service, plus bank holidays and your birthday off. We also offer enhanced leave policies to support parents and carers.
- **On-call compensation:** Additional pay and one extra day of annual leave for each completed week of on-call cover.
- **Health and wellbeing:** A healthcare cashback scheme and a monthly wellbeing allowance of £50 to spend on whatever makes you feel good, whether that’s a gym membership, a meal out or a treatment.
- **Professional development:** Six days each year to focus on your development, with a £500 budget to support your learning.
- **Connection:** Regular team communication and opportunities to spend time together, including two company-funded team gatherings each year.
- **Space to do good work:** Clear responsibilities and thoughtful ways of working, so you understand what you’re accountable for and can focus on doing your best work.
- **A voice in how we work:** Opportunities to join our steering groups and help shape our approach to equality, diversity and inclusion, internal culture, accessibility, AI and sustainability.

Every truck, excavator and tractor sold in North America moves through a dealer, a lender and a stack of paperwork. Credit applications get re-keyed into lender portals. Approvals come back by email. F&I products get quoted on spreadsheets. Commercial equipment is one of the largest markets in the economy, and it still runs on phone calls, PDFs and faxes.

title: QA Team Lead | KYC Experience Required | Full Remote
description:
About Us

At TeamPod, we help tech companies scale faster with fully managed, AI-powered teams. We connect businesses with skilled professionals across operations, customer support, finance, compliance, and more—so they can focus on growth while we handle the work behind the scenes.

**Responsibilities**
* Build and implement the KYC/KYB QA framework, including sampling, scoring and reviewmethodology. Design the QA framework from the ground up, a risk-weighted sampling approach (higher-risk cases reviewed more frequently than lower-risk ones), a scoring methodology that captures both document completeness and the quality of the risk judgment behind it, and a review cadence that scales as case volume grows.
* Conduct quality reviews of KYC/KYB, CDD and EDD cases, including higher-risk customers. Independently review completed onboarding files checking risk-tier accuracy, screening disposition, source of funds/wealth evidencing, and (for entity clients) whether ownership structures were properly unwrapped to identify beneficial owners. Higher-risk and EDD cases receive closer scrutiny given the greater consequence of getting them wrong.
* Identify errors, trends and root causes and recommend improvements. Go beyond flagging individual mistakes — group findings by root cause (e.g. a documentation gap vs. a genuine risk-judgment error vs. a partner-specific requirement being missed) so fixes target the actual cause, whether that's a training gap, an SOP gap, or a partner requirement that isn't properly documented.
* Develop QA reporting, KPIs and management information for Head of Compliance.
* Own a regular reporting cadence covering quality trends, recurring error types, and partner specific RFI patterns — feeding a core KPI: reducing avoidable back-and-forth with our banking partners by catching issues before submission, not after.
* Work closely with Head of Compliance to improve processes and controls.
* Act as the operational link between the compliance policy framework and how the team actually executes day to day — flagging where documented process and real practice have drifted apart, and helping close that gap.
* Identify training needs and provide feedback to onboarding teams.
* Use QA findings to drive what training actually happens — not generic refreshers, but targeted sessions addressing the specific gaps the data is showing (e.g. a pattern of source of funds vs. source of wealth confusion, or inconsistent handling of layered ownership structures).
* Continuously improve the QA framework as the business grows.
* Evolve the framework as new banking partners, products, or entity types are added.

**Requirements**
* Must have experience in KYC, AML, Compliance or Financial Crime QA within fintech, payments or financial services.
* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and risk-based onboarding.
* Direct, hands-on experience assessing KYC/KYB case quality (not general customer support QA experience). This role needs someone who can independently judge whether a compliance decision was right, not just whether a process step was followed.
* Experience building a QA framework from scratch. (This is a build role, not a maintain role. The successful candidate has built up a QA function before, not just operated within an existing one)
* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, scorecard design, and performance evaluation.
* Comfortable designing scoring criteria that are consistent and defensible across reviewers, and calibrating so different reviewers reach the same conclusion on the same file.
* Genuine technical depth, able to independently assess whether a risk tier was applied correctly, whether EDD was sufficient, and whether an ownership structure was properly unwrapped, not just whether a checklist was completed.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Able to turn QA findings into practical process improvements/training
* QA findings are only useful if they change something, this role needs to turn patterns into concrete process, training, or policy recommendations, not just produce reports.
* Confident challenging decisions and escalating issues. This role will sometimes need to tell an experienced analyst, or flag to the Head of Compliance, that something isn't good enough.
* The end output of QA work here isn't a report that sits unread — it's a training session, an SOP
update, or a process fix that actually closes the gap that was found.

title: Insights Data Manager
description:
## About the Role

The Insights Data Manager owns Carbon Arc's data assets from onboarding to launch, and is the person who can explain what each asset says, where it is reliable and where it is not. You will run the weekly data launch cadence while analyzing and interpreting our proprietary data to deliver actionable insights across companies, industries, and geographies.

This role sits within our Data Insights team and works cross functionally with Data Engineering, Applied Research, Product, Compliance, and GTM. You will work closely with Engineering, Research & Intelligence, GTM and Compliance to ship new data assets every week, and directly with clients to interpret trends, validate signals and understand limitations. It is ideal for someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear narratives and turning messy pipelines into a repeatable, high-quality launch process.

## What You'll Do

**Own weekly data launches**

- Run Carbon Arc's weekly data launch cadence end to end: coordinate go/no-go and ship new data assets on schedule
- Guide each data asset through the full pipeline, from ingestion and cleaning to aggregation, so it is accurate and ready for metric resolution at launch
- Partner with Engineering, Research, GTM and Compliance to clarify requirements, pressure-test pipeline and architecture decisions, and remove blockers before launch day
- Define how customers discover, evaluate and get value from each new asset on Carbon Arc's usage-based platform
- Build client-facing documentation and launch materials, and improve internal tools so every team understands what an asset covers and how to use it
- Track post-launch adoption, usage and quality metrics, and use them with client feedback to prioritize which assets to launch, fix or retire

**Represent and manage data-driven projects**

- Be the key stakeholder in projects that leverage our data and ontology - coordinate between teams executing to deliver those projects
- Ensure timely delivery and prioritization

**Deliver data insights**

- Back-test data assets against company-reported or government-reported KPIs to validate accuracy and performance before and after launch
- Model company-reported metrics, highlighting nuances, limitations and blind spots at both the company and data-asset level
- Derive and communicate insights on companies, industries and geographies through direct client conversations
- Support investor presentations by helping clients interpret trends across multiple data assets and identify key takeaways
- Support special projects, presentations and reports as needed

## What You'll Bring

title: Onboarding Training Facilitator
location: Detroit; Indianapolis; Louisville; San Antonio; Tampa; Nashville
description:
Wider Circle is looking for a remote Healthcare Onboarding Training Facilitator to join our Learning & Development team on a contract basis. Right now, that mostly means onboarding non-clinical frontline staff, but the mix of roles you train will shift over time as our hiring needs change. This is a training-delivery role first, built to flex across whichever new hire population needs it most.

Company Overview

Wider Circle is a mission-driven healthcare organization working to improve health outcomes for older adults and complex populations by addressing social and clinical barriers to care. We partner with health plans and providers across the country to run community health programs, connecting members with neighbors and Wider Circle staff who help them stay engaged in care and healthy at home. Our approach has been shown to build trust, improve members' experience, and reduce unnecessary hospital visits — and it's been featured in published health research. Today, Wider Circle runs its programs in hundreds of communities nationwide and serves members and patients both in-person and via telehealth.

About the Role

Training is delivered live over video conference to new hires distributed across the country, so you'll need to be as effective coaching a webcam room as you'd be in person. 

Wider Circle's culture and care model are unique, and getting new hires ready to begin working with patients quickly — to a consistent standard — matters directly to patient experience and program outcomes. Most of your time will go toward onboarding Care Navigators, who are Wider Circle's first point of contact with patients. You'll train them to build trust with patients via phone and video interactions, complete health assessments, take clear and consistent notes, and schedule intake appointments. You'll also introduce them to Wider Circle's culture and the tools and systems we use to manage patient interactions.

This is a contract engagement reporting into Wider Circle's Learning & Development team. You'll take existing onboarding curricula and facilitator guides and use them with new hire cohorts — facilitating live remote sessions, managing logistics, grading and coaching, and feeding field-level insight back into the materials themselves. You will be an active partner in improving materials over time by noticing what isn't landing, flagging it, and helping fix it.

What You'll Do

### Training Delivery

- Serve as the face of Wider Circle to incoming new hires as you facilitate live video-based onboarding sessions to distributed new hires introducing health screening scripts, intake workflows, technology tools and systems, HIPAA and consent requirements, and escalation pathways
- Create a welcoming, engaging, participatory learning environment — role-play calls, coach in real time, and adjust pacing to the cohort in front of you
- Administer and grade final training assessments and provide clear, actionable feedback on homework and practice assignments
- Serve as the go-to point of contact for new hires during onboarding — answering questions, troubleshooting confusion, and flagging anyone falling behind before it becomes a problem

### Scheduling & Logistics

- Coordinate training cohort schedules with hiring managers and new hires, working around start dates and staffing needs
- Own day-to-day logistics for each cohort: calendar invites, session reminders, materials distribution, tool setup and tracking attendance and completion
- Communicate proactively with managers on cohort progress, readiness, and any scheduling conflicts

### Materials & Feedback Loop

- Distribute training materials, job aids, and assessments to new hires, and keep completion records accurate and audit-ready
- Build and maintain relationships with hiring managers across the roles you train, actively soliciting their feedback and incorporating it into updates to the relevant training curriculum, scripts, and materials — closing the loop between what's taught and what actually happens on the job

### Other Training Programs

- Take on onboarding delivery for other new hire roles as Wider Circle's hiring needs shift — expect this to be a regular part of the job, not a rare exception
- Support the wider Learning & Development team with other training program development and delivery as needed — content review, ad hoc facilitation, or logistics for adjacent programs (e.g., Care Advocate onboarding)
- Bring back patterns and insights from the training room that could improve L&D's broader programs

**Requirements**

What You Bring

The following are required for this role:

- Experience facilitating training in a healthcare, call center, care coordination, or comparable regulated environment — you're comfortable with HIPAA and compliance-sensitive content
- Demonstrated experience delivering live, remote training to new hire cohorts, including role-play, real-time coaching, grading assessments and troubleshooting technical challenges that can arise in remote training environments
- Strong scheduling and coordination skills — you can juggle multiple cohorts, managers, and calendars without dropping details
- Comfort giving direct, specific feedback on homework and assessments in a way new hires can act on
- Excellent written and verbal communication — you can hold a virtual room, explain a workflow clearly, and write feedback that lands
- Instructional design experience — you can suggest or draft improvements to materials, not just deliver them as-is – and can work with subject matter experts to turn their knowledge into engaging, interactive training
- Relationship-building skills: you build trust with managers quickly and know how to solicit honest feedback, not just collect compliments
- Organized and detail-oriented — accurate attendance, completion, and assessment records matter here
- Comfortable with LMS platforms (we use TalentLMS) and standard tools like Slack and Google Suite; able to learn Healthie or similar care platforms
- Ability to work independently and manage your own schedule in a remote, fast-changing environment
- Comfortable ramping up on and delivering training for a new role's curriculum on relatively short notice

Bonus Points For

- Prior experience as a Care Navigator, Community Health Worker, or other frontline patient/member-facing role at a health care organization
- Familiarity with value-based care, social determinants of health, or care coordination workflows
- Experience working in a start-up environment where processes and roles evolve quickly
- Bilingual (English/Spanish or another language relevant to Wider Circle's member population)

Ideal Candidate

  - Cares about setting new hires up to succeed, not just getting them through a checklist
  - Builds trust quickly — with new hires in the training and with managers on the other side of the feedback loop
  - Notices when something isn't working and says so, rather than waiting to be asked
  - Comfortable holding people to a standard while still being encouraging and approachable
  - Organized enough to run multiple cohorts and manager relationships at once without things slipping

**Benefits**

- Rate: $30–35/hour
- Type: Independent contractor, 1099
- Location: Remote (U.S.)
- Hours: 30–40/week
- Duration: Three months, with potential to renew as a contractor or convert to employee status depending on performance and business needs
- Reports to: Learning & Development team
- Partners with: Hiring managers across onboarding roles, Care Delivery Operations
