title: Principal Engineer
acceptedRemoteLocations: South America; Central America; Latin America
description:
**About Cocoon**

Cocoon is a seed-stage home intelligence and service platform that is redefining the future of homeownership by making it more proactive, intelligent and easier to manage. We have built and deployed a production platform and we are expanding through insurance carriers, real estate, mortgage and other embedded channels to help homeowners maintain and protect their homes.

Our platform connects property intelligence, homeowner engagement and service fulfillment to help homeowners better understand, maintain and protect their homes while enabling insurance carriers and other business partners to move from identifying property risk to addressing and verifying risk mitigation.

***The Role***

Cocoon is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer who combines the architectural judgment of a senior engineering leader with the desire to be deeply hands-on in software development. 

We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of Cocoon's core team, participate meaningfully in the company's success and operate with the ownership and responsibility expected of a senior company leader.

Serving as Cocoon's primary internal technical authority and source of technical truth, you will own technical architecture and engineering decisions in alignment with the company's product and business priorities.

You will inherit an existing sophisticated platform rather than a greenfield environment. Your responsibility will be to understand that system deeply, determine what should be preserved, identify what should be improved and lead the evolution of the platform's technical foundation in line with product and business strategy.

One of your core initial responsibilities will be evolving Cocoon's data architecture from its current relatively flat structure into a robust relational model capable of supporting increasingly sophisticated property intelligence, automation and AI capabilities.

You will work alongside an engineering team including, a senior full-stack engineer, business analyst, and specialized outsourced resources. You may also have other engineering support as required.

**Core Responsibilities**

*Technical Architecture & Leadership*
* Serve as Cocoon's primary internal authority on system architecture, data architecture, system design and engineering quality. 
* Own technical architecture and engineering decisions.
* Spearhead Cocoon's efforts to build native AI-driven capabilities into its products, platform and engineering workflows.

*Hands-On Backend Engineering*
* Remain deeply hands-on in Cocoon's codebase and personally develop production software. 
* Enter an established codebase, understand it quickly and determine what should be retained, refactored or replaced.
* Help shape product ideas and requirements alongside Cocoon team members before specifications are finalized.

*Data Architecture*
* Lead evolution of Cocoon's existing data architecture into a sophisticated relational domain model. 
* Define schemas, relationships, data-access patterns and integrity standards.
* Develop safe migration strategies for evolving an active production database. 
* Account for both structured and unstructured information as Cocoon's AI capabilities expand. 
* Build a data foundation capable of supporting substantially greater intelligence, automation and scale over time.

*AI-Native Engineering & Environment*
* Be AI-native in how you work, actively using AI development tools to improve engineering speed and quality.
* Identify and develop AI-native capabilities that add meaningful value to Cocoon’s platform capabilities and user experiences.

*Infrastructure & DevOps Oversight*
* Ensure infrastructure decisions remain aligned with Cocoon's application architecture. 
* Maintain appropriate visibility into security, reliability, deployment architecture, performance & cost. 
* Provide technical direction and oversight to Cocoon's outsourced AWS/DevOps engineer.

*Enterprise & Partner Technical Leadership*
* As required, represent Cocoon in technical discussions with insurance carriers, technology partners and other external stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Exceptional Backend Engineering & Architectural Judgment:** 8+ years of professional, including backend, engineering experience at a Senior/Staff/Principal/Architect level, with exceptional hands-on development capability and significant production Java experience. Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Security and Hibernate/JPA strongly preferred.

**Deep Relational Data Architecture Expertise:** Proven ownership of complex production relational data models at real scale. Strong PostgreSQL experience (Cocoon currently uses Aurora PostgreSQL).

**Strong System Design & API Architecture Capability:** Demonstrated ability to design sophisticated production systems and REST APIs, understand distributed-system tradeoffs, with real experience improving an already-established codebase, not only building greenfield. 

**AI-Native Engineering Capability:** Demonstrated ability to use modern AI-assisted development tools to materially improve engineering productivity and quality, while applying the technical judgment needed to critically evaluate AI-generated work.

**Production Applied-AI Experience (Highly Preferred):** Meaningful hands-on experience implementing and operating production AI solutions, including agentic capabilities, working with multimodal approaches, or in particular computer-vision capabilities, including architecture, evaluation, retrieval, reliability, and production operations.

**Strong Cloud & Production Infrastructure Fluency:** Experience with AWS-hosted production systems (EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM, VPC networking), containers, CI/CD and modern cloud deployment architecture.

**Production Engineering Discipline:** Strong understanding of application security, automated testing, observability, reliability, performance and maintainability. Builds systems designed to operate reliably in production, not simply function in development.

**Technical Leadership & Independent Judgment:** Experience directing senior engineers and serving as a trusted technical authority. Comfortable making consequential decisions with incomplete information, surfacing risks early, challenging assumptions, and recommending a clear path forward.

**How You Work**

**Owner's Mindset, Professional Maturity & Communication:** Operates like an owner, not a ticket-taker. Takes responsibility for outcomes, moves quickly without sacrificing quality, disagrees productively, communicates clearly, and credibly represents Cocoon with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Genuine Engineering Craft:** Still loves building software and is comfortable operating without a large engineering organization around them.

**Thrives in a Startup Environment:** Acts independently while collaborating effectively within a small team. Knows how to get things done and works quickly without requiring a high degree of oversight.

**Why Join Cocoon**

* Meaningful equity options and participation in the company's long-term success 
* Direct working relationship with Cocoon's Founder & CEO 
* Genuine ownership of Cocoon's technical architecture and engineering direction 
* Opportunity to remain deeply hands-on while operating at the highest technical level in the company 
* Small, senior team with substantial individual autonomy and impact 
* Fully remote working environment
* Opportunity to shape Cocoon's products and engineering organization with AI

title: Full-Stack Developer — CTO Right-hand
description:
[Nina Purple](https://ninapurple.love) is building a more intentional way for people to create healthier relationships and community.

We are not building another high-volume swipe, dating, or transactional social platform. We are building a relationship-enhancement platform centered on trust, depth, safety, belonging, and meaningful human connection.

We are looking for a strong Full-Stack Developer to support our Founder / CTO in building, stabilizing, and evolving the Nina Purple platform.

This is an equity-first, founding-stage builder role. You will work closely with the founding developer on real product work: turning member and operating needs into reliable product experiences, improving platform quality, and helping build the technical foundation that can support Nina Purple’s first meaningful community.

You will not be joining a large engineering team with a finished roadmap and detailed specifications for every feature. You will work in an early-stage environment where priorities evolve with member learning, product readiness, trust and safety requirements, and the practical needs of the business.

**What you will do**

• Work directly with the Founder / CTO to ship, maintain, test, and improve Nina Purple’s web and/or mobile product experience.

• Build full-stack features across the member journey, including interest and intake flows, onboarding, profile completion, notifications, matching or connection workflows, member communication, event/community touchpoints, feedback capture, and re-engagement.

• Improve product reliability, usability, performance, accessibility, observability, and the developer workflow.

• Help translate member-feedback, customer-experience, operations, and partnership requirements into well-scoped technical work.

• Write clean, maintainable, secure code; participate in code review; document important systems and decisions; and help reduce technical debt responsibly.

• Build internal tools, lightweight administration workflows, dashboards, and integrations that reduce manual founder and team work without compromising privacy, trust, or the human experience.

• Support product analytics and experimentation, including event instrumentation and insight into onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and lifecycle behaviour.

• Contribute to appropriate trust, privacy, consent, authentication, data-handling, and security practices for a platform involving sensitive personal and relationship-related information.

• Help evaluate technical trade-offs and vendors when needed. You will bring recommendations and independent judgment; final calls on platform architecture, technology vendors, and product/technology direction remain with the Founder / CTO.

**What success looks like**

In the first 30 days, you will understand the existing codebase, deployment workflow, product priorities, known defects, technical constraints, and the member journey Nina Purple is trying to support. You will deliver at least one well-scoped improvement or bug fix and agree on a practical development rhythm with the Founder / CTO.

By 60 days, you will be reliably shipping scoped work, contributing to a prioritized technical backlog, improving documentation and testing where most valuable, and supporting the instrumentation or internal tools needed to understand member onboarding and activation.

By 90 days, you will have delivered meaningful product improvements tied to member or operational needs, reduced a defined technical or founder dependency, and contributed to a clear 6–12 month technical roadmap covering platform reliability, product learning, trust and safety, scalability, and engineering capacity.

**What you bring**

• Strong hands-on full-stack development experience, ideally 3+ years in a production environment or equivalent demonstrated work.

• Ability to work across front end, back end, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, and deployment workflows.

• Experience working in an early-stage startup, small product team, agency, or high-ownership engineering environment is highly valuable.

• A portfolio, GitHub profile, deployed product, or code sample that demonstrates production-quality work.

• Strong product judgment: you can turn an ambiguous user or operating problem into a sensible technical approach, ask the right questions, estimate trade-offs, and ship incrementally.

• Comfort with modern web development practices, version control, code review, testing, debugging, deployment, monitoring, and documentation.

• A security- and privacy-conscious mindset. Nina Purple is a trust-centered platform; we need someone who takes personal data, consent, authentication, and sensitive user experiences seriously.

• Comfort with product analytics, event instrumentation, and experimentation is valuable. Experience with PostHog or comparable analytics tools is a plus.

• Clear written communication and the discipline to work independently in a remote, early-stage environment.

• Genuine interest in building technology that supports healthier, more intentional human connection.

**Technical environment**

Our exact technical priorities will be discussed with qualified applicants based on the current codebase and roadmap. Please tell us which stacks, frameworks, databases, cloud platforms, mobile technologies, analytics tools, and deployment practices you have used in production.

We are especially interested in candidates with relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:

• JavaScript / TypeScript
• React / Next.js or comparable modern front-end frameworks
• Node.js or comparable back-end development
• Mobile development: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, or comparable
• REST APIs, GraphQL, third-party integrations, webhooks
• SQL / PostgreSQL and data modeling
• Authentication, identity verification, permissions, and secure user-data handling
• Cloud deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, and logging
• Product analytics and event instrumentation, including PostHog or comparable tools
• Testing, QA, accessibility, performance, and application security

**How the role works**

The Founder / CTO owns Nina Purple’s product vision, architecture, technology vendors, platform roadmap, and final technical decisions. This role supports that founding technical leadership by bringing hands-on engineering capacity, strong technical judgment, and reliable execution.

The successful candidate will help build the platform and the internal technical foundations that allow the company to learn from early members, improve the product responsibly, and grow without creating unnecessary technical or operational fragility.

**Compensation**

This is an equity-first, founding-stage role. There is no guaranteed cash salary at the start of the engagement.

The successful candidate will be expected to make a real, sustained contribution to building Nina Purple’s product and technical foundation. In exchange, compensation is structured initially as sweat equity: the candidate’s committed time, expertise, and demonstrated value creation are converted into equity, subject to vesting and formal legal agreements.

The eventual equity percentage will be co-constructed based on realistic capacity, length of commitment, the market value of the candidate’s contribution, scope of accountability, technical complexity, and the durable value created for Nina Purple.

Any future cash compensation is conditional on Nina Purple generating sufficient revenue and reaching an agreed financial trigger, budget, and cash-flow position. It is not guaranteed at the beginning of the engagement.

This role is not suitable for someone seeking immediate conventional salary compensation. It is for a builder who understands early-stage risk, wants meaningful ownership, and is prepared to help create long-term company value.

title: Head of Customer Experience (CX)
description:
[Nina Purple](https://ninapurple.love) is building a more intentional way for people to create healthier relationships and community.

We are not building another high-volume swipe, dating, or transactional social platform. We are building an experience grounded in trust, depth, safety, belonging, and meaningful human connection.

We are seeking a Head of Customer Experience (CX) to build the member-experience engine behind that promise.

This is an early-stage, high-ownership role. You will help us learn who our earliest members are, how to welcome and activate them with care, what makes them return, and how to build a repeatable community model without losing the human quality that makes Nina Purple matter.

**What you will do**

• Own the end-to-end member journey: qualified interest, intake, onboarding, profile completion, first meaningful participation, repeat engagement, referral, re-engagement, and respectful offboarding.

• Define and track the member lifecycle: interested, onboarded, activated, engaged, connected, retained, and referred.

• Build a high-trust onboarding and activation model. Identify which moments require human care, trust-building, discretion, or safety judgment, and systemize administrative work such as intake, reminders, scheduling, profile completion, event communications, follow-up, feedback requests, and re-engagement.

• Help build Nina Purple’s first meaningful community: a concentrated early cohort of members who participate, return, give credible feedback, and invite trusted people into the experience.

• Test high-trust acquisition and activation channels with the Founder, COO, and future CMO function: curated experiences, aligned community partnerships, referrals, ambassadors, and targeted organic outreach. Measure channel quality, not only sign-ups.

• Create a disciplined member-feedback and learning system: capture feedback, centralize it, identify patterns, lead a recurring Member Learning Review, maintain an experiment and decision log, and ensure relevant insight reaches product and operating decisions.

• Build CX dashboards, operating cadence, service standards, playbooks, escalation pathways, and a sustainable capacity model for future CX coordinators, hosts, ambassadors, facilitators, contractors, or partners.

• Help reduce unnecessary founder dependency while maintaining the human, safe, and intentional quality of the Nina Purple experience.

**What success looks like**

In the first 90 days, you will map the member journey; establish lifecycle definitions, a member record, a CX risk register, and a weekly operating snapshot; launch a repeatable onboarding and activation flow; implement a member-feedback process and Member Learning Review; and provide a 6–12 month CX operating and capacity roadmap.

Over 6–12 months, success means Nina Purple has evidence of a repeatable path from qualified interest to meaningful participation, return, and advocacy, with a transferable CX playbook and a clear decision on expansion readiness.

**What you bring**

• 5+ years of experience in customer experience, customer success, community, operations, marketplaces, memberships, hospitality, or product-adjacent experience in an early-stage or high-growth environment.

• Experience turning a highly manual or founder-led member/customer journey into a measurable, repeatable operating system.

• Strong judgment about when human care matters and when process or automation improves the experience.

• Experience with onboarding, activation, retention, re-engagement, journey mapping, service design, customer/member research, feedback systems, and community operations.

• Comfort using data and qualitative insight together. Experience with PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CRM tools, Airtable, Notion, Asana, or similar tools is valuable.

• Excellent written communication, facilitation, and operational judgment.

• Mature judgment around trust, consent, privacy, safety, inclusion, and community dynamics.

• Genuine interest in healthier relationships, intentional community, and human connection.

**How the role works**

The Founder retains final authority over mission, product roadmap, platform architecture, technology vendors, technical development, and major strategic decisions. The COO function owns company-wide internal operations, organizational build-out, and internal systems. The future CMO function owns brand and top-of-funnel growth.

The Head of CX owns the member experience after qualified interest enters the journey and works across these functions to ensure growth does not outpace trust, quality, or operational readiness.

**Compensation**

**This is an equity-first, founding-stage role.** There is no guaranteed cash salary at the start of the engagement.

The successful candidate will be expected to make a real, sustained commitment to building Nina Purple’s member-experience engine. In exchange, compensation is structured initially as sweat equity: the candidate’s committed time, expertise, and demonstrated value creation are converted into equity, subject to vesting and formal legal agreements.

The eventual equity percentage will be co-constructed based on:

• Realistic weekly capacity and length of commitment.
• The market value of the candidate’s contribution.
• The scope of accountability accepted.
• The durable assets and outcomes created for Nina Purple.
• The degree to which the work increases company value: trusted member acquisition, activation, retention, referrals, product learning, community health, and reduced founder dependency.
• Agreed time- and milestone-based vesting.

Any future cash compensation is conditional on Nina Purple generating sufficient revenue and on an agreed financial trigger, budget, and company cash-flow position. It is not guaranteed at the beginning of the engagement.

This is not a suitable role for someone seeking immediate conventional salary compensation. It is designed for a senior builder who believes in the mission, understands early-stage risk, and wants to co-create a valuable company over the long term.

title: AI Provider Operations
description:

description:
**The Role**

Rabbit (an innovative product by Aliz) helps enterprises cut their GCP spend — and the difference between a customer who saves millions and one who churns is the engineer standing next to them during adoption. We’re hiring a Customer Engineer to be that person for our customers across the US and the broader Americas.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role. Your focus is making customers successful: gluing Rabbit into each customer’s GCP environment, getting them onboarded and integrated, and keeping them unblocked so the product delivers real savings on their workloads. You’ll work closely with the core engineering team, but your center of gravity is the customer, not the roadmap.

Initial domain: BigQuery cost optimization — slot management, reservation models, job-level optimization, query analysis at petabyte scale. As Rabbit’s optimization scope expands across GCP, so will yours.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* Own technical adoption for a portfolio of enterprise customers — onboarding, configuration, and integrating Rabbit into their GCP setup until they hit first measurable savings
* Be the go-to technical contact when something breaks — investigate, debug, and fix issues across data anomalies, pipelines, and BigQuery cost questions
* Advise customers on GCP cost strategy — BigQuery reservation models, slot management, billing mechanics — and how Rabbit fits in
* Run technical Q&A, troubleshooting sessions, and hands-on workshops with customer teams
* Relay field signal back to Product and Engineering — you’ll have more customer context than anyone, and the core team builds on what you surface
* When the product genuinely can’t cover a customer need, build a custom solution to bridge the gap — but the goal is always to fold that need back into the platform, not to maintain bespoke one-offs

**How We Work — AI-First, Agentic by Default**

Rabbit is an AI-first company. Agentic development practices are mandatory, not optional — Claude Code, Cursor, and agent-driven workflows are how we move. You’ll use them to integrate, debug, and unblock customers in hours, not days.

**You Should Have**

Must-have:
* 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role — Customer/Solutions Engineering, Professional
* Services, TAM, or similar — with real hands-on engineering, not just advisory
* Deep BigQuery expertise — slots, reservations, pricing models, INFORMATION_SCHEMA, query optimization. Hard requirement; we’ll test for it.
* Strong SQL, and comfort in backend code (any language) — enough to integrate, script, and debug in a customer’s environment
* Hands-on GCP experience — you’ve worked with production workloads on Google Cloud
* Customer-facing instinct — you can run a technical conversation with an enterprise team without an Account Executive holding your hand
* Fluent with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) on real production work — not just demos
* Autonomy — small team, no middle management, you own customer outcomes

Strong plus:
* GCP cost management, FinOps, or cloud billing optimization background
* Familiarity with BigQuery reservation models, slot pricing, and workload management
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform on GCP)

**Why This Role**

* Direct customer impact. You see your work land in dollars saved on real workloads, customer by customer.
* Hard problems, hands-on. BigQuery optimization at petabyte scale, real-world anomalies, messy integrations — not generic SaaS onboarding.
* Short path to the product. What you surface from the field shapes what the core team builds next.
* Own the relationship. Small team, real ownership over whether your customers succeed.

title: Co-founder - Sales, GTM & Revenue | FlickerBytes Private Limited | Hyderabad, India | Founder-level | Equity + Performance-linked earnings
description:
**About FlickerBytes**
FlickerBytes is building technology at the intersection of regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, privacy and AI.
Our vision is ambitious: to build a technology-led company that helps organizations navigate an increasingly complex regulatory and cybersecurity environment - beginning with India and expanding globally.
We are building products that combine deep compliance expertise with modern technology and AI, rather than treating compliance as a purely consulting exercise.
Our products are already built and usable. We have two technology products with global applicability, and parts of the platform are already being used by active clients.
Now we are looking for the person who can take what has been built and turn it into a business.
________________________________________
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Co-founder – Sales, GTM & Revenue to own the commercial side of FlickerBytes.
* This is not a conventional sales or marketing job.
* You will not be joining an established sales organization with an existing pipeline, marketing team, SDR team and predefined targets.
* You will be building that organization with us.
* Your mission is simple:
* Build the revenue engine, win customers, build relationships, create the sales organization and help make FlickerBytes a category leader.
* You will own the journey from the first conversation to a signed customer - and eventually help build the team and systems that can do this at scale.
________________________________________
**What You Will Own**
1. Sales & Revenue
•	Build and own the sales pipeline for India and international markets.
•	Identify and approach potential customers and decision-makers.
•	Generate conversations with CXOs, CISOs, CIOs, DPOs, compliance heads, risk leaders and business owners.
•	Run discovery calls, product demonstrations and commercial discussions.
•	Own proposals, negotiations and closures.
•	Build relationships that result in repeat business, referrals and strategic accounts.
•	Establish a predictable sales process and revenue pipeline.
2. Market Development
You should already understand - or be capable of quickly building relationships within - markets where compliance, cybersecurity and regulatory requirements are business-critical.
Examples include:
•	BFSI / Banks / NBFCs
•	Healthcare
•	IT / ITES
•	SaaS and technology companies
•	Regulated enterprises
•	Financial services
•	Organizations dealing with privacy, cybersecurity and regulatory requirements
Existing professional networks and industry relationships will be a significant advantage.
We are particularly interested in people who can say:
“I know the market. I know the people. I know who has this problem. Let me start the conversations.”
3. Marketing & Positioning
You will also help build the company's market presence:
•	Define ICP and target segments.
•	Develop positioning and messaging.
•	Build outbound and inbound campaigns.
•	Drive LinkedIn, content, events and industry outreach.
•	Build partnerships and channel relationships.
•	Represent FlickerBytes in relevant industry forums and communities.
•	Convert market feedback into product and GTM priorities.
You do not need to be a specialist content marketer.
You do need to know how to create demand and convert it into revenue.
4. Build the Sales Organization
Initially, you will be hands-on.
Over time, you will help us build:
•	Sales processes
•	CRM and pipeline management
•	Outreach systems
•	Sales playbooks
•	Channel partnerships
•	Sales team
•	Account management processes
•	Revenue forecasting
The expectation is not that you remain a salesperson forever.
The expectation is that you build the revenue function.
________________________________________
**What We Already Have**
You will not be starting with an idea on a whiteboard.
We already have:
•	Working technology products
•	A technology and product foundation
•	Global applicability
•	Active client engagements
•	Compliance and cybersecurity capabilities
•	Product roadmap and technology capabilities
•	A founding team building the technology and delivery side
What we need now is someone who can take this to market aggressively and intelligently.
In simple terms:
The product exists. The opportunity exists. We need someone to build the business around it.
________________________________________
This Is Founder Economics - Not a Traditional Salary Job
We want to be completely transparent about this before you apply.
There is no fixed salary from Day One.
This is a founder-level opportunity where the initial economics are primarily aligned to ownership and performance, rather than a conventional employment package.
The broad model is:
1. Equity
You will have the opportunity to earn meaningful founder-level equity, based on your experience, commitment, responsibility and measurable contribution to the company.
Equity will not simply be given for joining.
It will be structured around value creation, contribution and long-term commitment.
2. Performance-linked earnings
You will receive a variable/commission component linked to the business you generate, subject to the agreed commercial structure.
If you create revenue, you participate in the upside.
3. Salary as the business reaches the appropriate stage
As FlickerBytes crosses an agreed revenue/business baseline, we intend to introduce a formal compensation structure, including a fixed salary component appropriate to the company's stage and the role.
The exact economics will be discussed transparently with shortlisted candidates.
________________________________________
**What We Expect From You**
This opportunity is for someone who genuinely wants to build something, not simply take another job.
We expect you to:
•	Take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
•	Be comfortable with uncertainty.
•	Build relationships from scratch.
•	Spend significant time in the market.
•	Open doors that the founding team cannot open alone.
•	Personally drive important sales conversations.
•	Own the number.
•	Be willing to put in the effort required to create momentum.
•	Stay involved beyond the first sale.
•	Build the team and process as the company grows.
•	Think like an owner because you will have ownership.
There will be a lot of freedom.
There will also be a lot of accountability.
________________________________________
**Who Should Apply**
You may be a strong fit if:
•	You have substantial B2B / enterprise technology sales experience.
•	You have sold into BFSI, NBFC, healthcare, SaaS, IT services or other regulated industries.
•	You already have a meaningful professional network.
•	You can independently originate opportunities rather than waiting for marketing-qualified leads.
•	You are comfortable selling to senior decision-makers.
•	You understand long enterprise sales cycles.
•	You can move between strategy and execution.
•	You have entrepreneurial or founder experience.
•	You want meaningful ownership in what you build.
•	You are motivated by creating enterprise value, not just monthly compensation.
Most importantly:
You should be a seller who wants to become a builder.
________________________________________
**Who Should NOT Apply**
Please do not apply if you are primarily looking for:
•	A conventional salaried employment opportunity from Day One.
•	A guaranteed monthly income without corresponding business ownership.
•	A narrowly defined sales role where leads, marketing and infrastructure are provided to you.
•	A quick-money opportunity.
•	A side project while your primary focus remains elsewhere.
•	An opportunity to build your own competing product or company alongside this role.
•	A role where someone else owns the difficult parts of sales and you only manage existing accounts.
•	A position where success is measured by activity rather than revenue and business outcomes.
If your primary question is “What is the fixed salary?”, this probably isn't the right opportunity.
If your question is “What can we build together, and what can I own if I create significant value?”, we should talk.
________________________________________
**The Vision**
We are not trying to build another small compliance consulting firm.
Our ambition is significantly larger.
We want to combine:
Regulatory expertise + Cybersecurity + Compliance + AI + Software
into a technology-led business that can operate across India and global markets.
Our near-term ambition is to establish FlickerBytes as a leading company in India in this space, and over time build a globally recognized company in regulatory technology, compliance and cybersecurity.
That will require people who are willing to build before everything is perfect.
________________________________________
**Why This Could Be Extraordinary**
If you are successful here, you won't simply have:
“Head of Sales” on your CV.
You will have helped build the commercial engine of a technology company from the ground up.
You will have:
•	Built the first major customer relationships.
•	Created the GTM strategy.
•	Built the sales process.
•	Built the pipeline.
•	Built the sales team.
•	Helped shape the product based on market demand.
•	Created revenue.
•	Participated directly in the value you helped create.
And you will have meaningful ownership in that journey.
We are looking for someone who wants to own the game - not just play a position in it.
If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

title: QA Intern | Black-Box Testing
description:
Tutcart is hiring two QA interns to test our product and help us catch problems before they reach users. If you enjoy figuring out why something isn't working and can explain it clearly, we'd like to hear from you.

You'll focus on manual, black-box testing: checking how the product behaves without needing access to the source code. That means trying real user journeys, looking beyond the obvious cases and documenting what you find.

## The details
- **Openings:** 2
- **Location:** Remote worldwide. Applicants outside India are welcome. Working onsite in Delhi NCR is also an option.
- **Compensation:** This is an unpaid internship with no salary or stipend.
- **Experience:** No prior professional experience required.
- **Schedule:** Start date, duration, weekly hours and any time-zone overlap will be agreed during selection.

## What you'll do
- Write test cases and checklists from product requirements and user journeys.
- Test everyday actions as well as invalid inputs, boundary values and less obvious scenarios.
- Run functional, exploratory, smoke and regression tests.
- Check forms, error messages and layouts across browsers and screen sizes.
- Log bugs with clear steps to reproduce, expected and actual results, and screenshots or recordings where useful.
- Retest fixes and explain which issues have the greatest impact on users.

## What we're looking for
You pay attention to detail, follow a problem through and keep useful notes. You can describe an issue clearly enough for someone else to reproduce it, and you're comfortable asking questions when the expected behaviour is unclear.

Basic knowledge of manual testing is helpful, whether you've picked it up through coursework, personal projects or self-study. Students, recent graduates and people starting out in QA are welcome to apply.

Familiarity with bug trackers, browser developer tools, boundary-value analysis or equivalence partitioning is a plus. Coding and automation experience are not required.

## What you'll learn by doing
You'll practise turning requirements into test cases, investigating unexpected behaviour and writing bug reports developers can act on. You'll also see how fixes are checked and how regression testing helps prevent old problems from returning.

## Apply
Apply through Wellfound with a short introduction, your time zone and availability. Tell us what interests you about testing. If you already have a sample bug report or test checklist from a personal or academic project, you're welcome to include it. There is no need to create a new assignment to apply.

Disha Naagar and Dhriti Gupta are coordinating applications for this role.

Bizora.ai is revolutionizing the tax and accounting space with AI-driven solutions tailored for accountants, tax professionals, and SMBs. We're building an AI co-pilot to transform tax workflows, drive efficiency, and simplify compliance.

**Why do we work?**
We now live in a world where the government is involved in every aspect of our lives. You wake up in the morning and make yourself some coffee, the coffee beans were imported from abroad and came to the US through official channels that had to go through customs and duties, then it had to be verified that it met the health code from the Food and Drug Administration. Then another government agency verifies that the price set to purchase these coffee beans were not anti-competitive, it was sent to the grocery store in trucks that was governed by the transportation department and finally you purchased it most likely with a credit card that was governed under the laws of the Federal Reserve . 

Now let's say you want to start a coffee business, you and only you in the world know the best way to make coffee beans that will truly revolutionize how we do this. But given the above steps do you know how you will get your product to market? You will have to go ahead and find an advisor, lawyer, accountant and every kind of specialist to make sure you go through the correct channels to get your product to market. We agree that government regulation is required to ensure consumers are protected but at the same time there needs to be a balance so as to not stifle innovation. We have seen the effects on those economies where too much regulation completely rooted out any kind of innovation because it was too cumbersome to make anything new. 

Thus, with Bizora our goal is not limited to providing assistance with tax compliance but helping businesses succeed by making sure a person starting a business in their bedroom has all the tools needed to go from idea to market without having to jump through so many hoops. title: Territory Partner (Field Sales)
description:
# **The Role**

Omada AI is the AI marketing platform built for small businesses — and we grow the old-fashioned way: in person, face to face, business by business. Territory Partners are the front line of that motion.

This is a true field sales role. You'll walk into local businesses, pitch owners directly, and get them live on Omada the same day. You find your own prospects, build your own pipeline, and close your own deals. There's no cold-call center behind you and no calendar of pre-booked meetings waiting when you log in — the TPs who win here are the ones who don't need one.

If you've done outside sales before and you know the feeling of turning an empty morning into three signed customers by dinner, keep reading.

# **What You'll Do**

- **Prospect your territory relentlessly.** Identify, approach, and pitch local SMBs — walk-ins, door pulls, referrals, local networking, whatever works. You own your pipeline end to end.
- **Sell in person.** Pitch business owners face to face and get them started in a live free trial on the spot — we don't do demos or demo accounts. You build their system on their real business, with their real content, in front of them.
- **Run the full sales cycle.** From first conversation through trial activation to paid conversion, the deal is yours.
- **Master the product fast.** Omada is straightforward to learn and pitch — most reps are confidently selling within their first day or two. The hard part isn't the product; it's the hustle. That's why we hire for the hustle.
- **Report and improve daily.** Track your activity, present your accounts in team reviews, and sharpen your close rate week over week.

# **How We Set You Up to Win**

- **Two-week apprenticeship.** You start paired with a veteran Territory Partner: shadow their pitches, then prospect together, then close your own deals with their help (with commission split during the ramp). No classroom fluff — you learn this job by doing this job next to someone who's great at it.
- **Proving Ground.** Our performance-gated ramp structure rewards producers quickly. Hit your numbers and your earnings and territory opportunities grow with you.
- **A real career ladder.** TP → Vanguard → City Captain → State Director → Regional Director → Country Manager. We promote from the field, full stop.
- **A product that sells.** SMB owners need marketing help, most can't afford an agency, and Omada does the work of one for a fraction of the price. When you get in front of the right owner, this sells.

# **Who We're Looking For**

**Required:**

- Proven field / outside sales experience — you've sold face to face before (D2D, B2B field, territory sales, retail energy/telecom/payments, or similar) and you have the numbers to show for it
- Demonstrated self-prospecting ability — you've built your own pipeline from zero and you're comfortable walking into a business cold
- Closer's mentality — you ask for the business, handle objections in the moment, and don't leave without a next step
- Self-managed and disciplined — you run your day like a business owner, because as a 1099 contractor, you are one
- Reliable transportation and the ability to work your territory in person daily

**You'll thrive here if:**

- You'd rather be paid for what you produce than for showing up
- You like small business owners and can talk to a plumber, a salon owner, and a realtor in the same afternoon
- You're energized (not intimidated) by rejection volume
- You want a shot at building and leading a market, not just working one

**This is not for you if:**

- You're looking for a role where meetings are booked for you
- You need warm leads handed over to get going
- You've only sold over the phone or by email and aren't sure about face-to-face

# **Compensation**

Commission-based with performance-gated ramp compensation through our Proving Ground structure. Top producers earn well above typical field sales roles — your income is a direct function of your production. Full details shared during the interview process.

# **About Omada AI**

Omada AI is a Seattle-headquartered AI marketing platform for small businesses, backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital. We're growing fast across the US and promoting our field leaders as we go.

**Ready to own a territory?** Apply now — our hiring process moves quickly, including a short async video interview and a conversation with a field leader in your region.

title: Social Media Intern
description:
**About Sanctory  **

At Sanctory, we are on a continuous quest to source the finest products from every corner of the world. Our mission is to provide these products to our patrons in their purest, natural, and most authentic form. Our partners in this journey—winemakers, farmers, and artisans—craft their products with the highest skills and traditions, fearlessly expressing their craft without bowing to market demands. Sanctory is a space for this beautiful interaction between our like-minded customers and these dedicated producers. 

**Position Overview  **

Sanctory is seeking a highly motivated Social Media Intern to join our team. This role is ideal for someone passionate about storytelling, content creation, and building genuine communities online. As a Social Media Intern, you will work closely with our marketing and brand teams to bring Sanctory's world—our farmers, our craft, our products—to life across social platforms. Your role will involve turning the stories behind each harvest, each process, and each producer into content that connects with our audience. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in brand storytelling, content strategy, and community building for a company rooted in heritage and authenticity. 

**Key Responsibilities: **

1. Planning, creating, and scheduling content across social media platforms (Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, etc.) 
2. Translate Sanctory's brand ethos and product stories—from farm to table—into engaging captions, reels, and posts. 
3. Support the creation of content calendars aligned with campaigns, product launches, and seasonal moments. 
4. Collaborate with the design and marketing teams to develop visual and written content that feels authentic to the brand. 
5. Monitor social media trends, platform updates, and audience engagement to inform content decisions. 
6. Track and analyze performance metrics (engagement, reach, growth) to identify what resonates with our community. 
7. Engage with our online community by responding to comments, messages, and building genuine relationships with followers. 
8. Research and identify potential collaborations, influencers, or storytelling partners aligned with Sanctory's values. 
 
**What We're Looking For **

1. A background or strong interest in social media marketing, content creation, communications, or storytelling. 
2. A natural storyteller with the ability to turn process, craft, and heritage into compelling, relatable content. 
3. Familiarity with social media platforms, content formats (reels, carousels, short-form video), and scheduling tools. 
4. Basic understanding of content design tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere/Photoshop, or similar (not mandatory, but a plus). 
5. Strong writing skills with an eye for tone, voice, and audience. 
6. Good understanding of current social media trends and what drives engagement. 
7. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with attention to detail. 
8. A portfolio or examples of past content (personal, academic, or professional) demonstrating storytelling and creativity.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
**About Stepful**:

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with [_a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT_](https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-announces-55m-series-c-to-scale-its-ai-powered-training-platform-across-the-healthcare-workforce). [_We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025_](https://www.stepful.com/post/stepful-named-1-edtech-company-in-us-top-10-globally-times-2025-list).

**Our values**:

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

- **Care first**: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.
- **Learn quickly**: We test, learn with data, and iterate.
- **Build together**: We win when we rely on each other.
- **Own it**: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

**The role:**

As our Staff Product Designer, you’ll be responsible for building rich, intuitive best in class experiences for students, instructors, and coaches. Your projects will range from designing delightful product experiences for students, maturing our design system, improving the platforms our coaches and instructors use daily and new products for Stepful partners.

**What you’ll do:**

- Use your product thinking, visual design, and system steward skills to design rich, intuitive best in class experiences for students, instructors and coaches
- Autonomously define opportunities and appropriate methodologies based on the shape of the problem, utilizing methods such as project prioritization and planning, conducting research, writing jobs to be done, mapping user flows, creating wireframes, prototyping, and designing high-quality workflows across our native and web apps
- Identify opportunities for and leverage both quantitative and qualitative data to guide your design decisions and utilize a hypothesis driven experimental mindset
- Collaborate closely with product, engineering, growth and operations to address challenges, manage trade-offs and get the team excited
- Own and mature our design system to evolve our patterns, components, styles and patterns across all products

**This job is for you if you have:**

- 8+ years of work experience with a focus on product design across a variety of platforms from mobile to web
- A deep understanding of the tech that powers digital products, and how to collaborate with engineering to make the most of emerging capabilities
- An end-to-end versus waterfall approach to product, able to apply a wide variety of product design skills (e.g., design thinking, design strategy, user problem definition, information architecture, service design)
- Experience driving user research to understand underlying pain points and needs and inform product strategy
- Experience building relationships with teammates, influencing decisions at a variety of levels and across multiple teams
- Experience or familiarity working with our tech stack: Figma, Claude, Storybook, Github, and Linear

**Bonus points if:**

- You have previous startup experience especially at B2B2C or B2C EdTech/Healthcare companies
- Experience with A/B testing or other experiment/data driven product development organizations

**Interview Process:**

In your application, please include a link to your portfolio showcasing relevant work samples. A portfolio submission is mandatory for consideration of your candidacy.

- Step 1: Screening call with Talent Acquisition
- Step 2: Whiteboarding session with the Hiring Manager
- Step 3: Portfolio Review with the Hiring Manager
- Step 4: Onsite interview at office in SoHo, NYC

**Compensation:**

New Hire Base Salary Bands:   
Staff I - $150,000-190,000  
  
Please note we do not have a bonus structure at this time so all cash compensation will come in the form of base salary. The total compensation package will also include our benefits package and an equity (ISOs) package.

Compensation for this role will fall within the pay range listed and will be determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications as well as interview evaluation. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

**Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

--

In light of recent hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will reach out to you directly from an **@stepful.com** email address to guide you through our interview process.

title: Front-End Software Engineer (Remote)
description:
As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth.

We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.

Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo — Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.

Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment — because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.

We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

**What You'll Do**

- **Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences.** Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code — we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.
- **Work across the stack.** Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.
- **Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code.** Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.
- **Prototype fast and validate with real users.** Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing — especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.
- **Build for scale and own the codebase.** Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.
- **Make automation legible and trustworthy.** Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.
- **Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability.** Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.
- **Share AI-native workflows.** Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

**Requirements**

A full-stack generalist who has taken a product from 0 to 1 and can apply that instinct inside a system that already has real patients on it. Entrepreneurial, willing to roll up their sleeves, and drawn to a mission that disrupts how healthcare gets delivered.

- 5+ Years of experience
- You are dangerous on the frontend of the stack.

- You are a highly skilled dev (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind and JavaScript).

- You also have backend skills (tRPC, Drizzle ORM, SQL, Node, SST).

- You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects or large areas of the codebase.

- Strong experience building paid products and services is preferred.

- React Native or Expo experience is a plus.

- You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints, and timelines.

- You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment.

title: Founding Engineer & Tech Lead: Help Us Fix How America's Retail Stores Restock

Independent stores in the US, like bodegas, corner stores and small grocers, still restock by phone calls, texts and PDF price sheets. Wholesale Hub puts their distributors in one place, so a store owner can buy from several suppliers in one checkout at real wholesale prices.

We launched in May 2026 and we're scaling quickly. A new supplier is bringing 75 of its retail locations onto the platform. We start raising our first round within the next three months, and we're building this company for the next ten years and beyond.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
### **About the Role**

We are seeking a **Senior Data Scientist** to help build and scale Northbeam's measurement products, including MMM, Incrementality, Insights, and Recommendation Systems.

This is an **applied data science role** focused on translating statistical and causal inference methodologies into reliable, production-grade systems. You will work across the full lifecycle of measurement products—from methodology evaluation and model development to implementation, deployment, monitoring, and customer support.

**This role emphasizes production implementation and operational ownership as much as statistical methodology.**

The ideal candidate combines strong statistical foundations with a builder mindset and is comfortable moving between modeling, software development, production operations, and customer-facing problem solving.

### **Your Impact**

- Build, deploy, and maintain production systems that power Northbeam's measurement products.
- Translate statistical and causal inference methodologies into scalable, reliable customer-facing capabilities.
- Improve the accuracy, coverage, reliability, and operational robustness of our measurement systems.
- Debug data, modeling, and production issues across the full stack, from source data to customer-facing outputs.
- Evaluate methodological improvements pragmatically, balancing statistical rigor, implementation complexity, maintainability, and business value.
- Partner closely with teammates across Data Science, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to improve measurement quality and product capabilities.
- Explain statistical concepts to customers, troubleshoot measurement issues, and gather feedback to improve Northbeam's products.

### **What You Bring**

- Bachelor's degree (MS or PhD preferred) in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or another highly quantitative field.

- Experience implementing, deploying, and supporting statistical or machine learning systems in production environments.
- Ability to debug issues across the full stack, including source data, data pipelines, model logic, production services, and customer-facing outputs.
- Experience owning projects end-to-end, from problem definition and methodology evaluation through production deployment and operational support.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment and driving projects from concept to production with a high degree of autonomy.

title: Enterprise Sales Engineer
description:
**Build a safer world with us, one incident at a time.**

Ambient.ai is the category creator and leader in Agentic Physical Security. Powered by Ambient Pulsar, the first reasoning Vision-Language Model purpose-built for physical security, our platform seamlessly integrates with existing security cameras and physical access control systems to unify monitoring, access control, threat assessment, response, and investigations through an always-on reasoning layer that augments security operators with superhuman capabilities. The results: 95% fewer false alarms, investigations 20x faster, and 10x faster response.

The momentum speaks for itself: we doubled new ARR in FY26, and have delivered results for world-class customers including Cisco, ServiceNow, SentinelOne, TikTok, Bayer, and MoMA. That kind of momentum creates an environment where great people thrive, and it shows: we recently ranked #71 out of 500 on the [Forbes best startup employers list](https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/).

Founded in 2017 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, and Allegion Ventures, Ambient.ai is on a fast-paced journey to fulfill our mission: prevent every security incident possible.

Ready to learn more? Connect with us on [**_LinkedIn_**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ambient-ai/?viewAsMember=true) and [ **_YouTube_**](https://www.youtube.com/@ambient-ai-inc)

**About the role:**

We’re looking for a high-performing Enterprise Sales Engineer who is excited to help win strategic accounts and bring Ambient.ai’s value to life for customers. You are a driven, curious, and customer-focused professional who enjoys translating technical capabilities into real business outcomes. In this pre-sales role, you’ll partner closely with Sales to deliver compelling product demos, support customer evaluations and pilots, and help prospects envision how Ambient.ai can improve security operations and reduce risk across their environments.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation and experience supporting complex technology sales. You’ll primarily support select in-region Enterprise accounts, while also partnering on channel-driven opportunities and high-value Commercial accounts as needed. You’ll play a key role in helping the field organization scale by bringing technical credibility, strong customer engagement, and a consultative approach across a range of selling motions.

**What you’ll do:**

- Partner with Regional Sales Managers to support complex sales cycles across select in-region Enterprise accounts, as well as channel sales and high-value Commercial opportunities
- Deliver compelling product demos and presentations to both technical and non-technical audiences across Enterprise, channel, and Commercial customer segments
- Support and lead technical evaluations, pilots, proof of concepts, and proof of value engagements with customers and partners
- Help customers and partners understand the technical and business value of Ambient.ai by connecting platform capabilities to their security priorities and operational goals
- Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, channel partners, and internal teams by providing technical guidance, answering questions, and recommending thoughtful solutions
- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Channel, and Engineering to share customer feedback, represent field needs, and help improve the product and customer experience
- Contribute to proposals, technical validation plans, partner enablement, and account strategy in partnership with Sales
- Support partner-facing technical conversations and help enable channel partners to effectively position and represent Ambient.ai
- Bring a consultative mindset to solving customer problems and helping move opportunities forward with strong preparation and execution across Enterprise, channel, and Commercial motions

**What you’ll bring:**

- 2–3+ years of experience in a Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or similar customer-facing technical pre-sales role
- Experience supporting technology sales in Enterprise, channel, and/or Commercial environments, ideally in SaaS and/or innovative hardware-enabled solutions
- Demonstrated success partnering with Sales on technical evaluations and multi-stakeholder customer engagements
- Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to a variety of audiences, including direct customers and partners
- Solid understanding of L2 switching, including VLANs, limitations of L2 vs. L3, and physical vs. logical network isolation
- Working knowledge of Linux networking basics, such as assigning IP/mask/gateway to NICs and configuring redundancy/failover concepts
- Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a customer-first mindset
- Ability to operate effectively across multiple routes to market, including direct sales, channel-led opportunities, and Commercial accounts
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Highly motivated, resourceful, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment

**Bonus points:**

title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
location: New York City; Washington DC; San Francisco; Washington
description:
**ABOUT ROCKET MONEY🔮**

Rocket Money’s mission is to meaningfully improve the financial prosperity of millions of people. Rocket Money offers members a unique understanding of their finances and a suite of valuable services that save them time and money – ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey.

**ABOUT THE TEAM 🤝**

The Agents Group is building the agentic systems that let Rocket Money move from helpful product surfaces to assistants that can safely and reliably finish work for customers. The group owns the system responsible for enabling agentic capabilities and the methods that let agents interact with customers and systems across various contact methods (phone, email, web bots, etc) and autonomous workflows.

This work sits at the intersection of LLM-powered reasoning, deterministic execution systems, tool orchestration, product constraints, observability, evaluation, trust and safety, and consumer-grade product craft. The bar is not “can the agent respond?” The bar is “can the agent correctly, safely, and verifiably complete the work?”

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will help build, evolve, and operate the Capabilities Engine: the core platform that makes agentic behavior reliable, reusable, observable, and production-ready across Rocket Money’s AI-powered experiences.

You will create the primitives that capability teams need to turn ambiguous product needs into shippable technical plans, prototypes, and durable systems. You will also partner with contact-method owners across phone, email, chat, web login, ODC, and autonomous workflows to make each method more agentic and better integrated with the Capabilities Engine. That means helping agents plan, discover and invoke capabilities, recover from ambiguity, handle real-world edge cases, and complete user-facing work safely and correctly.

This role is for an engineer who is excited by—and experienced in—AI as an execution layer, not just a conversation layer. You will build systems that let agents use tools, observe outcomes, recover from failure, and earn enough trust to act on behalf of users.

You will work across product and platform boundaries, moving between architecture, implementation, debugging, evaluation, and cross-functional collaboration. Success means making the Capabilities Engine easier to extend, operate, and integrate with; improving task completion and recovery across methods; and ensuring new capabilities ship with clear contracts, tests, traces, ownership, and production-readiness expectations.

**IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL:**

- Build, evolve, and operate the Capabilities Engine as a core platform for agentic product behavior.
- Design abstractions that make capabilities easy for agents and methods to discover, invoke, compose, observe, and improve.
- Partner with method owners across all contact method subagents as well as supporting agents to make each method more agentic and better integrated with the Capabilities Engine.
- Identify repeated patterns across methods and turn them into reusable capabilities, interfaces, evaluations, and operating practices.
- Provide guidance on how to monitor and optimize reliability, latency, cost, observability, and safety of capability execution in production.
- Develop practical evaluation loops for agentic behavior, including offline tests, production metrics, traces, regression suites, and qualitative review.
- Debug complex failures across model behavior, tool execution, orchestration, product constraints, and downstream systems.
- Translate ambiguous product needs into shippable technical plans, prototypes, and durable systems.
- Create the primitives capability teams need to successfully produce shippable technical plans, prototypes, and durable systems.
- Collaborate with product, design, data, platform, and operations partners to ensure capabilities are useful, understandable, and safe for real users.
- Mentor and develop engineers across the Agents Group, acting as a technical multiplier by sharing expertise, fostering a culture where others feel empowered to propose ideas and take on high-impact work, and helping shape the group's overall technical direction and standards.
- Document system behavior, capability contracts, tradeoffs, and operational expectations so other teams can build on the platform confidently.
- Drop into high-priority method work when needed to accelerate agentic behavior, unblock launches, or stabilize production issues.
- Stay curious about the frontier of applied AI engineering and help the team adopt new tools, patterns, and workflows where they make the product more dependable.

 

**YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:**

- Have experience shipping production software with strong engineering fundamentals.
- Are excited by AI as an execution layer. You understand that durable customer value comes from orchestration, tools, workflows, evaluation, approvals, observability, and recovery.
- Have hands-on experience or strong practical familiarity with LLM applications, agentic systems, tool calling, retrieval, workflow orchestration, or applied AI products.
- Have strong product judgment. You can reason from customer need to product experience to technical architecture, and you know the difference between a clever demo and a dependable customer-facing system.
- Are comfortable working across ambiguity. You can take a broad problem, identify the crux, sequence the work, make tradeoffs, and keep moving without waiting for perfect clarity.
- Like building platform abstractions and shared services that help multiple teams or product surfaces move faster.
- Hold a high bar for quality, reliability, and trust. You know that systems acting on behalf of users need clear contracts, observability, evaluation, and recovery paths.
- Are energized by debugging messy production behavior across model outputs, distributed systems, product logic, user context, and downstream integrations.
- Communicate clearly with engineering, product, design, data, operations, and platform partners.
- Are motivated to actively mentor and grow others.
- Are a tenacious learner who stays engaged with the frontier of AI engineering without chasing every shiny object.
- Are motivated by measurable customer and operational impact, not just interesting technical demos.

**STRONG CANDIDATES MAY HAVE:**

- Experience building production LLM applications, agentic systems, workflow engines, tool-calling systems, or AI-powered product surfaces.
- Experience designing capability platforms, shared services, orchestration systems, or reusable product infrastructure.
- Experience with TypeScript, Node, GraphQL, Postgres, LLM applications, agentic systems, and workflow orchestration.
- Experience creating evaluation and observability systems for probabilistic or agentic behavior.
- Experience improving reliability, alerting, tracing, incident response, operational quality, or other systems that make software safer and more dependable over time.
- Experience partnering deeply with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Legal, Support, or other cross-functional teams in a sensitive customer domain.
- Firsthand experience building products where customer trust, permissions, explainability, and recovery paths are central to the experience.
- A visible habit of turning repeated one-off work into reusable systems, patterns, and documentation.

**WE OFFER 💫**

- Health, Dental & Vision Plans
- Competitive Pay
- 401k Matching
- Unlimited PTO
- Lunch daily *(in-office only)*
- Snacks & Coffee *(in-office only)*
- Commuter benefits *(in-office only)*
