title: Platform Engineer
description:
## **Our Vision**

Hospitals run on three things: their people, their beds, and their supplies… and all are still managed with spreadsheets, phone calls, and gut instinct. Vitalize is building the system that runs it all intelligently, starting with labor—the biggest cost (nearly 60% of a hospital’s P&L) and the hardest operational problem.

We’re building the labor and capacity operating system for health systems—forecasting demand, matching the right staff to it automatically, and coordinating patients across the hospital.

The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay. This isn’t a nice-to-have—our customers pay 5–15x more than legacy incumbents because Vitalize is mission-critical software their hospitals rely on every single minute.

We’ve raised over $32M from top investors, and even our own customers.

##   
**Our Values**

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

- **🚗 Push the Car.** Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.
- **🏥 Premier 1K.** We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.
- **🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly.** Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.
- **💡 Think Bigger Fridays.** See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

## 

## **About Vitalize's Platform Team**

Platform encompasses everything from infrastructure that takes the app from [localhost](http://localhost) to production, to the developer tooling that allows our developers to focus on product, to the security that keeps our customers’ data safe, and much more. The Platform Team at Vitalize is unique in that we get to decide and own what it means to adopt AI in our workflows. Our job extends beyond traditional DevOps and into AI leadership. This means setting the AI roadmap for the Engineering and broader organization—deciding what workflows to bet on and what tools to incorporate.

## **The Role**

We are hiring our second Platform Team member. The role starts with the fundamentals of cloud infrastructure like AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. Building on that is a deep understanding of common infrastructure patterns like cybersecurity, observability, and CI/CD. Finally, the role expands to include developer tooling and building internal apps and features that extend beyond the engineering team (e.g. internal agent workflows, onboarding tools, etc.). This means: AWS/EKS -\> Vanta/Grafana/Buildkite -\> React/Effect/Bun.

## **What You'll Do**

- Own CI/CD end to end—pipeline code, test orchestration, deploy safety, preview environments (we use Buildkite + self-hosted runners)
- Maintain our EKS cluster (along with the AWS infrastructure that supports it)
- Build developer tooling with internal stakeholders at the forefront
- Own what observability means—what are the right tools? What’s the best way to get alerts? How do we get the right data to the right people at the right time?
- Maintain a strong security and compliance posture across all services, both internal and external
- Lead AI adoption across Engineering—decide which agent workflows to integrate, which tools to adopt, and build and maintain custom solutions for stakeholders across the organization
- Extend beyond traditional Infra/DevOps to include product analytics capture and analysis, as well as helping build and maintain data pipelines to share critical information with leadership & customers

## **What You'll Bring**

- Passion for the space—You have a deep passion for infrastructure, developer tooling, and AI
- Empathy for engineers—You understand other engineers and their needs
- End-to-end ownership—You own your work end to end, including when it goes wrong
- Bias to action—You want to ship fast and fix fast
- Curiosity about emerging technology—You’re eager to adopt cutting-edge ways of working (e.g., what does it mean to deeply integrate with AI tools?)
- Team mentality—You believe in “our code”—you might not have written it, but we’re a team and we’re going to fix it together

## **Benefits**

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) with company match
- Flexible PTO
- Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites
- Twice-yearly company off-sites
- Free meals in the office
- $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees
- Desk setup reimbursement
- Commuter benefits
- Monthly gym/wellness stipend
- An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

title: Software Engineer, Staff
description:
## About Check

Payroll is broken. It's still running on decades-old infrastructure. **We're rebuilding it.**  
  
We don't run payroll ourselves — we power the businesses that do. As the inventors of embedded payroll, we're redefining how people get paid and making it easier for those businesses to launch, grow, and thrive.

 

On our team, you'll use creative problem-solving, critical thinking, and grit to simplify the complexity of payroll for thousands of employers of every size, across all industries. We ignore conventional role boundaries in favor of the unique strengths and values each builder brings to our mission: ***make paying people simple**.* [_Check out our origin story!_](https://app.notion.com/p/checkhq/The-Generalist-Check-Solving-the-150-Billion-Payroll-Problem-3b24274a2e75804e9141cfac60476d25?source=copy_link)

 

Check is far more than just API infrastructure. We’re a springboard for building and scaling payroll businesses. [See how it works for our partners.](https://www.checkhq.com/partners)

 
## Engineering Culture at Check

At Check, engineering operates as one team. Engineers are staffed based on business priorities, not tied to fixed domains. Engineers stay close to the work and to each other’s decisions. The team is small and operates with a high level of ownership. Work does not sit waiting on ownership boundaries, and people step in to move things forward when something is stuck.

## About this role

As a **Staff Software Engineer** at Check, you’ll combine strong engineering fundamentals and close collaboration with cross-functional partners to build software that meaningfully improves how payroll businesses operate.

You'll build the platform that powers money movement, tax calculations, and compliance workflows for thousands of businesses. By turning complex infrastructure into clear, reliable systems for our partners, you'll allow teams to run payroll confidently and help thousands of people get paid.

## What You'll Do

- **Run at complex problems** across our platform, designing and building products that translate complex payroll infrastructure into intuitive tools for operators and partners.
- **Own projects end-to-end,** from identifying the problem and shaping the solution through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration based on real-world usage.
- **Be a true partner** to product, design, and operations by developing a deep understanding of the workflows and challenges faced by payroll operators and partners.
- **Build internal and partner-facing tools** that improve the visibility, reliability, and explainability of how money moves through the payroll system.
- **Reduce friction** in our systems by improving workflows, architecture, and tooling for both developers and operators.
- **Role model clear, critical thinking** through code, proposals, and diagrams that help teams align and move forward together.
- **Raise the quality bar** by working in the open, giving thoughtful feedback, mentoring teammates, and helping the team ship work we’re proud of.

## Who You Are

- Experience with staff-level ownership and delivery of production systems end-to-end, from design through deployment and operation.
- Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or product systems that support complex operational workflows.
- Ability to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and bring structure through thoughtful design and collaboration.
- Comfort debugging complex systems and investigating issues that span multiple services or infrastructure layers.
- Ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to engineers and cross-functional partners.
- While we don't have requirements for programming languages, experience with or, at minimum, a desire to learn our current stack is helpful: Python/Django, React, Typescript, AWS, Terraform, Postgres, Temporal, Github.

## Travel & Office Policy

The Check team is distributed across the US. Roles can be remote, hybrid, or based in one of our offices in **New York City** or **San Francisco**. We offer ample opportunities and encourage employees to attend team offsites, events, and hackathons throughout year. All Checketeers gather in the spring for our annual 3-day company retreat.

For our in-office and hybrid employees, our offices are open all week. We provide meals on **Tuesdays** and **Thursdays** and there are regular happy hours, game nights, and other in-person events.

Remote work at Check requires the ability to perform all responsibilities without distraction or disruption, while maintaining quality, effective communication, and productivity.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, provided they are consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Check is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.*

title: Software Engineer, Quality & Automation
description:
## About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners — specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We're based in San Francisco, CA, and we're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work.

## Role Summary

This role owns quality and automation for large enterprise deployments. You'll work closely with customers and our internal engineering team to develop a world-class QA Function that’s built from an agent-first lens.

We're building our quality and automation capacity around agentic tooling, and this role sits at the center of that: using agents to take on the repetitive work of finding, reproducing, and resolving issues, strengthening our internal testing, and keeping our SaaS and PaaS environments consistent. You'll also work directly with the customer on how issues get reported and resolved, and own the reporting that shows where quality is heading.

We're hiring across all levels. Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join executing against this scope, owning the customer's quality experience end to end, or setting quality and automation standards across Engineering. We'll calibrate seniority during interviews based on scope and demonstrated experience.

## What You'll Own

- Keep environments consistent across our SaaS and PaaS deployments, so behavior a customer sees in one place matches everywhere else and configuration drift doesn't become a defect
- Build our automation capacity for handling bugs using agentic tooling including triage, reproduction, and routing that runs without a human in the middle
- Use agentic tools to resolve bugs yourself, shipping fixes rather than filing tickets and waiting
- Run bug bashes on new features before they're released, and make the practice repeatable enough that other teams adopt it
- Own bug reporting and communication: severity-weighted trends, hotspots, and a clear read on where quality is heading that engineering leadership and the customer both trust
- Work closely with the customer to integrate deeply with their processes and improve how they report issues, validate fixes, and decide something is ready for customers
- Improve our internal automated testing: coverage where it pays, CI signal people believe, and less flake
- Close the loop from a customer-reported issue back to the test or environment check that would have caught it
- Support our evaluation efforts by creating and curating relevant datasets that can support agent quality

## Who You Are (All Levels)

- An engineer who fixes what you find. You're comfortable in the codebase and you'd rather ship the fix than hand it off
- AI-native in how you work: you treat agentic tooling as core leverage for the unglamorous parts of quality, and you've used it on real work rather than just tried it
- You think in trends, hotspots, and severity, not anecdotes, and you can tell a clear story from a messy bug backlog
- Strong with customers: you can sit with a frustrated enterprise user, understand their process, and be the person they trust to get it resolved
- Comfortable across the stack and across environments spanning application code, CI, and the deployment differences that make "works on SaaS" not mean "works everywhere"
- Genuinely collaborative across the organization: you'll work daily with engineers, PM, support, and customer-facing teams, and treat that as the best part of the job
- High ownership and comfortable with ambiguity. Nobody hands you the list of what to test or what to automate first
- Able to internalize a hard domain fast. You don't need to know audit, but you'll learn enough to know what "broken" means to an auditor

## Higher-Level Responsibilities

**At the Senior level, you may:**

- Own the customer's quality experience end to end, including the reporting and communication relationship
- Set the agentic automation strategy for bug handling and decide where automation pays and where it doesn't
- Define what environment parity means across SaaS and PaaS and drive the work to hold it
- Collaborate with PMs and engineering leads to shape release practice and quality gates
- Mentor other engineers and raise the bar on testing rigor across teams

**At the Staff level, you may:**

- Set and champion quality and automation standards across Engineering, beyond this one deployment
- Drive company-level initiatives on release confidence, environment consistency, and defect prevention
- Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term quality strategy
- Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Engineering, Product, and Support
- Represent Fieldguide externally through writing, speaking, and open-source contributions

## Experience

**Must-have:**

- Production software engineering experience — you write and ship code, not only tests
- Hands-on experience building test automation and CI quality gates that engineers actually rely on
- Real use of AI or agentic tooling as part of how you work
- Experience working directly with customers or enterprise users on issues they care about
- Comfort operating in ambiguity and owning outcomes without a defined queue

**Nice-to-have:**

- Python, TypeScript, React, Postgres, Hasura, GraphQL
- E2E and integration frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress
- Experience with both multi-tenant SaaS and single-tenant or self-managed enterprise deployments
- Infrastructure exposure for environment parity work — AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform
- Observability and tracing tooling such as Datadog
- Experience building agentic workflows or internal tooling with LLMs
- Performance and load testing, especially on long-running workflows
- Security and compliance environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP, or similar)
- Background in audit, accounting, financial services, or another regulated domain

## Benefits

- Competitive compensation with equity
- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits
- Flexible time off and work schedules
- Technology reimbursements
- 401(k) plan
- Twice-yearly in-person offsites across the U.S.
- Wellness benefits starting on your first day

## Our Values

- **Fearless** — Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls
- **Fast** — Launch fast with excellence; iterate to perfection
- **Lovable** — Deliver happiness and 11-star experiences
- **Owners** — Execute and run the business with ownership
- **Win-win** — Create mutual value and earn trust for life
- **Inclusive** — Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
**What You'll Do**

As a Growth Product Manager on Calm's direct-to-consumer business, you'll help more people discover, adopt, and build daily habits with Calm. You'll own the growth product strategy and roadmap, accountable for driving subscriber growth, activation, revenue per user, and retention. You'll set the priorities, design and run the experiments that test them, and partner with engineering, product design, marketing, data, and research to ship what works. Your goal is to make it effortless for users to form a lasting mindfulness habit while helping Calm reach and sustain its growth goals.

As a Product Manager working on Calm’s direct-to-consumer business, you will drive measurable impact across top-of-funnel conversion, trial-to-paid transitions, user activation, and long-term retention. You will design, execute, and analyze product experiments in collaboration with engineering, design, marketing, and data science teams.

Day to day, you will:

- Own growth strategy and roadmap: Develop and own Calm's growth product strategy and roadmap, translating company revenue, subscriber, and DAU goals into a prioritized set of bets across activation, conversion, and retention.
- Run a high-velocity experiment program: Form sharp hypotheses, design and ship A/B tests with engineering and data science, and read results honestly — including the ones that don't win.
- Remove friction from key journeys: Use quantitative and qualitative data to find where users drop off in onboarding, habit-building, and account flows, then test simpler paths through them.
- Ship habit mechanics: Build the features that help users plan, track, and celebrate progress, so a first session becomes a daily practice.
- Write PRDs that make decisions easy**:** Spell out the job to be done, the opportunity, success metrics, and the plan to ship and iterate — then bring engineers, designers, marketers, and leadership along as the plan changes.

**Who You Are**

- A growth PM, or equivalent, who's owned the number: 4+ years in consumer product, with a track record of owning a growth metric (subscriber growth, conversion, retention) and setting the strategy to move it, across consumer mobile (iOS and Android) and web.
- A subscription-business operator: Fluent in the economics of consumer subscription (trial and paywall conversion, LTV, churn) and how product decisions show up in them.
- A rapid experimenter: Experienced in fast experiment design and analysis (A/B tests, holdouts, sequential testing), with the statistical judgment to know when a result is real and when it's noise.
- Data-fluent: Adept at sourcing quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize a roadmap and make feature calls, and decisive when the data won't settle it.
- A student of habit formation: You know what drives repeat daily usage and how to build the mechanics (streaks, reminders, progress, celebration) that turn a new user into a daily one.
- AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in leveraging AI tools to drive team velocity and build lasting workflows, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.
- Technically agile: Comfortable discussing complexity and tradeoffs with engineers, and able to prototype your own ideas rather than wait in a queue.
- Exceptional at documentation and organization: You keep the experiment log, results archive, and roadmap docs in a state where anyone can find what was tested, what it showed, and what's live (so the team builds on its own learnings instead of rediscovering them.)
- A low-ego, persuasive partner: You present your thinking clearly in writing and in the room, to stakeholders and senior leadership alike, hold positions with conviction and update them on evidence, and make Product Design, User Acquisition, Research, and Engineering better for working with you.

**Nice to Haves**

- Experience in subscription-based consumer tech (onboarding, paywalls, or retention initiatives).
- Familiarity with product analytics or experimentation tools (e.g., Amplitude).
- Experience working with or passion for the health & wellness domain.
- Experience in developing features that drive habit formation and lifestyle change.

**Minimum Requirements**

- 4+ years of relevant experience in growth, product management, or equivalent.

Calm uses a geographic pay model that determines salaries based on the location where an employee lives. For this position, the base pay ranges across Calm’s pay tiers is as follows: $147,800 - $226,700. The base pay range represents the low and high end of Calm’s salary range for this position. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. Exact salary will ultimately depend on multiple factors, which include the successful candidate's geographic location, skills, experience and other qualifications. Calm uses employee zip code to determine which pay range applies. This role is also eligible for equity + comprehensive benefits + 401k + flexible time off.

title: Applied Research Engineer / Research Intern
description:
##  Research Engineer Intern – Voice AI and Conversational Architectures

**Please note this is a remote role (Preferably Dallas or India) ideally for internship position, but open to full time consulting for the rught person.

### About us

We are VoiceMonk (voicy.ai), a foundational research and intellectual property firm building the core architectures for real-time voice AI. With 14 granted patents in the United States, 2 granted patents in India, and 20 pending applications, our conversational AI research spans over a decade. We invented several of the core dialogue, streaming, and latency-reduction technologies driving today's mass adoption of multimodal voice agents.

### The role

You will sit at the critical boundary between state-of-the-art voice AI research and patent engineering. You will read the latest literature on full-duplex Spoken Language Models (FD-SLMs), speech-to-speech (S2S) architectures, and real-time streaming, reproduce what matters, and build functional reference implementations of our proprietary architectures.

This is not a standard product-engineering role. You will act as the technical engine for our licensing and IP strategy—translating cutting-edge latency reduction and turn-taking models into rigorous technical specifications, evidentiary prototypes, and infringement analyses.

### What you'll work on

* **Reference Architectures & Evidentiary Prototypes:** Design and deploy functional testbeds of our patented claims (e.g., real-time dialogue management, interruption/barge-in handling, and context retrieval). These prototypes serve as direct evidentiary validation for our licensing campaigns and defend against *Alice* invalidation challenges.
* **Full-Duplex & Speech-to-Speech (S2S) Systems:** Implement ultra-low latency voice-to-voice pipelines, streaming ASR-LLM-TTS cascades, and Voice Activity Detection (VAD) optimizations to benchmark against current industry standards.
* **Technical Infringement Analysis:** Analyze and reverse-engineer state-of-the-art enterprise voice agents and LLM telephony stacks to map commercial implementations directly to our existing patent claims.
* **Continuation Patent Engineering:** Translate architectural breakthroughs into rigorous technical whitepapers. You will work directly with our patent counsel to provide the engineering specifications necessary to file future-proof continuation patents mapping to modern LLM architectures.
* **Real-Time Inference and Benchmarking:** Measure Time to First Audio (TTFA), end-to-end latency across edge-cloud boundaries, and orchestration timing to prove the technical superiority of our proprietary conversational loops.

### Minimum qualifications

You should meet one of the following:

* MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Audio Engineering, or a related field, plus 2+ years of research experience (industry research, a research lab, or published work).
* PhD in a related field, plus 1+ year of research experience.
* Currently 3+ years into a PhD program (for the internship track), with a track record of independent research.

You should also have:

* **Strong Python:** You should write clean, reproducible, and tested code to build robust reference architectures, not just disposable research scripts.
* **Audio/ML Ecosystem Experience:** Hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX) and the current voice AI ecosystem (streaming STT/TTS, WebRTC, LLM orchestration).
* **Demonstrated Research Output:** Publications, preprints, a thesis, or a reproducible body of work in speech processing, conversational AI, or low-latency ML systems.
* **Self-Directed Execution:** The ability to go from an academic paper (or a legal patent claim) to a working prototype independently. We will give you a technical or legal objective, not a detailed spec.

### Nice to have

* Experience with full-duplex Spoken Language Models, audio codecs, or native audio-in/audio-out architectures.
* Work on inference optimization specific to voice: KV-cache management, speculative decoding, or streaming chunk orchestration.
* Familiarity with enterprise telephony infrastructure (SIP trunks, WebRTC streaming).
* Experience interfacing with legal, patent, or compliance teams on technical matters.
* Prior startup experience, or evidence that you thrive in an unstructured, highly autonomous environment.

### What we offer

* Direct collaboration with the founder to shape the technical and architectural direction of a massive IP portfolio.
* A unique hybrid role combining bleeding-edge ML research with high-stakes technology licensing and patent strategy.
* Highly competitive cash compensation, supplemented by significant performance bonuses directly tied to the successful technical validation and licensing of our IP.
* Support and resources for publishing technical whitepapers and open research.
* Interns get a defined architectural project, direct mentorship, and a serious shot at a full-time offer.

title: WordPress Developer — Remote, Full-Time, 40 Hours per Week
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress Developer to build, maintain and improve our websites, dynamic catalogues and data integrations, working with our custom plugins and backend team.

**WORKING HOURS, PAID EVALUATION PERIOD AND LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY**

This is a full-time, remote position with **40 working hours per week**. We are looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration.

The role starts with a **two-month paid evaluation period**. This period gives both sides the opportunity to assess whether the role, working methods and expectations are a good fit for a long-term collaboration.

During this period, you will become familiar with our websites, existing systems and team, and demonstrate your WordPress development skills through practical work. We will assess technical quality, independent problem-solving, reliability, communication, delivery and the ability to thoroughly test your own work.

During this two-month evaluation period, the pay is **USD 2 per hour** worked.

After a successful evaluation, **compensation will be reviewed and adjusted** based on demonstrated performance, experience and the responsibilities you take on. Strong performance may lead to an **earlier compensation review**.

**Hubstaff** is required for tracking working time throughout the collaboration. The tracking scope and monitoring settings will be explained before you start.

- Create dynamic catalogues with filters, pagination and detail pages.

- Deliver correct desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.

Apply through Wellfound in English with:

**EXPLICITLY CONFIRM EACH CONDITION**

- I accept two calendar months of paid probation from the agreed start date.

- I accept USD 2 per hour worked during probation.

- I agree to Hubstaff work-time tracking, with scope and monitoring settings explained before starting.

- I can meet the development, testing and completion standards above.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
## About MedaVida

MedaVida is building the payments-enabled operating system for modern cash-pay
healthcare. Our platform connects credential verification, patient care, prescriptions,
payments, suppliers, communication, and practice growth within one unified ecosystem.

We are a fast-moving healthcare technology and fintech startup preparing to bring
multiple products to market. We are looking for a technically strong **Senior Python
Developer** who can take on our hardest, most ambiguous backend problems — money
movement, clinical data integrity, credential verification — and ship them correctly,
not just quickly.

## The role

We're looking for a **Senior Python Developer** to own the backend work that doesn't
come with a clean spec: the tickets where the hard part is figuring out the right design,
not just writing the code. Our stack is Django/DRF over Postgres, integrated with a
Medplum FHIR clinical core and multiple payment processors — the kind of system where a
shortcut in one place quietly breaks correctness somewhere else, and where getting it
right the first time matters more than getting it out the door first.

We're a startup, which means responsibilities don't stay in one lane. You'll shift
between Development, Review, Product Requirements definition, and Testing as the moment
calls for it — that's a feature of how we work, not a scope-creep exception. You'll also
be a regular source of review and guidance for less experienced engineers picking up
work adjacent to yours, without that being a formal management responsibility.

If you're the person other engineers already bring the "I'm not sure this is even the
right approach" problems to, this role is built for exactly that.

## What you'll do

- **Own the hardest backend tickets.** Complex, ambiguous work — payment-gateway
  integrations, money-movement correctness, data-model design, cross-system
  integrations — where the primary job is judgment, not typing.
- **Design before you build.** For work this consequential, that means reasoning
  through edge cases, failure modes, and existing invariants before committing to an
  approach — and being able to explain that reasoning to a reviewer or a teammate.
- **Write tests that actually prove correctness**, not just tests that pass. Money and
  clinical-data code gets held to a higher bar here than a typical CRUD endpoint.
- **Review other engineers' work**, including AI-drafted PRs on more complex tickets,
  and give feedback that helps them build the same judgment over time.
- **Say when something's wrong**, even if it's already shipped or already agreed on.
  Surfacing a real problem late is still better than staying quiet to avoid friction.

## What you need

- **A real track record shipping production Python/Django backend systems, including
  work that required genuine judgment on ambiguous problems** — not just following a
  clear spec. This is the one non-negotiable requirement for this role.
- **Strong command of Python and a relational database** (we run Postgres) — comfortable
  reasoning about query performance, migrations, and data integrity, not just ORM syntax.

## Nice to have — things that make you a strong fit, not things you must already have

- Experience with Django REST Framework specifically, or a comparable Python web
  framework at production scale.
- Experience with payments, billing, or other systems where correctness failures cost
  real money — the instinct to be paranoid in the right places.
- Experience integrating third-party or partner APIs (payment processors, external data
  sources, webhooks) and handling their failure modes gracefully.
- Comfort giving direct, useful code review to engineers earlier in their career.
- Curiosity about system design beyond the ticket in front of you — how a change here
  affects something three files away.

## How we work

- **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.
- **Weekends:** Not the norm, and we mean that as a design goal, not a hope. If a weekend
  gets worked, we treat that as a personal and managerial failure first — something to fix
  upstream, not shrug off — and every effort is made to avoid it. That said, we're a
  startup: the team is expected to pivot to meet real opportunities, sometimes on short
  notice, and that occasionally means weekend work.

## Why this role

If you're a strong senior engineer who wants your hardest problems to actually be hard —
not busywork dressed up as a senior title — this is that. You'll be trusted with the
work that has real consequences if it's wrong, working directly with the people who
built the system, on a codebase that's still young enough to shape.

---

**Location:** Remote
**Compensation:** We're a startup with real product already in the market, and we offer
competitive salaries. We're also in the process of setting up an Employee Stock Option
Plan (ESOP), with vesting backdated to begin on your employment start date.

title: Software Team Lead
description:
## About MedaVida

MedaVida is building the payments-enabled operating system for modern cash-pay
healthcare. Our platform connects credential verification, patient care, prescriptions,
payments, suppliers, communication, and practice growth within one unified ecosystem.

We are a fast-moving healthcare technology and fintech startup preparing to bring
multiple products to market. We are looking for a technically strong, growth-minded
**Software Team Lead** who can turn ambiguous engineering problems into shipped,
reliable software and help build the team's ability to take on harder work over time.

## The role

We're looking for a **Software Team Lead** — someone who's already doing strong technical
work and is ready to start shaping how the team around them operates, without giving up
hands-on engineering.

This isn't a "step away from code and into meetings" role. You'll keep doing real,
hard engineering work — in fact, that's most of what makes you right for this role in the
first place. What's new is a second layer of responsibility: helping make sure the right
work gets to the right person, and helping the engineers around you grow into handling
harder problems themselves.

We're a startup, which means responsibilities don't stay in one lane. You'll shift
between Development, Review, Product Requirements definition, and Testing as the moment
calls for it — that's a feature of how we work, not a scope-creep exception.

If you're a mid-level or senior engineer who's already been the person others quietly
turn to for the tricky problems — even if you've never had "Lead" in your title — this
role is built for exactly that moment in a career.

## What you'll do

- **Keep solving the hard problems.** You'll continue owning and building the most
  complex, ambiguous pieces of engineering work — this doesn't go away when you take this
  role, it's central to it.
- **Keep a clear, honest read on the team.** A simple, current picture of who on the team
  is ready for more complex work right now, and who's still building toward it — not a
  guess based on titles or tenure, but something you actually track.
- **Help the team route work well.** Make sure genuinely hard problems go to the people
  ready for them, and straightforward work doesn't quietly eat up your most experienced
  engineers' time.
- **Help evaluate readiness, using real work as evidence.** When someone seems ready for
  more responsibility, you'll help confirm that by seeing how they actually handle a real,
  challenging assignment — not by guessing from a resume or a gut feeling.
- **Mentor.** Be a resource for engineers earlier in their growth than you, especially
  around the judgment calls that are hard to teach from documentation alone.

## What you need

- **A real track record of handling the hardest, most ambiguous engineering problems on a
  team** — the kind of work that requires genuine judgment, not just following a clear
  spec. This is the one non-negotiable requirement for this role. Everything else below is
  something we expect you to grow into, not something you need to already have done.

## Nice to have — things you'll grow into, not gate you out

- Experience mentoring or informally guiding less experienced engineers.
- Comfort keeping an honest, current read on where a team's skills and capacity actually
  sit.
- Interest in helping decide when a teammate is ready for more complex responsibility,
  grounded in real observed work rather than guesswork.
- Any prior experience — even informal — taking initiative on team-wide technical
  decisions.

## How we work

- **Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST.
- **Weekends:** Not the norm, and we mean that as a design goal, not a hope. If a weekend
  gets worked, we treat that as a personal and managerial failure first — something to fix
  upstream, not shrug off — and every effort is made to avoid it. That said, we're a
  startup: the team is expected to pivot to meet real opportunities, sometimes on short
  notice, and that occasionally means weekend work.

## Why this role

If you've been doing strong senior-level work but have never formally led anyone, this is
usually the next real step — not a lateral move into management, and not a step away from
engineering. You keep doing the work you're good at. You just start doing it with a
little more say in how the team around you grows.

---

**Location:** Remote

**Compensation:** We're a startup with real product already in the market, and we offer
competitive salaries. We're also in the process of setting up an Employee Stock Option
Plan (ESOP), with vesting backdated to begin on your employment start date.

title: Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
**About VeryAI**

VeryAI is on a mission to make the internet more human, all in the palm of your hand. Combining proprietary palm biometrics with agent verification, VeryAI powers secure and seamless digital experiences across social, fintech, and crypto platforms through the first hardware-free palm scan that works on any smartphone.

Built for an era of AI deepfakes and digital spoofing, VeryAI delivers fraud-resistant verification with privacy at its core. The platform enables organizations to confirm real users without compromising personal data. Developed by experts in biometrics, crypto, and AI, VeryAI is designed to meet the growing need for trust in an increasingly digital world.

By putting the next layer of trust in the palm of your hand, VeryAI is creating a new standard for online authenticity and security.

**About the Role**

VeryAI is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to build the systems behind Proof of Reality. You will design and ship the backend and frontend that power hardware-free palm verification at scale, working directly with the founding team before a formal engineering function exists. Strong candidates are pragmatic builders who care about performance, security, and shipping fast in an early-stage environment. We build with AI, not around it: the team uses AI coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor every day. We care as much about your judgment in reviewing what they produce as the speed they give you — in a fraud and biometrics product, knowing when the model is wrong is the job.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs that power VeryAI’s verification platform.
* Build front-end experiences and integrate them cleanly with backend systems.
* Ship scalable, secure, cloud-based infrastructure across our stack.
* Work directly with product and the founding team to turn ideas into shipped features quickly.
* Optimize, troubleshoot, and harden existing code as the product grows.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3+ years building production software as a full stack or backend engineer.
* Strong foundation in software development, object-oriented programming, database design, and API development.
* Proficiency in Go and TypeScript — our backend is Go and our web stack is React/Next.js — with comfort working across the front-end and back-end boundary. Python is a plus.
* Fluency with AI-assisted development. You use tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor in your daily workflow and have a clear sense of where they help, where they don’t, and how to review AI-generated code critically.
* Experience with scalable, cloud-based applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, early-stage team.

**Strong Candidates May Also Have**

* Experience with AI, biometrics, privacy, or security-sensitive systems.
* A track record shipping products from zero to one without a defined playbook.
* Hands-on experience with agentic or autonomous coding tools — e.g., OpenClaw or Hermes Agent — beyond the mainstream assistants.
* Familiarity with crypto, identity, or digital trust as a product category.
* Remote. US-based only. (SF, NYC, Miami preferred)

**How to Apply**

Send a CV and a short note on one or two things you have built that are relevant to this role. Tell us what the problem was, the decisions you made, and what you would do differently. Links to code or live projects are welcome. We read everything.

title: Product Marketing Director
description:
Priori transforms how legal departments source, manage, and engage outside counsel and legal talent. Our platform helps legal teams identify the right providers, run data-driven RFPs, manage law firm panels, engage flexible legal talent, and gain greater visibility into legal spend and performance.

Priori is seeking a strategic and customer-focused Director of Marketing to lead product marketing, customer insights, go-to-market strategy, and thought leadership initiatives across Priori's growing portfolio of solutions. This role will serve as the bridge between Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, ensuring Priori's products are effectively positioned, differentiated, and brought to market. The Director of Marketing will be responsible for developing messaging, driving product launches, managing customer feedback programs, leading client advisory board initiatives, and equipping revenue teams with the insights and content needed to succeed. The ideal candidate combines strong product marketing expertise with a deep curiosity about customers, markets, and industry trends. **While demand generation experience is important, this role's primary focus is product marketing, customer engagement, and go-to-market leadership.**


**You will: **
* Lead product marketing strategy across Priori's portfolio of solutions, including legal talent, panel management, RFP management, and future product offerings.
* Develop and maintain compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions for key buyer personas, including General Counsel, Legal Operations leaders, procurement teams, and business stakeholders.
* Drive go-to-market planning and execution for new products, features, partnerships, and strategic initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to ensure alignment between market needs, product strategy, and customer communications.
* Develop competitive intelligence and market insights that inform positioning, sales strategy, and business planning.
* Create and maintain sales enablement materials, including persona guides, battlecards, presentations, product collateral, and messaging frameworks.
* Serve as the voice of the customer by building and scaling programs that capture customer feedback and market insights.
* Own and expand Priori's client advisory board strategy, including member recruitment, engagement, programming, and executive communications.
* Lead customer research initiatives, including interviews, surveys, win/loss analysis, and voice-of-customer programs.
* Identify market trends, customer needs, and emerging opportunities that influence product development and go-to-market strategy.
* Partner with Product and Executive Leadership to translate customer feedback into actionable recommendations.
* Develop strategic content initiatives that support product adoption, customer engagement, and market education.
* Oversee the creation of customer stories, webinars, reports, thought leadership content, product launch materials, and sales enablement assets.
* Partner with internal subject matter experts, customers, and executives to develop compelling narratives that reinforce Priori's leadership position within the legal industry.
* Ensure consistent product messaging and storytelling across customer-facing channels.
* Partner with marketing leadership to reinforce Priori's brand positioning and market differentiation through product marketing, customer advocacy, and thought leadership initiatives.
* Support executive visibility efforts through customer programs, industry events, research initiatives, and content development.
* Help strengthen Priori's reputation as a trusted partner to legal departments and legal operations teams.
* Collaborate closely with the marketing team to ensure campaigns are grounded in strong market insights, audience segmentation, and product positioning.
* Partner on account-based marketing initiatives, integrated campaigns, events, and customer engagement programs.
* Support pipeline growth by developing messaging, content, and programs that improve engagement and conversion throughout the buyer journey.
* Analyze market feedback, campaign performance, and customer behavior to continuously refine go-to-market strategies.
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership to align marketing investments with business objectives.


**You have:**
* 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, and customer-facing marketing programs.
* Experience marketing enterprise SaaS, legal technology, marketplaces, professional services technology, or related solutions.
* Proven track record developing positioning, messaging, and launch strategies for multiple products or solution lines.
* Experience building customer insight programs, advisory boards, customer councils, or similar initiatives.
* Strong understanding of enterprise buying processes and complex B2B sales cycles.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling, and content development skills.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Executive teams.
* Familiarity with demand generation, account-based marketing, and revenue marketing principles.

title: Founding Product Designer
description:
# **🏛️ About GovWell**

We the people — and the taxpayers — deserve good government. Yet today, interacting with government services is often frustrating and inefficient. GovWell is building the AI operating system transforming how governments serve communities, starting with local agencies.

GovWell replaces legacy software for municipalities and counties, empowering public servants to radically streamline public services and cut internal processing time for permits and licenses by up to 95%.

Founded in 2023, GovWell powers 5,000+ mission-critical processes for agencies in 35+ states serving millions of residents. The company has raised $35M in funding from Insight Partners, Work-Bench, and Bienville Capital, and the team works in person at GovWell HQ in New York City. Read more about our founding story in [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2024/07/29/govwell-is-bringing-automation-and-efficiency-to-local-governments/).

# **🌟 Role overview**

Government software has historically forced users to choose between two bad options: outdated systems that are painful to use, or newer tools that look better but can’t handle the complexity of how government actually works. We believe the next generation of government software should do neither. It should make extraordinarily complex workflows feel simple, intuitive, and even delightful.

GovWell is hiring a **Founding Product Designer** to define what that future looks like.

You’ll be our first design leader and will build the Design function from the ground up. You’ll establish the principles, systems, and standards that shape every GovWell product—while remaining deeply hands-on in the work. You’ll redesign the look and feel of our core platform, help us create AI experiences that feel integral rather than bolted on, and give engineers the tools to build polished, consistent products without design becoming a bottleneck.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a mature team or spend most of their time reviewing other people’s work. Initially, you’ll be a full-time individual contributor and thought leader. Over time, you’ll hire and lead the team needed to make design a lasting competitive advantage for GovWell.

This role reports directly to our CTO and Co-Founder, Ben Cohen.

We have a hybrid work culture that combines regular in-person collaboration at our New York City office (3+ days per week) with flexibility to work remotely.

### 

# **☀️ Why GovWell?**

- **A mission that matters:** Building AI-powered products to fix outdated government systems isn’t just a design challenge—it’s a historic opportunity to improve our foundational relationship with government and ensure trillions of tax dollars result in high-quality services. [**WATCH: Mission & Vision with CEO & Co-Founder Troy LeCaire**](https://www.loom.com/share/3d733b22ca0d4fa6be241e0cdd36311a)
- **A rare design problem:** Local governments run some of the most complex workflows in the economy. Your job will be to make that complexity feel simple without stripping away the power that public servants need.
- **Real-world impact:** GovWell is the system of record for government services affecting millions of Americans. From helping a small business open sooner to accelerating the construction of affordable housing, your work will make an immediate difference.
- **The chance to define the standard:** Our product is established and growing, but our design language is still taking shape. You won’t be maintaining someone else’s system—you’ll define what exceptional government software looks and feels like.
- **Join a startup in hyper-growth:** We’ve found product-market fit and are scaling quickly, with 4X ARR growth in the last year. You’ll work closely with the founders and have exceptional autonomy, ownership, and influence over the company’s direction.

# **🎨 What you’ll do**

- **Set the design vision for GovWell.** Define the principles that make our products intuitive, differentiated, and unmistakably GovWell.
- **Reimagine the core product experience.** Lead a significant evolution of our platform’s visual design and interaction patterns without losing sight of the complex workflows our customers depend on.
- **Design AI-native experiences.** Shape how AI helps government staff complete work—not as a chatbot bolted onto existing software, but as a cohesive part of the product.
- **Build our design system.** Create the components, patterns, and guidance that let product and engineering teams move quickly while maintaining a consistently high bar.
- **Stay close to customers.** Develop a deep understanding of government staff, residents, contractors, and business owners, then turn their needs into simple and thoughtful product experiences.
- **Raise the quality of everything we ship.** Partner closely with our Head of Product ([Will Fisher](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wafisher/) - former Head of Digital at the MTA and builder of the [MTA TrainTime mobile app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mta-traintime/id1104885987)) and software engineers from early exploration through implementation, sweating the details that separate functional software from a truly great product.
- **Build the Design function from 0 to 1.** Define how design operates at GovWell, then hire and develop a world-class team as the company grows.

# **🧠 Who you are**

- **Complexity, made simple:** You have a track record of designing intuitive, beautiful products for complex use cases.
- **A player, not just a coach:** You’re an exceptional hands-on product designer who can take an ambiguous problem through to a polished experience—and you’re excited to do the work yourself.
- **More than a pair of hands:** You have strong product judgment. You challenge assumptions, simplify workflows, and help determine what should be built—not just how requirements should look.
- **AI-native, not AI-curious:** You’re an active user of AI and have thoughtful, evolving opinions about how it should reshape software experiences.
- **Systems without bureaucracy:** You can establish a design system that helps teams move faster without letting the system become more important than the product.
- **Clarity creates momentum:** You communicate clearly and can bring founders, product managers, engineers, and customers along with your thinking.
- **Vision down to the last pixel:** You move comfortably between articulating a multi-year product vision and debating the right label, state, or interaction.
- **A builder of teams:** You want to create a Design function and eventually lead a team, but you’re energized by starting as a hands-on individual contributor.
- **Empathy without prerequisites:** You can deeply understand the needs of government staff and residents without prior govtech experience.
- **Values are how you operate:** You align closely with our [Core Values](https://govwell.com/careers#core-values).

#   
**🖥️ Design Tooling**

- Lovable
- Cursor
- Figma

# **💸 Compensation and benefits**

Compensation within the posted salary band will be commensurate with experience. All offers will include:

- Competitive base salary.

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
- 401(k) program.
- Flexible PTO.

title: Inside Account Executive
description:
Travefy is the connected system powering the travel industry.

More than 50,000 travel agencies and advisors trust Travefy to help them prove their value, simplify their work, and grow their businesses. Our platform is where they go to manage clients, design and sell stunning trips, market their brands, and run the back office.

Travel is booming, a new generation of advisors is reshaping the industry, and Travefy builds the tools they run on. Come help shape how an entire industry works.

### About the Role

Travel advisors are real small business owners. Most of them are independent, most are growing, and almost all are underserved by the software they rely on every day. This role with Travefy is about reaching them.

This is a hybrid role by design. Qualified advisors land on your calendar every day through our marketing engine, and converting them is half the job. The other half is demand you create yourself, going after the individual advisors and small teams who have not found us yet. The best person in this seat excels at both, and the comp plan is designed to reward exactly that.

You will report to Revenue Leadership and work closely with marketing, account management, and our agency sales team. This is a high-volume, fast-cycle role with a short path from first conversation to closed business. You will run more sales conversations in a month than most reps run in a quarter, and you will have real influence over how this motion (and Travefy) evolves.

### What You'll Own

Converting inbound demand. Qualified advisors arrive on your calendar every day through 1:1 and group demos. You run the session, you follow up, you close. Over half of the advisors who sit through a demo become customers, and we expect you to protect that.

Creating your own demand. You'll have access to a named universe of individual advisors and small teams that aren't currently with Travefy. You build the lists, you run the outreach, you fill the seats that marketing does not.

Growing advisors into teams. The best advisors add people. You spot the two, three, and five seat opportunities early, sell the upgrade from Core to Premium, and expand accounts before someone else does.

Winning back what we lost. Lapsed trials, churned advisors, and prospects who went quiet are on the table, and you'd work that book of business deliberately, not just when the calendar is slow.

Writing the playbook. You talk with more working advisors than almost anyone at Travefy. The objections you hear, the competitors you run into, and the reasons advisors buy feed the company playbook and drive our experimentation.

### Your Day to Day
* Run 1:1 and group demos with self-scheduled prospects
* Build and work your own outbound lists by phone, email, and text
* Follow up on every demo within 24 hours, every time
* Route larger agency, white label, and API opportunities to the right team fast
* Keep an accurate, honest pipeline in HubSpot
* Bring what you are hearing back to marketing and product

### What We're Looking For

You have carried a number and hit it. Two to five years in a closing seat, ideally high volume SMB or self service SaaS. Not a support role with a quota attached.

You have sourced your own pipeline. You can walk us through a deal you created from nothing, not one that was handed to you by marketing or an SDR.

You are comfortable at volume. Many conversations a day, short cycles, small deals that add up. You get energy from a full calendar rather than dreading it.

You can run a room. Group demos with a dozen advisors, live questions, competing perspectives. You have done something like this or you are visibly ready to.

You are consultative at speed. You ask a real question before you show a feature, even when the call is 30 minutes long.

You are fluent in the toolkit. HubSpot, sequencing tools, AI in your actual daily workflow rather than as something you have read about.

You raise your hand. When the calendar is light you say so on Monday, not at the end of the month, and you show up with a plan to fill it.

You are authorized to work in the United States.

### Nice to Haves
* Experience in the travel industry, or selling to travel advisors, host agencies, or consortia
* A background selling to owner-operated small businesses
* Experience with a product-led or self-service funnel where the buyer can purchase without you

### What We Offer
* Competitive compensation: $45,000 to $65,000 base, $90,000 to $120,000 OTE, uncapped. Final offer depends on experience and location.
* Health, Dental & Vision insurance for you and your family.
* Life and Disability insurance.
* 401(k) with automatic company contribution.
* Unlimited Vacation + Annual Travel Stipend.
* Annual all team retreat to connect the whole company in person.
* Technology, learning budgets, and more.
* Location & Eligibility

This position is available as a remote opportunity within our distributed team, or as a hybrid role based in our Pennington, NJ, Lincoln, NE, or Omaha, NE offices.

At this time, we're not considering applicants who need immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization), now or in the future, to work in the United States.

title: Senior Associate, Strategy & Market Intelligence
description:
**Role Overview**

In this role, you'll work directly with our CEO to help determine in whom, what, where, when, and why Learneo invests. You will research and recommend potential investments across categories, asset classes, and deal types. You'll do the deep research behind those decisions and turn it into a clear view on where our capital should go. We believe AI is reshaping most of the economy, and the biggest opportunities are still ahead. We have a close-up view of how fast it's moving and where it's headed, and we want someone who sees the same opportunity and wants to help us get there early.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone with the ambition and work ethic to become a world-class investor. This role will have direct access to the CEO, minimal bureaucracy, and real influence over how our capital is allocated. Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.

We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore.

## The Role

In the Associate Project Manager, Research role, you’ll drive fast, accurate permitting research that powers Pulley’s next generation of products and services.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own end-to-end completion of permit research projects
- Collaborate closely with AI/engineering teams to improve research accuracy, speed, and automation

**Who You Are**

To be successful in this role, you are likely someone with:

- Ability to collaborate with engineers, product teams, and permitting leaders

title: Payer Operations Lead
description:
[**Allara**](https://www.allarahealth.com) is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by over 60,000 women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved [**health outcomes**](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/637f55cdd2e0aa051d497c52/68e6aa0f8fcce5c60e922219_Outcomes%20Impact%20Report%202025%20Web%20Display.pdf). **The Opportunity**

We're seeking an enthusiastic and process-driven **Payer Operations Lead** to own the most complex and high-stakes payer enrollments, build the documented processes our function runs on, and serve as the quality and coaching anchor for our enrollment team. As we expand in-network access across the country, this role directly owns the speed and accuracy of payer expansion — the difference between providers who can see members on day one and applications that stall.

You will be responsible for documenting processes across our workflows, relentless follow-up with payers to unblock the team, and oversight and coaching of enrollment functions.

- Conduct persistent, proactive follow-up with payers via phone, email, and payer portals to confirm application receipt, resolve deficiencies, and push applications through to approval. You own each item until it's done

- 2-3 years of experience in provider enrollment, credentialing, payer contracting, or healthcare administration (internship or adjacent revenue cycle experience considered)

- Comfort owning metrics and reporting on pipeline throughput
- Highly independent and driven. You follow up relentlessly (including comfort calling and escalating within payer networks), manage your own queue without reminders, and don't let applications sit

**Preferred Qualifications**

In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes equity, comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision), generous paid time off, and additional wellness and professional development perks.*

title: Contract Negotiation Lead
description:
We're [Scan.com](http://Scan.com). We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.

We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.

We're looking for a **Contract Negotiation Lead – Radiology Networks** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year-over-year.

 

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

## **WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE:**

This role sits at the heart of our network expansion and partnership management strategy, building and maintaining the radiology partnerships that power our nationwide platform. Reporting to Network Operations leadership, you'll take full ownership of contract negotiations from first contact through signed agreement, and serve as the primary relationship owner for contracted radiology provider partners throughout the lifecycle of the partnership. This is a contract position designed for someone who moves fast, thinks strategically, and excels at both closing deals and nurturing long-term partnerships. You will be empowered to independently shape deals that directly fuel our growth trajectory while ensuring ongoing partnership success.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

- Lead contract negotiations with radiology groups and imaging providers nationwide
- Serve as the primary relationship owner for contracted radiology provider partners
- Develop and execute network expansion strategies aligned with organizational goals
- Maintain long-term, strategic partnerships to ensure stability and network performance
- Conduct recurring business review meetings to assess operational and financial performance
- Track and analyze volume trends, turnaround times, and key service-level metrics
- Identify performance gaps and collaborate with partners on improvement plans
- Analyze financial, utilization, and market data to support negotiation strategy
- Draft, review, and finalize provider agreements in partnership with internal stakeholders
- Manage multiple negotiations simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
- Proactively manage issues, escalations, and contract compliance matters
- Partner cross-functionally (operations, clinical, finance) to support the overall partnership
- Identify opportunities to improve contract terms, rates, and overall network value

## **WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE:**

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

- Strong contract negotiation experience, preferably in healthcare or provider contracting
- Proven experience managing long-term strategic partnerships and conducting business performance reviews
- Proven analytical skills with the ability to interpret financial and operational data to inform strategy and identify performance trends
- Experience building or expanding provider networks (radiology or imaging networks strongly preferred)
- Ability to work independently with minimal oversight and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
- Comfort operating in high-urgency, high-volume situations where you're managing multiple negotiations and ongoing partnerships simultaneously
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across internal teams and external partners
- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with operations, clinical, and finance teams
- Self-starter mentality with the ability to take initiative and drive projects to completion
- Fast, decisive, and detail-oriented approach to work
- Strategic thinking combined with a practical, execution-focused mindset

## **AI REQUIREMENTS**

At [Scan.com](http://Scan.com), AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to reach for the best tool and get more done as a result.

Tier 2 — For this role, you're expected to be AI-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data. (most commercial, marketing, finance, people, and G&A roles)

*One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.*

 
## **A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here. For you to be successful at [Scan.com](http://Scan.com), you must embody our values.

 
## **HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU**

We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

1. 30-minute introductory phone call with a member of our Talent Team.
2. If it feels like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a 45-minute video call with the hiring manager. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.
3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at [Scan.com](http://Scan.com). You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to your role (see AI Requirements above).
4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.
5. Offer!

## **WHAT WE OFFER**

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. Here's what you can expect from us:

- Salary range of **$90,000 - $110,000 + Bonus**
- Equity
- 401k
- Healthcare, Vision, and Dental
- All the equipment needed for you to do your role effectively
- Flexible working
- Remote or hybrid working options
- Personal Development budgets
- 18 days PTO plus public holidays
- 10 paid sick days
- Inclusive policies designed by our team, for our team

## **DIVERSITY AT** [**SCAN.COM**](http://Scan.com)

[Scan.com](http://Scan.com) is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at [people@scan.com](mailto:people@scan.com).

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: VP Sales, Employer Markets
description:
# **About Yuzu**

At Yuzu, we’re building the next-generation health insurance company. We are NOT building a digital brokerage or an AI wrapper - we are going deeper to build the foundational infrastructure required to power tomorrow’s health plans. We believe that software can unlock the ability to build health plans that are affordable, adaptable, and scalable. Yuzu’s platform will be core to this future.

 

So how does this actually work? Over 70% of employer-sponsored health plans are self-funded, meaning the employer acts as the insurer and directly covers employees' healthcare costs. This allows companies to customize benefits, gain flexibility, and save money. Self-funded employers partner with a Third-Party Administrator (TPA) to handle the behind-the-scenes plan administration, like processing claims and managing benefits.

 

The TPA industry is a $500bn sleeper industry that has historically been seen as a services business, bogged down by manual processes and legacy systems.

 

Yuzu is different. We are a vertically integrated & tech-enabled TPA, currently servicing thousands of companies. We differentiate by helping innovative health plans come to life by facilitating new ways to pay for and access healthcare covered by insurance. Yuzu’s goal is to make it as easy for any business to create and manage a custom health plan as it is to create a storefront on Shopify.

  
# **The Opportunity**

Yuzu's platform already powers health plans for companies through plan designers and TPAs. Our next chapter is the broker channel.

Getting there takes two things at once: building health plans in direct partnership with leading health systems and consultants, and turning those plans into something regional brokerages want to build their business on. This role owns that motion end to end: identifying the right markets, establishing provider partnerships, building broker distribution, closing early employer groups, and eventually hiring the regional team to scale it.

This is a new role at Yuzu and a founding seat on our commercial team. You'll have direct partnership from our CEO and Head of Growth, a platform that is live and proven, and the mandate to define how Yuzu goes to market with employers.

 

**This role might be a fit for you if:**

- You've sold self-funded / level-funded health plans through brokers and understand what types of plan products and end-user experience earns a broker's repeat business.
- You've opened a new market or region from the ground up, not just grown an existing territory.
- You're comfortable carrying revenue targets personally before you build a team beneath you.
 

**What You'll Do:**

- Determine which direct networks and geographies to pursue
- Support us in defining the go to market playbook for selling these products, e.g., messaging, process, pricing inputs, and channel strategy
- Hire, onboard, and develop a sales team as we scale
- Serve as a senior voice with product, marketing, and leadership.
- Represent Yuzu at industry conferences, health system convenings, and with key stakeholders
 
# **The Skillset**

- 6+ years of commercial experience in health systems, managed care, or health plan sales
- **Must have experience selling through broker channels**
- Prior experience building or managing a sales team
- **Deep understanding of health plan economics, hospital system incentives, and employer dynamics**
- Entrepreneurial disposition: comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building from scratch
- Be available for 30–40% travel

# **The First 30 Days**

- Build fluency in Yuzu's platform, plan operations, and current partner relationships. Meet the brokers and plan designers we work with today. Develop an initial point of view on the first two to three target markets.

**The First 60 Days**

- Be active in market running outreach and early sales conversations with brokers and direct networks in the first target markets
- Have initial conversations underway with at least one health system partner and a first draft of the partnership structure (network, fee schedule, exclusivity) we’d propose
- Deliver a working version of the go-to-market playbook: ICP for employer groups, broker pitch and materials, pricing inputs and repeatable sales process we can run against

**90 Days & Beyond**

- Have a first health system partnership in signed or advanced negotiation and a defined broker bench in that market
- Close or have late-stage pipeline with the first employer groups, with clear line of sight to a revenue target for the year
- Own a documented playbook and market-prioritization framework that tells us which health systems and geographies come next and why
- Begin scoping the first regional sales hire, including the profile, comp structure and territory plan
 
# **Interview Process**

1. Initial Recruiter Interview: 30 min
2. Hiring Manager interview: 45 minutes
3. Take home assignment: ~2 hours
4. Onsite: 3 hours
 
# **Salary & Equity**

In this role, you’ll receive an $400,000 - $450,000 OTE (60/40 split), equity, and full benefits

 
# **Location**

Remote: US

 
# **The Perks**

🌴**Flexible PTO**: Unlimited

⚕️**Paid health benefits 100%:** Medical, vision, and dental

🏦 **401k Provider and match**

**📚Productivity Stipend:** $3000/annually

**🏠Home Office Stipend:** for remote employees

**🎉 Team Outings and Offsites:** We just went to a mets game!

**🥪 Daily in-office Lunch**

**🧢 Company Swag**
