## Compensation

This is a **commission-only independent contractor (1099) role**.

Business Directory Acquisition Partners earn:

* A **percentage of all subscription revenue generated from businesses they onboard**
* Ongoing commission from **monthly and annual renewals**
* Additional earnings from **tier upgrades (Basic → Elite conversions)**
* Performance bonuses for high-volume or high-value placements

### Revenue Model Includes:

* Recurring monthly subscriptions
* Annual subscription payments
* Tier upgrades and premium placements

There is no hourly wage, salary, or guaranteed income.

## Independent Contractor Status

This role is offered exclusively as a **1099 Independent Contractor** position.

Contractors are responsible for their own outreach systems, tools, taxes, and business expenses. This role does not establish an employer-employee relationship.

To comply with applicable laws, **JUS Official Services does not accept applicants residing in California or other jurisdictions where this contractor model is not legally supported or compliant.**

## Background Check Requirement

All applicants must successfully complete a criminal background check prior to onboarding and access to business systems or client outreach tools.

Failure to successfully complete the screening may result in disqualification.

## Performance Expectations

Success in this role is measured by:

* Number of businesses onboarded into the directory
* Subscription revenue generated
* Tier upgrades and conversion rates
* Renewal retention performance
* Pipeline activity and outreach consistency
* Expansion of directory client base across industries

## Ideal Candidate

The ideal Business Directory Acquisition Partner is persuasive, consistent, and highly entrepreneurial. They understand how to sell visibility, growth, and exposure to businesses that need customers. They are comfortable with outreach, follow-up, and turning conversations into recurring revenue.

JUS Official Services is committed to providing equal opportunity to all qualified applicants. title: Founding iOS Engineer
acceptedRemoteLocations: Argentina; Canada; Spain; United States; Germany; France; United Kingdom; Poland; Sweden; Ukraine; Norway; Italy; Colombia; Venezuela; Mexico City, Mexico
description:
Forty-one downloads. Thirty-eight of them were family.

Somebody spends a year building something beautiful, hits publish, and then sits there refreshing a dashboard that never moves.

You already know this. You might have lived it.

We have the exact opposite problem.

200,000 customers. Real ones. They buy from us, they open our emails, they write back with their actual problems. We spend $200,000+ a month on ads and we make money doing it. Profitable for years. Never taken a dollar of outside money. No board, no runway, no investor who decides on a Tuesday that your project is dead.

We've got the audience. We've got the people who run the traffic, the ones who make the content, the ones who talk to customers every day. Everybody here is a specialist with a weapon.

What we don't have is the person who builds the thing.

That's the job. You help us build it. On launch day we open the doors and the room fills up.

### **What we're actually doing**

The food industry has been lying to people for fifty years and getting rich doing it.

"Natural" on a box with nothing natural in it. Sugar hiding under sixty different names so it never shows up first on the label. The truth printed in six point type on the back, in a language nobody ever taught you to read.

A 52-year-old woman stands in a grocery aisle with her reading glasses on, holding a box, genuinely trying. And she cannot win. It was built that way on purpose. She goes home, eats it, gains the weight back, and decides something must be wrong with her.

Nothing's wrong with her. Somebody rubbed the numbers off the scoreboard.

We're putting them back.

### **Here’s what I want for you**

A few short years from now somebody asks what you've worked on. You say the name and they stop and go "wait. You built that?!"

But there's a smaller moment before that one, and it's better. You're standing in line at a grocery store and the woman in front of you pulls her phone out and opens the thing you made. She has no idea you're standing there. Nobody in the store knows. Just you.

That's what this is. Not a feature. Not a sprint. The thing people pull out of their pocket without thinking about it.

### **The work**

I'll say this much about what's hard.

Real time personalization at a scale where the obvious approach falls over. Millions of people, and a different correct answer for every one of them, fast enough that it feels almost instant.

An AI that has to still be good on night 400. Not preachy, not generic, not wrong. Harder than it sounds and nobody in this space has done it.

Unit economics where inference cost is big enough to change what the product is, not just what it costs.

A data problem where the free sources are a mess and the good ones are expensive, and neither one gets you where we need to be.

None of it is solved. Some of it might not be solvable the way I'm imagining it, which is why I want somebody who'll tell me so.

Solve these and you didn't ship a feature. You built something a very large number of people touch every day, that didn't exist before you, with your name on it.

### **This is probably for you if…**

You want to build something that hundreds of millions of people use. Not a “good” app. A great one that everybody knos. The money on this is good and it should matter to you, but if it's the main reason you're here it probably won’t work out.

You're somebody who's shipped. Not a portfolio of prototypes. A real app, in the store, that you kept alive for years and that has your fingerprints all over it. And recent matters more than long. Somebody who shipped last year beats somebody with ten years and nothing live.

Somebody who makes things that look and feel different. Competent isn't rare. What I'm after is rarer than that. I want the person who blew a weekend on an animation nobody asked for because it bugged them that it felt cheap. That instinct is the whole difference between an app people use and an app people love.

Somebody who argues. I have a plan. I want you to tell me what's wrong with it in the first conversation, before you're even hired.

Somebody who owns it. No product manager here. You and me, deciding fast, then finding out if we were right.

Swift and native iOS, enough backend that you're never stuck waiting on anyone, and real comfort with AI APIs and vision models. Subscriptions, StoreKit, App Review, the whole irritating machine. If you've shipped a paid app you know exactly what I mean.

### The honest downsides…

There's no spec. There's a firm direction, a prototype and a pile of unanswered questions. A real chunk of your week is deciding things nobody has decided yet. Some excellent engineers hate working that way. That's a reasonable thing to hate.

You'd be the only engineer for a while. No technical team to think out loud with, nobody to review your pull requests, nobody who shares your vocabulary. That can get lonely and I'm not going to pretend otherwise.

I'm not a programmer. I'll have opinions about things I only half understand, and you'll have to be the kind of person who can tell me why I'm wrong without it becoming a thing.

Right now we're a supplement and coaching company, not a tech company. We want that to change. But right now the people here are marketers and coaches. You'd be the only one in the room who speaks your language, at least at first. (upside: you’ll get to help build the team you want around you)

The users show up on day one. That's the whole advantage, and it's also the pressure. There's no quiet period where you get to polish in the dark.

And it takes over your brain. If you've already got something doing that, keep it. That's the right call and I'd make the same one.

### **What you get**

$200,000 to $260,000 base, depending on what you bring.

A share of the profit growth. Not a lottery ticket that pays out if somebody buys us in nine years. A cut of the money the business actually makes, starting the year you make it bigger. We're profitable today, so this is real money and not a story.

An equity stake with a written path to owning a real piece, tied to milestones we agree on up front.
Your name on it. Technical founder of this product, publicly. Not "a developer."

Real say over how it gets built. Not some fantasy where I never have an opinion. I'll have plenty, and I'll bring you what I hear from people who know more than I do. I'm not a programmer and I know it. You’re the lead on this one.

You build the team. When we add engineers, you pick them. Nobody gets hired onto your side of the house without you saying yes.

Remote, wherever you live. Four hours of overlap with my day. We’ll fly everyone in a few times a year and eat well.

I want version one in the App Store this year. Not the full vision. A real, small first version we can put in front of people and start learning from.

### **How to apply**

No cover letter.

Send me two things.

One, the app(s) you're proudest of. Link it, and tell me one thing you'd rip out of it today if you could.

Two, tell me about a time you built something nobody asked you to build. What it was, and why you couldn't leave it alone.

That's it. If it's good, we talk for 30 minutes and I tell you everything.

If that goes well, I pay you your full rate for two or three days to tear apart our janky prototype and tell me what version one should be. No free work, ever.

I'm talking to a small number of people. If you're already deep in something you love, go finish it. I mean that.

If you're not, and you've got the chops, this is the one. Come build it with us.

(And if this isn't for you but you know the person it is for, send them this. I'd owe you one.)

title: Global Sales Development Representative

## **🦸‍♀️ The Role 🦸‍♀️**

At Chattermill, we empower leading brands like Uber, Amazon, E.On, Next, and HelloFresh to put customers at the heart of everything they do. Our advanced Customer Experience Intelligence platform uses innovative AI to continuously analyse customer feedback, helping clients make data-driven decisions and elevate their service.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Global Sales Development Representative** (SDR) to play a pivotal role in our growth journey.

 

## 👉 **What you'll be doing:**

You’ll be playing a key role in prospecting and qualifying enterprise opportunities within Chattermill's defined Enterprise ICP. This means you will:

- Identify, research, and prioritise enterprise target accounts (with $1bn+ revenue) across Europe, the UK, and North America.
- Build and execute tailored, multi-channel outbound campaigns (email, phone, LinkedIn, video) aimed at senior leaders in CX, Product, Insights, and Voice of Customer roles.
- Qualify inbound and outbound leads against both our ICP and non-ICP criteria.
- Book and progress qualified meetings, ensuring a smooth handoff and maintaining an accurate pipeline in HubSpot.
- Develop strong knowledge of our solution, target customers, and the competitive landscape to engage confidently with enterprise stakeholders.
- Continuously iterate and refine your messaging, outreach sequences, and targeting strategy based on conversion data and insights.

 

## 🧰 **What you’ll need:**

- 6 - 12 months’ experience in a B2B SaaS environment (preferred)
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple conversations simultaneously
- Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced setting
- Coachable mindset, eager to learn and apply feedback quickly
- Excellent written and verbal communication, comfortable engaging prospects across phone, email, and LinkedIn
- Commercial curiosity with a natural ability to understand customer pain points and clearly communicate value

##

1. Introductory asynchronous interview – tell us about yourself and what you’re looking for. Our team will review your submission.
2. Sales Director interview – discuss your experience and learn more about the role.
3. A short take-home task – show us how you work.
4. Meet the team – get to know key team members you’ll be working with.
5. Co-founder call – explore our values and ensure our growth vision aligns with your goals.

- Flexible working in a choice-first environment - we trust the way you want to work!

- 25 days holiday + local bank holidays, plus an extra day for each year of service
- Your birthday off

*🌱 Growth & Ownership*

- Annual learning & development budget to support your growth (increasing over time)
- Equity options — share in the company’s success

*💚 Health & Wellbeing*

- Monthly health & wellbeing budget, increasing with length of service
- Optional private healthcare plan
- Life assurance & income protection (location dependent)
- Employee Assistance Programme (location dependent) for extra support when you need it
- Enhanced family leave (location dependent), plus fertility and neonatal leave

*🌆 Office Perks*

- If you’re in London, a dog-friendly office with great classes, events, and a rooftop terrace

##   
**💖 Our Values** 

- **We are obsessed with experience** – We take our mission to rid the world of bad Customer Experience seriously, and we practice what we preach.
- **We believe in the power of trust** – Whether it's with each other, our customers, partners, or other stakeholders, we always communicate with openness and trust.
- **We act as responsible owners** – Whether it's about the company, a team, a project, or a task, having the freedom to make decisions in our area of responsibility is a crucial driver for us.
- **We share a passion for growth & progress** – On every level, we’re motivated by taking on new challenges – even if they seem out of reach. We recognise that we are learning machines and we always seek to action feedback and improve collectively.
- **We set our ambitions high but stay humble** – We've come together to build a product and a category that’s never been seen before. While we're an ambitious bunch with lofty goals, we don't approach this goal carelessly.
- **We believe the right team is the key to success** – At Chattermill we’ve learned that all our important achievements have been the result of the right people collaborating together – that’s why we need ***you*** to apply today!

##   
**🌈 Diversity & Inclusion**

We want to enable exceptional experiences for everyone, and to achieve this we need everyone’s voice in our team.  We are on a mission to bring more diversity into the business and to give everyone (from all backgrounds and abilities) a chance to join us, even if they may not fit all of the requirements set out in this job spec. We realise that some may be hesitant to apply for a role when they don’t meet 100% of the listed requirements – we believe in potential and will happily consider all applications based on the skills and experience you have, we’d love to be part of your growth and we encourage you to apply!

To apply

title: Co-Founder & Chief Growth & Commercial Officer
description:
KiwiiApp | Remote / MENA

**About Kiwii**

Kiwii is building a new type of gamified brand engagement platform.

Every day at 8 PM, Kiwii features one brand, one digital scratch card, and one opportunity for each user to unlock a reward — such as a discount, exclusive offer, free product, experience, or surprise reward.

Instead of brands competing for attention in crowded advertising feeds, Kiwii gives one brand the spotlight for the day and turns passive advertising into an interactive experience users have a reason to return to.

Our positioning is simple:

Scratch. Win. Share.

Kiwii is designed to create a daily consumer habit while giving brands a new way to acquire, engage and retain customers.

The product is already live on Android, with the platform and backend infrastructure in place. The current app listing shows 1K+ downloads and was updated in August 2026.

**Why Kiwii?**

Advertising is becoming increasingly crowded and expensive. Consumers see thousands of marketing messages, but very few give them a reason to actively engage.

Kiwii changes the interaction.

- For users

Instead of scrolling through another advertisement:

Come back → Scratch → Discover a brand → Unlock a reward → Share it.

- For brands

Instead of simply buying impressions:

Get the daily spotlight → Engage users → Deliver a reward → Generate measurable interaction.

The concept is deliberately simple: one brand every day.

This creates scarcity and focus for brands while creating anticipation for users.

We believe the combination of daily habit + gamification + rewards + brand-funded experiences + social sharing can create a powerful two-sided growth loop.

Kiwii's current public positioning describes the product as a mobile scratch-card platform designed to create daily engagement between users and brands.

**Where We Are Today**

Kiwii is no longer just an idea.

We currently have:

~1,700 installs
~350 registered and active users
A functioning Android application
Working backend/platform infrastructure
A live demonstration experience
A signed partnership agreement with a first global brand partner.
A clear brand/merchant campaign model
The technology cofounder already in place
Early product validation and user feedback

The immediate challenge is no longer "Can we build Kiwii?"

The challenge is: Can we make Kiwii grow?

That is why we are looking for our next cofounder.

**The Opportunity** 

We are looking for a highly entrepreneurial:

Co-Founder & Chief Growth & Commercial Officer

This is not a traditional marketing job.

This is not a traditional sales job.

And this is definitely not a job where we give you a marketing budget and ask you to spend it.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a founding member of Kiwii and build the company's growth and commercial engine from the ground up.

Your mission will be simple:

Bring users to Kiwii. Bring brands and merchants to Kiwii. Turn both into a repeatable growth and revenue engine.

**The Kiwii Growth Strategy** 

We are taking a country-by-country approach.

We do not want to launch everywhere simultaneously.

Our strategy is:

Enter one country → build users → build a local brand/merchant network → prove the model → optimize → establish traction → expand into the next country.

The initial focus will be on selected MENA markets, with the ability to expand regionally once the model is proven.

The person joining us will have significant influence over which market we prioritize, how we enter it, and how we build the local growth engine.

**Your Mission** 

You will own two sides of Kiwii:

1. Consumer Growth

Build the user acquisition and engagement engine.

2. Commercial Growth

Build the brand and merchant acquisition engine.

You will work directly with the CEO and CTO to turn Kiwii from an early-stage product into a growing business.

**Your Responsibilities - USER GROWTH**

You will be responsible for growing Kiwii's user base primarily through organic and low-cost acquisition.

You will:

Build Kiwii's organic growth strategy
Develop TikTok, Instagram and social content strategies
Identify and recruit creators and influencers
Build referral and ambassador programs
Develop viral/shareable mechanisms
Build relationships with communities
Explore university and youth communities
Develop partnerships that can deliver users
Identify new organic acquisition channels
Experiment continuously with different growth mechanisms
Monitor activation, engagement and retention
Work with the CTO to improve the product based on growth data
Turn successful experiments into repeatable acquisition channels

We are not looking for someone who simply posts content.

We want someone who asks:

"How do I get 1 user to bring 2 more users?"

**BRAND & MERCHANT ACQUISITION**

You will build Kiwii's commercial pipeline from zero.

You will:

Identify potential brands and merchants
Build prospect databases
Find decision-makers
Conduct outreach
Arrange meetings
Pitch Kiwii
Create partnerships
Secure rewards/offers from brands
Secure campaign participation
Convert free/experimental campaigns into paid campaigns
Develop long-term brand relationships
Build a repeatable sales process
Develop campaign packages and commercial offers
Track the entire sales funnel
Negotiate and close deals
Develop strategic partnerships with larger organizations

Potential categories include:

Restaurants
Cafés
Fashion
Beauty
Electronics
Travel
Telecom
Entertainment
Hotels
E-commerce
Food delivery
Fitness
Events
Retail
Subscription businesses

**THE $0 ACQUISITION CHALLENGE**

This is one of the most important parts of this role.

Kiwii currently does not have a large marketing or sales budget.

We are therefore looking for a cofounder who knows how to create traction without depending on paid advertising.

You will initially have to build growth through:

Personal networks
Brand relationships
Creator partnerships
Affiliate arrangements
Referral programs
Revenue-sharing arrangements
Commission-based sales
Organic social media
Communities
Partnerships
PR
Events
Strategic alliances
AI-powered prospecting
AI-powered content and growth experimentation

For example, instead of paying an influencer $5,000 upfront, you might build a performance-based relationship.

Instead of paying to acquire 10,000 users, you might partner with a brand that already has 500,000 customers.

Instead of hiring 10 salespeople, you might build a commission-only business development network.

This mindset is essential.

We want someone who sees the lack of budget as a challenge to solve, not a reason why growth cannot happen.

**TURN BRANDS INTO USER ACQUISITION CHANNELS** 

A major part of your job will be developing this strategy.

We don't want brands simply to give Kiwii a reward.

We want brands to help distribute Kiwii.

For example:

Brand joins Kiwii

↓

Provides an exclusive reward

↓

Kiwii creates the campaign

↓

Brand promotes the campaign to its own audience

↓

Kiwii acquires new users

↓

Users engage with the brand

↓

Brand sees results

↓

Brand returns for another campaign

This creates a potential growth loop between brands and users.

You will be responsible for developing and scaling this model.

**BUILD THE COMMERCIAL NETWORK**

As Kiwii grows, you will also have the opportunity to build a network of:

Commission-based sales representatives
Brand ambassadors
Influencers
Creators
Community leaders
Local partners
Country representatives

The objective is eventually to create a system where Kiwii can enter a new country without having to build an expensive local team from day one.

**AI-POWERED GROWTH** 

We are building Kiwii as an AI-enabled company.

You will be expected to use AI aggressively to increase your productivity.

For example:

Identify potential brands
Find decision-makers
Research companies
Generate personalized outreach
Analyze acquisition channels
Identify creators
Generate content ideas
Analyze campaign performance
Identify growth opportunities
Build prospect lists
Automate repetitive sales activities
Analyze user behavior
Generate growth experiments

We don't want a person who needs a large team to execute.

We want someone who can use AI + automation + relationships + creativity to accomplish what traditionally requires a much larger organization.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS** 

Your first 90 days will be about proving the model.

Month 1 — Build the Engine
Understand the product and users
Define target users
Define priority country
Build initial brand/merchant pipeline
Build creator/influencer pipeline
Develop acquisition experiments
Establish growth KPIs
Establish commercial KPIs
Start outreach and meetings

Month 2 — Generate Traction
Launch user acquisition experiments
Recruit creators/ambassadors
Build community partnerships
Secure additional brands/merchants
Launch campaigns
Establish referral mechanisms
Test commercial offers
Measure user activation and retention
Identify the strongest acquisition channels

Month 3 — Prove Repeatability

By the end of 90 days, we want evidence of:

A repeatable user acquisition mechanism

and

A repeatable brand/merchant acquisition mechanism.

The objective isn't to spend money to manufacture numbers.

The objective is to prove:

"We found something that works, and we can do it again."

**Key Performance Indicators** 

You will ultimately be accountable for:

USER SIDE
New users
Activated users
Daily active users
Retention
Referral rate
Organic acquisition
Cost of acquisition
BUSINESS SIDE
Qualified prospects
Brand meetings
Brands onboarded
Campaigns launched
Paying campaigns
Revenue
Repeat campaigns
Brand retention
MOST IMPORTANT

Can you make the growth repeatable?

**Who We Are Looking For** 

We are looking for someone who is:

Entrepreneurial
Extremely proactive
Commercially aggressive
Comfortable with uncertainty
A strong communicator
A natural salesperson
Good at building relationships
Creative with acquisition
Comfortable with rejection
Data-driven
Highly resourceful
AI-native
Comfortable working without a large team
Comfortable working without a large budget
Excited by early-stage startups
Experience that could be particularly valuable

Experience in one or more of:

Consumer apps
Startups
Growth
Digital marketing
Advertising
AdTech
MarTech
Loyalty
Rewards
E-commerce
Marketplaces
Media
Influencer marketing
Brand partnerships
B2B sales
Business development

Existing relationships with brands, merchants, creators, media companies or strategic partners in MENA are a major advantage.

**What We DON'T Want** 

We are not looking for:

A traditional corporate marketer
Someone who needs a large advertising budget
Someone who only knows how to manage agencies
Someone who only wants to create social media posts
Someone who waits for leads to arrive
Someone who needs a large team before they can execute
Someone who wants a traditional 9–5 startup job

We are looking for someone who thinks:

"Give me the product, the opportunity and the problem. I'll figure out how to get traction."

**What You Get** 

This is a genuine cofounder position.

You will have:

Meaningful equity ownership
Direct influence on company strategy
A seat at the founding team
Direct access to the CEO and CTO
Responsibility for building Kiwii's growth and commercial engine
The opportunity to lead expansion into new countries
The opportunity to build and lead the commercial/growth organization as Kiwii scales
Equity

10–15% founder equity, depending on experience, commitment and what the candidate brings to Kiwii.

Our target range for the right full-time cofounder is approximately 12.5%, subject to a standard 4-year vesting schedule with a 1-year cliff and a mutually agreed founder/cofounder agreement.

We are more interested in finding the right person than negotiating a particular percentage.

**The Founding Team** 

Founder / CEO
Vision, strategy, fundraising, major partnerships and company leadership.

Co-Founder / CTO
Technology, product, AI and platform development.

You — Co-Founder / Chief Growth & Commercial Officer
Users, brands, merchants, partnerships, growth and revenue.

Together, the mission is simple:

Build Kiwii into the daily engagement platform connecting consumers with brands — one country at a time.

**Why Join Now?** 

Kiwii is at an interesting point.

We have already built the product.

We have users.

We have a functioning platform.

We have our first brand partnership.

We have technology leadership.

What we need now is someone who can turn the product into a business.

You will be joining as one of the people responsible for determining whether Kiwii becomes a real regional company.

If you want to build something from the ground up, have a strong commercial instinct, and get excited by the challenge of creating growth without relying on a big budget, we'd like to hear from you.

Let's build Kiwii. 🥝

Senior Python is a specialized hiring platform focused on Python and related technical talent. We help recruiters, staffing firms, and hiring teams reach relevant technical candidates without the noise of general job boards.

We are looking for independent B2B sales contractors to bring recruiters, staffing firms, and employers onto the platform. This is a fully remote, commission-only 1099 opportunity in the U.S.

**What You’ll Sell**

Customers **pay $99 per active job posting, per month**, and each posting is billed separately.

For example:

1 active job = $99/month 5 active jobs = $495/month 10 active jobs = $990/month

Customers may have multiple active postings and may renew them monthly.

* 12 months from the customer’s first paid transaction, or

* Strong professional communication skills

* Comfortable with commission-only compensation

title: Social Media Manager
description:

- Plan and organize social media content calendars

- Research social media trends, topics, hashtags, and content opportunities

This opportunity starts with contributing to Squama Marketing’s own social media presence.

- Your availability

acceptedRemoteLocations: Portland, Oregon; Tampa, Florida; Saint Petersburg, Florida
description:
**Independent Contractor | Commission Only | 25% Recurring Commission | Portland, OR or Tampa/St. Petersburg, FL**

## About HAEVN

HAEVN is a city-by-city dating network built around a simple idea: people shouldn't have to spend their time swiping, searching, and managing profiles to find someone compatible. Members complete an in-depth compatibility survey once, and HAEVN delivers compatible matches within their city. No swiping. No searching. No profiles to manage. No app to download.

Our goal is to help people find someone worth meeting and move into the real world.

## What Is a HAEVN Meetup Spot?

HAEVN Meetup Spots are local bars, restaurants, coffee shops, and other venues that partner with HAEVN as recommended places for members to meet. They are the physical, local layer of HAEVN's model: connecting compatible people with places in their own community where they can meet.

For venues, the opportunity is to become part of a growing local network of singles looking for places to go on dates and make connections. Meetup Spot partnerships cost $350–$1,000 per month and begin with an initial 90-day agreement.

## The Role

We're looking for a local partnerships sales professional to help build HAEVN's Meetup Spot network in Portland, Oregon or Tampa/St. Petersburg, Florida. Applicants must already be based in the market they will serve. Work combines home-based prospecting and account management with local venue visits. Visa sponsorship and relocation are not offered. This is an independent contractor, commission-only B2B sales and account-management role. You'll develop a book of local venue partners and maintain the relationships you create.

You'll work with venue owners, general managers, marketing decision-makers, and other local business leaders. Strong local-market knowledge, consistent prospecting, and reliable follow-through are central to the role.

## What You'll Do

- Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective local venue partners.
- Reach owners, general managers, and marketing decision-makers through local outreach and prospecting.
- Present the HAEVN Meetup Spot opportunity and explain the program clearly.
- Follow up with prospects and close new partnerships.
- Maintain relationships with the accounts you close and service.
- Support account retention and renewals throughout each partnership.
- Keep sales, pipeline, and account-management activity current in HAEVN's tools.

## Compensation

This is a commission-only independent contractor opportunity with no base salary. You earn **25% recurring commission on collected monthly revenue from the Meetup Spot accounts you close and continue to service**, for as long as those customers remain active and paying.

At partnership prices of $350–$1,000 per month, each active, paying account generates $87.50–$250 per month in commission. The opportunity is to build and retain a book of recurring business.

For illustration, at an average account value of **$500 per month**:

- **10 active accounts:** $1,250 per month / $15,000 annualized.
- **20 active accounts:** $2,500 per month / $30,000 annualized.
- **30 active accounts:** $3,750 per month / $45,000 annualized.
- **40 active accounts:** $5,000 per month / $60,000 annualized.

**These examples are illustrative only, not guaranteed earnings or a salary range.** Annualized figures assume the stated number of accounts remains active, paying, and serviced for 12 full months at a $500 monthly average. They do not account for the time needed to build your book of business. Actual earnings depend on accounts sold and serviced, pricing, collected revenue, and customer retention. No level of earnings is guaranteed.

## Who Could Be a Good Fit

- Experience in B2B sales, hospitality, local advertising, media, events, sponsorships, merchant services, or a related field.
- Strong knowledge of the local market and its venues.
- Comfort reaching business owners and decision-makers, presenting opportunities, and asking for the sale.
- The ability to manage your own pipeline and follow through consistently.
- A relationship-oriented approach to account management and retention.
- Interest in building a local partnership network with an early-stage business.

## What HAEVN Provides

HAEVN provides the brand, sales materials, program information, account-management tools, and support. You bring local knowledge, prospecting, relationships, and follow-through.

Help build the places where HAEVN connections happen in your city.

title: International Business Partner – Global Trade
description:
AKSAE is a South Korean international trading and sourcing company working across Korea, China, India, and other global markets.

We are expanding our Global Partner Network and looking for independent, business-minded professionals who want to build international business opportunities using AKSAE's sourcing network, supplier relationships, and product capabilities.

This is not a traditional employment position. It is an independent, performance-based business partnership for individuals who want to develop their own international trade business with the support of an established Korean company.

What You Will Do

- Identify potential buyers, distributors, importers, and business opportunities in your market.
- Develop and maintain relationships with international clients.
- Introduce AKSAE's products and sourcing capabilities to potential buyers.
- Understand customer requirements and coordinate with the AKSAE team for sourcing and quotations.
- Develop opportunities across industries such as:
  - Food & Beverages
  - Automotive & Auto Parts
  - Machinery & Industrial Products
  - Cosmetics
  - Packaging
  - OEM/ODM Products
- Coordinate negotiations and follow-ups between buyers and suppliers.
- Help develop long-term business relationships in your assigned market.
- Represent AKSAE professionally when communicating with potential business partners.
- Take ownership of your market and develop your own network of clients and opportunities.

What AKSAE Provides

- Access to suppliers and manufacturers in Korea, China, and India.
- Product sourcing and supplier identification support.
- Competitive supplier pricing and quotations.
- Assistance with product specifications and commercial discussions.
- Support from the AKSAE international business team.
- Opportunities across multiple industries rather than a single product category.
- The ability to develop your own market and client network with AKSAE's international infrastructure.

Who We Are Looking For

We are interested in people who:

- Have experience in international business, sales, sourcing, trading, distribution, or business development.
- Have an existing network of buyers, importers, distributors, or companies.
- Understand their local market and can identify commercial opportunities.
- Are comfortable communicating with international companies.
- Are proactive, independent, and comfortable working without close supervision.
- Want to build a long-term international business relationship rather than simply work a fixed job.
- Have strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

Experience in international trade is preferred, but strong business development professionals with relevant industry networks are also welcome.

Partnership Structure

This is an independent, commission-based partnership.

There is no fixed monthly salary. Partners earn through successful business deals generated and developed through their market activities.

The exact commercial structure will depend on the product, transaction, market, and role of the partner in each deal.

Partners remain responsible for developing their local business network and opportunities, while AKSAE provides sourcing, supplier, product, and international trade support.

Why Join the AKSAE Global Partner Network?

Instead of starting an international trading business completely from zero, partners can leverage AKSAE's existing network across Korea, China, India, and international markets.

You bring the market knowledge, relationships, and business opportunities.

AKSAE brings the sourcing network, suppliers, products, and international trade infrastructure.

Together, we develop business.

Important

This opportunity is intended for independent business partners, not conventional employees.

If you already have a network of companies, buyers, distributors, importers, or business contacts and want to expand into international sourcing and trading, we would like to hear from you.

title: Creative Designer / Visualiser

About Taxowl
At Taxowl, we are building modern, impactful solutions and reshaping how our audience engages with finance and technology. We value speed, innovation, and out-of-the-box thinking. If you love experimenting with visual formats, leveraging cutting-edge tools, and bringing high-energy ideas to life, you will fit right in.

title: Founding Product & Partnerships Lead – Web3 Ticketing
description:
## About Tikex

Tikex.com is a ticketing platform built to help independent event organizers sell and manage tickets more efficiently.

We are exploring a new product line: a secure and organizer-controlled secondary ticket marketplace. Ticket holders would be able to resell or transfer tickets safely, while organizers could define resale rules, prevent fraud, maintain visibility over ticket ownership, and potentially receive revenue from secondary transactions.

The solution may use blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, tokenized tickets, and external liquidity or marketplace protocols. The exact technical and commercial model has not yet been finalized — shaping and validating it will be a central part of this role.

## The Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Product & Partnerships Lead to help turn this concept into a validated product and a new business line within Tikex.

This is not a traditional sales position. You will work directly with the founder to define the product, interview event organizers, validate demand, develop the go-to-market strategy, and secure the first pilot partners.

You should be comfortable working at the intersection of ticketing, live events, marketplaces, Web3, and business development.

## What You’ll Do

* Research the European primary and secondary ticketing markets
* Interview event organizers, venues, festivals, and conference operators
* Identify the event categories with the strongest need for controlled ticket resale
* Validate organizer and ticket-buyer pain points
* Help design the secondary marketplace business model
* Define resale rules, pricing limits, organizer fees, and revenue-sharing options
* Evaluate blockchain-based ticketing models, smart contracts, and token standards
* Assess whether protocols such as Uniswap or other external marketplaces provide real value
* Identify legal, regulatory, operational, and user-experience risks
* Build relationships with event organizers and industry partners
* Secure the first one to three pilot events
* Turn pilot feedback into product requirements and a go-to-market roadmap
* Potentially build and lead this business line in the longer term

## Who We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Ticketing, live events, festivals, venues, or entertainment
* Business development or partnerships in an early-stage startup
* Two-sided marketplaces or resale platforms
* Web3, smart contracts, tokenization, or decentralized marketplaces
* Product discovery and customer interviews
* Launching new products or business lines from an early-stage concept

You do not need to be a software developer, but you should understand blockchain products well enough to work with technical teams and challenge assumptions.

Existing relationships with event organizers, venues, festivals, promoters, or Web3 communities would be a significant advantage.

## First 90 Days

Your initial objectives will be to:

* Interview at least 15–20 relevant event organizers
* Identify the strongest initial event segment
* Define the pilot product and commercial model
* Build a shortlist of potential partners
* Secure at least one committed pilot organizer
* Produce a validated product and go-to-market roadmap

## What We Offer

* A founding-level role in a new ticketing business line
* Direct collaboration with the founder
* Significant influence over product strategy and commercial direction
* Flexible, remote and part-time collaboration initially
* Compensation structured around a combination of cash, milestone-based rewards, revenue share, and potentially equity
* Opportunity to grow into a long-term leadership or co-founder-level role if the collaboration proves successful

## Important

This product is currently at the concept and validation stage. The secondary marketplace and blockchain implementation have not yet been built.

We are not looking for someone who simply wants to sell an existing finished product. We are looking for a partner who wants to help validate, shape, launch, and grow it.

If this sounds interesting, please send us:

* A short introduction
* Your relevant experience
* Any relationships you have within ticketing, events, marketplaces, or Web3
* Your initial opinion on where controlled secondary ticketing could create the most value
* An example of a product, partnership, or business line you helped launch

title: Growth, Marketing and Partnerships Intern

The platform transforms repository signals such as architecture, modularity, code quality, and technology depth into skill visualizations without exposing source code or personal data. Hiring teams gain faster, harder-to-fake insight into a developer’s capabilities, improving the quality and fairness of technical evaluations. Developers benefit from an alternative to résumé keyword filters, algorithm-heavy tests, and AI-assisted take-home assignments. Pragmys is focused on making engineering hiring more transparent, skills-based, and respectful of developer privacy.

*Check us out at [Pragmys.com](https://pragmys.com) and our [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/pragmys) page before applying.*

### Role Description

The Growth, Marketing and Partnerships Intern will support initiatives that expand Pragmys’ user base, brand awareness, and strategic collaborations. **This remote internship is an unpaid role, involving assisting with market research, analyzing growth opportunities, and contributing to experiments that drive user acquisition and engagement. The work is milestone-based and fully flexible across hours.** The intern will help draft marketing content, support social media and community outreach, and coordinate with partners such as student and developer communities, bootcamps, and hiring teams. Day-to-day responsibilities include tracking campaign performance, preparing simple reports, supporting sales outreach, and collaborating with the team on projects that refine messaging and positioning. - Clear and professional communication skills for marketing copy, outreach messages, and partner interactions, in B2C and B2B communications.
- Interest or experience in growth hacking and marketing strategies to support user acquisition and retention, especially with technical communities and students.
- Curiosity about developer tools, recruiting technology, or HR tech, and willingness to learn quickly.
- Enrollment in or completion of studies in business, marketing, communications, or a related field is beneficial but not required.

### Perks
- Direct experience working with the founders of an early-stage AI startup.
- Ownership of real growth, marketing, and partnership initiatives.
Exposure to product strategy, developer marketing, community building, and startup operations.
- Flexible remote work with opportunities to experiment and contribute ideas.
Practical experience and measurable outcomes for your portfolio.
- Opportunity to transition from an unpaid internship to performance-based compensation linked to measurable contributions to the company’s growth.

title: Senior AI Research Engineer

## **About Standard Bots**

At Standard Bots, we're revolutionizing real-world automation by making robotic systems accessible to everyone. Our AI-powered platform enables robots to tackle unprecedented challenges through an intuitive instruction interface, bringing the power of software automation to physical spaces.

## **About the Role**

We're seeking a Senior AI Research Engineer to develop and optimize our AI models and training systems. This is an exciting opportunity to apply your deep ML expertise to cutting-edge AI/robotics applications. You'll work closely with our engineering team to design, implement, and iterate on large-scale AI models while building efficient systems for rapid experimentation and deployment. We have a small team of AI engineers, so we’re looking for someone who is excited to work at a startup, and work across the stack to do what is needed to get a model that achieves a customer problem.

We're looking for an experienced engineer ready to make a tangible impact in the AI robotics revolution. This role requires a proven background working on ML planning within the autonomous vehicle space with experience using the latest techniques in diffusion and autoregressive models in a professional setting. If you're excited about building the latest advancements in AI and working in the robotics space, we’d love to hear from you.

## **In this role, you will:**

- Design and implement state of the art ML models and training pipelines:

  - Apply novel machine learning techniques to wide range of robotics applications
  - Develop efficient data and training strategies
  - Implement model evaluation frameworks and metrics tracking
- Lead model development and iteration with focus on:

  - Rapid experimentation and prototyping of new model architectures
  - Performance optimization and model debugging
  - Transfer learning and fine-tuning strategies
- Build robust evaluation and debugging systems to:

  - Analyze model behavior and failure modes
  - Implement interpretability tools and visualization frameworks
  - Track and improve model metrics
- Collaborate with engineering team to optimize training infrastructure and deployment

## **You might thrive in this role if you:**

- Have 5+ years of AI modeling experience, specifically within the self-driving car industry (or PhD with 3+ years of AI modeling experience in the self-driving car industry)
- Proven track record developing and deploying large-scale ML models
- Have experience using the latest techniques in diffusion and autoregressive models in a professional setting
- Are familiar with training inference and infra pipelines that go from camera input to trajectory output for self driving or robotics
- Have experience with RL (reinforcement learning)
- Have a strong understanding of modern ML architectures and training techniques
- Have experience with model debugging, optimization, and performance tuning
- Have a background in implementing ML research papers and adapting academic work

## **Tech Stack**

- PyTorch (experience with PyTorch required)
- Python
- NodeJS/Typescript
- Docker

## **Compensation and Benefits:**

The salary range for this role is $225,000 to $250,000 depending on experience. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.
