title: Capital Raising Manager (or Investor Relations Manager)
location: Austin; New York City; Texas; San Francisco
description:
**About Secure Grid Technologies**
Secure Grid Technologies is a US-based infrastructure company operating in AI/data-center infrastructure. As the company expands into AI and high-performance computing infrastructure, we're building out our finance function to support ambitious growth plans.

**About the Role**
We currently have a small group of investors in place and are looking to raise $100M in debt financing to fund future projects. We need a finance professional to lead this capital raise, sourcing and closing debt investors/lenders on the basis of our contracted compute revenue. We're open to full-time or a freelance/contract arrangement, depending on the right fit.

**Key Responsibilities**
Capital Raising (Primary Focus)
* Identify and engage debt providers relevant to infrastructure/AI compute financing — private credit funds, infrastructure lenders, banks, asset-backed lenders
* Lead the $100M debt raise from initial outreach through term sheet and close
* Structure debt financing using signed compute contracts as collateral/basis for lending — similar to project or asset-backed finance structures
* Prepare financial models, lender materials, and data room content to support the raise
* Negotiate term sheets and financing terms, working closely with the CEO and legal counsel
Financial Strategy
* Advise the CEO on debt structure, terms, and lender selection
* Track market conditions and debt financing structures relevant to AI/GPU infrastructure companies
Note: this role is focused specifically on raising new capital — not on managing relationships with existing investors.

**What We're Looking For**
Required
* Proven experience raising debt capital for growth-stage or infrastructure companies, ideally at a similar scale ($50M+ raises)
* Experience structuring debt financing against contracted revenue or assets (project finance, asset-backed lending, or similar)
* Existing relationships with debt providers relevant to infrastructure/tech financing (private credit, infrastructure lenders, banks)
* Strong financial modeling and lender material development skills
* Excellent negotiation skills and ability to move quickly
Preferred
* Experience in AI infrastructure, data centers, GPU/compute, or energy project financing specifically
* Background in investment banking, private credit, or corporate development
* Experience with compute/capacity contracts as loan collateral or revenue basis

**What We Offer**
* Fully remote role, based anywhere in the United States
* Full-time or freelance/contract engagement, depending on fit
* Direct working relationship with the CEO and executive team
* The opportunity to lead a high-impact $100M capital raise for a fast-growing AI/GPU infrastructure company
* Exposure to innovative financing structures in one of the fastest-growing sectors in the US

Apply now and help fuel Secure Grid's next stage of growth!

title: C#/.NET Engineer – ERP & QuickBooks Integration
description:
Location: Ukraine, Europe — 100% Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $2,000–$2,500 USD/month
Required Working Hours: U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced C#/.NET Engineer based in Ukraine to join our development team and work primarily on ERP development and QuickBooks integrations.

This is a remote position, but candidates must be available to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This requirement is important because the engineer will collaborate directly with our U.S.-based engineering team, customers, and business stakeholders.

You will build and maintain backend services, APIs, synchronization processes, and integrations connecting our ERP platform with QuickBooks and other business systems.

 

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain backend applications using C# and .NET / .NET Core.
* Build and maintain ERP integrations with QuickBooks.
* Develop integrations with QuickBooks Online (QBO) APIs.
* Work with customers, vendors, invoices, payments, bills, expenses, purchase orders, accounts, payroll-related data, and inventory.
* Design reliable two-way data synchronization between ERP and QuickBooks.
* Build REST APIs, webhooks, background services, and scheduled synchronization jobs.
* Implement OAuth 2.0 and other authentication mechanisms.
* Handle data mapping and transformation between ERP and QuickBooks.
* Troubleshoot synchronization failures, duplicate records, API errors, and data inconsistencies.
* Implement retry mechanisms, logging, monitoring, and error handling.
* Work extensively with SQL Server and relational data.
* Investigate and resolve production integration issues.
* Participate in code reviews and architecture discussions.
* Collaborate directly with U.S.-based developers, product managers, customers, and stakeholders.
* Participate in meetings and technical discussions during U.S. Eastern Time working hours.

 

Required Technical Skills

* 3+ years of professional C#/.NET development experience
* Strong C# programming skills
* .NET 6/7/8 or later
* ASP.NET Core / Web API
* REST API development and third-party integrations
* SQL Server
* Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core
* OAuth 2.0
* JSON and API data transformation
* Background workers and scheduled jobs
* Asynchronous programming (async / await)
* Git
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
 

ERP & QuickBooks Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:

* QuickBooks Online API
* QuickBooks Desktop integrations
* QuickBooks Web Connector
* ERP development
* Accounting system integrations
* Customer/vendor synchronization
* Invoice and payment synchronization
* Payroll integrations
* Inventory and purchasing workflows
* CRM-to-accounting integrations
* Financial data synchronization
 

Previous QuickBooks integration experience is highly preferred.

Nice to Have

* Microsoft Azure
* Azure Functions
* Azure App Service
* Azure SQL
* Azure Service Bus
* Docker
* CI/CD
* GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
* Microservices
* Message queues
* Redis
* Vue.js, Angular, or React
* Multi-tenant SaaS experience
* Experience modernizing legacy .NET applications
 

Working Hours — Important

This position requires working according to the U.S. Eastern Time (ET) schedule.

Candidates must be comfortable working U.S. business hours from Ukraine and should be consistently available during the agreed Eastern Time schedule for:

* Daily development work
* Team meetings
* Customer meetings
* Technical discussions
* Production support
* Collaboration with U.S.-based team members

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
[Tulip](https://tulip.co/), the leader in AI-native frontline operations, is helping companies around the world equip their workforce with composable, connected apps, leading to higher quality work, improved efficiency, and end-to-end traceability across operations. Tulip’s cloud-native, no-code platform, powered by embedded AI, is driving the digital transformation of industrial environments through composable, human-centric solutions that go beyond disrupting the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) category.

A spinoff out of MIT, Tulip is headquartered in Somerville, MA, with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, and Israel. Tulip has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast award winner, one of Energage’s Top Workplaces USA, and one of Built In Boston’s “Best Places to Work” and “Best Midsize Places to Work.”

**About You:**

We're looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to join our growing Customer Success team at Tulip Interfaces. As a TAM, you'll bridge the gap between technical expertise and customer success, partnering closely with our customers and the Tulip account team to provide strategic and tactical guidance on technical matters that drive customer value and adoption.

You'll serve as the technical advisor for customers, helping them maximize their investment in Tulip's no-code platform while ensuring they achieve their operational excellence goals.

You're passionate about technology, customer success, and manufacturing innovation. You speak fluently about current SaaS, IIoT, cloud, and AI trends in manufacturing, including actively using modern tools plus AI-assisted tools to work more effectively. You thrive in technical discussions while building strong relationships with customers and internal teams. You have a collaborative mindset and enjoy translating complex technical concepts for diverse audiences. You're excited about helping manufacturers transform their operations using cutting-edge no-code technology.

**What skills do I need?** 

Technical Background

- 5-7 years of experience in technical customer-facing roles (Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or similar)
- 3+ Years of Tulip delivery experience or equivalent MES experience, at the L4 SOLV level
- Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, Industry 4.0, or industrial software
- Experience with APIs, system integrations, and database concepts
- Familiarity with no-code/low-code platforms preferred
- Ability to travel (estimated 20%)

Communication & Collaboration

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
- Strong presentation and workshop facilitation skills
- Collaborative mindset with experience working across teams

Industry Knowledge

- Deep knowledge of digital transformation initiatives in industrial settings
- Understanding of manufacturing processes and operational challenges
- Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and similar platforms

**Key Responsibilities:**

Strategic Technical Advisory

- Partner with customers and the Tulip account team to develop and execute technical success plans for assigned accounts
- Provide expert guidance on Tulip platform architecture, integrations, and advanced use cases
- Lead technical discussions with customer stakeholders, from app builders to IT and Operations leaders
- Identify opportunities for deeper platform adoption and technical optimization

Customer Enablement & Growth

- Conduct technical workshops, training sessions, and platform deep-dives
- Help customers design scalable solutions using Tulip's no-code platform
- Guide customers through complex technical implementations and integrations
- Collaborate with customers to establish technical best practices and governance

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- As a member of the account team, you will work closely with Account Executive and Customer Success Manager to ensure seamless customer experience and account growth
- Partner with Product and Engineering teams to communicate customer technical requirements
- Collaborate with Sales Engineering during expansion opportunities
- Support renewal processes with technical value demonstrations

Technical Expertise & Thought Leadership

- Stay current on Tulip platform capabilities, industry trends, and manufacturing technologies
- Develop technical content, documentation, and enablement materials
- Participate in customer advisory boards and technical user groups
- Represent Tulip at industry events and technical conferences
- Actively use AI tools in your technical workflow

**Key Collaborators:**

- Customer Success
- Product
- Engineering
- Support

**Working At Tulip**

We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. Even if you don’t match every requirement, applying gives you the opportunity to be considered. 

We’re building a strong, diverse team that values hard work, families, and personal well-being. Benefits of working with us include:

- Direct impact on product and culture
- Company equity
- Competitive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision, Short-term Disability, Long-term Disability, Life Insurance, AD&D Insurance, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Commuter Benefits, Parental Leave, and 401(K)
- Flexible work schedule and unlimited vacation policy
- Virtual company events and happy hours
- Fitness subsidies
- An inclusive, dog-friendly office with diverse and inspiring colleagues

We are an equal opportunity employer. At Tulip, we celebrate all. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Help us build an inclusive community that will transform frontline operations. 

The compensation information displayed on each job posting reflects the range for new hire pay rates for the position across all US locations. Within the range posted, actual compensation will be determined depending on multiple factors including job-related knowledge & skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, market compensation data, and internal equity. *Expected compensation ranges for this role may change over time. *The estimated salary range for this position is $110,000 - $160,000 and is eligible for on-target earnings (OTE).

title: Director, Technical Program Management
description:
Cyberhaven is building the AI-native data security platform for the agentic enterprise. Our data lineage technology traces the full lifecycle of enterprise data across endpoints, browsers, SaaS, and cloud, and that foundation has made us a market leader in DLP and DSPM. It's also the launch pad for the next generation of products we're bringing to market.

We are looking for a Director of Technical Program Management to own end-to-end planning and execution across Cyberhaven's most complex, cross-organizational product initiatives. This role is accountable for release predictability, execution visibility, and operating discipline across the entire engineering organization, not a single team or program, but the system of programs that make up Cyberhaven's roadmap.

This is an individual contributor role: influence and impact are driven through expertise, judgment, and cross-functional leadership rather than headcount or direct reports. The person in this role is expected to operate as a peer to engineering leadership, shaping strategy and operating cadence at the organizational level while still being hands-on with the planning, tracking, and execution work itself.

This role also serves as the primary architect of engineering leadership's monthly and quarterly business reviews, providing decision support, surfacing risk, and driving follow-through across the company's highest-priority engineering programs.

This role goes well beyond traditional program management. It requires deep technical fluency to engage credibly with senior engineering leaders and architects, strong executive presence and organizational judgment to shape leadership priorities, and systems-level thinking to turn fragmented operational signals into the metrics, reporting, and AI-enabled automation that let Cyberhaven scale how it plans, tracks, communicates, and reviews technical work.

## **What you'll do**

### **Program Leadership and Executive Support**

- Own end-to-end planning, execution, and coordination across Cyberhaven's most complex, multi-team, cross-organizational programs, partnering directly with engineering and product leadership
- Set the strategy for how Cyberhaven improves predictability in its release model, including how scope changes, readiness risks, and cross-team dependencies are tracked and escalated
- Architect and run the engineering operating cadence, including monthly and quarterly business reviews, by consolidating team updates, preparing leadership readouts, and driving follow-through on action items at the executive level
- Partner with engineering leadership to translate company and organizational strategy into clear execution plans, success criteria, reporting standards, and operating mechanisms across the entire engineering org
- Define and standardize org-wide success metrics across quality, release health, and velocity, driving greater predictability company-wide while enabling team-specific metrics where needed
- Build and own the review cadences, status reporting, leadership readouts, and action follow-up systems used to surface execution risk and intervention needs across all teams and programs
- Establish data hygiene and governance standards in systems like Jira and related planning artifacts so that release, ownership, status, and progress signals are reliable at scale
- Lead the most ambiguous, highest-priority engineering initiatives that require additional structure, executive visibility, and follow-through, often stepping in where no clear owner exists
- Act as a thought partner and mentor to other program managers and engineering leaders, raising the bar on operating discipline, accountability, and reporting consistency across the org, without formal management authority

### **AI-Enabled Automation**

- Set the direction for AI-assisted dashboards and reporting workflows that give leadership visibility into program health, release scope, delivery risk, and team performance
- Design and build automations that connect tools like Jira, Notion, GitHub, and Slack to surface planning, execution, release, and other delivery signals across the org
- Automate recurring program management processes such as status collection, follow-up tracking, review preparation, and stakeholder reporting at scale
- Use these workflows to transform release reporting, business review inputs, leadership updates, and recurring status reporting, materially reducing manual status chasing across engineering

## **Who you are**

- 10+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Release Management, Engineering Operations, or a similar technical cross-functional role, with a track record of operating at Director-level scope as an individual contributor
- Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end planning and execution for the most complex engineering initiatives, spanning multiple teams and organizations
- Strong technical fluency and systems thinking, especially in engineering process, release workflows, operational reporting, and execution management
- Proven ability to drive accountability, coordination, and follow-through across an entire engineering organization without direct authority
- Track record of defining success metrics, tracking execution health, and turning operational signals into clear, executive-level reporting and decision support
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience owning monthly and quarterly business reviews, executive-facing updates, and cross-functional status reporting
- Deep familiarity with Jira-based workflows, reporting, and process hygiene at scale
- Strong judgment in prioritization, escalation, and leadership support in ambiguous or fast-moving situations, with the credibility to influence senior stakeholders
- Comfort using automation and AI to improve reporting quality, operating efficiency, and recurring workflow execution
- Experience owning QBRs, executive reporting, and engineering metrics programs at the org or company level
- Familiarity with DORA-style metrics, SLO/SLA thinking, release hygiene, and delivery scorecards
- Experience building AI-assisted dashboards, automations, or reporting systems
- Experience working in security, SaaS, endpoint, platform, or infrastructure-heavy environments
- Experience supporting globally distributed engineering organizations
- Prior experience operating at Director or Principal level as an individual contributor (not a people manager)
- Located in the Eastern Timezone to support our Global team.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

**AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

title: Sr. Staff Engineer - Applied AI, Patient  (Remote)
description:
We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms.

We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well-being. 

We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare.

Rula is a remote-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii.

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Sr. Staff Engineer – Applied AI, Patient to help Patient Engineering build and scale AI/ML-powered patient experiences across areas such as matching, ranking, recommendations, onboarding, and personalization.

Rula is at an important stage in its ML journey. We already have ML models and pipelines powering product experiences, with additional capabilities under development. At the same time, much of the engineering foundation required to develop, deploy, evaluate, and operate ML consistently at scale is still ahead of us.

This is a deeply hands-on technical leadership role. You'll develop and improve production models and AI-powered systems, build critical capabilities needed by Patient Engineering, and partner closely with Rula's ML team on shared infrastructure, models, standards, and architectural decisions.

You won't own a single model or product surface. You'll go where the highest-leverage Applied AI problems are—developing models, building reusable capabilities, improving existing systems, or determining whether a problem is best solved with custom ML, a foundation model/AI service, deterministic software, or a hybrid approach.

Success means enabling Patient Engineering to build better intelligent experiences while creating a strong technical partnership with Rula's ML team—resulting in better models, reusable capabilities, and faster, higher-quality delivery of AI/ML-powered patient experiences.

**Required Qualifications**

- 10+ years of software and/or ML engineering experience, including significant experience designing, building, deploying, and operating production ML systems with measurable product or business impact. Particularly Python, with experience building scalable systems and personally writing and reviewing production-quality code.
- Deep hands-on ML expertise and technical leadership across the ML lifecycle: demonstrated experience with problem formulation, data/feature engineering, model development and training, evaluation, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, while setting technical direction across teams, influencing architecture, mentoring senior engineers, and exercising strong judgment about when to use custom ML, foundation models/AI services, deterministic approaches, or hybrids.
- Demonstrated 0→1 experience building shared ML infrastructure or reusable capabilities adopted across teams, such as feature infrastructure, training/inference pipelines, model serving, evaluation, observability, or lifecycle tooling.
- Deep experience with recommendation, ranking, relevance, personalization, search, or matching systems, including rigorous evaluation connecting offline model performance to online experiments and product/business outcomes.
- Strong evaluation and experimentation rigor connecting offline model performance to online experiments and product/business outcomes.
- Hands-on experience building and operating modern foundation model/GenAI systems in production, including evaluation, reliability, latency, cost, privacy/safety, and operational tradeoffs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience helping an organization evolve from early-stage or ad hoc ML development toward mature ML engineering practices.
- Experience operating ML systems in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated/high-trust environment.

**We're serious about your well-being! As part of our team, full-time employees receive:**

- **100% remote work environment:** Working hours to support a healthy work-life balance, ensuring you can meet both professional and personal commitments (must be based in United States, currently not hiring in Hawaii)
- **Attractive pay and benefits**: Full transparency of pay ranges regardless of where you live in the United States
- **Comprehensive health benefits**: Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and FSA/HSA
- **401(k) plan access**: Start saving for your future
- **Generous time-off policies**: Including 2 company-wide shutdown weeks each year for self-care (for most employees)
- **Paid parental leave**: Available for all parents, including birthing, non-birthing, adopting, and fostering
- **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)**: Supporting your mental and physical health
- **Quarterly department stipend**: Fun team-building activities or in-person gatherings
- **Community and employee resource groups**: Participate in groups that celebrate employee identity and lived experiences, fostering a sense of community and belonging for all
- **Home office stipend:** New hire home office stipend & $50 monthly stipend to help cover internet or cell phone expenses
- **Wellness at Rula program:** Year-round wellness initiatives and a $50/month wellness stipend

**Our team**

We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental to our mission of making mental healthcare work for everyone.  We are dedicated to having a culture of inclusion that will support our employees in feeling safe, seen, heard, and valued.

title: Fuel Performance Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Fuel Performance Engineer to join our team. 

**Position Description**

Fuel Performance Engineers at Oklo are responsible for the fuel performance analyses and verification of current and future fuel design for Oklo's Aurora powerhouses. This includes engineering analyses, modeling and simulation, clear and thorough documentation of the analyses, as well as interfacing with our reactor design, fuel fabrication, and licensing teams.

**Specific responsibilities may include:**

- Analyzing current and novel fuel design performance across expected operating conditions and postulated off-normal conditions.
- Devising analysis methodologies that efficiently and effectively build confidence in a design, which can include software development of modeling and simulation tools.
- Verification and validation of modeling and simulation tools in support of analyses.
- Supporting experimental fuel campaigns.
- Collaborating cross-functionally to provide technical feedback to design teams.
- Documenting work using modern tools and techniques, and writing well-written, thoughtful technical reports.

**Competencies**

We are looking for a Fuel Performance Engineer that is:

- Passionate about clean energy and making advanced fission a reality
- Willing and able to learn quickly and adapt to evolving challenges
- Eager to work in a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment where we think differently and do things in new ways
- Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving
- Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems

**Minimum Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, plus 3 years of experience
- Experience with multi-physics system performance analyses
- Experience with finite element simulation software (e.g., Ansys, Abaqus)
- Experience with material analysis
- Experience with object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, C++)

**Bonus Qualifications**

- Experience with nuclear fuel performance analysis
- Familiarity with metallic fuels
- Experience with fuel analysis and fuel performance software (e.g., BISON, LIFE-METAL, etc.)
- Experience in material selection and material analysis
- Fluency in Python

**Who you are:**

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

_Motivated_: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

_A team-player_: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

_An excellent communicator_: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

_Creative_: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

_Detail-oriented_: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

 

**About Oklo travel requirements:**

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

 

**About Oklo compensation:**

Salary: $120,000-$165,000

Salary may fall outside of the range provided and will be dependent on applicant experience.

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, competitive pay, 401k, health insurance, FSA, flexible work hours, and other benefits.

We are looking to fill this position immediately!

* * *

**About Oklo Inc.:** Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

**#CHOP: Oklo’s Values**  
**Collaboration**: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.  
**Humility**: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.  
**Ownership**: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through  to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.  
**Pathfinding**: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

description:
At TixTrack, we support our clients by creating superior ticketing solutions for performing arts and cultural institutions through a combination of modern technology, beautifully simple design, and the art of listening.

Headquartered in the heart of the Broadway Theatre District, NYC, we are a small, but growing team of hardworking, highly motivated individuals. With a presence across both the US and UK, and trusted by key players on Broadway and the West End, we are passionate about our work and driven to innovate with our customers to solve current and future challenges with new solutions.

Our core product, Nliven, is a real-time platform that helps venues manage ticket sales efficiently while creating a more engaging buying experience for customers. We are transforming our engineering culture to align with an Empowered Teams model, embracing Continuous Delivery and focusing on building capabilities to drive higher quality, reliability, and speed.

Even with a highly dispersed, largely remote workforce, we stay connected through our Slack channels, virtual events and regional meetups. Come see how we “role”.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer II, you’ll lead complex technical initiatives and shape how we build, scale, and evolve our Nliven platform. This role is for someone who thrives on solving our hardest technical challenges while helping others grow and succeed around them.

This role requires deep expertise in .NET Core and strong full-stack range across modern frontend frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue, along with a real appreciation for the principles of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps that keep our systems stable, observable, and rapidly deployable. Whether you’re designing new features, optimizing critical services, or tackling tech debt head-on, you’ll have a direct hand in driving technical excellence.

As a full-spectrum engineer, you care about more than code - you care about customers, business outcomes, security, reliability, and architecture as part of your own work. Beyond technical execution, you act as a force multiplier: you mentor engineers, help the team adopt Continuous Delivery practices, and raise the bar on engineering best practices, partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering Leadership as part of a cross-functional, empowered product team. Proficiency in modern frontend frameworks (Angular, React, or Vue)



Strong front end experience (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript)



Strong back-end / API experience (.NET Core).



Deep understanding of SQL databases and data modeling best practices.

Essential Skills





Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail.



Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex technical concepts clearly.



Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Additional Desirable Skills

description:
**Who we are**

Naya was co-founded by Vivek and Saad at Harvard after 10+ years of real-world struggle in coordinating the chaos of the design process. Backed by some of the world’s best investors, they developed a platform which brings the entire digital workflow into one home. A place where brainstorms, 2D drawings, 3D models, spreadsheets, presentations, videos, and 150+ integrations/file types can co-exist, be collaborated on, organised, shared, and presented.

With the design journey in one home, Naya AI empowers teams to 1) generate 2D concepts, 3D models, and presentations, which enable greater creativity in the front end of the design process, and 2) create insights related to estimation, manufacturing, and value engineering, which help save time and cost in the back end of the design process. With a unified design home, creative teams at Google, MillerKnoll, and Adidas are moving more quickly through design iterations, collaborating more effectively, and driving greater innovation and delight for their customers.

Learn more about Naya here at https://naya.studio/site/6913b001506cb8c32be04f3f
We're looking for an AI software engineer who's hungry, sharp, and ready to grow fast inside a small team shipping real product to real users. If that sounds like you, reach out to shubham@naya.studio and madhumita@naya.studio

**Who you are**

**Professional**

* Experience. 1–5 years of professional software development experience using an hybrid AI stack. Internships, meaningful side projects, open-source contributions, or hackathon work all count — we care about what you've actually built and learned, not just where.
* Ships Things. You've taken at least one project from idea to something real that other people use, even if small. You know what it feels like to debug at 1am and ship the fix.
* Quality Mindset. You write code you'd be okay with someone else reading. You test what you build, and you're starting to develop taste for what "good code" looks like.
* Curious about the Craft. You read other people's code, follow people you admire on GitHub or X, and have opinions (even half-formed ones) about tools and tradeoffs, test new tools and are always continually improving yourself and your tools.

**Personality**

* Startup Lover. Excited by 0-1, small teams, wearing multiple hats, and the chaos that comes with it. You'd rather ship something imperfect today than something perfect next quarter.
* Coachable. Takes feedback well, asks good questions, and isn't afraid to say "I don't know." Wants to be mentored and is willing to put in the reps.
* Think before Code. Pauses to understand the problem before jumping to a solution. Sketches, asks, reads existing code — then writes.
* Owns Outcomes. When something breaks or slips, your first instinct is "what can I do?" not "whose fault is it?"
* Lifelong Learner. Genuinely enjoys learning new things. Reads docs, follows along with talks, tries stuff on weekends.
* Boundary Pusher. Naturally curious and self-motivated, with real passion for technology.

**Technical**

* Strong Fundamentals. Solid grasp of computer science basics — data structures, control flow, how HTTP/the web works, what a database does. We care that you understand why code behaves the way it does, not how many languages you've used.
* Strong Problem Solving. Can break a fuzzy problem into smaller pieces, reason about tradeoffs at your level, and ask for help when you're stuck rather than spinning for days. Poke a problem from multiple angles and never give up. Comfortable saying "I don't know yet" and then going to find out.
* Clear Communicator. Writes readable PR descriptions, asks specific questions instead of vague ones, and can explain what you built and why. Bonus if you enjoy writing — design docs, learning notes, anything.
* Context Switching. Can juggle a couple of threads at once — a feature you're building, a bug someone flagged, a code review for a teammate — without dropping all of them. This is a skill you'll grow into; we want to see the seed of it.
* Hybrid AI Coding Fluency. You actively use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows, MCP, etc.) as part of how you work. You know when to lean on the AI and when to drive yourself, and you read AI-generated code critically instead of trusting it blindly. This is non-negotiable for us — it's how the team ships.
* Security Awareness. You understand that "it works" isn't the same as "it's safe." Familiar with the basics: don't commit secrets, sanitize input, understand why auth matters, have heard of OWASP. You don't need to be an expert — you need to care.
* Built Something, Somewhere. Any stack is fine — web, mobile, scripts, games, hardware. We want to see range and curiosity more than a specific tech.

**Our stack**

You don't need to know all of this on day one. You'll pick up most of it on the job. Familiarity with any part of it is a plus.

* Frontend. ReactJS, Typescript, NextJS
* Backend. NodeJS, Python, SocketIO/WebSockets
* Testing and Monitoring. Playwright, Cucumber, Postman, Datadog, Pendo, Mixpanel
* Database. MongoDB, PostgreSQL
* Infrastructure. Terraform, Github Actions, CloudBuild, CloudRun, Kubernetes, Serverless, CI/CD

description:

We maintain deep expertise across the full stack—from client optimization to open-source tooling—backed by continuous contributions to Ethereum's evolution. **The Role:

This role owns the internal/corporate technology estate that the whole company runs on: developer platform, identity, security posture, and infrastructure spend. It sits alongside (and is distinct from) our client-facing blockchain infrastructure operations, though you'll partner closely with those teams.

You'll report directly to the CIO and serve as the central point of coordination for everything internal infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll manage people, drive strategy, break down silos between DevOps and the wider organisation, and be the go-to person for C-level and group leads on infrastructure matters. If you thrive at the intersection of people management, technical excellence, and cross-functional communication and you're excited about shaping how a 50+ country, fully remote Web3 company operates - we'd love to hear from you.


**Responsibilities:

*  Lead and supervise the full Internal IT Department: Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Security, IAM and FinOps.

*  People management across the department: staffing, career guidance, performance reviews, and raising the technical bar

* Adapt the best of AI technology to the daily engineering and non-engineering working routine

* Continuously identify and implement improvements and optimisations in the way the organisation works

**Must Haves:

* Experience translating compliance and audit requirements (e.g. SOC2, ISO 27001, or sector-specific frameworks) into operational controls.
* Comfort owning or governing internal AI tooling and agentic workflows, with a security-first mindset.

* Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to C-level stakeholders and non-technical audiences.
* Practical experience with security incident response and threat modelling, ideally including supply-chain and adversarial/state-actor scenarios.
* Comfortable operating in a fully remote, async-first, globally distributed environment.

**Nice to Haves:
**

* Familiarity with multi-cloud and hybrid architectures (AWS, OVH) at scale.
* Experience running ****self-hosted / sovereign infrastructure (e.g. self-hosted identity providers, internal platforms) over off-the-shelf SaaS.

* Hands-on experience with FinOps tooling and large-scale cost optimisation.

**What We Offer/ Benefits
**

* Global and Diverse Workforce: You'll work with people from various backgrounds and cultures.
* Learning and Development: You'll work on innovative, challenging projects and have access to experts and mentors to enhance your skills.
* Career Growth: Access to training, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to open-source initiatives.
* Global Events and Conferences: Opportunities to attend the industry events.
* Collaborative and Innovative Culture: We foster teamwork and encourage new ideas.
* Unlimited Time Off: Enjoy the freedom to structure your working hours in a way that suits you best, with the flexibility to take unpaid time off whenever needed to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

**Our Commitment to Diversity
**

At Nethermind, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We believe a variety of perspectives drives innovation and leads to better solutions for the blockchain community.


**Ready to Join Us?

**Important Notice for Candidates

Recruitment scams are becoming increasingly common. Please keep the following guidelines in mind when applying for roles at Nethermind.

title: MSP System Engineer
description:
ABOUT FUNCSHUN
FUNCSHUN is a Miami-based cybersecurity and IT services firm, founded in 2011. We started as an IT services provider and grew into a cybersecurity firm: security consulting, managed IT operations, incident response, and compliance (PCI DSS, FTC Safeguards, CMMC) for small and mid-sized businesses, many of them regulated — CPA firms, law firms, card merchants, condominium associations, contractors. We are a team of eight. Every ticket is worked with security in mind.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We're hiring a Systems Engineer to lead our help desk. This seat is the technical backbone of the service desk: you work the live ConnectWise board every day, you are the first escalation point for L1 work, you carry the daily operational controls (backup audits, patch review, alert triage), and you own client tickets from open to closure. You will be a trusted technical voice in front of customers, in English and in Spanish.
You'll work across a dozen-plus client environments, which means constant context switching between different networks, stacks, and people. If you need one quiet system to focus on, this is the wrong seat. If you like closing twelve to twenty tickets a day, fixing the thing that keeps coming back, and being the person the team relies on, keep reading.
This is not entry-level help desk. This is hands-on troubleshooting, system awareness, disciplined documentation, and ownership.
WHY THIS SEAT MATTERS
The engineer in this role typically handles a fifth of all ticket work at FUNCSHUN and the majority of the on-call rotation. It is the highest-volume, most client-facing technical seat in the company.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Own the live board
• Work the Help Desk board daily: triage new tickets, set priority and type correctly, schedule work, and keep every ticket moving toward closure with same-day time entries and clear notes.
• Resolve L1/L2 tickets across Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, Conditional Access), Windows 10/11, Windows Server, printers and peripherals, line-of-business apps (Sage, Autodesk, QuickBooks, LEAP, Toast), and networking (WatchGuard, UniFi, Starlink).
• Run the morning stand-up ticket review and the mid-day board check; flag SLA risk and blockers early.
• Take your turn in the on-call rotation and respond to after-hours incidents per the on-call runbook.
Run the daily and weekly controls
• Perform the Daily Server Backup Audit (Acronis) every business day and open remediation tickets for any failed or missing job.
• Run the weekly patching review: confirm NinjaOne patch compliance for client workstations and servers, schedule maintenance windows, and follow up on machines that fall out of policy.
• Triage RMM alerts (offline servers, CPU/disk thresholds, service failures) and Managed SOC / MDR alerts; take first-response actions and escalate to the CTO with evidence.
Deliver security work on client tenants
• Execute standardized security rollouts: MFA enrollment and migrations (Duo, Entra External MFA), Conditional Access policy reviews, BitLocker enablement, Keeper password manager onboarding, ThreatLocker allowlisting, Defender and RocketCyber configuration.

Improve the system

• Maintain accurate documentation in IT Glue / SharePoint; follow and improve SOPs; flag gaps.
• Coach junior technicians and hand back work that belongs at L1 with clear instructions.
HOW WE WORK
• AI is part of your toolkit. We use Claude, Copilot, and similar tools daily to draft runbooks, write PowerShell, interpret logs, and speed up research. We expect you to do the same and to show us how. We also expect you to know what never goes into a public model: client names, credentials, PII, or anything covered by our AI Use Policy.
• Everything happens in the ticket. If it isn't in ConnectWise, it didn't happen. Time entries are logged in real time, in 10-minute increments during troubleshooting, with screenshots where applicable.
• Security is not a department. You'll be asked "why is this the secure way?" on ordinary tickets.
• Direct communication. We'd rather hear "I'm stuck" at hour one than a heroic silence at hour six.
• Ownership. You close what you open. Nobody chases you.
SUCCESS MILESTONES
Milestone What "done" looks like
By Day 30 Working the board independently within SLA with complete notes and same-day time entries; running the Daily Server Backup Audit and weekly patch review without prompting; first on-call shift completed.
By Day 60 Escalations to the CTO arrive with evidence and a proposed fix; at least two repeat-issue root causes identified and eliminated; first SOP rewritten; first client security rollout (MFA, BitLocker, or Keeper) delivered end to end.
By Day 90 Handling priority incidents independently; first small client project delivered; ticket backlog for your queue trending down; clients recognize you by name.
Milestones are reviewed at each checkpoint; the Day 30 checkpoint doubles as the end of the paid trial period.
MUST-HAVE STACK
• ConnectWise Manage (PSA) and an RMM — NinjaOne preferred; Automate, Datto or Kaseya acceptable

• Security tooling: EDR/MDR, MFA rollouts (Duo / Entra), application allowlisting (ThreatLocker a strong plus), password managers (Keeper), phishing response
• Firewalls and networking fundamentals — WatchGuard or UniFi a plus
• Microsoft Teams and SharePoint / IT Glue-based documentation
QUALIFICATIONS
• 4+ years at an IT or security services provider supporting multiple clients simultaneously (not a single internal IT department)
• Strong troubleshooting skills and a root-cause mindset
• Security-aware by default
• Demonstrated daily use of AI tools in technical work — be ready to show examples

• Accountability mindset; comfortable with high ticket volume and frequent context switching
• Nice to have: MS-102, AZ-104, SC-200, Security+ / CySA+; exposure to PCI DSS, FTC Safeguards, or CMMC evidence collection; incident response experience; experience with condominium associations, law firms, or construction trades clients
TERMS

title: Product Designer
description:
About Premise

We’re an early-stage startup building a new kind of product for Hollywood—rethinking how stories are developed and managed from the first spark of an idea through collaborative development across creative executives and writers. 

We believe great tools don’t just manage processes — they inspire better work. By combining proven storytelling frameworks with powerful collaboration features, we’re reimagining how the industry’s best ideas come to life.

In essence, we’re building Figma for Hollywood.

We’re a small, passionate founding team with deep experience in technology and entertainment. We’re looking for our first hire to help shape not just our product, but our culture, processes, and future.

The Role

As Product Designer, you’ll generate and synthesize insights from customer research into beautiful, intuitive, pragmatic user journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and designs that solve real customer problems around creative collaboration. 

Reporting to our CTO, you’ll own product design from start to finish, work hands-on with customers to research and internalize their insights, iterate and test designs, and partner closely with engineering to create a tool that feels as intuitive to use as it is powerful. 

This isn’t a “keep the train running” role. In this role, you will build close relationships with customers to explore and refine features ideas, offer design solutions, and create your own virtuous cycle of feedback and joy for customers facing unsolved problems in their day-to-day jobs. You’ll create and execute design and user experience research processes at Premise, help set the tone for collaboration, and foster the core team that will take us from MVP to market leader.

What You’ll Do

Define and own user experience research and customer journey mapping.

Engage directly with writers, studio execs, and other early users to uncover needs and validate solutions.

Translate research insights into elegant, testable prototypes and high-quality shipped product experiences.

Work side-by-side with the CTO and engineering team to design our products.

Lead the build and launch of our MVP (target: Q1 2026 – Q2 2026), balancing speed with thoughtful iteration.

Partner with founders on recruiting top-tier engineers and shaping our early culture.

Foster a joyful, high-performance environment that inspires the best work of everyone around you.

What We’re Looking For

5–10+ years of product design experience, ideally in SaaS or creative collaboration tools.

Track record of generating powerful insights through user research. 

Proven ability to shape ambiguous ideas into real, shipped products.

Track record of designing best-in-class products in early-stage or resource-constrained environments.

Strong technical fluency; comfortable in deep conversations with engineers.

Experience driving adoption and revenue growth — especially through collaboration features.

Passion for film, TV, or storytelling. Bonus for entertainment industry exposure.

Bonus for “first designer” or pre-seed startup experience.

Bonus for hands-on experience leveraging AI in powerful user experiences.

Education

BA / BS in related field
MA / MS / MBA in related field a plus

title: First Sales Hire, B2B SaaS Scaleup (UK/USA) Real Equity
description:
**Bulbthings** · Based in the USA or UK (Remote) · Full-Time · OTE $130K to $180K + 0.25-1% Stock Options · 3+ years experience

We're Bulbthings, an **AI-powered Inventory and Asset Management platform** already trusted by some seriously big enterprise customers. It's a great, proven product and we're pushing LLMs deeper into it to make it even better. What we don't have yet is a dedicated sales function, that's about to change, and you'd be the one building it.

This is our first sales hire. There's no team to onboard you, no playbook sitting in a shared drive. What you do have is us, the co-founders, in the trenches with you: we'll be right there when a deal gets tricky, and we'll personally jump in alongside you on the big enterprise (BigCo) leads. 

There's a strong, proven product, real paying enterprise customers, and real demand we haven't gone after yet. We're not asking you to create a market from nothing, we're asking you to build the engine that captures the growth that's already there for the taking.

**MUST HAVES**

**Your background:**
* Native English speaker, based in the UK or USA
* 3+ years of experience selling B2B SaaS into asset-heavy industries (manufacturing, construction, energy, logistics, facility management or similar). You've sold to people who manage physical assets, not just data, and you know how that changes the pitch, the decision-making process and the sales cycle
* Solid grasp of mid-market sales processes and cycles: you know how these deals actually move, who needs to sign off, and how to keep a multi-stakeholder deal from stalling out
* Experience as the first or solo sales hire at a company. You've built a sales process from nothing before, you know what that actually involves, and you're not expecting a team of SDRs to hand you warm leads
* Proven experience selling into the US market. This role is primarily focused on growing our US customer base, with the UK as a secondary market, so you need to already know how American buyers evaluate and sign off on SaaS
* Comfortable with sales automation and CRM tools, you're not starting from a spreadsheet and a prayer

**What you'll do:**
* Find and qualify prospects, from cold outreach through to a real pipeline
* Run product demos and own the deal from first conversation to signed contract
* Build the playbook as you go: what messaging works, what objections come up, what a repeatable sales process looks like here, so the next sales hire doesn't start from zero
* Work directly with the founders and the rest of the (small) team, your feedback from the field shapes the product roadmap and marketing, not just your quota
* Team up with the co-founders on our biggest enterprise (BigCo) leads, you won't be closing those alone

**Personality traits we'll be looking for:**
* Ambitious and hungry: you want a real stake in a growing company, base + commission is nice but the equity is why you'd actually take this over a bigger base somewhere else
* Genuinely autonomous and self-driven: nobody's going to hand you a lead list or check in on you three times a day
* Resilient: you've been told no more times than you can count, and it still doesn't slow you down
* Genuinely excellent communicator: you can talk to a procurement lead and a founder in the same week and adjust accordingly, and you write clearly enough that the rest of us can follow what's happening in your pipeline without having to ask
* Room to grow: This is founding sales hire territory. Prove out the process and there's a real path to building and leading a sales team as we scale, not just carrying a bigger quota alone.

**NICE TO HAVES**
* Experience selling *specifically* into asset management, fleet management, or CMMS (computerized maintenance management systems)
* A strong social media presence, if you've already built an audience or a personal brand, that's a real asset for a founding sales role
* A second language (e.g. Spanish, German, French)

**COMPENSATION**
* Base comp $65K-$85K
* Uncapped commission, targeting $130K-$180K OTE at 100% of quota, with accelerators for over-performance
* 0.25 - 1% stock options
* Fully remote, as long as you're based in the UK or USA and a native English speaker

👋 **HOW TO APPLY**

Please include a short, genuine message telling us who you are and why this role and venture actually interests you. Not a copy-pasted cover letter, not three lines of "results-driven sales professional with a proven track record." We read every single one, and it's usually obvious within a sentence which is which. Tell us something real: why B2B SaaS sales, why systems of record, why building something from zero, why us. Applications without one won't move forward.

title: Sales Development Representative — Home Services (Remote, Latin America)
description:
About HomeOtter / Blue Ink Digital

HomeOtter connects US homeowners with home service professionals — delivering ready-to-buy leads, inbound calls, and booked appointments to contractors in roofing, bath, windows, solar and a growing list of verticals. We run our own consumer sites and paid media, we own our demand, and we're building the self-serve platform that lets contractors buy customers directly from us instead of through the big marketplaces. Small team, fast decisions, growing every month — and you'd be our first dedicated sales hire.

The Role

You put contractors on our platform. Your day is outbound: calling and emailing US roofing, bath, solar and window contractors in the zip codes where our lead flow is already strong — and showing them, live, the customers we can send them. The demo is the pitch: you pull up their zip, show real demand, and sign them onto a self-serve account with no long-term contract.

What you'll do

Own top-of-funnel: high-volume cold calls and email sequences to contractor prospect lists, prioritized by live demand data from our media team
Run demo-pitches — every real conversation includes a live look at lead flow in the prospect's service area
Sign and onboard self-serve accounts; hand off to account management for retention
Keep a clean pipeline in our CRM — every conversation, stage, and follow-up tracked
Feed intel back to leadership: objections, pricing feedback, which verticals bite

Ramp & Targets

First 90 days: structured training on our products, platform, and pitch — working directly with the CEO, who built the demand engine you're selling
At ramp: 20 demo-pitches/week with decision-makers, scaling toward 30+
Success = signed, activated accounts — your performance pay is tied to accounts that go live and keep buying

Who You Are

1–3 years outbound sales/SDR experience — phone-heavy, high-activity, unbothered by cold outreach
Fluent, confident spoken English — you'll be calling US business owners all day
Gritty: contractors are on roofs and in crawlspaces; reaching them takes persistence and personality
Home services, lead gen, or local advertising familiarity a plus (not required — we teach the industry)
CRM-fluent, organized, honest with your own pipeline numbers
Available full-time on US business hours

What We Offer

$2,000/month base + performance commission on activated accounts — uncapped, structure finalized with the hire
Ground floor of a new sales org — the first rep who proves the motion is first in line to lead the team we build behind it
Direct access to leadership; real input into pitch, pricing, and playbook
Full tooling provided: dialer/outreach stack, CRM, warm prospect lists built from live demand data

How to Apply

Apply with your resume and a 60–90 second voice memo (Loom, Vocaroo, or audio file) telling us the hardest thing you've ever sold. Applications without the voice memo won't be reviewed — this is a phone role, and the memo is round one. We're interviewing immediately and hiring this month.

 important business logic.

token-by-token response streaming.

* **Responsive & Cross-browser Development** — experience ensuring applications work consistently across different browsers, screen sizes, and devices.

* **NgRx** — basic understanding of NgRx and its core architecture, including the unidirectional data flow pattern; familiarity with when and why to use NgRx for predictable state management in larger Angular applications.

title: Senior Associate QA Engineer
description:

**Experience-** 2-3 Years

**Company-** Emplay Analytics Inc

**Positions-** 2 

**Salary( CTC Offered)-** 5 LPA- 8 LPA

**Job Location-** Remote / Work from Home


**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive QA Engineer with 2-3 years of experience and strong hands-on expertise in manual and automation testing. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, passionate about quality, and experienced in building reliable test strategies for web, API, and backend systems. You will play a key role in ensuring product stability by driving test planning, execution, automation, and release validation — and by actively leveraging AI tools to enhance testing efficiency in a fast-paced agile environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Strategy & Design**
* Develop and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios aligned with functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prioritize testing efforts based on risk assessment and business impact.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure complete requirement coverage before testing begins.
* Use AI tools to auto-generate test cases, edge cases, and boundary conditions from user stories and specifications.

**API & Backend Testing**
* Conduct thorough functional, integration, and regression testing on RESTful APIs using tools like Postman or Swagger.
* Validate backend data accuracy and integrity through well-structured SQL queries including joins and aggregations.
* Identify and document API contract violations and data inconsistencies across environments.

**Automation Development**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Python, Pytest, or Playwright.
* Embed automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality checks.
* Continuously refactor and improve automation scripts to reduce flakiness and maintenance effort.
* Use AI copilot tools to accelerate test script authoring and maintenance.

**AI-Augmented Testing**

* Actively use AI tools to generate test cases, identify coverage gaps, and speed up exploratory testing.
* Apply AI-driven insights to detect recurring defect patterns and prevent quality regressions across releases.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI-powered and self-healing test tools to improve team productivity and test reliability.
* Craft effective prompts to extract structured test plans, BDD scenarios, and API contract tests from AI assistants.

**Agile Collaboration**

* Participate actively in sprint ceremonies including planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Work alongside developers and DevOps teams to shift quality left and catch issues early in the development cycle.
* Support defect triage, root cause analysis, and pre-release quality sign-off.

**Mentoring & Documentation**

* Guide junior QA engineers on testing best practices, automation techniques, and AI tool usage.
* Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation including test reports, traceability matrices, and release notes.
* Communicate quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Solid understanding of software testing concepts, QA methodologies, and SDLC/STLC.

* Proven experience in manual testing across web and API layers.

* Strong experience with API testing tools — Postman, Swagger, or similar.

* Hands-on expertise in SQL including complex queries, joins, and data integrity validation.

* Practical experience with automation testing using Selenium, Python, Pytest, or Playwright.

* Hands-on use of AI tools (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) in a QA workflow.

* Ability to craft effective prompts to produce structured test plans and BDD scenarios.

* Exposure to version control systems (Git).

* Strong analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines — Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.

* Familiarity with test management tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Zephyr.

* Knowledge of performance testing tools like JMeter or Locust.

* Basic understanding of security testing concepts.

* Experience with AI-native testing platforms such as Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.

* Cloud testing experience on AWS or Azure.

* BDD experience with Cucumber or Gherkin.

* Basic awareness of testing AI/ML model outputs — hallucination detection, prompt injection risks.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

* 2-3 years of hands-on QA experience across web, API, and backend systems.

* Demonstrated use of AI tools in a testing workflow — examples or project references preferred.

* ISTQB Foundation (or higher), Selenium certification, or equivalent QA certification is a plus.

* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate quality risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Founding Sales Representative, Full Time, US only
description:
Founding Sales Closer
About Rezora
Rezora is an AI voice platform that helps businesses automatically follow up with leads, answer inbound calls, qualify prospects, and book appointments.
We currently serve two growing markets: real estate and home services — including real estate agents, teams, investors, roofing companies, HVAC companies, restoration companies, and other service businesses.
Our AI voice agents handle conversations that businesses traditionally need employees to handle, helping companies respond faster, follow up more consistently, and turn more leads into customers.
We are an early-stage, founder-led startup growing quickly. This is an early sales hire, and you will work directly with the founding team to help close our growing pipeline while helping build the sales engine from the ground up.
Role Overview
We are hiring a Founding Sales Closer to convert warm, pre-qualified appointments into paying Rezora customers.
There is no cold calling, prospecting, or lead generation required. Our marketing and AI systems generate and qualify the majority of opportunities for you.
Your focus will be on:
Showing up prepared for scheduled sales calls
Understanding the prospect's business and needs
Demonstrating how Rezora can help
Handling objections
Closing new customers
Following up with prospects who don't close immediately
You will sell across both of Rezora's core markets — real estate and home services — with opportunities to expand into additional industries as the company grows.
This is an early role with significant room for growth. The right person can develop into a Head of Sales or salaried sales leadership position as Rezora scales.
Responsibilities
Manage a calendar of warm, pre-booked sales appointments
Sell Rezora to real estate professionals, teams, investors, and home-service businesses
Run discovery calls, product demonstrations, and closing conversations
Understand each prospect's business and identify where Rezora can create value
Handle objections and move qualified prospects toward a purchase decision
Follow up consistently with prospects who do not close on the first call
Maintain accurate CRM and pipeline records
Work directly with the founders to improve sales messaging and close rates
Provide feedback on lead quality, objections, pricing, and customer needs
Help develop sales scripts, playbooks, and repeatable processes
Learn new verticals and take ownership of closing in those markets as Rezora expands
Help build the foundation of Rezora's sales organization
What We're Looking For
At least 1 year of sales experience, preferably in real estate, home services, SaaS, or another high-ticket sales environment
A proven ability to close — you are comfortable taking a warm conversation through to a signed agreement
Strong objection-handling and consultative selling skills
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills
Comfortable selling to business owners, real estate professionals, and decision-makers
Experience using CRMs, sales software, dialers, or other modern sales tools
Comfortable learning and selling AI-powered technology
Self-directed and able to operate in a fast-moving startup environment
Competitive, motivated, and hungry to earn
Interested in building something rather than simply following an existing playbook
Based in the U.S.; NYC strongly preferred
Compensation
$15/hour base + commission
$15/hour guaranteed base pay
25% of the first month's subscription for every customer you close
10% recurring monthly commission for as long as that customer remains active
No cap on commission earnings
Your recurring commission grows as your customer base grows
Full-time opportunity
Significant upside as Rezora expands into additional verticals
The combination of hourly pay and recurring commissions means you have a guaranteed base while building a growing book of customers that can continue generating commission every month.
Why Join Rezora?
You're not starting from zero.
Our marketing generates inbound demand and books qualified appointments directly onto your calendar. Your job is to close.
Work directly with the founders.
You'll have a direct impact on our sales strategy, messaging, pricing, and go-to-market approach.
Sell across multiple growing markets.
You'll work with both real estate and home-service businesses, giving you exposure to multiple markets and sales environments.
Build recurring income.
Every customer you close can continue generating monthly commission for you as long as they remain a customer.
Get in early.
You'll be joining at an early stage with the opportunity to help build the sales organization rather than joining an established team with limited room for advancement.
Real opportunity for advancement.
As Rezora grows, strong performance can lead to increased responsibility and eventually a Head of Sales or salaried sales leadership position.
