title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
Code for America believes government can work for the people, by the people, in the new digital age, and that government at all levels can and should work well for all people. For more than a decade, we’ve worked to show that with the mindful use of technology, we can break down barriers, meet community needs, and find real solutions.

Our employees build and transform government and community tools and services, making them so good they inspire change. We merge the best parts of technology, nonprofit, and government to help support the people who need it most.

With a focus on transparency and fairness, and deep empathy for partners in government and community organizations and the people that our partners serve, we’re building a movement of motivated change agents driven by meaningful results and lasting impact.

At Code for America, you contribute to exciting work while learning and developing in a supportive and flexible environment. Our compensation and benefits are holistic and thoughtfully curated to represent our employees and our mission. Help us drive real generational change that lasts.

 

Code for America is looking for a talented **Staff Data Engineer** who will lead the technical execution of our data infrastructure behind high-impact government services. In this role you will make data reliable and usable at scale — improving how our teams collect, move, model, and analyze the data that tells us whether the services we build actually work for the people who need them most. 

The pace of change in the policy and government landscape is accelerating at the same time that technology possibilities are shifting rapidly. Together, these shifts create new windows of opportunity to develop technical solutions that make critical public services more effective for the people who need them. Staff data engineers keep delivery moving through those moments, supporting staff and holding high delivery standards so that data are trustworthy, and reachable by the people who need it.

 

#   
**About the role:** 

Code for America’s Staff Data Engineers build and operate the infrastructure that moves data through the products we ship, between our systems and our partners’ systems, and into the analysis that drives meaningful improvements in outcomes across the tax, criminal justice, and safety net delivery areas. Staff Data Engineers lead the technical execution of data infrastructure projects and solutions while guiding their teams’ technical direction, setting a high standard for technical judgment, and enabling other data scientists and engineers through collaboration and mentorship.

This role will report to a Data Science Manager and is expected to travel no more than 10**%** of the time. 

Code for America is based in California and can employ those who reside full-time within the United States. This is a remote position.

# **In this position you will:**

- **Data Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering**

  - Lead cross-functional technical planning with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to translate data architecture requirements into scalable technical solutions for your team's projects
  - Create new data pipelines, data transfers, and compliance-oriented infrastructure to facilitate seamless data utilization within cloud environments
  - Contribute to best practices for dataset management and optimization, ensuring data consistency and performance
  - Implement data transformation, integration, and validation processes to support analytics and reporting needs
  - Partner with our DevOps team to apply deployment standards, monitoring frameworks, and operational best practices for data infrastructure
  - Lead technical investigations into data issues within the systems you own, resolving them with thorough communication and recommending process changes where necessary.
  - Optimize and fine-tune data pipelines for improved speed, reliability, and efficiency
  - Lead generation and optimization of data architecture recommendations and demonstrate the ability to implement them
  - Champion privacy, security, and data governance practices throughout the entire data lifecycle
  - Support Engineering's culture of writing by producing quality documentation and learning materials.
- **Technical Leadership & Enablement**

  - Contribute to the development of data engineering best practices and standards, and reinforce them across the team.
  - Collaborate with Product Managers and other cross-functional peers; adapt your approach as priorities, technology, and team needs shift; and actively help others do the same when facing major changes in direction or tooling.
  - Mentor engineers and data scientists on data engineering best practices, pipeline design, and sound architectural thinking, and create conditions for them to grow into unfamiliar problem spaces through pairing, documentation, or direct coaching.
- **Other duties as assigned**

  - Engage in ad hoc projects and initiatives as required by the organization's evolving needs.

# **About you:**

- 7+ years of experience in data engineering or related technical fields
- Expert-level SQL and experience with python, R
- Experience with Postgres and cloud-based data warehousing (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake)
- Expert at data orchestration tools (e.g. Dagster) for building and managing data pipelines
- Expert at using dbt for data transformation and modeling within data warehouses
- Demonstrated experience with Metabase or similar business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Looker)
- Experience in ensuring that data pipelines are accessible to Data Scientists through notebook tools (e.g. Hex)
- Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code.
- Excellent collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional relationships, respond to stakeholder needs, and facilitate effective decision-making conversations
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools judiciously, validating and refining generated code for quality, and modeling that discipline for teammates is needed for this specific role; organizationally, a curiosity about emerging AI tools and a commitment to using them responsibly and effectively
- A deep commitment to Code for America's mission of making government services work well for the people who need them most.

 

# **It’s a bonus if you have:**

- Experience with making government services better for people who need them most
- Personal or professional experience with the social safety net or other mission-relevant government services.
- Experience building and integrating AI-powered features in production systems, with evaluation and monitoring.

#   
**What you’ll get -**

## **Salary:** 

Code for America’s salary bands are transparent as a part of our commitment to transparency and fairness. As part of our hiring practices, we aim to target the midpoint of the 2nd quartile of the range for all new hires.

Offer targets vary based on market / geographic location. The offer targets for this role range from **$128,945 to $157,850**, annually. Your Recruiter will discuss compensation in more detail & answer any related questions, during the initial Recruiter phone screen.

##   
**Benefits and perks:** 

This role includes a comprehensive benefits package including the following:

- **Values:**
  - Leadership and teammates who share a strong work ethic and values, and who respect and care for one another
  - A collaborative, cross-functional, hardworking, and joyful environment
- **Employee Enablement Support:** 
  - Laptop provided
  - A **one-time** $700 payment for remote environment setup; $200 stipend (in first paycheck) and up to $500 reimbursement, in accordance with our equipment policy

title: Senior Design Engineer, Design Systems
description:
# About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top [_Y-Combinator company_](https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/) and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

## **About the role**

We're looking for a Senior Design Engineer to build our design system from the ground up, scale it, and close the gap between how Clipboard is designed and how it's built. The system you'll own is the backbone and experience infrastructure all of EPD builds products on.

You'll own the connective tissue between design and engineering, shaping the architecture and foundations of the system, building the reusable components, and closing the gap between Figma and production. You'll create the patterns and practices that make high-quality UI easier to ship, and build the AI tooling that enables all of EPD to prototype and build quality, system-led experiences.

This is a critical role with high impact and influence across product, design, and engineering. The right candidate will bring a high bar for craft, strong frontend engineering judgment, deep design-systems experience, and a genuine excitement for what they do.

## **What you’ll do**

- Establish the system's architecture and foundations across Figma and code, from primitives and tokens through components and patterns to critical user flows.
- Build reusable, production-ready components with the full range of states, interaction, motion, and accessibility built in.
- Keep design and code in sync as the system grows, closing gaps when Figma, code, and Storybook fall out of alignment.
- Define what good looks like in the system, set the standards, and hold teams' work to them so it stays consistent, accessible, and high quality.
- Create AI tooling and skills that let all of EPD prototype and build leveraging the system and design best practices.
- Write the documentation, usage guidance, and component rules that let people and AI build with the system correctly across Figma, code, and Storybook.
- Partner with designers, product managers, and engineers on how the system holds up in complex workflows and edge cases, and take those decisions into the system.

## **Skills you’ll need**

- 6+ years building production frontend design systems that serve multiple product surfaces across mobile and web.
- Strong frontend engineering across modern web technologies and component-based architecture, with the ability to ramp quickly in a large, established codebase.
- High UI and UX craft with strong product taste, and a clear read on whether an interface is polished, usable, accessible, flexible, and maintainable.
- Deep experience building and maintaining component libraries, design-token pipelines, Storybook, visual regression, and Figma workflows or plugins.
- Strong accessibility fundamentals across mobile and web.
- Experience standing up or consolidating design systems and aligning Figma libraries with production code.
- Real experience using AI to ship prototypes, components, and system work faster.
- Experience building the resources that make a system usable by AI, the skills, documentation, and rules that let others build against it correctly with AI.
- Strong communication that raises the work around them, explaining decisions clearly to specialists and non-specialists and making the right path the easy one for designers and engineers.
- A bias for building, making ideas real in code, learning from how they behave, and iterating from there.
- Senior judgment to work through ambiguity, focus on the highest-leverage work, and sequence change in a way teams can actually adopt.
- A body of work showing shipped design-engineering impact across production UI, component systems, prototypes, and system documentation.

### 

## **Nice to have**

- Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or products where both sides of a transaction depend on each other.
- Experience designing for healthcare, operations-heavy, or other high-stakes real-world domains.

###

## Location

- Preferred: San Francisco CA/Bay area
- Open to: US remote

**Quick Note on Scammers:**

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members [here](https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6).

title: Data Scientist - Junior role - 8 position
description:
# Data Scientist

Eveo, a pioneering AI-driven fashion and personality management startup, is seeking a skilled and innovative **Data Scientist** to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in preparing and analyzing data for training AI models, extracting valuable insights, and contributing to the success of our innovative platform.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Data Cleaning and Preparation:**

* Clean, preprocess, and transform large datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and identify relevant data sources.
* Handle missing, duplicate, inconsistent, and noisy data effectively.
* Develop efficient data preprocessing pipelines for machine learning workflows.

**2. Data Analysis and Exploration:**

* Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns, trends, correlations, and anomalies.
* Apply statistical techniques to analyze datasets and generate actionable insights.
* Create meaningful visualizations and reports to communicate data-driven findings.
* Evaluate data quality and identify opportunities for improvement.

**3. Data Mining and Information Extraction:**

* Extract and process information from diverse sources, including databases, documents, APIs, and external data sources.
* Apply data mining and analytical techniques to discover hidden patterns and relationships.
* Work with structured and unstructured data to support business and AI initiatives.
* Develop approaches for collecting and organizing relevant datasets.

**4. Machine Learning Model Training Support:**

* Collaborate with AI and Machine Learning Engineers to prepare high-quality datasets for model training.
* Perform feature engineering and data transformation to improve model performance.
* Support dataset creation, labeling, validation, and evaluation processes.
* Monitor data quality and identify potential issues affecting model accuracy.
* Experiment with different data preparation techniques to optimize machine learning outcomes.

**5. Data Visualization and Reporting:**

* Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present analytical findings.
* Translate complex datasets into clear and understandable insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Track key data and model-related metrics to support decision-making.

**6. Documentation and Collaboration:**

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of data sources, preprocessing steps, analytical methodologies, and results.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, AI Engineers, Software Engineers, and Product teams.
* Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay updated with emerging data science, machine learning, and AI technologies.

**Qualifications:**

1. Proven experience as a **Data Scientist**, Data Analyst, or in a similar data-focused role.
2. Strong proficiency in **data cleaning, preprocessing, and exploratory data analysis**.
3. Knowledge of **statistics, data mining, feature engineering, and information extraction**.
4. Familiarity with **machine learning concepts and model training workflows**.
5. Strong programming skills in **Python**; familiarity with R is an advantage.
6. Experience with data manipulation libraries such as **Pandas and NumPy**.
7. Familiarity with data visualization tools and libraries such as **Matplotlib, Seaborn, or similar tools**.
8. Basic understanding of **SQL and relational databases**.
9. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
10. Excellent communication, teamwork, and collaboration skills.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field**.

* **1+ years of experience** in Data Science, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, or a relevant field.
* Candidates with strong practical projects or hands-on experience in AI and data science are encouraged to apply.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to work on innovative **AI-driven fashion and personality technology**.
* Exposure to real-world machine learning and data science projects.
* Collaborative and fast-paced startup environment.
* Opportunity to work closely with AI, engineering, and product teams.
* Continuous learning and professional growth opportunities.

If you are passionate about **leveraging data to drive innovation** and are excited to contribute to the cutting-edge work at Eveo, we encourage you to apply.

Eveo is an **equal opportunity employer**. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Founding Software Engineer
description:
# Build With Us — WhipScribe Founding Software Engineer

We're looking for a **Founding Software Engineer** to join WhipScribe and work directly with the founding team on a real product used by real customers.

Instead of evaluating candidates only through resumes and interviews, we want to see **how you think, what you build, and how you ship**.

## Start Here

### 🚀 [Open the WhipScribe Buildathon & Hiring Challenge](https://github.com/neugence/whipscribe-buildathon)

**Please read the complete challenge repository before submitting your application.**

The repository contains the complete hiring challenge, available tracks, instructions, evaluation criteria, setup information, and submission process.

You can choose the challenge that best demonstrates your strengths — whether that's **desktop development, web/product engineering, APIs, AI workflows, MCP integrations, UI/UX, or something you want to build from scratch.**

## What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who:

* Builds without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Can take an idea from **problem → solution → implementation → deployment**.
* Has strong product and UI/UX judgment.
* Uses AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, and coding agents effectively.
* Understands, validates, and improves AI-generated work rather than blindly accepting it.
* Is comfortable working across technologies and learning quickly.
* Cares about what reaches the customer, not just what works locally.
* Takes ownership and enjoys working in a fast-moving startup environment.

## Your First Step

Before building anything, **show us what you've already built.**

Share your:

* GitHub
* LinkedIn
* Portfolio
* Shipped applications
* Hackathon projects
* Open-source work
* Projects you're proud of
* Team or leadership experience

Then use WhipScribe yourself and look at the product as both an engineer and a user.

Find something that could be better.

Then **build.**

## The Challenge

The Buildathon repository contains multiple tracks, including:

**Track 1 — Find What Is Wrong**
Use WhipScribe on desktop and mobile, identify meaningful product/UI/UX problems, and propose improvements.

**Track 2 — Build the Desktop App**
Build a real desktop meeting-recording experience integrated with WhipScribe.

**Track 3 — Google Drive, Bulk Upload & Search**
Build a workflow for processing recordings from Google Drive and searching across their transcripts.

**Track 4 — Invent a Workflow**
Identify a real problem that can be solved with audio/video intelligence and build the workflow using the WhipScribe API, MCP server, or both.

You can choose one or more tracks.

## Don't Optimize for Size

We don't expect you to build a huge system.

**One small, polished feature that actually works is better than a massive unfinished project.**

We want to see:

* Your product thinking
* Your engineering ability
* Your UI/UX judgment
* Your ability to use AI effectively
* Your attention to detail
* Your ability to finish
* Your ability to learn
* Your ownership

## How to Submit

Follow the instructions inside the Buildathon repository:

### 👉 [View the Full Challenge & Submit Your Work](https://github.com/neugence/whipscribe-buildathon)

Your submission should include your project/source code, explanation of what you built, demo where applicable, and the other information requested by the selected challenge track.

**Please do not submit a proposal without first reading the Buildathon repository.**

## What Happens Next

We review your work based on the quality of your thinking, implementation, product sense, and ability to ship.

Strong candidates may be invited to work with us on the real product before receiving the full-time offer, allowing both sides to evaluate the fit through actual work.

### The Opportunity

**Role:** Founding Software Engineer
**Company:** Neugence Technology — WhipScribe
**Work:** Fully Remote
**Compensation:** ₹6–10 LPA, negotiable based on skills and ownership
**Type:** Full-time
**Joining:** Immediate

You'll work directly with the founding team and have ownership over real product areas from the beginning.

---

## Ready?

Don't just tell us you're a builder.

### **Show us.**

🚀 **[Start the WhipScribe Buildathon →](https://github.com/neugence/whipscribe-buildathon)**

title: Founding GTM
description:
People are faking their way into jobs. Stolen identities, someone else on the call, AI feeding them answers. It is happening right now, at scale, to companies you have heard of.

**We stop it.**

aperture checks every applicant before they reach a hiring team, throws out the fakes, and ranks the real ones on what they can actually do. We plug in under whatever ATS a company already runs. Nothing gets ripped out.

Now we need someone to go tell the world.

**the job**

You are our first GTM hire. Not a cog in a sales machine. You are the machine.

**Compensation & Equity**
We are currently in the process of raising our pre-seed round. Given the stage of the company, we would structure a retroactive pay arrangement for the period leading up to the close of the round.

The expected salary range for this role is **$80,000–$120,000**, depending on experience, scope, and level of ownership.

The role also includes meaningful equity in aperture, with the exact grant depending on the candidate’s experience, seniority, and level of ownership.

Final compensation and equity will be determined based on the candidate's experience, responsibilities, and overall fit for the role.



**You will:**

* Build the lists. Clay and Apollo are yours to run however you want.
* Find the signal nobody else is looking at, then get to the buyer before their competitor does.
* Write cold emails people actually reply to.
* Run the calls. Discovery, demo, pilot, close.
* Publish. Our case files on hiring fraud are real, sourced, and a little unsettling. You will write more of them.
* Own a number and bring it to the CEO every week with an opinion attached.

No playbook. You write it.

**you, probably**
* You have built outbound from zero at a company nobody had heard of.
* Clay is muscle memory. You can walk us through a waterfall you built and what you did when the match rate let you down.
* You write well and you write a lot. Somewhere out there is a post of yours that went further than you expected.
* You would rather ship something rough on Tuesday than perfect it by Friday.
* Early-stage chaos reads as fun to you, not as a red flag.

**not you**
* You want a territory and a lead list handed to you.
* You need a manager to tell you what the strategy is.
* You think AI writes the emails. It does not write the first line, which is the only line that matters..

read that list and counted yourself out?

**Apply anyway.**

That list describes the shape of the person we imagine, not a gate. Nobody checks every box, and the best hires at this stage usually arrive with a strange combination we did not think to ask for. If you have never touched Clay but you are the sharpest writer we will read this month, tell us. If you have run outbound in a completely different industry, tell us why it transfers. If you have done none of this and you simply cannot stop thinking about the problem, tell us that too.

*We would rather read your case for yourself than have you talk yourself out of it before we get the chance.*

title: Growth Associate / Growth Hacker
description:
### About HireFT

HireFT is an AI-powered global job application platform that helps job seekers discover relevant opportunities, and apply to jobs in a single click.

We're building a global job application engine for candidates across markets including the **US, Canada, Australia, UK, EU, India and other international markets.**

### About the Role

We're looking for a highly entrepreneurial **Growth Associate / Growth Hacker** who can help us grow HireFT's user base rapidly through creative, unconventional and scalable distribution strategies.

This is **not a traditional marketing role**.

You'll be expected to experiment constantly, identify what works, and then scale the channels that generate users.

You will work across content, communities, social media, partnerships, creators, referrals, outreach and other growth channels.

### What You'll Do

* Identify and execute creative growth experiments to acquire new HireFT users
* Build and grow distribution across platforms such as **Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Discord, Facebook groups, Telegram and other communities**
* Create short-form content around job hunting, resumes, interviews, layoffs, career growth and AI
* Create both **faceless and talking-head content**, including screen recordings, product demos, voiceovers, educational content and trend-based content
* Find and collaborate with career creators, influencers, student communities and career-focused organizations
* Build and experiment with referral and viral growth loops
* Research emerging platforms and unconventional acquisition channels
* Analyze acquisition funnels and identify which channels produce high-quality users
* Run multiple growth experiments every week and document results
* Work closely with the founder to rapidly test and implement new growth ideas

### What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is **extremely internet-native, creative and execution-oriented.**

You should:
* Understand how social platforms and online communities work
* Be comfortable creating and distributing content
* Have excellent written English
* Be comfortable with outreach and cold messaging
* Have strong research skills
* Be comfortable using tools such as Canva, CapCut and basic analytics platforms
* Understand basic growth metrics such as CAC, conversion rate, activation and retention
* Be proactive and capable of working independently
* Be willing to experiment with unconventional ideas
* Have a strong bias toward execution rather than simply planning

### Bonus Points

You'd be a particularly strong candidate if you have:

* Previously grown a startup, SaaS product, community or social-media account
* Experience with Reddit or other online communities
* Experience creating viral or high-performing short-form content
* Experience working with influencers or creators
* Experience with SEO/content marketing
* Experience with referral or affiliate programs
* Experience targeting international audiences
* Experience in a startup or early-stage company
* Built something yourself or run your own online project

### What Success Looks Like

Your goal is to continuously increase the number of **high-quality users** coming to HireFT.

You'll be measured on outcomes such as:

* New user acquisition
* Activated users
* Application activity
* Organic/viral growth
* Growth from new channels
* Creator and partnership distribution
* Conversion rates
* Cost-efficient acquisition

We care more about **users and growth than the number of posts, messages or campaigns you complete.**

This role is ideal for someone who thinks:

> **“Give me a product and a target. I'll figure out how to get people to use it.”**

If you've built a community, grown a social account, run a side project, created content, experimented with growth or simply have a track record of figuring things out on the internet, we'd like to hear from you.

description:
**Company Description** Yaya Labs is a creative technology studio exploring the edge between technology, culture and entertainment.

We are creating **Robot Dog Fights** (**RDF**), a new sport and entertainment property for the era of AI.

RDF combines robot combat, live events, technology, media and culture around one simple idea:

**Robot dogs. Fighting.**

Following our first sold-out event in London, we are now building towards the next phase of RDF, based in Las Vegas, with ambitions to develop it into a global entertainment property.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Sponsorship Sales & Partnerships Manager** to help build our network of brand partners and sponsors.

**Role Description** The Sponsorship Sales & Partnerships Manager will be responsible for identifying, pursuing and closing new sponsorship and brand partnership opportunities for Robot Dog Fights.

This is a proactive, outreach-focused sales position. The ideal candidate is comfortable starting conversations, cold calling, sending outbound emails, networking, researching potential partners and getting in front of senior decision-makers.

You will take ownership of RDF's sponsorship pipeline, from identifying prospective brands and making the initial contact through to pitching, negotiating and closing partnerships.

You will work directly with the Yaya Labs team to develop commercial opportunities around RDF's events, media, technology, teams, athletes, content and wider brand.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and research brands, companies, agencies and organisations that could be potential RDF sponsors or partners
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors and commercial partners
* Conduct consistent outbound outreach through cold calls, email, LinkedIn, networking and other channels
* Connect with senior marketing executives, brand managers, partnership teams, agencies and other key decision-makers
* Introduce prospective partners to RDF, its audience, events, media opportunities and commercial vision
* Schedule and participate in sponsorship and partnership meetings
* Develop relationships with prospective partners and manage consistent follow-up throughout the sales process
* Develop creative sponsorship opportunities across RDF events, teams, robots, content, media and technology
* Identify brands that can authentically become part of the RDF world and culture
* Work directly with leadership team to develop sponsorship packages, pitches and partnership opportunities
* Negotiate and close sponsorship and partnership deals
* Track outreach, leads, conversations, follow-ups and opportunities through the sales pipeline
* Help build long-term relationships with RDF's commercial partners
* Represent RDF at confrences and events communicating with brands, agencies and potential partners

**Who We're Looking For**

* A supreme connector with an existing network of people they can reach out to and get meetings with, particularly across Web3, crypto, prediction markets, robotics and technology
* Has lived and worked in the Web3, crypto and degen ecosystem and understands its culture, communities and key players
* Has proven experience selling sponsorships, partnerships, advertising or other high-value commercial deals
* Has a strong track record of personally closing deals
* Comfortable with cold outreach and creating opportunities from scratch
* Confident getting in front of founders, CMOs, brand leaders, investors and other senior decision-makers
* Strong relationship-building, negotiation and commercial instincts
* Knows how to identify the right partner and turn a conversation into a deal
* Commercially hungry and motivated by results
* Able to work independently and move quickly in an early-stage company
* Most importantly, you know how to sell and you know who to call

**Compensation**

This is a commission-first position designed for an experienced sales professional who wants to directly benefit from the partnerships and revenue they generate.

The Sponsorship Sales & Partnerships Manager will earn a **15% commission on every sponsorship or partnership deal they successfully close for RDF.**

**For example:**

$150,000 sponsorship = $22,500 commission

One $150,000 deal per month = **$270,000 annual commission**

**There is no ceiling on commission.**

A salary will be introduced once you help RDF reach $1m in sponsorship revenue, and we'll work closely with you to give you the support, resources and access needed to reach that goal.

**The Opportunity**

RDF is at an early stage, but we are entering a period of significant growth and momentum.

We have already put on our first sold-out event in London, bringing robot combat to an audience of 2,000 people.

Now we're building towards the much bigger vision from Las Vegas.

Global events. New arenas. New technologies. New teams. New rivalries.

We are looking for someone who sees RDF and immediately starts thinking:

**"I know who should sponsor this."**

If that's you, we want to hear from you.

**How to apply**

DM us with:

- What you've sold
- The biggest deal you've personally closed
- Three brands you think should sponsor RDF
- Why

No lengthy cover letters.

Show us how you think.
**Be part of the future of combat sport.**

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
# **Lead AI Engineer**

## **About Sierra Studio**

When you apply to Sierra, you join an ecosystem. We specialize in connecting talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted small community of growing companies in the US. Applying to Sierra seamlessly integrates you into this ecosystem, granting automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities we offer.

**Location:** Brazil, remote

**Compensation:** $70k – $120k USD, CNPJ

**Reports to:** Founder & CEO

## **About our hiring partner**

Our hiring partner is a US-based retention marketing agency helping DTC brands build personal relationships with their customers at scale through the channels they own: email, SMS, and everything in between. Their thesis is simple: brands shouldn't have to grow by unprofitably spending more on paid social. Everything they do is built around producing programs and messages that customers actually want and that actually perform.

They're a team of about 12 (strategists, specialists, designers, copywriters, and ops), fully remote, at ~$1.2M in revenue with a goal to double in the next four months. They partner with the leading platforms in the space and are now evolving from an agency with great internal tooling into something closer to an agency and a software company combined.

## **About the Role**

Our hiring partner is hiring their first engineer.

The founder has already built the foundation himself using AI coding tools: a data layer that pulls Klaviyo data for every client into the company's own Supabase database (so the team can query it in ways the platform's native API doesn't allow), a set of AI skills and workflows the team uses instead of building reports by hand, and a diagnostics tool made of agents that continuously QA client accounts and flag what's broken. On top of that sit early products that are somewhere between prototype and solid foundation.

It works and it's validated. But it was built by one person, and it's reached a level of disorganization that isn't sustainable as the company scales. The products need to be rebuilt with scale in mind, and the whole system needs an engineer who owns it.

That's where you come in. You'll own the architecture end to end: auditing what exists, deciding what stays and what gets rebuilt, and turning it into a fully maintained codebase with clear guidelines. You'll pair closely with the founder, who leads on product while you lead on development, iterating on agency workflows and products with feedback that comes directly from clients. And you'll build agentic flows across nearly every area of the business, from account diagnostics to go-to-market, which today are all built and maintained by the founder alone.

This is a lead role, not a founding-engineer-in-name-only role: you set the technical direction and standards for everything that gets built, and as the engineering function grows, you'll be the one shaping it.

## **What You'll Own**

### ***Architecture and Codebase***

- Audit everything that's been built so far, define what stays, what gets rebuilt, and how it all fits together.
- Take the current system (hosted on Cloudflare, with Supabase as the data layer, all connected) to a fully maintained, documented codebase with clear standards and guidelines.
- Design the data pipelines: ingestion from Klaviyo, Postscript, and Attentive, modeling and storage in Supabase, syncing, and querying beyond what the platforms' APIs allow.
- Build for scale and clarity, so the business has a foundation it can actually execute on rather than a pile of scripts.

### ***Agentic Workflows and Internal Tooling***

- Design and ship agents and AI skills for account diagnostics, reporting, QA, go-to-market, and internal ops.
- Make internal AI tooling reliable and consistent, so the ops team can roll it out across the team with confidence.
- Define the quality boundaries so the whole team gets the same results the founder gets.

### ***Products***

- Evolve the early products built on top of the data layer into something clients can depend on.
- Own the integrations with the email and SMS platforms the agency works with, and whatever comes next.
- Establish the workflow between you and the founder: what he ships himself with AI coding tools, what goes through you, and how changes make it into the maintained codebase.

### ***Being the Technical Voice in the Room***

- Be the engineering counterpart to the founder in product decisions, giving honest reads on feasibility, effort, and risk.
- Get in front of clients when it matters, in a product-manager-style loop: understand the problem, adjust, ship, repeat.
- Set the engineering standards and practices that future hires will follow.

## **Qualifications**

### ***Required***

- 5+ years building software professionally, with a track record of shipping things real people used.
- Strong full-stack engineering skills (TypeScript and/or Python, modern backend and frontend, Cloudflare, Supabase/Postgres, SQL). You write code every day and you're good at it.
- Cloud infrastructure provisioning experience (AWS, GCP, Azure,..).
- CI/CD workflows experience.
- Hands-on experience building LLM-based systems: agents, tool use, RAG, evals, prompt and skill design. You understand where these systems break, not just how to call the API.
- Good taste for data pipelines: pulling data from third-party APIs, modeling it, keeping it in sync, and querying it well.
- Comfortable with Supabase/Postgres (or equivalent) and owning data infrastructure end to end.
- Experience being the only or lead engineer somewhere: you can scope, prioritize, ship, and maintain without a team around you.
- Ownership mindset. You say what you're going to do, and you do it. No one is going to check whether you're doing enough work.
- Proactive communicator in a remote, async environment, with excellent written and verbal English. You'll work directly with the founder and, over time, with clients.

### ***Preferred***

- Experience with email/SMS marketing platforms (Klaviyo, Postscript, Attentive, Braze) or the DTC/ecommerce ecosystem.
- Background at a fast-moving martech or retention product company.
- Experience productizing internal tooling, or taking an agency's workflows and turning them into software.
- AI coding tools (Codex, Claude Code, or similar) are already part of how you work.
- Product instinct: you have opinions about what should be built, not only how.

## **What Success Looks Like**

- The architecture has been audited, cleaned up, and documented, and the codebase is fully maintained with clear guidelines.
- The internal AI tooling is reliable enough that the team gets the same quality of results the founder gets, without needing him in the loop.
- Agentic workflows across the business are built and maintained by engineering, not by the founder on the side.
- The early products have moved from prototype to something clients rely on, built to scale.
- The founder spends his time on product, clients, and growth, because engineering is covered.
- You've laid the groundwork for the engineering function to grow beyond one person.

## **Benefits**

- 23 days of PTO.
- Generous maternity and paternity leave.
- Bonus structure.
- Fully remote with flexible hours and US overlap.
- Contractor engagement (no healthcare coverage).

## **A Note on Fit**

The culture is built around ownership. Everyone geeks out on their craft, shares what they learn, and treats each other like adults. Because the team is remote, there's a lot of flexibility and an equal amount of accountability. People who take a full area, own it end to end, hit deadlines, and communicate proactively do very well here. People who need to be monitored don't.

What makes this role different is where you sit. Most engineers building in this space are inside a software company, one step removed from the people using what they ship. Here you're inside the agency: the feedback loop with clients is direct, the results are measurable in revenue, and you're never limited to what the software can do. You get to own an entire engineering function and be at the front of figuring out what it looks like when an agency and a software company become the same thing. If that sounds like the kind of problem you'd want to go build your way through, you'll like it here.

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Integrations
description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. [Vibe.co](http://Vibe.co) is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.  
  
[Vibe.co](http://Vibe.co) is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.  
  
Today, more than 12,000 brands use [Vibe.co](http://Vibe.co) to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, [Vibe.co](http://Vibe.co) became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.  
  
**This is a unique moment to join Vibe.** With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

## About the Role

You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting to the Engineering Manager. The team owns everything flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines.

This role exists because we're building a first-class Developer Platform: opening Vibe's full capabilities as a public API so external partners can build on top of us. Criteo is the first partner live on it.

Three reasons to want this:

- You'll be one of the most senior engineers on Integrations, setting technical direction for a team that's still small enough for one person's decisions to shape it
- You'll own the foundational architecture for a platform external partners are already building against
- AI-augmented development is the expectation here, not the experiment

## What You'll Do

**Build and ship integrations**

- Design and implement production-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners
- Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes
- Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts

**Developer Platform**

- Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale
- Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good
- Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally

**Reliability and scale**

- Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild
- Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff
- Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's

**Technical leadership**

- Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows
- Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects
- Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration

## What You Need

- **Production backend TypeScript experience is required.** You've built, shipped, and operated backend services, APIs, or microservices using TypeScript and Node.js, or a similar TypeScript backend runtime.
- **Backend-leaning work.** At least half your recent work is services, APIs, data models, and integrations. Fullstack is fine if the backend side is real.
- **You build for users.** You've shipped features customers or partners actually use. You've worked with product on what to build, pushed back on scope, and changed course when feedback came in.
- **Ownership you can point to.** A project you took from scoping to production and stayed accountable for after launch.
- **AWS, with real architecture calls.** Not just deploying to it.

## Nice to Haves

- **Third-party integrations:** ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs, or similar
- **Additional backend languages:** Python, C++, Rust, or similar
- **Developer-facing platforms:** Experience designing or contributing to public APIs or developer platforms
- **Startup experience:** Current or past experience at a startup of ~300 people or fewer. Doesn't need to be your most recent role.

## Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

## What We Offer

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:  
  
The pay range for this role is €99,000–€133,000. *We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.*

- **Variable pay**. Based on real Vibe business goals.
- **Hybrid flexibility.** We're in the heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week.
- **Health insurance.** Full coverage via Alan.
- **Meal vouchers** via Swile.
- **Annual offsite.** The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.
- **Tech Syncs.** Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

## Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting.

1. **Recruiter screen.** 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.
2. **Manager Interview.** 45 min with your future manager. Your experience, your projects, your approach.
3. **Product Interview.** 30 mins with the Product Manager for this team. We want to hear about how you've worked cross-functionally in previous roles.
4. **Technical assessment.** 90 min. Code review exercise plus applied questions. Real problems, not tricks.
5. **Bar raiser.** 30 min with a senior leader to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.
6. **Offer.** Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

## Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

## Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

title: Technical & Infrastructure Co-Founder
description:
### About Nixora

Nixora is the control plane for AI-generated software.

AI coding agents are changing how software is created. Applications can now be generated in minutes, but the infrastructure required to deploy, manage, secure, govern, and maintain that software has not evolved at the same pace.

Nixora is building the infrastructure platform between AI-generated software and cloud providers.

Our vision is to become the default control plane for AI-generated software, enabling applications to be deployed, managed, governed, secured, updated, and eventually retired throughout their lifecycle.

**AI generates the software. Cloud providers run the infrastructure. Nixora manages everything in between.**

---

## The Opportunity

We are looking for a **Technical & Infrastructure Co-Founder** to join Nixora at the earliest stage and take ownership of the company's technical and infrastructure direction.

This is a true co-founder opportunity, not a conventional engineering position.

You will work directly with the founder to shape Nixora's architecture, build the core infrastructure platform, make foundational technical decisions, and help take the company from MVP to a scalable product.

You should be comfortable building from zero, working with ambiguity, and taking ownership beyond a defined job description.

---

## What You Will Own

* Define and lead Nixora's technical architecture.
* Build and evolve the Infrastructure Control Plane.
* Design reliable infrastructure provisioning and orchestration systems.
* Develop deployment and runtime infrastructure.
* Build abstractions across AWS, GCP, Azure, and other cloud providers.
* Design systems for managing the lifecycle of AI-generated applications.
* Develop infrastructure automation and developer-facing tools.
* Build MCP, API, and SDK integrations as the product evolves.
* Establish foundations for security, reliability, observability, and scalability.
* Make pragmatic technology decisions for an early-stage startup.
* Help define the future infrastructure engineering team.
* Eventually lead technical hiring and engineering culture.

---

## Ideal Candidate Profile

We are specifically looking for someone who has **previously founded or co-founded a company**.

### You should have:

* Prior founder or co-founder experience.
* Experience building a product or company from the ground up.
* Strong infrastructure engineering and systems knowledge.
* Experience working in an early-stage startup environment.
* A builder mentality and strong sense of ownership.
* The ability to make decisions independently and execute quickly.
* Interest in AI infrastructure, developer platforms, and cloud systems.
* A long-term mindset toward building a company, not simply joining a job.

Prior experience building an infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, SaaS, or AI company is a significant advantage.

---

## Technical Requirements

### Programming Languages

Strong experience in at least one of the following:

* **Go / Golang** — preferred
* **Python**
* **Rust**

TypeScript or JavaScript experience is a plus.

### Infrastructure Experience

Experience with several of the following:

* AWS, GCP, Azure, or multi-cloud infrastructure.
* Docker and containerization.
* Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.
* Terraform, Pulumi, or Infrastructure as Code.
* Distributed systems and backend architecture.
* Linux and networking fundamentals.
* APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling.
* Infrastructure automation and platform engineering.
* MCP or AI-agent integrations.

You do not need experience with every technology listed. Strong systems thinking, infrastructure expertise, and the ability to learn quickly matter more than a specific technology stack.

---

## Why This Opportunity

AI is changing the economics of software creation.

AI agents can generate applications rapidly, but organizations still lack infrastructure designed for managing software created at this scale and speed.

Nixora is building for this emerging infrastructure category.

### You will have the opportunity to:

* Shape the technical foundation of a potentially large infrastructure platform.
* Work on systems spanning cloud infrastructure, developer tools, and AI ecosystems.
* Build from first principles rather than maintaining an existing system.
* Influence product and company strategy from day one.
* Become a founding technical leader with meaningful ownership.

---

## What We Offer

* Genuine technical co-founder ownership.
* Direct influence over technical and company strategy.
* Opportunity to shape the architecture and engineering culture.
* Freedom to build the technical team from the ground up.
* Close collaboration with the founder.
* The opportunity to build a new infrastructure category.
* Equity participation appropriate to the co-founder role, discussed transparently during the selection process.

---

## Compensation & Equity

This is a **pure equity-based co-founder role during the pre-funding stage**. No fixed salary will be provided initially.

A salary-based compensation structure will be introduced once Nixora secures investment. Equity allocation and the overall compensation structure will be discussed transparently during the selection process.

---

## Who Should Apply

This opportunity is for someone who wants to build a company, not just join one.

If you have previously founded or co-founded a startup, have strong infrastructure and systems expertise, and are excited about building the infrastructure layer for AI-generated software, we would like to hear from you.

title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
description:
## About the Role 

We are looking for an experienced, autonomous field marketing manager to lead and execute all field marketing initiatives across the West Region. This is not an entry-level field role: it requires someone who brings deep B2B cybersecurity experience, understands partner ecosystems, and operates independently, with minimal day-to-day direction.

The ideal candidate will own the full spectrum of regional marketing strategy and execution, from live and virtual events to partner programs, pipeline acceleration, and alignment with sales teams and executive stakeholders. You will have a proven track record of influencing the pipeline, championing creative programs, and using advanced tools to measure impact and iterate.

## What You’ll Do

- **Own the West Region marketing strategy:** Develop and execute a 12-month integrated plan aligned to sales priorities, go-to-market strategy, and regional opportunities. Translate business goals into actionable, persona-informed programs that address key buyer pain points across the customer lifecycle.
- **Design and deliver high-impact events and experiences:** Plan and execute CISO dinners, roadshows, roundtables, golf outings, sporting events and show activations. Own all logistics, contracts, vendor management, and follow-up. Lead pre-event preparation and coordinate communications with sales, SDRs (sales development representatives), executives, and partners. Upload leads, work with marketing operations to confirm proper tracking, and report on pipeline influence and outcomes.

Participate in pipeline reviews, QBRs, and planning sessions. Proactively identify whitespace opportunities and activate programs that accelerate deals. Understand and support ABM strategies.

- **Own budget and performance metrics:** Plan and manage regional budgets. Track spend against outcomes and adjust tactics based on real-time results. Understand demand waterfall performance and conversion velocity to improve program outcomes. Partner with sales leadership to review data and results regularly, drive continual improvement, and share key insights with the regional and national teams.
- **Contribute to campaign ideation and content strategy:** Collaborate with global and product marketing on persona development, messaging, and localized content. Recommend program themes based on buyer insights, behavior, and market trends.

## Who You Are

- **Experience:** 6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B technology, cybersecurity experience strongly preferred.

- **Track record:** A history of building and executing integrated field programs that influence pipeline and accelerate deals, owning a full calendar of regional events each quarter, including executive dinners, regional conferences, partner activations, and thought leadership programs.

- **Tool familiarity:** Familiar with key marketing tools, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, and Goldcast.
- **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for sales, partners, and executives.
- **Ownership:** High initiative and ownership, with the ability to operate independently and with minimal oversight.
- **Location and travel:** Based in the West Region with willingness to travel in and out of the region for events (up to 25%).
