title: Full-Stack Product Engineer
description:
## About Valur

At Valur, we're on a mission to democratize innovative tax-planning strategies, making them affordable and accessible to everyone. Just as Roman Health and Hims productized regulated healthcare to make it more accessible, we're streamlining the tax-planning tools of the ultra-rich to make them affordable and available to everyone.

The proof is in the results: we've scaled to mid-7-figure annual revenue and now manage more than $1 billion in assets through direct-to-consumer engagement and partnerships with some of the top investment and financial firms in the business. On the back of that traction, we've raised around $5 million from top early-stage investors, including Box Group, Canaan, BasisSet, Vibe Capital, and notable angels.

We're still a small team, which means each engineer has a lot of impact.

### **Our Values**

- **Customer Centricity** - Our job is to be our customer's best partner.
- **Ownership** - Everyone here is an owner. We identify problems and solve them.
- **Growth** - We're never satisfied; we aim to be better every day.
- **Urgency** - We prioritize the highest-impact work and solve it now.

### What We've Built

- A financial-planning decision engine
- Tax-planning calculators with deep quantitative results and clear visualizations
- AI agents for customer support and recommendations
- Client onboarding and account-management tools
- Internal tools that help our operations team scale
- Infrastructure for managing complex tax-planning workflows

### What We're Building Next

- Integrations with financial institutions, custodians, and data providers
- Better tools for tracking assets and optimizing tax outcomes over time
- More advanced AI recommendation systems and RAG-based assistants for customers, advisors, and internal teams
- B2B2C tools for financial advisors
- More automation around onboarding, documents, trust administration, and tax workflows
- Better internal systems so a small team can serve thousands of customers

## About the Role

We're looking for a full-stack product engineer who works the way the best engineers work today: AI-native, fast, and accountable for everything that ships.

This isn't a narrow frontend or backend role. We need someone who works across the stack, understands the product, talks through tradeoffs, and ships complete features - using AI tools and coding agents to move faster without lowering the quality bar. You'll partner closely with our designer (who owns UX/UI), as well as product, operations, and leadership, to decide what to build.

### How We Work With AI

AI is core to how we build, not just what we ship. Coding agents, structured prompts, and automation are part of our daily workflow - we use them to explore the codebase, draft implementations, generate tests, refactor, write docs, and automate operations.

But AI doesn't replace engineering judgment. The best engineers here aren't just "AI users" - they're good *managers* of AI: they give clear context, break work into small steps, verify the output, and own the code they ship. You know when to lean on AI and when to slow down - which matters most in our domain, where a small mistake in tax logic, financial calculations, or legal documents can have large consequences.

### What You'll Do

- Build full-stack product features from idea to production - frontend, backend APIs, data models, admin tools, tests, and deployment
- Turn ambiguous product ideas into clear technical plans
- Partner with design, product, operations, and leadership to decide what to build
- Use AI tools and coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation - and review what they produce before it ships
- Write clear specs, prompts, and implementation plans that humans and AI agents can follow
- Build solid tests around important business logic, especially tax and financial calculations
- Improve our onboarding, calculator, trust-management, and advisor-facing products - plus the AI-powered support, recommendation, and operations tools behind them
- Help automate manual operations so a small team can serve thousands of customers
- Improve CI/CD, deployment, observability, and production support - and keep the system simple and maintainable

### Tech Stack

You don't need to know every tool in our stack before joining, but you should be able to learn quickly. Our current stack includes:

- **Languages:** Python, JavaScript, TypeScript
- **Frontend:** Vue 3, Vite, Tailwind
- **Backend:** Django, Django Admin, Flask, asyncio, PostgreSQL
- **Infrastructure:** AWS, Linux, bash scripting
- **AI:** OpenAI, LangChain, RAG, AI agents, internal automation workflows
- **Testing & quality:** Playwright, unit tests, integration tests, GitHub Actions, Sentry
- **Design & prototyping:** Figma

### What Makes You Successful Here

- **Startup mentality** - You're energized by fast-paced environments, comfortable with ambiguity, and proactive about finding and solving problems.
- **End-to-end ownership** - You own features from idea to production: code, edge cases, tests, UX, deployment, monitoring, and follow-up.
- **High leverage with AI** - You use AI tools to multiply your output without losing control of the system.
- **Craft and judgment** - You write code other people can understand, care about the details, and have an eye for good product and UX.
- **Customer and business focus** - You care about users and outcomes, not just shipping code, and can explain complex concepts clearly.
- **Growth** - You're eager to improve the system around you, not just complete assigned tasks.

You may not enjoy this role if you need detailed instructions for every task, only want to work in one narrow part of the stack, or prefer large-company processes with many layers of review before anything changes.

### Qualifications

The ideal candidate has built and shipped important features before. You don't need fintech experience, but you should be interested in learning complex financial and tax products.

- 4+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
- A track record of shipping production software used by real users
- Ability to build across frontend, backend, database, infrastructure, and tests
- Experience with Django, Vue
- Good judgment around testing, observability, scalability, and maintainability
- Comfort writing technical proposals and explaining tradeoffs
- Comfort using AI coding tools, agents, and LLMs in daily work - and reviewing their output critically
- Strong written and verbal English communication (we're a distributed team)
- Strong attention to detail, high ownership, low ego

### Nice to Have

- Experience with fintech, tax, wealth management, legaltech, or other regulated domains
- Experience building AI-powered products (LLM APIs, RAG, agents, tool-calling) with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or LangChain
- Experience building internal tools for operations-heavy teams
- Experience improving CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, or developer productivity
- Experience taking a product from zero to one

## What We Offer

- Remote-first - we hire the best people wherever they are
- A critical role in a fast-growing company, with direct impact and direct access to leadership
- A small, efficient team (under 15) with little bureaucracy
- A lot of ownership and personal growth
- Competitive salary and meaningful equity, so you share in the upside

## How to Stand Out

Show us something you've shipped - a product feature, internal tool, automation, AI workflow, complex refactor, or a system you built from scratch. We'd also love to hear how you use AI in your engineering work: what tools you use, what you trust them with, what you always check yourself, and where they've made you faster or failed. We're looking for engineers who use the new tools well but still think clearly.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Teleskope**

Teleskope is redefining data security for the AI era with the only dedicated platform that combines precise visibility with automated remediation. Teleskope continuously scans, catalogs and classifies data in-motion and at-rest while automating policy-based actions, helping organizations proactively manage data sprawl while securely enabling AI adoption.

Fresh off our $25 million Series A round, Teleskope is entering a high-growth phase backed by top-tier investors and exceptional product-market fit.

**About the role**

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer who will be the technical face of Teleskope to our customers. You’ll operate across pre- and post-sales, sit between Go-to-Market and Engineering, support technical needs of customers in pilot, and serve as the dedicated technical resource for a large cohort of active subscription customers. The role requires hands-on engineering: writing bespoke integrations/automations, fixing customer-specific issues, and delivering production-ready technical solutions while building and maintaining strong relationships with our customers.

**What you’ll do**

- Serve as the dedicated technical resource for a book of customer accounts, supporting core platform functionality as well as ancillary product needs to ensure an exceptional and consistent customer experience.
- Work alongside Technical Account Managers to ensure success from conversion all the way through to renewal.
- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Forward-Deployed SREs to ensure timely and accurate technical delivery.
- Diagnose, triage, and implement fixes for customer-specific bugs; author reproducible fixes, tests, and PRs or produce clear remediation documentation when immediate code changes aren’t appropriate.
- Build custom product features to address high-impact customer requests. Most of these will make it to the core product.
- Support technically complex use cases by developing scripts, automation, custom integrations, and reports.
- Conduct architecture reviews, technical deep dives, enablement sessions, and solution reviews for a range of personas — from individual contributors to senior security and engineering leadership.
- Help drive the product roadmap by bringing the voice of the customer into planning meetings, prioritizing issues, and championing high-value feature requests to the Product team.
- Produce clear technical documentation, runbooks, and handoffs for customers and internal teams.

**About you**

- 2+ years supporting enterprise customers in a hands-on technical role (Customer Engineer, Software Engineer, Technical Consultant, Technical Account Manager, or similar)
- Strong scripting and programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash; experience with Golang/TypeScript is a plus)
- Experience with cloud technologies and deployment tooling (AWS/GCP/Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD)
- Bias for action and speed – you move fast, find creative solutions and aren’t afraid to disrupt the status quo
- Proficiency using AI coding tools such as Claude, Cursor and/or Codex
- Excellent communication skills and a consultative mindset — able to explain technical tradeoffs to both engineers and functional stakeholders.
- BS/BA in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
- Must be based in NYC (we work hybrid).

**What you'll get**

- An opportunity to join an early-stage startup in one of today’s fastest-growing markets.
- A chance to bridge your technical skills with business impact and direct customer exposure.
- Room to learn, grow, and rapidly advance in your career as part of a growing team.
- A beautiful office in NYC’s Financial District, with breakfast and snacks provided daily, and weekly catered lunch.
- Flexible vacation and work-from-home days.
- Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
- Health, vision, dental, 401k and more benefits, heavily subsidized by Teleskope.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description:
### **About the role:**

We are seeking a Staff Security Engineer to serve as a technical anchor for our security function. This role is critical for leading technical design reviews and ensuring our security posture scales alongside our rapid customer growth. You will be responsible for defining the security standards that protect sensitive healthcare data, ensuring our systems are resilient against evolving threats while maintaining high engineering velocity.

### Where you will work:

Garner is headquartered in NYC, but this position is available for individuals who are comfortable with remote work and occasional travel to HQ.

### **What you will do:**

- Lead technical security design: Own the technical design and review process for security-critical systems, ensuring all new features meet Garner's high standards for data protection and resilience
- Master complex domains: Maintain and apply a mastery of one or more technical security domains (e.g., Cloud Security, AppSec, or Data) to solve the most complex business and technical challenges
- Course-correct technical direction: Identify when technical paths are inefficient or insufficient and proactively redirect efforts to capture higher ROI for the firm
- Architect automated defenses: Create and implement advanced tools and automation that increase the efficacy of security monitoring and incident response
- Translate ambiguity into execution: Take broad, complex security objectives and break them down into well-defined deliverables and architectural requirements for the broader engineering team
- Mentor through technical rigor: Raise the bar for the engineering function by providing high-level feedback during code and design reviews, fostering a culture of security-first development

### **The ideal candidate has:**

- **Exceptional Technical Judgment:** Proven ability to make high-stakes technical decisions that result in positive long-term outcomes for the company's security posture
- **Strategic Problem-Solving:** Effectively leverages context and data to analyze root causes and prioritize security initiatives that offer the greatest impact on risk reduction
- **Influential Stakeholder Management:** Builds strong relationships across the organization, conveying complex security risks in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical partners
- **Drive for Innovation:** Continuously identifies and implements creative solutions to pay down technical debt and improve the efficiency of our security infrastructure
- **Reliability Under Pressure:** Handles complex escalations and security incidents with discipline, ensuring rigorous analysis and comprehensive resolution without jumping to conclusions
- **A desire to be a part of a high-performing, mission-driven team** that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback

### **Technologies we use:** 

- Python, Kubernetes, Snowflake, AWS, Terraform, Wiz, Cyberhaven, and more

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.

### **Compensation Transparency:**

The target salary range for this position is $258,000 - $310,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k), Teladoc Health and more.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Location:** Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA 

**Role Type:** Full-time 

**Compensation:** $201,250 

**Reports to:** Chief Impact Officer 

**Visa sponsorship:** Not available 

**Hires remotely in:** United States 

**Experience:** 8+ years

-

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Director of Product and Design to join our team! We're a growing, fast-moving group building technology that helps government leaders safely reduce incarceration and improve outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. That's where you come in. We're looking for a product leader who is equally energized by people and strategy — someone who can set the direction, build the systems, and develop a high-performing team of product managers and product designers to do the most important work of their careers.

## **About us**

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we've been able to safely reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

## **About the role**

This role sits at the center of Recidiviz's ability to scale. As Director of Product and Design, you’ll lead and develop a team of experienced product managers and designers—people with years of domain expertise and a deep commitment to the mission. Your job is to make each of them sharper, more supported, and more impactful: setting strategic context, building the people systems that help them grow, and creating the conditions for them to build products that actually get used on a daily and weekly basis. You'll report to the Chief Impact Officer and serve as a key partner on product direction, team health, operational standards, and organizational strategy as Recidiviz scales nationally. Some travel to our state partners, internal team gatherings, and offsites is expected.

## **Core responsibilities**

- **Own the outcomes:** Drive positive correctional outcomes by expanding product-market-impact fit, building long-term organizational sustainability, and scaling what works to more states—ensuring tools deliver immediate usability and sustained weekly active engagement.
- **Lead and develop a high-performing team:** Manage and mentor PMs, designers, and emerging leaders. Build cohesive cross-functional rituals, streamline team operations, and drive adoption of shared UI standards to increase execution speed and state-by-state consistency.
- **Build cross-functional trust:** Partner closely with engineering, data science, state engagement, and marketing, coaching your team to do the same. Keep teams close to frontline staff, government leadership, and justice-impacted individuals through grounded, trauma-informed discovery practices.
- **Set strategic context:** Define a clear direction so every PM and designer understands where their area fits, what to prioritize, and why it matters. Partner with and coach team members as they navigate complex policy and administrative constraints, helping them land on clear roadmaps and intuitive user workflows.
- **Modernize workflows and execution:** Help the team stay ahead of shifts in technology by modeling AI-assisted workflows across discovery, scoping, and prototyping—accelerating delivery speed without sacrificing rigor or user empathy.

## **Wild success**

Here are a few things you might accomplish in your first year that would demonstrate wild success in this role. Some of these will be the direct result of your work. Others will be because of the conditions you've set for a great team to do great things.

- **Active adoption & impact:** Recidiviz’s product portfolio achieves deeper impact—measured by high weekly active tool usage, stronger client executive support, and steady launch momentum.
- **People growth:** Multiple team members have grown into meaningfully new scope—a first-time manager, a senior IC owning a harder problem, or someone who was stuck and is now thriving.
- **Operational velocity:** User feedback loops and reusable components are cleanly integrated into product cycles, eliminating redundant work and accelerating state deployments.

## **Minimum qualifications**

- Deep care for the growth and wellbeing of the people you manage—you measure your success by theirs.
- 8+ years in product management or design, with at least 3 years managing a team of PMs and/or designers; you've led both senior ICs and emerging leaders and know how to get the best from each.
- Exceptional communication and relationship skills—you earn trust quickly, especially with people who have strong opinions and high standards.
- Experience coaching PMs and designers toward management readiness—you've developed future managers, not just individual contributors.
- Comfort operating in ambiguity, with the ability to help teams create clarity and momentum where little exists.
- Strong strategic instincts: you can zoom out to see the system, identify what's misaligned, and help teams make better decisions with less friction.
- A builder's mindset paired with strategic rigor—you see gaps, you close them, and you leave things better than you found them.
- Ability and willingness to travel, about one trip per quarter.

## **Preferred qualifications**

- Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments where end users, administrative buyers, and institutional partners each have distinct needs—and where building trust with all of them is part of the job.
- Experience working in or closely with mission-driven, nonprofit, or public sector organizations.
- Personal or professional experience working with the criminal justice system.
- Experience in a high-growth startup where the playbook was still being written.
- Exposure to AI-assisted product development and the unique team dynamics it creates.
- A track record of elevating strong PM and design ICs into more strategic, senior thinkers—not just promoting people, but genuinely shaping their craft.

## **Compensation**

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The compensation for this role is: $201,250.

## **What we offer**

- Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
- 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
- Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays per year
- 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
- 12 weeks of paid parental leave
- Complimentary One Medical membership (availability based on location)
- Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
- Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
- Free mental health support via Talkspace
- Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
- An annual company offsite and other ad-hoc gatherings
- All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

## **More about Recidiviz**

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we've built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator's 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 20 state partners — big and small, red and blue — and touches over 46% of the country's incarcerated population. We have helped to get hundreds of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our[ 2025 Year in Review](https://files.recidiviz.org/recidiviz25.pdf), read some[ press coverage](https://www.recidiviz.org/press), or watch our[ TED Talk](https://www.recidiviz.org/updates/how-bad-data-traps-people-in-the-u-s-justice-system).

## **An important note**

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look — you might be great for another role or another time!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Build the Systems That Turn Great Code Into Reliable Releases
**
DevOps Engineer
Location: Fully Remote (USA)

About WhatConverts
WhatConverts is a B2B SaaS company specializing in marketing attribution and lead tracking solutions. We empower businesses to make data-driven decisions by providing deep insights into their marketing campaigns and helping them understand what drives conversions. As a remote-first company, we foster a mission-focused and performance-driven culture, valuing integrity, initiative, and innovation.

Position Overview
We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to help software move reliably from design into production. You'll work across architecture, development, and delivery by managing CI/CD, coordinating releases, expanding automation, and keeping projects on track. You'll also build security into the development pipeline, with broader cloud security responsibilities added as you grow into the environment. You'll work alongside our Senior Developers, who set technical direction, and report to our Senior Cloud Architect on AWS and security work.

In this role you’ll get to:
Own and improve CI/CD across all environments using AWS CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, and launch templates.
Coordinate releases, deployments, environments, and quarterly code-revert testing.
Expand automated testing across synthetic monitoring, user journeys, and unit, integration, and endpoint tests.
Strengthen observability through Datadog, CloudWatch, Real User Monitoring, and log and trace correlation.
Define standards for error resolution, EC2 lifecycle management, and auto-scaling, recommending architectural and cost improvements while systems administration handles routine execution.
Keep frontend and backend projects moving from design through testing and production.
Help Senior Developers turn their plans into clear scope, milestones, and delivery schedules.
Run planning sessions and check-ins, track progress, and surface blockers early.
Facilitate incident response and post-mortems, and keep operational runbooks current.
Build security into the pipeline through secret scanning, Aikido remediation, least-privilege access, and IAM hardening.
Support security-alert triage, SOC 2 evidence collection, and vulnerability scanning, growing into penetration-test coordination over time.

What we’re looking for:
2-3 years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, or software delivery.
Hands-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
Working knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, RDS, Auto Scaling, CloudWatch, CodePipeline, CodeDeploy, IAM, EBS, and AMIs.
Experience with GitHub workflows, pull requests, branching strategies, release coordination, and deployment controls.
Familiarity with automated testing, application observability, and tools such as Datadog, CloudWatch, or Aikido.
A foundational understanding of cloud security, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, IAM, and least-privilege access.
Experience supporting structured delivery practices such as regular planning and check-ins, work tracking, and cross-functional coordination.
The ability to work within established processes and under direction while finding practical ways to improve reliability, security, and delivery speed.
Strong organization, communication, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
Experience with incident response, post-mortems, penetration testing, or SOC 2 compliance is a plus.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact at a bootstrapped, growing SaaS company where you’ll shape how software is built, tested, secured, and released. Your ideas will be heard, ownership will be valued, and your work will directly improve the reliability and evolution of our platform.

No red tape. No endless layers. Just meaningful challenges, smart people, and the opportunity to build systems that help an entire engineering team move faster. 💥

Company Benefits/Perks:
Remote-First: Empowered to work agilely in a fully remote environment with no risk of office return.
Immediate Impact: From day one, take ownership of projects and make a direct impact.
Health & Wellness: 100% employer-paid premium medical, dental, vision, and life insurance.
401k with 5% Match: Secure your future with immediate vesting.
Employee Support: Access counseling, legal, and debt management services through our EAP.
Generous PTO & Flexible Time Off: Accrue PTO with additional days for tenure, plus up to 4 hours of flex time per week for personal matters.
Parental & Bereavement Leave: Paid leave for life’s important moments.
Volunteer Day: Give back with an annual volunteer day.
Diversity & Inclusion: Join a positive, supportive, and inclusive workplace.
Remote Work Perks: $100 monthly stipend to ensure your home office needs are met and company-provided devices.

If you're passionate about working in a dynamic, fast growing company with smart colleagues and opportunities for development, come grow with WhatConverts.

title: Video Editor Internship
description:
**Role has an initial unpaid internship period (~60-90 days) but can lead to paid work.**

[Relish](https://www.tryrelish.com) is an influencer marketing platform connecting freelance marketers and influencers with local agencies and brands for influencer marketing campaigns. Our goal is to help businesses expand into new markets, host launch events, and promote new products.

This role is part of our creative direction track. We're looking for a highly motivated Video Editing Intern to help us build a sustainable, repeatable process for turning raw creator footage into finished, publish ready content.

You'll work directly with our **CEO, Founder & Chief Growth Officer**, our **Director of Marketing**, and the creators themselves, receiving and organizing assets, building the shot lists that guide what gets filmed, and editing the footage into content that performs.

**New Partnership: Capi Taco** 
This role sits inside a new program we're building around a partnership with influencer, Capi Taco. Capi Taco is the online persona of Tomás Salem, a Norwegian-Argentine social anthropologist, documentary filmmaker, and author currently sailing across the Pacific with his crew aboard the Falkor.

Relish has partnered directly with Tomás as a strategic collaborator, helping him build a sustainable pipeline of edited content from the expedition, not just one off videos. This role is part of that partnership: you'll help stand up the workflows, templates, and systems that turn raw footage from the boat into finished, publish ready content.

It is important that applicants be self-motivated, proactive, and efficient with their time; Relish is a fast paced and agile company and applicants will be expected to keep pace with the speed of business.

**What You'll Do**
* Build and maintain a sustainable process for receiving, labeling, and organizing raw creator assets.
* Edit raw footage into polished, publish ready content across formats (short form, long form, platform specific cuts).
* Help build shot lists that set creators up for strong, on brand footage.
* Work directly with the Chief Growth Officer, the Director of Marketing, and creators to keep content on brief and on schedule.
* Help document and improve the editing workflow so it scales across more creators and more content.

**Who You Are**
* Skilled with video editing tools (e.g. Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, CapCut) and eager to sharpen those skills.
* Organized, you can build and follow a labeling/asset system without losing track of files.
* An eye for pacing, sound, and story — you know what makes a cut feel tight and a video actually perform.
* Self-directed and reliable, comfortable taking direction from multiple stakeholders.
* Curious about content, creators, and what makes a video actually perform.

**Why Join Us**
* Get hands-on editing experience shaping a brand new creator content pipeline from the ground up.
* Work directly with senior marketing leadership and real creators on a live product launch.
* Build a portfolio of real, published work.
* Learn how a content pipeline is actually built and scaled, not just how to cut a video.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. Reps are buried in admin work, managers are stretched thin, and leaders can’t see what’s really happening in the field.

Siro is redefining how field sales teams learn, perform, and win.

We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field.

Today, we’re something much bigger — an intelligent companion that automates sales reps’ tedious admin work, gives managers real-time visibility, and helps executives see around corners.

Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. Think *Iron Man’s* Jarvis for sales — proactive, personalized, and built directly into the tools teams already use.

Siro has raised $75M and is backed by world-class investors like Index, Fika, CRV, and SignalFire. We are trusted by leading home-improvement, retail, hospitality, and automotive brands, and powered by a lean team from Meta, McKinsey, Doordash, and Uber.

We’re building the future of human-AI collaboration in sales — and we’re just getting started.

We are seeking an outstanding **Enterprise Account Executive** who lives to hunt. This person will play a critical role in expanding our footprint among enterprise level clients: identifying strategic opportunities, penetrating accounts and existing partnerships, and establishing long‑term relationships. You’ll be a key member of our sales org, working closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Leadership.

**What You’ll Do:**

- Develop and execute a strategy to source, pursue, and close new enterprise customers in target verticals (e.g., Fortune 500, industry leaders).
- Hunt new business: cold outreach (calls, emails, social), leveraging networks, referrals, events, etc.
- Own the full sales cycle from initial outreach through contract negotiation and signing.
- Build, maintain, and grow a pipeline of high‑value opportunities; forecast with accuracy and drive predictable revenue.
- Partner cross‑functionally: collaborate with Marketing to align on lead gen and content; with Product to feed customer insights; with Customer Success to ensure smooth onboarding and account management.
- Serve as a thought partner and subject matter expert: present to C‑level executives, position the product in strategic conversations, act as the face of our enterprise go‑to‑market.
- Provide feedback to leadership on market trends, competitive intelligence, pricing, packaging.

### Requirements

- **~5+ years** of enterprise level B2B SaaS sales experience, hunting new logos and managing complex sales processes.
- Proven track record of exceeding large quotas.
- An existing network and the ability to create relationships with key stakeholders within target verticals.
- Deep experience selling to C‑suite / executives in large organizations.
- Strong ability to generate leads, build pipeline, and close enterprise deals with minimal assistance.
- Excellent communication & presentation skills; ability to tell compelling stories; confidence in executive level conversations.
- Self‑motivated, highly organized, resilient; you’re comfortable working independently in ambiguity and forging paths.

### Why join Siro as an Enterprise Account Executive

- High ownership & impact: this isn’t a support role - you’ll own your ledger, your strategy, and your results.
- Fast‑paced, mission‑driven culture where ideas matter and you can see the difference you make.
- Competitive compensation package: base + major variable incentive (quota‑bearing), equity, benefits.
- Opportunity to shape the future of field/in‑person sales intelligence.
- Strong team culture: helpful, smart, ambitious, and collaborative.

*At Siro, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Associate Creative Director
description:
**DTCo Associate Creative Directors** drive excellence in DTC advertisement creative quality, concept development, and seamless delivery of creative assets.

You will play a crucial role in developing and delivering creative for our performance marketing campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, and more. You’ll own the creative process from concept through briefing, production, and final delivery; partnering closely with Account teams and Editors to translate performance insights, client strategy, and audience understanding into compelling, conversion-focused creative. A core responsibility of this role is developing concepts and turning them into clear, actionable creative briefs for static, video, animation, and UGC.

The ideal candidate feels at home in design and editing software (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, CapCut), experience in AI generation for paid social creative, has incredible communication and project management skills, and is engaged in the DTC digital world with an eye for “what works.”

This role reports to a Senior Strategy Director. Associate Creative Directors work in close partnership with Account team members within their pod and manage a team of Video Editors.

### Responsibilities

**Creative Management:**
* Own the creative direction and development of assigned client accounts, overseeing the development and execution of static, video, animation, and UGC creative.
* Translate concepts into clear, actionable creative briefs that provide Editors with the strategic and creative direction needed to execute effectively.
* Work closely with Editors and Account team members to ensure that briefs are received with appropriate detail for immediate action. Resolve blockers cross-functionally with a growth mindset.
* Set and maintain the creative vision and quality bar for the account, ensuring creative output is strategically aligned, compelling, and built to perform.

**Execution & Production:**

**Internal Productions:**
* Own the concepting and briefing process for assigned creative, ensuring every concept has a clear hypothesis, audience, angle, hook, format, and executional direction.
* Own briefing for Editors, ensuring clarity, strategic rationale, actionable direction, appropriate assets, references, copy, and executional details across static, animation, UGC, and video creative through final delivery.

**UGC Productions:**
* Own end-to-end UGC production, including creator sourcing, casting, contracting, product coordination, briefing, scripting, and delivery to client.
* Review creator footage and direct how it should be edited, structured, and repurposed for performance.
* Manage Editor briefing, revisions, and final delivery to client

**Across all projects:**
*  Uphold adherence to brand voice, direct response best practices, and platform guidelines across all creative.
*  Mentor and elevate junior team members in concept development, briefing, execution, and platform-specific best practices.
*  Drive high QA standards across all creative outputs.
*  Lead adherence to agency processes, ensuring execution follows established systems to reduce risk and streamline workflows.

**Project Management & Organization:**
* Own creative organization across assigned projects, including documenting client feedback and maintaining creative guidelines in Asana and Notion.
* Maintain and evolve internal creative libraries with relevant assets, references, creator footage, and project files.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Account teams on ad analysis, insights, and new concept development, using performance learnings to inform future creative.
* Lead internal communication on timelines, deliverables, and project status across Editors.

**Resource Allocation:**
* Monitor workloads and adjust resources as needed to meet project deadlines.
* Support the facilitation of all internal and client feedback to ensure timely action.
* Anticipate production needs based on the creative roadmap, particularly for UGC, and proactively flag creator, product, footage, or resource requirement in partnership with Senior Strategy Director.

**Internal Communication and Client Facing:**
* Act as the connective tissue between strategy, concepting, production, and post-production to ensure creative intent is maintained from brief through final asset.
* Foster strong communication channels between your Pod and Client teams. Communication occurs between Slack, Asana, and weekly calls.

title: 🐶🐱 Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
# Senior Fullstack Engineer

**$170,000 – $210,000 base**  
Remote  
Company: Radimal – Veterinary Radiology Platform  
Reports to: VP of Engineering  

## About Radimal

Radimal powers veterinary radiology for hundreds of practices across the United States. We support emergency hospitals, specialty centers, and fast-growing practice groups with diagnostic workflows used every day.

Our platform combines board-certified veterinary radiologists with AI-powered tools to deliver fast, accurate diagnostic insight. Many cases are time-sensitive. Doctors rely on us to move quickly and get it right.

This is a live, operationally critical system handling thousands of cases per month across time zones. When we ship improvements, they immediately affect real veterinary teams and real patient outcomes.

We operate at meaningful scale:

- High daily case volume  
- 24/7 production usage  
- Complex scheduling and automation systems  
- Enterprise AI-assisted workflows  
- Growing partnerships with large veterinary groups  

Radimal is financially healthy, growing, and embedded in daily clinical operations. This is serious software used in real-world medical environments.

## About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to increase shipping velocity and strengthen our AI-powered workflows.

You will work across React (frontend) and Python (backend) inside a live production system. The problems are real. The users are real. The impact is immediate.

This is not a research role and not an architecture ivory tower role. It is a high-agency product engineering role focused on shipping.

You should expect to contribute meaningfully within your first week.

## What You’ll Do

Bridge the gap between complex radiological data and the veterinarian’s decision-making process. You'll ensure that when an AI generates an insight, it’s presented in a way that is intuitive, trustworthy, and actionable in a high-stress emergency environment.

- Ship end-to-end features across React frontend and Python backend  
- Proven ability to build polished, high-fidelity UIs. You care about 'the last 10%'—loading states, optimistic updates, and accessible layouts.
- Build and improve enterprise AI-assisted workflows  
- Improve case workflows, scheduling systems, notifications, and automation  
- Turn loosely defined ideas into production features quickly  
- Collaborate closely with engineering leadership on priorities  
- Use AI tools daily to accelerate development and testing  

## What We’re Looking For

### Required

- 5+ years building and shipping fullstack product features  
- Strong React and TypeScript experience  
- Strong Python backend experience (FastAPI, Django, or similar)  
- Deep understanding of API design, data modeling, and authentication  
- Experience building AI-driven interfaces (streaming, human-in-the-loop, or agentic UI) where user trust and clarity are the primary goals.
- Experience operating services in AWS production environments  
- Experience building and running LLM-powered features in production  
- High agency and strong debugging skills  
- Clear communication and ownership mindset  
- Active use of AI tools in your development workflow  

### Preferred

- Experience in high-availability or operationally sensitive environments  
- Experience shipping enterprise AI workflows  
- Experience increasing engineering velocity in growing teams  
- Comfort working in evolving systems without perfect documentation  

## What Success Looks Like

**Within 30 days:**

- You’ve shipped multiple meaningful improvements  
- You own a meaningful surface area of the product  

**Within 60 days:**

- You’ve materially improved or shipped an AI-powered workflow in production  
- You’ve measurably increased engineering throughput  

## This Role Is Not For You If

- You prefer long planning cycles before implementation  
- You primarily want to design architecture rather than ship features  
- You are looking for a pure ML research role  
- You need extensive onboarding before contributing  
- You are uncomfortable owning production outcomes

title: Paid Media Creative Specialist (PH)
description:
At Moxie, we empower ambitious aesthetic entrepreneurs to build profitable, independent practices—without burnout, overwhelm, or guesswork. In just a few years, we've grown from an idea to a global, remote-first team now supporting 700+ practices nationwide.

Our purpose is simple: to unlock sustainable success for aesthetic entrepreneurs, at every stage of their journey.

## **PH - Paid Media Creative Specialist**

We're looking for a **PH - Marketing Creative Specialist** to own the creative outcomes for paid social campaigns — concepts, iterations, and final static and video deliverables — directly driving the metrics (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) that determine campaign performance, while also making ads that are beautiful and delight our clients.

You'll also be stepping into building and owning AI-augmented creative workflows — using AI as leverage to increase the volume and quality of what you ship, without letting it replace your own trend instincts and creative judgment.

We’re looking for a creative who loves Meta - who lives and breathes Instagram. And who is obsessed with what makes content convert - both organically and in paid ads. You’ll get the autonomy and creative freedom to make amazing designs - and the responsibility for how those perform, and more importantly, using how they perform to improve what we make next. Done well, you’ll help us build creative capability that not just delights our clients, but delivers on ROI and growth.

## Our objectives for the role

- Ship creatives that delight our practices: creatives that highlight what’s best about their practices, results, and branding – and that they’re so excited about that they regularly ask us if they can post our ads as organic content on their feeds, too.
- Own creative performance (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) across your designs – and turn patterns of performance into meaningful insights and repeatable elements or frameworks that get actioned in feedback loops into your work and the broader team.
- Spot trends and micro-trends and translate them into on-brand, executable static and video creatives – that appeal to the right audiences and pain points for a given campaign.
- Demonstrate command of production tools, specs, file setup, and platform requirements across Meta placements, and become a go-to resource on specs and complex production issues (compression, accessibility, delivery).
- Contribute to AI-driven creative workflows and frameworks — for concepting, production, or testing — that get adopted across the broader creative team.
- Scale a creative process or workflow into standard team practice, and act as a subject-matter expert whose creative-performance patterns guide the rest of the team.

## We're looking for:

- **Top Tier Aesthetic Taste** — you know the exact layouts, fonts, music, and styling that will make creative pop. You can design for multiple aesthetics and never ship a boring or basic creative.
- **Creative ownership and execution** — you can spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work across both static and video, within provided frameworks, not just execute someone else's brief. This includes writing the copy and executing the design work, on-brand, and owning its performance in the ad platforms.
- **Performance fluency** — you're fluent in performance creative and think in terms of the metrics that matter: CTR, hook rate, cost per result, and ultimately, ROI.
- **Turn Patterns into Systems** — you see the hook that performs in every video ad you ship as a repeatable element you should mix into every new video we script, and that one red button that always makes a graphic’s cost per lead lower as your ace in your back pocket for accounts whose creative just doesn’t hit. And you’re ready to take this skill further into templates that de-risk creative performance, using insights from across a portfolio of brands running similar ads.
- **Production mastery** — deep command of specs, file setup,editing/creating tools (including AI augmentation), and platform requirements, with the ability to independently resolve production issues that stump others.
- **Trend fluency** — you already think like a trend-setter; spotting what's next is a skill you own, not something you outsource to an algorithm.
- **Productive use of AI** — you build and own AI-augmented workflows, using AI as leverage rather than a crutch or a replacement for your judgment. Ads and creatives that are obviously AI give you the ick - and you would never give us a final product that looks like Claude, or Chat, or some other AI tool’s basic output - even though you probably did use them to help you execute it.

## Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.
- This role is built for a creative who wants real ownership — not just execution against someone else's brief, but the ability to spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work, across both static and video.
- It's a high-autonomy, high-trust role with a clear growth path toward creative leadership, working at the frontier of AI-augmented creative production without being replaced by it.
- Competitive salary

At Moxie, we believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, trusted, and included. Our team lives by our values: **act as owners, give more than we take, move with speed and care, and simplify and learn every day.**

We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require any accommodations to fully participate in the interview process, please let us know, we’re happy to assist.

title: Associate General Counsel, Servicing & Title
description:
**Local or 100% Remote**

 

**About the role**

Point is seeking an experienced Associate General Counsel to serve as the primary legal partner to the teams that manage Point's home equity investment (HEI) product after origination. This role is focused on the servicing side of the homeowner lifecycle, from onboarding through defaults, exits, and maturity. This role reports to the Deputy General Counsel with direct access to the General Counsel and senior leadership on high-priority matters.

The Associate General Counsel, Servicing & Title will own day-to-day legal counseling for Point's Funding, Post-Closing, Servicing, and Investor Operations teams. Coverage includes servicing communications and disclosures, title and lien perfection questions and claims, contract administration, defaults, and the subservicers and title vendors that Point partners with to execute.

Point has built a substantial regulatory and compliance foundation for the HEI, and this role continues to expand that foundation. Questions will surface that no one has answered before. This is a hands-on role on a small team, and the work rewards a mortgage or consumer finance lawyer who is genuinely interested in how a servicing operation runs and keen to build a durable playbook along the way.

*This is a fully remote position with occasional travel required.*

 

**Your responsibilities**

- **Servicing lifecycle counseling**
  - Serve as the primary legal contact for Servicing and homeowner operations across the post-origination lifecycle, from homeowner inquiries through exit administration and maturity.
  - Draft and maintain Point's contract amendments, and own the state-by-state analysis that governs them, including recording and lien priority.
  - Review homeowner communications and notices, and maintain the matrix of applicable state disclosure and notice requirements in coordination with relevant legal and compliance partners.
  - Advise on vesting, transfers, trusts, estates, and capacity questions, and on cure mechanics when a transfer falls outside the agreement.
  - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design on servicing features and the legal requirements that shape them.
- **Title and lien perfection**  

  - Advise on title and lien perfection issues, including county rejections, corrective instruments, and state curative requirements.
  - Manage title claims with carriers from tender through resolution, including claim strategy and recovery efforts, and coordinate with the business on exposure.
- **Escalations**
  - Partner with Servicing and Point's subservicers on escalations that need a legal read: senior-lienholder proceedings, tax sales, condemnation, and casualty claims.
  - Advise on consumer bankruptcy questions, including proofs of claim and communication during stay periods.
  - Advise on delinquent property taxes, including redemption timelines, per-file risk, and remediation.
- **Outside counsel and investor support**
  - Retain and direct outside counsel on title, collateral, and tax-sale matters; define clear scopes of work, critically evaluate advice and work product, and manage deadlines and budgets.
  - Support diligence, investor notice, and consent obligations where servicing or title facts drive the answer.
- **Process, playbooks, and legal technology**
  - Build playbooks, templates, and self-service guidance so the business can resolve high-volume servicing questions on its own, and legal time goes to the harder calls.
  - Use AI-assisted workflows for document review, disclosure comparison, and matter triage, with approved tools, output verification, and confidentiality safeguards.

 

**About you**

- J.D. and active bar membership in any U.S. jurisdiction (California preferred); must be eligible for in-house practice in your state of domicile.
- 7+ years of experience practicing law in mortgage or consumer finance, at a law firm, in-house, or a combination of both, including meaningful, hands-on experience advising on residential mortgage or other real estate-secured consumer finance servicing matters.
- Demonstrated experience analyzing and resolving title, lien-priority, recording, or lien-perfection issues, with an understanding of title insurance and the ability to work through state-by-state variation.
- Comfort partnering with a servicing team, subservicers, and outside counsel on proceedings that affect the collateral. Familiarity with foreclosure and enforcement procedure in judicial and non-judicial states, including redemption periods and surplus funds, is an advantage.
- Working knowledge of the consumer finance and mortgage regulatory framework, including RESPA/Regulation X, TILA/Regulation Z, FDCPA/Regulation F, FCRA, ECOA/Regulation B, TCPA, SCRA, GLBA, UDAAP and state UDAP laws, and state servicing, licensing, and debt collection requirements.
- The ability to assess how regulatory requirements apply to a novel consumer financial product, and to translate them into operational guidance that the business can follow.
- Experience retaining and directing outside and local counsel, and managing scope and budget across a multi-matter portfolio.
- A strong sense of ownership: you advise in plain language, run the question down, and come back with a recommendation rather than handing back the issue.
- Sound judgment in a fast-moving, regulated environment, and the instinct to recognize when a question needs further analysis, specialist input, or escalation.
- Preferred experience includes:
  - Default servicing, foreclosure, bankruptcy, or loss mitigation exposure.
  - Title claims experience.
  - Supporting a novel consumer financial product through operational build-out.
  - Building legal playbooks, templates, intake processes, and service levels in a scaling legal function.
  - Leveraging legal AI tools in an in-house environment.

 

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

- Tier 1 | San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle | $211,850 - $234,150
- Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $190,000 - $210,000
- Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $176,700 - $195,300

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

 

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point’s states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

description:

title: Finance Business Partner
description:

description:
Product Specialist - crypto tax software
$20k – $50k • No equity

-------------------------------- **Please apply via https://careers.koinly.io/jobs/8326930-product-specialist/5dc8187c-1e50-4e13-b663-0449a1c2401c** --------------------------------

**Shape the future of crypto tax with a product people truly need
**

Koinly helps investors handle their taxes without losing their minds. Our goal is simple to describe but incredibly hard to deliver: a user should be able to complete their taxes in under 20 minutes.

We’re hiring a crypto-savvy problem solver who will start in Customer Support, solving real user problems through support tickets. This will give you a deep understanding of Koinly and our users, preparing you to quickly grow into a Product Specialist role — shaping new features, and helping developers squash bugs.

No prior experience in a similar role is required, but strong crypto and blockchain knowledge is a must. You should be comfortable with different protocols and on-chain activity, including using block explorers to investigate transactions.

As a Product Specialist, you’ll get your hands dirty in the data — understanding why something has gone wrong, whether that’s transaction data, imports, API discrepancies, cost-basis calculations, or how crypto activity is represented in Koinly.

If you’re crypto-native, analytical, and a self-starter who loves digging into how things work — read on. 👇

**Role at a glance **

🌱 Crypto expertise required — product experience isn’t

📩 Start in Support, master Koinly, then quickly move into your Product role (usually within 30 days)

🛠️ Your focus: User problems & feedback, data accuracy & integrations, feature QA & automation

🏡 Fully remote with flexible hours (European time-zone overlap required)

🤝 B2B contract

🎄 32 holidays per year (incl. public holidays)

👨‍💻 Co-working space budget

🚀 Work in crypto

**What you’ll own **

You’ll be the bridge between our users and developers, helping ensure Koinly remains one of the most accurate products on the market.

Solve user problems: Investigate complex cases, identify root causes, gather feedback, and help Support resolve issues.

Shape the product: Turn user insights and research into opportunities, working closely with Product and Engineering.

Ensure data accuracy: Investigate transaction and portfolio discrepancies and work with developers to improve integrations.

Test and refine features: QA new features and fixes before release, catching bugs and ensuring they work as expected.

Improve workflows: Use AI and automation to streamline processes and keep development work well organised.

**What success looks like **

Within 30 days, you can confidently use Koinly with complex portfolios, investigate transaction and import discrepancies, and produce clear, actionable findings. You have finished your training in support and can move on to your product role.

Within 60–90 days, you’re handling high-complexity crypto cases, spotting recurring patterns, contributing to QA, and producing investigations Engineering trusts.

The benchmark: You can run your own complex crypto portfolio through Koinly, understand what’s happening with your transactions and data, and investigate — and fix — anything that doesn’t look right.

**This role is a fit if this sounds like you… **

Crypto-native: You understand wallets, exchanges, transfers, trading, staking, DEXs, LPing and dapps. You’ve used crypto extensively yourself and understand the ecosystem beyond simply buying and holding.

Comfortable with block explorers: You can navigate explorers such as Ethereum or Solana, find transactions, and use on-chain data to investigate issues.

Analytical & technical: You enjoy debugging messy problems, comparing data sources, and reaching evidence-based conclusions.

Meticulous: You have a high bar for quality and a detective mindset when it comes to QA and testing.

Tool-savvy: You’re comfortable with spreadsheets and learning technical tools in general.

A clear communicator: You’re fluent in English and can turn complex technical issues into clear, actionable insights.

Adaptable & collaborative: You learn quickly and work well across Product, Engineering and Customer Support.

An AI power user: You use AI to investigate, automate and work faster — while applying your own judgement and validating its outputs.

A self-starter: You don’t wait to be told what to do. You prioritise effectively, spot what needs doing next, and take ownership.

Nice-to-haves Strong understanding of APIs and how data flows between systems

Hands-on experience with DeFi, NFTs, staking, and complex on-chain activity

Programming or scripting experience in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages

Familiarity with blockchain development concepts and on-chain data structures

title: Technical Product Lead
description:
# **Technical Product Lead**

Latitude is an early‑stage payments fintech building modern infrastructure for global money movement. We help businesses move value instantly, securely, and with full compliance-leveraging blockchain rails while delivering a seamless, enterprise‑grade experience.

Our team has built and scaled payments and financial infrastructure at Uber, Coinbase, Stripe, Amazon, and Facebook-bringing deep experience across fintech, marketplaces, and global‑scale systems. In January 2025, we [raised an $8M seed round](https://fortune.com/2026/03/31/exclusive-former-stripe-and-coinbase-employees-raise-8-million-for-latitude/?for40f=) led by NEA, with participation from Lightspeed Faction, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, Bitso, Solana Ventures, and others. We've since raised a $35M Series A led by [Oak HC/FT](https://www.linkedin.com/company/oak-hc-ft-partners/), with participation from existing investors [New Enterprise Associates (NEA)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/new-enterprise-associates/), [Coinbase](https://www.linkedin.com/company/coinbase/), and [Faction VC](https://www.linkedin.com/company/factionvc/), and new investors [Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati](https://www.linkedin.com/company/wilson-sonsini-goodrich-&-rosati/) and [OpenFX](https://www.linkedin.com/company/openfx/) -bringing our total raised to $43M.

We're looking for our first Product hire: an experienced technical product leader who wants to own the product function end-to-end at a fast-growing fintech.

## **The Role**

We're looking to make our first product hire; someone to work directly with the founders every day and own the roadmap, discovery, specs, launches - everything that makes a product successful.

Today, this is a hands-on role - not a management role. You will inherit a real product with real customers moving real money across a growing set of corridors, an experienced engineering team that ships fast, and a large backlog of decisions. As we scale, you'll build the product organization underneath you; today it's all hands on deck.

You'll work on two things at once: what ships this quarter, and where global money movement is going over the next three to five years. Which rails will matter, which regulatory shifts are coming, what we own versus rent. We need to build for now and the future.

Lastly, because we sell infrastructure to technical buyers, this role sits close to the metal. You should be comfortable reading an API spec, reasoning about the failure modes of a payment flow, and arguing about idempotency and reconciliation with engineers who will push back.

You'll have the opportunity to:

- **Own the roadmap.** Set product direction across corridors, rails, and platform capabilities. Decide what we build, what we don't, and in what order — then defend those calls to the team, our customers, and our leadership.
- **Run discovery with technical customers.** Talk directly to the engineers and operators who integrate with us. Turn what they tell you into specs precise enough to build from.
- **Define the core platform surfaces.** Help create excellent payment orchestration, ledgering, payout and collection flows, partner integrations, public APIs, and much more.
- **Turn regulation into product.** Payment rules change, and they change our architecture. You'll work with engineering, compliance, and our banking and fintech partners to translate new requirements into product decisions with clear tradeoffs and timelines.
- **Manage partner-facing product work.** Every day we work with banks and financial partners. You'll scope integrations, negotiate capability gaps, and hold partners to their commitments.
- **Set the product bar.** Establish how we write specs, run launches, communicate roadmap, and make decisions. You'll define what shipping excellent software looks like.

## **What We're Looking For**

### **Required**

- **6+ years in product**, including senior or lead ownership of a technical product with real users. Titles vary; what matters is that you've been the person accountable.
- **Domain expertise in at least one of our core areas:**

  - Cross-border payments, FX, and international money movement
  - Domestic payment rails and scheme integrations (ACH, RTP, SEPA, SPEI, PIX, UPI, InstaPay/PESONet, or equivalents)
  - Crypto and stablecoin infrastructure, and on/off-ramps
  - Treasury, liquidity management, and ledgering
  - Identity, fraud prevention, and compliance
- **Experience shipping API-first or developer-facing products** to technical buyers.
- **Comfort in regulated environments.** You've shipped alongside compliance and legal constraints and treated them as design inputs rather than obstacles.
- **Technical expertise.** You don't need to be a former engineer, but you need to be able to effectively lead a meeting full of engineers.
- **Startup range.** You've worked somewhere small and fast, and you're comfortable when the process you need doesn't exist yet.
- **Strong writing.** Specs, decision memos, launch notes. Much of this job is written.
- **Empathy and strong character.** We're building a collaborative, kind, high-achieving culture.

### **Preferred**

- Background at a payments platform, PSP, money transmitter, or bank technology provider
- Experience taking a product from early design partners through repeatable go-to-market
- Experience hiring or building out a product function
- Fluency with AI-assisted workflows and modern product and engineering tooling

## **Why Latitude?**

**Rare Opportunity:** We're backed by top investors (including NEA and Lightspeed Faction), finding significant traction, and taking on a massive market opportunity in international payments. First Product hires at companies like this are rare, and the leverage is real — you'll be shaping what gets built, not administering someone else's roadmap.

**Real Ownership:** You'll own the product function from day one, with direct access to the founders and no layer between you and the decisions.

**Impact:** You'll be building critical infrastructure that makes global payments faster and more accessible for businesses and individuals worldwide.

**Strong Team:** Join a high-caliber team that combines deep fintech expertise with startup execution experience. Our team has worked on the stuff that matters at companies like Stripe, Coinbase, Uber, and Facebook.

## **Compensation**

The base salary range for this role is $175,000 - up to $240,000, *commensurate with experience*, plus meaningful early-stage equity.

## **Benefits**

At Latitude, we believe success starts with our people — healthy, inspired, and empowered to thrive both in and outside of work.

We offer:

- Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance with generous company contributions
- Meaningful early-stage equity and a 401(k)
- Unlimited PTO
- 10 paid federal holidays
- Flexible remote work within the United States
 

Latitude is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

title: Account Manager (Marketing Agency)
description:
**TL;DR:** We're looking for a sharp Account Manager for a fast-growing US-based marketing agency specialising in multi-location businesses. You'll own client relationships, translate campaign performance into actionable insights, and drive growth by expanding services and budgets. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on client interaction, understands digital marketing fundamentals, and can independently manage complex accounts with hundreds of locations under a single umbrella.

**Role Type:** Full-time role (40 hours per week), Fully-remote, 6:30pm - 3:30am (IST)
