* Discovery call - to understand your motivations
* Technical task & discussion - to evaluate your key skills for this role.
* Final interview with client

title: Credentialing Manager
description:
**About This Role**

We're looking for a Credentialing Manager to join our credentialing team and help keep our dietitian network's enrollment pipeline moving. This is a hands-on, manager role focused on leading contractors and vendors, executing credentialing and enrollment work accurately and efficiently across a portfolio of payers.

This engagement starts as a contract role, with strong potential to convert to full-time based on performance and business need. It's a great fit for someone who wants to prove themselves quickly, take ownership of real workflows from day one, and grow into a larger role as the credentialing function scales.

You'll report to the Head of Provider Operations.

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Execute provider enrollment and credentialing applications across a defined set of payers — CAQH ProView, primary source verification, payer portal submissions, and follow-up.
- Track application status and turnaround times, flagging delays or missing documentation before they become bottlenecks.
- Maintain clean, accurate tracking in spreadsheets/dashboards — status logs, SLA trackers, denial/resubmission tracking — and keep data current and error-free.
- Troubleshoot issues as they come up — missing NPI data, license discrepancies, payer portal quirks, rejected applications — and drive them to resolution rather than just flagging them.
- Use AI tools to speed up repetitive or research-heavy work (e.g., drafting follow-up communications, summarizing payer requirements, organizing data) where it makes sense.
- Partner with the credentialing and RCM teams to make sure enrollment status is understood downstream and doesn't hold up billing or provider go-live.

**Your Skills & Experience**

Required

- Hands-on experience with provider credentialing and enrollment — you've actually done the work: CAQH, payer portals, license verification, application submission and tracking.
- Solid Excel/spreadsheet skills — comfortable with formulas, filtering, pivot tables, and keeping large trackers clean and accurate. You don't need to be an analyst, but you should be comfortable with data.
- An owner's mindset — you don't wait to be told what to do. You spot problems, dig into why something broke, and drive it to resolution on your own. That includes drafting or improving SOPs as you go, troubleshooting issues directly, and picking up the phone to call a payer when that's the fastest way to unblock something. Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where process is still being built.
- Strong attention to detail — credentialing errors are costly, so accuracy and thoroughness matter.

**Preferred**

- Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up day-to-day work — but a strong interest in learning to use them well is also welcome if you don't have direct experience yet.
- Experience credentialing telehealth providers — particularly dietitians, therapists, or other non-physician specialties.
- Familiarity with major commercial and government payer portals (Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, UHC, Humana, Medicare/Medicaid).
- Background at a high-growth startup or digital health company.

title: Customer Experience - build with AI
description:
**Join an early-stage startup.**  
**Accelerate economic opportunity.**

Join us as a Customer Experience hire helping shape the future of AI-powered support at Kovo. This multi-faceted role combines hands-on customer support with operational thinking and continuous improvement of the systems that power customer experience at scale.

This role is a good fit if:

- You've spent time in consumer fintech, lending, or credit. You know what a dispute, a chargeback, or a credit reporting question looks like from the customer's side, and you're comfortable working inside regulatory constraints
- You want to improve the workflows, automation, and support infrastructure, not just work inside them.
- You take ownership of complex customer issues and stay on them until they're actually resolved.
- You're already experimenting with AI tools and want to use them to scale support quality, not just volume.

## **About us**

- Kovo is expanding access to financial tools for people historically excluded from the traditional credit system. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity for economic independence, and we’re **building products that help people establish financial identity and unlock opportunity**.
- Over the past three years, Kovo has **grown revenue 20x** while maintaining exceptional capital efficiency. We **rank above the 99th percentile in revenue-per-employee benchmarks**, reflecting the leverage of a small, high-performing team.
- The team combines the ambition of a venture-scale company with the discipline of a profitable business. We **reached positive free cash flow early in our lifecycle**, allowing us to grow with less dilution and focus on building for the long term.
- Kovo is backed by Inspired Capital and Homebrew, and built by alumni from Plaid, Experian, Equifax, TransUnion, Innovis, Chime, Honey, Possible, Monzo, OppFi, Splash, Mercury, Twilio, and more. We're looking for exceptional people to **help us scale the company another 20x and beyond**.

## **Why you might be excited about us**

- Direct impact on millions of people’s ability to access credit
- High ownership with minimal bureaucracy
- Speed, learning, and impact are core values

## **Why you might not be excited about us**

- Roles and priorities evolve quickly
- Some systems and processes are still being built
- **The pace of execution and career growth is intense** (not optimized for work-life balance)

## **About the role**

Customer experience at Kovo is evolving quickly. AI and automation already handle many routine questions, and your impact in this role will come from improving those systems, identifying operational gaps, and helping expand what automation can reliably handle over time.

The goal is to handle customer inquiries as efficiently as possible while maintaining high quality and customer satisfaction. Efficiency increasingly comes from thoughtful operational design, effective use of AI and automation, and reducing the need for manual intervention over time.

You’ll help shape the foundation of AI-powered customer experience at Kovo by improving workflows, identifying patterns in customer conversations, and scaling support intelligently as the company grows.

Handling tickets manually is still a core part of the role. You’ll dive deep into complex or high-stakes issues when human judgment and empathy matter most.

## **What you’ll do**

Build and iterate on AI CX systems

- Review AI agent performance and real customer interactions to ensure automation handles more cases efficiently while maintaining high quality and customer satisfaction
- Identify patterns across conversations and use them to improve agents, workflows, and self-serve experiences
- Build, refine, and actively manage AI-driven support logic
- Proactively expand automation into new areas to reduce manual work and increase system coverage

Go deep when human judgment matters (when AI is unable to resolve issues)

- Support customers on complex, sensitive, or edge-case issues that require manual investigation
- Handle escalations, regulatory complaints, and high-stakes scenarios with care and ownership
- Follow issues through until there is a real resolution

Handling tickets is part of the job. Building systems that reduce the need for them is the goal.

## **About you**

Mindset

- You have an attitude of "I will do whatever it takes to solve a problem"
- Comfortable in a high-intensity role with significant ownership and accountability. Willing to move quickly, prioritize well, and follow through under tight timelines
- You write the playbook as often as you use it. When a customer situation has no rule yet, you draft one, get it reviewed, and ship it. Gaps in policy are yours to close, not escalate.
- Energized by building systems that expand financial access for millions of underserved individuals
- Thrive in a high-intensity remote work environment (you want more than a normal 8-5 job)

Skills and approach

- Strong quantitative/systems thinker who looks for patterns and root causes, not just individual cases
- Motivated to use AI, automation, and data tools to push the boundaries of what a single individual can accomplish
- Self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, handles shifting priorities fluidly, and works effectively across product, engineering, and operations
- Willing to dive deep into complex customer problems and follow them through to resolution

Experience

- 4+ years in consumer fintech, lending, or credit. Early stage startup experience required.
- Hands-on experience with regulated customer interactions such as disputes, complaints, or compliance-reviewed communications
- SQL for pulling data and spotting trends is a strong plus

title: Product Manager, Agent Platform
description:
### **Meet Siena**

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

### **The team**

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

### The Role

Siena runs customer experience for consumer brands through a connected multi-agent stack. As Product Manager, Core Agent Platform, you'll own the platform those agents run on, from its current capabilities to where it goes next. You'll own how we measure, test and improve agent performance, and how customers see it. You'll work directly with engineering, deployment and customers, and you'll be expected to build as well as specify.

### What You'll Do

- Own the core agent platform end to end, including the roadmap and the day-to-day product decisions.
- Build and ship the evaluation, testing and monitoring systems that make agent performance measurably better over time.
- Design and run structured experiments and A/B tests across agent workflows.
- Give customers clear visibility into how their agents are performing.
- Prototype your own ideas with coding agents, and ship them where you can, rather than waiting on a hand-off.
- Work with customers and our deployment team to understand what's working in the field and turn it into product.

### Who You Are

**The Bar:** *If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.*

- 3+ years as a PM in CX, ecommerce, helpdesk or AI automation.
- Technical fluency: you can explain how webhooks, OAuth and integrations work and have made product decisions around them.
- AI-native builder: you use tools like Claude, Cursor or v0 daily and have prototyped your own product ideas with them.

**Strong Signal:** *Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.*

- You've run structured experiments or A/B tests and can say what the data did and didn't tell you.
- You've built dashboards or visibility features people actually relied on.
- You're confident with customers: you've sat in on calls, run demos, and know what end users really complain about.
- You act like the CEO of your product area: strong opinions, and a habit of building and talking to customers without being asked.

**Nice to Have:** *Bonus, not required.*

- Engineering background, or you've shipped production code yourself.

### Not a Fit If:

- You wait to be told what to build.
- You want a narrowly scoped PM seat with a fixed roadmap handed to you.
- You're not comfortable being customer-facing or getting on a call to demo your own work.
- You'd rather stay behind the product than own the messy, ambiguous parts.
- You need a designer or engineer to turn your product vision into something people can click.

### **Why Siena?**

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

### **Our values**

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

### **Our approach to AI**

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

### **How we hire**

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at [talent@siena.cx](mailto:talent@siena.cx).

Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Mechanical Design for Augmented Reality Gasmask Project
description:
Summary
We are seeking a mechanical designer to develop a compact mechanical integration solution for an augmented reality (AR) system installed on an Avon FM50 gas mask.

The work will involve developing mounting, enclosure, and component-placement concepts for electronic and optical hardware located both inside and outside the mask. The design must account for the FM50’s limited available space while minimizing obstruction to the wearer’s field of view and avoiding interference with normal mask operation.

Key considerations include secure component mounting, cable and flex routing, adjustability of the AR display relative to the user’s eye, protection of sensitive electronics and interconnects, serviceability, and minimizing protrusions or snag points.

The designer will work from existing electronic assemblies, CAD models, dimensional constraints, and system requirements to develop a practical prototype-ready mechanical solution. Experience with wearable electronics, head-mounted displays, ruggedized equipment, or respirator/gas-mask integration is preferred.

title: Account Executive
description:
### About Pave
Pave is redefining how lenders understand repayment risk. We build cashflow-based credit scores that go beyond traditional credit reports and offer more precise, near-term predictions of financial behavior. Our infrastructure powers a new generation of lending products across consumer and SMB finance.
We’re a 13-person team with strong traction and growing fast. We’ve landed customers across fintech, lending, and banking, and we’re now ready to build a more consistent, repeatable go-to-market motion. We’re hiring an Account Executive to work closely with our founders and other team members to help shape and scale our sales process.

### What You'll Focus On

**Sales Execution**
Engage warm leads and inbound interest to start evaluations
Help manage the full sales process from initial call through close
Guide prospects through evaluations and business case reviews
Navigate pricing conversations, contracts, and redlines
Involve and update decision-makers throughout the process
**Deal Acceleration & Revenue Activation**
Collaborate with customers to set clear timelines and expectations
Build implementation and usage milestones into contracts
Help push for higher committed monthly minimums and earlier usage
Ensure post-signature setup is complete (e.g., correct AP contacts) to support on-time payment
**Expansion & Relationship Development**
Identify opportunities to upsell new products or expand usage
Support renewals and expansion conversations with current customers

title: Head of Client Experience
description:
**The Opportunity**

Project Expedition is looking for a hands-on, AI-forward Head of Client Experience to help us scale an organization already known for exceptional service, without losing the personal touch our clients, travel advisors, partners, and travelers expect.

This is not a strategy-only CX leadership role. We are looking for someone who leads from the front: someone who will learn the product deeply, understand our workflows, spend time in the queue, handle tickets when needed, take ownership of escalations, engage directly with customers, and coach the team from firsthand experience.

Our belief is simple: in travel, service cannot feel automated. Travel is emotional, time-sensitive, and often high-stakes. The right leader will know how to use AI to make our team faster, smarter, more consistent, and more proactive, while preserving the judgment, empathy, and human care that define an exceptional client experience.

You will own the day-to-day performance of the Client Experience team, the systems that support it, and the service philosophy behind it. Your mandate is to turn support into a measurable competitive advantage through operational excellence, product mastery, thoughtful AI adoption, and hands-on leadership.

 

**What You’ll Own**

You will lead our Client Experience function across email, chat, and phone, managing team leads and support specialists while staying close enough to the work to understand what is really happening on the front lines.

You will be expected to:

- Lead, coach, and develop team leads and support specialists across email, chat, and phone.
- Spend regular time in the ticket queue and reporting to understand customer pain points, product gaps, process friction, and team execution.
- Personally handle escalations, difficult customer situations, VIP/advisor issues, and time-sensitive travel problems when needed.
- Learn and master the Project Expedition product, booking flows, supplier/operator workflows, advisor needs, internal tools, and customer journey.
- Build a culture where leaders model the standard, not just measure it.
- Own key operating metrics, including CSAT, SLEs, QA scores and other service-quality indicators.
- Establish and improve QA programs, calibration routines, coaching cadences, SOPs, escalation paths, and training materials.
- Improve workforce planning, scheduling, coverage models, training ramps, and peak-season readiness.
- Use data to identify the root causes of customer friction and turn those insights into clear operational, product, or tooling improvements.
- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Supplier teams to improve support tooling, internal workflows, and the customer experience.
- Bring clear recommendations to leadership on what is working, what is broken, what needs investment, and where we can scale more effectively.

**AI + Human Touch**

We are not looking for someone who wants to “automate customer service” at the expense of quality. We are looking for someone who understands how to combine AI, automation, better systems, and human judgment to deliver a higher level of service than either people or technology could deliver alone.

You should be excited to explore and implement practical AI use cases such as:

- AI-assisted ticket triage, routing, prioritization, and summarization.
- Agent-assist tools that help the team respond faster while preserving warmth, accuracy, and brand voice.
- Better knowledge management and internal search so the team can answer confidently, accurately, and consistently.
- QA support, trend detection, sentiment analysis, and coaching insights.
- Automation of repetitive administrative work so humans can focus on complex, emotional, urgent, or high-value interactions.
- Proactive alerts and workflows for time-sensitive travel issues, supplier changes, cancellations, itinerary questions, and customer risk signals.

You should also know where **not** to automate. The right person will understand that travel support often requires nuance: last-minute changes, disappointed customers, special requests, refunds, safety concerns, travel advisor relationships, and high-stakes moments where empathy and judgment matter.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Have Experience**

- 6–10+ years in Customer Support, Client Experience, Customer Success, Travel Operations, or a similar customer-facing function.
- 3+ years managing managers, team leads, or a meaningful support/client experience organization.
- Proven experience scaling support or service operations in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment such as travel, hospitality, marketplace, e-commerce, logistics, fintech, or similar.
- A true lead-from-the-front mentality. You are comfortable jumping into tickets, calls, escalations, workflows, and customer issues to understand the work and set the standard.
- Strong product curiosity. You are the type of leader who wants to learn the product deeply enough to diagnose issues, coach effectively, improve workflows, and represent the customer’s voice internally.
- Practical AI and technology fluency. You have used, implemented, or meaningfully experimented with AI, automation, support tooling, knowledge-based systems, or agent-assist workflows to improve service quality and efficiency.
- Strong analytical ability. You are comfortable with dashboards, metrics, cohorts, QA data, and operational reporting, and you know how to turn data into action.
- Excellent written communication, tone, judgment, and customer empathy.
- Experience building systems: SOPs, playbooks, macros, QA frameworks, escalation paths, onboarding programs, training programs, and performance standards.
- Ability to balance policy, precedent, customer trust, and business judgment.

**Strongly Preferred**

- Travel, hospitality, marketplace, tour/operator, OTA, or time-sensitive operations experience.
- Experience supporting travel advisors, B2B partners, suppliers, or high-expectation customers.
- Experience with international customers, multi-time-zone teams, or 24/7 coverage models.
- Experience partnering with Product/Engineering on tooling, automation, AI-assist, self-service, or analytics improvements.
- Experience improving both efficiency and service quality without making the customer experience feel robotic.

**You’ll Thrive Here If You…**

- Believe exceptional service can be a true competitive advantage.
- Are as comfortable in a dashboard as you are in a customer escalation.
- Do not view frontline work as beneath leadership.
- Like getting into the weeds, finding the pattern, fixing the system, and coaching the team through the change.
- Have strong opinions on how AI should improve customer experience, but equally strong judgment about where human empathy needs to remain central.
- Can create clarity in messy, fast-moving, operationally complex environments.
- Hold a high bar for tone, ownership, speed, accuracy, and follow-through.
- Care deeply about travel and understand that when something goes wrong on a trip, the customer experience becomes personal very quickly.

**This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If…**

- You want a purely strategic leadership role and do not want to handle tickets, escalations, or frontline workflows.
- You prefer managing through reports only and do not want to learn the product deeply.
- You think AI should replace human service rather than strengthen it.
- You are uncomfortable with ambiguity, operational detail, or fast-changing priorities.
- You have led teams before but have not built systems, coached quality, owned metrics, or improved day-to-day execution.
- You are not energized by customer-facing problem solving.

**Benefits**

- Annual company bonus, up to $3,000 based on company targets and deferred eligibility.

- 15 days of leave (increases to 20 days at 2 years tenure)
- Company Healthcare Plan (Company contribution $10,500 with 2 completely covered plans)
- 401K company plan
- Annual work from home budget $500
- Annual training budget of $250
- TSA Precheck
- Annual Project Expedition tour credits of $750
- Employee discounts on thousands of tours and activities

**Additional Information**

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States. Currently, we are unable to hire employees residing in New York or California.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
About Xeliport

Xeliport is building the AI-native operating system for cross-border expansion. We help consumer brands launch and scale in new countries by bringing incorporation, compliance, logistics, warehousing, payments, and marketplace operations into a single platform.

We're an early-stage startup building from zero, and product here isn't a support function, it's core to whether Xeliport works at all.

The Opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated Technical Product Manager. This is a founding-team role in every practical sense: you'll work directly with the founders and our founding engineer to decide what gets built next and why, across our six operational layers (Compliance, Shipping, 3PL & Warehouse, Marketplace, Retail & B2B, Forex & Banking).

We're looking for someone junior in years but not in ambition: hungry to learn the entire business fast, and genuinely aiming to run product at Xeliport one day. If you do this well, there's a real path from this seat to Head of Product to CPO as we scale, not a hypothetical one.

We also want our product and engineering craft to be as tight and considered as the best in the world runs theirs, think Shopify's bar for product quality and internal tooling, not "startup MVP good enough." You'll be one of the people who sets that bar.

What You'll Do

- Own specs end-to-end: talk to operators, brands, and the founders to figure out what actually needs to get built, then write it down clearly enough that engineering can just build it.
- Prioritize ruthlessly across Compliance, Shipping, 3PL & Warehouse, Marketplace, Retail & B2B, and Forex & Banking, we have far more to build than time to build it.
- Get into the data. Query our database directly, read the schema, understand what's actually happening in production before making a call.
- Sit close enough to engineering to review PRs, understand architecture tradeoffs, and push back on shortcuts that hurt product quality.
- Talk to real operators and brands to find out what's broken before it shows up as a support ticket.
- Build the muscle to eventually own the roadmap and product strategy outright.

What We're Looking For

- 0-2 years of experience, early in your career, but you've shipped something (a product, a side project, a feature) that shows you think in systems, not just tasks.
- Technical enough to read code and a data model and have real opinions about them. You don't need to ship production code, but you should be comfortable in a codebase.
- Obsessed with product craft: you can point to a product whose quality you admire and explain exactly why it works.
- Hungry and ambitious: you're looking for a launchpad to run product, not a two-year resume line.
- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, we're writing it as we go.

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Next.js, Supabase, or Sanity, or the willingness to get hands-on with our stack fast.
- Experience with, or obsessive interest in, high-craft consumer or B2B SaaS products (Shopify-caliber design and engineering bar).
- Some understanding of cross-border trade, logistics, or compliance. We can teach this, but curiosity about it is a plus.

What We Offer

Direct access to the founders, real ownership over product decisions from day one, meaningful ESOPs, and a genuine track to CPO if you earn it.

How to Apply

To apply, fill out this form: https://forms.gle/BZ8stuGRYKgRe3E96

You’ll decide what we create, who it’s for, where it should live and how it can support our wider marketing and commercial goals.

We’re looking for an exceptional communicator who understands what makes B2B content perform. You’ll connect content to specific objectives, from building awareness and establishing thought leadership to generating demand, nurturing prospects and supporting sales.

Customer storytelling will be a major part of the role. You’ll work across the business to uncover the strongest customer stories, results and insights, turning them into compelling case studies and campaigns that demonstrate the impact of WIT and give our sales team powerful proof points.
You’ll be as comfortable developing a report or customer story as writing a sharp LinkedIn post, landing page or email campaign. Strong writing is essential, but so is editorial judgment: knowing what’s worth saying, finding the interesting angle and adapting an idea to the audience, channel and moment.

You’ll also play an important role in shaping WIT’s voice as our brand evolves, bringing personality, humor and consistency to how we communicate and helping develop a distinctive tone of voice and content style.

This is a highly autonomous role. We’re looking for someone who brings ideas, not just executes briefs. Someone who can take ownership of the content function, work closely with subject-matter experts across the business and continually identify new formats, channels and opportunities to grow our audience and commercial impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and continuously develop WIT’s content strategy, roadmap and editorial calendar
* Translate company, marketing and sales priorities into clear content plans and campaigns
* Identify content opportunities based on audience needs, industry trends, customer insights and relevant cultural moments
* Own customer storytelling, proactively identifying strong stories and turning customer results into case studies, campaigns, sales assets and content across multiple channels
* Create and manage content across formats, including:
* Social content
* CEO and leadership team branding and thought leadership
* Blogs and articles
* Customer stories and case studies
* Reports, guides and whitepapers
* Landing pages and website copy
* Email campaigns & Newsletters
* Video scripts and multimedia content
* Develop content across the buyer journey, from awareness and demand generation through to nurture, conversion and sales enablement
* Own and evolve WIT’s tone of voice, helping establish a distinctive and consistent brand style
* Work with internal subject-matter experts to uncover ideas, perspectives and insights and turn them into compelling content
* Partner closely with our internal creative team to develop strong creative concepts and bring content and campaigns to life
* Build and manage email content and campaigns within HubSpot
* Maximize the value of strong content by intelligently repurposing ideas and assets across channels and formats
* Track content performance and use insights to improve topics, formats, distribution and future strategy
* Identify and test new content formats, channels and opportunities for audience, engagement and pipeline growth


**What We’re Looking For**

* 3-5 years’ experience creating high-quality B2B and/or B2C content across multiple channels and formats
* Exceptional writing, editing and communication skills, with a strong sense of tone and storytelling
* A commercial mindset and experience using content to support demand generation, lead generation and sales
* Passion, energy, creativity and resourcefulness, with the ability to work autonomously and bring ideas to the table
* Strong editorial judgment and an understanding of what makes content perform across different audiences and channels
* Experience working with internal experts and customers to uncover and develop compelling stories
* A good eye for design and experience partnering with creative teams to bring ideas to life
* Experience with CRM/email platforms such as HubSpot and paid social is a plus
* Experience working with media partners and executing content or media partnerships is a plus
* AI-literate, using AI to work faster and smarter, while bringing the writing experience and editorial judgment to know when, where and how to use it.
* What You’ll Get
* Competitive salary, performance-based bonuses and long-term incentives
* Comprehensive company-paid medical, dental and vision benefits
* Fully remote working
* Flexible PTO with unlimited vacation days and paid holidays
* Company 401(k) plan
* Generous budget for work-related equipment, including laptop and monitor
* Access to exclusive sporting events and industry networking opportunities
* Salary range of $55,000–$70,000 USD

**About WIT**

WIT is a leading gamified marketing platform helping brands create interactive experiences that drive engagement and capture valuable first-party data that brands need to drive revenue.

Our platform features 40+ proven game formats, backed by end-to-end strategic and creative support. More than 200 organizations trust WIT, including Taco Bell, 7 Brew and Dunkin’, alongside teams and leagues across the NFL, NHL, NBA, WNBA, MLB, MLS, NWSL and NCAA.

WIT has been recognized as a Sports Business Journal Best Place to Work in Sports, a Front Office Sports Best Employer in Sports and an Inc. 5000 honoree, ranking No. 597 among the fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

description:
## Objective

Lead AI adoption across the client teams — from first assessment, through workshops and hands-on enablement, to self-sufficient daily AI use, with adoption reported as measured business impact.

## About the project

Neurons Lab delivers AI education and adoption programs for enterprise clients, mainly in financial services (banking, insurance, and capital markets). This role leads those programs inside the customer's own teams — taking each new client from first assessment, through workshops and hands-on enablement, to confident daily AI use.

The AI Adoption Manager is the face of the program with the client. Embedded in the customer's business teams, the role runs the full education and adoption cycle and carries the customer success side of the engagement: building the relationship, keeping adoption healthy, reporting outcomes to client stakeholders, and surfacing where the account can grow. Because most clients operate in regulated financial-services environments, every program runs inside the client's data-governance, compliance, and responsible-AI guardrails.

## KPIs

- Post-workshop AI adoption per team (primary KPI)
- Measured business impact per team — time saved, cycle-time, or effort reduced against a baseline captured before enablement
- Number of active champions identified, developed, and made visible to client leadership
- Cadence adherence — recurring sessions held on rhythm, response times measured in hours, not days
- Teams released as self-sufficient; qualified opportunities passed to the technical tracks
- Engagement growth — follow-up workshops, recurring enablement, new scopes originating from business team engagement

## Areas of responsibility

- **Assess and prioritize** — map each team's workflows and current AI usage, turn their real pain points into a prioritized enablement plan, and rule out use cases where the payoff isn't real
- **Deliver enablement end to end** — design and run workshops (personally and with external trainers) that target each team's own use cases and produce walk-away skills, prompts, and tools they use the next day
- **Build reusable assets** — maintain a shared library of approved prompts, skills, and templates teams can reuse without you in the room
- **Grow champions and adoption** — develop champions inside each team, surface and remove adoption blockers, and hold a steady cadence with the business teams
- **Keep it inside the guardrails** — align every plan with the client's data-governance, acceptable-use, and responsible-AI policies, working with IT, security, and legal
- **Measure and report value** — baseline each team, track adoption against targets, and report progress, risks, and ROI to client sponsors
- **Drive to self-sufficiency and expansion** — hand teams over once they sustain AI use on their own, pass engineering-grade work to the technical track, and surface new scopes for the account

## Skills

- Workshop and training design and delivery, with strong live facilitation
- Change management and adoption, grounded in instructional design and adult learning
- Practical, daily AI fluency (Claude, ChatGPT, agentic workflows, prompt engineering) and the ability to rebuild an expert's workflow as an AI-assisted one for non-technical users
- Customer success — trusted client relationships, healthy adoption, and usage turned into demonstrated value
- Strategic program design and clear executive, cross-functional communication, with comfort in ambiguity

## Knowledge

- Modern AI tools, agentic workflows, and prompt engineering, applied practically and daily
- Change management and adoption psychology — what makes change stick from within
- AI governance and responsible-use frameworks — data classification, acceptable-use, and responsible-AI policy, enough to keep enablement inside client guardrails
- Enablement/training business or consulting background

## Experience

- 5+ years in change management, enablement, digital-transformation consulting, or enterprise software rollout, including at least one full-cycle deployment
- Top-tier management-consulting experience (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain) **is a strong plus**
- Customer success experience strongly desired — owning client relationships, adoption health, and value realization
- Hands-on experience driving technology or process adoption inside organizations
- Track record designing and delivering workshops/training sessions personally
- Experience running assessments, feedback sessions, and executive updates
- Fluent English required

## What We Offer

- **Competitive compensation** — a monthly base plus expansion revenue upside
- **Fully remote** — outcomes over attendance
- **Unlimited PTO**
- **Full-time contractor** engagement with a fast-growing AI consultancy at the forefront of enterprise transformation

description:
The Field Engineer will be DigiStor's primary customer-facing technical resource supporting two US Sales Representatives.

The role combines technical pre-sales, solution design, product demonstrations, platform qualification, and field support. You will help customers select, evaluate, integrate, and deploy DigiStor secure-storage solutions within Dell Technologies and HP/HPE client, workstation, server, and edge platforms.

You will work closely with customers, channel partners, OEM contacts, Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Testing, and Technical Support. Your purpose will be to remove technical barriers, reduce risk, and help convert qualified opportunities into successful deployments.

About DigiStor

DigiStor develops secure data-at-rest solutions for enterprise, government, defence, and other security-conscious organisations. Our portfolio includes secure and self-encrypting SSDs, removable NVMe storage solutions, and technologies designed for demanding client, workstation, server, and edge environments.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Pre-Sales

Partner with two US Sales Representatives throughout the customer engagement lifecycle.
Lead technical discovery sessions to understand the customer's platform, workload, security, performance, environmental, and compliance requirements.
Recommend the most appropriate DigiStor product, capacity, form factor, interface, and security configuration.
Translate complex storage and security concepts into clear business and operational benefits.
Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, workshops, and architecture discussions.
Support customer responses, proposals, RFIs, RFPs, technical questionnaires, and tender submissions.
Help Sales identify technical risks, dependencies, and qualification requirements early in the opportunity.
Platform and Solution Engineering

Advise customers on the integration of DigiStor solutions into Dell and HP/HPE servers, workstations, desktops, laptops, and edge platforms.
Assess compatibility across NVMe, SATA, PCIe, BIOS/UEFI, operating systems, firmware, physical form factors, power, cooling, and thermal requirements.
Support storage technologies and form factors including M.2, U.2, U.3, E1.S, SATA, and removable NVMe solutions.
Develop recommended configurations, compatibility guidance, bills of material, and solution documentation.
Work with DigiStor Engineering and Testing teams to coordinate platform validation and resolve compatibility questions.
Evaluations and Proofs of Concept

Define and manage customer evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, and product qualification plans.
Establish clear technical success criteria with customers and Sales.
Assist with product installation, configuration, testing, benchmarking, and results interpretation.
Capture diagnostic information, reproduce reported issues where possible, and coordinate escalation to the appropriate Engineering or Support team.
Maintain ownership and clear customer communication through technical resolution and handover.
Secure-Storage Expertis

Explain secure-storage technologies including hardware encryption, self-encrypting drives, TCG Opal, pre-boot authentication, key management, and secure erase.
Help customers understand relevant certification and compliance requirements, including FIPS, Common Criteria, TAA, NATO, and regional security programs.
Ensure that technical claims and recommendations accurately reflect product capabilities and certification status.
Support customers operating in regulated, government, defense, financial-services, healthcare, and critical-infrastructure environments.
Partner and Field Enablement

Develop strong technical relationships with customers, distributors, resellers, integrators, and OEM stakeholders across the US. (EMEA)
Deliver technical training and enablement sessions for channel and sales partners.
Create and maintain technical guides, configuration notes, FAQs, reference architectures, and field playbooks.
Bring structured customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and emerging requirements back to DigiStor's Product and Engineering teams.
Represent DigiStor at customer meetings, partner events, industry events, and technical briefings.
Required Experience and Knowledge

Proven experience as a Field Engineer, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, Field Applications Engineer, or Technical Pre-Sales Engineer.
Practical understanding of enterprise storage, SSDs, NVMe, SATA, PCIe, firmware, BIOS/UEFI, and storage-device integration.
Experience supporting both Windows and Linux environments.
Ability to diagnose hardware, firmware, operating-system, performance, and compatibility issues.
Experience planning and delivering customer evaluations or proofs of concept.
Ability to communicate effectively with infrastructure architects, security teams, IT operations, procurement teams, partners, and senior decision-makers.
Strong written and spoken communication.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly across the US.
Ability to work independently within a geographically distributed organization.
Desirable Experience

Knowledge of self-encrypting drives, TCG Opal, AES-256 encryption, pre-boot authentication, and data-at-rest security.
Strong working knowledge of Dell Technologies and HP/HPE client, workstation, and server platforms.
Familiarity with FIPS 140-2/140-3, Common Criteria, CSfC, TAA, NATO, UK, or European security requirements.
Experience with Dell OEM, HP/HPE, or other major hardware-manufacturer ecosystems.
Experience with storage-testing and diagnostic tools such as NVMe CLI, SMART utilities, fio, Iometer, and operating-system hardware tools.
Experience supporting government, defense, financial-services, healthcare, industrial, or other regulated customers.
Knowledge of removable storage, rugged systems, edge computing, or industrial computing environments.
Measures of Success

Success in this position will be demonstrated through:

Effective technical coverage of US sales opportunities.
Faster and more accurate qualification of customer requirements.
Successful customer evaluations and proofs of concept.
Reduced technical risk and fewer late-stage compatibility issues.
Strong customer, partner, and Sales satisfaction.
Clear and timely resolution or escalation of field issues.
Improved technical enablement and knowledge across the US partner network.
High-quality field feedback that contributes to DigiStor's product and technology roadmap.
Core Competencies

Customer focus: Builds trust and remains accountable throughout the technical engagement.
Technical depth: Understands systems, storage, security, and platform integration at a practical level.
Commercial awareness: Connects technical recommendations to customer value and sales outcomes.
Problem-solving: Approaches complex technical issues logically and remains effective under pressure.
Communication: Explains technical subjects clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
Ownership: Drives activities through to completion and communicates progress proactively.
Collaboration: Works effectively across Sales, Engineering, Product, Testing, Support, and external partners.
Adaptability: Learns new technologies quickly and remains current with changing platforms and standards.
We currently operate in the following states only: California, Washington, Oregon, Texas, Kansas, South Carolina. At this time, we will only hire people who live in or will relocate to those states. We have a strong preference for Austin, Texas.

We are currently not accepting unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or staffing firms.

DigiStor is committed to building an inclusive working environment. Employment decisions are based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications.[](https://)

title: Senior Product Designer, Foundations
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. [Check out our ratings on G2](https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews).

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

**Design at Tremendous**

We design experiences that make complex systems feel straightforward and intuitive by taking our time to get things right. We favor depth and scale over speed, while raising the bar for quality so our product stays ahead of the competition. We’re a place for designers who care about doing things well.

**About the role**

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to raise the craft of the product across Tremendous.

You'll report to our Director of Product Design and work horizontally. Craft projects across the dashboard and the recipient experience: navigation, information architecture, the design system, motion. You'll also take small projects from pods that have no designer. Those teams have little user experience work of their own, which is why this is a Foundations role.

**What you'll do**

- **Raise the craft of the product.** Dashboard and recipient experience. Navigation, information architecture, how things open and close, empty states. Motion, micro-interactions, and transitions are a big part of the job.
- **Own the design system, and raise it.** Set patterns other designers can follow with clear documentation. Close gaps that produce one-off UI. Push the quality of the system itself.
- **Set a vision for product foundations.** Where craft, UX, and UI should go so the product holds up next to Stripe or Brex. Make that vision concrete enough to build toward.
- **Cover work that has no designer.** Small projects from pods without an embedded designer.
- **Partner with an engineer.** You'll work with an engineer focused on shipping this craft work with you. Use AI to prototype, show how something should feel, and help engineering implement it.
- Designers at Tremendous own the copy in their designs.

**What you'll bring**

- 8+ years as a product designer, including experience working on B2B products. You can do the product thinking: edge cases, shipping work that has to hold up in a real product.
- High craft. Strong visual design, UI, and motion. Your portfolio shows it.
- You've owned and improved a design system.
- You've done information architecture and set a product vision or redesign. You can tell that story.
- Strong communication and storytelling, written and verbal.
- You use AI in your design work, including prototyping (v0, Claude, Cursor, or similar).

**What's cool about the role**

- **Ship work you’ll be proud of.**
- **Competitive pay and equity.** Base salary for this role: $200,000 - $265,000.
- **Real benefits.** 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
- **Fully remote.** Work from anywhere in the Americas.
- **Great culture.** Read more about how we work in our [public handbook](https://handbook.tremendous.com/).

title: People Operations Manager
description:

**About the role**

We're ~175 people across the US, Canada, the UK, Brazil, and elsewhere, and we're launching our first dedicated people function. You'll own people operations end to end, you'll be the person anyone at the company can go to when something is wrong, and you'll run our immigration program in conjunction with outside counsel.

**What you'll do**

- Own our HRIS and associated systems
- Administer benefits for US, Canadian, and international employees: open enrollment, carrier and broker escalations, HSA and FSA, COBRA, 401(k), and required annual notices.
- Own the employee handbook, HR wiki, and people policies. Write the ones we're missing.
- Own onboarding end to end: cohort logistics, new hire paperwork, and the first-90-days experience. Own offboarding, exit interviews, and severance logistics.
- Be the company's HR point of contact. Take reports, run investigations, and write up findings. Build the intake, trust, and escalation process that makes reporting feel obvious and low-risk.
- Run our biannual HR cycle — performance check-ins, compensation review, and the employee engagement survey — on schedule, and improve it each time.
- Handle off-cycle compensation changes, promotions, relocations, and international moves, and the comp implications that come with them.
- Partner with recruiting on international employment models (EOR, contractor)

**What we're looking for**

- You have excellent judgment in situations with no precedent, and you write down your reasoning.
- People trust you quickly, including people who don't know you yet. You hold confidences absolutely.
- You're proactive. You'd rather build the tracker than field the emergency.
- You're comfortable being senior and still doing the unglamorous work. This role includes open enrollment reminders and chasing I-9 signatures.

- 5+ years in people operations, HR, or a people partner role, including time at a company without a large HR team
- Experience independently running workplace investigations, including harassment matters, and writing defensible documentation
- Deep experience administering US benefits and leave; global benefits experience is a bonus
- Strong HRIS experience; Rippling preferred
- Direct, hands-on experience with employment-based immigration: H-1B, O-1, L-1, and PERM
- Experience running performance and compensation cycles for 100+ people

**What's cool about the role**

- You're the first. You'll define what the people function is here rather than inheriting someone else's version of it, with direct access to leadership and real latitude to decide how this works.
- **Competitive pay and equity.** Base salary for this role: $110k to $160k.
- **Real benefits.** 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
- **Fully remote.** Work from anywhere in the Americas.
- **Great culture.** Read more about how we work in our [public handbook](https://handbook.tremendous.com/).

title: General Application
description:
## About Chip

Chip is the first mass-market American robot. He just happens to be your car.

Chip is building a new category of vehicle. Most cars are engineered for highway
speeds and long-distance range. The reality is that 60% of daily trips are under
6 miles. Chip is built for those trips: fully electric, street-legal on roads up
to 35 mph, 100+ mile range, and made to fit the way people actually move through
their neighborhoods.

We're also launching Chip *Go!*, a remote-driving service that keeps your
vehicle moving when you're not inside it. Say the word and he'll go off to park
himself, run an errand, get cleaned, or come get you and the family. Rolling out
regionally.

We launched publicly in July 2026 and reservations are open nationally.

## The role

You read the other postings and none of them is you. Apply anyway.

We're small, we launched nationally in July 2026, and the org chart is still
being drawn. Every role we've posted is the first of its kind here, and so are
the ones we haven't written yet. A posting is us noticing a gap we already feel.
It's a slower instrument than someone telling us about a gap we haven't named,
which is what this is for.

So this isn't a placeholder posting that lands in a folder. It's the way in for
the person whose job we'd have to invent, or whose job we're about to post and
haven't. Tell us what you do, tell us what you'd own here, and be specific
enough that we can picture the first 90 days.

If you've read this far because a car with a face is the most interesting thing
you've seen in a while, that instinct is the right one. Chip only works if the
people building him think he's worth building.

We're headquartered in Miami, with people in Austin and Los Angeles. Remote
depends entirely on the work: the web and cloud side is genuinely remote-friendly,
and anything hands-on with vehicles is Miami. You'll interview with the C-suite,
because at this size everyone does.

## Where you'd fit

The areas where a great person would change what we can do this year. This is
where we're looking, not a list of open jobs.

- Vehicle and embedded software. Rust on the car, Linux services, cameras, and
  the real-time stack behind his face, his voice, and low-latency remote driving.
- Cloud and web. Go services, Postgres, and the Next.js surface people meet him
  on, from the configurator through reservations and the customer portal.
- Hardware, electrical, and manufacturing. Vehicle systems, wiring, suppliers,
  and the work of turning a small stable of prototypes into something we build
  repeatably.
- Vehicle operations. Keeping prototypes alive, on the road, and on trailers
  between cities, plus the events where most people meet Chip in person.
- Design. Industrial, product, and brand, including the hardest one, which is
  what a robot's face should do when nobody is talking to him.
- Marketing and content. Social, video, partnerships, and the story that makes
  a 35 mph car obviously the right answer for a 6 mile trip.
- Business. Finance, supply chain, customer support, and the operational work
  that decides whether any of the above is affordable.

If what you do isn't on this list, that's not a no. It means you have to make
the case, and we read those.

## What you'll need

- Something you've owned end to end. Not a task you were assigned, a thing that
  existed because you were there.
- Comfortable arriving before the function exists. No team under you at the
  start, no playbook, and the tools are whatever you bring or build.
- A clear answer to what you'd own here. We can't evaluate a general
  application against a job description, so specificity is the whole bar. "I do
  operations" tells us nothing. "Your Miami fleet has no maintenance schedule
  and I'd build one" tells us everything.
- Evidence we can look at. A repo, a reel, a shipped product, a spreadsheet, a
  car you built in a garage. The format doesn't matter.
- Direct, low-ego, fast.
- Based in Miami, Austin, or Los Angeles, or remote in the United States, with
  travel to Miami when the work touches the vehicles.

We are not expecting seniority for its own sake. If you're early in your career
and the evidence is real, send it. We've never regretted reading one of these.

## Bonus points

- Early-stage hardware companies.
- EVs, mobility, fleets, or powersports.
- Robotics or consumer electronics.
- Live events, field work, and things that have to work outdoors on a schedule.
- A side project that got out of hand.
- Genuine interest in transportation.

## What happens after you apply

- A person reads it. Not a keyword filter, and not eventually.
- A good application with no role attached gets kept and revisited when one
  opens. We'll say so if that's where yours lands, rather than leaving you
  guessing.

title: Data Architect – Data Engineering & Business Intelligence
description:

title: Product Engineer
description:
Product Engineer
Experience: 1–3 years
Location: Remote
Compensation: ₹10–12 LPA + ESOPs


**About The Date Crew
**

The Date Crew is building a human-first matchmaking platform for relationship-ready professionals.
We don’t believe finding a life partner should be reduced to swipes, filters or endless profiles. We combine human judgment, psychology, technology and data to make matchmaking more thoughtful, efficient and effective.

As we scale, some of our most interesting challenges sit at the intersection of technology, product, operations and human behaviour.
And that’s exactly where this role comes in.


**The Role
**

We are looking for a slightly unusual person.
Someone technical, but not obsessed with writing code for the sake of writing code.
Someone who sees a messy business problem and instinctively starts asking:

* Why is this happening?
* What does the data say?
* Where exactly is the bottleneck?
* Can this be solved with a process change?
* Should we automate it?
* Should we build a product for it?
* Can AI solve part of it?

What is the quickest way to test whether the solution actually works?
You will work across different parts of The Date Crew and solve problems spanning matchmaking, product, sales, marketing, customer experience and internal operations.

One week you could be improving how our matchmaking algorithm ranks profiles.
Another week you could be figuring out why customers are dropping off at a particular stage of the sales funnel.

The next problem could involve psychometric analysis, building an internal AI workflow, improving matchmaker productivity or automating a repetitive operational process.
Your job is not simply to build what someone tells you to build.
Your job is to understand the problem deeply and figure out the best way to solve it.

**What You’ll Work On
**

Examples of problems you may solve:

Matchmaking & Recommendation Systems
-Improve the way profiles are ranked and recommended.
-Identify signals that actually predict compatibility.
-Analyse acceptance/rejection behaviour and improve recommendation quality.
-Build internal tools that help matchmakers make better decisions.

Psychology & Compatibility
-Help structure psychometric or behavioural information.
-Explore how qualitative information can become useful product signals.
-Build tools that help our team better understand compatibility between two people.

Sales & Growth
-Analyse funnel drop-offs.
-Identify why leads don't convert.
-Build tools or automations to help the sales team prioritise leads.
-Experiment with new ways of improving conversion.

Operations
-Identify repetitive processes that should disappear.
-Build internal dashboards, automations and lightweight tools.
-Reduce operational errors and manual work.
-Improve how information flows between teams.

AI & Automation
-Prototype AI agents and workflows.
-Connect APIs, LLMs, CRMs and internal systems.
-Use AI where it genuinely improves speed or decision-making—not because AI sounds cool.

**What We’re Looking For
**

You probably have 1–3 years of experience in engineering, product, automation, data or an early-stage startup environment.

More importantly, you think like a builder.

**You should be comfortable with:
**

-Breaking ambiguous problems into smaller pieces.
-Understanding APIs, databases and system architecture.
-Writing enough code to build working solutions.
-Using AI coding tools to prototype quickly.
-Vibe coding and stitching different tools/services together.
-Working with SQL or analysing data.
-Thinking in terms of metrics and outcomes.
-Building MVPs before building perfect systems.
-Talking to users and internal teams before deciding what to build.

You don't necessarily need to be the world's best engineer.

But you should understand technology deeply enough to know what is possible, what is difficult and what is unnecessarily complicated.

**You’ll Probably Love This Role If
**

-You frequently build random tools because something annoys you.
-You have automated parts of your own life or work just because you could.
-You enjoy figuring out why something is happening more than simply completing assigned tasks.
-You can open a spreadsheet, look at a funnel and start forming hypotheses.
-You can talk to an operations person in the morning and build a prototype for them by evening.
-You are comfortable saying: “I don't think we should build this yet. Let me first understand whether this is actually the problem.”

**You Might Not Enjoy This Role If
**

-You want clearly defined tickets and specifications before starting work.
-You prefer working only on frontend, backend, data or one specific technical area.
-You measure productivity primarily through lines of code shipped.
-You dislike ambiguous problems.

This role will involve a lot of ambiguity.

**What Success Looks Like
**

-Within your first few months, we would expect you to:
-Identify high-impact problems independently.
-Develop clear hypotheses around those problems.
-Use data to validate them.
-Prototype solutions quickly.
-Work closely with the team using the solution.
-Measure whether the solution actually improved the metric.
-Kill ideas that don't work and iterate on the ones that do.
-Ultimately, your output isn't software.
-Your output is problems solved.

**Compensation**
₹10–12 lakh per annum + ESOPs

For the right person, this role can grow significantly as the product and technology organisation at The Date Crew evolves.

title: Operations Manager – Founder/Entrepreneurial Experience
description:
## **Manage a Team of Ops Associates for a fast-growing NYC-based custom apparel start-up (Remote)**

Hi, this is **Arpana**, one of the founding members of Fresh Prints.

In December 2016, I came across a job post on Naukri from Jacob Goodman, one of the co-owners of Fresh Prints. They were looking for someone to lead Operations in India. The post had already been taken down, but I decided to send Jacob an email anyway. **To my surprise, he replied, and soon I found myself stepping into what would become a life-changing opportunity.**

During the interview process, it became clear just how new everything was. There was no office, no payroll system, no established infrastructure. But what stood out was Jacob and Josh's unwavering belief in the vision they had for Fresh Prints. They didn't have all the answers, but their passion was contagious, and I knew I wanted to help build something from the ground up.

So I jumped in. I found an office, figured out payroll, and even brought in my childhood best friend to help get things started. Those early days were full of unknowns, but that's what made them so exciting. I got to wear multiple hats, solve problems on the fly, and help build something tangible. What started as a team of two soon grew into teams across Finance, Tech, and Marketing.

As the first employee of Fresh Prints India, I've had the privilege of helping shape the company from its earliest days. After taking a short break to have my daughter, I returned to lead HR and Recruiting. Since then, we've grown from a scrappy startup into a team of 400+ people across three countries. But even today, we still believe it's day one.

One of the moments I'm most proud of was how we navigated COVID-19 together. Overnight, universities shut down, events stopped, and we went from million-dollar months to zero revenue.

But we'd spent years preparing for uncertainty. From day one, we believed our balance sheet had to be a strength, so we always planned to be able to operate for at least a year without revenue or layoffs. When COVID hit, we were scared, but we were prepared.

Then we adapted. As demand for PPE surged, we pivoted from custom apparel to supplying protective equipment. It wasn't just about keeping the business alive—it was about meeting a real need. That willingness to move quickly and solve problems together helped us come out stronger while many companies were simply trying to survive.

The opportunities that were available to me when I joined as the first employee are still here today—in fact, they're even bigger. We're at an exciting point in our journey, and we're looking for people who want to have a real impact on what comes next.

If you're someone who sees opportunity and isn't afraid to chase it, this is the role for you. We're looking for people with an entrepreneurial mindset who take ownership, challenge the norm, and enjoy solving problems without a playbook. At Fresh Prints, there are no limits—but if you're looking for a role with a clear set of instructions, this probably isn't it.

If our story resonates, we want to hear from you! 

### **Here's more about the Operations Manager role:** 

The operations team handles the most crucial part of the business and is directly responsible for every step in delivering the end product to our customers.

- How do we build a team that drives the business forward?
- How do we motivate Operations Associates to respond to a higher volume of tickets at an even higher quality?
- How do you most efficiently manage incoming requests from printers, customers, and Campus Managers?
- How can we reduce our costs and increase our profit margins overall?

As a member of the Operations Leadership team, you’ll be a driving force behind moving our Operations team forward. You will own an entire area and have a team of people to lead and motivate. You will set and track metrics by which your success will be measured. 

We’re looking for someone who has fantastic people management skills, is a quick learner, and isn’t afraid to take on challenges daily. This is a high-impact role that requires excellent leadership and prioritization abilities. We’re on a remarkable growth trajectory and as Fresh Prints grows, you will too. You will be given the autonomy and guidance to have a tremendous impact on your role.

You’ll be managing a talented team of 3 to 7 associates, depending on which team you lead.

### **Responsibilities**

- Fully own a part of our supply chain. That includes any projects, requests from other functions, headcount planning, helping the team realise its full potential and making it future-proof
- Managing a team of Ops Associates
- Managing communications with vendors & customers
- Managing escalations from the team and solving logistical issues
- Setting and tracking team metrics
- Make sure all goals are reached
- One-on-one meetings with your direct reports and with your manager

### **We’re specifically looking for someone who has:**

- Founded, co-founded, or independently run a real operating business.
- Built or scaled a business serving paying customers.
- Managed employees directly—not only agencies, vendors, or freelancers.
- Personally handled hiring, coaching, performance management, and difficult people decisions.
- Owned business operations, customers, vendors, costs, and financial outcomes.

- Strong communication, analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.

### Preferred Business Backgrounds

Experience building or running a business in any of the following areas would be especially relevant:

- Apparel, fashion, merchandise, or printing
- Supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or fulfilment
- Consumer products
- Vendor or marketplace operations
- B2B operational businesses
- Customer service or technology-enabled operations

The industry does not need to match Fresh Prints exactly. What matters is that you have managed real employees, customers, operations, and financial outcomes.

### What Does Not Qualify

Freelancing, solo consulting, passive co-founder roles, short-term side projects, or family-business involvement without clear ownership will not be considered equivalent to building and operating a business.

### What We Value

- Entrepreneurial thinking
- Strong people leadership
- Ownership and accountability
- Practical business judgment
- Proactive problem-solving
- Comfort with ambiguity
- Clear and structured communication
- Data-driven decision-making

This is a **high-impact role** with significant autonomy and the opportunity to grow into broader Operations leadership as Fresh Prints continues to scale.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
**About Prospyr**  
Prospyr is a well funded, seed-stage startup on a mission to fuel growth in the aesthetic healthcare space. There are over 25,000 aesthetic clinics in the US helping patients improve their mental and physical well-being by achieving their personal appearance goals, and patient demand and the number of clinics is growing rapidly: 1,400 new Med Spas opened in the US last year alone (a 20% increase!). In a period of increasing competition and economic uncertainty, it's never been more important for Med Spas, Plastic Surgeons, and Dermatologists to have the right toolkit to seamlessly deliver fantastic patient experiences and build strong, lasting patient relationships.

We help aesthetic clinics unlock the full potential of their businesses by delivering a unified platform for high-impact, delightful patient engagement and smooth, efficient clinical operations. Our best-in-class modern software solution for practice management is used by practices across the United States to actively run their businesses, and Prospyr has already helped serve thousands of patients. We are headquartered in Austin, TX.

**The Role**  
Prospyr's sales team is growing. We are hiring Sales Development Representatives to build the top of our funnel.

You are the first conversation a practice has with Prospyr. Most practices we talk to run four or more separate tools to get through a day: one for scheduling and charting, one for payments, one for marketing, one for patient calls and texts. None of them talk to each other. You find those practices, start real conversations with owners and practice managers, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives.

You will have what you need to do that well: a documented playbook, recordings of real sales calls, and direct coaching from the Director of Sales. You will learn how a sales team gets built at an early-stage company, because you will be part of building it.

**What you'll do**

- Prospect into med spas, wellness practices, and plastic surgery practices primarily by phone, email, and text
- Research each practice before you reach out: locations, providers, services, and the software they run today
- Run first conversations that uncover how the practice operates and where its tools break down
- Book qualified meetings and hand them off with clean notes, so the AE never starts cold
- Reopen conversations with practices that went quiet
- Bring what you hear from prospects back to sales, marketing, and product so our messaging gets sharper
- Hit monthly targets for qualified meetings and closed won revenue

**Requirements**

- 1+ years in sales development, outbound sales, or another customer-facing role. SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement
- Comfort on the phone. You will make a lot of calls, and many of them reach a front desk first
- Strong communication skills. Your emails and texts sound like a person wrote them
- Curiosity. You ask good questions and you listen to the answers
- Organization. You can run a full day of tasks in a CRM without anything slipping. HubSpot experience is a plus
- Coachability. You take feedback and use it on the next call
- A commitment to operating ethically, with integrity, and in line with company values
- Nice to have: experience in or around aesthetics, med spa, wellness, healthcare, or practice-management software

**Benefits**

- Competitive salaries and equity/stock options in a rapidly growing company
- Top quality medical, dental, and vision plans
- Open vacation policy
