title: Scientist
description:
**Location:** Oxford or London (Hybrid)

**The Mission: Why We Exist**

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

**A Day in the Life**

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle – including discovering and validating therapeutic targets and developing patient stratification strategies. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders.

For example, a Scientist may:

- Generate novel therapeutic hypothesis for diseases with unmet need, mining the in-house data resources using statistical approaches to understand the causal pathophysiology of disease, identify and triage potential targets with genetic evidence, and build a rich understanding of the cell types, cellular function, tissue-level characteristics, patient populations and biomarkers needed to support a development program.
- Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information (through polygenic risk scores) with conventional risk factors, to find those individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from particular therapies.

To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others.

**Who You Are**

Must have, solid foundations in:

- Statistics (modelling, regression)
- Genetics and molecular biology
- Statistical programming (e.g., Python or R)

Preferred:

- Experience using a broad array of statistical genetics approaches (e.g., GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores)
- Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records.
- Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference.
- Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding, containerisation)
- Experience building and running reproducible pipelines e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow.
- Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments e.g. DNAnexus or Verily Workbench.
- Experience with methods development within statistical genetics

**Your Package**

We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment.

### **Compensation & Growth**

- **Competitive Salary**: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure competitive compensation.
- **Clear Career Path:** A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal.
- **Continuous Learning:** Including external courses and a wide library of L&D materials, because your growth is our success.

### **Wellbeing & Time Off**

- **Holiday:** 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end.
- **Financial & Health Security:** Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance.
- **Enhanced Leave**: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents.

### **Work Environment & Culture**

- **Flexible Working:** Hybrid Working (e.g., From our London, Oxford Office)
- **Truly Inclusive Time Off:** Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you.
- **Vibrant Social Culture:** From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate.
- **Green Commute:** Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs.

**Ready to Build the Future?**

If this opportunity excites you, **apply now!**

We are dedicated to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Senior Shopify Developer
description:
We are hiring a **contract-based Senior Shopify Developer** to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

[**Original job posting link**](https://garden3d.notion.site/Senior-Shopify-Developer-3dd131fea2c78051b514d89208aa0001?source=copy_link)

### 🌎**About garden3d **
We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

**[Sanctuary Computer](https://www.sanctuary.computer/)** — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

**[XXIX](https://www.xxix.co/)** — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

- [Lightphone](https://www.thelightphone.com/)
- [Mill](https://www.mill.com/)
- [IngredientAI](https://www.ingredient-ai.com/)

### 🔮 **Who we’re looking for:**

We're looking for a **Senior Shopify Developer** who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

- Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
- Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
- Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
- Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
- Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
- Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
- Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
- Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

🔑 **Must-Have Competencies:**

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

- **8+ years** writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
- **Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery:** Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the **Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL)** and frameworks like **Hydrogen/Remix** or **Next.js**.
- **Modern Frontend Tech:** Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
- **Headless CMS & Integrations:** Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
- **Platform & Hosting:** Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
- **Architecture & State Management:** Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
- **Quality & Accessibility:** Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
- **Performance Optimization:** Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

💪 **Nice-to-Have Competencies:**

- **Custom App Development:** Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
- **Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features:** Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
- **Tracking & Analytics:** Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
- **WebGL, Canvas & 3D:** Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
- **Full-Stack & API Design:** Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
- **Client-Facing & Management:** Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

### 💸 **Compensation**

Our pay scale ranges from **$40/hr** to **$120/hr** pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week. 

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

### 🎤 **How we interview**

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

### 👩‍🏭 **How we work:**

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

- **[Transparency & Ownership](https://sanctucompu.substack.com/p/our-open-source-2020-profit-and-loss):** We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
- **[150% Carbon Negative](https://negative.sanctuary.computer/):** Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. [We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.](https://twitter.com/sanctucompu/status/1385282161197060100)
- **Strong Morals:** Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
- **Async & Decentralized:** We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
- **Remote Friendly:** Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
- **Ideas & Products:** In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

**→ Read more on our Substack, [over here](https://sanctucompu.substack.com/), or our Medium, [over there](https://medium.com/sanctuary-computer-inc).**

### **💌 How to apply**
Important Reminders: This job posting here in Wellfound is for sharing purposes only and does not serve as the direct application for the role. To be considered, please complete our application form below

We’re excited to hear from you! ❤ Please apply by telling us a bit more about your interest in the role: [**garden3d Creative Network**](https://app.notion.com/p/garden3d/1f1131fea2c78095922ec7e09bd96101?source=copy_link)

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying!

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**Who are Tyk, and what do we do?**  
The Tyk AI and API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services. Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!) 

If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London - UK, London - Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.

**Our Mission**

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.

**Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility**

We offer [unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world](https://tyk.io/worklife/), for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier. 

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

**Why this role, why now**

Tyk spent a decade becoming essential infrastructure for some of the world's biggest companies. We're now doing the same thing for the AI era — and we want someone to help us move marketing through that shift. It's a rare moment: a profitable, established company moving fast into new territory, with a small enough team that you'll shape the direction, not just execute it.

**Requirements**

**Here’s what you’ll be getting up to:**

*This is a doing role. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end - planning them and then executing them yourself, with AI as a force multiplier.*

- **Own campaigns and launches end-to-end**. Write the brief, build the assets and copy, ship the campaign or launch, and report on how it did - you don’t hand any part of that off to someone else or an agency.
- **Run events from first invite to final follow-up.** Own the details of owned, sponsored and community events - logistics, outreach, on-the-day readiness, and the follow-up sequence that turns attendees into pipeline.
- **Use AI as a force multiplier, not a novelty.** Build tools like Claude or ChatGPT into your day-to-day - research, first drafts, campaign builds, reporting - so you can output like a bigger team, ship like an engineer, and bring the rest of the marketing team along with you.
- **Turn a priority into a plan with your name on it.** Take “we should do X” and turn it into a scoped plan - timeline, owner, success metric - then execute it yourself rather than delegating the “how.”
- **Keep GTM moving across Marketing, Sales and Product.** Chase the people, approvals and information you need across teams so initiatives don’t stall, and make sure what you ship lands with real commercial impact, not just activity.
- **Report on what worked.** Track the metrics that actually show impact for each initiative (pipeline influenced, cost, conversion, attendance - whatever fits), share the results even when they’re not flattering, and use them to decide what to do next.

**Here’s what we’re looking for:**

- **2–3 years’ experience as a marketing manager, growth marketer or similar** - background matters less than what you’ve built and how you think. B2B SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement; agency background is welcome, especially if you’ve built things from scratch for multiple clients.
- **A builder, not just a contributor.** You’ve made something from scratch - a campaign, a launch, a side project, a small business - and you can point to it and say “I built that.”
- **A strategic executor.** You can zoom out to see the bigger picture, then zoom back in and do the work yourself, rather than handing the “how” to someone else.
- **Commercially minded.** You think in pipeline and revenue, not just opens and impressions, and you can talk through a deal or a campaign you helped move forward.
- **A self-starter.** You manage competing priorities and deadlines without being managed, and you raise problems before they become fire drills.
- **Genuinely into AI.** You already use tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your own work, and you have real opinions about where AI is taking marketing - not just enthusiasm for the idea of it.
- **Hungry for ownership.** You’re at the point in your career where you want real responsibility, and you’re looking for a team small enough that you get it fast.
- **Comfortable with - or quick to pick up - Monday.com and HubSpot.** You don’t need hand-holding on the basics of project management or marketing ops tools.

**Is this right for you?**

**This role is for you if…**

- You love building and shipping things yourself, and want a lot of ownership
- You’re excited by the idea of helping shape an AI-first marketing team from the front
- You thrive in a small, senior team where everyone does the work

**It’s probably not for you if…**

- You’re mainly looking to manage a team or oversee others’ work
- You prefer a big, structured organisation with lots of specialists to delegate to
- You want to focus on strategy and planning rather than execution

**Benefits**

**Here’s why you should join us:**

- Everyone has unlimited paid holidays.
- We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
- Employee share scheme
- Generous maternity and paternity leave
- Volunteering Days
- Company retreats
- Employee Wellbeing platform

We all share the same vision - we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? - to make what we do even better!

**Our values tell the story of Tyk - here’s how:**

- It’s ok to screw up!

We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones - so try it, at least we can say we have!

- The only stupid idea, is the untested one!

It’s in our DNA - starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free - sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!

- Trust starts with you - make it count!

Trust is a two-way street - instil it from day one!

- Assume best intent!

We have each other’s back - we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act. 

- Make things better!

Always try to leave things better than when you found them - change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

What’s it like to work here?! check it out: [https://tyk.io/worklife/](https://tyk.io/worklife/)

Tyk is an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

You can see more about us here [https://tyk.io](https://tyk.io)

description:

We are seeking an analytical, research-driven Enterprise Outbound Hunter (SDR) with proven experience breaking into net-new enterprise accounts and booking qualified discovery conversations with C-level and VP decision-makers in the United States.

This is a pure outbound hunter mandate focused on target account penetration. You will not be managing existing accounts, waiting for inbound leads, or blasting generic call-center templates. Instead, your sole mission is opening doors and originating net-new enterprise opportunities: mapping mid-market enterprises across our target sectors, tracking relevant business milestones (clinical trial transitions, commercial launch hiring, M&A integrations), and crafting concise executive correspondence to initiate high-value business discussions.

**Key Responsibilities:**
• Cold Account Penetration & Intelligence: Identify and research mid-market target accounts across US Biotech, Pharma, MedTech, HealthTech, Insurtech, and PE platforms using Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and public industry registries.
• Multi-Channel Executive Prospecting: Execute high-touch outbound sequences (custom cold email, LinkedIn messaging, and follow-ups) highlighting relevant business triggers and operational priorities across RevOps, R&D, and engineering.
• Meeting Qualification: Schedule executive discovery calls directly onto leadership calendars, ensuring every booked prospect satisfies our target client profile and senior executive criteria.
• CRM Discipline: Maintain accurate prospect profiles, deal stages, and verified activity logs in Zoho CRM.

**What We Are Looking For:**
• 3 to 5 years of verified experience as an Outbound Enterprise SDR / BDR hunting net-new North American enterprise accounts (selling B2B Services, High-Value Consulting, or Enterprise Tech).
• Flawless Business English: Exceptional written communication skills capable of engaging US Vice Presidents and C-level executives in concise, peer-level language.
• Tool Fluency: Hands-on daily experience with Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Zoho CRM.

Any applications from agencies will be immediately rejected and marked as spam. Please do not send direct messages (DMs) to our founders or team members regarding this role.

title: Prompt Engineer
description:
ABOUT TIMEPAY.AI

At timepay.ai we are on a mission to revolutionize how enterprises connect with their customers. Traditional approaches to collections, sales, and customer engagement are outdated—impersonal, inflexible, and wasteful of resources.

We build and deploy intelligent, human-like AI agents that operate 24/7, using predictive analytics to make communication more efficient, effective, and empathetic.

What we've built: Vox-v1 - Our flagship TTS engine with 15+ emotions, 12+ languages, and sub-100ms latency. Voice AI Agents - Autonomous agents handling millions of inbound & outbound calls. Automated workflow across multiple channels i.e sms, email whatsapp etc.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We're hiring for a Prompt Engineer at timepay.ai and this is one of the most exciting roles we have right now.

If you've worked in client delivery, automation, process excellence, customer support QA, business analysis, or CX transformation, and you've spent time working with AI-driven workflows or bot-building platforms, this role is built for you.

You'll work closely with our product and engineering teams to design, refine, and implement prompts and bot flows for our clients across customer support, collections, reminder systems, onboarding journeys, and custom automation.

It's a mix of language, logic, client management, and product thinking with direct ownership over how our AI agents behave in production.

YOUR ROLE

- Responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing prompts for AI models to ensure accurate, contextually relevant, and high-quality outputs. 
- Test prompts against our QC output to consistently refine for higher accuracy. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including AI researchers, and product managers, to create and refine prompts that enhance the performance of our AI solutions. 
- Conduct experiments and A/B testing to evaluate and improve prompt performance. 
- Analyze user feedback and data to refine and enhance prompt effectiveness. 
- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and natural language processing (NLP) technologies. 
- Document prompt engineering best practices and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

QUALIFICATIONS

Pursuing/Pass-out in bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, English, Journalism, or a related field. title: Legal Analyst
description:
Great  media Technologies is hiring a detail-oriented Legal Analyst to support the research, drafting, and case-management work of a U.S. law firm.

This position is suited to a law graduate who can analyse complex documents, write clear professional English, manage competing deadlines, and take responsibility for assignments without repeated reminders. The work will involve substantive legal support, not merely data entry or document formatting.

**Key responsibilities: **

* Legal research and analysis: Research relevant U.S. statutes, court rules, and case law. Prepare concise memoranda that distinguish established facts, legal conclusions, uncertainties, and recommended next steps. Verify every authority cited.
* Drafting and document review: Prepare first drafts of pleadings, declarations, discovery requests and responses, correspondence, and other case documents under attorney supervision. Check factual consistency, citations, formatting, and exhibit references.
* Case-file preparation: Review records, correspondence, contracts, and financial documents. Build chronologies, evidence summaries, exhibit indexes, and lists of missing information or inconsistencies.
* Deadline and workflow management: Maintain accurate case trackers and task lists. Record the source and assumptions behind proposed deadlines, obtain attorney confirmation, and escalate missing instructions or deadline risks promptly.
* Professional communication: Draft clear client updates and attorney correspondence. Coordinate document collection, appointments, and follow-ups within the authority assigned to the role.
* Quality, confidentiality, and accountability: Maintain organised files, version control, and accurate time records. Use only approved systems and AI tools, independently verify their output, and protect confidential information.

**Required qualifications:**

* Applicants must have at least two years of substantive legal work after completing their qualifying law degree. Student internships do not count toward this minimum.
* Excellent written and spoken English, supported by strong legal drafting and research skills.
* Experience handling legal documents and managing multiple assignments with attention to accuracy and deadlines.
* Proficiency in word processing, tracked changes, PDF review, spreadsheets, and organised electronic case files.
* Sound judgment, receptiveness to feedback, and the ability to identify and escalate issues rather than conceal uncertainty.
* Availability to work from the Kolkata office during the stated U.S.-aligned shift.

**Preferred experience:**

* Prior experience supporting a U.S. law firm or legal process outsourcing team is an advantage. Particularly relevant experience includes civil or family litigation, discovery, document review, case chronologies, and professional client correspondence.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
## **About us**

The world is electrifying. As we plug in more devices and services, we need new ways to connect to power.

The traditional, one-size-fits-all utility approach, with complicated bills and frustrating customer service, no longer works. At Light, we make it easy to get affordable, renewable electricity by embedding power with the products that consumers already use, from the companies they love.

Light's mission is to power a sustainable and abundant energy future for everyone. We do it by making any company able to sell electricity. With Light's utility-as-API platform, companies from automakers and solar providers to real estate and beyond can offer their own, integrated electricity plans.

Imagine purchasing an electric vehicle that includes unlimited home charging, or solar panels that come bundled with any excess energy you might need from the grid. We're building the flexible future where clean energy shows up wherever customers already are.

We're a Series A company based in Austin, TX. We've found meaningful traction and are now investing aggressively in growth. Join us in building the digital energy infrastructure for the next century of power.

## The role

As our customer retention hire at Light, you will own the two moments that decide whether a customer stays: renewing customers as their contracts come up, and recovering enrollments that stall before a customer goes live.

You're the first person dedicated to this work, which today is spread across the ops leaders who built it, and you'll have room to run it your way.

## In your first six months, you will:

- Move our monthly renewal rate, partner by partner, through your own outreach: the calls you make, the campaigns you launch, the appointments you set and keep.
- Build the recovery motion for stalled enrollments and turn validation holds back into active customers.
- Stand up the renewal cadences, scripts, and campaigns that don't exist yet, then run them yourself and improve them as you learn.
- Find the patterns in customer data that block renewals and enrollments, and drive the fixes with product, pricing, and partner success.
- Become the voice of the customer in our cross-functional renewals group, so what you hear on the phone shapes how plans get built and priced.

## You would describe yourself as:

- Having 7+ years experience in energy sales, retention, or account management.
- Fluent in energy: rates, contracts, plans. You can walk a customer through a renewal without a script, and you've probably shopped for your own electricity plan.
- Someone who has built a sales or retention plan and then picked up the phone to run it yourself.
- A trend-finder. Hand you a messy dump of customer records and you'll come back with the pattern and a proposed fix.
- Self-directed. You manage your own callbacks, reminders, and appointments, and you'd rather be judged on the outcome than the activity.
- Comfortable being the expert a customer would never normally get to talk to, and happy to do the ground-level work anyway.
- Based in the US, ideally Texas, and set up to work well remotely.
- Bonus if you speak Spanish!

title: Business Development, Data Centers
description:
## **About us**

The world is electrifying. As we plug in more devices and services, we need new ways to connect to power.

The traditional, one-size-fits-all utility approach, with complicated bills and frustrating customer service, no longer works. At Light, we make it easy to get affordable, renewable electricity by embedding power with the products that consumers already use, from the companies they love.

Light's mission is to power a sustainable and abundant energy future for everyone. We do it by making any company able to sell electricity. With Light's utility-as-API platform, companies from automakers and solar providers to real estate and beyond can offer their own, integrated electricity plans.

Imagine purchasing an electric vehicle that includes unlimited home charging, or solar panels that come bundled with any excess energy you might need from the grid. We're building the flexible future where clean energy shows up wherever customers already are.

We're a Series A company based in Austin, TX. We've found meaningful traction and are now investing aggressively in growth. Join us in building the digital energy infrastructure for the next century of power.

## The role

Campuses need power faster than the grid can deliver it, and the communities hosting them fear absorbing the cost. Light is a licensed retailer, and our platform makes structures possible that haven't existed before: flexible load arrangements that let a campus grow without adding to peak demand, retail supply for the neighborhoods around a site, community DER packages, and household electricity benefits written into community benefit agreements. Developers are building the first of these with us now. We build programs where the value on both sides is real and measurable, and pass on the ones that are only optics.

Light is hiring its first business development lead for data centers. You'll own the segment: which hyperscalers, operators, and campus developers we engage with, how we reach the people making energy decisions inside them, and what we build together.

## In your first six months, you will:

- **Find the right partners.** Map the landscape of hyperscalers, operators, and campus developers, and engage the ones whose objectives line up with ours.
- **Build relationships across functions.** Power, economic development, community affairs, entitlements, site leadership. Find where the problems sit and co-develop with the person who owns them.
- **Share what we learn.** Bring these programs to industry events, trade groups, and policy researchers, so more of the industry knows what's possible and what makes a program credible.
- **Turn relationships into signed partnerships.** Jointly define the problem, then construct the program: a flexible load pilot, retail supply around a campus, a DER package, CBA language.
- **Bring the market back to Light.** Turn what you hear into a clear point of view on where the industry is going and what we should build next.

In six months, success looks like: partnerships live in retail choice markets, spanning more than one of these structures, and delivering measurably for both the campus and the community around it.

## You would describe yourself as:

- **Experienced on the other side of the table.** You've worked at a hyperscaler, campus developer, or operator, in a seat that touched power, community, or economic development. You know what a proposal needs to survive an internal review.
- **An authentic relationship builder, not a professional networker.** You work with a broad range of personalities, and your relationships outlast the opportunities that started them.
- **Unusually perceptive.** You're comfortable in any number of contexts: a site team, a structuring session with an executive, a utility's front office, a public meeting in a host community.
- **An explorer.** Ambiguous problems and opaque institutions interest you rather than frustrate you. You're building structures that don't exist yet, and shaping them while you sell.
- **Driven by impact.** This work is on the ground before the results are visible, and you're motivated by what gets built rather than by title.
- **Experienced.** 10–15 years, enough to have owned significant relationships end to end and to be seen as a peer by an executive.
- **Comfortable on the road.** Roughly 50% travel to sites, events, and meet with partners.

The ideal candidate is a brand builder, growth strategist, and analytical leader who can drive growth through data-informed storytelling, customer engagement, and scalable acquisition strategies.
As a key member of the executive leadership team, the CMO will help shape the company’s growth trajectory, market positioning, and expansion strategy while building the marketing function from the ground up.
This position begins as a part-time executive role and is designed to evolve into a full-time leadership position based on company growth, funding milestones, and market expansion objectives as CulinaryFleet expands nationally and internationally.

* Develop and execute CulinaryFleet’s multi-channel marketing strategy with a strong GTM focus across digital, social, partnership, and experiential channels.
* Build and maintain a powerful and consistent brand identity aligned with CulinaryFleet’s mission, values, and long-term vision.

* Lead product positioning, market research, competitive analysis, and customer insight initiatives to strengthen product-market fit and market differentiation.

title: Founding Content & Creative Member
description:
**Tivvio is building the future of event discovery and ticketing in South Africa.**

We're creating a platform that makes it easier for people to discover what's happening around them — from concerts and festivals to nightlife, experiences, workshops, community events and everything in between.

We're still early.

That means we're not looking for someone to simply "do a job."

We're looking for someone who wants to **help build the brand from the ground up.**

## The Role

We're looking for a **Founding Content & Creative Member** to take ownership of Tivvio's visual content and social presence.

Your job isn't just to make graphics.

Your job is to help make **Tivvio culturally relevant.**

We want someone who understands South African internet culture, knows what makes people stop scrolling, and can turn an idea into content people actually want to share.

You'll work directly with the founder to develop Tivvio's content engine across Instagram, TikTok and other social channels.

### What you'll be doing

**Content**

* Create engaging Instagram carousels and posts
* Produce short-form video and Reels/TikTok content
* Create Stories and interactive social content
* Turn events, trends and ideas into compelling content
* Repurpose successful content across multiple platforms

**Creative**

* Develop Tivvio's visual identity across social media
* Create reusable templates and content systems
* Design event promotional assets
* Create campaign and partnership creatives
* Help maintain consistency across the Tivvio brand

**Growth**

* Identify trends, conversations and cultural moments Tivvio can participate in
* Experiment with different content formats and hooks
* Analyse content performance and learn what resonates
* Develop shareable content designed to grow Tivvio's audience
* Work closely with the founder on campaigns designed to attract event organisers and event-goers

## The type of person we're looking for

We're less interested in your formal qualifications and more interested in **what you can create.**

You could be a:

* Graphic designer
* Content creator
* Social media designer
* Motion designer
* Digital creative
* Video editor
* Design student or self-taught creator

What matters is that you have **strong visual taste, creativity and initiative.**

You should:

* Understand Instagram and TikTok culture
* Have strong graphic design fundamentals
* Be comfortable creating short-form video
* Understand what makes content shareable
* Have an eye for typography, composition and visual storytelling
* Be curious about trends and culture
* Be comfortable experimenting
* Be able to work independently
* Be willing to take ownership rather than wait for instructions
* Ideally have a strong interest in events, music, entertainment, nightlife, culture or technology

### A huge plus

You understand **South African culture and humour.**

You know that something doesn't have to be polished and corporate to perform.

You know the difference between content that looks nice and content that makes someone say:

> "Yoh 😭 I remember this."

That's the kind of creative thinking we're looking for.

# What we're offering

This is an **early-stage founding role**, so this isn't a conventional salaried position.

### Equity: 2% in Tivvio

The role will receive **2% equity**, subject to a formal equity agreement.

This means you're not just working *for* Tivvio.

You'll have an opportunity to **own a small part of what we're building.**

### Time commitment

We're initially looking for approximately **4–6 hours per week**.

The goal isn't to fill your calendar.

It's to give you enough ownership and responsibility to make a meaningful contribution while we're still early.

### Future compensation

As Tivvio grows and external funding or sufficient revenue is secured, the intention is for this founding role to transition into a **paid position**, with compensation and responsibilities agreed at that stage.

# What success looks like

After joining, we'd want you to help us build a repeatable content engine.

Success should sound like:

**"Tivvio is becoming an account people actually follow because they want to know what's happening."**

And look like:

* Consistent weekly content
* Increasing organic reach
* Higher shares and saves
* Growing Tivvio's social audience
* Stronger brand recognition
* Better event promotion
* More people discovering events through Tivvio
* More event organisers wanting to be featured on Tivvio
* A recognisable Tivvio creative style

# Why join this early?

Because you're not joining an established marketing department.

**You'd be helping create it.**

You'll have the opportunity to:

* Help shape Tivvio's brand
* Build a portfolio around a real startup
* Work directly with the founder
* Experiment with content and growth
* Have meaningful ownership in an early-stage company
* Potentially grow into Tivvio's future creative/content lead

If Tivvio becomes what we're aiming to build, the person who helped establish the brand and content engine from the beginning will have been there from the start.

# Who this is NOT for

This probably isn't the right role if you're looking for:

* A traditional 9–5
* Detailed instructions for every task
* A purely graphic-design role
* A corporate environment
* Guaranteed salary from day one

We're looking for someone who can build something amazing from a blank canvas

How to apply

Send us:

1. A short introduction about yourself
2. Your portfolio or examples of your work
3. Your Instagram/TikTok/other creative profiles if relevant
4. One example of a piece of content you think Tivvio should create
5. A short answer to this question:

**"If you were responsible for making Tivvio one of the most recognisable event brands in South Africa, what would you do?"**

We're much more interested in **how you think** than how polished your CV is.

title: Consulting & Business Development Fellow (Academic Practicum / Learning Internship)
description:
**About Bevel Consulting**

Bevel Consulting is a small consulting firm that helps small businesses identify, evaluate, and implement practical AI solutions. We examine real-world operational bottlenecks, evaluate automation tools, and work with business owners to understand how emerging technology can streamline workflows and drive growth.

This program is an educational fellowship designed to give students direct exposure to technology consulting, business development, AI tooling, and business problem-solving alongside the firm’s founders.

**Program Overview**

This practicum provides an end-to-end perspective on how modern technology consulting operates.

Participants explore the full consulting lifecycle:

Market Discovery/Outreach → Opportunity Assessment → AI Tool Benchmarking → Solution Design → Implementation Review

**What You’ll Learn & Practice**

Market Landscape Research: Study small-business verticals to map common operational friction points and identify where workflow automations and AI add measurable value.

Client Outreach: Reaching out to potential clients and understanding the bottlenecks their business faces to offer the best possible solution.

AI Tool Evaluation & Benchmarking: Test, compare, and document practical use cases for generative AI platforms, agentic workflows, and no-code automation tools.

Client Engagement Shadowing: Sit in on live discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, and strategy presentations led by the founders to observe real-world consulting dynamics.

Case Study Practicums: Analyze simulated business scenarios to build mock AI implementation roadmaps, workflow automations, and ROI models, receiving direct feedback from leadership.

Advisory Communication: Learn how technical solutions are translated into clear, actionable business strategies for non-technical owners.

**Who This Program Is For**

Current undergraduate or graduate students eligible to receive academic credit, or individuals seeking structured, experiential learning in tech advisory.

Students interested in business development, sales, management consulting, artificial intelligence, technology consulting, entrepreneurship, or operational strategy.

Curious, self-motivated learners comfortable experimenting with new software and AI tools.

Clear written and verbal communicators eager to understand how small businesses operate.

No programming or technical background required—curiosity, structured reasoning, and a desire to learn are the main priorities.

Relevant Fields of Study

Business • Information Technology • Computer Science • Data Analytics • Marketing • Finance • Entrepreneurship • Management • Cybersecurity • Artificial Intelligence

**Why Join the Fellowship?**

Direct mentorship from founders actively building an AI advisory practice.

Hands-on exploration of real-world business challenges and commercial AI applications.

Practical portfolio artifacts, including case study solutions and tool evaluation reports.

Full coordination and documentation support for university credit requirements.

title: Independent Business Development Consultant
description:
**About South Town Productions**

South Town Productions is a Lubbock-based video production and marketing agency helping businesses and organizations tell stronger stories, build their brands and connect with their audiences through professional video, marketing and digital services.

We are seeking an independent business development professional to identify and develop new B2B relationships and introduce qualified organizations to South Town Productions.

This is an independent contractor engagement and not an employment position.

**The Opportunity**

The primary focus of this engagement is developing new business opportunities for South Town Productions' video production, marketing, creative and digital services.

Our services are relationship-driven rather than transactional. Developing meaningful B2B opportunities may involve multiple conversations and a longer sales cycle.

The independent consultant will determine their own approach to identifying prospects, developing relationships and generating qualified opportunities.

South Town Productions will provide information about its capabilities, portfolio, available services and approved pricing as needed to support prospective client conversations.

**Scope of the Engagement**

The independent consultant will provide business development services that may include:

* Identifying potential B2B clients
* Establishing relationships with business owners, executives, marketing professionals and other decision-makers
* Identifying potential business needs and opportunities
* Introducing qualified prospects to South Town Productions
* Discussing South Town Productions' capabilities with prospective clients
* Developing and advancing potential new-business opportunities
* Coordinating with South Town Productions when proposals, creative expertise, scope development or pricing approval are required
* Assisting in moving qualified opportunities toward an executed client agreement

The consultant determines their own schedule, work location, prospecting methods and manner of performing the engagement.

There are no required working hours or work location.

This engagement is non-exclusive. The consultant may provide services to other businesses, subject to confidentiality obligations and any conflict-of-interest provisions contained in the independent contractor agreement.

The consultant generally provides their own equipment, phone, computer, transportation and ordinary business expenses associated with performing their services unless otherwise agreed in writing.

**Compensation**

This engagement is 100% commission-based.

The consultant will earn 20% of qualifying client revenue actually collected by South Town Productions during the first three months of each eligible new client relationship originated and closed through the consultant's efforts.

Commission becomes payable only after South Town Productions receives the applicable client payment.

The 20% commission applies only to qualifying collected revenue during the initial three-month commission period. There is no continuing commission after that period.

There is no cap on the number of eligible new client relationships the consultant may originate.

Commission terms for qualifying standalone projects may differ and will be established in the independent contractor agreement.

The independent contractor agreement will also define eligibility, attribution of prospects, the applicable commission period, payment timing and treatment of cancellations, refunds, nonpayment and other circumstances affecting commission.

**Client Agreements and Pricing**

The consultant does not have authority to enter into agreements on behalf of South Town Productions or otherwise legally bind the company.

Final pricing, discounts, scope of work, contractual terms and client agreements must be approved by an authorized representative of South Town Productions.

South Town Productions retains responsibility for executing client agreements and providing contracted creative and marketing services after an engagement is established.

**What We're Looking For**

This opportunity is best suited for an established sales or business development professional who is comfortable independently developing B2B relationships.

Relevant backgrounds may include professional services, marketing, advertising, media, video production, SaaS, consulting or other relationship-driven B2B sales.

We're particularly interested in professionals who have experience:

* Developing their own business opportunities
* Establishing relationships with organizational decision-makers
* Identifying legitimate business needs
* Selling professional services based on value rather than price alone
* Developing opportunities through longer B2B sales cycles
* Converting qualified opportunities into new business
* Previous experience with creative services is helpful but not required.
* Independent Contractor Relationship

The consultant operates as an independent business professional and is responsible for determining how and when their business development services are performed.

The consultant is responsible for their own applicable taxes, insurance, licenses, equipment and ordinary business expenses associated with their independent business activities.

This engagement does not provide employee benefits, paid time off or other employee compensation.

Any future employment opportunities with South Town Productions would be separate from this independent contractor engagement. Future employment is not promised or guaranteed.

**How to Express Interest**

Send us your resume, LinkedIn profile or information about your professional sales experience along with a short introduction.

We'd particularly like to know:

1. What types of products or services you've sold
2. The types of organizations and decision-makers you've worked with
3. Your experience developing your own B2B opportunities
4. The general size and sales cycle of deals you've previously worked with

We're more interested in demonstrated business development ability and professional relationships than a particular job title.

title: Fractional Lifecycle Marketing & Customer Insights Manager
description:
**Type:** Part-time / Fractional Contractor

**Commitment:** Approximately 10–15 hours per week to start

Huddle is a childcare marketplace helping parents find and book trusted babysitters through their existing communities and networks.

We're an early-stage consumer marketplace focused on building a better way for parents to find reliable childcare and for sitters to find families and manage their availability.

We are looking for a hands-on Lifecycle Marketing & Customer Insights Manager to own how we communicate with users after they join the company—and help us deeply understand what drives them to engage, book, return, or drop off.

This is a highly execution-oriented fractional role. We are looking for someone who can both develop the strategy and personally execute it.

**What You'll Own**

**Lifecycle Marketing & CRM**

Own the company's user lifecycle from signup through activation, booking, retention and reactivation.

Responsibilities include:

* Map the parent and sitter customer journeys and identify the most important opportunities to improve activation and retention.
* Build, manage and optimize lifecycle campaigns in Customer.io across email, push notifications and SMS.
* Develop onboarding and activation journeys for new parents and sitters.
* Build behavioral and event-triggered communications based on actions users take—or don't take—in the app.
* Develop campaigns designed to drive first bookings, completed bookings, repeat bookings and reactivation.
* Create audience segments based on user behavior and lifecycle stage.
* Write and edit clear, compelling lifecycle copy consistent with the company's brand.
* Develop an ongoing experimentation roadmap for messaging, timing, channels and calls to action.
* Monitor campaign and funnel performance and continuously improve lifecycle programs.
* Work with product/engineering as needed to identify missing events, attributes or triggers required for effective lifecycle campaigns.

**Customer Research & Insights**

Own a continuous customer feedback program that helps the company understand its users.

Responsibilities include:

* Regularly identify and recruit parents and sitters for customer interviews.
* Personally conduct user interviews by phone or video.
* Develop interview guides designed to uncover motivations, friction points and unmet needs.
* Speak with different user cohorts, including users who signed up but never booked, attempted to book but did not complete a booking, completed their first booking, became repeat users, and became inactive.
* Conduct surveys when appropriate.
* Organize qualitative feedback and identify recurring themes and patterns.
* Develop a regular Voice of the Customer summary highlighting what we're hearing, what it means and recommended actions.
* Translate customer insights into specific recommendations for lifecycle communications, product improvements, onboarding, positioning and marketing.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is both **analytical and highly comfortable talking directly with customers**.

You should have:

* 4+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, growth marketing, customer engagement or a related field.
* Hands-on experience building automated lifecycle journeys—not simply developing strategy for others to execute.
* Experience with Customer.io strongly preferred. Experience with Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, HubSpot or similar platforms is relevant.
* Experience with behavioral segmentation and event-triggered communications.
* Experience across email and preferably push notifications and SMS.
* Strong copywriting and communication skills.
* Experience conducting customer interviews or qualitative user research.
* Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative information into clear recommendations.
* Strong analytical instincts and comfort working with funnel and behavioral data.
* Experience with consumer mobile apps, marketplaces or early-stage startups strongly preferred.
* Ability to work independently and move quickly without a large team or significant process around you.


Ultimately, success means helping the company better understand its users and increasing the percentage of acquired users who become active, booking and repeat-booking customers.

**Tools**

Our current stack includes Customer.io, Segment, Amplitude, Metabase, PostHog, Appsflyer, Twilio and other analytics and marketing tools.

Experience working with product events, user attributes and behavioral data is important. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technical teams and troubleshooting lifecycle campaigns.

**When Applying**

Please include:

* A brief description of your lifecycle/CRM experience.
* Examples of lifecycle journeys you've personally built and managed.
* Your experience with Customer.io or similar platforms.
* Your experience personally conducting customer interviews.
* Experience working with consumer apps, marketplaces or early-stage startups.
* Your typical weekly availability and hourly rate.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
**About the Role**

Truework, recently acquired by Checkr, provides access to crucial employment, income information and asset information needed for mortgage loans, apartment rentals, background checks, and more. We are disrupting a $5B+ industry, dominated by legacy incumbents and outdated processes, with a better product and intense customer focus. Within Checkr, Truework operates independently, allowing rapid iteration while also being able to leverage the strengths and assets from our core business. Think of it like joining a startup within a startup!

As a Strategic Account Executive on the Truework team, you’ll help scale our impact across large national and regional lenders, with a primary focus on acquiring new clients to Truework Verification services. As automated verification services become a more common practice for lenders in how they run their operation, you’ll lead the charge in building and executing a more repeatable playbook to drive new customers who will grow with us for years to come. By deeply understanding their unique company challenges and goals, you will pair them with solutions that will help them reach their business objectives and innovate within their organizations. 

This role is ideal for a proven sales professional who:

- has experience selling transformational solutions to customers, where you can quickly identify and pattern map where and how the Truework solution can drive impact in a customer’s operation
- has experience identifying and building relationships with decision makers, business and technology influencers and users, closing 6- and 7-figure pursuits
- who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment— ready to help close the gap between the legacy solutions and processes lending teams are leaning on and their plans and intentions to deliver competitive and streamlined processes for consumers

You will be an important part of an elite, professional, and rapidly growing cross-functional team that succeeds through collaboration, grit, and learning.

**What you’ll do**

- Deliver Sales Excellence:

  - Consistently achieve pipeline and revenue targets by applying modern sales techniques and processes to efficiently manage top of funnel engagement tactics and deal strategy and close processes
  - Think outside-the-box to cultivate awareness of the Truework vision. Plan and execute targeted campaigns for your territory working with the marketing and partner teams to scale your coverage and build pipeline
  - Partner with and guide the efforts of our internal team to support your accounts in pre-sales activities and in the deployment to execute on agreed upon account goals, strategies and tactics for growth
  - Leverage analytics, case studies, past performance, and market intelligence to create a territory plan and craft your own target account strategies.
- Manage Account Relationships:

  - Have an understanding of the lender’s operation and an ability to identify the varying use cases where verification services can drive impact
  - Exhibit deep and up-to-date knowledge of our product portfolio in order to communicate the benefits of new features and enhancements
  - Show proficiency in navigating buy team personas, with intentional activities for executive bridging and champion building
- Exhibit Industry- & Customer-specific Business Acumen:

  - Actively understand each customer’s strategic growth plans, technology footprint, and corresponding technology strategy, internal challenges, and competitive landscape.
  - Review public information (e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to stay updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect.
  - Be equipped to identify and discover centers of value for lenders, and conduct analysis to quantify ROI and impact of our solution on their operation
- Be a good teammate

  - Represent both market trends and client needs to the Executive and the Product teams to ensure we are both serving current needs well and evolving our products and portfolio to identify future client needs
  - Show unparalleled grit - constantly experiment, be willing to pivot, and have resiliency regardless of the obstacles faced

**What you bring**

- 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience, selling transformative technology solutions
- Experience closing new business accounts and building pipeline using modern marketing tactics
- Experience selling to EVPs, CXOs and end-users (in the same sales cycle) in both individual and team sales environments
- Ability to navigate large organizations’ political landscape to maintain and expand relationships at all levels
- General knowledge in common sales practices like MEDDPICC, Command of the Message (Force Management), Challenger, Power Selling, or others
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to simplify complex topics in a friendly and approachable manner, present executive-level business cases
- Ability to juggle and complete multiple priorities and projects (internally and externally) in a fast-paced environment
- You are smart, self-motivated, organized, disciplined, inquisitive, detail-oriented, and process-oriented; you have an ownership mentality within all aspects of your work
- You have a growth mindset that is always learning, growing, and actively seeking feedback
- You have a team-first mentality—you show up for your team and expect the same in return. You enjoy planning, adjusting, executing, winning, and celebrating as a team.
- An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Akadenia is looking for a Full Stack Engineer who is equally comfortable shaping a React interface, designing a GraphQL schema, and deploying services to AWS. You'll own features end to end — from the database to the screen — on a small, fast-moving team where what you ship reaches users in days, not quarters.

**What you'll do**

Build and maintain full stack features across our React front end and Node.js/TypeScript backend.
Design and evolve APIs in both GraphQL and REST, balancing developer experience with performance.
Deploy, monitor, and scale services on AWS (compute, storage, queues, and managed databases).
Collaborate with product and design to turn rough ideas into shipped, well-tested software.

Experience building back-end services in Node.js and designing APIs with both GraphQL and REST.
Hands-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS.
A working knowledge of AI coding tools and good judgment about when to trust, verify, and rewrite their output.
A pragmatic approach to testing, code review, and shipping — you care about quality without gold-plating.
Clear written communication and the ability to work autonomously in a small team.

Experience with infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker).
Exposure to performance tuning, caching, or event-driven architectures.
A track record of mentoring or raising the engineering bar on a team.

A team that treats AI tooling as a real productivity multiplier and invests in the tools you need.
Direct ownership and short paths from idea to production.
