title: Director, Text-to-Speech Synthesis Research
description:
# **Company Overview**

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

# **Company Operating Rhythm**

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

## The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Research to own our Text-to-Speech program end to end — the research strategy, the technical bets, and the models that ship. This is a hands-on leadership role: you set direction and stay in the details, shaping architectures, experiments, training strategy, and evaluation. You'll also build the team and operating model that let exceptional researchers move fast without lowering the bar.

The mandate is broad: advance the state of the art in speech generation, and turn those advances into models in production.

## What You'll Do

- Own the TTS research and model roadmap — decide which technical directions can materially move speech-generation quality, including the expensive and non-obvious ones, and recognize when an approach should change or die.
- Drive advances across neural audio modeling, prosody and expressiveness, controllability, multilingual speech, voice identity and consistency, data and training strategy, post-training, and inference performance — and make sure they land as measurable production gains.
- Stay deeply technical: review research, challenge assumptions, design experiments, diagnose model failures, and take on the highest-leverage problems yourself.
- Build evaluation and benchmarking that explains *why* models improve, not just whether they did — automated metrics alongside human perceptual assessment.
- Lead a mix of individual contributors and tech lead managers. Hire and develop both, hold an exceptionally high technical bar, grow senior researchers into technical leaders, and set direction across sub-teams while pushing decisions down to the people closest to the work.
- Partner with engineering and product leadership on ship-readiness, and represent Deepgram's TTS research internally and externally.

## You'll Love This Role If You

- Want to own a frontier-model program end to end rather than optimize one slice of someone else's agenda.
- Care about the breakthrough and the ship in equal measure.
- Still love training runs, failed evals, and architecture arguments, even as most of your impact now comes through the people you lead.
- Get energy from deciding which bets are worth making when the answer isn't obvious and the experiments are expensive.

## You Must Have

- Deep expertise in modern TTS, speech generation, or audio generative modeling, with a track record of personally training and improving large-scale neural models.
- Command of the modern speech-generation stack and the open problems behind naturalness, expressiveness, controllability, robustness, voice consistency, and inference cost.
- A history of setting research direction under genuine uncertainty: prioritizing experiments, allocating compute and researcher time, and killing approaches that aren't working.
- Experience leading researchers and research engineers *through* other technical leaders — developing tech lead managers or equivalent, setting direction across sub-teams — while staying technically influential yourself.
- AI as your default mode of work, not an occasional tool. You've rebuilt how you and your team operate around it, and you have a specific, earned view of what it still can't do in speech research.
- The ability to make complex technical tradeoffs legible to product, engineering, and executive audiences.

## It'd Be Great If You Had

- TTS or generative-audio models deployed at meaningful production scale.
- Built or substantially scaled a high-performing AI research organization.
- Sophisticated evaluation systems for generative speech; expressive or multilingual generation, voice cloning and adaptation, or controllable generation.
- Recognized external contributions — publications, open source, patents, invited talks — in speech synthesis, neural audio codecs, speech language models, or multimodal models.
- Experience in fast-moving startup or research environments that routinely take models from idea to production.

***Notice**: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @*[*deepgram.com*](http://deepgram.com) *email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.*

title: Director, Engineering (Platform)
description:
## **About Juniper Square**

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

*Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in* [*digital-first*](https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/) *operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.*

## **About your role**

As the Director, Engineering you will lead the vision and execution for the foundational systems that power our entire engineering organization. Your mandate spans four critical pillars: architecting the modularization of our core Python/FastAPI monolith, accelerating our transition to an AI-native engineering culture, empowering product teams with tools to build AI-enabled features, and establishing a robust Application Security (AppSec) posture.

You will manage a group of engineering managers and staff engineers. You will act as a strategic multiplier for the company, treating our internal platform as a top-tier product. Your ultimate goal is to create secure, high-velocity "paved paths" that make our product teams incredibly fast, while systematically reducing technical debt and security risks.

## **What you'll do**

- **Direct the Monolith Evolution:** Own the multi-year technical strategy to safely decouple our legacy Python/Jinja monolith into a modern, modular FastAPI architecture using Domain-Driven Design and zero-downtime database migration tactics.
- **Drive the AI-Native SDLC:** Champion the rollout and adoption of AI-assisted coding tools and AI-augmented workflows across the entire engineering organization, systematically measuring and improving developer productivity.
- **Enable AI Feature Development:** Treat the internal platform as a product. Guide the development of intuitive SDKs, data pipelines, and internal tools that reduce cognitive load and allow product engineers to easily integrate LLMs and build AI-powered features.
- **Lead Application Security (AppSec):** Champion a "shift-left" security culture. Embed secure coding practices, automated vulnerability scanning, and threat modeling directly into developer workflows, ensuring our core platform is resilient against modern threats.
- **Oversee Core Shared Services:** Drive the scale, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical systems, including Identity (AuthN/AuthZ, OAuth2, RBAC), Audit Logs, and high-throughput API & MCP Gateways.
- **Navigate Org-Wide Boundaries:** Negotiate complex refactoring timelines with Product leaders and collaborate seamlessly with other Engineering teams and DevOps to align our platform capabilities with infrastructure.
- **Build a World-Class Organization:** Recruit, mentor, and grow a high-performing organization of engineering managers and staff/principal engineers, fostering a culture of architectural pragmatism and deep developer empathy.

## **Qualifications**

- 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering leadership, including explicitly managing managers and leading multiple teams.
- High AI Fluency: Proven experience architecting systems that support AI features (LLMs, RAG, tool calling) and a track record of driving AI-assisted development tools (AI SDLC) across engineering teams.
- An executive track record of successfully guiding massive monolith-to-modular migrations and decoupling shared database schemas in high-traffic, business-critical environments.
- Deep strategic understanding of Application Security principles, Identity/Access Management (OAuth 2.0, OIDC), and modern API traffic management.
- Strong technical fluency in Python and FastAPI ecosystems, with the ability to guide Staff-level engineers through complex architectural decisions involving both modern APIs and legacy applications.
- Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, security, and AI trade-offs into business value.

## **Compensation**

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, bonus, equity and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range is $230,000 - $285,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

- Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family
- Life insurance
- Mental wellness coverage
- Fertility and growing family support
- Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays
- Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies
- Retirement saving plans
- Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home
- Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience and Reliability (AI-Native)
description:
# The short version
We're a six-person full-stack team (Go, React) building manufacturing execution software that runs on real factory floors. We're adding a seventh engineer whose focus is not the next feature ticket, but helping everything the team ships be correct, well-tested, and ready for customers, and making that faster over time.

This is not a QA role in the traditional sense. You won't sit downstream of the team clicking through release candidates. You'll be a peer engineer with the same technical bar as everyone else, reviewing code alongside the rest of the team before it merges, owning the release pipeline, and using AI and automation to replace the slow, manual parts of quality work with tooling everyone benefits from.

If you're a strong full-stack engineer who gets more satisfaction from finding the edge case nobody thought of, or from cutting a two-week release process down to two days, than from shipping the feature itself, this is the role.

We're a fully remote company with teammates spread across five-plus time zones, and we don't have project managers driving day-to-day progress. That shapes who thrives here: people who can take an ambiguous goal, decide what to do next, communicate clearly in writing, and keep moving without someone checking in. More on that below.

# What you'll do
Review code as a core part of your job. PR review is our biggest bottleneck, and you'll add real capacity to it as one of the team's regular reviewers. You'll read Go and React code critically for correctness, edge cases, test coverage and test quality, and the failure modes that show up in production rather than in the happy path. Every engineer here still owns their own work and still reviews each other's code; you bring an additional, dedicated lens on quality, and your feedback lands while the code is still being written rather than after a release.

Own the release process end to end. You'll drive what "ready for customers" means and make sure we get there. That means working with product, customer success, and implementation teams to understand how customers actually use the product, translating that into test coverage and release criteria, and being the person who confidently says a release is good to go. You'll set the standard with the team, not for it: the best release process is one the whole team believes in and follows without being chased.

Build the tooling, don't be the tooling. Where quality work is manual today (regression testing, environment setup, release verification), your job is to automate it. You'll own our CI/CD pipelines, test infrastructure, and quality tooling, and you'll use AI aggressively: agent-driven test generation, AI-assisted code review, automated exploratory testing, and whatever else works. We expect you to evaluate what's real versus hype and build what actually moves the needle.

Support the team's projects rather than run your own. You'll be embedded in other engineers' work: pairing on test strategy early in a project, helping design for testability, flagging risk in design reviews, and stepping in on hard bugs. You'll write production code when it serves quality, reliability, or developer velocity, and occasionally pick up a feature ticket when the team needs it, but your default mode is force multiplier, not individual feature owner.

Raise the quality bar with the team, not over it. Over time, the team should get better at testing and reviewing because you're on it. You'll propose patterns, write the reference examples, and make the case for changes; when the team disagrees, you'll argue your position, then commit to the decision and make it work. This role succeeds through influence and trust, not authority.

# What we're looking for
## Must have

5+ years as a professional software engineer, with meaningful time as a full-stack developer. You've built and shipped production systems, not just tested them.

Strong enough in Go and modern React/TypeScript to review a senior engineer's PR and have your comments taken seriously. Deep experience in one and solid experience in the other is fine; you'll be reviewing both.

A track record of owning CI/CD and test infrastructure: designing test strategies, building automated test suites (unit, integration, end-to-end), and keeping pipelines fast and trustworthy.

Hands-on, current use of AI tools in your engineering workflow, and opinions about where they help and where they don't. You've used coding agents for more than autocomplete and can talk about what you've automated with them.

The instinct for what breaks. You think in edge cases, failure modes, and "what happens when the network drops halfway through this," and you can explain that risk to a non-engineer.

Comfort working directly with non-engineering stakeholders to define what "done and ready" actually means.

Clear, kind, and direct written communication. Most of your impact will land through PR comments, design feedback, and release notes, often read hours later by someone in a different time zone.

Self-direction. You can take a goal like "make releases boring," break it into work, decide what matters most, and make steady progress without a project manager setting the pace. When something is ambiguous, you ask a good question or make a reasonable call and move; you don't wait.

Team instincts. You can hold a strong opinion, make the case for it, hear the counterargument, and commit fully to whatever the team decides, including when it isn't your preference.

## Nice to have

Experience with the operational side of software: observability, release management, on-prem or edge deployments, or hardware-adjacent systems.

Familiarity with manufacturing, industrial software, or other environments where downtime has a physical cost.

Experience with SOC 2, ITAR, or similar compliance requirements as they apply to release process.

Experience at a small company where you had to build process from scratch rather than inherit it.

## Who this role is not for
We want to be upfront so we don't waste your time:

If you want to spend most of your week shipping your own features, this isn't the role. Your output is measured in the team's quality and velocity, not your ticket count.

If your QA experience is primarily manual test execution or test-case management without a strong engineering background, you'll find the review and tooling expectations a stretch.

If you see AI tooling as a threat to quality rather than a lever for it, we'll disagree on strategy from day one.

If you do your best work with a manager or PM setting daily priorities and checking in on progress, a fully remote, multi-time-zone team without that structure will feel like too little support rather than freedom.

## Why this role matters here
Our software runs on factory floors. When it's wrong, production lines stall and real people feel it. We think the best way to protect quality is to build it in from the start: quality expertise in the design conversation, in the code review, and in the pipeline, rather than as a checkpoint at the end. This role exists to make that a permanent part of how the team works, and you'll have the autonomy and the mandate to shape it.

You'll join a small, senior team where your work is visible immediately and where the release process, test infrastructure, and quality practices are yours to shape together with the people who'll live with them.

## How we work
Pico is fully remote, with teammates across five or more US and international time zones. In practice that means a lot of our collaboration is asynchronous and written: design docs, PR threads, and clear status updates carry more weight than meetings. We keep a small set of overlapping hours for the conversations that need to be live.

We don't have project managers on the engineering team. Priorities come from the team and from the company's goals, and each engineer is trusted to turn those into a plan, surface blockers early, and keep things moving. It's a lot of autonomy, and it works because everyone here takes ownership of both their own work and the team's shared outcomes.

## About Pico MES
Pico MES builds manufacturing execution system software for modern factories, along with the on-site network appliances that connect it to the shop floor. We support customers in many industries, from consumer products, aerospace & defense, automotive and more.




Pico MES is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Because of ITAR requirements, this role is limited to US persons as defined by 22 CFR 120.62.

title: Software Engineer, Internal Audit (All Levels)
description:
## About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners—specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

You'll join a genuine 0→1 team on the ground floor of one of the company's biggest new bets. You will work full-stack on long-horizon agents, ship features that do real audit work, and work alongside practitioners.

Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join building within a major agent area, owning one end-to-end, or setting technical direction for agentic audit work across the team. - Ship code from day one and ramp quickly into full ownership of significant product areas
- Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and SOX subject matter experts to work through difficult domain problems

## Higher-Level Responsibilities

**Nice-to-have:**

## What Should Excite You

- 401(k) plan
- Twice-yearly in-person offsites across the U.S.

***How would you like to work in an environment in which you can directly shape the product?***

At Molten Cloud, we don't believe in artificial boundaries or engineering silos. We don't split our team into front-end and back-end camps; everyone here has the opportunity to work across the entire stack. We pair this high level of project autonomy with a fully remote setup, company-covered AI coding tools, and a healthy culture that actually insists you take your vacation time.

Born out of MIT, Molten Cloud simplifies today’s complex intellectual property rights, content, and royalties operations for the media industry. Our platform is already used by major organizations to manage hundreds of millions of film and TV rights and host petabytes of content. * Modern Tooling: We want you to move fast. The company completely covers your subscriptions for advanced AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude.
* Real Flexibility: We offer work flexibility, and we are serious about you actually taking time off.  10 days a year — minimum.

* The Package: Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits, a top-tier hardware setup provided by us, and a 401K plan (no company match just yet).

* Take ownership of, and lead, a team of engineers for the timely delivery of features based on Agile sprints.
* Review code developed by your team of engineers, and aid in their training and development.
* Contribute to the design, architecture, research and development of core platform and applications (which may include aspects of data transmission, cryptography, back-end and front-end development).
* Own application features end to end: building, deploying, and iterating at every stage.
* Work across both the backend and frontend to design, architect, and scale our core platform.
* Ensure high performance, accuracy, and security for global user groups handling massive data streams.
* Collaborate directly with our Chief Product Officer and Lead Engineers to align your work with the broader product vision.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Core Tech: Technical proficiency in Python and JavaScript.
* Our Stack (Bonus Points): Experience with Vue.js, Pinia, TypeScript, MongoDB, AI/LLMs, or DevOps tools is a major plus.

If you want to build technology that impacts the global media landscape from the comfort of your own home, we want to hear from you. Send your resume to Steve Gold at steve.gold@moltencloud.com.

title: Founding Engineer (AI & Agentic Systems)
description:
Codexa is building an agent-first CRM. Instead of reps working a CRM by hand, our AI agents run the revenue operation itself: outbound, qualification, and pipeline management, end-to-end, replacing traditional SDR and AE workflows. The MVP is live, we have paying clients, and the core architecture is already running client campaigns.

We're looking to hire a founding engineer to own the intelligence layer of the product. This person lives entirely on the agentic and AI side of Codexa: the orchestration that decides what every agent does next, the LLM systems behind it, and the voice infrastructure that runs live calls. It's an AI-focused seat, but not an AI-only one. We're building a full CRM, so you need real full-stack engineering behind you. 

**Compensation**

This role starts on a fully deferred cash comp rather than a standard salary. It's a market-rate role with pay deferred and repaid at a premium once we hit a funding or revenue milestone. We're upfront that this is a real trade: less cash now, real upside as the company grows. Happy to walk through the specifics directly.

**What you'd own**

* The agentic orchestration layer: the state machine and decision engine that runs each lead end-to-end across email and voice, including our Next Best Action logic, escalation, and handoff rules
* Our LLM stack: model integration and routing, prompt systems, tool and function calling, retrieval and vector memory, and the evals and guardrails that keep agent behavior safe and reliable in production
* Voice AI: the real-time voice agent stack, from call orchestration and latency tuning to qualification on live calls
* The reasoning and data enrichment pipeline as it scales from internal tooling into a productized platform
* Application development around all of it: the backend services, data models, and APIs the agents run on
* Engineering standards for how we build AI systems from the ground up, where your calls on frameworks and architecture will stick

**What we're looking for**

* Hands-on experience building agentic systems with orchestration frameworks like LangGraph and LangChain, not just calling an LLM in a loop
* Strong applied LLM engineering: prompt design, tool and function calling, RAG, vector databases, and structured outputs, with real production experience
* Voice AI experience: real-time voice agents, telephony, and the ability to structure and tune latency-sensitive call flows
* Comfort integrating and routing across model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, OpenRouter) and reasoning about cost, latency, and reliability trade-offs
* Solid full-stack engineering: able to ship end-to-end across backend, data, and APIs (Node.js/TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, queues and workers) 
* Experience with multi-agent or event-driven architectures and state machines
* Startup or 0-to-1 experience preferred, and comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration
* Based in Canada or the US with overlap in Eastern hours.

**Strong pluses**
* Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for giving agents controlled access to internal and external systems
* LLM observability and evals: tracing, prompt versioning, and offline and online evaluation
* Multi-tenant, workspace-isolated architecture at scale
* Experience building enrichment or data pipelines that feed agent decisioning

title: Healthcare Data Architect
description:
Empower is a high-growth, innovation-driven company focused on delivering impactful solutions that transform how healthcare organizations operate. Our team combines deep industry expertise with a commitment to excellence, enabling us to solve complex challenges at scale. We foster a collaborative, results-oriented culture where high performers thrive, ideas are valued, and continuous improvement is expected. We move quickly, think strategically, and hold a high bar for performance, while supporting each other in achieving ambitious goals.

If you care about building a data foundation that powers real-time ML predictions, enjoy working at the intersection of data architecture, performance engineering, and healthcare interoperability, and want your work to have a direct impact on patient care, you will feel at home here.

### Summary of Role 

We are seeking an experienced Healthcare Data Architect to join the Empower Healthcare team. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience working directly for Epic, given the depth of platform knowledge that brings to designing and optimizing our data environment.

We are not an EHR. We currently consume Epic-sourced clinical data through Snowflake, our data warehouse, and use it to power ML models whose outputs are displayed to end users in near real time. Live integration with EHR/FHIR APIs directly is on our near-term roadmap. This role owns the architecture connecting those data sources to fast, reliable predictions our users can act on.

This is not a general software engineering role. It requires deep, demonstrable expertise in healthcare data architecture, Snowflake performance engineering, and low-latency data serving. Candidates should expect technical questions that go well beyond surface familiarity, and applicants without direct, verifiable experience in this domain will not be considered.

This is an immediate need and we are actively hiring. The interview process includes an intro call, behavioral interview, a technical interview administered by the Engineering Manager, and a final interview with Senior Leadership.

**Responsibilities**

*  Architect the data layer connecting Snowflake to the application, optimized for low-latency retrieval at inference time.
*  Design data models, indexes, and query patterns that support real-time and near-real-time ML inference.
*  Partner with the ML team on feature pipelines and serving architecture (feature stores, caching, precomputation) to meet strict latency requirements.
*  Own Snowflake performance tuning for high-throughput, low-latency application queries.
*  Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines moving Epic-sourced data from Snowflake into structures suited for ML consumption.
*  Design and lead upcoming live integrations with EHR/FHIR APIs (SMART on FHIR, HL7), building on the current Snowflake-based pipeline.
*  Define APIs/interfaces with application engineers for serving model outputs to the UI.
*  Establish and enforce data governance, data quality, and security standards across the data environment.
*  Ensure architecture and data practices comply with HIPAA and other applicable healthcare regulations.
*  Document technical decisions and contribute to internal runbooks and data architecture standards.


### **Must Have**

Data architecture:

* 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data modeling, or data warehousing, with a strong focus on healthcare data.
* Working knowledge of Epic data models (Clarity/Caboodle) sufficient to work effectively with Epic-sourced data.
* Demonstrated experience designing low-latency data serving layers for application or ML consumption, not just batch reporting.

Interoperability:

Experience with HL7 and FHIR (R4), including SMART on FHIR app integration and OAuth 2.0-based authorization flows, and the ability to lead a future live EHR/FHIR integration effort.

Data engineering:

Strong SQL skills and experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.


### **Nice to Have**

 Performance and ML serving:

Direct, hands-on experience with Snowflake, including query and warehouse performance tuning for high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
Experience feeding data to production ML models and serving predictions to end users quickly (caching, precomputation, feature stores, or similar techniques

* Prior direct employment at Epic Systems, or Epic certification (Clarity or Caboodle).
* Experience with Snowpark or other Snowflake-native processing tools.
* Experience with real-time feature stores (e.g., Feast, Tecton) or caching layers (e.g., Redis) for ML serving.
* Security and compliance:
* Deep knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare data governance requirements.
* Experience implementing data security controls, including access management and audit logging.
* Experience with population health data, value-based care models, or risk scoring (e.g., HCC, RAF).
* Master's degree in data science, computer science, or a related field.

**Technology Stack (Relevant to This Role)**

**Data platform**
* Snowflake (connector, Snowpark), PostgreSQL
**EHR / Interoperability**
* Epic Clarity, Epic Caboodle, FHIR R4, SMART on FHIR OAuth, HL7 (upcoming live integration)
**ML serving**
* Feature stores, caching layers, low-latency query design
**Data engineering**
* SQL, ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling and warehousing tools
**Auth / Security**
* OAuth 2.0, HashiCorp Vault, audit logging, HIPAA-aligned access controls
**Infra / Tooling**
* Git, GitHub, CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions), Docker



**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, OR equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience in data architecture, with direct experience in healthcare data environments.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfort working in a healthcare/regulated context where accuracy, security, and compliance matter.
* Eligible to work in the United States and currently reside in United States. 
* **Pass stringent background checks pertinent to the healthcare industry (Identity Verification, Criminal Check, OIG / SAM, FACIS L3) and a pre-employment drug test.**
* Discipline to work in a fully remote environment while staying on task and engaged.

title: AI Revenue Engine Lead
description:
**AI Revenue Engine Lead**

**About the Role**

We’re hiring a senior operator to find and fix the highest-impact problems in Better Health’s revenue engine.

Your mandate is simple: **find where the funnel is broken and make it better.**

You’ll work across the entire revenue journey, from lead generation through enrollment, documentation, shipment, and recurring revenue. You’ll use data to identify bottlenecks and opportunities, get to the root cause, and then own the solution end-to-end.

This is a hands-on role. You won’t just diagnose problems or make recommendations. You’ll redesign processes, leverage AI and automation, improve systems, and lead cross-functional projects through implementation and measurable results.

You’ll report to the SVP of Strategy and Operations and work directly with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Operations, RCM, Finance, Product, and Engineering on some of the company’s highest-priority growth problems.

## **What You’ll Do**

### **Find and Fix Revenue Problems**

- Continuously audit the revenue funnel to identify conversion gaps, bottlenecks, broken handoffs, manual work, and opportunities for growth.
- Use data to get to the root cause of performance problems and prioritize opportunities based on business impact.
- Own high-priority initiatives end-to-end, from defining the problem and developing the solution through implementation and measuring results.
- Redesign processes and workflows rather than accepting “this is how we’ve always done it.”
- Use AI and automation aggressively where they can improve conversion, prioritization, speed, visibility, or team productivity.

### **Run the Revenue Engine**

- Own the weekly revenue operating cadence, including funnel performance, forecasting, key drivers, risks, and actions.
- Build the analytics and leading indicators that help us understand where performance is headed and why.
- Maintain a consistent view of the funnel and ensure teams are working from trusted data and definitions.
- Own CRM and revenue systems governance, while partnering with other teams on larger systems and technical implementations.

### **Drive Cross-Functional Execution**

- Turn ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, workplans, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
- Bring together the right people across functions and drive projects forward without waiting for perfect information or organizational structure.
- Pressure-test assumptions, make recommendations, and hold teams accountable for execution.
- Measure whether changes actually worked and iterate quickly when they didn’t.

## **What You’ll Bring**

- 8+ years of experience building and operating businesses, ideally across high-growth startups, strategy & operations, revenue operations, consulting, product, or similar roles.
- A track record of taking ambiguous, high-impact business problems from identification through measurable results.
- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. You can dive into the data yourself and turn it into action.
- Strong project management skills and the ability to drive execution across teams without direct authority.
- Fluency with AI and automation and a strong instinct for where technology can fundamentally improve how work gets done.
- Strong business judgment, low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward action.
- Comfort getting into the details. This is a builder/operator role, not a strategy-only role.
- Experience in a fast-growing startup is strongly preferred.
- **Former founders, early-stage operators, or people who have built functions from scratch are especially compelling.**
- Healthcare experience is helpful but not required.

## **Why This Role Is Different**

You won’t inherit a narrow function or a fixed playbook. You’ll be expected to find the problems that matter, figure out why they exist, and own fixing them.

The goal is not better reporting. **The goal is a better-performing revenue engine.**

Compensation: The expected base salary range for this role is $130,000–$200,000, depending on experience, skills, and location. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
As a Staff Data Scientist at an early-stage, high-growth company, you'll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights and apps that shape strategy, fuel growth, and improve the customer experience. You'll have a direct hand in the decisions that move the business, not just the reports that describe it.

This isn't a "run the numbers and hand off a deck" role. You'll be partnering directly with senior leaders and an experienced data & analytics team to drive data science and experimentation initiatives across sales, marketing, and product areas — putting both traditional analysis and ML to effect change.

**What You'll Get to Do:**

- Architect optimization analyses and forecasts that help leaders pinpoint opportunities across Growth, Strategy, Revenue, Marketing, and Product teams.
- Partner directly with executive leadership, translating complex analysis into clear, actionable decisions and process changes.
- Design counterfactual analyses and A/B tests to enable data-driven evolution of our UX, product features and customer experience.
- Build data apps that automate and supercharge our sales and marketing processes.
- Own your projects end-to-end — from framing the business question to shipping the model to presenting the recommendation, with the autonomy to decide how you get there.
- Work on top the same semantic layer and DBT models powering our AI-driven analytics stack (Snowflake Cortex, Sigma, Claude, etc.), so your analyses build on a single-source-of-truth data.
- Create data science frameworks — templates and guides that data practitioners across the org can leverage and build upon.

**What You'll Bring to the Role:**

- Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack — Snowflake, DBT, and various BI tools (Sigma, Looker, Metabase, Omni, or similar).
- Strong SQL and statistical modeling skills, with a track record of building forecasting and causal inference models.
- A love of documentation and Git — you enable others to build on top of your work..
- You appreciate scalable data models — you contribute to the shared semantic layer, and let the whole org benefit.
- You're just as excited to hack together a scrappy new analysis or app as you are to build scalable products that meet stringent quality standards.

**Who You Are:**

- Self-driven and organized, with the ability to manage projects across cross-functional stakeholder groups with minimal oversight, keeping everyone updated on progress and next steps.
- You don't wait for direction — you spot the opportunity, make the case, and drive it through.
- An amazing communicator and presenter, equally comfortable in a room with executive leadership or heads-down in the data.
- A true team player — you love brainstorming, peer reviews, and pressure-testing ideas.
- You're in it for the journey, not just the destination.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
# Origin 

Origin is building the AI-native wealth management platform that democratizes sophisticated financial services — combining money management, personalized AI-grounded advice, and financial products in a single intelligent system. We're a Series B company founded by repeat entrepreneurs, backed by Founders Fund, Felicis, and General Catalyst.

We've reached profitability and are expanding from our core personal-finance product into banking, high-yield savings, and mortgage & insurance referrals — while growing 100%+ year over year.

## The Role

You'll own AI-driven product surfaces inside one of the most design-obsessed consumer finance products in the market. You will report to the CTO, partner daily with the CEO, and ship hands-on against the two things Origin is maniacal about: **speed** and **design**.

### What you'll own

- End-to-end product surface for a major area of the Origin Financial app (AI assistant, planning, investing, or onboarding — scoped on day one with the CTO).
- The full PM craft, hands-on. You write the PRDs, run the discovery, push the Figma files with our design partner, define the test plan, draft the QA cases, sit in on engineering standups, and own the metric.
- AI-native execution. You're expected to use AI heavily — for research, competitive teardowns, prototypes, PRD drafts, deck building, test-plan generation, exec readouts. Tooling preference is yours; the bar is the output and the speed.
- The interface between engineering, design, marketing, and Origin Financial's leadership team. You make the cross-functional motion run.
- Metric ownership. Every ship declares its activation / retention / ARPU / NPS target before the build starts, and you own the readout after.

### How you work

- **Low ego.** Thoughtful, an amazing listener, and want to deeply understand problems before acting. You happily share credit and split scope with peers. You'd rather be right tomorrow than loud today.
- **Hands-on, every day.** No throwing work over the wall. You produce the artifacts yourself.
- **You move fast.** A week feels long. You ship the smallest thing that proves the bet.
- **Design taste is non-negotiable.** You don't have to push pixels, but you must be able to look at two flows and pick the better one — and say why.
- **You write.** Specs, decision memos, post-mortems. Writing is the artifact at Origin.

### What you've done

- 6+ years in product management with shipping reps in both a larger company (mature surface, real scale, real cross-functional rigor) and a small / early-stage company (0→1, no scaffolding, owned a P&L).
- Strong written communicator. Your PRDs, decision docs, and exec updates are short, testable, and unambiguous.
- Either one of the two paths:
  - 3+ years in financial services — consumer fintech, wealth, neobank, brokerage, lending, or insurance. You understand RIA / BD / custody / regulated-flow constraints well enough to ship without breaking them.
  - 3+ years in highly competitive direct-to-consumer SaaS — consumer product, growth and distribution, rapid iteration and research. You understand the metrics and the pace required in a competitive marketplace.
- AI-product experience *(nice to have)* — you've shipped an AI feature (LLM-backed, agentic, or assistive) inside a consumer or financial product, with real metrics.
- Quantitative fluency *(nice to have)* — you pull your own data if needed. You read a retention curve and a funnel without a deck. You partner with data leadership for complex modelling, but don't sit idle.

### This is not the role if

- You expect a "hand-off executive" seat where you delegate the craft. At Origin you own both the vision and execution.
- You believe AI-leveraged PM work is beneath you. Origin is an AI-heavy org — if you wouldn't draft your own PRD with AI, this isn't your role.

## Reporting & Location

- Reports to the CTO. Weekly 1:1 with the CTO; bi-weekly 1:1 with the CEO. Direct exposure to the founders is structural, not optional.
- Monthly Boston on-site. 2–3 days at our Boston HQ during one designated week; travel covered. No Boston residency required.

## What We Offer for This Role

- Principal PM band, calibrated for Tier-1 metropolitan areas.
- Meaningful equity grant package.
- Travel covered for in-office weeks.
- Healthcare.
- Wellness stipend.
- Mental wellness program.
- Unlimited access to financial planning.
- Life insurance.
- Retirement 401k.
- Unlimited DPTO.
- Paid Parental Leave.
- Parenthood and fertility assistance.
- Monthly co-working membership reimbursement.
- Build your home office one-time stipend.
- Pick your setup (Apple, Windows) and accessories.

## Eligibility Requirements

- Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
- Origin does not sponsor visas.

## Originals

Fulfilling our mission is only possible with a diverse team that breathes for excellence and is hugely committed to making money simple for everyone, everywhere.

As a team, we are obsessed with delivering the best solution possible to our members through an elegant and self-guided experience. We know that building a product of this magnitude requires from us tons of creativity, autonomy, and flexibility to move fast and embrace uncertainties with ownership. This is who we daily pursue to be!

To embrace talented people like this and provide the necessary resources to achieve their best versions, we believe in the power of a healthy environment where each person is valued for who they are and have clear goals and expectations for the future they can build within the company. Each person here is seen as a key player in our team.

Our environment is diverse, with excellent people and equal opportunities. We believe in the power of the individuality and uniqueness of each of us to make our team even more powerful.

We are building an outstanding solution, and here is an invitation for you to become an Original and join us on this journey!

**Company:** [SourceIQ](https://SourceIQ.Cloud)
**Location:** Remote
**Duration:**  3-6 months (with potential for conversion to full-time)
**Compensation:** Unpaid (Academic credit available)
**Start Date:** Flexible (Rolling applications) Winter 

**About SourceIQ**
SourceIQ is an AI-powered supplier management and sourcing platform transforming how enterprises discover, evaluate, onboard, and collaborate with suppliers. We automate compliance, analytics, and sourcing workflows from end to end, helping companies streamline procurement operations.

We're building the infrastructure layer for enterprise procurement—a platform designed to consolidate a fragmented $50B market by becoming the centralized intelligence and data layer that integrates with all procurement tools.

**The Role**
As a **Data Engineering Intern**, you'll build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers SourceIQ's AI models and analytics. You'll work with **Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, and Azure** to create ETL pipelines, process large datasets, and ensure data quality across our platform.

This is hands-on data engineering where you'll contribute directly to production data pipelines used by enterprise customers including JP Morgan and Humana. You'll work closely with our Head of Technology, ML engineers, and backend team to build the data foundation for our AI-powered platform.

You'll learn modern data engineering practices including lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, PySpark, and data quality frameworks while working on real business problems.

**What You'll Do**

* ETL Pipeline Development (Primary Focus)
* Build and maintain ETL pipelines using Python and PySpark on Databricks
* Process supplier data from multiple sources:
CSV imports from conferences and events
State/local government databases (150K+ suppliers)
Association databases
ERP systems (Coupa, SAP Ariba, QuickBooks)
API integrations (real-time data ingestion)
* Implement schema mapping to standardize non-standard data formats
* Create automated data refresh pipelines (e.g., marketplace data updated every 30 days)

**Data Quality & Validation**
* Design and implement data quality checks and validation rules
* Build data profiling and completeness scoring systems
* Create deduplication logic to identify duplicate suppliers across sources
* Implement data cleansing (address normalization, phone validation, etc.)
* Monitor data quality metrics and set up alerting for anomalies

**Lakehouse Architecture (Databricks)**
* Work with Delta Lake (Bronze → Silver → Gold layers)
Bronze: Raw data ingestion from all sources
Silver: Cleaned, deduplicated, standardized data
Gold: Aggregated features for ML models and analytics
* Design and optimize data models for analytics and ML workloads
* Implement data versioning and time travel for auditability
* Work with Unity Catalog for data governance and access control

**Analytics & Reporting Support**
* Create aggregated data tables for dashboards and BI tools
* Build data marts for spend analytics, supplier performance, and engagement metrics
* Optimize query performance for reporting workloads
* Support ad-hoc data analysis requests from product and business teams

**Data Pipeline Orchestration**
* Implement Databricks Jobs for scheduled data processing
* Build idempotent, fault-tolerant pipelines with retry logic
* Monitor pipeline health and performance
* Create data lineage documentation

**Collaboration & Process**
* Follow Jira tasks and sprint cycles
* Participate in code reviews focused on data quality and pipeline reliability
* Document data schemas, transformations, and pipeline dependencies
* Work cross-functionally with ML, backend, and product team

**Required Qualifications**

**Technical Skills (Must Have)**
* ✅ Strong Python programming skills (data manipulation with Pandas, NumPy)
* ✅ SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, subqueries, window functions)
* ✅ Understanding of ETL concepts and data pipeline design
* ✅ Experience working with data (cleaning, transformation, analysis)
* ✅ Database knowledge (relational or NoSQL - PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)
* ✅ Git/GitHub proficiency for version control
* ✅ Basic understanding of data modeling and schema design

**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Apache Spark or PySpark
* Familiarity with Databricks or cloud data platforms
* Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud services
* Knowledge of data warehousing concepts (fact/dimension tables, star schema)
* Understanding of streaming data and event-driven architectures
* Experience with data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, dbt)
* Familiarity with orchestration tools (Airflow, Databricks Workflows)
* Knowledge of data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
* Understanding of distributed computing concepts

**Mindset & Approach**
* Detail-oriented: Data quality matters—you care about edge cases and validation
* **Ownership mentality: You build it, you monitor it, you fix it**
* Systems thinker: You understand how data flows through the entire platform
* Pragmatic problem solver: Balance perfect solutions with shipping quickly
* Collaborative: Work well with engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders

**What You'll Learn**

**Data Engineering Skills**
* Lakehouse architecture: Modern data platform combining data lakes and warehouses
* Databricks ecosystem: Industry-leading platform for data engineering and ML
* PySpark: Distributed data processing at scale (handle millions of records)
* Delta Lake: ACID transactions, time travel, schema evolution
* ETL best practices: Idempotency, error handling, monitoring, testing

**Data Quality & Governance**
* Data validation frameworks: Automated quality checks and anomaly detection
* Schema design: Optimal data models for analytics and ML
* Data lineage: Track data from source to consumption
* Access control: Role-based permissions and data security
* Compliance: GDPR, CCPA requirements for enterprise data

**Cloud & Infrastructure**
* Azure services: Blob Storage, SQL Database, Cognitive Search
* Scalable architecture: Design systems that handle growing data volume
* Cost optimization: Efficient data storage and compute usage
* Monitoring: Pipeline health, data quality metrics, performance tracking

**Why Join SourceIQ?**
✨ Real-world data engineering: Build pipelines processing 150K+ suppliers and millions in procurement spend
🚀 Hands-on mentorship: Work directly with our Head of Technology and senior data engineers
📈 Career acceleration: Exceptional interns convert to full-time data engineering roles
💡 Modern data stack: Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake—the tools used by leading tech companies
🌍 Mission-driven work: Build data infrastructure that creates economic opportunities for diverse suppliers
🎯 High-impact work: Your pipelines will power AI models and analytics from day one
📊 Rich data environment: Work with real enterprise data from Fortune 500 companies

**Our Data Tech Stack**

**Data Platform (Your Primary Focus):**
* Databricks (unified data + ML platform)
* Delta Lake (lakehouse storage)
* PySpark (distributed processing)
* Databricks Jobs (orchestration)
* Unity Catalog (governance)
* Databricks SQL (analytics)
* Apache Spark (distributed data processing)
* Python (data engineering scripts, transformation logic)

**Data Storage:**
MongoDB (NoSQL, application database)
Azure SQL / PostgreSQL (relational data)
Azure Blob Storage (raw files, documents)
Delta Lake (unified data storage with ACID)

**Data Sources:**
CSV imports (conferences, events, leads)
State/local databases (API and bulk downloads)
Association databases
ERP integrations (Coupa, SAP Ariba, QuickBooks)
Real-time events (user interactions, transactions)

**Search & Analytics:**
Azure Cognitive Search (full-text and vector search)
Databricks SQL (analytics queries)
Redis (caching layer)

**ML Integration:**
MLflow (feature engineering, model training)
Databricks Feature Store (reusable features)
TensorFlow / scikit-learn (ML model consumption)

**DevOps:**
Git/GitHub (version control)
GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps (CI/CD)
Docker (containerization)

**Application Requirements**

*Please submit the following:*
1. Resume/CV highlighting data/analytics coursework, projects, and experience
2. GitHub profile with code samples (Python, SQL preferred)
3. Portfolio showcasing data work:
Data analysis projects (Jupyter notebooks)
ETL scripts or pipeline code
SQL queries demonstrating complexity
Data visualization dashboards

**Brief cover letter (200-300 words) answering:**
* Why are you interested in data engineering at SourceIQ?
* Describe a data quality issue you've encountered and how you solved it
* What excites you most about working with large-scale data pipelines?

**Note: During the interview process, you may be asked to:**
Walk through a data project you've completed
Write SQL queries to solve a business problem
Discuss how you would design an ETL pipeline for a given scenario

**Commitment & Expectations**
* Time commitment: 20-40 hours per week (flexible based on your schedule)
* Duration: Minimum 3 months, with potential to extend to 6 months
* Work style: Remote-first with regular video standups and async collaboration
* Academic credit: Available for students whose universities offer it
* Mentorship: Weekly 1:1s with senior engineers, regular code reviews, pair programming

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

*You might be a great fit if you:*
🎓 Are pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field
💻 Have completed coursework in databases, data structures, or data analysis
📊 Have worked with real data (messy, incomplete, from multiple sources)
🔧 Enjoy solving data quality problems and building robust pipelines
🚀 Are excited about building infrastructure that powers AI and analytics
🌱 Want to learn modern data engineering tools and best practices
⚡ Care about performance and scalability of data systems

**Ready to Apply?**
If you're passionate about data engineering, eager to build production pipelines, and excited about transforming enterprise procurement with clean, reliable data, we want to hear from you!
To apply: Send your resume, GitHub profile, data portfolio, and cover letter to [zishan@sourceiq.cloud] with the subject line "Data Engineering Intern - [Your Name]"
Questions? Reach out to our team at [zishan@sourceiq.cloud]

description:
## **About Starbridge**

Starbridge helps go-to-market teams win in the public sector. Government buyers signal their priorities constantly, in council meetings, budget documents, RFPs, and public records, but that intelligence is scattered across thousands of sources and impossible to track by hand. Our platform surfaces those signals, connects them to the right buyers, and turns them into pipeline.

We move fast, stay close to our customers, and are building the category. This is a chance to join early and shape how we scale.

# **About the role**

At Starbridge, we're redefining how companies win public sector deals. Our innovative GTM intelligence platform empowers businesses to confidently approach and win more contracts in the State, Local, and Education (SLED) market—a $1.5 trillion space ripe for disruption. Leveraging AI-driven insights, we provide our clients with an unfair advantage in identifying early buying signals, streamlining outbound strategies, and automating cumbersome processes.

We're hiring a Founding Business Development Representative to help drive our explosive early-stage growth. This isn't a typical BDR job—it's an opportunity to join a fast-moving, high-impact team where your work directly contributes to the company's trajectory. In just our first three weeks, we booked 249 demos. You'll play a critical role in scaling this momentum.

## **What you'll do:**

- **Lead Initial Outreach:** Own the first touchpoint with prospects, leveraging our proprietary AI-powered insights to engage highly qualified leads through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.
- **Accelerate Pipeline Growth:** Work closely with the sales team to convert conversations into demos, constantly optimizing messaging and outreach strategies.
- **Build from Scratch:** As an early member, you'll influence the playbook for our outbound motion, shaping best practices that will scale as we grow.
- **Sales Bootcamp:** You'll receive personalized mentorship, structured sales training, and clear pathways toward becoming an Account Executive on an accelerated timeline. We expect you to learn quickly and move into a closing role.

## **Why you'll love this role:**

- **High Earning Potential:** Uncapped commission structure directly tied to your performance, rewarding your hustle and effectiveness.
- **Rapid Advancement:** Structured career growth designed to move you quickly into a higher-level sales role.
- **Perks & Support:** Meaningful equity options and comprehensive onboarding & sales training.

## **What you bring:**

- **Proven BDR experience:** Ideally 1-2 years of experience in outbound sales or business development. If you have a different background but possess grit, intelligence, and ambition, we're flexible. Convince us why you're the perfect fit.
- **Relentless & Competitive:** You thrive in competitive environments and approach challenges with resilience. The idea of spending 5 hours per day making dials fills you with excitement.
- **Coachable & Ambitious:** You actively seek feedback, apply learnings quickly, and aspire to advance into an AE role.
- **Bachelor’s Degree Required:** Field of study less important than your drive and results-oriented mindset.

If you're energized by the idea of shaping a rapidly growing startup and accelerating your sales career in a supportive, dynamic team, we want to talk to you.

## **Interview process**

We move fast — really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed. All interviews are conducted via Google Meet.

## **How we work**

- **Build Bridges to Help Customers Win -** We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.
- **Shooting Star Speed -** We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.
- **Fun Is a Feature -** Fun is a Feature means we intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.
- **In the Arena -** We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

## **Benefits include:**

- Competitive salary + early-stage equity
- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
- Unlimited PTO
- Regular offsites (NYC + global locations)

title: Software Engineer (Python, AI)
description:

title: Founding Engineer
description:
ABOUT

Early-stage startup, pre-launch. Our MVP is nearly ready. We're in stealth so we can share more about the product in a call

THE ROLE

We're hiring our founding engineer.

You'll own systems end to end and make the architecture decisions on them. You'll have input on what we build, not only how. Being able to talk to customers directly is a plus. Equity is a large part of the package.

You'd work directly with the founders. Decisions get made in a day, not in a planning cycle. There's no ticket queue and no one handing you scoped work. The first focus is to reach our MVP.

You'll set the technical standards the next engineers inherit: how we test, how we review, what we automate. As the team grows, the role grows with it. If you want to lead engineering here, that's on the table.

We'll shape the role around the right person rather than the other way round.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

* Customer-facing product. Complex, stateful interfaces used daily.
* Correctness-critical systems where bugs are costly.
* High-volume data processing that runs unattended.
* Platform work: performance, security, reliability, deployments.
* Engineering foundations: testing, tooling, automated checks, CI.

Stack: Next.js, React, Node, TypeScript, PostgreSQL.

REQUIREMENTS

* Several years shipping production software.
* Ability to ship secure and reliable code fast, leveraging AI technologies.
* B2B software experience: multi-tenant, permissioned, in production.
* Full-stack. Strong on both UI and backend/data.
* SQL and relational data modelling.
* Experience with concurrency, partial failures and production edge cases.
* You ship complete work: tested, monitored, handed over.
* You can define a spec yourself.
* Comfortable without process. No PM, no QA, no backlog groomed for you.

NICE TO HAVE

* Founding or first-engineer experience.
* Product and design judgement.
* PostgreSQL at depth: query performance, migrations, data modelling.
* Next.js and React on a large application.
* Taking a product from prototype to first paying customers.
* Setting up CI, observability or test infrastructure from scratch.

COMPENSATION

Salary plus meaningful equity. We can weight the package towards salary, towards equity, or split it — that's a conversation, not a fixed grid.

title: Senior Director of Clinical Operations
description:
**🍊Our mission**

Great science regularly stalls in the clinic, not because the science is wrong, but because the company behind it lacks the capital, infrastructure, or focus to take it all the way through. Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients.

Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. We’re a new initiative, but we’re building on a proven foundation - the same infrastructure that has delivered 82% of Lindus Health’s sponsor trials on or ahead of timeline, across 40+ completed trials across the US and Europe.

We’re in-licensing 5-7 clinical-stage, typically Phase-2-ready assets, funded directly from Lindus Health’s balance sheet. We’re targeting deal close on our first assets through 2026, with first trials launching in H1 2027.

**🍊About the role**  
  
We're looking for an exceptional Senior Director of Clinical Operations to take personal ownership of the clinical delivery of one of our five in-licensed assets, running the trial from start-up through to close-out.

You'll be accountable for that trial's clinical and regulatory execution, its quality, and its delivery on time and on budget, working closely day-to-day with the Clinical Program Manager running it and stepping in wherever a call needs to be made, whether that's on safety, protocol interpretation or trial methodology. Alongside your own asset, you'll bring that hands-on delivery experience to the wider portfolio, acting as a senior voice on our SOPs, quality bar and systems, and as a source of counsel for other trial teams.

You'll collaborate closely with members across the business, including our Chief Medical Officer, our ClinOps team across five assets, our Director of Quality, and our Product team, and you'll report to our VP Operations.  
  
**🍊About you**

**We'd like to hear from you if…**

- You have high agency and a bias for action
- You are passionate and curious about our mission; changing how the healthcare industry operates and how new health treatments are developed
- You want to learn what life is like at a high-growth, mission-driven, VC-funded startup

You belong here! If your experience and interests match with some of the below, we want you to apply:

- **15+ years** in clinical operations, with genuine hands-on delivery across multiple Phase 2 drug trials.
- Experience with complex neurology trials in chronic indications
- Real, first-hand experience making clinical, quality and safety judgement calls in real time across a range of trials.
- A track record of senior review and sign-off on essential trial documents - monitoring plans, RAMPs, protocol deviations, eTMF readiness.
- A proportionate, risk-based approach to clinical oversight - you focus on what's actually risky, not on ticking every box.
- A track record of contributing to or leading SOP and process design at a portfolio or function level, not just following processes someone else wrote.
- Broad experience across trial types, phases and therapeutic areas, with the judgement to advise operators more junior than you without taking the decision away from them.
- Comfortable shaping the tools you work in, not just using them - you've influenced how trial systems (EDC, CTMS, eTMF) get built, not only adapted to what's there.
- Genuinely energised by a portfolio-wide authority role - shaping safety, process and clinical judgement across every asset - and equally happy to get hands-on running a trial of your own once you're ramped in.
- Experience across multiple regulatory jurisdictions is a strong plus, with FDA preferred

**🍊 What you'll focus on**

- **Focus area 1: Clinical Operations Leadership on an Asset**

  - Own the delivery of the trial for one of our assets - accountable for its clinical and regulatory execution, its quality, and its delivery on time and on budget.
  - Work closely with and line-manage the Clinical Program Manager running the trial day-to-day
  - Proactively spot and mitigate risks by contributing to the assets clinical development plan, maintaining good collaboration with Programme Directors in the Corp Dev team
- **Focus area 2: Clinical Operations SME**

  - Build clinical operations and regulatory capability as we move into more complex, FDA-facing trials - raising the bar on monitoring, oversight and quality across the Clinical Operations team
  - Accountable for and input into ClinOps SOP and process design across the portfolio, partnering closely with our Director of Quality
  - Work closely with tech and product teams input into Citrus and other tools and system design from a clinical delivery perspective
  - Guide, mentor and support professional development of the wider ClinOps team
- **Focus area 3: Portfolio ClinOps Sign-off -** Senior authority on operational and quality decisions and sign-off across every trial in the LTx portfolio, covering safety, trial design and proportionality, plus sign-off on essential trial documentation and quality issues. Collaborate effectively with cross-functional leads to solve issues that arise.

**🍊 What we offer**

Make an impact across all areas of our business and fix one of the world's most broken industries.

- Competitive salary, plus meaningful stock options
- 27 days annual leave in addition to 11 National Holidays
- Health insurance coverage through our PEO Trinet
- $40 monthly wellness allowance, which you can spend on a wellhub membership, or wellness activities and expenses of your choice!
- Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks full pay for primary caregiver and 6 weeks full pay for secondary caregiver
- $2,000 Learning and Development allowance each year to put towards courses, certifications, and development
- Regular whole company and team events, both in person and virtually
- Access to gym and retail discounts through our benefits platform Happl
- Monthly lunch voucher for our remote teams
- Charity events and fundraising opportunities through our charity partnership with the Forward Trust

**🍊 Our hiring process**

- Initial conversation with Cam, our Senior Talent Partner (30 minutes)
- Second interview (45m) with Hannah, VP Operations, and Tessa
- Functional Interview (60m) with Luke, CMO, and Shane, head of Quality
- Values interview with 2 team members (30 minutes, Meri competencies with Gemma/Veronica)

**We will only contact you from** [**lindushealth.com**](http://lindushealth.com) **email addresses. Please check the spelling of emails which appear to come from Lindus carefully before responding. We will never ask for your financial information over email.**  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We evaluate all candidates based solely on their skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status

title: Junior Account Executive — B2B Sales & Business Development | Commission Only | Miles Ahead Hosting
description:

* No hourly pay
* No monthly retainer
* No guaranteed income
* No paid training
* No employee benefits
* No guarantee that existing leads will close
* No guarantee that you will earn money during your first weeks or months
Commission is earned only when a client signs, is invoiced and Miles Ahead Hosting receives cleared payment.
Commission percentages and payment terms will be agreed upon in writing before you begin working on opportunities.

You must be financially comfortable working without guaranteed income.
This is a performance-based sales position for someone who is prepared to prospect, communicate with leads, follow up consistently, qualify opportunities, attend sales calls and help close business.

Miles Ahead Hosting is a growing digital services company providing a range of technology, marketing and business solutions, including:
* Website design and development
* WordPress and Shopify solutions
* Web hosting and domains
* Search engine optimization
* Digital marketing
* Lead generation
* Branding and social media
* Custom applications
* CRM systems
* AI and business automation
* Ongoing website and technical support

Projects can range from smaller website and hosting engagements to larger digital systems, applications and ongoing growth services.

We are looking for a Sales Development Representative / Junior Account Executive to work directly under the Head of Sales / Revenue Operator.
Your role is to help turn leads and prospects into legitimate sales opportunities and, where appropriate, into paying clients.

* Outreach
* Follow-up
