title: AI Growth Engineer
description:
RedirHub is a growing B2B SaaS platform providing link infrastructure for modern websites.

Companies use us to manage domain redirects, branded links, trackable QR codes, website migrations, and redirect analytics.

We’re a small, profitable, founder-led team serving customers around the world. We already use AI agents extensively across engineering, research, content, support, and operations.

Now we want to bring that same approach to growth.

The role

We’re looking for an AI Growth Engineer who can turn growth ideas into real things that get shipped.

This sits somewhere between growth, product, and engineering.

You might notice an acquisition opportunity, research it, build a landing page or free tool, instrument it, launch it, and look at the results.

The important part is that you can go through the whole loop:

opportunity → research → build → ship → measure → iterate

We’re not looking for someone who primarily produces strategies, audits, or recommendations for other people to execute.

We want a builder.

Things you might work on

* Landing pages and conversion experiments
* Free tools, checkers, generators, and calculators
* Programmatic SEO and AEO experiments
* Interactive lead magnets
* Onboarding and activation experiments
* Small product-led growth features
* AI-powered growth automations
* Analytics and experiment instrumentation
* New growth ideas we haven’t thought of yet

You don’t need to be an expert in all of these.

We care more about whether you can identify something worth testing and independently get a useful version into the hands of real users.

How we work

You’ll work closely with the founder.

We use tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, and other AI agents heavily. You should be comfortable using AI as part of your normal building workflow.

Our web stack is primarily Next.js and TypeScript.

We move quickly, keep experiments small, and prefer real-world feedback over long planning cycles.

A good week might end with something new live on the internet and enough data to decide whether we should keep investing in it.

You might be a great fit if

* You build things yourself
* You have strong product and growth instincts
* You use AI coding tools every day
* You’re comfortable working with ambiguity
* You can move from idea to working implementation without a large team
* You understand basic funnels, conversion, and analytics
* You care about outcomes more than output
* You naturally look for leverage

Experience with B2B SaaS, developer tools, product-led growth, technical SEO, or internet infrastructure is a plus.

Side projects and things you’ve built independently matter a lot to us.

What we care about

We care much more about what you’ve built than where you worked.

When applying, show us 2–3 things you’ve actually shipped.

For each, tell us briefly:

* What problem or opportunity did you see?
* What did you personally build?
* How did AI help you build it?
* What happened after you launched?

Live products, side projects, GitHub repos, demos, and experiments are all welcome.

Starting small

We prefer to start by working together on a real, small growth experiment.

If we work well together, there’s an opportunity to take significant ownership over growth experimentation at RedirHub.

We’re looking for someone who wants to help discover what works, not simply execute a predefined marketing playbook.

title: Business Development Manager - Sonic Scout Radio
description:
**Business Development Manager**
Remote | Commission Only | Uncapped Earnings

Sonic Scout Radio is a global internet radio platform supporting unsigned and independent artists. We currently reach just over 40,000 listeners each week and, as a community funded platform, we are developing partnerships with businesses that would like to put their brand in front of our growing audience.

We are looking for motivated Business Development Managers to introduce our business promotion opportunity to small businesses with fewer than 100 employees, particularly companies that sell products online or provide services that can be accessed or purchased online.

**The opportunity is simple.**

Participating businesses have their logo displayed on the Sonic Scout Radio [https://sonicscoutradio.com/listen-live-dashboard] to our listeners through our website and app. 


When a visitor clicks the business logo, they are taken directly to a URL of the business's choice, typically their website, online store, booking page or service page.

Each month, we provide participating businesses with their number of impressions and click through rate, giving them measurable insight into the exposure their brand is receiving.

We are community funded, so we do not impose a fixed advertising fee. Instead, businesses are invited to make a contribution to support Sonic Scout Radio. Any contribution, big or small, is appreciated.

**Your Role**

You will identify and contact suitable businesses with fewer than 100 employees and introduce them to the Sonic Scout Radio business promotion opportunity.

You will explain how their logo can be displayed to our audience of more than 40,000 weekly listeners, how visitors can click directly through to their business, and how we provide monthly impression and click through reporting.

This is a fully remote role, giving you the freedom to develop your own prospect base and manage your own activity.

**Compensation**

This is a commission only opportunity with no earnings ceiling.

For every new business logo placement you secure, you receive 50% of the business's contribution.

A business contributes $100, you receive $50.

A business contributes $500, you receive $250.

A business contributes $1,000, you receive $500.

There is no ceiling on the number of businesses you can introduce or the amount you can earn.

**Who We're Looking For**

We would particularly like to hear from people with experience in business development, telesales, advertising sales, sponsorship, digital marketing or B2B relationship building.

More importantly, you should be confident speaking directly with business owners and decision makers, comfortable developing your own leads, and able to clearly communicate the value of putting a business in front of an engaged audience.

If you enjoy building relationships with small businesses and want a flexible remote opportunity where your earnings are directly connected to the business you generate, we'd love to hear from you.

**Sonic Scout Radio**
Supporting independent artists. Connecting listeners. Supporting the business community.

title: Business Development Executive (Commission-Based)
description:
**Company:** Memento Labs
**Location:** Remote
**Employment Type:** Contract / Commission-Based
**Experience:** Open to experienced professionals and motivated candidates with relevant sales/business development skills

### About Memento Labs

Memento Labs is a software development company building modern digital products and custom software for businesses worldwide.

We work with businesses and teams to turn ideas, challenges, and opportunities into reliable digital solutions — including web applications, business platforms, custom software, integrations, and automation.

We are looking for a Business Development professional who can help us identify and bring in genuine software development opportunities from international clients.

### The Role

As a Business Development Executive, you will be responsible for identifying potential clients, initiating conversations, understanding their requirements, and helping move qualified opportunities toward a project.

This is a **commission-based role**, making it particularly suitable for someone who is confident in sales and wants the opportunity to earn based on the business they bring in.

You will have flexibility in how you approach lead generation and outreach, while working closely with the Memento Labs team throughout the sales process.

### Key Responsibilities

* Identify and research potential international clients who may need software development services.
* Generate and qualify leads through LinkedIn, email outreach, networking, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Initiate conversations with prospective clients and understand their business and technical requirements.
* Present Memento Labs and communicate our services clearly and professionally.
* Schedule and participate in discovery calls with potential clients.
* Maintain communication and follow up with prospects throughout the sales process.
* Coordinate with the founder/technical team to understand project requirements and prepare suitable proposals.
* Help move qualified leads from initial contact through negotiation and project closure.
* Maintain a record of leads, conversations, follow-ups, and opportunities.

### Commission Structure

This is a **commission-only position**. There is no fixed monthly salary at the initial stage.

Commission will be paid on **successfully closed and paid projects brought in by the Business Development Executive**.

The exact commission structure will be discussed and agreed upon before starting.

There is **no requirement to make a financial investment or pay any upfront fee to Memento Labs**.

As the company grows and a consistent business pipeline is established, the role and compensation structure may be revisited.

### Who We're Looking For

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable communicating with international clients.
* Ability to independently research and identify potential prospects.
* Understanding of sales and lead-generation processes.
* Confidence in conducting professional conversations and discovery calls.
* Ability to understand client problems and communicate how software solutions can address them.
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently.
* Experience selling software development, IT services, SaaS, digital products, or related services is a plus.
* Existing international client connections or a strong B2B network is a plus, but not mandatory.

### How the Sales Process Works

You will not be expected to independently handle technical discussions or make technical commitments to clients.

The general process will be:

**Lead Generation → Initial Outreach → Qualification → Discovery Call → Technical/Project Discussion → Proposal → Negotiation → Contract → Payment → Project Kickoff**

The BD will take ownership of prospecting, relationship building, and sales coordination, while the founder/technical team can participate in discovery and closing discussions where appropriate.

### What We Offer

* Commission-based earning with no fixed ceiling tied to successful business brought in.
* Remote and flexible working arrangement.
* Opportunity to work with international clients.
* Direct collaboration with the founder and technical team.
* Freedom to develop and test your own lead-generation and outreach strategies.
* Opportunity for a longer-term role as Memento Labs grows.
* No upfront investment or joining fee.

### Important Note

This position is **strictly commission-based at the initial stage**. Please apply only if you are comfortable with a performance-based compensation model and are genuinely interested in business development and client acquisition.

If you believe you can help Memento Labs build relationships with businesses looking for software development services, we'd like to hear from you.

**Apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV and briefly tell us about your previous business development/sales experience and the types of clients or markets you have worked with.**

title: Content Creator & Social Media Specialist

* **Capture authentic stories:** Work with parents, sitters and creators to produce interviews, testimonials and user-generated content, coordinating permissions and approvals.

* **Build partnerships and creator collaborations:** Identify relevant creators, parenting communities and local businesses; coordinate outreach, content briefs and joint campaigns that grow Huddle’s reach and community.

* **Support paid-social creative:** Partner with the growth team to develop ads and adapt content into different hooks, openings, formats and calls to action.

* **Learn from performance:** Review engagement, watch time, saves, shares and conversion feedback to understand which ideas resonate and what to test next.

* **Maintain brand consistency:** Keep content recognizable, accurate and grounded in real experiences, with a voice that feels warm and trustworthy.

**What we’re looking for**

* 1–3 years of experience in content creation, social media, digital marketing or a related creative role. Freelance and portfolio experience count.

* A strong creative eye and a portfolio that shows storytelling, visual judgment and editing ability.

* Confidence producing content from concept to finished asset, with a willingness to get behind—and occasionally in front of—the camera.

* Proficiency with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

* Strong writing skills, particularly for video hooks, scripts and social captions.

* Familiarity with Instagram and TikTok, including platform-specific formats and trends.

* Strong communication skills and confidence working with creators, community partners and customers.

* An organized, proactive approach and the ability to manage several projects in a small team.

* Ability to dedicate 10-15 hours per week to this role.

**Bonus points**

* Experience creating assets for Meta or TikTok ads.

* Understanding of creative testing and how hooks, messaging and calls to action can affect paid performance. You don’t need to be a media buyer.

* Experience working with UGC creators, managing collaborations or coordinating small shoots.

* Familiarity with parenting, family, community or consumer marketplace brands.

**What success looks like**

A consistent flow of original content, stronger community engagement, productive creator partnerships and a growing library of creative ideas we can learn from across organic and paid channels.

**To apply**

Send a short introduction, your availability and compensation expectations, and 3–5 examples of your work. For each example, tell us what you contributed and, where available, how it performed.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Computation
description:
**About Aurora Solar**

Aurora is on a mission to create a future of solar for all. Our award-winning software puts the power of data and technology into the hands of every solar professional to make solar adoption simple and predictable. Our software has designed millions of solar projects so far, empowering solar companies to sell, design, and install residential and commercial solar arrays accurately, seamlessly, and at scale. 

We’ve been named one of "The Best Remote Companies" by [_BuiltIn.com_](https://builtin.com/company/aurora-solar) and have been recognized for the second time as a Certified Green Business (CGB) with the city of San Francisco. We’re in this together to support the world’s transition to solar.

**About the Team**

The System Design Pod sits at the heart of Aurora's core platform, building the computation engines that make accurate, high-fidelity solar design possible. Our team owns the algorithms and systems that power load and utility bill modeling, whole home electrification, PV and battery electrical design, and system performance simulation. The work is deeply technical, operating at the intersection of software engineering and applied math, and it has an outsized impact on the quality of every solar project designed in Aurora.

We work closely with product managers, designers, research engineers, and QA to turn hard physics and engineering problems into software that installers can trust. If you like digging into a tough problem, debating the right approach, and shipping something that holds up in the real world, you'll fit in here.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer on the System Design Pod, you'll help build the next generation of PV and storage design tools at Aurora. You'll lead technical features from discovery through general release, propose new mathematical approaches to long-standing problems, and push our simulation and optimization work forward alongside a team that cares deeply about getting it right.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and applied math, with a direct line to the quality of every project designed on the platform. The technical and business contexts are steep at first, and the payoff is real: you'll move the accuracy and capability of solar design forward for thousands of installers and millions of homeowners.

**Your Impact**

- Design, build, and maintain the backend systems and computation engines behind Aurora's solar and electrical design workflows
- Advance our simulation and optimization work across PV and battery storage system layout, component selection, and electrical configuration
- Partner with product managers, designers, research engineers, and fellow engineers to turn complex physical models and engineering constraints into reliable, scalable software
- Shape the architecture of our simulation and computation infrastructure so it stays correct, fast, and maintainable as it grows
- Write clean, well tested code and raise the engineering bar through the patterns you establish
- Mentor teammates and show up fully in technical discussions, code reviews, and design documents
- Own the services you build end to end, including on-call rotation

**What You Bring**

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong backend foundation
- Academic background or equivalent skillset in computational mathematics, optimization, linear algebra, control theory, or numerical algorithms
- Hands-on experience with simulation or optimization
- Experience designing and building APIs, microservices, or data pipelines at scale
- Sharp algorithmic thinking, with the ability to reason about performance, correctness, and edge cases in computational systems
- Proficiency in one or more backend languages. Our stack is C++, Python, and Ruby, and relevant experience in other languages is welcome
- Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate well on a distributed team

**Nice to Haves**

- Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in computer science, applied math, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field
- Familiarity with solar PV and battery technology, or electrical engineering concepts more broadly
- Experience with cloud-native compute infrastructure and batch or distributed processing systems
- A genuine pull toward renewable energy and the work of accelerating the transition
- Track record of thriving when the pace picks up and the problem space shifts

**What We Offer**

- **🏖️Flexible PTO**
- **🍼Parental Leave**
- 💰**WFH Stipend**
- 🏢 **Coworking Stipend**
- ☀️**Energize Fridays**
- **📶Connectivity Stipend**
- **Learning & Development**
- 🩺**Medical, Dental, and Vision**

Please take a look at our [_U.S. Benefits Booklet_](https://www.canva.com/design/DAFLaobzynI/0YAE1SCIRKE7QHnJVp54iA/view?utm_content=DAFLaobzynI&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link&utm_source=publishsharelink) for a deeper dive into our offerings

**Where Aurorans are:** Aurora currently has teams within the US, Canada, Poland, and Germany with additional locations on the horizon. We’re united in our work to support the world’s transition to solar!

Aurora is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workforce of people who believe in and are passionate about creating a future of solar energy for all. title: Recycling Operations Engineer Lead
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for an Operations Engineering Lead to join our engineering team.

**Position Description**

The Operations Engineering Lead is responsible for establishing the operating model and operations engineering basis for Oklo’s nuclear fuel recycling facility. This person will represent facility operations throughout design, construction, commissioning, startup, and ramp-up to ensure the facility is safe, secure, operable, maintainable, testable, and capable of meeting its performance objectives.

The Operations Engineering Lead will translate operational, safety, security, safeguards, material control and accountability, and regulatory needs into traceable design requirements, operating philosophies, system boundaries, operating sequences, preliminary operating limits, procedures, training programs, and readiness criteria. This role will work closely with Process Engineering, Instrumentation and Controls, Systems Engineering, Safety, Licensing, Regulatory, Security, Safeguards, Material Control and Accountability, Quality, Maintenance, Construction, and Project Management to integrate these needs into the facility design.

The ideal candidate has significant experience designing, commissioning, starting up, or operating nuclear fuel-cycle facilities. Candidates with substantial experience in complex chemical, petrochemical, refining, or similar process facilities will also be considered, particularly those who have supported both greenfield projects and brownfield modifications.

**Specific responsibilities may include:**

- Lead development and configuration control of the facility concept of operations, including normal operation, startup, shutdown, standby, maintenance, upset, degraded, and emergency operating modes.
- Translate operational, safety, security, safeguards, material control and accountability, and regulatory needs into traceable design requirements, operating philosophies, system boundaries, operating sequences, preliminary operating limits, and acceptance criteria, in coordination with the responsible functional owners.
- Represent operations throughout facility and system design to ensure equipment and systems are safe, secure, operable, maintainable, accessible, testable, and suitable for remote and radiological environments.
- Complete documented operability, maintainability, accessibility, remote-handling, operator-task, human-factors, and failure-recovery reviews, with identified actions assigned and tracked through disposition.
- Review PFDs, P&IDs, equipment specifications, layouts, control narratives, alarm strategies, human-machine interfaces, system descriptions, and safety-related design inputs from an operations perspective.
- Lead development of preliminary staffing, procedure, training, maintenance, commissioning, startup, facility-turnover, and production-ramp-up plans with defined interfaces, milestones, responsibilities, and acceptance criteria.
- Establish requirements for system turnover, walkdowns, pre-operational testing, cold commissioning, integrated testing, initial material introduction, and operational-readiness reviews.
- Participate in design reviews, hazard analyses, safety reviews, human-factors evaluations, maintainability reviews, readiness reviews, configuration management, and management-of-change activities.
- Coordinate with maintenance and reliability teams to define equipment criticality, preventive maintenance, spare parts, vendor support, work controls, and asset-management needs.
- Build and lead the operations engineering organization as the project matures, while communicating readiness status, risks, decisions, and unresolved design actions to project and technical leadership.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

- A bachelor’s degree in chemical, nuclear, mechanical, electrical, industrial, or another relevant engineering discipline, or equivalent directly applicable experience.
- 10 or more years of experience in nuclear fuel-cycle, nuclear, chemical, petrochemical, refining, specialty chemical, or another complex industrial process environment.
- Significant experience in facility operations, commissioning, startup, maintenance, or operational support, combined with experience supporting facility design or capital projects.
- Experience with greenfield facility development, brownfield modifications, or both.
- Demonstrated experience developing or implementing commissioning, operational-readiness, procedure, training, maintenance, or startup programs.
- Ability to translate engineering designs into practical operating requirements, test plans, procedures, staffing needs, and acceptance criteria.
- Experience reviewing engineering documents such as PFDs, P&IDs, equipment specifications, control narratives, and system descriptions.
- Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, manage interfaces, and deliver work in an evolving project environment.
- Strong technical writing, communication, organization, and decision-making skills.

**Bonus Qualifications:**

- Experience designing, commissioning, starting up, or operating a nuclear fuel-cycle or radioactive-material processing facility.
- Experience with nuclear fuel recycling, pyroprocessing, molten salts, remote handling, hot cells, radiological ventilation, or radioactive waste treatment.
- Experience delivering a first-of-a-kind nuclear, chemical, or industrial process facility.
- Knowledge of NRC, DOE, or comparable nuclear regulatory requirements and operational practices.
- Experience with operational-readiness reviews, pre-startup safety reviews, HAZOPs, human-factors evaluations, or process hazard analyses.
- Experience with control systems, alarm management, computerized maintenance systems, equipment reliability, or operator training programs.
- Experience building or leading an operations engineering, commissioning, startup, or plant technical-support team.

**Competencies**

We are looking for an Operations Engineering Lead that is:

- Technically grounded in the design, commissioning, startup, and operation of complex nuclear or industrial process facilities.
- Able to integrate operational, safety, security, safeguards, material control and accountability, and regulatory needs into traceable and practical design requirements.
- Skilled at converting a developing facility design into controlled operating concepts, system boundaries, operating sequences, preliminary operating limits, procedures, training, test plans, and readiness criteria.
- Capable of identifying operability, maintainability, accessibility, human-factors, remote-handling, and failure-recovery risks early enough to influence the design.
- Able to collaborate effectively with Safety, Licensing, Security, Safeguards, Material Control and Accountability, Engineering, Maintenance, Construction, and Commissioning organizations while maintaining clear ownership and interfaces.
- Practical and field-oriented, with the judgment to distinguish between a design that works analytically and one that can be safely operated, maintained, tested, and recovered in the field.
- Capable of balancing safety, security, reliability, facility performance, schedule, and cost when evaluating technical decisions.
- A strong multidisciplinary leader who establishes clear ownership, manages interfaces, mentors others, and drives actions through documented disposition.
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity, documenting assumptions, and making informed decisions with incomplete or evolving design information.
- A clear and effective communicator who can explain complex operational and technical issues verbally and through well-written, active-voice documents.
- Collaborative, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and accountable for delivering high-quality results.
- Passionate about clean energy and making advanced fission and nuclear fuel recycling a reality.
- Comfortable working and learning quickly in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment.

**Who you are:**

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

_Motivated_: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

_A team-player_: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

_An excellent communicator_: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

_Creative_: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

_Detail-oriented_: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

 

**About Oklo travel requirements:**

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

 

**About Oklo compensation:**

**Salary: $130,000-$175,000**

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

* * *

**About Oklo Inc.:** Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

**#CHOP: Oklo’s Values**  
**Collaboration**: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.  
**Humility**: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.  
**Ownership**: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through  to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.  
**Pathfinding**: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

title: Technical Partnership Manager
description:
### Job Description

Postscript is the leading AI-powered conversational commerce platform for Shopify brands, trusted by 20,000+ stores. We're all-in on SMS with one goal: make it the #1 revenue channel for the merchants we serve. Backed by Greylock, Y Combinator, and other top investors, we're growing fast and looking for remarkable people to help build a world-class organization.

Merchants don't run Postscript in isolation. They run it alongside a stack of loyalty, subscription, reviews, support, and data tools — and the connections between those tools are where a lot of untapped revenue sits. This role owns that surface area.

Reporting into Marketing and working shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, the **Technical Partnership Manager** builds and grows Postscript's technology partner ecosystem. You'll find the partnerships worth making, scope what it actually takes to build them, and make sure each one turns into demand rather than a logo on a page. It's a rare hybrid: you need the commercial instincts to size an opportunity and the technical depth to be credible with a partner's engineering team.

Here's the thing — most partnership roles are one or the other. This one isn't.

### Primary Duties

- Own a portfolio of technology and integration partners end to end: sourcing, evaluation, technical scoping, launch, and ongoing growth.
- Identify and size partnership opportunities using real inputs — shared merchant overlap, attach rate, revenue impact, and build-and-maintain cost — and make a clear recommendation on what we should and shouldn't pursue.
- Lead technical discovery with partners: understand their API surface, data model, and architecture well enough to scope a viable integration and flag risks early.
- Translate partner opportunities into written specs and business cases that Product can act on, and represent the ecosystem's needs in roadmap conversations.
- Partner with Marketing to turn every launch into demand — co-marketing, joint content, app listings, webinars, and events.
- Build the enablement layer so Sales, Solutions, and Support can sell and service integrations confidently.
- Serve as the escalation point for partner technical issues, triaging what Support handles, what Product needs to see, and what you can resolve yourself.
- Own the number. You'll carry quarterly goals for partner-influenced pipeline and integration adoption, set in tandem with leadership.
- Build the operating system for this function — tiering framework, partner agreements in concert with Legal, review cadence, and reporting.

### What We'll Love About You

- 4+ years in technical partnerships, partner/solutions engineering, technical account management, product marketing, or a similar role where you owned both a commercial outcome and a technical conversation.
- You're technical enough to be dangerous: comfortable reading API docs, reasoning about webhooks and data flows, poking at a sandbox, and holding your own with a partner's engineering team. You don't need to ship production code, and we won't ask you to.
- You've sized an opportunity and talked your own team *out* of a partnership. You know that a long partner list isn't the same as revenue.
- Experience in ecommerce or martech is strongly preferred; Shopify ecosystem experience is a real advantage.
- You write well. Specs, business cases, and partner briefs are the job, not the overhead.
- You've influenced a product roadmap without owning it, and you can explain how.
- High attention to detail with a process- and solution-oriented mindset — you leave behind systems, not just relationships.
- A demonstrated record of meeting and exceeding performance targets.
- Experience with CRM and partner/opportunity management systems, preferably Salesforce.
- Willingness and ability to travel, up to 20%.

### What You'll Love About Us

- Salary range of **USD $120,000 to $146,000 base** plus **variable compensation** **(30%)** and equity regardless of location.
- High growth startup - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career!
- Work from home (or wherever)
- Fun - We’re passionate and enjoy what we do
- Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
- Flexible paid time off
- Health, dental, vision insurance

- Own your team's number — outreach activity, leads, conversion, and loan application volume against monthly targets
- Coach your team through weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and live feedback on calls and partner meetings
- Hold each AE to their production standard, and act early when someone falls off pace
- Run the weekly cadence of pipeline review, activity inspection, and forecast submission, giving sales leadership an accurate read on where the month lands
- Onboard and ramp new AEs to productivity on a defined timeline
- Interview and hire Account Executives, and build a candidate pipeline ahead of open roles
- Equip the team to position the Knock Bridge Loan™ against the alternatives and handle cost, rate, and timing objections from both the partner and the borrower
- Ensure the team represents Knock's partner lender relationships correctly, including compliant framing of introductions where the partner lender retains the forward mortgage
- Maintain pipeline accuracy and data hygiene in MeridianLink Mortgage (MLM)
- Escalate systemic blockers — lead quality, product gaps, operational friction — to sales leadership with the evidence behind them
- Partner with Lending Operations and Underwriting to keep applications moving once submitted

**What You'll Bring**

- Proven success carrying a team number, not just a personal quota
- Proven ability to coach sellers — able to diagnose whether an AE's problem is activity, targeting, or skill, and fix it
- Working knowledge of how loan officers, team leads, and branch managers make decisions, and what converts them into producing partners
- Ability to sell the product yourself and model the pitch in front of a partner
- Comfort inspecting pipeline and activity data, and acting on what it shows
- Willingness to give direct feedback and hold a standard consistently across a team
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to represent Knock externally to partners
- A deep belief in fostering inclusive, equitable practices that reflect Knock's core values
- Proven success in a fully remote, distributed team environment
- Recent lending experience required
- Experience: Minimum of 5 years of sales or business development experience in mortgage, real estate, or proptech, including at least 2 years leading or formally mentoring a sales team
- Education: Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification. We value potential, growth mindset, and diverse experiences.

**Physical Requirements**

- Set up and constantly operate a computer.
- Communicate and exchange accurate information to others via telephone or internet video applications.
- Must be able to travel, including overnight travel at least 4 times per year
- Must be able to lift, carry and push up to 20 lbs.

The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Compensation**

Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated. The compensation information below is a good faith estimate for this position and is provided in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

title: Product Engineer (Full-Time, Remote)

### **About AnswerThis**

AnswerThis is an AI-powered research platform built to eliminate the most time-consuming part
of academic research: the literature review. We serve researchers globally, from PhD students
to academic professionals, helping them go from query to a comprehensive, cited review in
minutes.

Our system understands how papers connect, ranks relevance, summarizes insights, and maps
citations - removing weeks of manual work. But that’s just the beginning. We’re building a
vertically integrated AI research suite that streamlines every stage of academic discovery.
This is a high-velocity, high-impact product environment. If you’ve ever wanted to ship fast, take
real ownership, and contribute to technology used by researchers making breakthroughs in
medicine, AI, climate, and more this is it.
The Role

We're hiring a full-time Product Engineer who will design, code, and ship high-impact features
across the stack. You’ll work directly with the founding team in 1–2 week product sprints and
own the outcome of every feature you build.

This role requires strong frontend experience, particularly in Next.js, as well as the ability to
work independently across backend services and AI infrastructure.

**What You’ll Do**

● Design, build, and ship features from scratch across both frontend and backend.

● Create polished user interfaces and seamless user experiences with React/Next.js.

● Build AI-powered tools for search, citation mapping, summarization, and more.

● Develop backend APIs using Python and FastAPI, with database logic in Postgres.

● Work with semantic search, vector databases, and retrieval pipelines for AI features.

● Participate in fast product sprints with rapid feedback and tight iteration loops.

● Take full ownership of your work—from architecture to deployment to performance
monitoring.

● Frontend: Strong skills in React and Next.js, with a clear eye for UI/UX.

databases (e.g., FAISS, Weaviate, Pinecone).

● Styling/UI: Experience using Tailwind or similar utility-first CSS frameworks.

● Workflow Tools: Proficient with Git, Docker, and modern CI/CD pipelines.

● Academic context: Understanding of citation networks, research tooling, or academic
workflows.

● Able to work in a remote environment aligned to EST hours, with daily standups.
Compensation

$2,000–$3,500/month initially, depending on experience and ownership scope. This is a
full-time role with significant responsibility and growth potential.

Send a brief introduction and links to your work to:

ayush@answerthis.io

Subject: Product Engineer Application

● A project you’re proud of and your role in building it.

● Why you want to work at AnswerThis.

● Your availability and preferred start date.

title: Director / Manager, Strategic Finance & Integration
description:
**About Us**

We're on a mission to transform pharma services — the backbone of how new therapies reach patients. Vitalis is a Series A company backed by Kleiner Perkins and other leading Tier 1 VCs / angels across both AI / technology as well as Healthcare.

Vitalis is currently fully remote, but we foresee being hybrid in the near future and will ask employees to come in 3 days a week to an office in NYC or San Francisco. Even when hybrid, we will maintain a commitment to flexibility.

**What You'll Do**

* Own financial integration across Vitalis and our operating companies — building consistent financial processes and infrastructure as we acquire and scale businesses
* Drive core financial operations across our companies, including AR and collections, AP and vendor payments, working capital management, and cash controls
* Lead the rollout and ongoing management of NetSuite (or other ERP) across Vitalis and our operating companies, including standardizing chart of accounts, reporting, and financial processes
* Own Vitalis' consolidated financial model, annual budget, forecasts, and long-range financial planning
* Own our cash forecast and liquidity planning, giving leadership a clear view into cash needs, runway, and capital requirements
* Build reporting and KPI infrastructure that provides visibility into the financial and operating performance of each business and Vitalis on a consolidated basis
* Partner with our accounting teams to drive a timely and accurate monthly close, improve reconciliations and controls, and ensure the quality of our financial reporting
* Support fundraising and financing processes, including financial modeling, investor materials, diligence, and Board / investor reporting
* Support M&A diligence and lead the financial integration of newly acquired businesses

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, private equity, accounting / finance, or another highly analytical environment
* Exceptional financial modeling skills and a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement
* High level of ownership — you are equally comfortable building a long-term financial model and figuring out why an overdue customer invoice hasn't been collected
* Strong operational orientation and willingness to build processes from scratch rather than simply report on existing ones
* Ability to operate across multiple businesses, prioritize aggressively, and bring structure to ambiguous problems
* Extremely detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable working directly with senior leadership

**Nice to Have**

* Experience implementing or managing ERPs
* Experience with multi-entity financial reporting, acquisitions, or post-close integration
* Experience in healthcare, pharma services, technology-enabled services, or another operationally complex industry
* Experience supporting equity or debt fundraising processes
* Experience building a finance function or financial infrastructure in a rapidly growing company

**Compensation and Benefits**

* $300k+ total compensation ($150-$200k cash + substantial equity)
* Best in class healthcare, dental, vision, disability insurance, and other benefits

title: Principal Strategic Account Executive
description:
You’ll join our **New Business Sales** team, reporting to our **Sr. Director, New Business Sales** selling NextRoll’s AdRoll platform to sophisticated advertisers and agencies across CTV, DOOH, display, audio, and addressable TV. As a Principal Strategic Account Executive, you will be an individual contributor, owning the full sales cycle for strategic mid-market opportunities from self-generated pipeline through close.

As a **Principal Strategic Account Executive**, you’ll own the full sales cycle from self-generated pipeline through negotiation and close. You’ll identify high-value opportunities, engage senior decision-makers, shape the commercial strategy and position NextRoll’s AdRoll platform across **display**, **CTV, and DOOH**.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a commercially driven seller who understands how modern media is bought and can credibly engage sophisticated advertisers, agencies and media leaders. You’ll combine strong industry relationships with prospecting, consultative selling and deep programmatic expertise to create new opportunities, win net-new logos and grow investment into NextRoll’s fastest-growing channels.

You’ll work closely with **Solutions, Marketing and Customer Success** to develop compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes and deliver meaningful new business revenue for NextRoll.

**This role is open in San Francisco, New York City, or US** [**Remote**](https://rollwhereyouthrive.com/#/locations) **locations.**

[Unsure](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/what-imposter-syndrome-how-overcome-get-ahead-by-linkedin-news/) that you check all the boxes? You should still apply! We’ll review your application for other opportunities.

## **The impact you’ll make:**

- **Own the full sales cycle** for strategic opportunities, from prospecting and pipeline creation through commercial negotiation and close.
- **Build and convert self-generated pipeline**, with a strong focus on net-new logos.
- Develop trusted relationships with **senior marketing, media, advertising and agency decision-makers**, building consensus across complex, multi-stakeholder buying groups.
- Identify opportunities to **shift and grow customer media investment** across **display**, **CTV, and DOOH**.
- Bring a strong understanding of **programmatic and ad tech** to customer conversations, translating complex media capabilities into clear commercial outcomes.
- Lead with a consultative approach, understanding customer business challenges and developing **strategic, differentiated proposals** that address them.
- Partner with **Solutions, Marketing and Customer Success** to develop, position and close high-value opportunities.
- Create compelling commercial business cases and confidently negotiate with senior stakeholders to drive deals to close.
- Maintain disciplined **pipeline management, forecasting and CRM hygiene**, providing accurate visibility into revenue performance and deal progression.
- Consistently achieve and exceed **new business revenue targets**, while contributing to the evolution of NextRoll’s NAMER go-to-market strategy.

## **Skills you’ll bring:**

- **8+ years of experience** in ad tech and/or media sales, with experience selling across multiple media channels and deep expertise in one or more of CTV, DOOH, display, audio, linear or addressable TV.
- Experience selling from the **platform side of the ecosystem**, ideally with a DSP, SSP or other ad tech platform, rather than primarily selling media-owner inventory.
- Strong understanding of **programmatic advertising**, including buying models, targeting, measurement, data and the broader digital media ecosystem.
- A proven track record of **self-generating pipeline and winning net-new business**, with clear evidence of consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets.
- Strong outbound prospecting skills and the ability to turn cold or underdeveloped relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities.
- Demonstrated ability to **sell consultatively and strategically**, connecting media solutions to business objectives rather than selling products in isolation.
- Comfortable navigating **complex organisations, multiple stakeholders and senior-level buying processes**.
- Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills and executive presence.
- Credibility with sophisticated advertisers, agencies and media buyers, with the ability to challenge thinking and introduce new approaches.
- Highly self-directed and accountable, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, evolving environment.

## **Benefits and perks:**

- Competitive salary and equity
- We cover 100% of the employee-only premium for our HSA medical plan, and 95% of the employee-only premium for our PPO, HMO, dental, and vision plans.
- We contribute 75% toward dependent premiums across all medical, dental, and vision plans.
- We offer access to Multiply Mortgage, a concierge homebuying service that provides free personalized guidance and below market mortgage rates (up to 1% below top retail lenders).
- Short and long term disability benefits at no cost to the employee
- Basic life and AD&D insurance at no cost to the employee
- 401K Plan (Pre-tax, Roth and After-tax)
- 4 weeks of paid time off and work/life balance
- Up to 6 weeks of paid disability leave (up to 12 weeks for pregnancy disability leave)
- Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave for birthing parents (in addition to pregnancy disability leave)
- Up to 16 weeks of paid family leave for non-birthing parents
- Up to 12 weeks paid family leave to care for a family member
- Join a community of fellow Rollers as a member of one of our [Employee Resource Groups](https://www.nextroll.com/careers/culture)
- Ample opportunities to volunteer with local organizations with NextRoll Gives Back
- Access to the latest AI tools and dedicated time to experiment
- For additional benefits not mentioned, visit our [Careers](https://www.nextroll.com/careers) page

## **Compensation:**

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. The range includes base salary and variable pay tied to sales targets. 

**San Francisco and New York Metro Areas**   
On-Target Earnings (OTE): $245,005 – $308,006

Includes:

- Base salary: $147,000 – $184,800
- Target incentive: $98,005 – $123,206 (paid quarterly, uncapped*)
- Pay mix: Approximately 60/40

**All other US Cities**   
On-Target Earnings (OTE): $208,254 – $277,206

Includes:

- Base salary: $124,950 – $166,320
- Target incentive: $83,304 – $110,886 (paid quarterly, uncapped*)
- Pay mix: Approximately 60/40

Our compensation plan is structured to reward performance against sales targets, is uncapped*, and includes accelerators for overachievement. 

*NextRoll’s sales compensation plan is subject to modification at the discretion of NextRoll. Uncapped Target Incentive allows reps to continue to earn a percentage of every dollar brought in, beyond 100% quota attainment. Please refer to the sales compensation plan document for details, which will be provided by your Recruiter.

In addition to competitive compensation, we also offer equity + benefits.

**How We Determine Pay:**

The range provided is NextRoll’s reasonable estimate of the On-Target Earnings (OTE)  for this role. The actual amount will be based on job-related and non-discriminatory factors. Compensation is determined using objective, gender‑neutral criteria aligned to NextRoll’s job architecture, including scope of responsibility, relevant experience, skills, and geographic labor market considerations. Consult with your Recruiter during the initial call to determine a more targeted range based on these job-related factors.

## **About NextRoll:**

NextRoll is a leading marketing technology company that empowers businesses to drive sustainable growth while building trusted connections with their audiences. Built on nearly two decades of AI and data expertise, NextRoll delivers its solutions through AdRoll, its flagship brand and connected advertising platform. The AdRoll platform brings together two powerful offerings: the AdRoll product, which helps brands generate awareness, deepen engagement, and drive measurable revenue through AI-powered multi-channel campaigns; and AdRoll ABM, a full-funnel account-based marketing product that unifies buyer insights, predictive AI, and multi-touch advertising to accelerate pipeline and revenue for B2B teams. Together, these solutions give marketers the clarity, efficiency, and performance they need to grow with confidence. NextRoll is a privately held company headquartered in San Francisco, CA.

We are committed to building diverse teams of “Rollers” and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Learn more about our DEI impact via our DEI Annual Report on our [Culture page](https://www.nextroll.com/careers/culture). All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, sex, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, citizenship, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or other characteristics. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To request reasonable accommodation, contact [candidateacommodations@nextroll.com](mailto:candidateacommodations@nextroll.com).

title: Director of Global Markets
description:
At Feeld, we are creating a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves. We are building an inclusive, human-centred product and are looking for a Director of Global Markets to become part our remote team and our mission to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships.

We’re looking for a globally minded, culturally fluent marketing leader to shape how Feeld shows up in the world: market by market, community by community. This role owns the strategy and execution of our localized marketing efforts across key and emerging markets. It sits at the intersection of brand, data, and culture—translating Feeld’s identity into work that resonates deeply and authentically at a local level.

You won’t be scaling templated campaigns across regions. You’ll be building a system that listens first, grounded in research, subcultures, and lived experiences. Then responds with marketing that feels specific, intentional, and true to the communities we serve.

You’ll work closely with Data and Research to understand where we grow, and why. With Brand and Creative to shape how we show up. And with local partners to ensure what we put into the world isn’t just seen, but felt.

### What you will do:

- Define and lead our global localization strategy, setting a clear point of view on where and how Feeld shows up across markets
- Partner deeply with Data and Research to identify opportunities, set market-level targets, and uncover the cultural and behavioral nuances that drive growth
- Develop and steer local marketing plans that feel native to each market—grounded in insight, not replication
- Drive expansion into new and emerging markets, building thoughtful entry strategies that prioritize learning, community fit, and long-term potential over short-term scale
- Collaborate with Brand and Creative to shape campaigns that create a strong brand halo globally, while allowing for meaningful local expression
- Use local markets as testing environments for messaging, positioning, and campaigns, feeding insights back into global strategy and creative expression
- Build a deep, ongoing understanding of subcultures and communities, ensuring our work reflects the diversity, complexity, and progressiveness of our audience
- Create strong feedback loops between markets and brand, so what we learn locally influences brand, product, and growth decisions globally
- Own performance across markets, balancing brand impact with measurable outcomes and sustainable growth
- Build and manage a network of local partners, collaborators, and operators, enabling high-quality, culturally attuned execution on the ground

**Requirements**

### About you:

- 8+ years of experience in global or regional marketing, with 3+ years in a managerial and/or leadership role, and a track record of building and leading localization strategies across multiple markets
- Deep experience in consumer brands, with a strong instinct for brand-building that goes beyond aesthetics and into meaning, identity, and cultural relevance
- Highly fluent in data and research, using insight not just to optimize, but to understand people and shape strategy
- Culturally aware and deeply curious, with a genuine interest in subcultures, relationships, and the nuances of how people connect across different contexts
- Experienced in market expansion, with a thoughtful approach to entering and scaling new regions
- A strong cross-functional collaborator, able to work fluidly with Brand, Creative, Product, and Data teams
- Strategic but not removed, comfortable moving between vision and execution, and holding a high bar for the work at every level

**Benefits**

### About us:

Feeld is an independent, experimental and fully remote organisation reshaping the dialogue on dating and sexuality. The company was founded in 2014 and has evolved since to become the open, distributed structure it is now. We have a naturally agile and fluid culture. The whole team is fully remote, which means you work where and when helps you perform at your best. We regard autonomy highly and treat our organisation as a product – we iterate, improve and test things internally to see what works best for everyone.

### Our culture:

We believe in creating a safe work environment through humanity, fluidity, safety, transparency and progressiveness. When hiring, we look for culture add rather than culture fit.

Because we are a fully remote team, it’s especially important that we create an environment where our colleagues feel included and connected as humans.

### Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging at Feeld:

Feeld promotes open-mindedness, inclusion, diversity and kindness, both in the world and among our own workforce.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with a history of marginalisation, whether because of race, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, national origin, disability (seen or unseen) or any confluence of intersectional identities.

Our goal is a barrier-free application process and working environment. If you require further details or assistance or have any questions about this process, please let us know at [hr@feeld.co](mailto:hr@feeld.co).

### Compensation and perks:

We are conscious of how our work and decisions impact other humans and the environment. We design our product and organisation with consideration for the wellbeing of our Members and colleagues. Feeld’s way of working is designed to proactively prevent burnout and an “always on” culture. We believe in technology and working environments that enable people to live a meaningful, fulfilled life.

Therefore, we offer our staff:

- Flexible working hours
- Unlimited paid time off
- A fully remote working situation
- Home office budget
- Learning & development budget
- On demand therapy sessions and mental health support via [Spill](https://spill.chat/)
- In-person meet ups

Our compensation system is one of the ways we work to uphold equity and inclusion at Feeld. Just as we strive to enable honest expression on our platform, we strive for openness of information within the organization. Internally, we keep decision-making transparent to keep each other accountable and make sure all voices are heard. That is why we offer a compensation system that is transparent, honest, and equitable.  Additionally, we believe all humans deserve to earn a competitive wage, so we offer a Baseline Freedom Salary of £60,000 GBP per year for any role that indexes below £60,000 GBP per year.

Estimated compensation for this role:

- Total cash compensation for this role varies by geographic location. We estimate the market-competitive compensation range for this position to be between $195,000 - $230,000 USD.

### Our interview process:

- Your first conversation with Feeld will be a screening call with our recruiter, where you’ll be able to ask - and receive answers - regarding any general questions you have and to confirm the role is a fit for what you’re seeking.
- Your second conversation will connect you directly with the hiring manager for the role you’re applying to. Here, you’ll have a chance to ask more questions about the work you’ll be doing. This conversation will also focus on your past work experiences.
- The next step for most of our roles is a candidate challenge. This is an evaluation of the skills relevant to be successful in this role and generally takes about an hour to complete.
- Your third conversation allows you the opportunity to meet the team members you might be working with on a daily basis. Here, you’ll be able to ask questions about team processes, workflow, and the employee experience at Feeld.
- We generally make an offer within 2 weeks of our final call, and offer a flexible start date that can begin as early as the next Monday after you sign our offer documentation.
- Of note: all of our interviews are conducted remotely, and our interviewers will work with you to find an agreeable interview time based on mutual availability.

We understand we're asking you to invest your time and best efforts in our process, and are appreciative of getting the chance to better know who you are as a person and candidate. In return, we’re committed to offering transparent communication and prompt feedback as you navigate this application with us.

*To find out more about Feeld, *[*download our app*](https://feeld.onelink.me/TRZt/cv5g9n74)* (available on iOS and Android).*

title: Community Manager
description:
**About Us**

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That’s not a policy. It’s just who we are.

What keeps us going is what we hear from our Community. Families tell us they used to wake up every morning with a knot in their stomach. They don’t anymore. They tell us our product changed their relationship with their parents, from anxious and fearful to present and connected. It’s genuinely important work, and we don’t take it lightly.

If that’s the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years on, one with real scale, real mission, real momentum, and a real Community of people behind it, we’d love to talk.

**What we’re building**

Aging in America is broken. Seniors are isolated. Their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond “I hope Mom’s alright.”

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home. Most of them, and most of their families, are navigating this alone. Community Phone is fixing that. We built a phone so simple it works out of the box, wrapped it with AI-powered check-in calls, and built a family app that turns daily dread into peace of mind.

It’s working. We’re well into 8-figure subscription ARR pacing to 9-figure, with 30,000+ families trusting us with something that matters deeply. We are called Community Phone for a reason, and that Community is real, warm, and growing. We’re now looking for the person who turns that quiet loyalty into a movement.

**What you’ll own**

Building a community is a central part of our brand. We keep our customers connected: to their families and to the people who love and support them.

As our Community Manager, you own the network and energy of our Community.

**Community Engagement** — launch and own the customer newsletter and other touchpoints that make people feel part of something, not just billed by a vendor. 

**Organic Social** — own our organic social presence. Participate in and mobilize Facebook and Reddit communities around caregiving and senior safety. Own our organic Facebook and Instagram presences. Be obsessed with engagement, shares, and network growth. Figure out the puzzle of engaging a customer base that isn’t native to platforms like TikTok or Snapchat. 

**Referrals** — turn word-of-mouth into a machine. Our customers already recommend us; you make recommending us easy, rewarding, and constant. Own referral programs end-to-end.


**What we’re looking for**

* 3–5 years in community, social, or content marketing, with real ownership of a channel or program — not just posting.
* You are a relentless engine. You do a remarkable amount of work. You don’t get blocked. Your manager thinks, “Wow, how did they pull that off?” not “I wonder what they are up to.”
* You have proven opinions about how communities grow. You aren’t just writing out newsletters and clicking send. You’re fixated on the nature of our social network. Who are these customers? What makes them fall in love with something? How can we make that viral?
* Strong writer. You can turn our product into an emotional message that a 65-year-old’s daughter understands and wants to forward.
* A real feel for how things spread among people who are not young and not on TikTok. You can explain why something travels inside a 50+ or caregiver community.
* Enough hands-on design sense to make your own organic content look good without waiting on a designer.
* Analytical. You set goals, watch the numbers, and cut what isn’t working.
Bonus: you’ve marketed to older adults, caregivers, or their families.

**How we’ll know it’s working**

* More customers refer more friends, month over month.
* Newsletter and organic engagement grow, and customers tell us they feel part of a Community.
* Word-of-mouth becomes something we can see, not just something we hope for.
* Our organic social following and share rate climb steadily.

**Compensation and logistics**

* $85,000–$105,000 base, plus equity. 401(k) and health insurance included.
* Remote-first. About 80 people across 15 countries. 3–4 in-person offsites per year at domestic or international locations.
* Backed by Y Combinator, YC Continuity, SNR.vc, and other top-tier investors.

title: Vice President, Growth Strategy
description:
About Us

Adeia Inc. (Nasdaq: ADEA) develops foundational innovations that shape how the world computes, connects and experiences entertainment. Its inventions span a broad range of semiconductor and media technologies, including 3D interconnect (hybrid bonding) and advanced thermal management for AI datacenters, as well as content discovery, personalization, and streaming. Adeia’s innovations enable more powerful and efficient products, and more immersive, personalized experiences across billions of devices worldwide. Learn more at www.adeia.com.



Position Summary

The VP, Growth Strategy serves as Adeia's internal owner of long-term growth strategy capability, responsible for identifying, evaluating, prioritizing, and advancing new market and cross-domain growth opportunities beyond the company's existing core and adjacent markets. Reporting directly to the Corporate Strategy Officer (CSO) and operating as a peer to the core domain (i.e., Media and Semiconductor) Strategy Leads, this role develops the frameworks, market fact base, opportunity pipeline, business cases, and executive materials required to support long-term growth decisions.



The role leads new market and growth platform strategy outside the existing core and adjacent markets, collaborates closely with domain Strategy Leads on growth opportunities within or adjacent to their areas, and develops management-led growth strategy materials for executive and Board-level review. The role integrates market, technology, IP, partnership, ecosystem, financial, and inorganic insights to inform enterprise strategy, long-range planning, and Executive-level decision-making.



Key Responsibilities

Long-Term Growth Strategy Capability Ownership

Own Adeia's internal long-term growth strategy capability, including the frameworks, evaluation criteria, market taxonomy, decision processes, and governance routines used to identify and assess new growth opportunities.
Define and refine long-term growth theses that answer where Adeia should play, why it can win, and how new opportunities can create durable value.
Establish repeatable methods for screening, prioritizing, and advancing opportunities across strategic, market, technology, IP, financial, and execution dimensions.
Partner with the CSO to integrate growth priorities into enterprise strategy, long-range planning, and Executive-level decision-making.
New Market and Growth Platform Development

Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new markets, adjacencies, and cross-domain growth opportunities beyond existing Media and Semiconductor verticals.
Lead development and qualification of new licensing verticals and growth pathways that cut across or sit outside existing core and adjacent markets.
Assess market attractiveness, technology relevance, IP monetization potential, ecosystem dynamics, competitive structure, and strategic fit for prospective growth areas.
Define business models, monetization paths, licensing constructs, market entry approaches, and partnership or ecosystem models that strengthen Adeia's right to win.
Opportunity Evaluation, Business Cases, and Prioritization

Build and maintain a prioritized pipeline of long-term growth opportunities, including recommendations to advance, monitor, pause, or eliminate opportunities.
Develop strategic business cases, investment logic, and opportunity assessments for priority growth initiatives.
Evaluate and qualify partnership, ecosystem, and inorganic opportunities with cross functional input.
Executive and Board-Level Growth Strategy Support

Develop management-led long-term growth strategy materials for executive and Board-level review.
Prepare growth narratives, opportunity roadmaps, strategic options, tradeoff analyses, and recommendations for the CSO and Executive Leadership Team.
Translate complex market, technology, IP, financial, and competitive analyses into concise, decision-ready materials.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Technology, or related discipline.
