title: Full stack software developer/engineer (Mid-level)
description:
**Bulbthings** · Fully Remote (EU, UK, or USA) · Full-Time or Contract · €55K–€75K · 0.5–2% Stock Options · 2–5 years experience

We're not a garage-stage startup running on ramen and vibes. We're a live, proven platform already trusted by some seriously big enterprise customers, and we've already got LLMs wired into the guts of it. Now we want to push further: extend what they can actually do and use that to genuinely wow our customers, not just tick an "AI-powered" box on a slide.

We're looking for the kind of engineer who reads "enterprise software" and gets excited instead of bored. Someone rigorous enough to be trusted with a platform real companies run on, but still hungry enough to want a real stake in where this goes next.

If that's you: we should talk. If it's not, no hard feelings, there's a fine cushy job out there for you, just not here.


**MUST HAVES**

Your background:
* BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, or something close enough
* 2–5 years of real, provable experience shipping production code for enterprise software/platforms. We're talking actual customers, actual uptime, actual "*oh no it's 2am and something's on fire*" experience, not just a slick MVP that never had to survive contact with a real customer
* Experience working on enterprise systems of record, think CRM, ERP, HR, Inventory Management, accounting platforms, or similar. You know what it means to build software that businesses trust with their core operational data, not just a nice-to-have tool on the side
* Some hands-on experience putting LLMs to work on real problems

**Your skills and experience:**
* Strong engineering fundamentals and a track record of actually shipping on a live, revenue-generating platform that large, demanding customers depend on
* Comfortable in (or able to quickly pick up) our stack: Angular, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, REST APIs
* You're UI/UX-minded first and foremost: you care as much about how a feature feels to use as how it's architected underneath. We need someone who thinks about the customer experience, not someone who'd rather be three layers deep in backend or devops
* Some practical experience with LLMs in a real product context: RAG, agents, evals, prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning, or whatever the acronym of the month is. You don't need to be a research scientist, but you should have actually built something with this, not just read about it
* Rigorous and detail-oriented: you can own a feature end-to-end and ship clean, maintainable code at a good pace

**Personality traits we'll be looking for:**
* Ambitious and hungry: you want a real stake in a growing company, not just a job title and a badge
* Strong work ethic, responsible, and genuinely autonomous: we're fully remote and we're not going to hover over your shoulder (we don't even have shoulders to hover over, we're a Slack window)
* You thrive in a small team where your work is visible and actually moves the needle, not lost in eleven layers of process
* Rigorous and detail-oriented as a habit, not a performance: the kind of person who double-checks their own work because sloppy isn't in your nature
* High EQ and genuinely excellent communicator: in a small remote team, there's no layer of process to catch what falls through the cracks. You write clearly, you flag blockers before they become fires, and you can explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical teammate without either of you losing the will to live
* You're earlier in your career, so we'll invest real time in you, and we'll expect real engagement in return while you learn the ropes and earn the team's trust.
* Room to grow: This role can evolve into a *Lead* position fast for the right person. We're a small team, so there's no ladder of middle management standing between you and more responsibility. If you're good and you want it, you'll get it quickly.

**NICE TO HAVES**
* Some DevOps experience (CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring) or a knack for database query optimization, useful to have, not the core of the role
* You speak another language (French, German, Spanish, Italian; extra credit for anything that makes our customer calls smoother)

**✋ HOW TO APPLY**

Please include a short, genuine message telling us who you are and why this role and venture actually interests you. Not a copy-pasted cover letter, not three lines of "I am a passionate developer with X years of experience." **We read every single one**, and it's usually obvious within a sentence which is which. Tell us something real: why enterprise software, why LLMs, why now, why us. Applications without one won't move forward.

title: Founding Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
**VOICERA AI**
Founding Business Development Representative
Remote  ·  Founder equity + commission  ·  Part time (bootstrap phase)  ·  Reports to the Head of Business Operations

**About Voicera**

Voicera is a US based generative AI startup building the next generation of customer intelligence by capturing the true voice and emotion of the customer with empathic AI. Voicera builds Sincerity™, a multimodal AI credibility intelligence platform that software builders embed into their own products as a native data layer. Our API measures sincerity across audio, video, and composite signals, giving platforms a new dimension of insight they cannot get anywhere else. We are early, moving fast, and looking for someone who wants to help build the commercial engine from the ground up.
Signup free: https://voicera.io (up right) and get 5 hours of video & audio analytics. 

**The Opportunity: Equity & Commitment**

This is a founding member position for a true entrepreneur. No guts, no glory. We are seeking a partner ready to walk the talk and help build a category defining company.
•	Equity package: a negotiated amount of founder equity.
•	Commission (bootstrap phase): we are bootstrapping and none of the co-founders or CXOs are taking salaries, but you earn commission on any revenue closed from business you generate.
•	Time commitment: part time (minimum 10 to 20 hours per week) is acceptable during the bootstrap phase.
•	Activation: a competitive salary and attractive stock package activate on the successful close of our fundraising round.
Mandatory filter: please do not apply if you are going to ask for a salary. This is an equity driven role with commission as a bonus.

**The Role: Founding BDR (the “Doer”)**
We are hiring a part time business development contractor to open doors. You will find the right prospects and investors, reach them across the channels that work, and grow awareness of what Sincerity can do. This is a builder’s seat: you will shape the outreach playbook as you run it, and your work will directly shape our early traction story.
What You’ll Do
Find prospects and investors.
•	Build and qualify a pipeline of software builders and platforms who would embed Sincerity, plus investors aligned with our stage and thesis.
•	Research target accounts and decision makers, and keep a clean, prioritized list of who to reach and why.

**Run the outreach.**
•	Reach targets through email, LinkedIn, and any other avenue that earns a reply, from warm intros to events and communities.
•	Write outreach that sparks curiosity and invites prospects to try Sincerity and submit a video to see how it works and what it surfaces.
•	Follow up with discipline, book conversations, and hand off qualified interest to the founder.
Grow the brand.
•	Raise Voicera’s visibility with the people who matter, so the name is already familiar when we reach out.
•	Spot the channels, partners, and conversations where credibility intelligence belongs, and put Voicera into them.
•	Feed what you hear in the market back to the team so our messaging keeps getting sharper.
Who You Are
•	Hungry and resilient: 1 to 2 years in sales or lead generation. You have been in the trenches and want a big swing opportunity where your impact is visible.
•	Self starter: you do not need a playbook handed to you, you help write it, and you are comfortable with the controlled chaos of a startup.
•	Competitive: you want to be the top performer so that when we scale the team, you are the natural choice to lead it.
•	Tech savvy: you understand the AI and SaaS landscape and can speak comfortably about technology and data driven insights.
Why Join Us
•	Career path: we are looking for our future BDR manager. Hit your milestones and you get the first shot at building and leading the team as we grow.
•	Direct access: work directly with the executive team (CRO and CEO) for a masterclass in go to market strategy and startup scaling.
•	Flexibility: this is a remote role. During the bootstrap phase we are open to full time or a high impact part time (minimum 20 hours per week) commitment for the right person.
Qualifications
•	1 to 2 years of outbound sales experience (BDR or SDR experience preferred).
•	Proven track record of hitting activity and meeting set goals.
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can hook a lead in 30 seconds.
•	A no excuses mindset.

**How to Apply

Send your resume and a cover letter to hr@voicera.io. In the subject line, reference the title of the position you are applying to. In your cover letter, please highlight:
1.	What you would bring to Voicera’s product innovation and our team.
2.	Your UX and UI feedback, plus general thoughts on how to improve Sincerity after testing the product.
Test Sincerity™ for free: Signup on https://voicera.io 
The Voicera AI team looks forward to hearing from you.

title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
description:
# About Fyxer 

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

## The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.

##

- High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization
- You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

## How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.

**The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win**

- **The Trajectory:** We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.
- **The Evidence:** Ranked **7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps**. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.
- **The Culture of Agency:** We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.
- **Zero Bureaucracy:** No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.
 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

## The basics

- Remote, US

title: Tech Lead - Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
Magical is building an agentic AI platform that brings “AI employees” into the workplace to execute repetitive, operationally critical work.

Our agents help organizations move faster, reduce manual work, and improve outcomes in areas where reliability matters—particularly healthcare. We work directly with customers to understand complex workflows, deploy AI agents into real operating environments, and turn what we learn into a more powerful and scalable platform.

The shift toward agentic work is already underway, and we are building the infrastructure and deployment playbook that will define how it happens.

Magical is backed by Greylock, Coatue, Altman Capital, Lightspeed, and other investors behind companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, and Notion.

## About the role

We are looking for a Tech Lead to raise the technical bar across Magical’s Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on our most difficult customer and platform challenges.

This is a highly senior individual-contributor role. You will remain deeply hands-on while providing technical leadership across multiple customers, deployments, and FDE workstreams.

You will step into complex or ambiguous situations, quickly understand what is going wrong, and lead the work required to solve it. You will also coach less experienced FDEs, review technical approaches, and help the broader team develop stronger judgment and execution skills.

You will report to the Head of Deployments and work closely with Forward Deployed Engineers, Deployment Strategy, Product, and Engineering.

## What you’ll do

- Take the lead on Magical’s most complex, high-risk, or technically ambiguous customer deployments.
- Get hands-on in the work—designing agentic workflows, writing and improving prompts, building integrations, debugging failures, analyzing system behavior, and shipping production solutions.
- Diagnose difficult issues across customer environments, integrations, agent performance, data quality, and platform behavior.
- Provide technical leadership across multiple customers and teams rather than owning only a single project or account.
- Review solution designs, implementation plans, testing strategies, and production-readiness for complex workflows.
- Coach FDEs through technical problems and help junior team members develop stronger problem-solving, debugging, and systems-thinking skills.
- Set an example for technical ownership, execution quality, urgency, and customer focus.
- Identify risks, architectural weaknesses, and reliability issues before they become customer-facing problems.
- Partner with Product and Engineering to distinguish between deployment-specific issues and platform-level gaps.
- Translate recurring customer challenges into reusable platform capabilities, internal tools, reference implementations, and technical standards.
- Improve the team’s practices for testing, observability, debugging, incident response, documentation, and release management.
- Help define what excellent Forward Deployed Engineering looks like at Magical.

## What success looks like

- Magical’s technical deployments are delivered on time and thoroughly.
- Customer-facing issues are diagnosed accurately, with root causes addressed rather than repeatedly patched.
- FDEs make better technical decisions and become more capable of solving complex problems independently.
- Technical quality becomes more consistent across customers and workstreams.
- Repeated implementations are converted into reusable tools, patterns, and platform improvements.
- Product and Engineering receive clear, technically credible feedback from customer deployments.
- The organization can take on more complex customers without relying on a small number of people to repeatedly rescue deployments.

## About you

- You have significant experience in software engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, solutions engineering, systems integration, implementation engineering, or a similarly hands-on technical role.
- You have operated as a technical lead or senior individual contributor on complex, customer-facing software deployments.
- You are comfortable moving across the full problem space—from understanding a customer workflow to debugging an integration, improving agent behavior, and shipping a reliable production solution.
- You are an exceptional problem solver who can bring structure to unclear situations and make progress without complete information.
- You have strong technical judgment and know when to fix a local implementation, change the architecture, or escalate a platform limitation.
- You enjoy being hands-on and are willing to personally take on difficult implementation and debugging work.
- You are able to influence and lead other engineers without relying on formal management authority.
- You are a strong coach who can explain not only what should change, but how to think about the problem differently.
- You communicate clearly with engineers, deployment teams, and customer stakeholders, especially when a project is under pressure.
- You care deeply about production reliability, testing, observability, and solving the underlying cause of a problem.
- You are deeply curious about AI agents, prompting, automation, and multi-agent systems. Prior experience is valuable, but strong technical fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly matter more.
- You have a strong bias toward action and consistently demonstrate “show, don’t tell.”
- You have high agency and can prioritize, make decisions, and unblock yourself and others without waiting for perfect information.
- You are energized by early-stage environments where the technical playbook is still being created.
- You are located in Toronto or willing to relocate.

A science, engineering, or similarly technical educational background is helpful, but we care more about what you have built, solved, and learned than where you studied.

## The reality of the role

This is not an advisory or architecture-only position. You will be expected to get into the details, work directly in the implementation, and stay close to a problem until it is solved.

You may move between customers, technical domains, and urgent priorities quickly. Some periods will involve intense work, incomplete information, and problems that do not have an obvious owner or solution.

You should be excited by the opportunity to step into those situations, create clarity, and lead from the front.

## What we offer

- The opportunity to define the technical standard for Forward Deployed Engineering at Magical
- Ownership of some of the company’s most important and technically difficult customer problems
- A chance to work at the frontier of agentic AI and multi-agent systems
- Significant influence over Magical’s product, platform, and deployment practices
- A modern technical stack and access to leading AI tools
- Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
- Unlimited PTO
- Team offsites, with past trips including Iceland, Lisbon, Cancún, and Costa Rica

title: Co-Founder, Growth and Customer Acquisition
description:
GovSteals is a working research platform that helps people evaluate government vehicle auctions using active listings, historical auction results, comparable sales and data driven price predictions.

The product and technical infrastructure are built. GovSteals is currently pre-revenue, and I am looking for a cofounder who can take ownership of bringing the product to market and acquiring customers.

This person would own the commercial side of the company. That includes customer research, positioning, content, partnerships, outreach, acquisition channels, conversion, onboarding and retention.

I will continue to own product development, engineering, data, modeling and technical operations. Major decisions involving pricing, company strategy, fundraising, budgets and hiring will be made together.

**What you would own**
1. Identifying the strongest initial customer segments
2. Interviewing prospective and current users
3. Developing positioning and messaging
4. Building an organic content and distribution strategy
5. Establishing partnerships with automotive creators, dealers, auction buyers and relevant communities
6. Testing customer acquisition channels
7. Improving registration and paid conversion
8. Building marketing conent, email, onboarding and retention programs
9. Tracking acquisition cost, conversion, activation and retention
10. Turning early experiments into a repeatable growth strategy

**Who I am looking for**

You should have personally helped grow a product, service, audience or business from an early stage.

You should be comfortable doing the work yourself. This is not currently a management position with an agency, advertising budget or marketing staff underneath it.

Strong candidates will be able to explain:

What they helped grow
1. The numbers before and after their involvement
2. What they personally did
3. What failed and what they learned
4. How they would approach a useful product with little existing awareness

Automotive experience is useful but not required. Evidence of execution matters more than formal credentials or impressive job titles.

Must be fluent in English and knowledgeable of US culture as the market is strictly in the US. 

**Commitment**

The role can begin part time with a minimum commitment of approximately 15 hours per week.

The expectation is that both founders transition to full time once revenue or outside funding allows the company to support reasonable founder salaries.

Applicants must be able to support themselves during the initial pre-revenue period. No timeline to salary is guaranteed.

**Compensation**

There is no cash salary currently.

The expected equity range is 15% to 25%, with 20% as the target offer. The final percentage will depend on experience, initial commitment and the expected transition to full time.

Equity will vest over four years with a one year cliff, followed by monthly vesting. Both founders will be diluted proportionally by future investment.

This is an equity based cofounder opportunity. It is not an internship, freelance project, commission position or conventional employee opening.

**How to apply**

Please include:
1. Your LinkedIn profile or résumé
2. One example of something you helped grow
3. The measurable results
4. What you personally contributed
5. Your weekly availability
6. How long you can realistically operate without salary
7. What you would do first after reviewing [GovSteals](https://govsteals.com/)

Applications that only contain general marketing language without specific examples or results will not be considered.

title: City Scout - Rome
description:
About Atlys
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

 
The Role
We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

 
The Job
* Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

* Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

* Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

* Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

* Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

 
The Ideal Candidate
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

* Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

* Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

* Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

* Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.


 
Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

 
Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

 
The Role
We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers.

You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.

 
The Job
* Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

* Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

* Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

* Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

* Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

 
The Ideal Candidate
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

* Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

* Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

* Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

* Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.


 
Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

 
Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

description:
Stesso, Inc. | Remote | Part-Time / Flexible Hours | Commission-Only

**About Stesso**
Stesso is an AI platform that helps D2C and omnichannel brands turn one-time buyers into repeat customers. We build branded AI assistants that guide customers through projects using the tools and products they already own, recommending the right next purchase only when a project genuinely needs it. We work with design-forward brands in the home improvement and tools space including hardware brands, specialty tools companies, and lifestyle product brands.
We're a small, fast-moving team with a strong product and real partners. This is an early-stage opportunity with meaningful upside for the right person.

**The Role**
We're looking for a driven, relationship-oriented Business Development Representative to open doors with retail buyers, category managers, and digital product leaders at mid-to-large retail organizations. Your job is to identify the right contacts inside target retail accounts, start meaningful conversations, and book qualified discovery calls for our leadership team.
This is a fully remote, commission-only role. You set your own hours and get paid for results.

**What You'll Do**
* Research and prospect target brand accounts in the home improvement, tools, hardware, crafts, and adjacent consumer product verticals.
* Identify the right decision-makers: CMOs, heads of e-commerce, VP of marketing, digital product leads, and founders at growing D2C brands.
* Execute multi-channel outreach via email, LinkedIn, and Instagram to initiate meaningful conversations.
* Personalize messaging around each brand's specific post-purchase engagement challenge, product catalog, and digital footprint.
* Book qualified discovery calls with contacts who influence or own the brand's digital customer experience.
* Track all activity in the outreach CRM and report weekly on pipeline progress.

**What You'll Earn**
This is one of the most aggressive commission structures in early-stage SaaS. We don't offer a base salary, so we make the upside worth it.
50% to 100% commission on every retail deal you close.
Close two deals a quarter working part-time hours, and you're earning more than most full-time sales roles. There is no cap.

**Who We're Looking For**
You're a strong fit if you:
* Have experience prospecting into mid-to-large retail, e-commerce, or consumer brand organizations.
* Understand how retail buying and digital product decisions get made and who the right people are.
* Are comfortable navigating large organizations, finding decision-makers, and getting past gatekeepers.
* Write concise, compelling outreach that earns a response from busy executives.
* Are organized, self-directed, and can manage a pipeline without hand-holding.


**Bonus points if you:**
* Have worked in SaaS, e-commerce technology, or digital marketing tools.
* Have experience selling to or working with Shopify brands.
* Have existing relationships inside D2C brand marketing or e-commerce teams.
* Are familiar with the home improvement, tools, hardware, or crafts product space.

**What to Expect**
* Fully remote. Work from anywhere.
* Flexible hours. No set schedule. You manage your time and deliver results.
* A clear, documented outreach playbook ready for you from day one.
* Weekly 30-minute check-in with the CRO to review pipeline, get coaching, and align on priorities.
* A real path to growth. As Stesso scales, this role grows with it.

title: Client Success Specialist
description:
# About Ataraxis AI

Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients.

Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our [causality](https://www.ataraxis.ai/research-causality) (Ataraxis™ Tau), [foundation model](https://www.ataraxis.ai/research---representation-learning) (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and [survival analysis](https://www.ataraxis.ai/research-survival-analysis) research.

Our first clinical products, such as [Ataraxis™ Breast](https://www.ataraxis.ai/ataraxis-breast-overview) for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide.

At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine.

Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity).

We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential.

## **Responsibilities**

- Serve as the primary contact for physicians, labs, hospitals, patients, and internal teams, responding promptly and professionally to all inquiries via phone, email, or web.
- Deliver an excellent customer experience by addressing questions about tests, services, billing, and order status with empathy, accuracy, and clear communication.
- Collaborate with Sales and clients to resolve missing or incomplete data, ensuring smooth ordering process and and timely delivery of test results.
- Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of all communications, actions, and follow-ups.
- Research and resolve escalated issues, identify root causes, and communicate outcomes clearly to both customers and internal stakeholders.
- Stay knowledgeable about Ataraxis oncology tests, including sample requirements, workflows, and documentation needs.
- Support process improvements and special projects that enhance efficiency, quality, or customer satisfaction.

## **Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent mix of education and hands-on experience.
- 1-2+ years of client-facing or customer support experience, ideally within diagnostics, biotech, or healthcare.
- Proficient in Salesforce, Microsoft Office, and general data management or CRM systems.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for physicians, patients, and internal teams.
- Strong organizational and time management abilities; able to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
- Demonstrated problem-solving skills with sound judgment and attention to detail.
- Works effectively in cross-functional teams, maintaining professionalism and a positive attitude under pressure.
- Flexible and adaptable to changing business priorities and operational demands.

title: Operations Engineer
description:
## Details of the role

- **Location**: Remote (preference for UTC-6 to UTC+5).
- **Type of work**: Full-time (contractor or employee [_depending on circumstances_](https://mui-org.notion.site/Hiring-FAQ-64763b756ae44c37b47b081f98915501#494af1f358794028beb4b7697b5d3102)).
- **Level**: [_IC4 Senior and above_](https://mui-org.notion.site/Leveling-at-MUI-5c30f9bfe65149d697f346447cef9db1).
- We're a **remote** company, operating mostly asynchronously.

## The company

MUI's story began in 2014 with Material UI, the most successful React implementation of Google's Material Design. This open-source project has paved the way for the fully-fledged startup known as MUI (founded in 2019), which now boasts an ever-expanding ecosystem of React UI products. We're a company of 40 people as of 2026, and we're growing steadily.

## The products

MUI is best known for our flagship product, Material UI—but this is just one of the UI libraries we maintain. Material UI is complemented by advanced components through MUI X (Data Grid, Charts, Date and Time Pickers, Tree View) for more complex user interactions and data visualization needs. Base UI is our headless component library. We also host Design Kits and pre-built Templates.

## The culture

MUI is a fully remote company with a team that spans the globe. The majority of our work is asynchronous, and we rely on written communication to collaborate. We're radically transparent: a lot of our work happens in public. Each contributor has the freedom to decide how and when they work, and that work is primarily self-directed: it's your responsibility to define and complete your own tasks in a timely manner.

For additional details about the culture, you can check our [_careers_](https://mui.com/careers/) and [_about_](https://mui.com/about/) pages and also our [_public Handbook_](https://mui-org.notion.site/).

## Why we're hiring

MUI is scaling, but traditional business operations have become a strong bottleneck to our growth. The leadership team is spending too much time on manual, repetitive tasks, building spreadsheets, debugging ETL regressions, wiring SaaS tools together, firefighting operational issues, etc.

Rather than hiring a conventional IT team, we treat internal company operations as an engineering problem. We believe that applying systems thinking, modern software engineering, and AI automation directly to business operations will create immense leverage.

We are opening this role to act as a **hands-on force multiplier** across the organization—building zero-defect data models, automated internal tools, and AI-driven workflows across Finance, GTM (RevOps, Sales, Marketing), People, and Product.

Overall, both our open-source community and our premium products are growing fast. We need talented people to keep up with the demands of our exigent community!

### Why this is interesting

- **Function as a modern hands-on CIO / Head of business systems:** Instead of managing large corporate budgets or enterprise governance, you will directly apply software engineering (TypeScript, SQL, AI frameworks) to real-world business systems.
- **Massive organizational leverage:** You will step into cross-functional gaps to eliminate operational bottlenecks, saving hundreds of hours of leadership time and accelerating company velocity.
- **High-agency autonomy:** Operating without a rigid backlog, you will systematically map MUI's cross-functional workflows using Lean principles, identify high-leverage opportunities, and build end-to-end technical solutions.
- **AI-first execution:** You will be at the forefront of implementing AI agents, LLM tool integrations, and low-code orchestration engines to automate routine business tasks across every department.

Our products empower React developers to build awesome applications faster – we see millions of developers on MUI's docs every year, one million a month.

## The role

### Key responsibilities

Depending on the day, you'll:

- **Internal systems architecture & management (Modern IT/CIO):** Own, maintain, and connect the company's internal software stack—from CRM, billing, and Accounting platforms to internal databases and analytics dashboards.
- **AI & workflow automation engine:** Identify, prototype, and build custom scripts (SQL, JavaScript), AI agents, low-code integrations (for example, Zapier, Make), etc. to eliminate manual tasks across People, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.
- **GTM & RevOps technical execution:** Partner with Sales and Marketing to streamline lead pipelines, customer data enrichment, conversion funnels, and customer-facing website updates.
- **Data Engineering & Operational analytics:** Build and maintain data pipelines, operational dashboards, and data models to power strategic decision-making (for example, pricing model LTV analysis, product adoption telemetry, sales PO volumes, npm/GitHub ecosystem metrics, or OKRs progress).
- **Process engineering & Systems optimization:** Apply the five core Lean principles and systems analysis to map company workflows, identify operational or financial bottlenecks, and build technological solutions to resolve them.
- **Technical force multiplier for Leadership:** Serve as a direct execution arm for executive leadership—stepping in to resolve unowned, cross-cutting technical issues across products, vendor platforms, or internal operations.

## Who we're looking for

### Required

- **High-agency & Cross-functional judgment:** Self-directed problem solver who thrives in ambiguity and can prioritize among many opportunities. See [Manager of one](https://mui-org.notion.site/Managers-of-one-00432bb0f6cf4667ae4ce9dd4cca23d3).
- **High conscientiousness & Detail rigor:** Strong commitment to eventually reach no-defect execution; double-checks everything, maintains immaculate documentation, focuses on friction-free user experiences.
- **Modern business Tech Stack management (CIO/RevOps):** Technical mastery over core SaaS ecosystems (Salesforce/HubSpot, Stripe, NetSuite/Xero, Segment, GitHub/npm APIs).
- **Full-Stack engineering:** Proficiency in TypeScript and SQL; can quickly build internal tools, scripts, and API integrations.
- **Systems & Process engineering (Lean/Systems thinking):** Ability to map cross-functional workflows, spot operational bottlenecks, and apply Lean principles to eliminate non-value-added steps.
- **Data engineering & Analytics architecture:** Track record of designing reliable data pipelines, maintaining zero-defect data models, and delivering actionable BI dashboards (Revenue, LTV, PLG telemetry). For example, ensures data & financial models match to the cent.
- **Workflow automation & AI agents:** Hands-on experience with modern AI workflows (LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, function calling) alongside low-code orchestration engines (for example, Pipedream, Make, Zapier, n8n).
- **4+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with at least 2+ years spent building internal tools, data pipelines, or cross-functional business automation.

### Nice to have (but not required)

- Prior experience as an early-stage startup founder, Technical Operations Lead, GTM Engineer, Finance Ops Engineer, or Principal Engineer with cross-functional scope.
- Experience with React, Next.js, and MUI's tool ecosystem.
- Deep familiarity with open-source ecosystems, developer tools, or PLG (Product-Led Growth) telemetry metrics.
- Background in applying Lean principles within knowledge work or software development contexts.

## Benefits and compensation

We offer competitive compensation commensurate with your experience level and location and are prepared to pay top market rates for someone who can clearly exceed the role's expectations. You can find the other perks and benefits on the [_careers_](https://mui.com/careers/#perks-and-benefits) page.

Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway! Research shows that certain folks are less likely to apply for a role than others [_unless they meet 100%_](https://hbr.org/2014/08/why-women-dont-apply-for-jobs-unless-theyre-100-qualified) of the outlined qualifications. If this role excites you, we want to hear from you. We'd love for you to share the unique skills, passion, and experience you could bring to MUI.

description:
**About Share**

Share is a venture backed company building the marketplace for bandwidth: the infrastructure layer that connects internet capacity suppliers to every individual and business that runs on it.

Today, bandwidth is the most in-demand asset in the world, but its buy/sell process is highly fragmented and inefficiently priced. Share brings the supply and demand together by building distributed routing nodes and connecting carriers, ISPs, data centers, and enterprise buyers through a neutral exchange, turning bandwidth into a liquid, tradeable resource.

We're building the category-defining marketplace for how bandwidth gets bought, sold, and delivered globally.

**The Role**

Share is a venture backed company building the marketplace for bandwidth: the infrastructure layer that connects internet capacity suppliers to every individual and business that runs on it.

title: Sr/Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a senior DevOps engineer to be our sole infrastructure owner — the person who keeps our platform running, scales our delivery pipeline, and responds when things go wrong in production. This isn't a role where you hand off tickets to a platform team. You'll own the infrastructure end-to-end, work closely with engineers on deployment and reliability, and be the on-call anchor for critical incidents. You're someone who combines deep technical expertise with a collaborative, process-minded approach — you keep the team in the loop, follow change control procedures, and understand that good infrastructure work is as much about communication as it is about execution.

What you'll do
* Own and evolve our cloud infrastructure on AWS (+ some Azure) — architecture, provisioning, cost, and security
* Manage and improve our Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads (Docker)
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions
* Drive infrastructure-as-code practices — everything in version control, nothing snowflaked
* Maintain and improve observability: logging (Grafana + Loki), error tracking (Sentry), alerting, and dashboards
* Serve as the primary on-call engineer for critical production incidents 
* Partner with the engineering team on deployment strategy, environment management, and reliability improvements
* Identify gaps proactively and bring well-reasoned recommendations to the team before acting

What we're looking for
* 5+ years of DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience
* Deep hands-on expertise with AWS
* Strong Kubernetes experience: cluster management, networking, resource configuration, troubleshooting
* Docker proficiency — building images, optimizing layers, managing registries
* Solid GitHub Actions experience
* Infrastructure-as-code fluency 
* Comfortable to be the sole DevOps presence on a team 
* On-call ready: you can respond to a production incident at off-hours if needed, stay calm under pressure, and lead the resolution
* Process-minded: you respect change control, loop in the right people before making impactful changes, and document your work as a matter of habit
* Clear, concise communicator — you can explain an outage, a trade-off, or a migration plan to the technical VP of Engineering
* Startup experience — you know how to prioritize ruthlessly and deliver with limited resources
* Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Copilot) to accelerate infrastructure work

Nice to have
* Experience with HIPAA and/or SOC2 compliance
* Familiarity with Grafana, Loki, or Sentry in production
* Background supporting Java microservices deployments
* Experience with database operations — RDS, backups, failover, migrations
* Scripting proficiency in Python or Bash for automation

How we work
* You'll be the only DevOps engineer — high autonomy, high ownership, direct impact on the platform
* We follow change control procedures for production — changes are coordinated, communicated, and documented as a team practice
* Code review is a first-class practice here — every PR gets a thorough review, and we expect engineers to engage seriously with feedback and explain their reasoning
* Remote-first, async-friendly — team spans the Americas
* Linear for project management, GitHub for version control
* Small team = high ownership, direct impact, no bureaucracy

To be considered, make sure to include in your application:
* your linkedin profile
* a link to a 2–3 minute video walking us through the last production incident you led. What broke, what you did, and who you told.

description:
# S U L E — Join Us in Building the Future of Personal Health

**IMPORTANT — Please visit [www.thesule.com](https://www.thesule.com/) before applying.**

We strongly encourage you to understand what we are building, why we are building it, and the stage we are currently at before applying.

---

# About S U L E

**S U L E — Secure Unified Life Enhancement** is an early-stage HealthTech initiative building a personal health platform designed to bring fragmented health information into one connected experience.

Today, health information is often scattered across hospital systems, medical records, wearable devices, home measurements, laboratory results, imaging, and individual apps.

S U L E is being developed around a simple idea:

> **Your health should have a connected story — not a collection of disconnected data points.**

The current S U L E concept brings together a personal Health HUD, health records, device data, trends, configurable health information, family connectivity and access to telemedicine within one experience.

We are now moving toward **Beta testing and a public pre-release phase.**

This is important to understand before applying:

**S U L E is early.**

It is not a finished corporate product with a large team and every process already established.

There are things that need fixing.
There are things that need redesigning.
There are things we have not thought of yet.

And that is precisely why we are looking for the right people now.

---

# An Important Note About Compensation

S U L E is currently a **founder-led, pre-revenue early-stage venture**, and at this stage I do not have the financial resources to offer conventional salaries.

Therefore, **these positions are equity-based rather than salaried positions at the present stage.**

This is not being presented as a conventional paid employment opportunity.

Instead, successful candidates will have the opportunity to join the **early core team of S U L E with an equity arrangement**, subject to the applicable agreement and terms.

The purpose is to build the company together and align the contribution of the early team with the long-term value they help create.

We are therefore looking for people who are genuinely interested in **building something from the ground up**, rather than people simply looking for a conventional salaried position.

As S U L E progresses, funding, revenue and future compensation structures will be considered as part of the company's development.

---

# Why We Are Hiring

Healthcare is one of the most complex environments in which to build technology.

It involves patients, clinicians, healthcare providers, devices, data, privacy, regulation, business models and — ultimately — people's lives.

At the moment, I am taking S U L E forward as a founder-led project.

There is only so much one person can build, test, research, operate and communicate at the same time.

I am therefore looking for **five exceptional people who want to become part of the core team and help shape S U L E from an early stage.**

This is not a role where you receive a perfectly defined task, complete it and hand it back.

You will be expected to **think, challenge, build, communicate, learn and deliver.**

If you see a problem, don't just point at it.

**Help solve it.**

---

# What You Can Expect

### 🚀 A genuine opportunity to build

You will be joining at a stage where your contribution can materially influence the product, company and direction of S U L E.

Your ideas will not disappear into a large organisation.

### 🧠 Room for ingenuity

We are looking for people who can think beyond the obvious.

If you have a better way of doing something, we want to hear it.

### 🕐 Flexible working

We are an early-stage venture, so flexibility is important.

We care about **ownership and outcomes**, not simply being online for a particular number of hours.

### 🤝 Core-team involvement

These are not isolated support positions.

The people joining us will have visibility across the wider S U L E initiative and will contribute to decisions affecting product, technology, healthcare, growth and the company's direction.

### 🎯 Real responsibility

You will have the opportunity to take ownership of an area rather than simply execute instructions.

---

# What We Are Looking For

The most important qualification is simple:

## **Can you walk the talk?**

We are looking for people who:

* Take ownership.
* Deliver what they commit to.
* Can work independently.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity.
* Can identify problems without becoming overwhelmed by them.
* Communicate clearly.
* Are willing to learn outside their immediate area of expertise.
* Can challenge ideas constructively.
* Care about the quality of what they build.
* Understand that an early-stage venture requires initiative.

You do **not** need to know everything.

You do need to be willing to figure things out.

---

# The Five Positions

## 01 — TIBERIUS

### Startup & Strategy / Founder's Office

**The person who helps turn an early-stage project into a company.**

We are looking for someone with experience in **startups, entrepreneurship, business strategy, operations or venture building.**

This person will work closely with the founder across the broader S U L E initiative.

### What you could own

* Startup strategy and execution
* Business planning
* Go-to-market development
* Market and competitor research
* Partnerships and ecosystem development
* Investor preparation and fundraising support
* Business operations
* Prioritisation and execution planning
* Turning ideas into concrete initiatives
* Helping establish processes as the organisation grows

### Ideal background

* Experience working in an early-stage startup
* Experience building or operating a business/project
* Strategy, consulting, venture building or operations
* Strong commercial thinking
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to move between strategy and execution
* Bias toward action rather than endless planning

**Key qualities:** Entrepreneurial mindset · Strategic thinking · Execution · Commercial awareness · Ownership

---

# 02 — HELIX

### Technology & Product Development Lead

**The person who helps build what comes next.**

S U L E is fundamentally a technology product, and we need someone capable of taking the technical vision forward.

This is not simply a developer position.

We are looking for someone who can understand the **product, architecture, users and technical possibilities** and help turn them into a scalable platform.

### What you could own

* Future product development
* Web and mobile application development
* Backend and API development
* Platform architecture
* Healthcare data integrations
* Wearables and device integrations
* AI/ML product opportunities
* Technical product decisions
* Security and privacy by design
* Technical roadmap
* Testing, deployment and reliability
* Turning prototypes into production-quality systems

### Relevant experience may include

* Full-stack development
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React / modern web frameworks
* Node.js
* Python
* REST APIs
* Databases
* Cloud infrastructure
* Mobile development
* Healthcare interoperability / FHIR
* AI/ML
* IoT / wearable integrations
* Cybersecurity and data protection

You do **not** need to have experience in every technology listed.

What matters more is the ability to **understand systems, solve problems and build things.**

**Key qualities:** Engineering · Product thinking · Architecture · Problem solving · Security · Curiosity · Execution

---

# 03 — EVANDER

### Partnerships, Customer & Account Development

**The person who takes S U L E from a product into the real world.**

Building the technology is only half the challenge.

We need someone who can speak to people — understand their problems, build relationships and turn conversations into meaningful partnerships.

This role sits between **customers, healthcare organisations, partners and the S U L E team.**

### What you could own

* Customer discovery
* Account management
* Partnership development
* Healthcare and business outreach
* Customer onboarding
* Product demonstrations
* Gathering and translating customer feedback
* Building relationships with healthcare organisations
* Identifying commercial opportunities
* Managing early pilot relationships
* Supporting go-to-market activities

### Ideal background

* Account management
* Business development
* B2B sales
* Healthcare sales or partnerships
* Customer success
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills
* Confidence speaking with senior stakeholders
* Ability to build relationships from zero

Experience in **HealthTech, MedTech, SaaS, healthcare services or enterprise technology** is particularly relevant.

**Key qualities:** Communication · Relationship building · Commercial thinking · Customer empathy · Persistence · Ownership

---

# 04 — VALERIUS

### Clinical & Medical Advisor

**The person who helps make sure we build healthcare technology with healthcare reality in mind.**

Healthcare cannot be designed entirely from a technology perspective.

We need a healthcare professional who can challenge assumptions, identify clinical considerations and help us understand how S U L E should fit into real-world healthcare environments.

### What you could contribute

* Clinical perspective on product development
* Review of healthcare workflows
* Clinical use-case development
* Patient and clinician journey mapping
* Medical terminology and interpretation
* Feedback on health-data presentation
* Identification of clinically meaningful information
* Review of proposed features and workflows
* Guidance around clinical safety considerations
* Support for healthcare validation and pilot design
* Helping the team understand the realities of clinical practice

### Relevant backgrounds

* Doctor / Physician
* Nurse
* Allied health professional
* Clinical researcher
* Healthcare practitioner
* Healthcare innovation professional
* Clinical informatics professional
* Medical technology professional

Experience with **digital health, telemedicine, clinical systems, medical devices, health data or healthcare innovation** is particularly valuable.

This is not a position where we expect you to provide medical treatment through S U L E.

Your role is to bring **clinical knowledge and healthcare reality into the development process.**

**Key qualities:** Clinical judgement · Patient perspective · Healthcare experience · Critical thinking · Communication · Curiosity

---

# 05 — AURELIUS

### Brand, Social Media & Growth Lead

**The person who takes S U L E from zero visibility to a recognizable presence.**

This position is different from the others.

We are starting essentially **from scratch**.

S U L E needs someone who can take ownership of our public presence and build the story of the company across social media, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to schedule posts.

We are looking for someone who can answer:

**Why should people care about S U L E?**

And then communicate that answer consistently to the world.

### What you could own

* S U L E social-media strategy
* LinkedIn presence and growth
* Content planning
* Company storytelling
* Founder/company positioning
* Community building
* Educational healthcare content
* Product announcements
* Beta and pre-release campaigns
* Short-form content
* Visual/content concepts
* Engagement and audience development
* Identifying relevant communities and conversations
* Monitoring social-media performance
* Building an organic growth strategy from zero

### The challenge

There is currently no large marketing department behind you.

There is no established audience waiting for us.

There is no massive content library.

**You will be building the foundation.**

That means you will have considerable freedom to experiment, test ideas and establish what S U L E's public voice should become.

### We are particularly interested in someone who has

* Experience managing LinkedIn/company pages
* Social-media strategy experience
* Strong writing and storytelling skills
* Understanding of LinkedIn growth
* Content creation experience
* Understanding of social-media analytics
* Ability to create content independently
* Knowledge of personal branding/founder branding
* Experience with startups or technology companies
* Ability to turn technical ideas into understandable stories
* Strong visual sense or experience working with designers/content tools

Healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech or technology experience is a plus — but **curiosity and communication ability are more important.**

You will essentially be building the **public voice of S U L E from the ground up.**

**Key qualities:** Storytelling · Creativity · Communication · Social media · Brand building · Growth mindset · Independence · Consistency

---

# Five People. Five Different Responsibilities.

The five positions are deliberately different — but they will **work together.**

**Tiberius** helps shape the company.

**Helix** builds the technology.

**Evander** brings it to customers and partners.

**Valerius** brings clinical knowledge and healthcare reality.

**Aurelius** tells the world what S U L E is and builds the audience around it.

Together, these roles form the foundation of the next stage of S U L E.

---

# Who Should Apply?

You should apply if you visit the S U L E website and think:

> **“There is something here. I can see what could be better — and I want to help build it.”**

You should probably not apply if you are looking for:

* A highly structured corporate environment
* A role where every task is already defined
* Someone else to solve every problem
* A position with no ambiguity
* A conventional salaried role at this stage

S U L E is early.

That means there is uncertainty.

But it also means there is **room to make a difference.**

---

# What We Value

**Ownership over excuses.**
**Curiosity over ego.**
**Execution over endless discussion.**
**Constructive criticism over negativity.**
**People over titles.**
**Long-term thinking over short-term noise.**

If something is broken, tell us.

If you know how to fix it, even better.

If you don't know how to fix it yet, **help us figure it out.**

---

# Before You Apply

Please visit:

### **[www.thesule.com](http://www.thesule.com)**

Understand the product and the problem we are trying to solve.

Then tell us:

1. **Which position are you applying for?**
2. **Why S U L E?**
3. **What can you bring to the team?**
4. **What is something you have built, delivered or achieved that demonstrates how you work?**
5. **After looking at S U L E, what is one thing you would improve?**

We are much more interested in **how you think and what you can do** than in a perfectly polished CV.

---

# This is an early-stage opportunity.

You will not be joining a company that has already figured everything out.

**You will be joining to help figure it out.**

If that excites you, we would like to hear from you.

title: Analyst, Asset Management
description:
*This is a full-time, in-office position at our Boulder, CO headquarters. We are not offering remote or hybrid options for this role.*

### About Wunder

Wunder is building a Modern Energy Company.

We were founded with one simple vision: to address the greatest crisis of our generation by accelerating the deployment of solar energy. In doing so, we help businesses, municipalities, and schools save money by delivering clean on-site power. We convert simple warehouses into electrified industrial platforms built for the future. We enable the nation’s leading commercial and industrial real estate firms to capture the benefits of solar across their properties. We align ESG goals with revenue targets, and the renewable energy assets we’re deploying today will power America’s tomorrow.

Wunder currently holds more than $1 billion in solar assets under management and capital commitments. Our team has evaluated more than 10,000 properties for solar across all 50 states. Our average solar system - about 480 kilowatts in size - can offset 350,000 pounds of coal burned each year of system operation!

* * *

### The Role

We have an amazing opportunity for an energetic, detail-oriented, and industrious analyst to solve hard problems and push renewable energy forward. We’re looking for someone who works quickly and efficiently, has an eye for detail, and is inspired by a challenge. Our team is rapidly acquiring commercial customers and developing solar across the country alongside our national network of solar partners, and we need your help! 

Specifically, you’ll join our Asset Management team and help us answer a deceptively hard question every day: is each of our solar systems producing what it should be, and if not, why? You’ll compare live production data against weather-adjusted performance models to spot underperformance, dig into inverter and meter data to diagnose the cause, and drive the fix with our construction partners. The answer is different every time, and the processes and tooling we use to get to it are still being built. You’ll help build them. You’ll also help keep the commercial side of the portfolio running: tracking revenue and lease payments, processing annual PPA and lease rate escalations, and building the reporting our customers rely on.

If you get excited about unlocking the untapped commercial and industrial market, joining a team designed for hyper-growth, and building an organization aimed at saving the world, then this is the role for you.

* * *

### About You

- *You Have a Technical Foundation* - You have 1-2+ years of experience or are a recent graduate with a solid foundation from a previous internship, part time, or full time role. We’re especially excited about candidates with an electrical background, whether that’s a degree in Electrical Engineering, time in the trades as an electrician, or hands-on experience with power systems, controls, or instrumentation. If you can look at a single-line diagram and reason about what’s happening on the DC and AC sides of a system, you’ll hit the ground running.
- *You’re a Methodical Troubleshooter* - Most of our systems are hundreds of miles away, so diagnosis happens through data rather than walking the array. You form a hypothesis, test it, rule it out, and move to the next one, instead of guessing and hoping. You know the difference between a number that looks wrong and a number that is wrong, and you execute intentional steps to determine the root cause.
- *Excellent Written & Oral Communication* - You have clear, concise written and verbal communication skills. In this role you might talk through a fault with a service technician on a roof in the morning and write a portfolio update to a customer that afternoon. You can communicate clearly to either audience without losing the substance.
- *You’re Eager and Ready to Learn* - You are at the beginning of an exciting career and you’re ready to get your feet wet and learn how a commercial solar system actually behaves once it’s energized: the hardware that runs it, the failure modes that quietly erode its performance, and the contracts that turn it into a business. You want to get your hands dirty and try new things, all while saving the planet.
- *You Have a Team Ethos* - You thrive in a creative, inventive, fast-paced rapid-growth environment, with people who are passionate about their work and mission. You’re not just excited to work cross-functionally, you crave it.
- *You Believe That No Problem is Too Hard* - In an industry where people are constantly stuck, we find ways to get it done. You know how to articulate and roll out solutions, recognizing there are many solutions to the same problem. You find new and effective ways to streamline and create processes to increase efficiency.
- *Located in Boulder or Denver, CO* - Candidates must currently live in, or be willing to relocate to, the Boulder/Denver area.

* * *

### Some Benefits To Look Forward To

Wunder provides one of the only tangible opportunities to truly save the planet - and that’s hard work! Your job impacts nearly every facet of your life, so we provide an extensive compensation and benefits package to ensure Wunder has a positive impact on your life, both personally and professionally.

#### Salary & Equity

The base salary range for this role is $65,000 - $90,000 per year, plus equity in the form of stock options. Wunder determines the successful candidate's compensation package throughout the interview process based on experience and expertise, and the final compensation package will be discussed with the candidate during the final stages of the interview process.  

#### Benefits & PTO

Wunder truly cares about your happiness and well-being, so we strive to ensure our benefits offerings are of top quality. We offer the following benefits to all team members:

- 100% employer-paid medical, dental & vision insurance for all team members
- 50% employer-paid medical, dental & vision insurance for dependents
- Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability & life insurance
- 401k Matching (50% match up to 4% of your base salary)
- Health Savings Account (HSA) & Dependent Care FSA
- Up to 14 weeks fully paid Parental Leave for childbearing parents; 6 weeks fully paid Parental Leave for non-childbearing parents
- 11 paid holidays & unlimited PTO

#### Culture

Wunder believes connecting with your team members is instrumental to job satisfaction and your ability to solve complex problems. You’ll find our team taking coffee walks or solving problems at a whiteboard, while also cycling, hiking, climbing, skiing, camping, and dining all over our mile-high home: Colorado. Here are some of the ways we facilitate a flexible yet cohesive work environment:

- A big, bright, modern office located in Downtown Boulder; in-office meals and a fully stocked kitchen
- Commitment to diversity, equity & inclusion through company principles, programs, and events (see below for even more details)
- In-person monthly events, team offsites, and company retreats
- Annual professional development budget and unlimited book budget
- And so much more!

#### Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)

Wunder is focused on providing a happy, productive workplace, and we’re constantly improving it! We’re committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace in which all team members have an opportunity to contribute to the success of our mission. At Wunder, people are valued for their skills, experiences, and diverse perspectives, and we encourage all individuals to apply, even if they don’t check every box in the ‘About You’ section above. 

Our commitment to equity is embodied in company policy, but it’s also evident every day in how we conduct business and the internal initiatives and programs we provide for our team. Here are some of the ways we strive to ensure everyone feels welcome, safe and free to be themselves at Wunder:

- A holistic, actionable DEI learning strategy that enables all team members to advance inclusivity in a meaningful way
- Inclusive, objective recruiting processes and partnerships with diverse candidate pools & organizations
- Monthly Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), events and initiatives focused on inclusivity
- Equitable Compensation Principles that ensure every team member is paid fairly and equitably
- An environment that values feedback, active listening, flexibility and open communication
