description:
Cybersecurity Sales Executive / Account Executive

 Managed SIEM | XDR | EDR | MDR | SOC | Penetration Testing

**GuardsArm Inc. | Remote — Canada / United States**

## About GuardsArm

GuardsArm is a growing cybersecurity company helping organizations strengthen their security posture through managed security, threat detection and response, penetration testing, compliance, and cybersecurity advisory services.

Our solutions and services include:

* Managed SIEM
* XDR / EDR
* Managed Detection & Response (MDR)
* SOC monitoring and security operations
* Vulnerability and cybersecurity assessments
* Internal and external penetration testing
* Web application and wireless penetration testing
* Incident response
* vCISO and cybersecurity advisory
* SOC 2 readiness and compliance support
* PCI DSS cybersecurity and compliance services
* Healthcare privacy and security assessments
* Other managed cybersecurity and compliance services

We are now expanding our sales operation and are looking for experienced cybersecurity sales professionals who can help us generate new business and build long-term customer relationships.

## The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly motivated **Cybersecurity Sales Executive / Account Executive** with experience selling cybersecurity, managed security, SaaS, IT services, MSSP/MDR, SIEM, EDR/XDR, or related technology solutions.

This is not an account-management-only position.

We are looking for a **hunter**.

You should be comfortable identifying opportunities from scratch, starting conversations with prospects, conducting discovery, developing opportunities, and progressing deals toward close.

The ideal candidate understands how to sell cybersecurity outcomes rather than simply product features.

You will work directly with the founder and GuardsArm's technical team, giving you immediate access to the people who can scope solutions, demonstrate our technology, answer technical questions, and help close opportunities.

## What You Will Do

You will be responsible for building and converting your own pipeline.

Key responsibilities include:

* Identify and prospect potential GuardsArm customers
* Conduct outbound prospecting through LinkedIn, email, telephone, networking, referrals, partnerships, and other channels
* Develop relationships with business owners, CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, IT Directors, IT Managers, compliance leaders, and other decision-makers
* Book and conduct discovery meetings
* Understand the customer's cybersecurity environment, challenges, compliance requirements, and business risks
* Identify opportunities for SIEM, XDR, EDR, MDR, SOC, penetration testing, compliance, and advisory services
* Present GuardsArm solutions to prospective customers
* Work with our technical team on demonstrations, solution design, scoping, and proposals
* Manage opportunities through the sales pipeline
* Handle objections and commercial discussions
* Negotiate and close new customers
* Build referral and channel relationships with MSPs, IT consultants, technology providers, and other partners
* Develop strategic accounts and recurring managed-security revenue
* Maintain accurate visibility into pipeline activity and deal progression

## Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who have sold for or competed within environments such as:

* MSSPs
* MDR providers
* Managed SOC providers
* Cybersecurity consulting firms
* SIEM vendors
* EDR/XDR companies
* Endpoint-security companies
* Cloud-security companies
* Penetration-testing firms
* Compliance/security consulting firms
* MSPs and IT service providers

Experience with companies or ecosystems such as Arctic Wolf, eSentire, Huntress, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Sophos, Palo Alto Networks/Cortex, Fortinet, Microsoft Security, Rapid7, ConnectWise, Blackpoint Cyber, Expel, Red Canary, or similar cybersecurity organizations is highly relevant.

## Ideal Background

You may be a strong fit if you have:

* Previous cybersecurity or B2B technology sales experience
* A track record of generating net-new business
* Experience prospecting into SMB, mid-market, or enterprise organizations
* Experience selling recurring contracts or managed services
* Knowledge of cybersecurity terminology and buyer concerns
* Experience selling to IT Directors, CISOs, CTOs, CIOs, business owners, or senior executives
* Strong discovery and consultative-selling skills
* Confidence conducting outbound prospecting
* Experience building your own pipeline instead of relying entirely on inbound leads
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Negotiation and closing ability
* An entrepreneurial mindset

Existing relationships with potential cybersecurity buyers are highly valued.

## Industries We Serve

Our target markets include organizations in sectors such as:

* Healthcare
* Legal and professional services
* Financial services
* Municipalities and public-sector organizations
* Energy
* Oil and gas
* Manufacturing
* Technology
* Education
* Transportation
* Retail
* Regulated small and mid-sized businesses

## Compensation

We are open to working with exceptional cybersecurity sellers under an **independent / performance-based compensation structure with significant uncapped earning potential**.

Our preferred model includes attractive commissions on new business generated and closed.

Depending on experience, network, and responsibilities, compensation may include:

* Competitive commission on first-year revenue
* Recurring commission opportunities on managed-service renewals
* Accelerators for exceeding revenue targets
* Additional incentives for strategic accounts
* Potential progression into a senior sales leadership role as GuardsArm grows

There is no artificial cap on earnings.

A salesperson who consistently creates and closes meaningful managed-security opportunities should be rewarded accordingly.

We are particularly interested in experienced sellers who value performance-based upside and want an opportunity to help build a growing cybersecurity company.

## Why GuardsArm?

### Sell multiple cybersecurity solutions

You are not limited to selling one narrow security product.

A prospect that is not ready for managed SIEM may still require penetration testing, an assessment, EDR/XDR, compliance services, vCISO support, or another cybersecurity engagement.

That gives you multiple ways to create and expand customer relationships.

### Recurring revenue opportunity

Our managed cybersecurity offerings create the potential for meaningful recurring customer relationships rather than one-off transactional sales.

### Direct access to leadership

You will work directly with GuardsArm's founder and technical team rather than navigating layers of management.

### Technical support during the sales process

You do not need to be the SOC engineer.

Our technical team can support qualified opportunities with technical discovery, demonstrations, architecture discussions, security assessments, scoping, and proposal development.

### Build, not maintain

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys creating markets, opening doors, and building a sales function—not simply inheriting an existing territory.

### Growth opportunity

Exceptional performers can grow into roles such as:

* Senior Account Executive
* Enterprise Account Executive
* Sales Director
* Head of Sales
* Channel Sales Leader

as the company expands.

## What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is straightforward:

You create qualified cybersecurity opportunities.

You build relationships with decision-makers.

You develop a predictable pipeline.

You convert opportunities into paying customers.

And you help GuardsArm build recurring cybersecurity revenue.

We care far more about measurable results than activity for activity's sake.

## Who Should Apply

We would especially like to hear from:

* Experienced cybersecurity Account Executives
* Former MSSP/MDR sales professionals
* Independent cybersecurity sales representatives
* Cybersecurity sales consultants
* Enterprise technology sellers with security experience
* High-performing SDRs ready to progress into closing roles
* Former cybersecurity sales leaders interested in an entrepreneurial opportunity
* Professionals with strong MSP, channel, CISO, CIO, or IT-leadership networks

If you understand cybersecurity buyers, know how to open doors, and can turn conversations into revenue, we would like to speak with you.

## How to Apply

Please include a short note covering:

1. Your cybersecurity or technology-sales background
2. The types of cybersecurity solutions or services you have sold
3. Your experience generating net-new pipeline
4. Your typical customer profile or industries
5. Your experience with outbound prospecting
6. Examples of quota attainment or significant deals you have closed
7. Whether you already have relationships within cybersecurity, IT, MSP, or executive buyer communities

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate measurable sales performance.

**GuardsArm Inc.**
Cybersecurity. Detection. Response. Compliance.

title: Open Source Contributor
description:
**Company Description**
Doplex Labs is a two-person stealth team building Belay, an open-source experience layer for coding agents. Belay reads Claude Code and Codex sessions locally, surfaces the mistakes agents keep repeating, and carries approved lessons into future sessions. Our first evaluation is public: getbelay.vercel.app/whitepaper. We're based in the San Francisco Bay Area and work with open source contributors remotely. This is an open source contributor volunteer program.

**Role Description**
Please note that this is an open-source volunteer role, not employment; there is no compensation at this stage. Remote, contribute at your own pace; optional weekly office hours with the founders. You'll work in the public belay-engine repo under your own name: building detectors over real session data, MCP tools that agents use to read evidence, and the evaluation tooling for our next benchmark study. Stack is Go and SQLite with Claude Code and Codex integrations. If this becomes a company, the people who built it with us are the first ones we call.

**Qualifications**

* Solid in Go or Python; you've shipped something people used
* You think from first principles
* You've actually used Claude Code or Codex, ideally daily
* Comfortable with Git and code review in a public repo
* Interest in agent reliability and evaluation; rigor over hype
* Students and early-career engineers welcome

To fast-track: use belay and tell us 2-3 features you'd like to improve and the shortcoming you noticed from a user's perspective; also send a link to something you've built (and maybe what you'd fix first in belay-engine): doplexlabs[@]gmail[dot]com

title: Demand Generation
description:
## **About Us**  

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place.

## About the role and you

We're hiring a Demand Generation Lead to own pipeline generation for North America. Today, demand gen at Lorikeet is spread across several people who each carry a piece of it alongside their day jobs — this role exists to change that. You'll be the first person whose sole focus is building the machine that fills our pipeline.

You'll own a North American pipeline target and work backwards from it — designing and executing the mix of events, webinars, industry programs, and campaigns that gets us there. You'll also help shape how demand gen scales as a function as we grow, defining the playbook rather than inheriting one. This is a mid-senior role for someone who's comfortable being accountable to a hard revenue-linked number with a high degree of autonomy over how they hit it.

## What you'll do

- Own the North American pipeline target and build the quarterly plan that gets us there
- Design and run the full demand gen program mix: field events, executive dinners, webinars, industry programs, and integrated campaigns
- Work backwards from pipeline goals to channel-level targets, budgets, and forecasts, and report clearly on what's working and what isn't
- Partner closely with Sales to ensure every program converts — tight handoffs, fast follow-up, and shared accountability for pipeline quality
- Build the demand gen operating infrastructure from scratch: campaign tracking, attribution, and reporting that give us a real view of the funnel
- Identify which channels and plays are worth scaling and which to kill, iterating quickly with limited resources
- Define the demand gen playbook for Lorikeet as we grow, laying the foundation for the function's future team and budget

## The right candidate

We're looking for someone who is energized by owning a number, not just running programs — someone who sees a pipeline target as a puzzle to reverse-engineer rather than a burden. The ideal candidate learned the fundamentals of demand gen inside a rigorous, well-resourced marketing org, then proved they could build the whole thing from scratch with none of that scaffolding.

You might be a fit if you:

- Have 4–7 years of demand generation experience in B2B SaaS
- Spent your foundational years at a public software company where you learned what best-in-class demand gen looks like
- Then spent 2–3 years at an early-stage startup (under ~100 people) building the demand gen function from zero — choosing channels, setting up systems, and owning outcomes without a big team or budget
- Have hands-on experience across the program mix: field events, webinars, executive dinners, and industry programs, not just digital campaigns
- Think in pipeline, not MQLs — you work backwards from revenue targets and can defend your math
- Operate with high autonomy and low need for direction, and are relentless about follow-through
- Care about the quality of the pipeline you create, not just the volume — you see Sales as your customer
- Are curious about AI and excited to help define what an AI-first company looks like from the inside

If you don't quite match this and are from an under-represented background we strongly encourage you to reach out. We know first hand that diverse teams are higher performing and are proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

## **What's unique about this opportunity?**

**A culture that's genuinely different.** Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

**A front-row seat to building something meaningful.** We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.

**Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar.** Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.

**We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too.** Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.

**Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii.** Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.

**A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops.** We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.

If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

title: Business Marketing Lead
description:
The **Monad Foundation** is a team of dedicated ecosystem and community builders who are on a mission to massively grow the impact of decentralized tech. We believe that the [Monad](https://monad.xyz/) blockchain--the performant and parallel EVM Layer 1--will help decentralized apps eat the world.

## **The Role**

The Monad ecosystem is quickly growing as established crypto companies, financial institutions, fintechs, and technology companies look to launch products and build businesses onchain. This role is focused on translating that activity into compelling stories that show and share why businesses are choosing Monad, and the possibilities opened by building on the network.

As a Business Marketing Lead, you will own co-marketing and collaborative go-to-market efforts with key integrations and deployments. You’ll work across the GTM and creative teams within the Monad Foundation, and liaise directly with external marketing and business teams to understand the opportunity and identify strong stories to develop and deliver high-quality campaigns.

This is a dynamic role that demands managing a high volume of complex external workstreams and a high degree of quality. You will own campaign design and delivery, from brief through launch, which includes crafting memorable messaging and building out case studies, among other creative content and activations.

## **What You Will Do**

- Be embedded within the GTM business and content teams to understand pipeline context, priorities, and opportunities for co-marketing amplification.
- Maintain a clear view of upcoming launches, evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on expected impact. Determine where marketing can create the most value, decide the appropriate level of support, and translate those decisions into clear strategies.
- Develop and own joint marketing campaigns. Identify key narratives; create social activations; write case studies and blogs; and own other programs that turn deployments into broader proof of Monad’s adoption, capabilities, and momentum.
- Drive campaigns from start to finish, including managing timelines and execution across asset development and deliverables, legal and compliance reviews, launch sequencing, and follow-through across stakeholders.
- Own campaign outcomes. Define upfront objectives and success metrics, track performance and results, and leverage learnings for go-forward programs.

## **Who You Are**

- You have 5+ years of experience in business marketing, partner marketing, or a related role ideally within crypto, financial services, or enterprise technology.
- You understand the crypto ecosystem and can work credibly with both crypto-native companies and traditional businesses. Familiarity with DeFi, payments, stablecoins, tokenization, and financial infrastructure is a strong plus.
- You have owned integrated or joint GTM campaigns involving external organizations, from initial planning phases through launch and measurement.
- You are an excellent writer and editor. You can quickly understand a complex integration or business relationship, identify the strongest market-facing story, and turn that into clear content for sophisticated audiences.
- You exercise strong judgement, are highly organized, and are comfortable running many concurrent workstreams.
- You are high-agency and self-directed. You use AI and automation intelligently and can move work forward without significant oversight.

## **Why Work with Us**

- **Challenging problems.** You’ll tackle deeply complex and technically demanding problems, with autonomy and impact.
- **Endless Opportunity for Impact.** The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) standard is ubiquitous, but existing EVM-compatible chains are slow and bandwidth-constrained. Monad’s core innovations offer developers and founders the best of both worlds (portability and performance) and are a game-changer to power global on-chain finance.
- **The right team.** You’ll be part of a world class team, who are exceptional and highly-motivated.
- **Culture**. We’re a lean team working together to achieve very ambitious goals. We are united in our culture of collaboration, low ego, and high-quality output.
- **Strong Ecosystem**. The broader Monad ecosystem has attracted support from leading investors, builders and long-term contributors.

title: Web Development Partner - Existing Client Base
description:
### Required

**Remote | Global | Partnership Opportunity | No Salary or Retainer**

**This is not a salaried job or freelance development position.**

We’re looking for experienced website developers, freelancers and web agency owners who already have an established client base and want to create an additional revenue stream from the relationships they’ve already built.

You already have the clients.

You already understand their businesses.

They already trust you with their website.

We provide additional tools and technology you can introduce to those clients - and when an opportunity turns into a sale, you earn a share of the deal.

### The Opportunity

T3 Labs builds interactive website tools designed to help businesses turn their websites into something more useful than a digital brochure.

Our solutions can include:

* Instant quote and estimation tools
* Pricing calculators
* Measurement tools
* Product and material calculators
* Interactive customer tools
* Smart AI assistants trained around a business
* Custom website-based sales and lead-generation tools

Rather than finding completely new clients, the opportunity is to look at the businesses you already work with and identify where one of these tools could improve their website, customer experience or internal process.

For example, you may have previously built a website for a roofing company.

Instead of simply leaving that website as-is, you could go back to them and introduce a tool that allows customers to estimate the cost of a roof directly from their website.

Or perhaps you work with a supplier whose customers regularly call asking how much material they need.

We could build a calculator that handles that process automatically.

You identify the opportunity and introduce it to your client. **T3 Labs handles the product and technical delivery.**

You earn from the resulting sale.

### Who We're Looking For

This opportunity is specifically suited to people who:

* Have several years of website development experience
* Already have an existing client base or strong professional network
* Have ongoing relationships with businesses whose websites they have built or managed
* Understand where their clients lose leads, waste time or have inefficient website processes
* Are comfortable introducing additional products or services to existing clients
* Want to add another revenue stream without having to build the underlying technology themselves

You could be:

* An independent website developer
* A freelance web designer/developer
* The owner of a web development agency
* A digital consultant
* Someone who has spent years building websites and has accumulated a substantial client network

### What This Is NOT

This is **not**:

* A salaried role
* An hourly-paid development position
* A retainer arrangement
* A traditional employment opportunity
* A role where we provide you with a list of clients and ask you to cold call them

This is a **commercial partnership opportunity**.

The value you bring is your experience, your existing relationships and your understanding of the clients you've worked with.

The value we bring is additional technology that you can offer those clients without having to develop it yourself.

### How It Works

You identify a client or contact who could benefit from one of our tools.

You introduce the opportunity.

Depending on how involved you want to be, you can either make the introduction and let our team take over, or remain involved throughout the sales process.

If the opportunity becomes a completed sale, you receive an agreed share of the revenue.

There are no required hours and no expectation that you stop doing your existing work.

This should sit alongside the business and client relationships you already have.

### Why It Makes Sense

If you've spent years building websites, you've also spent years building something potentially even more valuable:

**trust.**

Your clients already know you.

They already come to you when they need something changed, improved or added to their website.

Instead of referring them elsewhere when they need more advanced functionality, you can bring T3 Labs into the project and participate commercially in the work.

**You keep your client relationship. We provide the technology. You share in the opportunity.**

### Before Applying

Please only apply if you understand that **this is a partnership opportunity and there is no salary, hourly rate or guaranteed income.**

We're particularly interested in speaking with people who already have a meaningful client base they could introduce relevant solutions to.

When applying, tell us:

* How long you've been building websites
* What types of businesses you typically work with
* Roughly how many existing or previous clients you have relationships with
* Whether you're a freelancer, consultant or agency owner
* What industries your client network is strongest in

If you've already spent years building websites and relationships with businesses, this is an opportunity to create additional revenue from that network without having to build another product from scratch.

description:

title: Coalition Partnerships Manager
description:
**A mission worth building for, on a model you should understand before you apply.** FiNC is changing how politics works in America, and we are Crowd-Starting it. **Contributor roles are not paid yet; compensation is deferred.** Full details in the Crowd-Starting section below.

## About FiNC

We're assembling a coalition to change how politics works. Forever.

3 middlemen decide which candidates you ever hear about: big money, party gatekeepers, and media manipulation. They control the money, the access, and the visibility every candidate needs to win, so they decide who wins before anyone votes. The system isn't broken. It's rigged, and it works exactly as it was built to.

FiNC (Future is Now Coalition) is the way around it. Citizens say what they care about, candidates say who they are, and the 2 sides connect with nobody in between. Our work is the human side: outreach, PR, social, and citizen buy-in. We're not marketing a website. We're campaigning for a better way to choose leaders.

We're largely neurodiverse, direct by default, and soft on hierarchy. Team members here are partners and co-architects, not employees. Full mission and culture at futureis.org.


## IMPORTANT: This involves DELAYED COMPENSATION -- Please read carefully

To maintain our independence and avoid conflicts of interest, we are not accepting investors or financing that comes with strings attached. Instead, **we are Crowd-Starting FiNC: building it together from the ground up**.

***We ask team members to contribute 15 to 20 hours per week during this phase, with compensation deferred until we are operational. That includes the Founder, who has not drawn a salary and will not until the team does.***

This model only works if you see it as a **short-term investment for a long-term return**. Contributors who build this with us **earn an ownership stake in FiNC**.

We are **building toward something akin to a nonprofit cooperative, where the people who build the organization own it, and we operate not for profit in the meantime**.

This model filters for people who believe in the mission deeply enough to build alongside us. It is not for everyone, and that is okay.

## Culture and Employment

**A New Kind of Organization for a New Kind of Democracy**

- Neurodiversity and diversity-of-thought are strengths, not obstacles
- Servant leadership, dynamic team structures, and shared ownership
- Purpose over profits, value over hours, and respect for work-life balance
- We reward authenticity, passion, and commitment, not conformity
- We support individual weaknesses to enhance collective strengths
- Continuous role assessments, long-term growth opportunities, and real career sustainability

From your first 2-way interview, you will see (and feel) how radically different we are.

## The Role

FiNC is looking for a **Coalition Partnerships Manager** to build the coalition from the partner side: the communities, movements, organizations, and candidates who bring their own people with them.

We say we're assembling a "coalition of movements." This is the seat that turns that sentence into a list of names.

You would work directly with the Founder, starting with partnerships that are already live.

## The problem you would solve

Every movement, third party, and reform group is pushing against the same status quo, and every one of them is pushing alone. They split the resources, the media access, and attention, and each one builds its own table. Those tables collapse, because the system is built to collapse them.

We're assembling 1 table they can all sit at.

We know who to call. That part is not the gap. The gap is everything after the first conversation: staying with people, finding the thing worth building together, and making sure the relationship is still alive 3 weeks later. Our failure with partners has never been that people lose interest; it's that nobody hands them a specific thing to do by a specific date, so a warm conversation dies quietly and nobody notices for a month.

## Who you would be talking to

3 groups, in rough priority order. All are open, and we're ready to meet anyone who fits.

- **Communities and movements.** Our biggest opportunity. Disability advocates, veterans, reform organizations, issue movements, regional civic groups. They have the 1 thing we need most, which is their own people. Most are under-resourced and fighting in silos, and plenty have already been burned by a partnership that went nowhere. They'll be cautious, and they're right to be
- **Candidates.** Independents, third-party candidates, and candidate coalitions. You would lead with the full package we build around a candidate, never with "we have a profile for you"
- **Independent voices.** Podcasters, creators, and independent journalists. We're a story, not a sponsor, and that's a better pitch than it sounds

The instinct that has to be real in all 3 rooms: **we're not competing with any of them.** They have goals in politics. We're assembling the system that lets them reach theirs.

## How you would work with the Founder

Most partner meetings are the 2 of you.

The Founder carries the depth: the mission, the architecture, the answers to the hard questions. **You carry the relationship and the shape of the conversation.** Opening it, reading the room, knowing when to let him go deeper and when to bring it back, and getting it to a specific next step before anyone leaves.

That's a real division of labor, not a junior seat. The substance is covered. What's missing is the person who makes an hour with strangers feel easy and end somewhere, and who keeps the rhythm going between meetings so the next one isn't starting cold.

## What you would do

- Own our live partnerships day to day
- Build and lead **workshops** with partner communities, alongside the Founder
- Bring new partners in and turn existing leads into actual relationships
- Deliver value before you ask for anything. Cross-promote their work, set up an interview, run a shared post
- Turn every offer of help into a task with a date and 1 named owner, within 7 days. That's a standing rule here, not a suggestion
- Onboard partners and walk them through what's real today
- Carry what you hear in those rooms back to the team so what we build fits actual use

## What success looks like in 90 days

- **The Nevada community has defined what it wants counted**, in their words rather than ours
- **At least 1 workshop** built and delivered end to end
- **2 new partners in real conversation**, each with a named contact and a dated next step
- **Zero open commitments to any partner** without an owner and a date attached

## Who we're looking for

- 2+ years in partnerships, coalition work, community organizing, program management, or something close enough that you can show us the work
- **You're good in the room.** You can carry a first meeting with people you've never met, keep it warm, and still get to a decision
- **You run a room without being the expert in it.** Workshops, facilitation, group discussion where the partner knows their own needs far better than you do
- **You listen more than you pitch.** Partners can tell the difference in the first 5 minutes, and the ones we want are the most sensitive to it
- **Comfortable working with things that are half-built,** and comfortable saying so out loud to a partner instead of smoothing over it. We never promise a date we can't control, and we'd rather show someone the sequence. Honesty about where we are persuades better than polish, and we hold that line hard
- **You follow up.** Not "I'll circle back." A date, an owner, and then the thing actually happens

title: Sales & Marketing Intern
description:
**Employment Type:** Full-Time Internship

**Duration:** 3 Months

**Work Mode:** Remote

**Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM IST

**Reporting To:** Founder & Sales Leadership

## About SafetyConnect

SafetyConnect is a B2B SaaS company building technology solutions that help enterprises improve workplace, driving, and process safety.

We are looking for a **Sales & Marketing Intern** who is excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment and gain hands-on experience across **B2B sales, enterprise marketing, market research, and go-to-market execution**.

This is not an observational internship. You will work closely with the **founder and sales leadership team**, take ownership of assigned workstreams, and contribute directly to our sales and marketing initiatives.

## What You'll Do

### Sales & Business Development

* Research and identify potential enterprise customers across priority industries and target segments.
* Build and maintain prospect lists using relevant research and prospecting tools.
* Support outbound sales activities, including lead sourcing, qualification, outreach, and follow-ups.
* Assist in preparing sales presentations, proposals, one-pagers, and other customer-facing materials.
* Maintain accurate lead and prospect information and track movement through the sales funnel.
* Support the sales team in preparing for customer meetings and follow-up activities.

### Marketing & Demand Generation

* Support marketing initiatives across **LinkedIn, email, and other digital channels**.
* Assist in creating marketing collateral, including presentations, one-pagers, case studies, and campaign content.
* Conduct competitor, industry, and market research to identify trends and opportunities.
* Support the development of messaging and positioning for different customer segments.
* Track and analyse basic marketing and campaign performance metrics.
* Contribute ideas for improving brand awareness and inbound demand generation.

### Market & Customer Research

* Research target industries, buyer personas, customer needs, and key business pain points.
* Analyse industry trends and competitor offerings to support GTM initiatives.
* Capture and organise insights from sales conversations and market research.
* Help translate customer and market insights into actionable recommendations.
* Support refinement of SafetyConnect's go-to-market messaging based on field insights.

### Execution & Collaboration

* Work directly with the founder and internal teams on day-to-day sales and marketing initiatives.
* Take ownership of assigned workstreams and drive them from research to execution.
* Participate in weekly reviews, planning discussions, and progress meetings.
* Maintain structured documentation of activities, learnings, and outcomes.
* Provide clear and timely updates on assigned projects and deliverables.

## What We're Looking For

* Strong communication and written English skills.
* Good research, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Interest in **B2B SaaS, enterprise sales, marketing, and startups**.
* Comfortable conducting online research and working with spreadsheets, presentations, and productivity tools.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to organise information effectively.
* Proactive approach with a willingness to take ownership rather than wait for instructions.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Comfortable communicating with internal teams and, when required, prospective customers.
* Students, recent graduates, or candidates with relevant internship/project experience are welcome to apply.

### Good to Have

* Previous experience in sales, business development, marketing, or market research.
* Familiarity with CRM, lead-generation, email outreach, or sales prospecting tools.
* Experience creating presentations or marketing content.
* Basic understanding of B2B SaaS or enterprise sales processes.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn-based prospecting and outreach.

## What You'll Gain

* Hands-on experience building and executing **B2B SaaS sales and marketing initiatives**.
* Direct exposure to working with the founder and sales leadership team.
* Practical experience in **enterprise sales, lead generation, GTM strategy, market research, and demand generation**.
* Opportunity to work on real customer and business problems rather than simulated projects.
* Exposure to startup operations and cross-functional collaboration.
* A strong foundation for a career in **Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Growth, or Business Operations**.

## Performance & Growth

This is a **performance-oriented internship** designed for candidates who want meaningful ownership and real-world startup experience.

Interns will be evaluated based on their **ownership, execution quality, consistency, communication, and measurable contribution** to assigned workstreams.

High-performing interns may be considered for a **full-time opportunity with SafetyConnect** based on business requirements and individual performance.

## Work Culture

We value:
* **Ownership over supervision**
* **Execution over observation**
* **Curiosity over assumptions**
* **Data-driven decision making**
* **Clear and proactive communication**
* **Continuous learning and improvement**

If you're looking for an internship where you can **learn by doing, work closely with leadership, and see the direct impact of your work**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply now to join SafetyConnect and be part of our growing team.**


### **Application Question**

Imagine you have been asked to help SafetyConnect identify new enterprise customers. Choose one industry you believe SafetyConnect should target, identify 3 potential companies within that industry, and explain which company you would prioritise first and why. Also mention the job title/person you would approach within that company.

***This question is intended to understand your approach to market research, customer identification, prioritisation, and B2B sales.***

title: Sales Development Intern (Tele-calling)
description:
Call India's affordable housing finance companies, find the person who owns
construction-stage disbursement, and book the meeting. Two months, then a
full-time offer if you perform.

ABOUT STAGEBRIDGE
When a home loan is disbursed in tranches, the lender has to prove the house
actually reached the stage being paid for. Today that means scheduling a site
visit and chasing photos over WhatsApp.

StageBridge replaces that with guided, location-stamped photo capture on the
borrower's own phone, automated checks on every submission, and an AI stage
read that writes out its reasoning. A named credit officer still makes every
release decision. The software never approves or disburses anything.

We are early. The product is live and in evaluation with housing finance
companies. There is no revenue yet. You would work directly with the founder
and the GTM lead.

THE ROLE
You are the first voice of the company. Your job is to reach the right person
at 100+ housing finance companies and get them into a 20-minute conversation
with our GTM lead.

What you do every day:
- 60 to 80 dials. That is the target and we hold you to it. It takes about
  five focused hours.
- Reach the right owner: Head of Credit, Chief Risk Officer, Head of Technical
  or Valuation, Head of Operations, or the COO at smaller lenders.
- Get past the gate. Most calls end at a receptionist or branch manager. Find
  the name, the designation and the direct line, and call back at the right hour.
- Qualify in 90 seconds. Does this lender disburse against construction stages?
  Who signs off the tranche? How do they verify progress today?
- Book the meeting, with the prospect's name, role, phone and context written
  up before you hang up.
- Log every dial, gatekeeper name, callback time and outcome the same day. An
  unlogged call did not happen.
- Fifteen-minute debrief at the end of each day on what worked and what we
  change in the script tomorrow.

What good looks like: 60 to 80 dials usually gives 8 to 12 real conversations
and 1 to 2 qualified ones. We expect 2 to 3 booked meetings a week by week
three. You will miss these numbers in your first days. That is normal and we
coach you through it.

What this is not: no email blasting, no marketing or social media, and no
script that promises things the product does not do.

WHAT YOU GET
- A written call script, objection library and the exact target list. You are
  not cold-starting anything.
- Live coaching from the founder and the GTM lead, including reviews of your
  own call recordings.
- A front-row seat while a B2B sales motion is built from zero in regulated
  lending. You will learn how housing finance companies actually buy.
- A completion certificate and a reference.

COMPENSATION, TARGET-BASED
There is no fixed stipend for the two months. You earn on what you produce.

- Daily dial target: 60 to 80 calls.
- Every converted call pays Rs 100. A converted call means a decision maker at
  a housing finance company agrees to a 20-minute meeting at a specific date
  and time.
- Hit 90 or more dials in a day and every converted call that day pays Rs 150
  instead of Rs 100.
- Paid monthly against the shared call log. Duplicate calls to the same person,
  and bookings the prospect did not actually agree to, do not count.

At the end of two months, a full-time offer with a fixed monthly salary plus
per-meeting incentive, decided on your numbers and your discipline. Conversion
is not automatic and we will not pretend it is.

HOW YOU CONVERT
We review at week 4 and week 8 on four things: dial discipline, meetings booked
and actually attended, quality of your written handoff, and coachability.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- 0 to 2 years of experience. Freshers welcome. Tele-calling, collections,
  insurance or loan-sales experience is a plus, not a requirement.
- Fluent English and Hindi on the phone. A South Indian language, Marathi or
  Gujarati is a real advantage, since these lenders sit in tier-2 and tier-3 India.
- You are not scared of being hung up on 50 times a day.
- Your own laptop, a phone with a working plan, stable internet, a quiet place
  to call from.

title: Creative Strategist Intern
description:

I’m looking for a Creative Strategist Intern to help manage and grow my content across Instagram, YouTube and other platforms.

I create content around products, startups, business, technology, and the strategies behind successful companies. I enjoy researching ideas, writing scripts, and recording videos — but managing the entire content pipeline myself has become a bottleneck. [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/theprathamshankwalker/)

Your job will be to take ownership of everything after the idea/script is ready and make sure content consistently gets produced, edited, published, improved - leading to virality and more followers.

* Work hours - 2-3 hrs a day (flexible timing)
* Stipend - Rs 5000/mo

What You’ll Do

* Manage the complete content pipeline
* Coordinate with and manage video editors
* Give editors clear briefs, references, B-roll ideas, and feedback
* Manage thumbnails, carousels, graphics, captions, and other creatives
* Schedule and publish content across platforms
* Maintain a content calendar and ensure nothing gets delayed
* Research content trends, formats, hooks, and topics
* Analyze content performance and identify what’s working
* Suggest new content ideas, formats, and experiments
* Continuously improve our content based on analytics and audience feedback

* Experience working with video editors
* Familiarity with tools like Notion, Google Drive, Canva, CapCut/Premiere Pro

* Learn how to build a content engine from scratch
* Freedom to experiment with new formats and ideas
* Exposure to startups, product building, marketing, and personal branding

You’ll be expected to think, experiment, coordinate people, analyze results, and actively contribute to growing the content.

What is one creator or brand whose content strategy you think is excellent, and why?

title: Independent Sales Representative — Software & AI (Commission Only)
description:
About Montegra Studios

Montegra Studios is a Canadian custom software and AI development company. We build custom software, AI automation, internal business systems, web and mobile applications, integrations, APIs, ERP/CRM solutions, and other business technology for private-sector clients.

We are expanding our sales network and looking for independent Sales Representatives to originate new B2B opportunities.

The Role

You will independently identify and approach businesses that may need Montegra’s services through outbound email, calls, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, or other professional prospecting methods.

Your primary responsibility is generating and developing qualified opportunities. Montegra supports the technical side of the sales process, including discovery, scoping, estimates, proposals, contracting, and project delivery.

Our projects generally start around CAD $10,000 and can be materially larger depending on scope.

Compensation

This is a commission-only independent contractor position.

10% commission on qualifying collected project revenue
Additional performance bonuses
No cap on qualifying commissions
No salary, hourly wage, or guaranteed income

For example, qualifying CAD $50,000 in collected project revenue would generate CAD $5,000 in commission, subject to the terms of the representative agreement.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for people who can communicate professionally with business decision-makers, prospect independently, and consistently develop new opportunities.

B2B sales, business development, lead generation, technology, consulting, or professional-services experience is useful, but technical development experience is not required.

Montegra handles technical delivery. Your focus is bringing qualified business to the company.

Before Applying

Please apply only if you understand and are comfortable with:

Independent contractor status
Commission-only compensation
10% commission on qualifying collected project revenue
Independently conducting outbound prospecting
Signing Montegra’s independent contractor agreement before beginning

title: Part time Business Development Associate
description:
**About AroundU
**

AroundU is building the Shopify for events and experiences.

Most communities, creators, clubs, and experience businesses currently manage their operations across Instagram, Google Forms, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, and ticketing platforms. They may get registrations, but they do not build a usable customer database or own the relationship with their audience.

AroundU helps organizers create their own branded booking infrastructure, manage registrations and payments, retain attendee data, communicate with customers, and grow their audience over time.

We’ve grown to 35,000 users with zero marketing spend and are already generating revenue. Communities and organizers across cities use AroundU to host workshops, meetups, run clubs, curated gatherings, and social experiences.

As we scale, we’re looking for people who enjoy talking to businesses, building partnerships, conducting demos, and helping organizers move their events and customer relationships onto AroundU.

This role is ideal for MBA students, aspiring founders, or people interested in sales, partnerships, growth, SaaS, and startups.

**What You'll Do **

• Find communities, creators, clubs, and experience businesses that regularly host events, workshops, meetups, or activities
• Reach out to organizers through Instagram, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, and calls
• Understand how they currently manage registrations, payments, attendee data, and customer communication
• Explain how AroundU gives organizers their own branded booking infrastructure instead of relying only on Google Forms, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, or ticketing marketplaces
• Conduct product demos and explain how AroundU works as a Shopify-like platform for events and experiences
• Show organizers how they can build and retain their own customer database after every event
• Help businesses import previous attendee data from Google Forms, spreadsheets, and ticketing platforms
• Help organizers set up their booking page, launch their first event, and understand the platform
• Build long-term relationships with organizers and help them host multiple events through AroundU
• Maintain a structured pipeline of leads, demos, follow-ups, and converted accounts
• Share feedback from organizers with the founder and product team

**Incentives**

This role is performance-driven, meaning you earn incentives based on the impact you create.

You will earn incentives for:

• Every organizer who launches their first event
• Paid events run through AroundU
• Subscription or branded booking plans closed
• Organizers who continue hosting multiple events through the platform

Top performers can earn ₹25k–₹30k+ per month through incentives.
We also run monthly leaderboards and additional bonuses for top performers.

**Who This Is For**

• MBA students interested in sales, partnerships, business development, or growth roles
• People who enjoy talking to founders, creators, community managers, and business owners
• People who are comfortable with cold outreach, follow-ups, demos, and closing deals
• Hustlers who like building networks and creating opportunities from scratch
• Aspiring founders who want hands-on experience selling and growing an early-stage SaaS product.
• People with strong networks among creators, communities, event organizers, cafés, clubs, or experience businesses

Sales, community-building, SaaS, partnerships, or event management experience is a plus but not required.

**Why Join**

• Work directly with the founder
• Learn real startup distribution, sales, and growth strategies
• Get hands-on experience with prospecting, product demos, negotiation, onboarding, and account growth
• Build a strong network with community organizers, creators, and experience businesses
• Help shape the sales process and product based on real customer conversations
• Sell a product that helps organizers own their brand, audience, and customer relationships
• Opportunity to grow into a full-time business development, partnerships, or growth role

This is not a passive internship or a certificate-based role. You will be expected to speak with real businesses, understand their problems, follow up consistently, and close accounts.

If you enjoy meeting people, pitching ideas, understanding how businesses operate, and helping organizers build something they truly own — you’ll thrive in this role.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Desktop Application)
description:
CADROOMS is a browser-based CAD collaboration and product data management platform for enterprise teams in automotive, aerospace, rail, and marine. We are a small remote team headquartered in Denmark. The platform is ISO 27001 certified, SOC 2 Type 2 audited, and hosted on AWS in the EU.

You will take end-to-end ownership of our Rust/Tauri 2 desktop client and its supporting backend, database, and TypeScript work, starting Q4 2026 with a structured onboarding into the codebase.

This is a full-stack ownership role with a desktop core: Rust/Tauri 2 comes first, backed by strong Postgres and practical TypeScript/React ability.

## What you'll own

- **Rust/Tauri desktop core.** Own file watching and CloudFS sync, Windows integration, IPC/local state, packaging, signing, releases, and automatic updates.
- **Backend and data.** Own Postgres schemas, migrations, SQL, row-level security, real-time communication.
- **TypeScript product layer.** Deliver the React/TypeScript work needed for desktop and backend features; UI direction and the specialist 3D viewer sit elsewhere in the team.
- **Delivery and reliability.** Maintain CI/CD, Playwright tests, Vercel and Cloudflare deploys, Sentry monitoring, and incident response.

## What you bring

- **Proven Rust/Tauri desktop engineering.** You have shipped and maintained an end-user application with substantial Rust and OS integration - not only a web wrapper, library, CLI, or embedded system.
- **Strong Postgres ownership.** You can design schemas and migrations, diagnose SQL, apply row-level security, and improve performance.
- **Practical TypeScript/React ability.** You can implement and debug features across the WebView, Tauri commands, and backend using modern TypeScript frameworks.
- **Production ownership.** You can maintain pipelines and releases, monitor deployments, and help resolve incidents.
- **Senior independent judgment.** You bring 6+ years of professional experience and have owned a product area end-to-end in a small team.

## How we work

**High trust, high accountability.** Own outcomes, make progress visible, communicate risks early, finish what you commit to, validate production results, and ask for help before a blocker becomes a delay. You will have autonomy, with clear responsibility.

## Nice to have

CAD or manufacturing software; file-sync or local-first applications; WebAssembly; Deno, Stripe or Cloudflare.

## Practicalities & apply

Remote, with substantial CET overlap. Start date Q4 2026. Email your CV/profile, relevant application links, and a brief note on Rust/Tauri and full-stack ownership to christina@cadrooms.com.

title: Applications Engineer (Texas)
description:
**About Standard Bots**  
  
Standard Bot’s mission is to significantly lower the barrier to entry to real-world  
automation, bringing the power of bits to the world of atoms and unlocking  
productivity for entire new industries and users. Our user facing applications and APIs  
unlock the power of automation for entire new use cases. A relentless focus on  
simplicity and ease of use brings the revolutionary potential of robotic automation to  
new users and industries. The Applications Engineering team drives forwards the  
company’s mission by designing solutions around, installing and supporting Standard  
Bot’s innovative 6 axis robot.

**Note: This role requires up to 50% domestic travel. That number goes down as we grow the team, but right now you're in the field -- a lot. If that's not for you, this probably isn't the right fit.**

 

**Also note: If you're looking for a role where you train models and push code, this isn't it. This is a mechanical + electrical + software trifecta that happens to use AI as a tool. The factory floor is your office.**

**We are unable to offer Visa sponsorship for this role.**

**About the Role:**  
  
We’re looking for seasoned and skilled customer facing problem-solvers to help  
architect the future of robotics through the design, installation and support of  
innovative new robotic solutions. As a Applications Engineer you will work with other  
engineers, organizational leaders, sales and customers to design, install and support  
solutions for our customers in new and exciting robotic applications.

**What You’ll Do:**

- Partner with sales and customers to design robotic solutions for novel applications, serving as a trusted technical resource throughout the sales cycle
- Own installations end-to-end — traveling to customer sites to install, program, and validate Standard Bots solutions in the field
- Create technical enablement materials including sample code, application notes, and white papers that help customers get the most out of our platform
- Collaborate with in-house engineering to test and refine new features and integrations as our product expands
- Contribute to marketing efforts by developing collateral that communicates the value of Standard Bots solutions to prospective customers

**What you'll bring:**

- **Technical Depth:** You have hands-on experience across electrical, software, and mechanical systems — you're comfortable with DC power, understand NPN vs. PNP, can write Python scripts, and can navigate CAD tools like SolidWorks
- **Industry Fluency:** You have hands-on experience in automotive, manufacturing, or industrial automation environments — you understand the constraints, workflows, and stakeholders that come with deploying technology on a factory floor
- **Operational Context:** You've worked alongside or within production or assembly environments and can speak credibly to customers about cycle times, uptime requirements, safety standards, and integration with existing equipment
- **Growth Mindset:** You're energized by new domains and challenges, and you pick up context quickly to maximize your impact
- **Clear Communication:** You communicate with precision and empathy — in writing, in person, and across technical and non-technical audiences
- **Bias for Impact:** You prioritize user outcomes over technical elegance, and you execute with urgency
- **Proactive Simplicity:** You default to simple, reliable solutions and proactively flag opportunities to improve on what's proposed or already in place
- **Thrives in Ambiguity:** You do your best work in fast-moving, high-expectation environments alongside a diverse team

## **Compensation and Benefits:**

The salary range for this role is $80,000 to $120,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.

title: Account Manager, Mid-Market
description:
**About Aurora Solar**

Aurora is on a mission to create a future of solar for all. Our award-winning software puts the power of data and technology into the hands of every solar professional to make solar adoption simple and predictable. Our software has designed millions of solar projects so far, empowering solar companies to sell, design, and install residential and commercial solar arrays accurately, seamlessly, and at scale. 

We’ve been named one of "The Best Remote Companies" by [_BuiltIn.com_](https://builtin.com/company/aurora-solar) and have been recognized for the second time as a Certified Green Business (CGB) with the city of San Francisco. We’re in this together to support the world’s transition to solar.

**About the Team**

The Scaled AM team is built on a simple belief: when our customers win, we win. We obsess over customer outcomes, not activity metrics or internal optics, and we hold ourselves accountable to the impact we actually deliver. We move fast, share what's working, and push each other to build smarter, not just work harder.

**About the Role**

In this role, you'll own a high-volume portfolio of solar professionals in Aurora's Scaled Account Management segment where you will execute the account management playbooks, systems and processes that let you serve them well at scale.

You'll drive retention, early renewals, and expansion across a large book of business by pairing sharp account management instincts with a real appetite for leveraging AI agents, automated workflows, and operational design. You won't just use the tools, you'll help shape them.

This is a role where your account management skills and your systems thinking sharpen each other. The customers are real, the relationships matter, and the workflows you execute directly determine how well you can serve them.

**Your Impact**

- Own and grow a high-volume portfolio of accounts in the Scaled AM segment, driving retention, early renewal upsells, and expansion through a combination of proactive outreach and AI-assisted workflows.
- Serve as the primary relationship owner for customers under approximately $25K to $50K ARR, ensuring every account receives timely, relevant engagement, even at scale.
- Operationalize and continuously improve AI-assisted workflows that support customer onboarding, ramp acceleration, health monitoring, and upsell identification.
- Identify and act on ramping risk signals early, ensuring new logos reach their utilization thresholds within the ramp window.
- Surface and qualify early upsell opportunities by detecting usage-based signals and coordinating with Account Executives and Enterprise Account Managers on expansion motions.
- Maintain clean, structured Salesforce data across the Scaled AM segment, including contact/account hygiene, renewal timelines, so that AI-driven workflows operate on reliable inputs.
- Partner with GTM Ops to scope, test, and refine the tooling and field structures that power scaled customer intelligence.
- Document workflows, playbooks, and operational processes for repeatable, low-maintenance assets the team can build on.
- Identify recurring customer questions, content gaps, and failed resolution patterns, and route them to the right internal owner (Support, Product, Sales) through a structured process.
- Advocate for customers internally while contributing to Aurora's broader go-to-market strategy and product feedback loops.

**What You Bring**

- 2+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Sales, preferably in a SaaS or clean tech environment.
- Proven ability to manage a high-volume book of business with strong retention and upsell results, even with limited one-on-one customer time.
- Comfort building and executing structured workflows — you don't just manage accounts, you build systems to manage them better.
- Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM tools; you understand why data hygiene matters and you maintain it as a daily habit, not a quarterly cleanup.
- Ability to identify account health signals — usage data, engagement trends, renewal timelines — and act on them before risk becomes obvious.
- Strong written communication skills; you can craft outreach that feels personal at scale and represent Aurora's voice clearly across a large customer base.
- Collaborative instincts — you're comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, RevOps, Support, Product, and GTM Ops to get things done for your customers.
- Organized, self-directed, and able to manage competing priorities across a complex portfolio without letting things fall through the cracks.

**Nice to Haves**

- Experience working with AI tools in a professional workflow context — drafting, summarizing, routing, or automating repeatable tasks.
- Familiarity with AI agent platforms or automation tools and an interest in building workflows, not just using them.
- Background in solar, clean energy, or construction tech — understanding of the contractor and installer market is a real advantage.
- Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS environment where you had to build processes, not just follow them.
- Ability to scope operational needs clearly and partner with technical or ops stakeholders to implement them.
- Familiarity with credit-based, usage-based, or tiered SaaS pricing models.
- Experience contributing to internal documentation, playbooks, or knowledge bases — you know how to write something once so the team benefits from it repeatedly.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
## **Our Vision**

Hospitals run on three things: their people, their beds, and their supplies… and all are still managed with spreadsheets, phone calls, and gut instinct. Vitalize is building the system that runs it all intelligently, starting with labor—the biggest cost (nearly 60% of a hospital’s P&L) and the hardest operational problem.

We’re building the labor and capacity operating system for health systems—forecasting demand, matching the right staff to it automatically, and coordinating patients across the hospital.

The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay. This isn’t a nice-to-have—our customers pay 5–15x more than legacy incumbents because Vitalize is mission-critical software their hospitals rely on every single minute.

We’ve raised over $32M from top investors, and even our own customers.

##   
**Our Values**

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

- **🚗 Push the Car.** Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.
- **🏥 Premier 1K.** We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.
- **🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly.** Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.
- **💡 Think Bigger Fridays.** See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

## **About Vitalize's Marketing Team**

We're looking for our first Head of Marketing to build the function from the ground up. You'll define the strategy, establish how marketing operates, determine where we invest, and hire the team that will help take Vitalize through its next stage of growth.

In the beginning, you'll do a little bit of everything. You'll spend time with customers, launch campaigns, shape product positioning, partner closely with Sales, build our brand, and create the playbook that future marketers will inherit. Over time, you'll build the organization around you. You'll decide which capabilities to hire first, how the team should evolve, and what great marketing looks like at Vitalize. This isn't an opportunity to manage an existing team; it's an opportunity to build one.

## **The Role**

Marketing should become one of Vitalize's primary growth engines. As the marketing leader, you'll own the function end-to-end. You'll bring an operator's mindset to the role, owning the strategy to drive enterprise pipeline, shape how the market understands Vitalize, support our sales organization, launch new products, build our employer brand, and establish us as the defining company in healthcare operations.

This is a true builder's role. You'll define the strategy, establish the operating cadence, hire great people, and create the systems that allow marketing to scale. At the same time, we expect you to remain deeply connected to the work itself. You should enjoy interviewing customers, writing positioning, reviewing creative, digging into data, partnering with Sales, and launching campaigns just as much as building teams and setting strategy. We're looking for a leader who believes the best executives never become too far removed from the craft.

## **What You'll Do**

- Build the marketing organization—Our marketing organization does not exist at the moment. You'll design the strategy, define how the team operates, establish priorities, and hire exceptional people
- Build a marketing engine that drives growth—Marketing exists to accelerate the business. You'll develop the playbook that consistently generates enterprise pipeline, strengthens our position in the market, enables our Sales team to win, and supports long-term revenue growth. You'll partner closely with Sales and Growth Operations to understand where growth comes from, identify where marketing can create leverage, and continuously improve the engine. Success in this role won't be measured by campaigns launched—it will be measured by business outcomes
- Turn customer success into our greatest competitive advantage—We believe the best marketing we'll ever create won't come from us. It'll come from the clinical leaders whose hospitals we've transformed. You'll spend time with customers, visit hospitals, listen to implementation calls, and deeply understand how Vitalize changes healthcare operations. Those insights will become the foundation for everything we create—from demand generation to thought leadership
- Shape how the market understands Vitalize—You'll define how customers, candidates, investors, and the broader healthcare industry understand who we are. That includes product marketing, positioning, launches, communications, employer brand, customer advocacy, executive events, and public narrative. Every story we tell should be grounded in real customer outcomes and reinforce why Vitalize is becoming the category leader in healthcare operations
- Build a team people want to join—As the company grows, you'll recruit and develop high-performing marketers who combine ambition with humility, ownership with curiosity, and creativity with execution

## **What You'll Bring**

- High-growth B2B SaaS experience—You've built and scaled marketing at a high-growth B2B SaaS company. You know how to create a strategy, establish an operating cadence, and build the systems that allow marketing to scale alongside the business
- Marketing engine expertise—You understand how demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, brand, communications, events, and sales enablement work together to drive enterprise growth—and how those priorities evolve as a company grows
- Enterprise SaaS expertise—You've marketed complex products with long sales cycles, multiple executive stakeholders, and high-value deals. You know how marketing partners with Sales to influence meaningful pipeline and revenue
- Customer obsession—You naturally spend time with customers, uncover what matters most to them, and turn those insights into positioning, campaigns, product launches, and compelling stories
- Team building—You know how to hire, develop, and coach high-performing marketers while creating a culture of ownership, curiosity, and high standards
- Player-coach mindset—You enjoy setting strategy, but you're equally excited to write messaging, review creative, launch campaigns, analyze pipeline, and stay close enough to the work to know what great looks like
- Judgement—You know how to prioritize, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and focus your team's energy on the highest-leverage opportunities instead of trying to do everything

## **Benefits**

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) with company match
- Flexible PTO
- Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites
- Twice-yearly company off-sites
- Free meals in the office
- $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees
- Desk setup reimbursement
- Commuter benefits
- Monthly gym/wellness stipend
- An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

title: AI Security Engineer
description:
**Who We Are:**  
  
Interra Health is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone.

Interra Health is expanding its use of artificial intelligence and machine learning across a fast-moving, highly regulated healthcare market. As an AI Security Engineer on the Security Engineering team, reporting to the Lead Security Engineer, you will help secure the models, data pipelines, and AI solutions.

This role is hands-on and technical: you will assess AI systems for vulnerabilities, build guardrails against risks like prompt injection and data leakage, and partner with Engineering and Data & Analytics to bake security into how AI is designed and shipped. You will independently assess and resolve AI security risks across multiple workflows, escalating complex or high-impact issues to senior security leadership as appropriate. The right person is genuinely curious about how AI systems can fail, and wants to build the guardrails before something goes wrong, not after.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

- Lead security assessments of AI/ML models, data pipelines, and AI-enabled applications, identifying vulnerabilities such as prompt injection, model inversion, data poisoning, and adversarial inputs
- Partner with Data & Analytics and Engineering to embed security requirements and threat modeling into the AI development lifecycle, from data collection through model deployment
- Build and maintain guardrails, monitoring, and detection controls for AI systems in production, flagging anomalous model behavior and unauthorized data access
- Conduct security reviews of third-party AI tools, APIs, and vendors, such as LLM providers, before they are integrated into Interra Health
- Lead incident response for AI-related security events, including investigating suspicious model outputs or unexpected data exposure
- Design and advise on standards for the secure, responsible use of AI, including data handling practices for training and inference
- Test and validate access controls, encryption, and data segmentation for AI systems
- Use AI tools to accelerate security testing, code review, and threat research, while modeling responsible AI use for the broader engineering organization
- Stay current on the evolving AI threat landscape and translate emerging risks, such as jailbreaks and model-supply-chain risks, into practical mitigations
- Document findings, risk assessments, and remediation plans clearly for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING**

- Bachelor's degree and 5+ years in security engineering or application security, including hands-on experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM-based applications
- Deep knowledge of AI/ML security risks (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, adversarial ML, and data poisoning) and proven ability to test for and mitigate them
- Hands-on experience with security tooling, including SAST/DAST and vulnerability scanning, and comfort scripting in Python or a similar language
- Understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how AI/ML workloads are deployed and secured within it
- Clear communicator who can translate technical risk into terms non-security stakeholders understand
- Comfort operating in a fast-paced, post-merger environment where systems, priorities, and structures are still evolving

**NICE TO HAVE**

- Experience securing systems in a regulated healthcare or life sciences environment (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST)
- Familiarity with LLM security frameworks and tools, such as MITRE ATLAS, Garak, or promptfoo
- Security certifications such as OSCP, GCIH, or CISSP
- Experience red-teaming or penetration-testing AI/ML systems specifically

**Pre-Employment Drug Screening:** This position is subject to a pre-employment drug screening, where permitted by applicable law. Any required screening will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

 

**Benefits & Perks:**

💸**Competitive compensation**

🌍**Remote-first**

Work from anywhere in US. We also provide a one-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi-Fi reimbursement.

**Flexible work**  
Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life.

✈ **Company-wide offsite**  
We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together.

🌴**Time off that you’re expected to use**  
Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave.

💙**Comprehensive health coverage**  
Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family.  
Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection).

💰**Financial wellness**  
401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future.

* **Voice pipeline reliability: **backpressure, failover, graceful degradation, and monitoring for live calls
* **Call-data pipeline:** transcripts, events, and structured extraction flowing from every call into the warehouse
* **Analytics & dashboards:** data modeling and conversation-intelligence features on top of call data
* **Evals & monitoring for voice agents:** quality metrics, drift detection, and cost/latency tracking

* Write clean scalable code
* Own the voice and data stack end-to-end: design, build, test, deploy, and operate
