* Respond to critical system issues and ensure continuous system reliability
* Mentor team members and collaborate across teams, especially with product and subject matter experts
* Work to understand the needs of our users and think creatively about how to solve design challenges in your work

* Hands-on experience with realtime voice or streaming systems: telephony (SIP/Twilio), WebRTC, streaming STT/TTS, or frameworks like LiveKit or Pipecat — or comparable experience with demanding realtime/streaming infrastructure

* Excitement to leverage AI coding tools to their maximum benefit. We love Claude Code and Cursor and are constantly looking for better ways to leverage our time to build fast and build for scale.

title: Sales Manager, Insurance Technology (USA - Remote)
description:
### The Opportunity

Hospitable built its own licensed insurance agency. Most software companies partner with an insurer and call it a day. We built Align Insurance Services ([www.aligninsure.com)](https://www.aligninsure.com)) instead, and it is already one of the most advanced AI driven insurance agencies on the planet.

You lead high-impact business consultation calls with short-term rental operators, guiding them on how to get fully "aligned" to safeguard their business, properties, and assets. In these calls, you help clients structure their entity setups correctly, implement robust owner's dwelling and liability insurance, and deploy reservation-level protections including guest damage and trip cancellation coverage. Delivered as an interactive, tech-driven, in-product SaaS demo powered by AI, this consultative sales experience consistently wows prospects. You will manage a team of licensed Property and Casualty (P&C) producers, leveraging Hospitable's 25,000 customer base from day one while aggressively targeting the broader market across the full sales cycle: outbound prospecting, lead generation, deal creation, and closing.

If you have spent your career in SaaS and never sold a policy in your life, read on. Insurance is one of the hottest categories in venture backed technology right now. A large share of recent Y Combinator batches have gone after insurance, because the industry is enormous, badly served by legacy systems, and finally crackable with AI. Align is that thesis already proven out. You bring the sales leadership. We already solved distribution, product, and the license.

### What you will own

**Full cycle sales leadership.** You run the team responsible for outbound prospecting, lead generation, deal creation, and closing, across both the Hospitable customer base and the open market. Quota is the scoreboard. You are accountable for hitting it, every period, no excuses. You will report to our VP of Insurance, Derek, whose favorite fruit is Jackfruit.

**Daily coaching.** You are in the deals with your reps, not reviewing them after the fact. You coach daily so the team gets sharper every week, and you build a culture where people want to get better at the craft of selling.

**The property protection dashboard.** Hospitable's core product includes a property protection dashboard that helps operators configure the right layers of coverage. Your team helps 25,000 customers use it correctly, starting with the most basic layer of protection there is: getting their business entities set up right, then layering the best practices to help hosts protect their business and property. 

**Broker integrity plus proprietary product**. Align operates as a broker, so your team brings customers objective recommendations across the market. Align also has its own insurance products. You teach your team to hold both truths at once: sell what is right for the customer, and know when that is Align's own product.

**Hiring and team building**. You recruit and hire internally, and you manage third party labor arrangements alongside that. You are building a bench, not just filling seats.

**Commission programs**. You design and run the compensation structures that keep producers motivated and performing, and you own the results those programs produce.

**Culture**. You build a sales floor people are excited to be part of, one where reps are building real careers, whether that means growing inside your team or moving anywhere else within Hospitable.

**Requirements**

Hospitable is a remote-only and globally distributed company but for this role, we need someone who is based in the United States.

We want a great sales leader first. Insurance experience is a real plus, but it is not the gate. Plenty of the best SaaS sales leaders have never sold a policy in their life, and we would rather hire that person and teach them insurance than hire an insurance lifer who cannot lead a modern, AI powered sales org.

- 5+ years of sales leadership experience, ideally running quota carrying teams through full sales cycles, from outbound and lead generation through close, not just account management
- Genuine enthusiasm for technology and software, not tolerance of it. You want to sell through a platform, use AI tools daily, and think about how technology changes what a sales org can do
- A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining sales talent
- Comfort designing and running commission plans that actually motivate behavior instead of just paying out
- Insurance or P&C background is a plus, not a requirement. If you have never held a P&C license, Hospitable will sponsor you to get one after you start

### Why Insurance, Why Now

Insurance is not a boring, legacy category anymore. It is one of the categories venture capital has chased hardest over the last several years, and a large share of recent Y Combinator batches have built insurance companies, because the market is massive, the incumbents run on decades old infrastructure, and AI can finally attack the underwriting, claims, and distribution problems that made the industry slow in the first place. The founders and investors chasing that thesis are not wrong. Insurance is one of the biggest, most fixable markets in tech right now.

Align is that thesis, already built, already selling, already profitable, inside a company that does not need to raise a round to prove it out.

### Why Hospitable, Why Now

Hospitable is running at a $50M+ ARR run rate, growing 100% year over year, with no VC or PE money in the business. That means no board meetings to prepare for and no investors to manage, just a company in full control of its own destiny, free to reinvest in the product and the people building it.

Align is the boldest expression of that: a licensed insurance agency built by a software company, with an AI first approach that traditional agencies and most insurtech startups cannot match, and a 25,000 customer pipeline that most insurance sales leaders would need years to build from scratch, and that most insurtech startups would need a huge funding round to buy.

**Benefits**

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

- A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
- The gross salary for US employees could be anywhere between USD$106,044.87 - $133,893.17, with a 10% seniority increase after 6 months provided performance standards are met.
- On top of the base salary, this role is also eligible for commission, with the OTE to be discussed directly with candidates.
- We also offer compensation into the company equity through (RSU's), with a current grant value of up to $59,400.00 to share in the long-term upside value of the company.
- For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).
- 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.
- Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by [Spill](https://www.spill.chat/).
- Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

title: Product SME – Property Claims
description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Assured Insurance Technologies modernizes insurance claims processing through software solutions for major insurers, addressing a sector that remains "highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct."

We're looking for a hands-on property claims practitioner to own the property-claims perspective inside Product — turning your adjusting judgment and real operational data into defensible workflows, quality standards, and measurable product improvements. This is an individual-contributor role: you won't manage a team, but you'll teach and advise Product and Engineering, find the right work in an ambiguous environment, and help us modernize claims without losing the human and regulatory controls that have to stay in place.

## **What you'll do**

🔍 Conduct an end-to-end review of the property claims lifecycle — Examine the full claim journey (FNOL intake, inspection, coverage evaluation, cause-of-loss determination, scope and estimate development, reserving, vendor coordination, settlement, and closure), identifying friction points and automation opportunities, and explaining how the decisions and data at each stage depend on one another.

🧠 Develop deep expertise in how property claims decisions are made and supported by data — Understand what adjusters rely on (inspection reports, photos/videos, contractor estimates, policy data, weather data, third-party reports), how it's structured in the system, and where gaps exist.

🧩 Identify breakdowns in claim workflow and documentation — Surface inconsistencies in data capture, estimate accuracy, reserve alignment, vendor handoffs, task routing, approvals, or reporting, diagnosing root causes rather than symptoms.

✅ Own the integrity of core claims data across systems — Ensure key indicators (coverage determination, cause of loss, damage scope, reserve position, estimate accuracy, settlement status) are accurately captured and consistently reflected across product, operational, and financial views.

📐 Define and defend standards for claims quality and defensibility — Set and hold the line on expectations for inspection quality, documentation rigor, estimate accuracy, decision rationale, reserve adequacy, and claims-data integrity, including relevant compliance and audit needs.

🤝 Partner cross-functionally to resolve systemic issues — Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Claims Operations, and Leadership on root causes impacting claim efficiency, estimate accuracy, vendor performance, and customer experience.

🛠️ Improve both inputs and outputs across the claims process — Enhance how property damage data is collected and structured (inspections, imagery, estimates), and how insights are delivered through dashboards, reporting, automation, and AI models — with sound judgment about where automation helps and where human review has to stay.

📊 Translate insights into measurable product improvements — Prioritize enhancements that reduce cycle time, improve loss ratio performance, minimize leakage, strengthen reserving accuracy, improve customer satisfaction, and increase operational efficiency.

🧭 Influence roadmap decisions with financial and operational context — Articulate business impact across indemnity spend, expense management, vendor costs, subrogation recovery, litigation exposure, adjuster productivity, and customer retention — through evidence and credibility, not formal authority.

🎓 Teach and advise Product and Engineering as the internal SME on property claims — Translate complex claims concepts into concise, usable frameworks for non-experts; guide best practices for inspections, scoping and estimating, vendor coordination, documentation, and automation.

🤜🤛 Align teams around consistent process standards — Partner across Claims, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Customer Success to build shared understanding and disciplined execution.

🗣️ Communicate clearly across audiences — Present findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

## **You have (Must-Haves)**

- 5+ years of hands-on P&C property claims experience, including field or desk adjusting at a major carrier, with credible responsibility for real adjudication decisions — not just adjacent exposure to claims.
- Deep end-to-end command of property claims: FNOL, inspection, coverage and cause-of-loss analysis, scoping and estimating, reserving, vendor coordination, settlement, and closure. You can explain how these decisions and data dependencies interact, not just recite the terminology.
- A track record of assessing complex claims workflows and raw operational data, diagnosing root causes, and turning that into prioritized improvements with measurable effects on accuracy, cycle time, leakage, reserves, customer outcomes, or productivity.
- Experience defining and defending practical standards for claim completeness, documentation quality, inspection/estimate accuracy, decision rationale, and core claims-data integrity, including relevant compliance or audit needs.
- A demonstrated ability to find and structure high-value work on your own — when the role, inputs, or path aren't predefined, and without waiting for detailed direction.
- Clear written and verbal communication: you can translate complex claims concepts into concise, usable frameworks for non-experts, and teach and advise Product and Engineering by earning credibility through evidence rather than formal authority.
- Experience partnering with product, engineering, analytics/data, and claims or operational teams to turn domain expertise into workflows, requirements, reporting, automation, or product decisions.
- Real curiosity about modern technology in claims, with sound judgment about where automation or AI adds value — and where human review, compliance, or quality controls have to stay.

## **Nice-to-Haves**

- Both field and desk adjusting experience, followed by claims supervision or another role that gave you a broader view across adjusters, processes, and outcomes.
- Depth in complex, high-severity, large-loss, or commercial property claims, including making defensible decisions under incomplete information and exposure to varied policy types.
- Experience improving inspection imagery, estimates, dashboards, claims-data structures, AI models, or other technology-enabled claims workflows.
- Experience contributing domain expertise to carrier meetings, client discovery, product marketing, or product-roadmap decisions.

**Benefits:**

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

title: Co-founder - Security & Enterprise Systems
description:
Velvt is building the independent evidence layer for autonomous agents. Right now that means two things: a public research network where outside agents take on real adversarial problems, and an assurance product companies use before granting an agent more authority. We just closed our first public mission. 

Have you built and shipped security-critical or enterprise-grade systems? Someone who thinks in terms of trust boundaries, evidence integrity, failure modes, and what it takes for a skeptical security team to actually believe a piece of infrastructure? Our whole premise is that a claim isn't evidence until it's been independently tested and adjudicated. We will hold our own product to that standard as hard as we hold everyone else's agents to it.

This is unpaid, equity-based, and doesn't need to be full time. What it does need is honesty about what's actually working and what isn't, real technical judgment, and the drive to keep building something rigorous. 

If you've spent years in security, infrastructure, or systems where getting it wrong has real consequences, and the idea of building the thing that decides whether an autonomous agent should be trusted with more authority sounds like the right problem to spend the next stretch of your life on, I'd like to talk.

*Bonus* if you're public-facing and happy to attend events with me, meet other teams/partners and network.

title: Co-founder - Business Development & Partnerships
description:
Velvt is building the independent evidence layer for autonomous agents. We test agents under real adversarial pressure and produce evidence a company can actually rely on before handing that agent more authority - more budget, more permissions, more consequential decisions. 

The research side of this is already producing results. What it needs now is someone who can turn that into relationships: enterprise teams willing to be design partners, model labs and infrastructure providers who see the value of independent testing, and the partnerships that make Velvt something an ecosystem builds around instead of something that has to shout to be noticed.

I need a co-founder who's actually closed deals, built partnerships, or driven enterprise adoption before. Someone who can walk into a room with a security team or a head of AI and make the case plainly: here's what we test, here's what independence actually means, here's why self-graded evidence isn't good enough anymore.

This is unpaid, equity-based, and doesn't need to be full time to start. What matters more than hours is honesty, follow-through, and actually caring whether the agents getting more authority in the world deserve it. If building the relationships that make independent agent evidence the default, not the exception, sounds like a problem worth your name on it, let's talk.

4-8% equity plus 15% of what you bring in and close. Contract sizes rage $3k to 75k plus ongoing.

title: Account Executive - SaaS Sales, EMEA (202607)
acceptedRemoteLocations: Germany; United Kingdom; France; Netherlands; Ireland
description:
Digify is a cloud-based virtual data room and digital rights management software provider. Our platform helps companies control, protect and track important documents after they have been shared.

Companies use Digify to protect confidential information for fundraising, M&A transactions, due diligence, intellectual property sharing and sensitive business communications. Today, Digify is used in 138 countries by more than 700,000 users worldwide.

**THE ROLE**

We are expanding our sales team and are looking for an Account Executive to support and grow our EMEA business.

This is an inbound-led SaaS sales role focused on SMB and mid-market customers. The first priority of the role is to manage and convert inbound demand from EMEA, including trial signups, general enquiries, quote requests and RFPs. As lead volume across EMEA can be high, the Account Executive must be strong at qualification, prioritisation and identifying the opportunities with the highest potential.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded SaaS salesperson with 2–3+ years of experience and notable success in a sales or closing role. You should enjoy speaking with prospects, understanding their pain points, recommending suitable solutions, conducting product demos and following up closely to move deals towards close.

We are also open to exceptional candidates from an SDR/BDR background if they have demonstrated closing experience and are ready to take ownership of customer conversations through to close.

This is a remote role. Candidates should be based in a time zone that allows meaningful overlap with EMEA prospects and the Digify team.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:**

  - Manage inbound leads from EMEA, including trial signups, general enquiries, quote requests and RFPs.
  - Qualify leads effectively to understand fit, urgency, use case, buying intent and commercial potential.
  - Prioritise high-potential opportunities while managing a steady volume of inbound demand.
  - Speak with prospects over calls, emails and video meetings to understand their business needs and pain points.
  - Recommend suitable Digify solutions based on each prospect’s use case, requirements and buying context.
  - Conduct clear and effective product demos, with enough product understanding to address common technical and workflow-related questions.
  - Communicate Digify’s value proposition clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  - Follow up consistently and professionally to maintain deal momentum and move opportunities towards close.
  - Manage opportunities in HubSpot, keeping records accurate and up to date.
  - Share customer feedback, objections, market trends and competitive insights with the sales, product and marketing teams.
  - Work closely with the existing sales team to support territory transition, shared learning and EMEA sales growth.

**Requirements**

  - 2–3+ years of SaaS sales experience with notable success, preferably in a closing role.
  - Experience selling SaaS or cloud-based software products to SMB and/or mid-market customers.
  - Excellent lead qualification skills, with the ability to quickly assess fit, urgency and deal potential.
  - Strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritise effectively in a high-volume inbound environment.
  - Excellent communication skills, especially the ability to understand customer pain points and explain product value clearly.
  - Ability to build rapport and trust with prospects through calls, emails and online meetings.
  - Confidence conducting product demos and explaining technical concepts in a simple, practical way.
  - Ability to make sound and reasonable product recommendations based on customer needs.
  - Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to create urgency and maintain deal momentum in a professional, consultative way.
  - Strong written and spoken English. Additional European languages, such as German or French, are a plus.
  - Comfortable selling across different EMEA markets, with sensitivity to different business cultures, languages and buying contexts.
  - Familiarity with CRM tools, preferably HubSpot.
  - Comfortable using AI tools to improve sales productivity, including call preparation, prospect research, follow-up drafting and CRM updates.

**NICE TO HAVE**

- Experience selling document security, data room, cybersecurity, legal tech, fintech, investment, M&A, or other B2B software solutions.
- Experience handling inbound trial-led or product-led growth sales motions.
- Familiarity with data protection, document security, due diligence or compliance-related buyer concerns.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

A successful Account Executive in this role will be able to:

- Quickly identify which inbound leads are worth prioritising.
- Understand the prospect’s real business problem, not just respond to surface-level requests.
- Recommend the right Digify solution in a consultative and credible way.
- Deliver effective product demos independently.
- Maintain strong follow-up discipline and keep deals moving.
- Convert qualified EMEA inbound demand into paying customers.
- Build trust with SMB and mid-market prospects across different EMEA markets.
- Contribute useful market and customer insights back to the wider team.

Learn more about Digify by [visiting our website](https://digify.com/).

title: Associate General Counsel, Litigation
description:
**Local or 100% Remote**

 

**About the role**

Point is seeking an experienced Associate General Counsel to lead litigation strategy across the company's home equity investment (HEI) platform and other consumer finance products. This is the senior-most litigation position within Point's legal department, reporting to the Deputy General Counsel with direct access to the General Counsel and senior leadership on high-priority matters.

The Associate General Counsel, Litigation will own Point's litigation portfolio end-to-end: managing outside counsel and litigation budgets, setting case strategy, responding to civil and regulatory subpoenas and investigative demands, and coordinating with compliance and business partners to align litigation positions with regulatory expectations. The ideal candidate brings deep defense-side experience in consumer finance litigation, is comfortable managing a high-volume, fast-moving docket, and exercises sound judgment on complex, multi-jurisdictional matters.

 

**Your responsibilities**

- Manage an assigned portfolio of consumer financial services litigation, including lawsuits, arbitrations, and class actions.
- Respond to and manage civil and regulatory subpoenas, civil investigative demands, and related inquiries, including and issuing and maintaining data holds to preserve relevant records. custodian coordination and rolling productions.
- Set and adjust litigation strategy for matters involving servicing, payments, credit reporting, title insurance, collections, other consumer financial products, and employment matters.
- Serve as Point's primary point of contact for outside counsel, directing case strategy, negotiating and managing litigation budgets, and monitoring performance against internal expectations.
- Organize the pre-litigation intake process, including triaging and responding to demand letters and pre-suit claims, and setting response posture in coordination with outside counsel.
- Perform early case assessments to evaluate regulatory exposure, litigation risk, and potential precedent or downstream impact across the portfolio.
- Support arbitration strategy, including motions to compel arbitration and enforcement of arbitration provisions.
- Coordinate with compliance and business partners to align litigation positions with regulatory expectations and internal policies.
- Lead internal fact investigations and prepare witnesses as needed to support litigation and regulatory matters.
- Provide litigation-risk input on contract terms and dispute-resolution provisions.
- Track litigation outcomes and trends across the docket (including matters involving other industry participants) to identify risk patterns and improvement opportunities, and report on litigation status, risk exposure, and legal spend to senior management.

 

**About you**

- J.D. and active bar membership in any U.S. jurisdiction (California preferred); must be eligible for in-house practice in your state of domicile.
- 5+ years of litigation experience involving consumer finance (civil or criminal, state or federal), on the defense side; experience with class action defense strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to respond to and manage civil and regulatory subpoenas and investigations.
- Experience directing outside counsel and managing litigation budgets across a multi-matter portfolio.
- Familiarity with consumer protection and lending statutes (e.g., TILA/Regulation Z, HOEPA, FCRA, FDCPA, RESPA/Reg X, UDAAP and state UDAP laws) and financial services products.
- Preferred experience includes:
  - High-volume consumer claims, arbitration practice, and/or class actions.
  - Mortgage servicing, foreclosure, or bankruptcy-adjacent litigation.
  - Litigation defense at a large law firm.
  - Federal clerkship.
  - Leveraging legal AI tools in a litigation environment.

 

Compensation at Point will be determined by skills, experience, and geographic location. Point has identified the expected annual base salary for this role at this level based on the market by tiers (Region | Location | Market Salary):

- Tier 1 | San Francisco Bay Area, New York, and Seattle | $211,850 - $234,150
- Tier 2 | Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, Philadelphia, Portland, Sacramento, San Diego, Santa Barbara & Washington DC | $190,000 - $210,000
- Tier 3 | All other US metro areas | $176,700 - $195,300

This does not include any other potential components of the compensation package, including equity, benefits, and perks outlined above. At the launch of each position, we benchmark compensation to the appropriate role and level utilizing competitive compensation data from various data sources as references. At the offer stage, we use the signal we received from our interviews, coupled with your experience, location, and other job-related factors, to determine final compensation.

 

Location Requirement: This is a remote position. However, candidates must reside in one of Point’s states of operation: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Hospitality
description:
**About WorkWhile**

WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs: the true backbone of the hospitality, catering, and event industries. These workers often face highly volatile schedules, sudden booking surges, and limited benefits.  
  
WorkWhile identifies the best, most reliable hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life. For high-volume catering companies, stadium and venue operators, corporate food service providers, and large-scale event producers, we provide instant access to a vetted, high-quality workforce to seamlessly scale up for major events and peak periods. For workers, we provide stable income and unmatched benefits, including next-day pay, free telehealth services, upskilling, and financial wellness tools.

We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work in hospitality and live events.

## **Role Summary**

We are looking for a high-performing **Enterprise Account Executive – Hospitality** to drive new business and strategic expansion within catering conglomerates, national contract food service providers, sports and entertainment venue operators, and premier event management groups.

This role focuses on selling flexible labor solutions to enterprise-scale organizations with multi-stakeholder environments, extended sales cycles, and significant volume requirements. You will leverage your expertise in the events and food service sectors, consultative selling, and executive relationship-building to transform how major hospitality brands staff their operations, helping you exceed quota and meaningfully contribute to WorkWhile’s growth.

## **Key Responsibilities**

- **Drive the Full Sales Cycle:** Prospect, discover, position solutions, negotiate, and close enterprise hospitality and event targets. This is a hunter role designed for someone who loves opening doors with major national operators.

- **Collaborate Internally:** Work closely with WorkWhile’s operations, finance, and product teams to deliver tailored workforce proposals and proofs of concept (POCs) for major multi-city rollouts or high-profile events.

- **5–10+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience**, with a proven track record of hitting targets and closing large, strategic deals within the contract food service, event management, university, catering, or venue operations sectors.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
HARMONICA

We are a London based stealth startup (ex Revolut, Meta, Imperial PhD) building the defining AI company for ageing. Ageing is one of society's biggest problems, and for us it's personal. We're an expat team building for our own ageing parents, who live far away in China, India, Brazil, and Italy.

We build voice first technology to keep seniors at home, healthier and happier for longer.

Our first product is Olympia, a proactive voice assistants for older adults living at home. She provides conversation and stimulation, remembers what matters, connects the family, and notices changes in wellbeing. Real seniors already use her in real homes. She's voice-first, proactive, and gets more useful the longer she knows someone.

Hear what it means to live with Olympia from one of our user: https://canva.link/ay0pj21d8yt6k6y

OUR AMBITION

By 2050, the number of people over 80 will triple, and care systems are already running out of money, workers, and capacity. Today's system sees the cliff: the fall, the hospital admission, the crisis. Olympia sees the drift, and acts while the problem is still small.

We're here to win the category. The opportunity is massive: this is where tech meets good, at the scale of how the world ages. Daily use of Olympia builds a picture of how people age that nobody has had before: cognition, mood, routines, mobility, social connection. Across millions of homes, that intelligence lets families act earlier, helps clinicians support far more people, and saves billions in care spending. Harmonica becomes the infrastructure an ageing world runs on.

Five-year goal: 250,000 homes, $170M revenue. You'd be one of the first engineers building the product that gets us there.

WHO WE ARE

Team from Meta, Revolut, Tractable, and an Imperial PhD in voice AI. We've built consumer products at scale, taken AI products from pilots to eight-figure contracts, and worked at the frontier of real-time speech.

Backed by Eileen Burbidge's NFG Ventures, Mati Staniszewski of ElevenLabs, and many more, with research collaborators at Oxford, Wharton, and Toronto.

WHAT WE'LL DO TOGETHER

Have the best time of your career working on an awesome, meaningful product with super talented people.

- An AI-native engineering org. Agents across coding, reviewing, QA, ops, support, scheduling. You'll help turn the company itself into an intelligent system.
- Speech-to-speech agents that feel like a person in the room. Interruptions, back-channels, noisy kitchens, hearing aids, thick accents, millisecond latency.
- Companions with long-term memory. Knows someone after six months the way a friend would.
- Assistants inside messaging, connecting families across cities and countries.
- Health biomarkers from conversation. Cognitive decline, mood, breathing, loneliness, with research partners at Wharton, Toronto, and Oxford.
- PhD-level audio in production. Speech enhancement, VAD, diarization, TTS tuned for older voices.
- An agentic browser: booking appointments and getting things done online through conversation, no wrestling with websites.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- A cracked, AI-native engineer. You use AI to multiply what you ship, and you've made yourself measurably faster with coding agents or your own setup.
- You've shipped something that runs on an LLM in production. Voice AI experience (real-time STT, TTS, speech-to-speech, telephony) is a plus but not needed.
- You go above and beyond and can prove it: a side project, a repo people star, a hackathon you won, something you built over a weekend because you couldn't stop. Show us.
- High agency. If something is broken and nobody owns it, you own it now. You'd rather be wrong fast than wait for a spec.
- Product taste. You care how it looks and feels, not just whether it works.
- Low ego, kind, hard-working. No politics.
- You care about the mission: older adults ageing well at home, work that matters to real families.

WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT

- Where you went to university, or whether you did. Show us what you've built.
- Where you live. Overlap with London hours matters more than your postcode.
- Gender, age, background, or anything else that isn't the work.

FOUNDING ENGINEER MEANS FOUNDING

You will be integral to whether Harmonica succeeds. That's literal, and it comes with the freedom to match.

- Set the engineering standards: how we test, review, deploy, and use agents as we grow.
- Shape the stack. A strong opinion backed by evidence changes how we build.
- Hire the team. You'll interview and help decide who joins after you.
- Own broadly today (voice, memory, messaging, biomarkers); take primary ownership of a major surface as we grow.
- Real equity and a real voice in product, engineering, and company decisions.
- You'll learn more here in one year than in three elsewhere. That's a promise.

THE PACKAGE

- 0.5% to 1.5% equity, depending on seniority, on a standard four-year vest.
- What that could be worth. If we hit the plan ($170M revenue in year five), a business like ours trades at roughly 5x to 10x revenue, putting Harmonica between $850M and $1.7B. After typical dilution from future rounds, your stake would be worth in the region of $2.5M to $20M+. This is a projection, not a guarantee; startups fail, and we're telling you what we're aiming at.
- Competitive salary.
- Hardware, tooling, and model spend. Nobody waits for approval to try a new model.
- Maximum creative freedom, and a team building this for our own parents.

Most software assumes the user will learn its interface. We're building an interface that learns the person.

What should an AI companion become when its users did not grow up with software? A human face, an abstract presence, or voice alone? When should it speak first? How does it show it is listening, remembering, acting? These are not polish questions. They decide whether an 84-year-old trusts Olympia enough to speak with her every day.

- An agent that can act: medication, appointments, transport, everyday tasks through conversation.

title: QA and DevOps Engineer

description:
**About KloudMate**

KloudMate is an Observability platform for Developers and Businesses, building applications on distributed systems.

KloudMate detects performance bottlenecks in modern distributed applications, identifies errors and boosts developer productivity by reducing Mean-Time-To Resolve (MTTR), helping businesses improve application performance, shrink operating costs, increase customer satisfaction and grow revenues.

**Job Overview:**
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer to join our growing team. As a QA Engineer at KloudMate, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our innovative observability platform. You will be responsible for designing, executing, and analyzing tests to identify defects and ensure our software meets the highest standards of quality and performance. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Responsibilities:**
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on product requirements and technical specifications.
* Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, system, and performance testing.
* Identify, document, and track software defects using our bug tracking system, ensuring clear and concise reporting.
* Collaborate closely with development and product teams to understand product features and provide timely feedback on potential issues.
* Participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our QA processes and methodologies.
* Potentially contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts (depending on experience and skills).
* Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and work with the development team to ensure timely resolution.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest testing tools and techniques.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1 year of professional experience in software quality assurance.
* Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, concepts, and the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Experience in creating and executing test plans and test cases for web-based applications.
* Familiarity with bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Bugzilla).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience testing observability platforms or monitoring tools.
* Exposure to cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).
* Experience with Monitoring tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Zabbix, Nagios)
* Experience with any cloud provider’s monitoring service (AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Monitoring)
* Experience with metrics, logs, or traces in QA role
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin
* Familiarity with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
* Basic scripting skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript).
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.

**What We Offer**
**Compensation:** Competitive salary in the range of 2 to 4 LPA CTC annually.
**Location:** Remote-first with the flexibility to work from anywhere. We have offices in Bangalore, India, and occasional visits are encouraged to foster team connections. We also host annual off-sites at beautiful locations (beaches or mountains!).

**Benefits:**
* Comprehensive health insurance.
* Generous PTO (20 days) + National/Regional holidays + Compensation Day off.
* Remote-friendly work environment.
* Professional development opportunities.
* Fun and engaging company events.
* Strong emphasis on work-life balance (including celebrating birthdays and anniversaries!).
* Opportunity to work from home.

**Cutting-edge Technologies:** Work with the latest and greatest technologies on a brand new codebase.

**Growth and Impact:** As an early-stage employee, you'll have significant ownership and the chance to make a real difference.

**Healthy Work Culture:** We value a 40-hour workweek and asynchronous communication.

**Investment Day:** Similar to Google's 20% time, we encourage employees to dedicate Fridays to explore and develop ideas that benefit KloudMate.

**Hiring Process**
1. Quick Intro Chat (30 min): Get to know you and your QA background.
2. Technical Deep Dive (2 hours): Assess your hands-on QA skills.
3. Vision & Fit Talk (30 min): Chat with founders about our goals and your potential.

**Ready to join a passionate team and build the future of cloud observability? We look forward to hearing from you!**

title: Youth Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) Coach
description:
**Build The Next Generation Of Youth Coaching**

**About Us**

At tapouts, we believe in the boundless potential of every child. Our mission goes beyond teaching skills; we are dedicated to nurturing the emotional and psychological well-being of the next generation. Imagine being part of a team that transforms the lives of a million children and their families. By joining tapouts, you are not just taking on a job but using your talents for a deeply rewarding cause.

**About the role**

We seek energetic, experienced **Social-Emotional Learning** (SEL) coaches to lead and facilitate live online group sessions for youth. As a tapouts SEL Coach, you'll create a fun, engaging, and emotionally safe virtual environment where kids build confidence, self-regulation, and connection with their peers.

As a tapouts SEL Coach, you will:

- Lead live online SEL group sessions for youth ages 4-16 years
- Deliver structured social-emotional learning activities and games that build self-awareness, emotional regulation, and interpersonal skills
- Build positive relationships with participants and foster an inclusive, emotionally safe group space
- Manage group dynamics and respond calmly to behavioral or emotional disruptions during live sessions
- Monitor and assess individual and group progress

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Education, Social Work, or a related field (Mandatory), Master's degree is preferred
- At least 2 years of experience leading live group sessions with children in a virtual or online setting
- At least 5 years of experience designing or leading structured group sessions or programs for children
- SEL, coaching, or mental-health-specific certification is strongly preferred (e.g., ICF, IPEC, PPS Credential, CASEL, Mental Health First Aid)
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable using Zoom and Google Suite as day-to-day coaching tools
- Availability for a minimum of 10 hours per week to provide coaching within tapouts peak hours (1-8 pm PT) during weekdays and weekends (6am-8pm PT). Example schedule: Mondays (2pm-6pm), Thursdays (5pm-8pm), Saturdays (8am-11am) and Sundays (6 a.m. to 6:30 p.m.)
- A fast, reliable internet connection and a quiet working space

This position is remote, 100% online coaching position is a part-time independent 1099 contractor position that offers you the flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed.

**Our Application Process**  
Because our coaches lead every session live over video, all applicants are required to complete a **short video interview** as part of our recruitment process. This step allows us to see your energy and communication style on camera, and applications cannot move forward without it.

**Our Commitment to Building a Diverse, Equitable, and Inclusive Workforce**

tapouts is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, or age.

Join us in our mission to empower children with the social and emotional skills they need to succeed!

title: Founding Outbound Lead (Cold Email) · US / UK / LatAm
description:
**About YourLio AI**

**YourLio AI** is the 24/7 AI sales rep for Shopify and D2C brands. Our agents live on the storefront, WhatsApp, Instagram, email, Messenger and SMS with one shared memory per shopper: they answer from the live catalog, recover abandoned carts, apply discount codes and complete checkout inside the chat.

100+ D2C brands run on YourLio, including Sugar Cosmetics, Soulflower, Dr. Ortho, Baidyanath, Slurrp Farm and Sylvi. Brands report +12% conversion, +16% average order value, 67% cart recovery and 95% of inquiries resolved without a human. We're rated 5.0 on the Shopify App Store, price from $49/month against tool stacks that cost brands $1,600+/month, and let brands run us in parallel with their existing tools for 14 days before switching. We also support WooCommerce, Magento and BigCommerce.

**We're HelioAI:** 11 to 50 people, founder-led, with teams in Hubli, Bangalore and Miami.


**Why this role exists**

We win in India. Our Account Executive covers EMEA. Nobody owns the US and UK, two of Shopify's largest markets, or Latin America, where WhatsApp-first commerce is exactly what we're built for. We want to change that with outbound, and we want it done by someone who knows D2C from the inside.

You'll be our first dedicated outbound hire. You'll build the cold email engine from zero, run it yourself, book qualified demos with D2C decision-makers, and turn what works into a playbook we hire SDRs into, under you.


**What you'll do**

- Build the outbound infrastructure. Secondary sending domains, 10-20 warmed inboxes, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, one-click unsubscribe, inbox rotation and warm-up. The primary yourlio.ai domain never touches cold volume.
- Own the ICP and list building. Use Shopify store-detection and enrichment (StoreLeads, BuiltWith, Apollo, Clay, Sales Navigator) plus buying signals (Gorgias/Tidio/Zendesk in the stack, Klaviyo, active WhatsApp campaigns, Shopify Plus, hiring for CX, recent funding, large catalogs) to find beauty, personal-care, wellness, supplement, fashion and jewellery brands likely to convert. Verify every list before it's sent (bounce rate under 2%).
- Write and ship sequences. 4-6 step, under-80-word emails to founders, Heads of Ecommerce, CX leads and retention/growth leads, personalised at scale, sent in the prospect's timezone, and localised in Spanish and Portuguese for LatAm. Go multichannel: LinkedIn on every sequence, phone and WhatsApp where they fit (email plus LinkedIn roughly doubles positive replies, and email plus calls does better still).
- Test relentlessly. Subject lines, angles (cart recovery, WhatsApp selling, support cost, AOV lift, replacing a $1,600/month stack), segments and CTAs. Kill what doesn't work weekly and document what does.
- Book, qualify and hand off. Run first-touch discovery, book demos with the founder/AE (or run them yourself once ramped), and keep HubSpot/Pipedrive spotless: sequences, replies, meeting outcomes, sourced MRR.
- Protect deliverability like it's revenue. Google Postmaster Tools, complaint rates, bounce rates and inbox placement checked weekly. Spam complaints stay under 0.1%.
- Stay compliant by market. CAN-SPAM in the US, PECR corporate-subscriber rules in the UK, LGPD legitimate interest in Brazil, and knowing when a market (Germany, Canada) needs a different approach.
- Feed the company. Which objections come up, which segments reply, which competitors appear: back into product, marketing and pricing every week.
- Turn it into a machine. Document the playbook, then hire and coach the first SDRs once you're consistently at target.


**Your first 90 days**

- Days 1-30: infrastructure live and warmed, ICP agreed with the founder, first 1,000 verified prospects, first sequences running in the US and UK, first 3-5 demos booked.
- Days 31-60: 8+ qualified demos, reply rate at or above 5%, LatAm (Mexico, Colombia, Brazil) sequences live in Spanish and Portuguese, first version of the playbook written.
- Days 61-90: 12+ qualified demos in the month, one repeatable segment-and-angle you can point to, sourced MRR on the board, and a plan for markets four to six (Canada, Australia, UAE, the Nordics are candidates).


**How we'll measure success (monthly, after ramp)**

- 15-20 qualified demos booked with ICP-fit D2C brands (the 2026 benchmark for outbound SDRs is 12-15, and top performers reach 18-20).
- Reply rate at or above 5% and positive replies at or above 2% of emails sent (the 2026 average reply rate is 3.7%, and the top 10% of campaigns get

**Want to move faster?** 

Connect with our founder, Prakash Singh, on LinkedIn at https://www.linkedin.com/in/prkskrs/ and mention this role in your note. A LinkedIn message alongside your application gets you to the first call quickest.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Evolphin is building the next generation of AI-powered media workflows for enterprise media teams managing large image and video libraries at scale, including environments with tens of millions of video assets and extremely large metadata and embedding footprints. Its platform adds a conversational AI layer for extracting intelligence from media, enabling powerful search, conversational discovery, and automation of media workflows through AskAI.

We're now pushing further into AI — building the next generation of intelligent, automation-first media management — and we're looking for people who want to help build that future from the ground up.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer (5–8 years experience) who can take ownership of automation strategy and quality engineering for our AI-powered platform.

This role is primarily automation-focused, but will also require hands-on manual testing for new features, exploratory scenarios, AI output validation, and edge-case workflows. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, usability, performance, and scalability of our image and video automation workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving startup environments and enjoys building automation frameworks while staying close to product behavior through manual validation when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

- - Design and own the end-to-end automation framework for web, API, and AI-driven features
  - Build API automation suites for our core automation workflows and integrations (Postman/Newman/RestAssured)
  - Drive UI automation using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress
  - Ensure cross-browser compatibility for our design-heavy, canvas-based interfaces
  - Build performance testing suites to validate image/video processing throughput under load
  - Embed quality gates into our deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins)
  - Enable rapid, confident releases through automated testing at every stage
  - Create validation frameworks for non-deterministic ML results—balancing precision with creative flexibility
  - Partner with Product to define acceptance criteria for AI-driven features
  - Work alongside Engineering to shift-left quality and build testability into system design
  - Experience using LLMs (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to generate and refactor automation scripts
  - Ability to review, validate, and harden AI-generated test code (not blindly accept output)
  - Experience building prompt templates for test case generation from user stories
  - Familiarity with AI-assisted test case generation and coverage analysis
  - Understanding of how to test AI-driven features (prompt testing, hallucination detection, cost optimizations, response validation)
  - Ability to design deterministic validation strategies for probabilistic AI outputs
  - Experience integrating automation into AI-heavy workflows (semantic search, generative features, etc.)

**Requirements**

- 5 to 7 years of hands-on QA automation experience in fast-paced product environments
- Web Automation: Deep expertise in Playwright, or Cypress—you know when to use which
- API Testing: Proven experience with Postman, Newman, RestAssured, or similar tools
- AI/ML Testing: Experience validating machine learning systems or computer vision pipelines
- Programming: Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript—you can read and write production code
- CI/CD: Experience integrating tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar pipelines

title: Creative Strategist (Performance Creative)
acceptedRemoteLocations: Argentina; Mexico; Colombia; Bogota, Colombia; Mexico City, Mexico; Buenos Aires, Autonomous City of Buenos Aires; Latin America
description:
**Read this before you apply**
Most job posts are written to attract everyone. This one is written to find one kind of person: a sharp ad copywriter who's tired of writing into the void and wants to own the outcome.

DigiCom is a two-time Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency based in NYC. We scale D2C and e-commerce brands on paid channels, and our clients pay us because their revenue is our scoreboard.

Here's the honest pitch. If you've written ad copy for a while, you know the frustration: you craft the hook, hand it off, and never really learn if it worked — or you're one voice buried under a brand team. This role is the opposite. You research the customer, develop the angles, brief the creative, and then you watch your ideas go live and see exactly how they performed. Your work, your outcome, on a scoreboard.

We'll teach you the performance side. You bring the writing and the research instinct; our media team and your Growth Manager get you fluent in the data. What can't be taught is the nose for what makes someone stop scrolling and buy — that part has to already be in you.

This is not a design or editing job — you'll direct designers and editors, not become one. And it's not a content-calendar job — it's direct-response creative built to sell.

**Only apply if you have:**
* 2+ years writing ad or direct-response copy for D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brands — copy meant to sell, not just to sound nice.
* A real research habit. You dig into reviews, competitors, and customer language to find the angle, not just the words.
* Fluent written and spoken English. You'll work in real time with a US team.
* Full-time availability on US Eastern hours.

You do not need prior performance-marketing or media-buying experience. If you can write copy that converts and you're hungry to learn how it performs, we'll handle the rest.

**What you'll do**
* Research & competitor teardowns. Mine reviews, Reddit, TikTok, and the Meta Ad Library for real pain points and desire triggers. Build persona maps for the brands you own.
* Angles & briefing. Turn insight into complete creative briefs — hook variations, visual direction, scripts, on-screen text — that an editor can build without a single follow-up question. One brief should spark several distinct ads, not one with a color swap.
* Learn the performance loop. Sit with your Growth Manager each week to see which hooks, angles, and formats won, and feed that straight into the next round. This is where you pick up the data side, fast.
* Own the quality bar. QC every asset before it goes live. Your name is on the output.
* Use the full AI stack. Accelerate research, ideation, and variations. Build your own workflows and share what works.

**Why you'll want this**
* See your work perform. Most copywriters never learn if their words landed. Here you'll see spend, hooks, and results across many brands every week — years of pattern recognition in months.
* Real ownership. Your Growth Manager owns the client and the calls. Your time goes into the thinking.
* A transparent scoreboard. You'll always know exactly where you stand — no politics, no mystery, no review that arrives six months late. Strong strategists earn well above base through quarterly bonuses.
* Ground floor. This is the first creative strategy team we've built. The people who define it will lead it.

**The honest part**
Shipping isn't winning. An idea only counts here when it actually scales — when the media buyers put real budget behind it because it's working. We measure that on a clear scorecard, reviewed quarterly. And the pace is real: once you're ramped, the baseline is 15–20 briefs a week across several brands. Volume is part of the strategy, never at the cost of the thinking behind it.

If that sounds like pressure, it is. If it sounds like the place you finally get to prove your ideas win, apply.

**What you need**
**Non-negotiable:** 2+ years writing conversion-focused ad copy · a genuine research habit · fluent written and spoken English · full-time on US Eastern hours · daily hands-on use of AI tools · real hunger to move into performance creative.

**We'll teach you:** reading performance data (CPA, ROAS, hook rate, hold rate), how Meta's delivery rewards creative volume, and the mechanics of testing and scaling.

**Nice to have:** experience with supplements, beauty, pet, or CPG brands · basic CapCut or Premiere · directing UGC creators · TikTok Ads.

**How you work**
Curious about why people buy. Fast — you move in hours, not days. Detail-obsessed, because a sloppy brief makes a sloppy ad. Coachable, taking direct feedback and applying it immediately. Self-driven, because remote means nobody's watching and you deliver anyway. Competitive — you want your ads to be the ones that scale.

**Compensation**
$1,500 USD per month, plus quarterly performance bonuses that unlock at a strong scorecard grade. 

**About DigiCom**
We believe creative is the last real lever in paid media, and the team that researches harder and ships faster wins. We're building the best creative strategy team in the industry — across borders, because talent is everywhere and we intend to find it.

title: Customer Success Engagement Manager
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a SaaS company building a modern operating system for the moving industry, starting with moving company management software. Our MVP launched in Spring 2022, and we've rapidly expanded across the US, with our founders and engineers based in NYC.

Moving is a universal, stressful, and expensive experience that’s ripe for disruption. ~35M Americans (~10% of the country) move every year, with businesses, non-profits, government agencies, and military families also requiring moving services. This creates a massive moving economy, with a ~$30B industry of moving companies at the center.

Running a moving company is complicated, high-stress work. Most moving companies still rely on a disjointed mix of generic online tools and paperwork for sales, field service management, and back-office operations. We believe the lack of modern tools for movers is the critical challenge hindering major innovation in the moving experience.

Chariot addresses this problem with a simple, modern software platform that boosts sales conversions, reduces work to schedule and dispatch moves, simplifies move day, improves customer service, and streamlines payment collection. We're pursuing ambitious new product directions to expand our market size and impact for moving companies and customers.

Our founding team brings experience from Google, Flatiron Health, Cedar, Bain & Company, Bridgewater, Teachable, KeyMe, and ASAPP. We're backed by VC firms and co-founders of successful vertical SaaS companies, and advised by moving company owners nationwide.

PLEASE NOTE:
This role is remote or hybrid if located in the NYC metro
This role will also require after-business hours and weekend coverage for our Help Desk, one week per month or as needed. 

**What You'll Do**

The Customer Success Engagement Manager will play a critical role in scaling Chariot’s hands-on, high-quality customer experience. You’ll own a book of accounts, work the health metrics daily, and drive retention and growth through proactive outreach. You’ll work closely with the Head of Customer Success and our Product Support. This is a high-ownership role on a small team. 

**Customer Health & Engagement**

* Review customer health metrics daily and identify customers that are declining, stalled, or at risk
* Proactively reach out to at-risk customers to drive adoption and get them back on track
* Own a book of accounts and run regular check-ins to keep customers engage and using the product 
* Run quarterly business reviews with “VIP” customers that reinforce value, and surface expansion opportunities (upsells, quarterly → annual conversions) 
* Identify customers who have stalled in onboarding and re-engage them to complete setup
* Track and report on engagement trends across customer base
* Maximize business value of healthy customers by driving referrals and upsells

**Help Desk & Support**

* Support the help desk on an as-needed basis, including a 1-week-per-month on-call rotation for after-hours/weekend coverage. 

* You’ll be responsible to:
* Respond to customer questions via help desk with fast SLAs
* Triage product questions and escalate appropriately while maintaining customer ownership
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to improved documentation and internal processes

**Also Part of the Role**

* Help with billing and payment-related questions
* Occasionally run onboarding and training calls, support onboarding follow-ups and setup tasks

**Who You Are**

You may come from one of the following backgrounds:
* 2-4 years in customer success, customer support, or account management role within a SaaS or technology company, ideally with ownership over renewals, retention, or expansion
 OR
* Experience working in the moving industry, ideally in a management, or operations-focused role, with a comfort working in software platforms
 OR 
* 2+ years in an operations, account management, or client success role involving data-driven decision-making, proactive client communication, and ownership over a portfolio or set of outcomes

**In addition, you:**

* Are driven about learning, growing your skillset, and advancing your career. You embrace the opportunities of working at a startup and find ways to make an impact without being asked. 
* Are comfortable working with data – you’ll be able to look at a health score, spot what is declining, and what to do about it. You can think critically about how to improve data and systems to make yourself more effective.
* Are a confident, proactive communicator. You don’t wait for customers to reach out, you reach out first. You’re not afraid to pick up the phone, text, and stay persistent to reach a customer.
* Are highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through managing a full book of accounts without anything important falling through the cracks.
* Comfortable working with small business owners and employees in a “blue-collar” industry. 
* Are flexible and low-ego – this is a small team, so you’re willing to help with support tickets, billing questions, or other tasks when needed, even if it’s not your main focus.
* Are excited to deeply learn a complex product and become an expert in how moving companies operate.


**Bonus Points:**

* Experience at an early stage startup (Seed, Series A)
* Experience with B2B SaaS products
* Experience supporting SMB customers (in the moving industry or another “blue-collar” industry)
* Familiarity with help desk systems (Zendesk, Intercom, etc.)
* Experience with HubSpot

**Compensation**

* Salary: $65-90k + equity (depending on location & experience)
* Benefits & Perks
* Unlimited vacation
* Competitive salary and significant equity
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance with comprehensive benefits
* 401(K)
* WFH equipment budget (for remote employees)

title: Operations Associate - Graduate Internship
description:
***Note:** Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.*

##   
🚀 Our Story

Partly's mission is to connect the world's parts and we're doing that by building the first global platform for replacement parts, starting with auto parts. Our big vision is to accelerate the world towards a sustainable future where waste is eliminated and all replacement parts are universally searchable, accessible and available to all.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we utilise bleeding-edge technology to solve challenging but exciting problems that make a huge impact in a $1.9 trillion industry. We've more than tripled our team over the last 12 months and expect to double in size again over the coming 12 months. We're a global team spanning both Europe and Australasia.

We provide a scalable digital infrastructure solution to some of the world's largest businesses and the most exciting startups. Partly's solutions are integrated across hundreds of companies globally, providing the backbone for cataloguing and managing parts online.

Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co-Founder).

We're continuing to build a world-class team and ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built at Partly, and our [values](https://www.partly.com/careers) are lived throughout every experience.

## 🖍️ This role

As the first time was a huge success, we're launching version 2 of Partly's Repairer Ambassador Programme — a 3-month, full-time (with flexibility), paid internship for a small cohort of sharp, driven graduates who want real responsibility from day one. This is for people who want something more than a coffee run and a PowerPoint, and will lead to a full-time role for those who make a genuine impact.

Your job is simple: get newly onboarded repair shops actively using the Partly platform as quickly as possible. That means building relationships on the ground, understanding why certain shops aren't placing orders through us, and removing those barriers. You'll become the human face of Partly in repair shops across the UK — someone repairers genuinely trust and enjoy working with.

This is not a desk job. You'll spend your first 1–2 weeks in our London office receiving structured training before heading out to visit customers across your assigned region.

**Key details:**

- **Contract:** 3 months, full-time with flexibility
- **Start:** As soon as possible
- **Location:** UK-wide (field-based, with initial training in London)

## 💻 What will you do

- Visit newly signed repair shops across your region and help them get up and running on the Partly platform.
- Understand why shops aren't placing jobs through Partly and identify practical ways to remove those barriers.
- Help repairers optimise and streamline their parts procurement workflows.
- Track repairer activity, monitor adoption, and report insights back to the team on what's working and what isn't.
- Build authentic, long-term relationships with shop owners and parts managers.
- Feed customer insights back to the wider business so we can continually improve the product and onboarding experience.

## 🥷 What we're looking for

description:

- How you'd architect a solution for a real estate lead generation platform

---

**To Apply:** Send your portfolio and a brief note on how you currently use AI in your development workflow.

title: Founding Content Lead (Social & Video)

description:
# Founding Content Lead (Social & Video)

**Shymea · Remote · Full-time or part-time · 1–2% equity · No cash compensation initially**

### About Shymea

Shymea is a Western astrology app that helps people explore places, timing, relationships and everyday questions through their birth chart.

Our tools include Life Map, which compares approximately 390 cities; a chart-based AI guide; classical horary questions; and relationship insights. We also offer personalized daily letters, guided audio and free learning resources.

We’re live on iOS, Android is next, and we’ve received our first in-app purchase. The founder built the product. Now we’re looking for someone to help build the audience.

### The role

You’ll turn Shymea’s ideas and features into content people want to watch, share and explore further.

This is a hands-on role: you’ll create the content yourself, publish it and use the results to improve. We’ll focus initially on Instagram and TikTok, adapting suitable videos for YouTube Shorts.

You’ll:

* Create short videos and carousels with strong hooks and clear storytelling.
* Shape Shymea’s voice and visual style alongside the founder.
* Build a consistent publishing schedule using templates and batch production.
* Test formats and track retention, engagement, website visits and attributable app installs.
* Turn audience questions and comments into content.
* Identify relevant creators for collaborations.

**Part-time:** Approximately 15–20 hours per week, focused on production, publishing and testing a manageable set of formats.

**Full-time:** Broader ownership of content strategy, production, community, creator collaborations and organic audience growth.

Priorities and output will match the agreed commitment. Paid advertising is outside the initial remit.

### Who we’re looking for

You’ve personally helped an Instagram or TikTok account grow substantially—and can show your contribution.

You can edit videos, design polished carousels and explain why your content works. You’re comfortable taking initiative, testing ideas and working with limited resources.

Astrology knowledge is welcome, but not essential. Curiosity and sound editorial judgment matter. You should be comfortable working with AI-assisted, chart-based interpretations without presenting predictions as guarantees.

### What you’ll get

You’ll work directly with the founder, who will support you with product knowledge, analytics, creative feedback and production tools.

You’ll have meaningful creative ownership, substantial product material to work with and the opportunity to grow into a larger leadership role as Shymea develops.

### Commitment and equity

* **Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours/week: 1% equity.**
* **Full-time: 1.5–2% equity**, depending on experience and agreed responsibilities.

Equity vests over four years, with a one-year cliff and monthly vesting afterward. Percentages are calculated on a fully diluted basis at grant and are subject to future dilution.

If you move from part-time to full-time, we’ll agree on an updated grant. The full-time percentage represents your **total equity**, not an additional 1.5–2%.

### Cash compensation

**There is no cash salary, stipend or fee available initially.** Please apply only if this is financially workable for you.

For either arrangement, the starting cash compensation is **US$500 for each calendar month in which Shymea earns at least US$3,000 after app-store/payment fees and refunds**, paid the following month.

If revenue falls below that threshold, no cash compensation accrues for that month. Payments resume for months that qualify. You’ll have visibility into the relevant revenue figures.

Compensation will be reviewed quarterly based on company revenue, individual performance and responsibilities. Increases are not automatic and will be agreed in writing.

Equity continues vesting throughout the active engagement, including months without cash compensation. Any engagement must comply with applicable local pay and employment requirements.

### How to apply

Apply through Wellfound with:

* **An Instagram or TikTok account you grew:** The link, follower growth, timeframe, your responsibilities and whether growth was organic or paid.
* **Proof:** An analytics screenshot showing growth and reach. You can hide confidential details.
* **Your work:** Two short videos and one carousel you personally created.
* **One idea:** A Shymea content idea and its opening hook, in 2–3 lines.
* **Your availability:** Location, preferred full-time or part-time arrangement, and earliest start date.

No cover letter or newly produced sample required. Please confirm that you understand the initial equity-only arrangement and revenue-dependent cash compensation.

title: Senior Computational Scientist
description:
**About the role**
We are looking for an experienced computational protein scientist to lead receptor design at Priora and take ownership of the computational strategy from initial concept through to experimentally testable candidates.

You will develop and operate the computational design pipeline spanning structure generation, sequence design, ligand-pocket optimisation, structural filtering and docking. More importantly, you will determine how these approaches are combined and applied to generate high-quality receptor candidates within the specific functional and structural constraints of our platform.

You will work directly with modern protein-design and structure-prediction methods, build and maintain the underlying computational workflows, and design the libraries that progress into experimental screening.

A central part of the role will be the iterative interface between computation and experiment. Working closely with our wet-lab scientists, you will use screening data to refine design hypotheses, improve candidate selection and guide successive design cycles.

This position would suit someone who combines deep technical expertise in protein design with strong scientific judgement: someone able to move from an open-ended biological objective to a tractable computational strategy, prioritise candidates intelligently, and take responsibility for a design campaign from first principles through experimental iteration.
