title: Compliance Regulatory Specialist
description:
As a Regulatory Compliance Specialist, you will play a key technical role within the Regulatory Compliance team, working closely with the team and Compliance management on complex regulatory matters, with a strong focus on Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) and National Monetary Council (CMN) requirements applicable to financial institutions and payment institutions. You will independently assess regulatory requirements, translate them into practical business, process, and control requirements, advise stakeholders on regulatory matters, and monitor their implementation and effectiveness across the company, contributing to the team’s technical consistency and regulatory compliance framework.  
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Analyze BCB, CMN, and other applicable regulations and assess their impact on the company’s products, processes, controls, and operations.
- Own regulatory compliance assessments end-to-end, from regulatory interpretation and impact assessment through implementation follow-up and effectiveness validation.
- Provide regulatory compliance advice for new products, projects, processes, and business initiatives.
- Conduct compliance reviews and adherence testing, assessing evidence, identifying regulatory gaps, and recommending remediation actions.
- Monitor the implementation of regulatory requirements and follow up on action plans with responsible business areas.
- Support regulatory monitoring activities, including the assessment, classification, and communication of new or amended requirements to impacted stakeholders.
- Review and contribute to Compliance policies, procedures, controls, and regulatory governance frameworks.
- Support regulatory inspections, requests, audits, findings, and remediation plans, including interactions with internal and external stakeholders.
- Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk, Technology, and other areas to translate regulatory requirements into actionable business and control solutions.
- Contribute to Compliance reporting, regulatory risk visibility, and the continuous improvement and effectiveness of the Compliance Program.
- Provide technical guidance to other Compliance team members when required, contributing to knowledge sharing and consistency of regulatory assessments.
- Manage multiple regulatory matters simultaneously, prioritizing activities based on regulatory risk, materiality, deadlines, and potential exposure.

**Requirements**

- Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or a related field.
- Solid experience in Regulatory Compliance within financial institutions, payment institutions, fintechs, or other companies operating in regulated financial environments.
- Hands-on experience in institutions directly regulated or supervised by the Central Bank of Brazil is strongly preferred.
- Strong knowledge of BCB and CMN regulatory frameworks applicable to financial institutions and/or payment institutions.
- Proven ability to interpret regulations and translate regulatory requirements into practical business, process, and control requirements.
- Experience with regulatory assessments, compliance reviews, adherence testing, action-plan follow-up, and/or regulatory remediation.
- Experience assessing regulatory requirements related to payment accounts, Pix, cards, credit, investments, and/or other financial products is a plus.
- Ability to independently handle complex regulatory matters from assessment through implementation follow-up and effectiveness validation.
- Ability to manage multiple regulatory matters, prioritize based on regulatory risk and materiality, and operate effectively in a fast-changing regulatory and business environment.
- Ability to interact effectively with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
- Strong analytical, written communication, and advisory skills.

**SOFT SKILLS**

- Demonstrates strong ownership and technical autonomy.
- Communicates complex regulatory matters clearly and pragmatically.
- Combines regulatory rigor with a practical understanding of business, product, and operational realities.
- Challenges constructively and exercises sound judgment.
- Influences stakeholders effectively without relying on formal authority.
- Works collaboratively across business and technical teams.
- Demonstrates strong organization and prioritization skills in an environment with multiple concurrent regulatory demands.
- Maintains high standards of integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

**Benefits**

- Competitive and market-aligned salary.
- Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
- Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
- Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
- Life insurance.
- Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
- TotalPass membership to take care of your health.

### Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
## About the Role

We're hiring a Senior AI Engineer to own AI-powered automation end to end — from identifying manual, repetitive, or error-prone work across the business, to building and shipping automated systems that replace it in production. This role sits on top of an existing internal operations platform and works directly with the business stakeholders (across multiple regional markets) who currently do this work by hand.

This is not a research role, and not a prototype-and-handoff role. You'll take a defined business problem — a manual process, a spreadsheet, a support queue — through to a shipped, monitored production system, and you'll set the technical standard for how AI gets built across the company going forward.

## What You'll Do

- Own AI-powered automation end to end: take a business problem from an undefined state through to a shipped, monitored production system.
- Work directly with operations and business stakeholders across multiple regional markets to identify automation opportunities grounded in real operational data.
- Design and ship a conversational AI / chatbot layer for customer/resident-facing support, targeting a significant share of time currently spent on repetitive manual support.
- Extend self-service capabilities into adjacent flows as the platform matures — bookings, maintenance/service requests, account and billing queries.
- Automate document- and data-heavy manual work: data extraction, lifecycle processing (e.g. onboarding/offboarding), pricing and availability logic currently run by hand across disconnected spreadsheets and tools.
- Build anomaly detection and decision-support tooling where it has clear financial impact (e.g. exception patterns, pricing anomalies, chargebacks).
- Own model selection, prompt/agent architecture, and evaluation practice for anything AI-powered in the company.
- Decide what's core AI infrastructure versus a one-off script, and what needs guardrails before it touches a real customer or a real contract.
- Make the call on when an LLM is the right tool — and when it isn't.

## What We're Looking For

- Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of shipping AI-powered features to production — not only notebooks or demos.
- Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompting, agents, and retrieval, along with sound judgment on when fine-tuning (or a non-AI solution) is the better fit.
- Demonstrated ability to own a feature from an undefined business problem through to a monitored production system without a pre-written spec.
- Strong stakeholder skills — able to work directly with non-technical business stakeholders to translate an existing manual process into a buildable specification.
- Comfortable operating in a small team where supporting infrastructure is still being built out.

## Nice to Have

- Prior conversational AI / chatbot production experience.
- PropTech, real estate, or other operationally complex industry exposure.
- Experience operating inside a multi-entity or post-M&A organization.



**Location:** Remote (working hours overlapping Japan & APAC)
**Type:** Contract
**Compensation:** Market-standard, commensurate with experience and skill level

title: Content Creator & Storyteller
description:
### **Job Description**

You are a storyteller, writer, journalist, content creator, or brand communicator who can turn ideas, people, and complex subjects into clear, compelling, and memorable stories. You are curious about technology, science, and startups and will play a key role in shaping QuantumX’s voice, narrative, and public presence across channels.

### **What you’ll do**

- Own QuantumX storytelling and narrative across social media, website, campaigns, newsletters, and launches.
- Be the on-camera voice for QuantumX across social media, presenting ideas, stories, interviews, explainers, and other content in a natural and engaging way.
- Turn complex quantum, deep-tech, research, and technology topics into clear and compelling stories.
- Find and develop stories around founders, researchers, ventures, technologies, problems, breakthroughs, and the QuantumX ecosystem.
- Create content concepts, scripts, social posts, articles, interviews, founder stories, campaign narratives, and newsletters.
- Work closely with the Marketing Head and Venture and Community teams to identify and surface stories worth telling.
- Interview founders, researchers, engineers, and other members of the QuantumX ecosystem.
- Develop narratives around launches, research, community initiatives, events, milestones, and announcements.
- Adapt stories across different formats and platforms while maintaining a consistent voice.
- Build and manage a content pipeline and editorial calendar.
- Collaborate with designers, video creators, marketers, founders, and researchers to bring stories to life.
- Evolve QuantumX’s tone, editorial style, and storytelling approach.
- Stay current with developments in quantum, AI, deep-tech, startups, research, and emerging technology.
- Help build QuantumX’s public presence through consistent, high-quality storytelling.

### **Skills Required**

- Interviews & Communication – Strong interviewing and communication skills; comfortable creating on-camera content, comfortable speaking with founders, researchers, and technical teams.
- Writing & Storytelling – Excellent writing, editing, and narrative-building skills across different formats.
- Content & Editorial – Ability to identify strong stories and develop content, campaigns, articles, scripts, and social posts.
- Technical Storytelling – Ability to simplify complex technical/scientific ideas into clear and engaging stories.
- Social & Digital Content – Understanding of social media storytelling and adapting content for different platforms.
- Collaboration & Execution – Strong ownership and ability to work with Marketing, Venture, Community, Research, and creative teams.

### **Experience**

- 2+ years of experience in storytelling, content, journalism, brand communications, editorial, or content marketing.
- Experience creating content for technology, startups, science, deep-tech, or similar audiences is preferred.
- Strong writing and narrative skills, along with experience in social media, interviews, founder stories, or campaign storytelling, are valuable.
- Experience simplifying complex technical subjects is a strong plus.
- Experience or interest in quantum, AI, deep-tech, startups, science, or emerging technologies is a plus.
- Experience building your own personal brand or managing personal branding/content for someone else on platforms such as X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, or similar, is preferred.

### **What success looks like**

- A recognisable and consistent QuantumX voice across platforms.
- Complex quantum and deep-tech ideas are communicated through accessible and engaging stories.
- A consistent pipeline of high-quality content is created and published.
- Founders, researchers, ventures, technologies, breakthroughs, and the wider ecosystem are regularly brought to life through storytelling.
- A coherent narrative exists across QuantumX’s website, social media, campaigns, newsletters, and launches.
- QuantumX develops a stronger public presence, brand, and reputation.

### **Why you’ll love it**

You’ll work at the intersection of storytelling, quantum technology, research, entrepreneurship, and emerging tech. You’ll work closely with founders, researchers, engineers, and technical teams while learning about cutting-edge developments. You’ll have the opportunity to build QuantumX’s voice and narrative, turn technical work into stories that reach broader audiences, and directly shape how QuantumX and its ventures are understood by the world.

### **Who we are**

title: Distribution Manager
description:
**About Homefans**
Homefans is the leading marketplace for authentic sports travel experiences. We connect fans with local hosts in 100+ destinations across football, Formula 1, NFL, basketball, and more — offering matchday experiences, stadium tours, and multi-day trips that go far beyond the standard ticket. With a 4.9/5 rating from thousands of reviews, we are transforming how fans experience sport around the world.

**The Role**
We are looking for a Distribution Manager to own and accelerate our OTA and distribution channel strategy. This is a revenue-growth role with a product lens: you will ensure every experience we list on Bokun, Viator, GetYourGuide, and other OTAs has the right content, photo inventory, and pricing strategy — segmented by channel — to drive guaranteed recurring revenue with significant growth upside.

The area currently grows at ~15% annually. We need to hit 40-50%. We have an exceptional product. What we need is the right strategy, execution, and partnerships to get there.

**What You Will Own**
* Revenue Growth: Drive 40-50% annual growth across all OTA and distribution channels by optimising listings, pricing, and channel mix.
* Product Listing Strategy: Own the end-to-end product presentation on Bokun and every OTA — content, imagery, descriptions, and categorisation — ensuring each channel gets the right product mix.
* Dynamic Pricing: Build and execute a pricing strategy linked to product lifecycle (launch, growth, mature), seasonality, and channel characteristics to maximise yield and occupancy.
* Partner Acquisition: Identify, negotiate, and seal new distribution partnerships — from global OTAs to niche sports-travel platforms.
* Channel Connectivity: Work closely with our technology and operations teams to streamline manual connectivity gaps and influence the product roadmap for automated distribution.
* Performance Analytics: Track channel-level P&L, conversion rates, and market trends; use data to reallocate inventory and prioritise high-ROI partnerships.

**What We Are Looking For**
* Experience: 2-4 years in OTA management, online travel distribution, or e-commerce marketplace management — with a proven record of revenue growth.
* Travel Sector DNA: Deep understanding of how OTAs, tour operators, and experience marketplaces work — ideally within sports, events, or hospitality.
* Product Mindset: You think like a merchant: every listing is a product, every channel is a shopfront, and every price point is a lever.
* Commercial Drive: Comfortable owning a revenue target and building the plan to hit it. You are relentless about growth.
* Deal-Making: A track record of opening new distribution channels and negotiating win-win partnerships.
* Tech Fluency: You do not need to code, but you need to speak the language of APIs, connectivity, inventory systems, and automation — and influence tech decisions accordingly.
* Data Literacy: Strong analytical skills; you live in spreadsheets and dashboards and use them to tell stories and drive decisions.
* Language: Fluent English required; additional languages (Spanish, Portuguese, Italian) a strong plus given our destinations.

**Why Homefans**
* High-Impact Role: You will single-handedly transform how we distribute and monetise a world-class product.
* Growth Trajectory: We are scaling fast — this role has a direct path to senior leadership as the team and revenue grow.
* Global Product: Work with iconic clubs, stadiums, and destinations across six continents.
* Remote-First: Work from anywhere in Europe with a flexible, results-driven culture.
* Founder Access: Direct collaboration with the COO and leadership team; your voice shapes strategy and technology.

**How to Apply**
Send your CV with the specific subject **"Distribution Manager Application"** and a short note on the biggest distribution win you have driven to **careers@homefans.com**  

We review every application personally and should there be a fit, we will get in touch.

title: Design Manager, 5+ years (Leadership Founding role, Equity-only)
description:

title: Chief Delivery Officer
description:
**This is a unquie role for sure. This role should be someone looking to step into a CTO role but technically sharp in modern appdev to grow and lead the proper team. **

Role: Chief Delivery Officer Company: Veritium Corp (www.veritium.com)

Veritium Corp is a US-based technology solutions provider delivering enterprise-grade cloud, data, and AI architectures. We are not just any other consulting and services company. We are turning the model of AI and Cloud development on its head.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, high-performing leader to establish, scale, and lead our technical practice which entails custom software development, cloud deployments and infrascture.

As CDO you will have complete autonomy to build Veritium’s engineering team. Operating as both a strategic leader and an active architect/lead developer, you will define our engineering strategy, lead our key developements and lead our technical staff to be high preforming and structured.  As CDO you will be called on to preform pre-sales discussions with clients to secure foundational enterprise accounts, and recruit a top-tier technical delivery team.

This role will inhert a team of about a dozen fulltime engineers and support staff across the US and India with a mandate to quickly hire additional technical staff.

This position offers a rare combination of corporate stability and startup agility, backed by a parent company and founder.

We are a 1.5 year old startup, but well backed spin-off of a sucessful SaaS holding co with several established modern tech companies. We have a solid revenue stream and technical team.

We prefer someone that loves travel and getting out to meet current and prospective clients.

We're building a new practice delivering custom AI solutions, SaaS products, and cloud infrastructure to B2B clients. We need a hands-on technical leader who can architect solutions, code alongside a small team when deadlines demand it, mentor junior/mid-level engineers, and represent the practice credibly in front of clients — from discovery calls through delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Delivery

* Own end-to-end technical architecture across AI/ML systems, SaaS applications, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Make and document build-vs-buy, framework, and platform decisions that balance speed, cost, and long-term maintainability
* Write production code regularly — not just review it — especially on critical paths, prototypes, and when the team hits capacity constraints
* Set and enforce engineering standards: code quality, testing, CI/CD, security practices, and technical documentation
* Evaluate and integrate third-party AI models/APIs (LLMs, vector databases, ML infrastructure) into client solutions

Team Leadership

* Directly manage and mentor a small team of junior-to-mid-level engineers, growing their skills and ownership over time
* Run sprint planning, technical reviews, and 1:1s; balance individual growth with delivery deadlines
* Create a technical culture that scales — documentation, onboarding, and repeatable patterns — so the team isn't dependent on any one person's tribal knowledge
* Make staffing and skills-gap calls: when to hire, when to upskill, when to bring in contractors

Client Engagement

* Serve as the primary technical voice in client meetings — discovery, solution design, technical sales support, and status reviews
* Translate complex technical tradeoffs into business terms for non-technical stakeholders
* Produce and present architecture diagrams, technical proposals, and project roadmaps clients can act on
* Build client trust and confidence through polished, professional presence — this role is often the technical face of the company externally
* Support pre-sales: scoping calls, technical feasibility assessments, and SOW/estimate input

Strategic/Operational

* Advise leadership on technology strategy, platform investments, and delivery risk
* Own technical risk management: security posture, scalability planning, and incident response readiness
* Help define the practice's service offerings and reusable accelerators/IP as the team scales

Qualifications

Technical

8+ years of software engineering experience, including full-stack and cloud-native development
Demonstrated experience architecting and shipping AI-powered products (LLM integration, RAG, ML pipelines, or similar) — not just using AI tools, but building with them
Deep hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CDK/Pulumi) a strong plus
Strong SaaS architecture experience: multi-tenancy, API design, scalable data models, security/compliance basics (SOC 2, data privacy)
Fluent in modern development practices: CI/CD, containerization, automated testing, observability
Comfortable being the most senior engineer in the room and the one still writing code under deadline pressure

Leadership

3+ years leading or mentoring engineering teams, ideally in a small company, startup, or consultancy setting where roles are fluid
Track record of developing junior talent into confident contributors
Comfortable operating without a large org chart or established process — willing to build the playbook, not just follow one

Client-Facing

Proven experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical B2B clients or executives
Polished communication style — confident, credible, and consultative rather than purely technical/transactional
Experience in a client-services, consulting, or agency environment is a strong plus
Comfortable owning a room: client kickoffs, technical sales support, exec-level status updates

Mindset

Entrepreneurial — energized by building a practice from the ground up, not inheriting a mature one
Pragmatic: knows when to move fast and ship, and when to slow down for the client-critical stuff
Low ego about doing "junior" work (writing code, debugging, documentation) when the team needs it

Nice to Have

Prior experience in a technical co-founder, fractional CTO, or agency/consultancy lead role
Existing network or reputation in the AI/SaaS consulting space
Public speaking, writing, or thought-leadership presence (blog, conference talks, etc.)

Generate and grow profitable online sales.

* Work toward monthly sales and revenue targets

* Analyze sales performance across different brands
* Identify high-performing products and opportunities for scaling
* Recommend offers, bundles and promotions
* Analyze the complete customer journey from ad to purchase
* Identify problems affecting website conversions

**Creative Strategy**
* Ability to understand what type of creatives generate sales
* Research competitor advertising
* Identify new hooks and marketing angles
* Give clear briefs to our graphic designer/video editor
* Recommend static ads, UGC concepts, carousels and video ideas
* Analyze creative performance
* Identify winning creatives

**Required Skills**

* Understanding of Google Ads
* Knowledge of Amazon Seller Central
* Knowledge of Amazon PPC / Sponsored Ads
* Familiarity with Flipkart Seller Hub and Flipkart Ads
* Understanding of e-commerce and D2C marketing
* Understanding of ROAS, CAC/CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR and AOV

* Canva

We don't want someone who simply launches ads and waits for results.

title: Electronics/Embedded Systems Intern
description:
**Type**: Internship (2–3 months, extendable) 
**Stipend** - 5K - 10K
**Location**: Remote Availability - full time / part time

About the Role- Make My Health builds consumer health-tech products, including wearable devices that pair sensors with our mobile app to help people track and improve their health (e.g. posture, movement, recovery). As our hardware initiative grows, we're looking for an Electronics/Embedded Systems intern to help prototype and build these devices — starting with our current wearable project and extending to future health-device builds as they come up.

**What You'll Do**

1. Prototype sensing pipelines using common sensors (IMUs, pressure, temperature, or similar, depending on the device) to capture the physical signal a product needs to track.
2. Build calibration and signal-processing logic that turns raw sensor data into meaningful health/behavior signals (e.g. a baseline position, a threshold crossing, a trend).
3. Wire and solder compact circuits combining sensors, actuators (buzzers, LEDs, haptics), batteries, and a Bluetooth/BLE chip (e.g. ESP32, nRF52).
4. Write embedded firmware (C/C++, Arduino IDE or equivalent) for the device's core logic and power management.
5. Get BLE streaming working so a companion phone app can receive and log device data.
6. Iterate on prototypes for comfort, battery life, and accuracy through hands-on testing.
7. Document each build: wiring diagrams, component lists, calibration parameters, and firmware notes, so designs can be handed off for app integration or production scoping.

**What We're Looking For**

1. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Electronics, ECE, Mechatronics, IoT, or a related field.
2. Hands-on experience with Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or similar microcontroller platforms — academic, personal, or hackathon projects all count.
3. Working knowledge of common sensors (IMUs, etc.) and basic calibration/signal-processing concepts.
4. Familiarity with BLE/Bluetooth communication fundamentals.
5. Comfortable with basic circuit design, breadboarding, and soldering.
6. Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded programming.
7. A DIY, trial-and-error mindset — this is early-stage prototyping across multiple products, not a single spec'd-out build.

**Nice to have**

1. Prior experience in designing or building a wearable device.
2. Familiarity with CAD and 3D printing for enclosure design
3. Experience working with a mobile app team on hardware/software integration.

**Why this Internship**
1. Own hardware builds from End-to-end, breadboard prototype to a wearable people can actually try on.
2. Work across multiple health-device concept not just one product - broad exposure to consumer hardware.
3. Work closely with the Founder and product team on Consumer health-tech from earliest stage.

title: Founding Product Manager (co-founder, equity) Barcelona Onsite/Spanish required
description:
Location:** Barcelona, in person.** Not remote. Compensation: equity only until first revenue. Range and vesting below. Start: October 2026.** Languages: Spanish and English fluent, Catalan a plus.**

Folks from outside Spain and do not speak Spanish - Please do not apply, you are wasting your and my time and electricity.

**What we are building**

Every Spanish subcontractor that sends workers onto a client's site (installers, maintenance firms, cleaning, industrial services) has to prove, worker by worker, that the paperwork is in order: social security, training, medical fitness, insurance. The client demands it through a CAE platform it chose. A subcontractor with five clients faces five platforms, five formats, five sets of expiry rules. Someone in the office spends 8 to 12 hours a week re uploading the same files, or the company pays €200 to €600 a month for a person to do it. When a document expires unnoticed, a worker is turned away at the gate.

Where we are: research done (market, competitors, platforms, legal, unit economics), product spec written, UI mocked up. Zero customers, zero code in production. The next 90 days are about talking to 30 subcontractors, signing 10 alpha customers, and building the smallest thing they will pay for.

The founder is a repeat B2B software founder (one of his previous companies became a unicorn after he left), CPTO by trade, based in Barcelona. He builds fast. He does not yet speak Spanish well enough to sell. That is the gap you fill.

**What you will do**

In the first 90 days:

Call and visit subcontractors in Barcelona and Tarragona. Find the office manager who does the uploads and the owner who pays. Ask when a worker last got stopped at a gate, what they pay today, how many platforms they face. Log every conversation. Sign 10 alpha customers who let us run their CAE uploads by hand while we build. You will be in their office with a laptop doing the first upload live. Turn what you hear into the product. Decide what goes in the first version and what waits. Write the WhatsApp messages, the onboarding checklist, the one page presupuesto, in Spanish that an installer's admin actually uses. Open doors with the gremios (GREMIMET, Gremi de Tarragona), a few gestorías and one prevention service. The plan depends on one of them endorsing us before we have ten customers. Own the product spec and the roadmap after that. The founder builds what you and the customers decide.

After 90 days: you run product and customer discovery, the founder runs engineering, and we hire a salesperson under you when the pitch is repeatable.

**Who this is for**

You have sold, supported or built something for Spanish SMEs, ideally in construction, installation, facility services, PRL, or a gestoría. You have used a CAE platform (Nalanda, Obralia, CTAIMA, Twind, Dokify, e-coordina) or you have watched someone suffer through one. You are comfortable calling a stranger who owns a 20 person installer firm, and comfortable sitting in his office at 8 in the morning. You write clear Spanish and speak it like the customer does. You can work with an English speaking founder all day. You have shipped a product or run a customer facing process end to end. Title does not matter. Having been an office manager at a subcontractor counts as much as having been a PM at a startup. You want a co founder seat, not a job. You are fine with no salary for the first months and you can say so plainly.

Not for you if: you need a salary from month one, you want to manage a team before there is one, you would rather write strategy documents than make 30 calls a week, or you have never closed anything.

**Equity and terms**

Founding PM, second founder. Equity range 10% - 35%, four year vesting, one year cliff, standard for a founding hire in Spain. Salary starts when monthly recurring revenue passes €10,000, target within 6 to 9 months. Contract as autónomo or via a founders' agreement, your choice, drafted by a Spanish lawyer. The founder keeps control and is the CEO.

You will see the full business plan, the numbers, the risks (including the two that could kill it: platform terms of use, and whether in house firms will pay €149) before you decide. We would rather you say no with full information than yes with half.

title: US Roofing Sales Rep - Project & Recurring Commissions
description:
### **Remote | Flexible, alongside your existing sales work | Commission only**

Already selling to roofing suppliers, distributors, manufacturers or installation businesses?

Add a useful new offer to conversations you’re already having - and earn one-off and recurring commissions without having to handle every sale yourself.

T3 Labs builds practical software that helps roofing businesses make buying easier, generate better sales inquiries, and reduce manual estimating and quoting work. We’re looking for an experienced rep with established U.S. roofing relationships who can spot opportunities and introduce these solutions.

### **What you’ll introduce**

**Website sales tools**
Smart assistants and interactive estimators that help customers get product answers, find pricing, measure roof plans and submit better-informed quote requests, without needing to call or wait for a response.

**Custom business solutions**
Estimating, pricing and quoting systems, plus other tailored tools, built around how each business works and what it needs.

**QuoteCore+**
Our ready-to-use roofing measurement, estimating and quoting app, for everyone from an individual roofer to a large supplier. The paid app brings the workflow together, allowing customers to save and edit jobs, reuse their pricing and produce professional quotes rather than starting from scratch.

### **How you earn**

**Website tools and custom solutions**
* 15-20% commission: Introduce a qualified prospect and get them onto a call with our team. We handle the sale; you earn commission on resulting deals.
* 30% commission: Manage and close the sale yourself, with support from our team where needed.
These projects offer one-off commissions, with potential recurring commission where ongoing monthly payments apply. Prices for these packages start from $999 but can easily go beyond $20k

**QuoteCore+ subscriptions**
Earn 30% recurring monthly commission on paid subscriptions you refer. Share your referral link or code to give customers a special introductory deal.
This opens up a wider market: anyone in your network who needs to measure, estimate and quote could be a suitable customer, not just larger businesses.

**Easy ways to start the conversation**
You don’t need to be a software expert. You need to understand roofing businesses and recognize where these tools could help.

An opener could be as simple as:

**“How much time does your team spend answering pricing questions and putting quotes together?”**

We provide sales materials, short demonstration videos and **free standalone tools you can share with prospects**, which are designed to sell the services.

### **Work it into the relationships you already have**

This suits an experienced roofing or building-materials rep who already speaks with business owners, sales leaders, estimators or other decision-makers.

Make introductions alongside your existing, non-competing sales work, build monthly subscription referrals, or take a more active role developing and closing new business.

**No base salary, hourly rate or retainer. No fixed hours, required call volumes or cap on commission.

Interested? Tell us which types of roofing businesses you already sell to, the U.S. markets you cover, and whether you prefer making introductions, closing sales or building subscription referrals.**

title: Fractional Founding Account Executive — Digital Health
description:
**Nexalink is hiring up to three Founding Account Executives to accelerate go-to-market for CareCompass.**

**This is a fractional, flexible, commission-forward role designed for experienced startup sellers who are not expected to leave an existing full-time position.** We anticipate an initial commitment of approximately 5-15 hours per week, with scope increasing only where there is demonstrated pipeline traction and mutual interest. 

**We welcome candidates based in the United States or Europe.** We are particularly interested in people with relationships at European digital-health and health-tech companies that sell into, are expanding into, or are otherwise active in the U.S. healthcare market. Candidates must be able to engage effectively with U.S.-market prospects and participate in a reasonable overlap with U.S. business hours.

Nexalink is a healthcare AI infrastructure-as-a-service company. We build core SDKs and platform capabilities that health-tech companies can integrate into revenue-cycle-management workflows, including medical-coding, prior-authorization, and related operational automation.

CareCompass is designed for health-tech companies that want to embed healthcare AI capabilities into their own products and workflows without building the underlying AI infrastructure from scratch. 

We are looking for entrepreneurial sales leaders with startup experience and an active network across digital health, health-tech SaaS, RCM technology, payer and provider technology, or adjacent healthcare-infrastructure companies—especially organizations selling into the U.S. market. This is not a traditional, fully built sales role: you will help create the playbook.

You will identify and qualify the highest-potential customer segments, activate your network, build an early pipeline, secure pilot opportunities, and help turn successful pilots into annual commercial agreements. You will work directly with the founder and technical team to refine positioning, validate our ICP, surface product feedback, and build a repeatable GTM motion. 

**What you'll do**
* Build and manage a pipeline of health-tech prospects, with an emphasis on companies serving RCM, coding, prior authorization, payer, provider, or healthcare-operations use cases
* Use existing digital-health relationships and targeted outbound prospecting to generate qualified introductions and discovery conversations
* Develop the ICP, buyer personas, value proposition, and qualification criteria alongside the founding team
* Run discovery, communicate CareCompass's technical and commercial value, and coordinate technical evaluations with Nexalink's product and engineering team
* Structure and advance pilots, then help convert successful pilots into annual customer contracts
* Maintain disciplined pipeline records, forecast opportunities realistically, and share market feedback that sharpens our product and GTM strategy
* Represent Nexalink credibly with senior product, engineering, operations, RCM, and commercial stakeholders

**What we're looking for**
* Experience as a founding AE, early-stage account executive, first sales hire, startup GTM lead, or entrepreneurial healthcare seller
* An existing, active network within digital health or health-tech companies—not simply healthcare provider organizations
* Experience selling enterprise B2B software, APIs, developer platforms, AI products, RCM technology, or healthcare workflow solutions
* Comfort selling an evolving product and translating customer conversations into ICP, product, and messaging improvements
* Strong consultative discovery, outbound prospecting, relationship-building, and deal-advancement skills
* Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-moving startup environment
* Familiarity with medical coding, prior authorization, revenue-cycle management, health-plan technology, or provider operations is strongly preferred

**Compensation**

**This is a fractional, commission-forward contractor engagement—not a conventional full-time salaried AE role. The $60,000–$70,000 salary range shown in the Wellfound compensation fields reflects an estimated annualized compensation equivalent for platform purposes; it is not a guaranteed base salary. Actual compensation is earned through the commission structure below and will depend on closed business.**

* **12–15% commission** on annual contract value for qualified opportunities you originate that convert from a paid pilot into an annual customer agreement
* **Equity participation up to 1%**, based on experience, demonstrated contribution, expected scope, and long-term involvement
* Flexible initial commitment of approximately **5–15 hours per week**, with an opportunity to expand scope as Nexalink establishes a repeatable GTM motion

Candidates must be able to work with Nexalink without violating any obligations to a current employer, client, or portfolio company. We cannot engage individuals with a direct conflict involving a competing healthcare AI infrastructure, RCM automation, coding, or prior-authorization product.

We are transparent about the stage: we are looking for people motivated by ownership, direct impact, and the chance to build an enduring healthcare AI infrastructure company—not candidates seeking a conventional, fully salaried enterprise-sales environment.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
HOW TO APPLY: do not apply on this site, including Wellfound's own Apply button. We will not see it. Apply at https://jotpsych.com/careers-customer-support?utm_source=support-wellfound (a phone voicemail and a short form, on purpose).

JotPsych makes software for behavioral health clinicians. Our scribe has drafted more than 3.1 million patient notes and reduces administrative time by about 90%. We're now expanding from the note into the full revenue cycle: billing, audit, prior-auth.

The fastest way for a clinician to get value out of JotPsych is for a thoughtful human to walk them through it. That's this role.

**THE ROLE**

You're the frontline of customer outcomes. Your job is to take short blocks of time, mornings, evenings, the hour between meetings, and turn them into real progress for clinicians: faster time-to-value, higher adoption, longer retention.

We see customer support, customer success, and sales as deeply interdependent functions. The right person in this seat grows into a Customer Success or Sales role as the company grows.

**WHAT YOU'D OWN**

* Welcome new providers and walk them through setup, one 15 to 30 minute call at a time
* Run async follow-ups (short emails, Loom snippets) to get providers to their first win quickly
* Triage incoming questions: bug vs. user education vs. workflow gap, and hand engineering tickets clean context
* Share workflow tips that save time (templates, shortcuts, smarter habits) and reduce avoidable churn
* Surface recurring patterns to product and engineering so the same issue doesn't show up next month

**WHO YOU PROBABLY ARE**

* 2 to 4 years of customer support, success, or sales experience. You've handled hard customer conversations before and you're calmer for it.
* Empathetic listener, confident communicator. You can build rapport in a 15 minute call and you can write a clean follow-up email.
* High ownership. You do what it takes to unblock customers. You don't punt to "let me check with the team" when you can solve it yourself.
* Comfortable with the basics. CRMs like HubSpot or Salesforce, Google Workspace, async video tools. You don't need a runbook for every tool you touch.
* Curious about healthcare. Interest in behavioral health is a plus, not a requirement.

**WHO YOU'RE PROBABLY NOT**

* Someone who needs a fixed 9-to-5 with predictable rhythms. The schedule is yours to set.
* Someone who treats support tickets as a queue to clear, not customers to keep.
* Someone who needs an answer in a runbook before they pick up the phone.

**LOGISTICS**

* United States only. New York City preferred: if you live in New York City, you work from our Brooklyn Navy Yard office. If you live elsewhere in the United States, you work remote. You set your hours.
* Part-time (as little as 10 hours/week) up to full-time (40 hours/week).
* $25/hour cash base, with on-target earnings of $40 to $50/hour.
* We measure outcomes, not clock time.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on the job page: https://jotpsych.com/careers-customer-support?utm_source=support-wellfound

Two steps, both on that page: a phone voicemail and a short form. No resume. The voicemail is your audition.

From there: a 15 minute phone call, a software walkthrough where you demo JotPsych yourself, a pitch challenge where you cold-call a member of our team to pitch a product (not JotPsych), and three professional references. We move quickly and we tell you where you stand at every step.

title: Content Creator (Shopping App)
description:
**About Scout**
Scout is a shopping app that makes online shopping social, personal, and fun. You talk to it like you'd talk to a friend with great taste. It learns what you like, finds things you'd never have found on your own, helps you put together looks, and sells the stuff in your closet you're done with. And it's built to be shared: your friends can shop your taste, you can shop theirs, and gifting finally gets easy.

We're a small team in New York. The founders, Ethan Arpi and Swati Vauthrin, previously ran the shopping and Reels teams at Instagram. We're early, we're moving fast, and we're building toward the holiday season. This is the moment where Scout has to become something people talk about, and you'd be the person making that happen.

**The role**
You will be the face and voice of Scout across all of our major channels: TikTok and Instagram Reels first, and wherever else our audience turns out to be, whether that's YouTube, Discord, or something that doesn't exist yet. You'll post on Scout's accounts, and you'll help define what Scout looks and sounds like to the world. This is not a "manage the calendar" job. You're on camera, you're shipping video all the time, and you're working directly with the founders.

**What you'll do**
* Concept, shoot, edit, and post short-form video on both Scout's accounts
* Build recurring formats around what Scout does best: taste, trends, hauls, closet flips, gifting, niche obsessions, and finding the thing nobody else can find
* Try the app constantly and turn what you find into content, then feed what you learn back to the product team
* Bring other people into the frame: collabs with tastemakers and creators, features on people with their own obsessions, man-on-the-street interviews, and whatever else gets Scout in front of new audiences
* Watch the numbers, figure out what's working, and double down fast
* Show up with your own ideas about hooks, formats, and platform best practices, and stay open to feedback
* Help with IRL shoots and activations around the city as we plan them

**Who you are**
* You love to shop and you have strong opinions about it
* You get obsessed with things: trends, niche hobbies, a specific pair of shoes, a category nobody else cares about yet
* You love being on camera and you're comfortable being the face of a brand
* You know Gen Z shopping culture cold, whether because you live it or because you've built an audience in it.
* You're social. You'd rather stop a stranger on the street or DM a creator you admire than shoot alone in your apartment, and you see other people's taste as material, not competition
* You have real taste and style, and you're not a perfectionist about it. Volume and speed beat polish
* You can turn out a lot of content very quickly and you'd rather post than overthink
* You already use TikTok and Reels as a creator, not just a viewer, and you'll share your accounts with us
* You're fluent in CapCut, Edits, or similar, and you're curious about AI tools like Claude and Higgsfield to move faster
* You're a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, early-stage environment where the plan changes weekly
* Ideally you live in NYC, but we can be flexible for the right person
*

I’m looking for an independent business development professional who can help introduce PolicyFlo to agency owners and operational leaders, generate qualified conversations, and close business where there is a strong fit.

This is not a traditional high-volume sales role with a rigid script.

The right person will be comfortable having real conversations with agency owners, understanding how they currently handle renewals and service operations, identifying whether PolicyFlo solves a meaningful problem, and providing honest market feedback.

**What You’ll Do**
* Prospect independent insurance agencies
* Contact agency owners, principals, and operations/service leaders by phone, email, and LinkedIn
* Introduce PolicyFlo and determine whether there is a meaningful fit
* Conduct short discovery conversations
* Schedule and/or conduct product demonstrations
* Follow up with interested prospects
* Close new agency accounts when appropriate
* Track outreach, objections, feedback, and outcomes
* Share recurring themes from agency conversations so we can continue improving the product

**What I’m Looking For**
Experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred:

* B2B SaaS sales
* Insurance or insurtech sales
* Independent insurance agency operations
* Agency management systems, CRM, or insurance software
* SMB owner-led sales
* Fractional SDR / AE / business development work

**You should be comfortable:**

* Making outbound calls
* Speaking directly with business owners
* Working independently
* Selling an early-stage product
* Asking discovery questions rather than relying only on a canned pitch
* Giving candid feedback about what prospects are saying

**Compensation**

This is a 1099 independent contractor, commission-only opportunity. There is no base salary, hourly pay, guaranteed income, or equity.

Compensation is structured as follows:

* 30% of first-year collected subscription revenue for new agency accounts you source and close
* 25% of first-year collected subscription revenue for prospects provided from PolicyFlo’s existing outreach list
* Commission is paid monthly as customer payments are actually received
* Commission continues for the customer’s first 12 months

PolicyFlo’s current subscription plans range from $297 to $997 per month.

PolicyFlo was created from hands-on experience running operations inside an independent insurance agency.

The goal is simple: build tools that solve real operational problems for agencies rather than add another system they have to manage.

Please send:

* A brief summary of your sales background

title: Sales Executive Representative — Americas
description:
Remote | Enterprise AI SaaS | US Focus

Procurement is one of the most complex, painful, and underserved functions in enterprise business.

  - Direct work with experienced enterprise sales leaders — and a clear growth path toward AE.
  - Remote-first role with the freedom to own your results.
  - A stage where your work visibly moves the company: every meeting you book matters.

title: Climate Impact Research Analyst Intern (Winter/Spring 2027)
description:
**Boundless Impact Research & Analytics** is looking for interns to support the research team by conducting in-depth research for climate impact assessments of emerging clean technologies and industries. This is an opportunity to learn about our unique approach to climate impact analysis and gain exposure to some of the most exciting new technologies, including but not limited to Energy, Transportation, Food & Ag, New Materials, Waste to Value, and Water.  

Research Interns can work remotely, flexibly, between 10 and 20 hours per week, receiving direction and guidance from a Senior Research Analyst. This is an unpaid internship, running from January 2027 through April 2027.

**Who We Are**
Boundless Impact Research & Analytics provides precise environmental impact data for clean-tech companies, sustainable brands, and investors. Our analytics validate and differentiate sustainable products, reduce investment risk, and support credible reporting. Boundless blends science-based impact analysis, industry-specific benchmarks, and AI-driven data to deliver the insights companies need to prove their impact and thrive in the market. We achieve this through a science-based, data-driven approach, grounded in the proven methodology of Life Cycle Assessment. The scores and metrics derived are trustworthy and reliable because they are unbiased and validated by external industry and/or scientific experts. Boundless has the capabilities to perform rapid (and screening) LCA, LCA consistent with ISO 14040, and Scope 1,2,3 inventories. 

Boundless has completed assessments of dozens of cleantech products and projects, alongside competing technologies, ranging from renewable energy (geothermal, pv), circular economy (eg plastic recycling), HVAC and disinfection technologies, bioenergy and bioproducts, and innovative water and wastewater technologies. The resulting company reports frequently influenced investor decisions.

**Responsibilities**
* Assist with researching, developing, and maintaining a repository of environmental and financial impact metrics.
* Perform detailed literature research, using various information and data sources, to characterize the environmental impact of specific technology areas.
* Support Boundless documentation through PowerPoint presentations and technical reports.
* Development of climate impact scores for various industries.

**Qualifications**
* Current undergraduate or graduate with a science or engineering background, and an interest in research, impact measurement and sustainability.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills.
* Able to diligently review several types of data sources and select appropriate information from them.
* Competence in modeling and analysis in Excel.
* Attention to detail and transparency (e.g., documenting assumptions and references)
* Strong intuition for the functional unit for various technology areas (e.g.,liters of potable water, lumens of light).
* Ability to be an effective member of project teams.
* Positive attitude, entrepreneurial spirit, proactivity, and strong attention to detail.

**Culture**
* Small, growing and collaborative team, lots of cross-role interaction
* Mission driven company and profitable product
* Flexible Hours

title: Video Editor Intern
description:
# Video Editor Intern

**Kangaroo Agency** - A part of Quinite Group

**Location:** Remote, India
**Preferred:** Candidates based in or around Vapi, Gujarat
**Duration:** 6 Months
**Type:** Paid Internship
**Working Days:** 6 days/week
**Work Style:** Flexible, task & deadline-based

---

## About Kangaroo Agency

Kangaroo Agency is a creative agency working with brands and businesses across different industries. As part of the **Quinite Group**, we work on social media, digital marketing, branding and creative content for our clients.

We are looking for a **Video Editor Intern** who understands that good editing is more than just putting clips together. We want someone with a good eye for **design, composition, typography, visual balance, transitions, motion and overall aesthetics**.

You will work on actual client projects as well as internal creative projects, giving you hands-on experience in a real agency environment.

---

## What You'll Work On

Your primary work will involve creating short-form video content, especially:

* Instagram Reels and social media videos
* Real estate content and property reels
* School and education-related content for clients
* Promotional and advertising reels
* Internal product explainers
* Creative concepts and performance-oriented ad videos
* Short-form content with motion graphics and visual effects

### Typical Workload

* **Daily:** 1 basic/standard video edit
* **Weekly:** 1 higher-level edit involving motion graphics, stronger visual storytelling and advanced editing

The exact workload may vary depending on client requirements and project timelines.

---

## What We're Looking For

### Must Have

* Good working knowledge of **CapCut or Adobe Premiere Pro**
* Understanding of video editing fundamentals
* Strong understanding of **design principles**
* Good sense of **visual aesthetics, art and composition**
* Good understanding of typography, spacing, alignment and visual hierarchy
* Ability to create clean and engaging **text animations**
* Good understanding of transitions and when to use them effectively
* Ability to edit content specifically for short-form platforms such as Instagram
* A **decent portfolio** of work, whether personal projects, freelance work or client projects
* Ability to understand a brief and turn it into a visually appealing video
* Own laptop/PC suitable for video editing
* Ability to work independently and deliver tasks within deadlines

### Good to Have

* Experience with **Adobe After Effects**
* Motion graphics experience
* Experience creating ads or performance-oriented content
* Experience working with brands or agencies
* Understanding of social media trends and short-form content
* Basic understanding of sound design, SFX and music selection
* Experience with real estate, education or other commercial content

---

## What We Value

We care about **taste** as much as technical skills.

You don't need to know every editing technique or have years of experience. But you should be able to look at a video and understand what makes it feel **premium, clean, modern and engaging**.

We're looking for someone who:

* Notices small visual details
* Understands what looks good and what doesn't
* Doesn't overuse transitions and effects just because they are available
* Understands that simplicity can be more effective
* Has a strong visual and creative sense
* Is willing to experiment and improve
* Can take feedback positively
* Is curious about design, editing and visual storytelling

---

## Software

**Required:**
CapCut / Adobe Premiere Pro

**Preferred:**
Adobe After Effects

**Note:** Required software will be provided by the company. Candidates must have their own suitable laptop/PC.

---

## What You'll Get

This is not a purely training-based internship. You will get the opportunity to work on **real projects and real client requirements**.

During the internship, you will:

* Work on actual client content
* Build experience across different industries
* Learn how agency workflows and deadlines work
* Develop your short-form editing skills
* Work with creative briefs and feedback
* Improve your motion graphics and visual storytelling
* Build a stronger professional portfolio
* Receive guidance and feedback from the creative team

On successful completion of the internship, you will receive:

* **Internship Certificate**
* **Letter of Recommendation (LoR)**
* **Potential Full-Time Opportunity** based on performance

---

## Who Can Apply?

This internship is suitable for:

* Video editing students
* Recent graduates
* Self-taught video editors
* Freelance editors looking to gain agency experience
* Creators who want to work on commercial content
* Candidates with some prior editing experience who want to develop professionally

**Freshers can apply if they have a good portfolio and demonstrate strong creative ability.**

---

## How to Apply

If you think you have the editing skills and creative eye we're looking for, we'd love to see your work.

**Portfolio is important.** Please share your best work, whether it is personal, freelance or client work.

**Location:** Remote, India
**Preferred:** Vapi, Gujarat and nearby locations

description:
# Freelance B2B Sales Executive – WealthTech

**Independent Contractor | Commission-Only | Remote | Germany**

Q72 Capital develops portfolio optimization and validation technology for professional investment decision-makers.

Our platform enables wealth managers, independent asset managers, family offices and other investment professionals to compare different portfolio-construction methodologies under identical mandates and validate their robustness using historical and out-of-sample analysis.

We are looking for an experienced B2B sales professional to acquire and close paying clients in the professional investment industry.

## What you will do

* Identify suitable wealth managers, family offices, EAMs, asset managers and other professional investment firms
* Establish contact with CIOs, Heads of Investment, Portfolio Managers, Managing Partners and other senior decision-makers
* Conduct qualification calls and product demonstrations
* Understand each firm’s current portfolio-construction and validation workflow
* Position Q72 within that workflow
* Manage objections, commercial negotiations and follow-ups
* Move qualified opportunities through the complete sales cycle
* Close and hand over paying client accounts

This is a full-cycle sales role. It is not an SDR position and is not focused on measuring activity through emails sent, calls made or meetings booked.

## What we are looking for

You should have relevant experience selling software, data, analytics or investment-related solutions to professional financial institutions.

Relevant client experience may include:

* Wealth managers
* Independent Asset Managers and EAMs
* Family offices
* Asset managers
* Investment consultants
* RIAs
* OCIOs
* Private banks

Experience in WealthTech, institutional FinTech, portfolio analytics, risk software or asset-management technology is particularly relevant.

An existing professional network within one or more of these segments is a strong advantage.

## What success looks like

Success is measured through:

* Qualified commercial opportunities
* Progress with relevant decision-makers
* Completed product evaluations
* Signed and paid client contracts

We are looking for someone capable of selling a sophisticated financial product through credible commercial conversations—not generic, high-volume SaaS scripts.

## Contract and compensation

This is a **paid, self-employed independent-contractor engagement**.

Compensation is **commission-only**. There is no base salary, guaranteed minimum compensation or employment relationship.

Commission is earned on eligible client contracts personally originated and successfully closed, subject to the agreed written commission terms. The commercial terms, attribution rules and payment schedule will be provided before the engagement begins.

Applicants must be legally entitled to provide independent professional services and are responsible for their own applicable taxes, insurance and statutory obligations.

No application fee, investment, product purchase, capital contribution or recruitment of additional sales partners is required.

## About Q72 Capital

Q72 is an independent portfolio optimization and validation platform.

Instead of producing one black-box portfolio recommendation, Q72 enables investment professionals to compare multiple portfolio-construction approaches under the same mandate, universe and constraints and evaluate their robustness through historical and out-of-sample validation.

The final investment decision remains with the investment professional.

## How to apply

Please include:

* Your relevant institutional or financial-services sales experience
* The markets and client segments you know best
* Examples of financial technology, investment or analytics products you have sold
* The regions in which you currently have an active professional network

title: Brand & Web Designer
description:
Fireflies.ai is the leading AI teammate for meetings, trusted by more than 20 million users across over 500,000 organizations, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Fireflies captures knowledge, automates repetitive work, and helps teams become more productive before, during, and after every meeting.

Fireflies has achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion. In 2024, Ramp recognized Fireflies as the sixth most popular AI platform by number of paying customers, alongside companies including OpenAI, Midjourney, and Anthropic. There is a good chance you have already seen Fireflies quietly powering one of your recent meetings.

The first job is the brand itself. We have a visual system today, but we want someone to take a position on it: what Fireflies should look and feel like, what makes it recognizable, and what holds together across everything we put out. The website is where that lands first and hardest. New pages, launch moments, and the product imagery that carries them. From there it extends to social, ads, email, video, and campaigns.

Our product is mostly words on a screen, made up of transcripts, summaries, and notes. Turning that into something people want to look at is the heart of this job. This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership. You'll work closely with marketing, product design, and engineering.

**Brand & Design at Fireflies:**
* Character: Fred is the Fireflies mascot and the face of our product. He sits at the heart of the brand, and for many people, he'll be their first introduction to Fireflies. We're looking for people who can build a world around a character and keep it feeling cohesive as the product grows.
* Warmth: We want Fireflies to feel human and approachable, closer to a notebook than traditional enterprise software. Plenty of generic AI products are out there, and we have an opportunity to build something that feels distinctly ours.
* Recognition: Ideally, people should be able to recognize a Fireflies illustration even without seeing the logo. That recognition comes from having a clear point of view and carrying it consistently across everything we make.
* Craft: We care about the details: color, type, spacing, composition, and the quality of every asset. We care about both how something looks and how well it works. Anything that ships with the Fireflies name on it should feel intentional and considered.
* Persuasion: A page can look beautiful, but if it doesn't help people understand the product or take action, there's more work to do. We value strong marketing instinct and curiosity about what happens after something goes live. Copy is part of the design here too, so being able to shape a headline or rethink messaging is just as valuable as getting the visual design right.
* One system, many products: Meetings, email, Slack, Talk, CRM, tasks, knowledge, and more. Each product can have its own personality while still feeling like part of the same creative system. The connection between the brand and the product should feel natural and obvious.
* Shipping: We move quickly, and we like to ship. The best work is ultimately experienced in the real world, not just in Figma. We work toward real launch dates, learn from what goes live, and keep improving.
* Opinions: Bring references, ideas, and a point of view. Good ideas can come from anywhere, and we value thoughtful debate. We'd rather explore different perspectives and arrive at something better together than agree for the sake of it.

* **What You'll Work On:**
* Brand ownership: Evolve the visual system and the templates that let the team move without you.
* Website and landing pages: Design and ship new pages, from the hero visual through to how they hold up live.
* Launch campaigns: Carry one concept across the launch page, announcement, social, and video.
* Social media assets: Design product-first posts that make the value or outcome land fast.
* Digital ads: Design creative ads for Meta, Google, and LinkedIn that stop the scroll.
* Storyboards: Build the visuals and scenes behind launch and explainer videos.
* Marketing materials: Design event slides, in-app banners, and posters that hold the brand.

**What We're Looking For:**
* 3+ years of brand, web, or visual design experience.
* A brand or identity system you defined yourself.
* A portfolio with live links, showing marketing pages or sites you designed and shipped.
* Strong command of typography, layout, composition, and color, with visual ideas that are clearly your own.
* Proven ability to make software look good. Show us work where you created the product imagery.
* Solid grasp of UI principles like visual hierarchy, spacing, and alignment, since much of this work involves product UI.
* Understanding of how a page behaves, not just how it looks in a frame, including responsive judgment and section rhythm.
* Range across illustration, dimensional and 3D treatments, and motion, reached for when the idea calls for it.
* Systems thinking, so a treatment repeats cleanly and launches don't require rebuilding everything from scratch.
* Marketing mindset. You want visuals that drive clicks, engagement, and conversions, and you're comfortable seeing how the work performed.
* Comfort working quickly across several projects with real launch dates.

**Values that are important to us:**
* You should be a great communicator and culture maintainer
* Take a look at our culture document
* You're data-driven and customer-focused
* You value fast & incremental engineering cycles
* You maintain design excellence and minimize complexity
* You measure your results & automate when possible
* You get 10% better at something every week
* You have an internal compass and take accountability & initiative
* We value overcommunication, candid feedback and a results-driven culture

**Perks & Benefits:**
* Competitive compensation
* Work remotely anywhere in your respective country
* Ability to move laterally within a team and grow rapidly
* Paid time off and flexible leave policy
* No boss culture
* Flexible working hours
* LGBTQ+ friendly
* Company offsites
* Tech reimbursements

**About Fireflies.ai:**

At Fireflies.ai, we are changing how teams use AI in their daily work. Our culture champions security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19 million from investors including Canaan and Khosla Ventures, plus angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is driven by a global team of more than 100 people across over 20 countries and every time zone. We are building a world-class, global-first company, and we use our own product to do it.

Fireflies.ai is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly value diversity because our team is stronger with different perspectives and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Front-end product designer/engineer
description:

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
# 

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**
 

Procurify is the leading agentic procurement platform for the mid-market, helping organizations take control of their spend and make smarter financial decisions.

 

We’re building an ambitious, high-performance company where talented people are trusted with meaningful ownership and given the opportunity to make a real impact. Our remote-first culture values accountability, resilience, collaboration, and continuous growth. You’ll work alongside driven teammates on complex, important problems, grow your career through meaningful challenges, and help shape an AI-native company at a defining moment in the evolution of agentic procurement. We’re seeking a talented and collaborative **Senior Product Manager** to join us in building innovative, customer-centric solutions that drive meaningful outcomes.

 

As a **Senior Product Manager** at Procurify, you will play a key role in defining and delivering high-impact solutions within one of our core product areas. You will work in a fast-paced, AI-Native product and engineering environment. You will partner closely with your triad of engineering and design, and collaborate across the triple diamond to move quickly from concept to delivery.

 

We are looking for someone who is driven to solve important problems for customers and motivated by the opportunity to create real impact. You thrive in a collaborative environment and see cross-functional partnership as essential to building great products. You will work closely with teams across the company to ensure we are solving the right problems with purpose and clarity.

### 

### **WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Focus on outcomes, not just features**

- You will be responsible for driving meaningful business and customer results. Your work will align with strategic priorities and guide your team to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.

**Building great strategy through domain expertise**

- You will be responsible for strategic direction and effective decision-making in your product domains. This will be achieved through your depth of knowledge in your domain and through facilitation with experts within the company.

**Act as a strong customer advocate**

- You will represent the voice of the customer through deep curiosity, insight, and empathy. You will champion their needs and ensure that every solution improves their experience and drives value.

**Work fast in an AI-Native environment**

- You will operate within a modern product development process that uses rapid prototyping, fast experimentation, and AI tools. You will help identify how AI can unlock better solutions, faster.

**Collaborate across the company**

- You will work closely within your product triad and partner across every part of the business. You will build alignment, share context, and ensure that product decisions are grounded in both customer insight and cross-functional collaboration.

**Lead with clarity and purpose**

- You will approach product challenges with a strong sense of ownership and focus. You will drive decisions that balance customer needs, technical realities, and business goals, always aiming to deliver exceptional results.

**Contribute to product direction**

- You will help shape the product strategy and inform roadmap decisions in your area, you will be responsible for delivering results aligned with its goals.
 
### **WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

- 5+ years of product management experience in SaaS, fintech, or related industries.
- Proven product ownership experience within the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle. You must have deep expertise in at least one core domain:

  - Procurement (eg, purchase requisitions, PO management, supplier onboarding, sourcing)
  - Accounts Payable (eg, invoice data capture, approval workflows, payment execution)
- Proven ability to deliver high-impact business and customer outcomes in fast-moving environments
- Experience working in empowered, cross-functional triads with engineering and design
- Familiarity with AI-Native development practices and rapid experimentation
- Strong communication skills and a highly collaborative mindset
- Analytical thinker with a focus on solving the right problems
- Clear sense of domain ownership and ability to align work to strategic goals
- Passion for building meaningful products as part of a high-performing team
- Excellent project management skills to effectively run discovery, design, and development of initiatives in parallel.
- For customer-facing roles, maintains an up-to-date LinkedIn profile and ensures it is refreshed upon joining, to reflect their role at Procurify and help maintain a consistent, professional presence across our GTM team.

### 

### **WHY PROCURIFY?**

### **Help us modernize spend management**

Procurify is a remote-first company with a big heart and a strong ambition to modernize the way organizations manage business spend. We’re trusted by hundreds of companies around the world — across industries like biotechnology, education, health care, manufacturing, and software — to manage over $30B in spend. We recently closed $50M in Series C funding to help us strengthen our core offering, launch new payment capabilities, and provide customers with an AI-enhanced procure-to-pay experience. Read the press release [_here_](https://www.procurify.com/press_release/procurify-raises-50m-series-c/).

### **Be empowered to do your best work**

We’ve created an environment where personal and professional growth is a real priority. Some of the great perks we offer include:

- Flexible working: We’re a remote-first organization with flexible working hours. Work anywhere from within Canada!
- Unlimited responsible time off: Work hard, play harder. All team members can take advantage of our unlimited responsible time off policy.
- Extended health benefits: We prioritize our team’s health and well-being. We offer a competitive health, vision, and dental package along with an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a health and wellness spending account.
- Community initiatives: We have a strong commitment to giving back to our communities, including regular volunteer days, our Donate Your Day program, and education lunch and learns.
- Stock options: Everyone has a chance to own a part of Procurify with our competitive stock program.
- DEI initiatives: We regularly run a diversity, equity, and inclusion roundtable where we host guest speakers and tackle the topics that matter.
- **Base Salary Range:** $145,000-$160,000 CAD (This range is dependent on experience and not inclusive of any bonus, commission, benefits or equity that might exist in your total compensation package).

### 

### **Work with an amazing team**

We’ve welcomed team members who were boat captains, funeral directors, swing dancers, competitive gamers, plumbers, and novelists. Everyone has a story and we’re here to embrace them!

 

## **LEARN MORE**

Procurify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against any team members or applicants for employment because of race, color, disability, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity and/or expression.

If you feel like you don’t meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that feelings of imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting incredible candidates, and we certainly don’t want those feelings to get in the way of meeting you! We really want to get to know you and why you're great for the role. Please avoid including your picture and age on your resume.

 

Apply online today and let’s start a conversation.

To learn more about Procurify, check out these resources:

- Get to know our team through our[_Meet Us Monday videos_](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLaADg-JHT1trtbIv6MH6rhv2wJq_ihJ_B)
- Check out [_what our customers are saying about us_](https://www.procurify.com/testimonials)
- Learn more about our [_procure-to-pay platform_](https://www.procurify.com/product/)
