**ABOUT THE JOB**

Swovo is looking for a Senior Growth Marketer with deep, hands-on expertise in organic search and paid acquisition. Organic search has historically been our strongest acquisition channel, and we are looking for someone who can take direct ownership of rebuilding and growing that engine while also developing paid marketing into a reliable source of qualified pipeline.
This is not a role for a broad marketing generalist or someone whose SEO and paid media experience has primarily been managed through agencies. We need someone who has personally executed SEO and paid search strategies, understands the mechanics behind both channels, and can diagnose problems, identify opportunities, launch initiatives, measure results, and continuously improve performance.

Success in this role will be measured by qualified leads, pipeline, customer acquisition cost, and revenue—not traffic, rankings, clicks, or lead volume alone. You will own search-led customer acquisition across Swovo's business lines, including technical SEO, content and keyword strategy, authority building, Google Ads, landing-page optimization, conversion tracking, and experimentation.
We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You should be comfortable digging through Google Search Console to understand why organic performance changed, restructuring a Google Ads campaign yourself, evaluating landing-page conversion rates, working with developers on technical SEO improvements, directing writers and subject-matter experts, and reallocating budget based on what is actually producing qualified opportunities.
This is a full-time, 40-hour/week remote role. Candidates must be based in Latin America and available to work during U.S. business hours.

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Swovo is a cutting-edge software development consultancy with a presence in both the U.S. and Latin America. We partner with clients ranging from early-stage startups to Fortune 100 companies to design and build cutting-edge solutions for healthcare as well as other industries. Our mission goes beyond software development—we aim to create products that deliver measurable improvements in business performance as well as people’s lives.

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**

The success of this role will be measured by the volume, quality, and cost of qualified opportunities generated across Swovo’s business lines. You will own our primary acquisition channels—organic search and paid marketing—and be expected to turn business goals into measurable growth initiatives.

**Own SEO Strategy & Execution:** Take full ownership of SEO across Swovo’s business lines, including technical SEO, keyword and search-intent research, content optimization, internal linking, backlink acquisition, and organic conversion strategy. Diagnose performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush/Ahrefs, crawling tools, and other relevant platforms, then translate findings into prioritized actions and personally execute or manage implementation. Success will be measured by qualified organic leads and pipeline—not traffic or rankings alone.

**Rebuild & Grow Organic Search:** Audit our existing websites and content portfolios, identify the causes of traffic and lead declines, and determine which pages should be improved, consolidated, redirected, expanded, or removed. Build a sustainable organic growth strategy that improves visibility across both traditional and AI-assisted search.

**Own Paid Acquisition:** Personally manage and optimize paid acquisition campaigns, with a primary focus on Google Ads. Own campaign structure, keyword strategy, match types, negative keywords, bidding strategy, audience targeting, budget allocation, conversion tracking, landing-page performance, and ongoing experimentation. Evaluate other paid channels where they make sense for the business.

**Improve Lead Quality & Conversion:** Work beyond traffic and clicks to improve the quality of leads generated through both paid and organic channels. Analyze conversion rates, landing-page performance, lead quality, SQL rates, pipeline contribution, and customer acquisition costs, then identify and execute improvements throughout the funnel.

**Build Organic Authority:** Own Swovo’s backlink and authority-building strategy through digital PR, partnerships, expert contributions, original research, targeted outreach, and other high-quality link acquisition strategies. Evaluate and manage outside SEO or link-building partners when appropriate.

**Own Search-Led Content Strategy:** Develop content strategies based on buyer intent, organic opportunity, competitive research, and qualified-pipeline potential. Work with Swovo subject-matter experts, writers, designers, freelancers, and partners to produce differentiated content grounded in real expertise rather than high-volume generic content.

**Drive Growth Across Multiple Business Lines:** Develop and adapt acquisition strategies across Swovo’s software consultancy, Swovo Fuse, and future business lines. Understand that each business may require a different mix of SEO, paid acquisition, content, and conversion strategy, and allocate effort based on where the greatest opportunities exist.

**Measure, Analyze & Optimize Performance:** Build clear reporting around qualified leads, SQLs, pipeline, conversion rates, CPL, CAC, and revenue attribution. Continuously evaluate performance, scale what is working, stop what is not, and communicate clearly about where marketing investment is producing business results.

**Support Additional Growth Initiatives:** Help test and scale other acquisition opportunities—such as referral programs, partnerships, retargeting, email, and paid social—when they support the broader growth strategy. These channels are secondary to your core responsibility for organic search and paid acquisition.

**ABOUT YOU**

-You live in Latin America.
-The ideal candidate has experience driving growth of enterprise customers in service businesses.
-Personally owned SEO strategy and execution for a B2B organization.
-Demonstrable experience diagnosing material organic traffic declines.
-Strong technical SEO, content-quality, keyword-strategy, internal-linking, and authority-building experience.
-Ability to present examples with measurable qualified-lead, pipeline, or revenue outcomes.
-Experience converting SEO findings into implementation requirements for designers, developers, and writers.
-Ideally you have experience building and engaging with communities and running events.
-You have excellent English written and verbal communication.
-You have 7+ years of experience in growth marketing, customer acquisition, or digital marketing.
-You have a proven track record of scaling marketing campaigns that drive measurable business growth.
-You are comfortable managing referral programs, digital ad campaigns, and data analytics.
-You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about driving growth for innovative software solutions.

For more information, visit https://swovo.com

title: Associate Member of Technical Staff, Infrastructure
description:
**About the role** 

You will keep Himaya's production footprint reliable and secure across two clouds, and you will build the CI/CD that the team currently lacks. Today deploys are scripted ACR builds pushed to Azure Container Apps by hand. Your first quarter is making that a pipeline with tests, image scanning, and staged rollout.

**What you will do**

* Own the Azure production estate: Container Apps revisions and traffic splits, ACR, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Service Bus, Key Vault, Front Door, and the Azure OpenAI deployment.
* Own the AWS estate: ECS services, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS queues with DLQs, S3, CloudFront, and the isolated EC2 detonation-sandbox VPC.
* Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions with OIDC workload identity (no long-lived secrets), running the pytest suite, tsc, and production builds as merge gates, then deploying by revision with health checks and rollback.
* Secure the microservices and codebase: scope service principals and IAM roles to least privilege, rotate and centralise secrets, harden container images, and burn down the dependency-vulnerability backlog with a repeatable process.
* Improve observability: Sentry releases and environments per service, structured JSON logging, alerting on queue depth, scan-loop failures, and revision health.

**Requirements**

* 1 to 3 years in infrastructure, DevOps, or backend work with real production responsibility.
* Hands-on with at least one major cloud (we run Azure and AWS; you will learn the other here).
* You have written a CI/CD pipeline from scratch, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, and can explain OIDC federation versus stored credentials.
* Comfortable with Docker, container registries, and debugging a failed deploy from logs alone.
* You treat IAM as a security surface: least privilege, scoped roles, no shared admin credentials.
* Nice to have: Postgres operations (backups, connection limits, lock contention), Terraform or Bicep, experience running queue-based workers, exposure to compliance regimes (SOC 2, UAE or KSA data residency).

Driftrock's product runs on a pragmatic Elixir and Phoenix LiveView stack, solving real marketing challenges for our B2B customers. As more of the world's biggest car brands come on board, we're growing our engineering team and the volume of data we process for them. Right now we're building lead qualification across communication channels and bringing it together in our Single Customer View, while optimising our event-driven architecture for growing workloads.

You'll join a small, high-discipline squad, ship to production from your first weeks, and take on more scope and independence as you go, with real room to grow your craft and your career with us. ### What you'll own

You'll own the delivery of features within your squad, shipping well-tested, production-ready Elixir that moves our product and our customers' results forward, and growing your scope and independence as you go.

### Your first 90 days

- **By day 30:** you've found your feet in our codebase and domain, paired with the team, and shipped your first small changes to production.
- **By day 60:** you're picking up features independently, writing well-tested code and taking an active part in technical and product discussions.
- **By day 90:** you're a productive, trusted member of your squad, shipping regularly and starting to shape how we approach problems.

### What you'll be doing

- **Build and ship product features** in Elixir and Phoenix LiveView, from idea through to production, several times a week.
- **Write well-tested, maintainable code** using test-driven development, and take part in pairing and code reviews to keep quality high.
- **Help shape the how and the why**, bringing your own viewpoint to technical and product discussions and to our roadmap.
- **Work across our event-driven architecture**, building services that talk over APIs and RabbitMQ and handling a growing volume of customer data reliably.
- **Use data and observability** to understand how your changes behave in production and whether they're delivering value for customers.
- **Grow your craft**, learning from a team that cares about how it works, with a clear path toward senior over time.

### What you'll bring

- A solid foundation in computer science fundamentals, whether from a CS degree or equivalent demonstrable grounding in data structures, algorithms, complexity and how systems work under the hood.
- Some professional backend experience, ideally with Elixir or a similar language, and a genuine drive to deepen your Elixir skills.
- Some experience with web development, ideally server-rendered UI (we use LiveView with TailwindCSS).
- A habit of writing tested, maintainable code, and an interest in practices such as continuous delivery, TDD, pairing, code review and retrospectives.
- A data-driven mindset: you care whether the work genuinely helps customers, not just whether it ships.
- The judgement to use AI tools well: you use them to go faster, and your CS grounding means you can evaluate what they produce and steer away from suboptimal solutions rather than taking the output on faith.
- A desire to keep learning and growing, and to collaborate closely in a small team.

**Bonus points**

- Production experience with Elixir, Erlang/OTP, Phoenix or LiveView.
- A background in Ruby or another functional language.
- Experience with event-driven systems, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL or Redis.
- Exposure to Kubernetes or Google Cloud.

*Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway.*

### Why Driftrock

Driftrock's mission is to become the world-leading automotive and e-mobility marketing software platform, and help accelerate the transition to clean transport.

We work with some of the world's biggest brands, including BMW, BYD, Mercedes-Benz and Volvo, and partner with the world's leading platforms, including Meta, Google, [mobile.de](http://mobile.de) and Auto Trader.

We've been building since 2013, and our work enables billions of euros in vehicle sales every year.

We're a close, fully remote team of 35 people across engineering, design, customer success, performance and commercial, spread across the world.

That means your work has a real, visible impact on our product, our culture and how we operate.

We're at the cutting edge of marketing technology, with plenty of room to unlock value from data and to help speed up the shift to electric vehicles.

How we work is shaped by four values:

- **We care:** about our team, our customers, and the people who see the marketing messages that we power. Work isn't done until we can prove it's useful to both the consumer and the customer.
- **Be that person:** if something needs fixing, fix it. It's never someone else's problem.
- **People-first:** we put people at the core of everything, and never compromise security or privacy for results.
- **Be better today than you were yesterday:** we bake learning and continuous improvement into everything we do, for ourselves and our customers.

In practice, this looks like weekly Monday Showcases where we share what we're learning, regular retros, a budget to attend the courses and conferences that grow you, Donut coffee pairings to stay connected, and an annual company Summit that brings the whole global team together in person.

### What's in it for you

We're remote-first and flexible about how and where you work, with co-working space available if you want it. Alongside your salary:

- **Share options** in Driftrock, on founder-friendly, tax-efficient EMI terms, including the option to retain vested options after leaving (at board discretion).
- **Comprehensive Vitality health cover:** medical, dental, vision, hearing, mental-health support and therapy, cancer cover, a free Headspace subscription and Vitality rewards.
- **24 to 28 days' holiday** (24 + 1 extra each year, capped at 28), plus bank holidays.
- **Pension contributions, life assurance (3x salary) and income protection.**
- **Electric car salary-sacrifice scheme** (Octopus): save up to ~40%, with insurance, servicing and a charging perk included.
- **Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.**
- **A learning budget** for books, courses and conferences, plus time for personal goals.
- **Perks and discounts** via CharlieHR, and a BMW Group employee discount programme.

**International team members:**

We're remote-first and hire globally. While some UK-specific benefits are delivered differently abroad, we strive for genuine parity. Wherever you are, the standard package includes a comprehensive health plan, pension contributions, paid time off including local bank holidays, share options, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, a learning budget, and our flexible working culture. International team members are employed compliantly via an Employer of Record ([Remote.com](http://Remote.com)).

**Salary bands are location-based and may vary depending on the employee’s primary place of work.**

### Our hiring process

1. A short intro call.
2. A conversation with the hiring manager.
3. A practical task based on real challenges, never unpaid spec work.
4. A final conversation with the team.

### Inclusion at Driftrock

Driftrock is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background, identity and life experience, and we're building a team that reflects the people our marketing reaches. We don't make decisions based on age, disability, gender, gender identity, marital status, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process to do your best, just let us know, and we're glad to help.

**We will not be considering recruitment agencies for this role.**

By applying for this job you give us permission to store your data on our secure applicant tracking system and to contact you about Driftrock job opportunities. We process your data for recruitment purposes only and keep it until this role is filled, after which we will delete it or, with your agreement, keep it for similar future roles for up to 12 months. See our privacy policy at [driftrock.com/privacy-policy](http://driftrock.com/privacy-policy) for how we comply with GDPR, including how to access, correct, delete or restrict the data we hold. You can lodge a complaint with the UK supervisory authority (the Information Commissioner's Office), or contact our DPO for any concerns.

* Own client models, including three-statement operating models, financing models, and more.
* Work collaboratively with internal and client accounting teams to prepare monthly financial statements and financial reporting packages for executive review.

* Partner with colleagues across the company and on client teams to implement and integrate new processes.

Benefits include medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, as well as a 401(k) plan. Travel is minimal and includes attendance at Karlon Group’s required annual company offsite.

Karlon Group provides enterprise-grade fractional finance & accounting, data analytics, and investor relations support services to bootstrapped, venture-backed, and private equity-owned companies at various stages of growth. We bring decades of strategic and operational finance & accounting experience, partnering with businesses across a range of industries, from consumer to SaaS to business services. Our fractional CFO franchise prioritizes close partnership, excellence, and integrity above all in our approach to advising clients on their most critical finance & accounting challenges.

We are committed to actively recruiting and hiring people of all races, religions, colors, national origins, genders, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, ages, marital statuses, veteran statuses, and disability statuses. As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate what makes each of us unique and foster an inclusive environment for all. Everybody is welcome at Karlon Group.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager
description:
Upbound is building the control plane for the modern enterprise. As the company behind Crossplane, the open-source CNCF project that extends Kubernetes into an AI-native cloud control plane, Upbound enables organizations to compose, manage, and operate infrastructure and services through declarative, programmable control planes. Upbound Cloud delivers hosted, multi-tenant control planes that power platform engineering teams at scale.

The Management Plane is how customers experience all of it. It is the unified API surface, the interface they work in, the catalog they discover content through, and the systems that connect, license, and bill everything they run. As we scale into the next phase of growth, **we are hiring a Senior Manager to lead this group.**

### Areas of Ownership

- **Hub** — The Upbound Hub API, which indexes and aggregates control planes across an organization and provides unified API access, multi-tenancy, and organization context regardless of where those control planes run.
- **Console** — The primary frontend client and user experience for the entire Upbound platform, spanning single control plane views, multi-control-plane management, and organization-level operations.
- **Marketplace** — The distribution and discovery layer where users and customers find providers, functions, configurations, and extensions.
- **Middleware** — The platform services the business depends on: billing and metering, licensing and entitlements, Connect, and the identity and access plumbing that ties them together.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for growing a team, defining the architecture of the Management Plane, and ensuring these four surfaces operate as one coherent product rather than four adjacent ones.

### **In this role, you will …** 

**Management Plane Strategy**

Own the long-term technical direction for Hub, Console, Marketplace, and middleware. Ensure they present a single coherent experience to customers whether their control planes run in Upbound Cloud or in their own environment. Define the architectural direction for the Hub API, multi-tenancy, and organization-level identity and access management. Drive the reliability and performance standards these surfaces are held to.

**Middleware and Commerce**

Own the systems that turn product usage into revenue: metering, usage aggregation, billing, licensing, and entitlement enforcement. Ensure these systems are accurate, auditable, and resilient, and that they can support new packaging and pricing without a rewrite each time. Partner with Finance and Revenue on the operational side of billing correctness.

**AI-Native Access**

Ensure the Hub API is a first-class interface for autonomous agents as well as human operators, with the declarative, programmatic access agentic workflows require. Evolve the Console toward a multi-modal experience that works alongside those workflows rather than around them.

**Team Leadership**

Lead senior ICs and tech leads directly. Grow the team deliberately against the roadmap, raise the hiring bar, and develop engineers into senior and lead roles. Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, on-call ownership, and production excellence across the Management Plane surfaces.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner closely with Product, Design, GTM, Finance, and Customer Success. Translate enterprise requirements around security, multi-tenancy, packaging, and entitlements into platform capabilities. Represent the Management Plane in conversations about pricing changes, packaging, and customer-facing reliability.

### **You are a good fit if you have…**

- 7+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers directly
- Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS products at scale
- Strong API design fundamentals, including versioning, backward compatibility, and designing for third-party consumers
- Hands-on experience with at least one commerce or platform middleware domain: billing, metering, licensing, entitlements, or identity and access management
- Track record of owning production reliability for customer-facing services, including incident response and on-call culture
- Has built or intentionally restructured a team, not only inherited one
- Technically credible with senior and principal engineers while operating at the roadmap level

### **Skills / Traits**

- Leadership: Sets direction and quality standards for a group of senior engineers who need clarity more than supervision. Earns followership through judgment and technical credibility rather than title.
- People Management: Develops engineers deliberately toward their next level, runs consistent 1:1s and feedback loops, and addresses underperformance directly instead of waiting for a review cycle.
- Decision-Making: Makes calls with incomplete information on a surface where reversals are expensive. A published API, a data model, or a billing schema is hard to walk back, so the bar for thinking a decision through is higher here than in most teams.
- Communication: Translates fluently between engineering, Product, Design, Finance, and GTM. Writes clearly enough that a pricing change or an API deprecation can be understood by everyone it affects without a meeting.
- Problem-Solving: Drives to root cause on correctness problems rather than stopping at a mitigation. Comfortable reasoning about a discrepancy that only shows up in one tenant's invoice.
- Prioritization: Balances roadmap commitments against revenue-blocking middleware work, reliability debt, and customer escalations, and can explain the tradeoff to the people who lost the argument.
- Project Management: Delivers predictably across four tightly coupled surfaces where a Hub API change can block Console and Marketplace at the same time. Manages dependencies and sequencing without adding process for its own sake.
- Adaptability: Absorbs shifts in packaging, pricing, and agentic access requirements without rearchitecting each time. Adjusts approach when a framework or plan stops serving the team.
- Risk Management: Treats billing accuracy, entitlement enforcement, and API compatibility as areas where mistakes cost real money and customer trust. Builds the guardrails, auditability, and testing to catch problems before customers do.
- Technical Proficiency: Credible in API design, multi-tenant data modeling, and identity and access patterns, with enough frontend depth to lead Console work substantively rather than defer on it.

### It is a plus if you have…

- Familiarity with Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem
- Frontend or full-stack depth, enough to lead Console work substantively
- Experience with marketplaces, developer catalogs, or package distribution systems
- Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the systems behind them
- Startup experience in high-growth infrastructure or developer-tools companies
- Familiarity with how AI agents consume infrastructure APIs

description:
**Mission**

If you ask a hospital today how much a treatment will cost, the answer is usually: “We don’t know.” Not because providers don’t want to tell you but because patient cost is computed across insurance plans, negotiated rates, and billing rules that are fragmented, opaque, and not designed for real-time transparency. What should be a simple question requires navigating a web of systems that don’t talk to each other. So humans do that work instead. They log into portals, call payers, follow decision trees, and manually stitch together answers across disconnected systems. Even when providers want to give a clear answer, the system makes it nearly impossible. At Bravebird, we’re changing that. We’re building agents that do the work between systems - end to end. We believe the future of work is machines talking to machines, handling fragmented, system-to-system workflows so humans can focus on decisions, judgment, and care.

**About The Role**

We're building agentic AI systems that can reason, act, and operate reliably in messy, real-world environments. As a Software Engineer (Browser Automation), you will build the backbone that makes our agents reliable, scalable, and production-ready. You'll write the automations that log into fragmented legacy portals, keep them durable when those portals change, and build the infrastructure that runs thousands of them at once. This is a deeply technical, high-ownership role. You'll work directly with founders, shape the technical direction, and ship systems that are used in real-world, high-stakes environments.

**What You’ll Do**

Build Robust Automation Engines — highly reliable, code-first browser automations navigating complex, fragmented legacy portals and extracting structured data.
Build Self-Healing Workflows — deterministic + AI-assisted self-healing that adapts to UI updates, layout shifts, and element mutations without human intervention.
Scale Execution — concurrent, high-throughput execution of thousands of long-running workflows with strong state management, retries, low latency, high consistency.
Architect Stealth Infrastructure — build and scale execution infrastructure using advanced stealth execution, browser fingerprinting, and residential proxy management to keep automations stable against portals that don't want to be automated.
**What You’ll Bring**

5+ years of software engineering experience — you ship production systems and build software.
Web automation at scale (hard requirement) — a proven track record of building and maintaining production-grade web automation or scraping systems at scale.
Deep browser-automation expertise — hands-on mastery of Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or CDP, plus the DOM, HTTP, headers, and session management.
Stealth and proxy mastery — direct production experience with stealth execution, residential proxy management, and browser fingerprinting.
Architectural rigor — strong thinking around state management, distributed queues, and retries for long-running, non-deterministic workflows.
A resilient problem-solving mindset — you enjoy reverse-engineering obscure systems, finding stable workarounds, and building durable software for restrictive environments.
What We Offer

**Ownership and impact**
Competitive compensation with meaningful equity
Direct access to founders and customers
The opportunity to ship production systems in high-stakes environments

title: Marketing Lead
description:
# About OpsLevel

OpsLevel is the agentic delivery engine designed to help dev teams build, ship, and maintain software better than ever. The way software gets developed and delivered is changing rapidly, and OpsLevel provides the context and guardrails that your human & agent developers both need to navigate their world. Entire engineering teams at great companies like Okta, Keller Williams, Nerdwallet, and Zapier run on OpsLevel.

### 

We're a fully-remote team of team members across North America. OpsLevelers live our company values on a daily basis and when we’re not heads-down on a project or collaborating in real-time over Zoom, we're competing in trivia over lunch or sharing the latest fur baby photo in #pets-to-make-you-live-longer.

### 

Our culture and values are very important and ground us in how we interact as one team:

**Growth Mindset** - Get comfortable with being uncomfortable

**Focus & Efficiency** - Keep the main thing the main thing, and get it done

**Empathy** - Think of others; think of your users

**Intellectual Honesty** - The best solution is more important than anyone's ego

**Simplicity** - Don't overthink it

## About the Role

We're looking for an ambitious marketer with start up experience — someone who’s seen the pieces of a marketing function up close and is ready to run one solo.

### 

This is a real growth opportunity. The person in this seat will start by owning content, campaigns, and demand gen day-to-day — but as they prove they can run the function, there's a clear path to taking on full ownership of marketing at OpsLevel and partnering directly with the executive team on strategy.

### 

We're looking for someone who is both creative and analytical: someone with a sharp sense in brand and design, who's just as comfortable in the numbers — understanding the funnel, what's converting, and why.

## What You’ll Do

### 

### Product Marketing

- Own our messaging: what OpsLevel does, who it's for, and why we win against the alternatives. Keep it consistent from the homepage through to the sales pitch.
- Take each release to market. Launch plan, release notes, customer comms, and work with Product on the content around it.
- Own competitive positioning and the material sales needs to use it: comparisons, objection handling, and pitch content.
- Work closely with Sales and Customer Success to understand what they're seeing in the market, and turn that into sharper positioning, content, and product feedback.

### Demand Gen

- Plan and run multi-channel campaigns across paid ads, email, social, webinars, and events.
- Own the funnel. Know how prospects move from first touch to conversion, where they drop off, and what to fix.
- Own our marketing stack and how leads flow through it: HubSpot/Salesforce, attribution, lead routing and list hygiene, and the MQL definition and handoff to sales.
- Run experiments using our experimentation framework. Make a hypothesis, set goals, run the test, read the result, change course based on what it says. Iterate weekly.
- Work with sales and leadership on demand gen strategy, and report on performance in terms the rest of the company can act on.

### Brand & Content

- Own OpsLevel's brand voice and keep it consistent across the website, social, and content.
- Run our social presence and content calendar. Plan it, write it, publish it.
- Build out content that supports the buyer's journey: blog posts, case studies, one-pagers, and campaign copy.
- Own how we show up in search: traditional SEO plus visibility in AI answers (AEO). Write and structure content that ranks, and that gets cited when a buyer asks ChatGPT or Claude about our category.
- Keep the website and landing pages current with our messaging and built to convert.

## What We’re Looking For

We're less focused on years of experience and more on drive and proficiency. What matters is whether someone can operate independently, think like a brand owner, read a funnel, and partner with the people around them — not how long they've been doing it. To be clear: we’re not looking for a unicorn that is already strong in every area, we’re looking for the ability to get up to speed on what's missing, not arrive with it already mastered.

- Experience marketing to an engineering audience — one that doesn’t like being marketed to.
- Breadth across the marketing function. You've done real work in product marketing, demand gen, and brand & content, with deep ownership in at least one. We don't expect equal depth across all three.
- Strong analytical thinking: able to review results and adjust based on data, not instinct alone.
- Some experience working at a startup or scale-up — comfortable with the pace and scrappiness that comes with it.
- AI native: actively uses AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, design/image-generation tools) day-to-day, and constantly researching and testing new approaches week over week.
- Proven ability to work independently, take ownership, and self-direct: comfortable taking loose direction and building the plan, not just executing someone else's.
- Design taste — has a feel for what looks good and sounds compelling.

## Nice-to-have

- Hands-on experience running paid ads on Google, LinkedIn, or Reddit — comfort with experimentation and testing frameworks matters more than which platforms you've already used.
- Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and our marketing SaaS suite
- Experience supporting marketing for in-person events or conferences.
- Podcast, video, or other multimedia content experience.

*This posting is for an existing vacancy.*

# Compensation

We offer market-leading compensation, including equity, based on the skill set and aptitude of the candidate.

# "Should I apply?" - Yes!

If you meet some or most of what we're looking for, we want to hear from you, and if you’re unsure - apply anyways!

# What do I need to interview with OpsLevel?

Not much! A working web camera, microphone, and (ideally) a quiet place with minimal background noise.

# Additional Information

We are building an inclusive and welcoming workplace where employees feel appreciated, valued and free to be who they are regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes them unique.

OpsLevel is an equal opportunity employer and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and barrier-free work environment for all employees and candidates. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and if accommodation is required during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact any member of the Management team. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

*We use automated tools, including AI, to support the review of applications.*

title: Project Manager Assistant
MLPerf Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About MLCommons Association**
MLCommons is a new kind of organization for the AI era. We are a non-profit that builds the standards that define AI through open, state-of-the art, industry-standard benchmarks to measure quality, performance, and risk. We aren’t like standards organizations that slowly negotiate over specifications - we bring the community together to work on cutting edge problems and build the future with code.


We’re a global consortium supported by 125+ members and affiliates, including startups, leading companies, and academics. We are a fully remote organization that supports a flexible working environment; this requires mature communication, accountability, and transparent collaboration by all team members.

**About MLPerf**
The MLPerf family of benchmarks is the industry standard for measuring performance and efficiency of AI on everything from smartphones and laptops to the world’s largest supercomputers. Our open, fair, and trusted benchmarks help bring together the broader community, including researchers, engineers, purchasers, and vendors to enable more capable and efficient AI for the entire world.


The MLPerf team includes product managers, program managers, and engineers who work collaboratively with member organizations. Together, they build, operate, and sustain the MLPerf benchmarks, AI workload evaluation harnesses, and infrastructure that serve our members, their stakeholders, and the entire AI ecosystem.

You can read about MLPerf here:

IEEE Spectrum: Machine Learning Tests Keep Getting Bigger
AMD: AMD Delivers Breakthrough MLPerf Inference 6.0 Results
NVIDIA: NVIDIA Platform Delivers Lowest Token Cost Enabled by Extreme Co-Design 
Scope of MLPerf Software Engineer
As an MLPerf Software Engineer, you will work in the open-source space, designing and building the systems and infrastructure that power the MLPerf benchmarks — the automation behind the benchmarks and the critical processes around submission, review, publication, and reproducibility, as well as the visualization of benchmarking results.

This is a role for an engineer who thinks in systems: someone who can own architecture and technical direction, weigh trade-offs, and design infrastructure that scales — not just implement against a spec. You will work alongside the MLPerf team and experts in performance optimization, benchmarking, and ML at our member organizations to shape the evolution and success of the MLPerf benchmarking suite.

Responsibilities

Architect and design benchmarking systems, infrastructure, and tooling — owning technical decisions from concept through implementation.
Design robust, scalable automation for submission, validation, review, publication, and reproducibility of benchmark results.
Learn and operate existing MLPerf pipelines; identify structural improvements and re-architect where needed rather than patch around them.
Partner with MLPerf engineering and program management to translate roadmap goals into technical designs and deliver them.
Collaborate with ML engineers, DevOps teams, and hardware vendors to design and optimize end-to-end benchmarking pipelines.
Debug and resolve complex issues across automation, submissions, and benchmark harnesses.
Produce high-quality design docs and documentation to drive collaboration and technical alignment.
Present technical designs, progress, and outcomes to the MLPerf working groups.
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated experience designing systems and infrastructure — architecture decisions, trade-off analysis, and building for scale and reliability.
4+ years of post-academic software engineering (or equivalent impact via open source / industry).
Proficiency in Python and Bash; strong automation mindset.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions (or equivalent CI/CD), artifact/version management.
Working knowledge of containers (Docker) and running workloads reproducibly.
Familiarity with ML concepts (inference/training basics) and performance benchmarking or optimization.
Nice-to-have Qualifications
Experience designing distributed systems, data pipelines, or large-scale automation infrastructure.
Infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and cloud platforms.
Experience with MLPerf (reference or vendor implementations), LoadGen, and logging schemas.
ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime.
Understanding of hardware for ML (CPUs/GPUs/TPUs/accelerators) and performance profiling.
Data validation, schema management, and results visualization experience.
Prior open-source contributions in benchmarking tools and communities.
Why Join Us
Own the design of open, industry-standard tooling and infrastructure that advances trustworthy, efficient AI.
Collaborate with leading hardware vendors, ML engineers, and researchers worldwide.
Shape the architecture and best practices for automation, reproducibility, and software quality at scale.
Fully remote with high-ownership work and meaningful community impact.
Compensation & Timeline
Type: Contractor (non-W2)
Location : Remote (North American time zone preferred)
Commitment: ~40 hrs/week
Duration: 12 months, with possible extensions
Start date: Immediately
Eligibility: We currently do not provide Visa Sponsorship
Compensation: commensurate with experience
Application Process
Send the following to jobs@mlcommons.org with subject: "Applying for MLPerf Software Engineer Role — [Your Name]"

Resume/CV
Relevant links (GitHub, LinkedIn, personal site)
Answer to the question: "Think of a system or automation you designed. If you were to redesign it today, what's one thing you would do differently and why?"

title: Clinical Safety & Digital Health Advisor — Nani Health
description:
About Nani Health

Nani is Taskclan’s AI-powered Family OS. It helps families coordinate schedules, routines, household responsibilities, memories, caregivers and important family information.

Nani Health will extend this foundation into responsible family-health organization, education and support. It will not be positioned as a substitute for qualified medical care.

The opportunity

We are looking for a licensed Canadian healthcare professional or experienced digital-health specialist to serve as our Clinical Safety & Digital Health Advisor.

You will help us define what Nani Health can safely do, establish clinical boundaries and review product decisions involving health information, families and children.

This is an advisory role. It does not involve diagnosing users, prescribing treatment or establishing a clinician-patient relationship through Nani.

What you will own

• Help define the clinical scope and boundaries of Nani Health
• Review health-related product requirements, workflows and language
• Identify clinical risks, unintended consequences and potential harms
• Establish escalation guidance for urgent and emergency situations
• Review parental consent and child-safety considerations
• Help distinguish wellness, organizational and medical functionality
• Review educational content for accuracy and responsible presentation
• Advise on symptom, medication and health-record features before release
• Help assess when external regulatory classification is required
• Review how AI-generated health information is presented to families
• Establish procedures for clinical-content review and version control
• Collaborate with privacy, compliance, product and engineering teams
• Support partnerships with healthcare professionals and organizations

What we are looking for

• Current or recent Canadian clinical licensure or substantial digital-health regulatory experience
• A background in medicine, nursing, pharmacy, pediatrics, family health, mental health or health informatics
• At least five years of relevant professional experience
• Understanding of clinical safety, consent and patient communication
• Experience with digital-health applications is strongly preferred
• Familiarity with PHIPA and Canadian health-privacy expectations
• Ability to communicate clinical risks clearly to non-clinical teams
• Strong judgment around children, parents and vulnerable users
• No expectation that the product should make unsupported medical claims

Compensation and commitment

This is initially a part-time, equity-only advisory role with no cash salary. The proposed equity range is 0.1%–0.5%, depending on credentials, commitment and final responsibilities.

The engagement will use a formal advisor agreement. Equity should generally vest monthly over two years with a three-month cliff, subject to legal review and board approval.

To apply, provide your professional background, jurisdiction of practice and any experience advising digital-health products.

As an Ambassador, you will be the operational face of bataSutra’s growth mandate outside our core team. You will analyze audience sentiment, optimize conversion funnels for deep-dive content, represent our brand in professional networks, and cultivate a community of engaged readers who value intellectual substance over fleeting trends. This role requires rigor, analytical precision, and a commitment to the platform’s educational mission.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Growth Execution: Design and execute data-driven strategies to increase newsletter subscriptions, article engagement, and platform retention. You will be responsible for A/B testing content distribution channels to maximize Return on Investment (ROI) without compromising content integrity.

Audience Advocacy & Representation: Act as the primary liaison between bataSutra’s editorial team and our external community. Identify key stakeholders, partners, and influencers within the Business, Science, and Technology sectors who align with our values and facilitate mutual growth partnerships.

Content Performance Analysis: Monitor analytics regarding read-through rates, newsletter open rates, and referral traffic. Provide actionable recommendations to the editorial team on how content themes resonate with professional aspirations and market demands.

Community Stewardship: Foster a high-quality community environment where readers can discuss insights derived from our deep-dive content. Ensure that external discussions reflect accuracy and intellectual rigor appropriate for professionals.

Conversion Optimization: Identify friction points in the user journey from content discovery to subscription/retention. Implement strategies to convert passive readers into active subscribers without resorting to aggressive monetization tactics that detract from the educational experience.

Qualifications

Experience: Minimum of 3 years in growth marketing, content strategy, or community management within a B2B or EdTech environment. Experience with long-form content distribution (text-based media) is highly preferred.

Sector Knowledge: Demonstrable understanding of the Indian Business, Technology, and Science landscapes. Ability to converse fluently on topics ranging from FinTech regulations to Emerging Tech trends without needing basic orientation.

Analytical Acumen: Proven ability to interpret analytics dashboards (GA4, Mixpanel, etc.) and translate data into strategic narratives. You must be comfortable with experimentation and iteration based on hard metrics.

Professional Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English. Portfolio demonstrating a serious, authoritative voice is required.

Ethical Standards: A commitment to accuracy and fact-based reporting. Misinformation is strictly prohibited.

Independence: Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision while maintaining a high level of accountability for KPIs.

Why Join bataSutra

You will not be merely executing tasks; you are building the intellectual infrastructure for a new generation of professionals. We offer an environment that values substance over vanity metrics, where your contributions directly influence how India engages with global knowledge. This is an opportunity to shape the future of professional education in a sector that demands rigor, integrity, and forward-thinking strategy.

Application Process

Candidates should submit their resume and a cover letter outlining:

A brief analysis of bataSutra’s current digital presence (strengths/growth opportunities).
An example of a content campaign or growth initiative you led that utilized data to improve conversion or retention.

title: Account Executive (UK)
description:
## **Company Overview**

Construction is one of the world’s largest industries, yet it remains one of the least technologically advanced. Every year, contractors invest significant time and resources into creating cost estimates for bids. Much of that process still relies on tedious “takeoffs” manually measuring and counting materials from construction drawings.

Bobyard uses computer vision and NLP to automate takeoffs, helping contractors create estimates faster, reduce errors, and bid more work. We’re a fast-growing team backed by Primary, Pear, and 8VC, building purpose-built technology for the construction industry.

## **Position Overview**

We’re looking for a **Founding** Account Executive to help validate, establish, and grow Bobyard’s presence in the UK.

This is not a traditional AE role where you inherit an established territory and fully developed playbook. The UK is currently in a market validation stage, so you’ll play a direct role in identifying where we have the strongest product market fit, refining our messaging, and building a repeatable sales motion.

You’ll partner closely with our UK SDR, but you’ll also be expected to generate your own opportunities through targeted outbound, industry relationships, events, referrals, and other creative market development efforts. You’ll own the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through product demonstrations, negotiation, and close.

Across our sales team, we have achieved a 57% qualified-to-close rate. Your job will be to help us sustain that performance as we expand internationally and build the foundation for long-term growth in the UK.

## **Accelerated Ramp Expectations**

Because this is a founding role, the ramp period will be shorter and more hands on than at a traditional AE organization.

We’ll provide product training, coaching, and access to the broader Bobyard team, but you’ll be expected to take ownership of your development from day one. That means learning the platform quickly, practicing independently, asking thoughtful questions, seeking feedback, and becoming confident leading tailored product demonstrations earlier than is typical in most AE roles.

Product fluency and demo readiness will be key measures of early success. We’re looking for someone who is energized by that pace and does not need to wait for every process, resource, or playbook to be fully built before taking action.

## **Responsibilities**

- Own the full sales cycle, including outbound prospecting, discovery, product demonstrations, negotiation, and close
- Build your own pipeline while partnering with the UK SDR on coordinated account coverage and outbound execution
- Build and manage a pipeline of mid-market contractors across landscaping, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, and other construction trades
- Take ownership of an accelerated ramp and become confident running tailored product demonstrations quickly
- Learn how contractors currently complete takeoffs and estimates, then connect Bobyard’s capabilities directly to their workflows and pain points
- Prepare thoroughly for demos and adapt each conversation to the prospect’s trade, business model, estimating process, and priorities
- Help validate Bobyard’s UK market opportunity by testing customer segments, trades, messaging, pricing, and sales approaches
- Develop relationships across the UK construction industry and create opportunities through outbound, referrals, events, and in-person engagement
- Maintain strong pipeline management, CRM hygiene, follow-up, and forecasting discipline
- Travel throughout the UK for trade shows, contractor meetings, and job site visits when it can meaningfully advance an opportunity
- Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure a smooth handoff and set new customers up for success
- Document market learnings and provide structured feedback to Product, Customer Success, and company leadership
- Help shape the repeatable UK sales playbook that future GTM hires will follow
- Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets

## **What We’re Looking For**

- Experience owning and closing full-cycle B2B SaaS sales opportunities
- A proven ability to learn technical products quickly and translate their capabilities into clear, compelling demonstrations
- A proactive approach to ramping, including independent practice, preparation, and actively seeking feedback
- Strong discovery skills and the ability to understand operational workflows, business pain points, and financial impact
- Confidence leading product demonstrations and commercial conversations with multiple stakeholders
- A track record of generating your own pipeline rather than relying exclusively on SDR sourced opportunities
- A self directed, entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in a market that is still being validated
- The ability to turn early market feedback into clear, actionable recommendations
- Strong pipeline management, follow-up, and forecasting discipline
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Construction technology, estimating, takeoff, or contractor sales experience is preferred but not required
- Willingness to travel throughout the UK as needed
- Occasional in office visits to our San Francisco headquarters

## **Benefits**

- Competitive base salary with uncapped commission
- Equity options
- Partnership with a dedicated UK SDR, while retaining ownership of building and converting your own pipeline
- The opportunity to be Bobyard’s founding UK Account Executive and directly shape our go-to-market strategy
- Direct exposure to company leadership, Product, and Customer Success
- The chance to build something new in a large, underserved industry

We believe our product stands out and that the UK construction market is ready for it. If you’re excited by the opportunity to validate a market, build the playbook, and create the foundation for Bobyard’s growth in the UK, we’d love to hear from you.

**Comp Philosophy**

We are proud to offer competitive, top-of-market compensation because we want to celebrate the dedicated people who ship amazing work and drive our success. Our individual compensation is thoughtfully tailored based on your role, experience, and contributions, alongside performance-based rewards.

title: Software Engineer Internship
description:
PhrasIQ
Software Engineering · Remote · Full-time Intern

Before applying, please follow [PhrasIQ page](https://www.linkedin.com/company/phrasiq) on LinkedIn — we look at engagement with our updates as one signal of genuine interest.

**About the Team**
PhrasIQ is building the intelligence layer for enterprise finance. Our platform — InsightOS — gives finance teams AI-powered forecasting, decision support, and reporting that is fully auditable and traceable. We're a small founding team that moves with the speed and rigor of people who know exactly what they're building and why. Every person here has a direct line to the product, the architecture, and the decisions that shape both.

**About the Role**
We're looking for a Software Engineer Intern to work directly with the founding team on real product problems — not tickets, not documentation, not support tooling. You'll build features that enterprise users will touch, work across a codebase that takes system design seriously, and be expected to think, not just execute.

This is an unpaid internship. What it offers instead: genuine ownership, close mentorship, and a direct path to a full-time role based on performance, learning outcomes, and culture fit. We're not looking for someone to fill a seat — we're looking for someone who wants to grow into a founding engineer.

This isn't a summer project. Over 6 months, you'll go deep enough to own a surface area of the product end-to-end.

**In this role, you will:**

* Build and ship features across the InsightOS interface and API layer
* Work on how financial data is structured, surfaced, and explained to enterprise users
* Collaborate directly with the founding team across product, design, and architecture decisions
* Treat unclear requirements as product problems — and propose solutions, not just questions


**Your background looks something like:**

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Some hands-on experience with TypeScript, React, or Python — we don't need all three
* Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar)
* Genuine curiosity about AI, fintech, or developer tooling
* Comfortable in environments where things are loosely defined and you're expected to bring structure


**About PhrasIQ**
PhrasIQ is an agentic finance and decision intelligence platform. We're building the infrastructure that makes AI-generated financial outputs trustworthy — deterministic, versioned, and explainable by design. Our thesis is that enterprise finance teams deserve AI that can be audited, not just admired. We're early, we're focused, and we're hiring people who want to build something that lasts.

**A note on compensation**
This role is unpaid. We're transparent about that because we respect your time. In exchange, you get: proximity to a founding team building in a defensible space, real product ownership from day one, and a conversion path to a full-time role for interns who demonstrate the capability and drive to grow with us.

***Screening Questions (must reply in your application)***

1. **This is an unpaid internship, 4–6 months, with a possible path to a founding role based on performance. What makes that worth it for you right now?**


2. **Describe a project where you had to figure something out with little to no guidance — a bug with no clear cause, a spec that didn't exist yet, a tool you had to learn on the fly. What did you actually do first?**


3. **Our architecture has a hard rule: one system layer (InsightOS) never touches another's database directly, only through its API. Why might a rule like that exist, and where have you seen (or broken) something similar?**

title: AI/ML Engineer Intern
description:
**Type**: Internship (2–3 months, extendable) 
**Stipend** - 5K - 10KLocation: **RemoteAvailability** - full time / part time
 
Make My Health is building health products powered by data from wearables and health platforms — Apple Watch, Google Health/Fit, our own custom devices (e.g. the posture wearable), and other third-party health trackers. We're looking for an AI/ML Engineer to turn that raw sensor and health data into meaningful insights and algorithms — things like activity/posture pattern detection, anomaly or risk scoring, personalized recommendations, and predictive health signals — that power features across our app and devices.

**What You'll Do**

* Ingest and normalize health data from multiple sources — Apple HealthKit, Google Health Connect/Fit, custom BLE devices, and manually logged data — into a consistent internal data model.
* Design and build ML models/algorithms for health signal detection: e.g. posture/slouch pattern recognition, activity classification, sleep/recovery scoring, anomaly detection, or trend/risk prediction, depending on the product.
* Do exploratory data analysis on time-series sensor data (IMU streams, heart rate, steps, sleep stages, etc.) to identify useful features and signals.
* Prototype and evaluate models (classical ML and/or deep learning where appropriate) and iterate based on accuracy, latency, and battery/compute constraints for on-device or near-real-time use.
* Work with the mobile/firmware teams to figure out what should run on-device (edge inference) vs. in the cloud.
* Turn validated models into production-ready pipelines/APIs that the app and devices can call.
* Continuously evaluate model performance against real user data and retrain/improve as new devices and data sources are added.
* Stay current with relevant health-AI research (wearable sensor fusion, digital biomarkers, etc.) and bring in applicable techniques.

**What We're Looking For**

* Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Experience working with time-series or sensor data — wearable/health data experience is a strong plus, but general time-series/IoT/signal-processing experience also counts.
* Comfortable with the full ML lifecycle: data cleaning, feature engineering, model training/evaluation, and deployment.
* Familiarity with health data APIs/SDKs (Apple HealthKit, Google Health Connect, or similar) is a plus, or willingness to learn them quickly.
* Understanding of basic signal-processing techniques (filtering, sensor calibration, feature extraction from accelerometer/gyroscope/heart-rate data).
* Ability to work with ambiguous, early-stage product requirements and iterate quickly.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with edge/on-device ML (TensorFlow Lite, Core ML, or similar) for wearables or mobile apps.
* Background in digital health, biomedical signal processing, or clinical data.
* Experience building APIs/data pipelines (FastAPI, cloud data pipelines, etc.) to serve models in production.
* Familiarity with regulatory/privacy considerations around health data (HIPAA-style handling, data anonymization).

**Why This Role**

*Work at the intersection of hardware, health, and AI — your models will run on real devices people wear every day.

* Shape the algorithms from scratch across multiple health products, not maintain a legacy pipeline.

*Work closely with the founder and product team, with direct visibility from data to shipped feature.

title: Computer Vision + Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
**Please only apply if you have previous Nvidia Omniverse, Computational Fluid Dynamics, or VFx experience**

About OmniPath

OmniPath is building high-performance, real-time perception and reinforcement-learning systems for sports analytics and industrial energy optimization.

On the sports side, we’re deploying a next-generation CV + simulation stack (object tracking, event inference, physics-aware embeddings, 3D overlays) for live broadcast and sportsbook integrations. Curling is our first vertical, but the underlying architecture generalizes to multi-sport tracking, play prediction, and virtual broadcast augmentation.

On the industrial side, we extend the same RL and digital-twin backbone to rotating-asset optimization—compressors, pumps, turbines—using GPU-accelerated physics, real-time inference, and Omniverse-based simulation staging.

We’re Calgary-based, NVIDIA Inception-aligned, and shipping real GPU-accelerated production code across sports and energy environments.

What You’ll Do

You will own one or more vertical slices across real-time CV, RL training loops, and 3D/Omniverse deployment:

Computer Vision

Multi-object tracking: detectors, trackers (ByteTrack/DeepSORT), ID stitching, occlusion recovery

Event + state inference: play/shot classification, trajectory smoothing, impact/terminal state extraction

Camera calibration, homography recovery, field-of-play normalization

Latency-tuned GPU inference (batching, mixed precision, TensorRT optimizations)

Reinforcement Learning

Gymnasium-compatible environments for sports and industrial settings

PPO/SAC baselines for shot/play recommendation, or control policies for rotating equipment

Sim-to-live transfer, reward shaping, evaluation harnesses

TorchScript/ONNX exports integrated into real-time pipelines

3D / Digital Twin / Omniverse

USD scene prep from Blender/Unity assets

Real-time overlays for sports broadcasts

Physics-informed pipelines for industrial digital twins (Omni.PhysX, Flow, Replicator)

Infrastructure & Tooling

Annotated video/debug artifacts, metrics dashboards, validation sets

Profiling: Nsight, TensorRT, GPU scheduling

You Might Be a Fit If You Have

Strong Python engineering fundamentals

CV experience: OpenCV, PyTorch, Detectron2/YOLO, object tracking, calibration

RL familiarity: PPO/SAC/IMPALA, Gymnasium/Gym, RLlib, SB3

Data tooling: NumPy, Pandas, Parquet, DVC

This is an equity-only founding engineering role for someone interested in building at the intersection of artificial intelligence, scientific research, and biological experimentation. We’re seeking a Founding AI Research Engineer to join me and another technical cofounder to help design, train, evaluate, and study new models and research systems.

Our work focuses on developing AI as both an object of scientific study and a tool for scientific discovery. This may involve training foundation models from scratch, experimenting with new architectures and optimization methods, developing models for specialized scientific domains, and studying how models learn and represent scientific concepts. We’re also interested in understanding how AI systems can participate in scientific workflows, from hypothesis generation and computational modeling to experimentation, analysis, and evaluation.

Depending on the project, the work may span machine learning research, foundation model development, scientific computing, model evaluation, optimization, and research tooling. You’ll work closely with scientists, software engineers, computational researchers, and other technical collaborators while helping build the underlying research capabilities of an early-stage company.

Assist with executing the end-to-end process of developing research capabilities:

title: Community Manager, Reddit
description:
**A mission worth building for, on a model you should understand before you apply.** FiNC is changing how politics works in America, and we are Crowd-Starting it. **Contributor roles are not paid yet; compensation is deferred.** Full details in the Crowd-Starting section below.

## About FiNC

We're assembling a coalition to change how politics works. Forever.

3 middlemen decide which candidates you ever hear about: big money, party gatekeepers, and media manipulation. They control the money, the access, and the visibility every candidate needs to win, so they decide who wins before anyone votes. The system isn't broken. It's rigged, and it works exactly as it was built to.

FiNC (Future is Now Coalition) is the way around it. Citizens say what they care about, candidates say who they are, and the 2 sides connect with nobody in between. Our work is the human side: outreach, PR, social, and citizen buy-in. We're not marketing a website. We're campaigning for a better way to choose leaders.

We're largely neurodiverse, direct by default, and soft on hierarchy. Team members here are partners and co-architects, not employees. Full mission and culture at futureis.org.


## IMPORTANT: This involves DELAYED COMPENSATION -- Please read carefully

To maintain our independence and avoid conflicts of interest, we are not accepting investors or financing that comes with strings attached. Instead, **we are Crowd-Starting FiNC: building it together from the ground up**.

***We ask team members to contribute 15 to 20 hours per week during this phase, with compensation deferred until we are operational. That includes the Founder, who has not drawn a salary and will not until the team does.***

This model only works if you see it as a **short-term investment for a long-term return**. Contributors who build this with us **earn an ownership stake in FiNC**.

We are an LLC today because we needed a legal home to start from. We are **building toward something akin to a nonprofit cooperative, where the people who build the organization own it, and we operate not for profit in the meantime**.

This model filters for people who believe in the mission deeply enough to build alongside us. It is not for everyone, and that is okay.

## Culture and Employment

**A New Kind of Organization for a New Kind of Democracy**

- Neurodiversity and diversity-of-thought are strengths, not obstacles
- Servant leadership, dynamic team structures, and shared ownership
- Purpose over profits, value over hours, and respect for work-life balance
- We reward authenticity, passion, and commitment, not conformity
- We support individual weaknesses to enhance collective strengths
- Continuous role assessments, long-term growth opportunities, and real career sustainability

From your first 2-way interview, you will see (and feel) how radically different we are.

## Job Description

FiNC is looking for a **Reddit Community Manager** to own our official online community.

Our subreddit is the home of the Digital Politics Network: a room where citizens work out how politics actually runs underneath the noise, without it turning into left against right. This role owns that room. You start the conversations, you answer the people who show up, and you go find more of them in the subreddits where they already are.

Reddit is where our community lives while we get our Discord ready, so whoever builds this well is the natural owner of both.

2 things to be clear about up front. **This is an active seat, not a maintenance one:** the room grows because you are in it talking, not because it is tidy. And you own the initiative, not a team. Nobody reports to you, and people across Outreach and Marketing work alongside you on it.

### Why this role exists

We will be straight with you about the problem we are hiring to solve.

We have had a Reddit presence for months and the threads pulled real traffic. Almost none of it turned into anything, for 2 reasons: there was nowhere to send people once we had their attention, and the person doing it was working alone.

Both are fixed. The subreddit is built and waiting: description, rules, pinned posts, a launch plan, and a language guide that translates how we talk into how Reddit actually talks. Marketing produces the original posts for the feed. Others on Outreach work the comments with you.

What is missing is the person who talks to people. **You are being handed the room right before the doors open.**

### What you'll do

Listed in priority order.

**1. Own the subreddit**

- Start the conversations. Post prompts, ask real questions, and answer everybody who shows up, especially early, when 1 unanswered comment makes the whole place look empty
- Set the culture. Our rules are unusual: keep your politics, aim them up at the people who set the rules, and nobody keeps score on which party is worse. Holding that line is most of the job
- Run the mechanics: AutoModerator, flair, removal reasons, and the judgment calls the rules do not cover

**2. Grow it from other subreddits**

- Go deep in a handful of subs instead of wide across dozens. The same faces seeing you over time is the only thing on Reddit that turns into trust
- Reply where people are already circling the problem and do not have a name for it yet
- Never spam, never brigade, never break another community's rules. We would rather grow slowly than get the account banned

**3. Turn what citizens tell us into something that goes somewhere**

- Collect what people say about what is broken where they live, and hand it to Marketing for the weekly roundup we publish and carry to candidates and movements
- Follow the best threads into DMs and pull those people into the community

**4. Tell us what is actually working**

- Report on what is growing and what is not, and bring back what Reddit taught you that our plan got wrong. We would rather be corrected than agreed with

### What we're looking for

- Real Reddit fluency. You use the site, you know why 1 comment lands and the next one dies, and you can spot the difference between an organization participating and an organization advertising
- You have built or grown an online community somewhere: a subreddit, a Discord, a forum, a group. Hobby experience counts. Some of the best people for this have never had it in a job title
- You write like a person, not a brand
- You can sit in political conversations all day without picking a side. We host every position and take none, and that posture has to survive contact with an argument
- Thick skin, light touch. Somebody will call you a shill in week 1. The right answer is to agree that you work here and keep talking
- Comfortable being early. Small numbers, slow weeks, and the honesty to say so out loud instead of dressing it up
- Mission-aligned, and genuinely curious about why people believe what they believe

### What this role is not

- **Not a moderator seat.** Rule enforcement is a small slice. A well-run room with nobody talking in it is not a community
- **Not a content creation role.** Marketing writes the original posts. Your job is everything that responds to a human
- **Not an advocacy job.** This is our highest-exposure seat for drifting off the referee posture, because you are in political threads every day with nobody looking over your shoulder
- **Not growth hacking.** No alt accounts, no vote rings, no karma farming. Those cost us the community permanently and they are not worth 1 good week
- **Not solo.** Alexandra is holding this now and will keep supporting you once you are in the seat

### Why this role matters

Reddit is one of the last places online where a stranger will argue with you honestly and sometimes change their mind in public. It is also where we have reached the most people who already feel that something is rigged and have no language for it. This is the seat that turns that feeling into a community, and the community is the thing we are actually building.

title: Founding Sales Lead
description:
**About HyprStart**

HyprStart gets tradespeople hired. HVAC, electrical, and plumbing techs and apprentices apply to us for free. We find the local shops that are hiring right now, match them to the right candidates, and make the introduction. Shops only pay when someone gets hired.

The product is built and live. Real candidates apply through our job listings in markets like Phoenix, Houston, Dallas, Atlanta, Tampa, and the Bay Area. Our AI tools find the shops and score the matches. What's missing is a person on the phone turning those matches into hires. That's you.

**The role**

You own the funnel from the moment a candidate applies to the day they start work. This is not a shadowing internship. You'll be the first sales hire, working directly with the founder, making real calls that close real placements.

**What you'll do every day**

- **Work the candidate queue.** Review new applications daily, call or text candidates to confirm their experience, certifications, availability, and pay expectations, and approve the ones who are ready. Nobody should wait more than 48 hours.
- **Call shops.** Our AI tools build your daily list of shops posting jobs right now, so you're never dialing random numbers. Call owners and service managers and pitch a specific candidate, not a service.
- **Get the yes.** Get shops excited about a candidate, then set up the interview or ride-along.
- **Follow up until it closes.** Stay on both sides through interview, offer, and first day. Most placements are won in the follow-up.
- **Keep the pipeline honest.** Log every call and status change in our operator console so nothing falls through.
- **Tell us what you hear.** Which objections come up, which markets are hot, what shops actually want. You'll help write the scripts and shape the pitch.

**Who you are**

- Early in your career: a student, a recent grad, or a year or two into your first job. You want real reps, not busywork.
- Hungry. You'd rather make 50 calls and hear 45 no's than wait for leads to come to you.
- Comfortable talking to blue-collar business owners. Direct, friendly, and hard to rattle.
- Organized. You follow up when you said you would, every time.
- Self-directed. You can run with loose structure and ask good questions when you're stuck.
- Free during shop hours. Owners pick up early (roughly 7 to 10am local), and our markets run from Eastern to Pacific time.

**Requirements:** your own laptop and phone, reliable internet, and based in the US.

**Bonus points:** you grew up around the trades or worked one, you've done sales, recruiting, or customer service, or you speak Spanish.

**What you get**

- **A real title.** Founding Sales Lead, or pitch us one that fits the work you're doing. It goes on your resume.
- **AI-powered sales tools.** Access to AI tooling to power sales.
- **Real ownership.** You run the funnel. Your results are your results, with numbers you can bring to any interview.
- **Direct access to the founder.** Weekly 1:1s, feedback on your calls, and a close look at how a company gets built.
- **Uncapped upside.** $50 for every interview that happens and $500 for every placement you close.
- **Flexibility.** Fully remote. Set your own schedule around shop hours.
- **Room to grow.** If this works, the role grows with it.
- **A strong reference** from someone who watched you do the work.

**Compensation**

Commission only, no cap: $50 for every interview that happens and $500 for every placement. Part-time and flexible, 15 to 25 hours a week, fully remote (US).

**How to apply**

Apply here on Wellfound and include:

1. A few sentences on why you want this and why you're a fit.
2. Include "HYPR" in your message.
