title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
**Build the Future of Fractional Executive Leadership**

**ExecPods is redefining how companies access executive leadership.**

Companies need experienced leadership at critical moments when they’re scaling, transforming, entering new markets, navigating change, or preparing for what’s next. But they don’t always need or want the cost and commitment of a full-time executive.

ExecPods gives companies access to proven executives through flexible, fractional executive Pods bringing the right leadership into the business at the right time.

**Our mission is simple: Scale excellence.**

We’re looking for an exceptional Chief Revenue Officer to turn this model into a category-defining business.

This is not a traditional CRO role. You won’t be stepping into an established market with a proven playbook. You’ll help define the market, shape our go-to-market strategy, develop strategic partnerships, and establish the revenue infrastructure needed to scale.

**The Role**
- As CRO, you will own ExecPods’ commercial strategy and be responsible for turning a differentiated model into predictable, scalable growth.

**You Will**
- Research target customers, markets, companies, and decision-makers.
- Build and manage targeted prospect lists.
- Analyze results and identify opportunities to improve performance.
- Develop, test, and improve outreach messaging.
- Experiment with new ways to generate qualified leads.
- Use AI and emerging technology to make research, prospecting, and outreach smarter.
- Track what works and help build a repeatable lead-generation process.
- Bring ideas to the table and turn them into action.

**What We’re Looking For**
- We’re looking for a proven revenue leader who knows how to develop markets, and turn an emerging opportunity into significant revenue.

**You have demonstrated the ability to:**
- Build markets and turn emerging opportunities into compelling categories.
- Build and scale revenue in an emerging or high-growth business.
- Develop and execute enterprise go-to-market strategies.
- Build trusted relationships with CEOs, founders, and senior executives.
- Commercialize and communicate a differentiated business model.
- Create repeatable sales motions, predictable pipeline, and disciplined forecasting.
- Develop strategic partnerships and new growth channels.
- Build and lead high-performing teams with a culture of accountability and results.
- Operate with urgency, sound judgment, and a high degree of ownership.

**Why ExecPods**
- **The traditional executive model is changing.**
- Companies want access to experienced leadership, but increasingly need flexibility, speed, and the right expertise at the right moment. ExecPods is built around that shift.
- We believe the future isn’t simply full-time versus part-time. It’s about giving companies access to the right executive leadership for the moment they’re in.
- This is an opportunity to help define that future.
- You are not stepping into an established market with a proven playbook. You are helping write the playbook.

The CRO will have significant influence over the market we enter, the customers we serve, the way we sell, the partnerships we create, and the organization we build.

If you want to build a market, build a company, and help define the future of fractional executive leadership, this is that opportunity.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**About Us**

Peratera is a UK-based fintech company, founded in 2022 and authorised by the FCA as an Electronic Money Institution.
We are building a modern, all-in-one payment platform that enables businesses to manage global payments and financial operations seamlessly.
Our solution allows companies to open multi-currency accounts, send and receive payments worldwide, and manage cross-border transactions from a single platform.
Our mission is to simplify global finance and remove friction from international business operations.


**Your mission**
As a Technical Program Manager, you'll work closely with the CTO and Engineering leadership to turn technical and strategic priorities into structured programmes, coordinated execution and predictable delivery across multiple teams.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong programme management skills with a solid understanding of software engineering, modern technology environments and business-critical financial systems.


**Your Tech Environment**
You will work in a modern, cloud-native stack with clear ownership and no legacy surprises:


Backend: Java 17+, Spring Boot (Core, Security, Data, Cloud), REST APIs, event-driven services, Camunda
Infrastructure: AWS (EKS, RDS, CloudWatch), Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD
Data & Messaging: PostgreSQL, AMQP / Kafka-style message brokers, event-driven architecture
Observability: OpenSearch / ELK, Prometheus / Micrometer, OpenTelemetry (in progress)
Integrations: Open Banking providers, banking partners, external payment systems


**What You’ll Do**
* Coordinate technical initiatives across multiple Engineering teams, keeping scope, timelines and dependencies clear
* Build and maintain delivery plans, including milestones, dependencies, risks, blockers and key actions
* Track progress across multiple teams and provide clear status updates on delivery, risks and dependencies
* Work with Engineering and Product teams to break down high-level initiatives into clear deliverables, milestones and actionable work
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and follow up with owners to ensure actions are completed on time
* Maintain clear ownership of open actions, decisions, risks and blockers throughout the programme lifecycle
* Prepare and maintain Confluence documentation, including programme plans, meeting notes, decisions, status updates and delivery documentation
* Organise planning, status and delivery meetings, ensuring agendas, actions and decisions are clearly documented
* Support backlog and requirements discussions, helping ensure work is sufficiently defined before Engineering planning
* Prepare regular delivery reports and dashboards for Engineering and Product stakeholders
* Maintain visibility across technology initiatives, including payments, banking integrations, card processing, liquidity, observability and platform development
* Identify opportunities to improve Jira workflows, reporting, planning routines and delivery processes
* Follow up on decisions and actions from technical and cross-functional meetings through to completion

**What We’re Looking For**
* 3+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Technical Project Management or a similar role
* Experience coordinating technical projects or initiatives involving Engineering teams
* Hands-on experience using Jira for project planning, backlog tracking, dependencies, risks, dashboards and reporting
* Good working knowledge of Confluence for programme documentation, meeting notes, decisions and status reporting
* Experience setting up or maintaining Jira boards, workflows, dashboards or other delivery tracking tools
* Ability to structure technical work into clear milestones, deliverables, owners and timelines
* Experience tracking project progress and identifying risks, blockers and dependencies early
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle and modern engineering practices
* Strong organisational and communication skills with attention to detail
* Practical understanding of Agile, Scrum or Kanban

**Nice to Have**
* Familiarity with regulated payment environments, including PCI DSS, AML/KYC or EMI compliance requirements
* Background in software engineering, data or another technology discipline
* Experience with payment processing, money movement, banking integrations, payment providers, card schemes or cross-border payments


**What You’ll Get**
* Competitive, market-aligned compensation
* A genuine opportunity to shape Engineering delivery governance and ways of working
* A real fintech environment - fast-moving, international, never boring
* Work directly with Product and Engineering leaders to shape key product decisions
* International, distributed team with a collaborative mindset
* Remote-friendly setup with flexible working hours
* Supportive team culture focused on knowledge sharing and ownership

Sounds like a match? Send us your CV - we’re excited to get to know you.

title: Freelance Sales Rep (Commission-Only) - Hospitality SaaS

This is a commission-only role with no salary. Everything you earn comes from the commission described below, on every customer you bring.

Mangobeds is a property management system for colivings, hostels, hotels, campsites, glamping sites, cabins, retreats, surf stays, villas and vacation rentals, from small independents to large operators running 10 to 200 units. We have paying customers across Europe, the Americas and Asia, and we are looking for self-employed sales reps to bring us more.

THE DEAL

- Commission-only. You earn 30% of everything a customer you bring pays us in their first 12 months, rising to 35% and then 40% as you close more.
- Paid monthly, within 15 days of month end, once the customer has been with us for one month. No long vesting, no quarterly wait.

- You have sold software, travel or hospitality services before and can run your own pipeline end to end.

- You are self-employed and can invoice us.
- You speak English, plus any of Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, French or German.

ONE HOUSE RULE

If another rep is already working an account, you cannot jump on it. Ask us and we will tell you who has what.

- A Mangobeds email address and direct access to the founder for demos and pricing questions.

title: Head of Brand
description:
# Head of Brand

You'll own how Firecrawl shows up in the world: the positioning, the voice, the social presence, the launch copy, and everything in between. Right now, we're one of the fastest-growing developer tools on the internet. This role is about making sure the world knows it, understands it, and chooses us over everything else.

**Salary Range:** $244,000–$277,000 USD/year

**Equity Range:** Competitive equity. Details shared during the process.

**Location:** San Francisco, CA (SF HQ). Hybrid, onsite 3+ days a week.

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 4+ years owning brand at a developer-facing or technical product company

**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the United States. We're not able to sponsor US visas right now, though that may change down the line.

# About Firecrawl

Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data. It's the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

In September 2026, we raised a $75M Series B led by Smash Capital, and we're spending it building the largest repository of knowledge in the world. We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 187k+ GitHub stars, putting us in the top 40 repositories of all time, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves. No hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web. That library is called Alexandria, and it starts now.

# What You'll Do

- Own Firecrawl's brand positioning end to end, from how we describe ourselves on the homepage to how we show up in competitive comparisons and LLM recommendations
- Write and ship launch copy, product announcements, website updates, and social posts that actually land with a technical audience
- Grow and manage our presence on X and LinkedIn. Not just posting, but building a community and a point of view
- Run competitive analysis and translate it into messaging that differentiates us clearly, without marketing-speak
- Partner directly with founders and product to align brand with roadmap and GTM priorities
- Shape the content calendar and own the cadence of what goes out across every channel
- Think about discoverability beyond SEO, including how LLMs surface and recommend tools like ours

# What We're Looking For

- You understand how developers think. Not just what they do, but how they evaluate tools, what they distrust, and what makes them share something with their team. You've built brand for a developer-facing product before and you have receipts
- You're a writer first. The best brand work here will be in words: short-form, sharp, opinionated. You write copy that sounds like a smart person talking, not a marketing team hedging
- You've driven organic growth. You've moved the needle on search visibility and social reach for a technical product, and the numbers hold up when we check them in Ahrefs
- You're comfortable working directly with founders. No brand committee. No approval chain. You'll sit close to the people making product decisions and be expected to have a strong point of view on how we talk about what we're building
- You think about LLMs as a distribution channel. You understand that discoverability now includes AI tools recommending products, and you know how to write for that world

*Backgrounds that often do well: in-house brand at a developer tools or infra company, head of marketing at an early-stage API startup, founding marketer who owned everything from positioning to social.*

# What We're NOT Looking For

- Brand strategists who hand off execution to someone else
- People who measure success in impressions and engagement rate over organic growth and real developer mindshare
- Anyone who needs a brand playbook handed to them before they can start

# A Note On Pace

We operate at an absurd level of urgency because the window for what we're building won't stay open forever. If that excites you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings, but this role probably isn't for you.

# Benefits & Perks

## **Available to all employees**

- **Salary that makes sense:** $244,000–$277,000 USD/year, based on impact, not tenure
- **Own a piece:** Gain competitive equity in what you're helping build
- **Generous PTO:** 15 days mandatory, anything after 24 days, just ask (holidays excluded). Take the time you need to recharge
- **Parental leave:** 12 weeks fully paid, for all parents
- **Wellness stipend:** $100 USD/month for the gym, therapy, massages, or whatever keeps you human
- **Learning & Development:** Expense up to $1,000 USD/year toward anything that helps you grow professionally
- **Team offsites:** A change of scenery, minus the trust falls
- **Sabbatical:** 3 paid months off after 4 years, do something fun and new

## **Available to US-based full-time employees**

- **Full coverage, no red tape:** Medical, dental, and vision (100% for employees, 50% for partner and kids). No weird loopholes, just care that works
- **Life & Disability insurance:** Employer-paid basic life and AD&D, short-term disability, and long-term disability. Coverage for life's curveballs
- **Virtual care and a health guide:** Teladoc for the couch doctor visit, plus Rightway to answer coverage questions and fight billing errors for you
- **Mental health:** Talkspace, therapy and psychiatry on your schedule
- **Fertility and family building:** Carrot, covering you and your partner
- **EAP:** Free confidential counseling, legal and financial consults, and online will prep through Guardian
- **401(k) plan:** Retirement might be a ways off, but future-you will thank you
- **Pre-tax benefits:** HSA, FSA, and commuter benefits to help your wallet out a bit
- **Supplemental options:** Extra life and AD&D, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, plus pet, legal, and identity protection through MetLife

## **Available to SF-based employees**

- **SF HQ perks:** Snacks, drinks, team lunches, intense ping pong, and peak startup energy
- **E-Bike transportation:** A loaner electric bike to get you around the city, on us

# **Interview Process**

**Application Review:** Send us your work: examples of brand or copy you've owned, social presence you've grown, or positioning you've built. Add a quick note on why Firecrawl, and what you'd want to change about how we show up today.

**Intro Chat (~25 min):** A quick conversation to get to know each other before we go deep. We'll talk about what you've built, your instincts on developer brand, and what you'd prioritize first. Time for your questions too.

**Deep Dive Chat (~45 min):** Walk us through a real example: a time you owned positioning for a technical product and it worked. Then we'll dig into a live scenario: how would you differentiate Firecrawl against our closest competitors? Come ready to think out loud. We care about taste and reasoning, not a rehearsed pitch.

**Founder Chat (~25 min):** Culture, pace, ownership, and how you like to work. Time for your questions too.

**About Parisi Labs**

Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions.

Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators.

We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products.

**About the role**

You will work directly with our co-founder and Chief Scientist, Matt Miller, to develop, implement, and test our core models. Matt's background spans MIT Media Lab, Bluefin Labs, nearly a decade in Twitter Cortex Applied Research, and leading Data and ML at Automattic.

We are looking for a researcher who can innovate, collaborate, and build foundation-scale models of complex, nonstandard systems. You will own independent lines of research while contributing to the team's central model-development work. This requires novel invention alongside meticulous rigor, strong engineering, and a commitment to real-world impact.

Our current work centers on generalizable time-series foundation models across electricity prices, demand, and generation on multiple grids. These systems reflect interactions among human behavior, energy markets, large-scale weather, and the physical grid. Open research questions include generalization, physical constraints and interactions, holistic world modeling, and simulation.

**What you'll own**

- Collaborate with the Chief Scientist to develop proprietary, state-of-the-art advances in time-series foundation models and world models.
- Train and test models on difficult, valuable, real-world forecasting tasks.
- Own independent research directions from hypothesis through implementation, experiments, ablations, and clear technical conclusions.
- Investigate multimodal inputs and event data, alongside methods for representing physical constraints and interactions.
- Work with engineers to productionize and ship successful research into systems that support real decisions.
- Extend advances beyond energy into domains such as supply chain, logistics, water, oil and gas, manufacturing, and predictive maintenance.
- Maintain reproducible experiments and communicate findings with the rigor needed to distinguish genuine progress from misleading results.

**What we're looking for**

- 5+ years of combined post-graduate and industry experience in ML research.
- A demonstrable history of research contributions and innovation that either genuinely advance the state of the art or deliver real business impact.
- Deep expertise in relevant technologies, such as time-series foundation models, world modeling, simulation, dynamical systems, and optimization.
- Creative problem-solving abilities and high adaptability.
- Strong coding and engineering skills: the ability to build in addition to invent.
- Relevant industry experience, such as energy, supply chain, or manufacturing, is a significant plus, not a requirement.

We are looking for PhD-level depth of knowledge and expertise, but recognize that this can be achieved in many ways; a PhD is not required. This is not a purely academic role. We need someone creative, passionate about impact, and able to execute and build while making full use of their technical expertise.

**First 90 days**

- 90 days: Establish an independent research direction, deliver evidence-backed findings, and work with engineers to translate promsing results into the core system.

**Why join**

Research is central to the company's thesis. You will help develop genuine research intellectual property, advance the frontier of the field, and apply those advances to difficult, complex, valuable problems in physical industry. You will work directly with the founders and engineers who turn that research into useful technology.

**Location and compensation**

Salary range: $210,000–$275,000 USD.

Equity: meaningful early-company equity.

title: Software Engineer — Medley Learning
description:
## About Medley Learning

Medley Learning is building AI for the real work of classrooms: support that helps students access rigorous learning, gives teachers time back, and earns the trust of schools. Medley is an instructional support tool for multilingual learners that helps students access grade-level content without being separated from core instruction. Our browser extension layers individualized reading and writing scaffolds directly onto the digital materials schools already use, including curriculum platforms, Google Docs, websites, and PDFs. Supports are tailored to a student's English proficiency level and home language, so students get the help they need in real time while staying engaged with the same rigorous content as their peers.

Medley supports the whole school ecosystem: students get more equitable access to grade-level work, and teachers save significant time by not having to manually create differentiated supports for every lesson. The goal is stronger student participation, reduced teacher burden, and better instructional outcomes in classrooms tasked with meeting increasingly diverse needs. Medley is grounded in research-backed practices and is already being used by over 20 districts across the US.

Medley is led by CEO Brandon Cardet-Hernandez, a former multilingual learner who has worked across K-12 as a teacher, turnaround principal, policy advisor, and edtech leader. We're backed by Workshop Ventures and advised by leading researchers.

## The Opportunity

This is a hands-on engineering role on a small team where the interface *is* the product. Medley's scaffolds live inside a Chrome extension that sits on top of whatever a student is already reading, so the front end has to be fast, beautiful, accessible, and resilient to pages we don't control. Behind it is a data layer that's more interesting than it looks: student proficiency levels, home languages, content extracted from wildly different sources, and AI-generated supports that need to be stored, versioned, evaluated, and kept private.

We're looking for an engineer who is strongest on the front end (React, TypeScript) but thinks in systems — someone who can build a polished component *and* reason about where its data comes from, how it's modeled, and what happens when it scales to many classrooms. We'd love to find someone with a real eye for UI/UX who can contribute to design decisions, not just implement them.

You'll work directly with our Head of Engineering and a small, senior team, with real ownership from day one.

## What You'll Do

- **Build the front end.** Develop and ship features in our React/TypeScript Chrome extension and web apps, with attention to performance, accessibility (WCAG), and the realities of injecting UI into third-party pages.
- **Shape the user experience.** Partner on UI/UX design — wireframes, interaction patterns, visual polish — and help turn rough ideas into intuitive experiences for students and teachers. Design tool experience is a plus; design instinct is essential.
- **Think in systems.** Understand and contribute to our data models and APIs (Node.js, MongoDB): how student, content, and scaffold data fit together, how it flows through the extension, and how we keep it correct and private.
- **Expand product coverage.** Help Medley work seamlessly across more websites, learning platforms, Google Workspace tools, and PDF-based materials.
- **Support AI product quality.** Work with the engineering team on the interfaces and data that let us evaluate and improve AI-generated scaffolds.
- **Build for trust.** Contribute to privacy, security, and reliability as we scale with school partners.
- **Operate with ownership.** Take initiative, solve problems independently, and help shape engineering culture on a small, fast-moving team.

## What We're Looking For

- **Strong React and TypeScript skills.** You've built and shipped production front ends and care about component design, state management, and performance.
- **Systems thinking.** You're comfortable reading and writing backend code, and you naturally ask how data is modeled, where it lives, and how it moves — even when the task in front of you is a UI.
- **Design sensibility.** You notice when something feels off, can articulate why, and can propose something better. You've collaborated with (or been) the person sketching the interface.
- **Product mindset.** You think beyond the ticket and care about what should be built, for whom, and why.

title: Fundraising manager
description:
FUNDRAISING MANAGER

Company: Skandax Nexus Private Limited
Position: Fundraising Manager
Engagement Type: Performance-Based / Success Fee

1. Role Objective

The Fundraising Manager will be responsible for identifying, approaching, negotiating with, and facilitating potential investors and funding sources for Skandax Nexus Private Limited.

2. Responsibilities

- Identify potential angel investors, venture capital firms, strategic investors, institutions, and other legitimate funding sources.
- Generate and manage investor leads.
- Present the company's business model, products, projects, financial projections, and funding requirements.
- Arrange and coordinate investor meetings.
- Follow up with potential investors until completion of the fundraising process.
- Assist management during negotiations and due diligence.
- Maintain confidentiality of company and investor information.
- Coordinate with the directors until the investment amount is successfully received.

3. Performance-Based Compensation

The Fundraising Manager will receive a success fee based only on funds actually received by Skandax Nexus Private Limited through investors directly introduced or substantially facilitated by the Fundraising Manager.

Funds Successfully Raised| Success Fee
Up to ₹25 lakh| 5%
₹25 lakh – ₹1 crore| 4%
₹1 crore – ₹5 crore| 3%
Above ₹5 crore| 2%

The applicable percentage will be calculated on the amount actually received by the Company.

4. Payment of Success Fee

The success fee shall become payable after the investment funds are credited to the Company's designated bank account.

Where an investment is received in multiple tranches, the corresponding success fee shall be paid proportionately after each tranche is received.

5. No Guaranteed Compensation

No fixed salary or guaranteed compensation shall be payable unless separately agreed in writing.

The Fundraising Manager's compensation is primarily performance-based and depends on successful fundraising.

6. Investor Protection

The Fundraising Manager shall not:

- Make unauthorized promises or representations to investors.
- Guarantee returns or profits.
- Alter company valuation or investment terms without written approval from the Company.
- Collect investment money in a personal bank account.
- Sign investment agreements on behalf of the Company without authorization.

7. Term

The engagement shall initially remain valid for 12 months, unless terminated earlier by either party according to the agreed termination terms.

8. Confidentiality

All business plans, financial information, investor information, intellectual property, technology, customer information, and other confidential information obtained during the engagement shall remain confidential.

9. Approval

All final investment terms, valuation, equity allocation, agreements, and acceptance of funds shall remain subject to approval by the authorized directors of Skandax Nexus Private Limited.

title: Educational Growth & Curriculum Specialist
description:
SkillWhimsy is building a conversational AI learning platform where people can learn through interactive, personalized learning experiences instead of simply watching videos or reading static course material.

We are looking for an **Educational Growth & Curriculum Specialist** who can identify what people actually want to learn and turn that demand into focused, engaging learning experiences.

### What you'll do

* Identify learning needs and trending questions across Reddit, Facebook, LinkedIn, forums, and other online communities.
* Find topics where people are actively looking for guidance — from *“What does a mechatronics engineer actually do?”* to specific technical skills, university preparation, career paths, or professional knowledge.
* Design short, practical curricula around these real-world needs.
* Create interactive learning paths using the SkillWhimsy platform.
* Share relevant learning experiences with communities where these questions are already being discussed.
* Experiment with different topics, formats, and acquisition channels.
* Talk to learners and understand where they struggle or drop off.
* Measure whether learners start, complete, and continue learning.
* Help us discover which educational niches SkillWhimsy should focus on.

### What we're looking for

You don't necessarily need to be a traditional teacher.

You might be an educator, tutor, instructional designer, content creator, university student/graduate, community builder, or someone with a strong interest in education and technology.

What's more important is that you:

* understand how people learn;
* can research unfamiliar topics and structure knowledge clearly;
* are comfortable engaging with online communities;
* have strong written communication skills;
* are curious about AI and the future of education;
* enjoy experimenting rather than following a predefined curriculum;
* think about outcomes, not just content creation.

### How we think about the role

This is not a traditional curriculum-development position where we give you a syllabus and ask you to produce 50 lessons.

We want to work **demand-first**:

**Find a real learning need → create a focused curriculum → reach the people who need it → measure whether they learn and continue.**

You'll have significant freedom to propose topics and experiments.

Together, we'll define **30/60/90-day goals** around learner acquisition, engagement, curriculum completion, and retention.

### Example experiment

You discover that students are repeatedly asking:

**“Should I study mechatronics? What will I actually learn?”**

Instead of writing another blog post about it, you could create a short interactive SkillWhimsy curriculum:

**“Is Mechatronics for Me?”**

The learner explores mechanics, electronics, programming, and control systems through short explanations and exercises, tests their understanding, and gets a clearer picture of whether they want to pursue the field.

Then we measure:

**Did people click? → Did they start? → Did they finish? → Did they continue learning?**

### Why join us

SkillWhimsy is still early, which means this role can have a significant influence on both the product and our educational strategy.

We're looking for someone who wants to experiment with a new model of education — combining **AI, conversational learning, curriculum design, community discovery, and growth**.

If you like the idea of discovering what people want to learn and then building the shortest path for them to learn it, we'd love to talk.

Please apply by email at kukodajanos@icloud.com with the subject line "Educational Growth & Curriculum Specialist". Include a short note on your background and why this excites you.

title: English Curriculum Fine-Tuner — for teachers with real, active students (AI-native, remote, trial-based)
description:

We already have an English curriculum on the platform. We're not looking for someone to build a channel or find new learners cold — we're looking for a working English teacher who already has real students, willing to use those students as the real-world test bed. Your own students actually using the material, and coming back to it, is the proof that your fine-tuning made it better. That's the whole point of this role.

## What you'd do

Please don't use Wellfound's apply button — email us directly at **kukodajanos@icloud.com** with the subject line exactly:

**How would you like to work in an environment in which you can directly shape the product?**

At Molten Cloud, we don't believe in artificial boundaries or engineering silos. We don't split our team into front-end and back-end camps; everyone here has the opportunity to work across the entire stack. We pair this high level of project autonomy with a fully remote setup, company-covered AI coding tools, and a healthy culture that actually insists you take your vacation time.

Molten Cloud is a media rights and royalties platform used by roughly 80 customers to manage complex rights, avails, and royalty calculations. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our small, high-leverage Royalties engineering team, working on correctness-critical financial logic — including our next-generation flexible royalty waterfall engine.

This is not a “move fast and break things” role. Royalty calculations are the product — customers are paid based on what this system computes, and correctness is non-negotiable. You'll be joining two senior engineers already deep in this domain, and will be expected to own significant pieces of design and implementation with minimal hand-holding.

We are a diverse, highly collaborative team backed by top-tier venture funds and prominent investors, including Jack Dorsey, Ashton Kutcher, and Michael Ovitz.

The problems we solve are consequential and every day we manage petabytes of data. In fact, our technology touches over 10% of all movies known to exist on IMDb.

* Partner directly with product on ambiguous requirements — translating business/contract logic into precise acceptance criteria, not just code
* Contribute to test strategy for financial correctness (a genuine gate on this team, not a formality)

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong data modeling skills, including experience enforcing integrity and precision in NoSQL/document databases (MongoDB experience a strong plus)
* Comfort operating with real ambiguity — you'll help define the spec, not just build to one
* Track record in a small or scaling company environment
* Working familiarity with core accounting concepts (general ledger, AR/AP, double-entry bookkeeping) — we're extending the platform into general ledger functionality in the near term

title: Head of Cyber Safety
description:
## **About Gray Swan**

Gray Swan is on a mission to empower the world to use AI safely and securely. We evaluate AI models for the leading frontier labs along with building real-time threat detection and adaptive adversarial red teaming agents for teams deploying AI.

We're a team of approximately 50 people, well-funded, growing quickly. Our work directly influences how the world deploys AI agents and systems at scale..

[_Learn more about how we work_](https://www.grayswan.ai/about).

## **The Role**

Come build and lead Gray Swan's cyber safety capability from the ground up, serving as the technical authority on AI-enabled cyber risk across red-teaming, evaluation, benchmarking, defenses, and safety infrastructure development. You'll help define how frontier AI systems are evaluated for offensive cyber capabilities while partnering with leading AI labs to reduce real-world security risks.

This role sits at the intersection of offensive security, AI safety, and machine learning. You'll transform deep cybersecurity expertise into scalable evaluation methodologies, safety infrastructure, and automated defenses that help establish industry standards for frontier model security.

**If you have deep expertise in offensive cybersecurity, vulnerability research, or adversarial AI security, experience evaluating frontier models, and are driven to reduce catastrophic cyber risks from increasingly capable AI systems, we'd love to hear from you.**

## **What You’ll Do:**

- Design and lead adversarial evaluations of frontier LLMs for offensive cyber capabilities, including vulnerability discovery, exploit development, malware generation, privilege escalation, social engineering, persistence, and autonomous cyber operations across text, agentic, and multimodal systems.
- Partner closely with machine learning engineers to translate cybersecurity expertise into scalable benchmarks, classifiers, guardrails, automated detection systems, and evaluation infrastructure for both internal products and frontier AI lab deployments.
- Develop and maintain Gray Swan’s catastrophic cyber harm taxonomy, continuously evolving cyber evaluation frameworks as frontier model capabilities rapidly advance.
- Produce technical risk assessments and actionable recommendations for frontier AI labs, enterprise customers, and internal stakeholders, helping guide responsible model deployment and security mitigations.
- Build, mentor, and lead a world-class team of cybersecurity subject matter experts while establishing scalable evaluation processes, quality standards, and technical infrastructure.
- Represent Gray Swan as the company's cybersecurity authority, collaborating with frontier AI labs, security researchers, government partners, and the broader AI safety and cybersecurity communities.

## **Who You Are:**

- Deep technical expertise in offensive cybersecurity, vulnerability research, exploit development, penetration testing, malware analysis, reverse engineering, or a closely related field through industry, research, or equivalent experience.
- Significant experience assessing advanced cyber threats, offensive tooling, or AI-enabled cyber capabilities, especially in critical infrastructure domains.
- Hands-on experience conducting adversarial evaluations, AI red-teaming, LLM security research, or building evaluation datasets for frontier AI systems.
- Comfortable operating at the intersection of cybersecurity research, AI safety, and machine learning engineering.
- Thrive in highly ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you'll define strategy while building entirely new capabilities.
- A builder who enjoys creating teams, infrastructure, and evaluation systems from scratch.

## **Bonus Points If You Have:**

- Experience developing machine learning models, AI security classifiers, or automated cyber detection systems.
- Hands-on experience red-teaming frontier language models, jailbreaking, prompt injection research, or agentic AI evaluations.
- Experience working with frontier AI labs, national security organizations, or leading cybersecurity research teams.
- Background in threat intelligence, autonomous cyber operations, AI agent security, or AI governance.
- Strong software engineering experience in Python, Go, Rust, or other systems programming languages.

If you don’t have 100% of these, you should still seriously consider applying. We care more about what you can do than your credentials.

## 

## **You’ll Thrive Here If You:**

- Want visibility across the frontier of AI security by evaluating multiple frontier models and working directly with the world's leading AI labs.
- Are excited to build the infrastructure that makes AI cyber safety scalable.
- Feel motivated to reduce catastrophic cyber risks posed by increasingly capable AI systems.
- Enjoy turning offensive security research into practical defenses that improve the safety of frontier AI.
- Have a vision for what world-class AI cyber safety should look like—and are excited to build it.

## **What We Offer:**

We offer a competitive compensation package designed to reward impact and incentivize growth. Our compensation philosophy is informed by our current valuation and recent industry data.

Compensation: **$230,000 - $280,000** plus performance based bonus and meaningful equity package

**Benefits:**

- 401k with up to 4% matching
- 28 days annual leave (vacation + holidays)
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- Catered lunches (Pittsburgh office)
- Flexible work arrangements
- Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates

🗣 Recruiter Screen. We learn about you; you learn about us.

🧑‍💻 Technical interview or Hiring Manager Interview.

💻 Role related assesment

🗣 Experience & culture interview

📃 Offer. If it’s mutual, we move fast.

Submit your resume, link to your portfolio, and answer the questions on the application.

title: Chief Technology Officer & Technical Co-Founder — HEAL
acceptedRemoteLocations: San Francisco Bay Area, United States
description:
I'm Anu, founder of HEAL. I started this because I believe some of the hardest problems in healthcare aren't technical - they're emotional. People don't stop taking care of themselves because they forget or don't know better. They stop because nothing in their life is actually listening to them. HEAL is my answer to that: a voice-first companion built into a physical device, designed so technology can finally feel less like a tool and more like presence.

This idea started as my grad thesis, and it's grown into something real enough to win an AWS Hackathon, get featured by the James Dyson Award, and now, into a company I'm building for the long run. We have a working first version, a small team that believes in this deeply, advisors in psychiatry and healthcare who keep us honest, and a raise underway to take this to the next stage. What's missing is someone to build the technical soul of this thing alongside me.

I'm not looking for someone to just execute a spec. I'm looking for a real partner - someone with a strong AI/technical background who gets excited by hard, high-stakes problems, who can go deep into architecture one day and sit in a room with a psychiatrist the next and translate between the two. Someone who can push back on me, who has their own conviction about how this should be built, and who wants ownership that matches that kind of investment — not just a title.

Practically, that probably means: you've built and shipped real AI/ML systems, ideally something conversational or voice-based; you're comfortable with the ambiguity of very early stage, where the architecture isn't decided yet and a lot of it will be yours to decide; and you care about the "why" here as much as the "how" — this only works if the tech stays in service of feeling human, never the other way around.

I can't tell you exactly what this will look like in two years, because that's a big part of what we'd be building together. What I can tell you is what it feels like right now: early, a little scrappy, full of real conviction, and worth doing right. If that resonates — if you've been waiting for something worth building from scratch with someone who'll match your intensity — I'd love to talk.

The most important thing that would be considered for this job would be your EQ, personality and curiosity. 

San Francisco-based. Founder-level equity. Let's see if this is a fit, for the company and for each other.

title: Data Scientist - Ads Marketplace
description:
#### **#TeamNextdoor**

Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at [**nextdoor.com**](http://nextdoor.com/).

#### **Meet Your Future Neighbors**

As a Data Scientist at Nextdoor, you will help design and oversee product experiments and own complex analyses to drive company and product strategy. We use a semi-embedded team structure, in which a group of data team members works on a specific product or pillar, interfacing directly with product and engineering stakeholders. The Data Science group consists of people from a diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives, trained in fields as wide-ranging as economics, physics, statistics, and operations research. We are an integral part of the product development organization and play an active and collaborative role in building and improving the product.

At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we’re looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI-assisted outputs. 

We also offer a warm, inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model and provides flexibility for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London.

#### **The Impact You’ll Make**

As a Data Scientist on the Monetization Team, you will drive revenue growth and advertiser value by focusing on the machine learning auction ads delivery layer. You’ll directly contribute to growing and improving our core Ads products and help lead us into the future of data and revenue at Nextdoor. Responsibilities will include shaping ranking models and objective functions, establishing an explainability layer for model feedback loops, and performing auction measurement. The role offers the opportunity to drive the roadmap and explore potential applications for artificial intelligence and large language models.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and driven candidate to accelerate our efforts and be a major part of our data-centric culture. This person will work closely with various cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Sales & Finance to develop and deliver metrics, analyses, solutions, and insights, with actionable recommendations to business partners. 

**Your responsibilities may include:**

- Design and develop algorithms and models to optimize Ads Marketplace performance, driving value for both end-users and Advertisers
- Experiment design: Make sure we run experiments efficiently and accurately, including monitoring early feature development through tracking post-release follow-ups
- Develop and share key strategic insights through data analysis, including designing experiments and evaluating the performance and impact of data-driven content
- Partner with cross-functional teams to support product development efforts (including product, design, engineering, marketing, and operations)
- Participate in in-person Nextdoor events such as trainings, off-sites, volunteer days, and team-building exercises
- Build in-person relationships with team members and contribute to Nextdoor’s company culture

#### **What You’ll Bring To The Team**

- 4+ years of relevant Data Science experience
- Experience in Ads Marketplace and/or Monetization experience
- Experience architecting, debugging, and executing complex SQL queries
- Excellent knowledge of Python, including common scientific computing packages and data science tools such as numpy, pandas, and scikit-learn
- Experience formulating, running, and sharing complex analyses, including different types of experiments, causal inference studies, and other exploratory analysis work
- Innate curiosity around finding meaningful insights that inform the way we think about and develop both our product and our business strategies
- Eagerness to explore and apply AI and emerging technologies to reimagine how work gets done

#### **Bonus Points**

- Work experience related to social or community-based products
- Work experience related to small businesses and marketplaces
- Work experience related to advertising and auction systems
- Experience with agentic coding platforms such as Cursor or Windsurf

#### **Rewards**

Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

The starting salary for this role in the San Francisco area is expected to range from $153,000 to $208,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location.

We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date.

When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee-only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care.

At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

For information about how we collect and use applicants’ personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found[ here](https://help.nextdoor.com/s/article/Personnel-Privacy-Policy?language=en_US).

title: Product Engineer - Haskell
description:
Websites are crucial for businesses—helping them get found and chosen online. Yet for many small businesses, websites become a burden. They launch with high hopes, spending countless hours on every little detail, aiming for perfection. But soon after launch... no more updates. The website sits untouched, slowly becoming outdated, broken, and buried by search engines, eventually joining the ranks of the "living dead" websites in the vast online cemetery.

To address this issue, CentralApp (soon rebranding to [https://stride-site.com/](https://stride-site.com/) ) is moving away from a template-first approach (such as Wordpress or Wix) and is developing an innovative method for website creation. This new approach integrates numerous pre-designed business modules, alongside a branding engine that offers millions of possibilities. This combination aims to deliver an optimal design and content with minimal effort.

Our solution is currently used by thousands of businesses across Europe, mostly in France, Belgium, Italy & Spain.

In addition to our website product, we offer a suite of tools designed to enhance your impact: an Integration Marketplace, Advanced Website Forms, Client inbox & clients list, Local SEO with Listing Management, an Instagram Wall, and a Review Wall.

### What will you be doing? 

***This is not a narrow frontend role or backend role***

We are looking for a Product Engineer who can take an ambiguous product problem and drive it to production: clarify the user experience, define the expected behavior, prototype quickly, implement the frontend, shape the API contract, and work with backend owners to ship the full solution.

Your strongest execution layer should be backend & dev ops. You should be able to review Haskell code independently and maintain a high bar on performance, accessibility, maintainability, and product correctness.

You do not need to be a production front-end engineer aswell (AI will do the translation, or frontend focused colleague can help) but you do need to be able to reason about front-end constraints, including UX and be able to implement Front-end parts of the project you will work on.

### Current stack

Our backend includes Haskell services and Node.js

Our frontend stack includes: React, including server-side rendering and Node.js

Our infra is AWS focused.

### Responsibilities

As a Product Engineer, you will:

- Turn ambiguous product problems into clear user flows, product behavior, edge cases, and success criteria.
- Build and maintain scalable, modular, high-performance frontend code.
- Review backend and frontend implementation independently across UX, code quality, performance, accessibility, maintainability, and product correctness.
- Define API contracts and backend expectations clearly.
- Collaborate with backend engineers on architecture, data models, permissions, error handling, observability, and performance.
- Use AI tools to accelerate prototyping, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and technical exploration.
- Critically review AI-generated output and stay accountable for correctness, maintainability, and product quality.
- Balance speed, simplicity, performance, maintainability, and user experience.
- Keep the end user, business impact, SEO, accessibility, and product quality in mind.

**Requirements**

We are looking for a Product Engineer who can operate like a one-person product strike team when needed.

### **This role is for you if**

- You want to own outcomes end to end: clarify the problem, define the product behavior, implement the frontend, coordinate backend work (or even develop it depending on which service we need to act on), and ship.
- You are strong enough in frontend to review React code independently, while also reasoning about APIs, data models, permissions, backend constraints, and edge cases.
- You use AI to move faster, but still trace the logic, adapt the output to the codebase, and verify the result before it reaches review.

### **This role is not for you if**

- You want a pure frontend implementation role with detailed tickets, finalized designs, and predefined APIs.
- You expect product managers, designers, or backend engineers to make the hard product and technical decisions before you start.
- You prefer narrow specialization, heavier process, or avoiding ownership of backend or UX constraints, edge cases, and AI-assisted output quality.

**Benefits**

- Remote-first role, with flexibility in how and where you work.
- Preferred timezone: anywhere between London and Singapore
- High ownership: you will have real influence over product direction, technical decisions, and the evolution of the stack.
- Flexible working setup, focused on output, autonomy, and impact rather than rigid process.
- Opportunity to work across product, design, frontend, backend architecture, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
- Small, experienced team where strong contributors can move fast and have visible impact.

title: Technical Cofounder — building AI native public accounting service (10-person big 4)
description:
This is a cofounder role; not a paid advisor or CTO or engineer role. There's no cash compensation yet.
Please only apply if you want to build and are ready to build with another cofounder.

About the company
We're building a ten-person Big 4 a SaS (service as softare) company: a licensed accounting and tax advisory firm where an always-on team of AI agents does the work and a small number of licensed CPAs review and sign.
Clients buy an outcome — a technical accounting memo, an R&D credit study, an income tax provision, a valuation — at a fixed price, delivered in 48 hours instead of three weeks. Public accounting is a $650B industry priced on the assumption that expertise is human and therefore scarce. That assumption just stopped being true.
Not software sold to accountants. A firm. Law has its AI-native firm. Medicine has one. Accounting doesn't yet.

What you'll own
Engineering and product, end to end, as a genuine cofounder — not a first engineer
The agent stack: multi-agent systems that draft professional deliverables to a standard a licensed CPA will sign
Document ingestion and extraction from messy client source material — trial balances, general ledgers, prior-year returns, contracts, board minutes
A hybrid reasoning architecture: deterministic calculation where numbers must tie out, model reasoning where judgment is required
Source grounding and citation verification against primary tax and accounting authority
The review layer — self-checking, uncertainty flagging, and escalation, so human review drops from 100% of output to a fraction
Audit trail and evidence generation that holds up to a regulator, an insurer, or a peer reviewer
The learning loop: playbooks, client context and patterns that make engagement #20 dramatically cheaper than engagement #1
Technical hiring and architecture decisions as we grow


Requirements
Founder intent
5+ years building software, with meaningful time as a senior/staff/lead engineer or a technical founder
Shipped production LLM or agent systems that real users depended on — not demos, prototypes, or internal experiments
Strong Python (or equivalent) and hands-on experience with modern agent frameworks, tool use, RAG and evals
Experience in correctness-critical domains where "close enough" fails — finance, healthcare, legal, compliance, payments, or similar
Comfortable with document-heavy and calculation-heavy problems (PDF/Excel parsing, structured extraction, numerical accuracy)
Able to go from zero to a working, client-usable system independently and fast
Comfortable operating pre-funding, pre-product, with ambiguity that resolves through customer contact rather than planning


Nice to have
Built evaluation harnesses or QA systems for LLM output
Experience with SOC 2, data security, or handling regulated client data
Prior startup founding or very early-stage experience
Familiarity with accounting, tax, or fintech workflows — a bonus, not a requirement

Who you'd be working withLotus Li, CPA — I've sat on every side of this industry:
KPMG — senior associate, audit
Razer (VP of Finance) and Printronix (Corporate Controller) — the buyer, hiring Big 4 and regional firms and knowing exactly which fees were worth paying

title: REAL ESTATE SALES AGENT — TRAINING & MENTORSHIP PROVIDED
description:
Creative Real Estate Pros is a New York real estate brokerage working across commercial, residential, and creative spaces.

We’re looking for motivated people who want to build a career in real estate and are willing to learn, prospect, follow a process, and consistently work opportunities from first contact through closing.

Real estate experience is welcome, but it is not required. We provide structured training, technology, mentorship, inventory exposure, and supervised experience working with real prospects and properties.

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO

You’ll learn CREP’s available property inventory and how to match spaces to client requirements. You’ll market available properties through approved platforms such as Facebook Marketplace and other CREP marketing channels. You’ll respond to incoming inquiries, qualify prospective tenants and clients, maintain consistent follow-up, identify appropriate spaces, coordinate property showings, and learn how to move opportunities through the real estate process.

You’ll also learn how to prospect for new clients, landlords, property owners, and listing opportunities so you can develop your own book of business.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for people who communicate well, follow instructions, stay organized, take initiative, and follow through.

You should be comfortable using computers and online business tools, communicating by phone, text, and email, learning new systems, working independently, and traveling throughout New York City when necessary for meetings and showings.

You do not need to know everything about real estate when you start. You do need to be willing to learn and consistently apply what you are taught.

LICENSING

Applicants who already hold a New York real estate salesperson license are welcome.

Applicants who are not yet licensed may also be considered and must be willing to complete the licensing requirements necessary to perform licensed real estate activities.

TRAINING & SUPPORT

CREP provides a structured onboarding process designed to move new agents from training into supervised real-world activity.

Training includes prospect qualification, property inventory, lead generation, follow-up, property marketing, landlord prospecting, listings, showings, real estate paperwork, deal progression, and CREP systems.

After completing initial training, agents begin working on supervised live opportunities.

COMPENSATION

This is a commission-based real estate sales opportunity. Earnings depend on production, transactions completed, commission revenue received, and the agent’s level of participation in each transaction.

Specific commission structure and independent-contractor terms are reviewed during the onboarding process.

ABOUT CREP

Creative Real Estate Pros helps businesses and individuals find space for what’s next.

We work across commercial, residential, and creative real estate throughout New York City and beyond.

Our approach combines real estate knowledge, technology, marketing, local relationships, and practical guidance to help clients identify and secure the right space.

SPACE FOR WHAT’S NEXT.

THE HIRING PROCESS

We care about more than resumes.

Applicants selected to continue will be asked to complete a short CREP screening process. This allows us to evaluate communication, attention to detail, ability to follow instructions, and how applicants approach practical situations.

Candidates who successfully complete the screening may be invited to interview with CREP.

If you’re looking for an easy paycheck without prospecting, follow-up, accountability, or consistent effort, this probably isn’t the right opportunity.

If you want to learn the business and are prepared to put the work in, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer
description:
## Junior Software Engineer — Part-Time Remote LATAM

**Fixed Monthly Compensation: USD $800–$1,200
**Expected Workload: Approximately 1–2 focused hours per day **with the right experience
**Work Type: Part-Time · Fully Remote · LATAM, excluding Brazil**

We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Engineer to join our team in a **part-time, fully remote role**.

Our product is **mature, established, and already in production**, so this is not an early-stage position where you will be expected to build everything from scratch. Most of the work involves maintaining the existing product, making improvements, fixing issues, and implementing well-defined features.

We are also an **AI-friendly company**. We actively encourage engineers to use modern AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and similar tools to research problems, understand existing code, write and review code, debug issues, and work more efficiently.

### Workload and Schedule

This is a **part-time, results-oriented position**.

For an engineer with the right experience and technical ability, the typical workload is approximately **1–2 focused hours per day**.

We care more about completing tasks correctly and on time than about tracking the number of hours you spend online.

Some days may require more or less time depending on the task, but this is **not intended to be a full-time position**.

The role offers a **fixed monthly compensation of USD $800–$1,200**, depending on experience, technical ability, English communication skills, and overall fit.

### What You'll Do

* Maintain and improve an existing production software product.
* Implement small to medium-sized features.
* Investigate and fix bugs.
* Work with existing APIs, backend services, databases, and frontend components.
* Read and understand an established codebase.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code.
* Use Git and participate in pull requests and code reviews.
* Communicate progress, questions, and blockers clearly.
* Use AI development tools where appropriate to improve productivity and code quality.
* Complete assigned tasks reliably and within agreed timelines.

### What We're Looking For

* Approximately **1–2 years of professional software development experience**.
* Strong programming fundamentals.
* Experience working with an existing production codebase.
* Familiarity with APIs, databases, Git, and modern development practices.
* Experience with at least one modern programming language or framework.
* Ability to investigate technical problems independently.
* Ability to understand requirements and complete tasks with limited supervision.
* Good judgment when using AI-assisted development tools.
* Reliable internet connection.
* Strong sense of responsibility and reliability.

A Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related degree is helpful, but **equivalent practical experience is also welcome**.

### English Requirement

Strong spoken and written English is important for this position.

You should be comfortable:

* Participating in meetings in English.
* Understanding verbal instructions and follow-up questions.
* Explaining technical problems and solutions in English.
* Communicating through chat, email, and video calls.
* Asking questions when requirements are unclear.

A native accent is **not** required. Clear communication and good comprehension are what matter.

We are generally looking for **B2 English proficiency or higher**.

### AI-Friendly Work Environment

We believe experienced engineers should use AI as a productivity tool rather than avoid it.

You are encouraged to use tools such as:

* ChatGPT
* Claude
* GitHub Copilot
* AI-powered IDEs and coding assistants
* Other appropriate development and automation tools

However, you are still responsible for understanding, reviewing, testing, and validating the code you submit.

We value engineers who know how to combine **their own technical judgment with AI tools** to work efficiently.

### Nice to Have

Experience with some of the following is helpful but not required:

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Python
* Node.js
* React
* REST APIs
* SQL
* PostgreSQL or MySQL
* AWS or other cloud platforms
* Docker
* Automated testing
* CI/CD

You do not need experience with every technology listed above.

### Location

This is a **fully remote, part-time position**.

We are especially interested in candidates based in **Latin America, excluding Brazil**.

Candidates based in **Brazil** are not eligible for this position at this time.

Candidates should be able to maintain reasonable working-hour overlap with U.S. time zones when meetings or collaboration are required.

### Compensation

**Fixed monthly compensation: USD $800–$1,200**

The final amount will depend on:

* Professional experience
* Technical ability
* English communication skills
* Ability to work independently
* Productivity and reliability

The expected workload is generally around **1–2 focused hours per day for someone with the right experience**.

This role is well suited to an engineer looking for stable additional monthly income without taking on another full-time position.

### Application Process

Our hiring process is straightforward:

1. Application review
2. Short English introduction
3. Practical technical assessment
4. Final discussion

### When Applying

Please include:

1. Your current location.
2. Your years of professional software development experience.
3. Your primary programming languages and technologies.
4. Your current employment or availability.
5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.
6. Your availability to start.

We are looking for someone who can **work efficiently, communicate clearly, take ownership of assigned tasks, and use both technical experience and modern AI tools to deliver high-quality work**.

title: Founding Growth & Sales Contributor
description:
# Founding Growth & Sales Contributor — Cohort 01

**Remote — India | Contract | Performance-Based Revenue Share**

### About KRAXYS

KRAXYS Global is a pre-incorporation technology and consulting venture building AI-powered and software solutions around specific business problems.

We do not want our sales team cold-selling a vague promise such as “we provide AI solutions.”

Our process works differently.

Researchers identify a real problem inside a target company.

Developers build a focused MVP around that problem.

**Sales takes the working solution to the people who actually experience or own that problem.**

We are now building the first Growth & Sales team for **KRAXYS Founding Contributor Cohort 01**.

## The Role

Your job is to turn strong research and working products into conversations with potential customers.

You will receive approved target intelligence, decision-maker hypotheses, a working MVP and supporting documentation.

Your job is to determine how to reach the right person, communicate why the solution matters, create curiosity, run thoughtful outreach and help move qualified opportunities toward a commercial conversation.

This is not mass-spam sales.

Sending 2,000 meaningless emails is not success.

Starting one serious conversation with the right buyer can be.

### What you'll do

* Review completed KRAXYS opportunity briefs and MVPs.
* Understand the problem well enough to explain it simply.
* Identify the most appropriate decision-makers.
* Develop personalised outreach through email, LinkedIn and other appropriate professional channels.
* Run initial conversations and qualification.
* Demonstrate approved MVPs.
* Understand objections and feed them back into Research and Development.
* Maintain accurate outreach and opportunity records.
* Work with the founders during pricing, proposal and closing stages.

Contributors will not independently sign contracts, alter approved pricing, make legal commitments or promise functionality that has not been approved.

Final commercial agreements are handled by the founders.

## Compensation

This is currently a **performance-based role with no guaranteed base salary or stipend**.

For successfully converted client projects attributed to your sales work, **21% of net collected project revenue is allocated to the Sales Success Pool**.

Where one sales contributor owns the successful opportunity, that contributor receives the relevant sales allocation.

Where multiple contributors materially contribute to the same conversion, the pool is divided according to predefined attribution rules.

Payment is triggered by **client revenue actually received**, not merely by booking a meeting, obtaining verbal interest, or receiving a signed proposal.

This compensation is revenue share, **not equity or partnership ownership**.

There is no artificial earnings cap imposed on successful project attribution.

## What you'll get

You will work directly with the founders and learn through actual execution:

* B2B prospecting;
* personalised cold outreach;
* identifying decision-makers;
* selling technical solutions;
* discovery conversations;
* objection handling;
* software demonstrations;
* consulting sales;
* commercial thinking;
* the relationship between product, positioning and revenue.

You will also have the advantage of selling something far more concrete than a generic agency pitch: in many cases, a working MVP designed around the target company's own publicly observable problem.

Strong active contributors will be among the first candidates considered for formal KRAXYS internship roles following incorporation. Any future internship or employment relationship will require a separate offer and is not guaranteed.

## Who we're looking for

You do not need previous enterprise-sales experience.

You do need:

* strong written and spoken communication;
* confidence initiating conversations;
* persistence without becoming spammy;
* curiosity about businesses and technology;
* comfort with rejection;
* the ability to understand a technical product well enough to explain its commercial value;
* good judgement.

Experience with any of the following is useful but not required:

* B2B sales;
* cold email;
* LinkedIn outreach;
* consulting;
* SaaS;
* lead generation;
* copywriting;
* founder-led sales.

Applicants must be **18 or older**.

## Working model

Remote, non-exclusive and project-based.

There are no fixed hours.

Sales contributors may claim sales-ready opportunities and work them within the attribution and outreach rules of the KRAXYS platform.

The focus is outcomes and professional conduct, not attendance.

## Selection

Shortlisted applicants will receive a sample KRAXYS MVP and target company and will be asked to explain how they would approach the prospect.

This will use a simulation/example opportunity rather than unpaid selling for a live KRAXYS client.

If you like understanding people, communicating difficult ideas simply and turning good products into real conversations, we would like to hear from you.

title: Founding Development Contributor
description:
# Founding AI & Software Development Contributor — Cohort 01

**Remote — India | Contract | Project-Based | Revenue Share**

### About KRAXYS

KRAXYS Global is a pre-incorporation technology and consulting venture building focused software and AI solutions around real business problems.

Our workflow is intentionally different from a traditional software company.

Researchers identify a specific problem inside a real company. We evaluate whether it is commercially worth solving. Developers then turn the strongest opportunities into focused working MVPs that demonstrate what a better workflow could look like.

Those MVPs are then taken directly to prospective customers.

We are now selecting the first developers for **KRAXYS Founding Contributor Cohort 01**.

## The Role

You will take approved business problems and turn them into **small, convincing, working products**.

The goal is not to spend three months building a perfect SaaS platform.

The goal is to understand the essential workflow, remove unnecessary complexity, and build enough of the right thing that a potential customer can immediately understand its value.

We actively encourage modern **AI-assisted development**.

Use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or whatever helps you move faster.

But speed is not an excuse for code you cannot understand.

You should be capable of reasoning about what you ship, debugging it, changing it and explaining it.

### What you'll do

* Claim approved KRAXYS opportunity briefs.
* Understand the business problem before writing code.
* Decide the smallest MVP capable of demonstrating the proposed solution.
* Build web applications, automation workflows, AI tools, dashboards or internal-tool prototypes depending on the opportunity.
* Work primarily with synthetic, anonymised or public data during MVP development.
* Integrate APIs and LLMs where they genuinely improve the workflow.
* Deploy working demonstrations.
* Document architecture, assumptions, limitations and setup.
* Respond to founder feedback and improve the MVP before it moves to Sales.
* Occasionally support a sales conversation when technical explanation is valuable.

## Compensation

This role does **not currently include a guaranteed salary or stipend**.

For successfully converted client projects, **27% of net collected project revenue is allocated to the Development Success Pool**.

Where one developer is solely responsible for the accepted project build, that developer receives the relevant development allocation.

Where multiple developers materially contribute, the 27% pool is divided using attribution agreed for that project.

Payment is contingent on **client revenue actually being received by KRAXYS**.

Building an MVP alone does not guarantee payment if the opportunity does not convert into revenue.

This compensation is revenue share, **not equity or partnership ownership**.

## What you'll get

You will work closely with the founders on:

* AI-assisted software development;
* product scoping;
* MVP architecture;
* translating business problems into software;
* LLM and automation use cases;
* deployment and technical decision-making;
* understanding how software is actually positioned and sold.

You'll also see what happens to your build after development: what prospects respond to, what they reject, what they request and what they are actually willing to pay for.

That feedback loop is difficult to get from conventional student projects.

Strong active contributors will be among the first candidates considered for formal KRAXYS internship positions following incorporation. Future employment or internship positions will require a separate offer and are not guaranteed.

## What we're looking for

We care much more about **ability to build** than credentials.

You should be comfortable with at least some of:

* JavaScript / TypeScript;
* React / Next.js;
* Python or Node.js;
* REST APIs;
* databases;
* Git and GitHub;
* deploying applications;
* modern LLM APIs and AI development tools.

Useful but not mandatory:

* Supabase / Firebase;
* Vercel / Render / Railway;
* automation platforms;
* RAG / agent workflows;
* data processing;
* authentication;
* API integrations.

You do **not** need to know everything listed above.

We care about whether you can learn quickly and ship intelligently.

Applicants must be **18 or older**.

## Working model

Remote, flexible and project-based.

There are no fixed working hours or attendance requirements.

Developers choose whether to claim available opportunities. Once a project is claimed, however, we expect clear communication and serious ownership of the agreed deliverable.

A small thing you built and can explain probably will.
