title: Engineering Project Manager
description:
**About the Role**

**Location:** Remote (United States, Europe, Canada, or LATAM)

**Role Type:** Full-Time 

**Reporting to:** VP of Engineering

**Compensation:** $140,000 to $178,000 per year for US-based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe.

CodePath's educational programs run on our learning platform, a set of applications spanning admissions, course delivery, grading, career coaching, and reporting. A small engineering team builds and maintains all of it. As we build more and serve more learners, we need someone whose job is to keep that work organized, tested, and moving.

We're looking for an **Engineering Project Manager** who works alongside our engineers day to day. You'll keep projects organized and moving, make sure what we build gets tested and bugs get fixed, and keep the engineers, the product team, and the internal teams who use our tools in sync.

 

**Key Activities**

- Keep engineering projects organized and moving: track what's in flight, flag what's blocked, and help the team stay clear on what's next
- Own quality: test what we build, use AI to automate the repetitive parts, and write Capybara tests where they're worth it
- Run the bug pipeline: reproduce issues, prioritize them, route them to the right engineer, and confirm the fix
- Be the day-to-day connection between the engineers, the product team, and the internal teams who use our tools
- Work with us to determine when adding process or rituals might be useful, but being thoughtful about the cost and friction
- Report on status so the team and leadership know where things stand

 

**Qualifications**

- 4+ years in a project management, delivery, or QA role, ideally on a small engineering team
- Technical enough to work closely with engineers: you can reproduce a bug, read a stack trace, and write a test case to automate fixing it
- Hands-on QA experience: you've owned testing and a bug pipeline, manual or automated
- Comfort using AI tools to automate work you used to do by hand
- Good judgment about process: you add structure when it helps and leave it out when it doesn't
- Strong written and verbal communication, and you work well with people
- Comfort with ambiguity and small-team dynamics. You've worked without heavy process and know how to keep things moving without it
- Passion for education and desire to make a positive impact

**Nice to Haves**

- Familiarity with Ruby on Rails or Django codebases, the stacks we run
- Experience with Capybara, RSpec, or comparable testing tools
- Experience working with product managers and non-technical stakeholders
- Experience as the first project manager or QA hire on a team

 

**Compensation**

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for an individual contributor position at an annual salary of $140,000 to $178,000 per year for US-based applicants. Adjusted contingent on location for applicants based in Canada, LATAM, and Europe. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

 

**Full-Time Employee Benefits**

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

- Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
- Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
- Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
- Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
- ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
- Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

title: Machine Learning Engineer II- ML Systems, Models and Analysis
description:
**Role Summary**
This role is suited for a candidate with deeper interest and capability in machine learning systems, model development, model evaluation, inference workflows, experimentation, and analytical problem-solving. The candidate will work on model-driven systems that support product matching, classification, similarity search, explainability, automated decisioning, and quality improvement.
The role requires someone who can understand ML model behavior, analyze outputs, improve inference pipelines, measure performance, and collaborate with science and engineering teams to translate model capabilities into production workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* 	Build, improve, and maintain ML inference pipelines and model-serving workflows.
* 	Work on model evaluation, error analysis, performance tracking, and experimentation.
* 	Analyze model outputs to identify patterns, failure modes, precision / recall trade-offs, and           improvement opportunities.
* 	Collaborate with Data Scientists to operationalize models into production-ready systems.
* 	Support model training data preparation, labeling strategy, validation sample analysis, and benchmark creation.
* 	Work on ML systems involving embeddings, vector search, retrieval, classification, ranking, and match verdict generation.
* 	Develop analytical scripts, notebooks, dashboards, and reports to measure model performance and business impact.
* 	Help improve model explainability by surfacing signals, evidence, decision factors, and confidence indicators.
* 	Support automation workflows where model predictions are used for decisioning and downstream product workflows.
* 	Debug production ML issues related to model outputs, drift, thresholds, retrieval quality, and data inconsistencies.
* 	Contribute to building reusable ML utilities, evaluation frameworks, and experimentation workflows.

* **Required Skills**
*	Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
*	2–5 years of relevant experience in ML Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science Engineering, or Analytics Engineering.
*	Strong academic or project experience may be considered for candidates with lower industry experience
*	Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including classification, embeddings, similarity search, evaluation metrics, and model validation.
*	Experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, sentence-transformers, or similar frameworks.
*	Ability to perform model output analysis, error analysis, and metric-driven evaluation.
*	Strong analytical skills with the ability to work with datasets, derive insights, and identify improvement opportunities.
*	Good understanding of precision, recall, F1 score, confidence thresholds, false positives, false negatives, and sampling strategies.
*	Strong in SQL , Python ML Libraries and data extraction for ML analysis.
*	Familiarity with model inference pipelines and production ML workflows.
*	Experience with LLMs, prompt-based evaluation, RAG systems, or agentic AI workflows.
*	Ability to write clean, modular, maintainable code.
*	Good communication skills to explain model behavior, analysis findings, and technical trade-offs.
 
**Good to Have**
* Experience with NLP, product matching, entity resolution, semantic search, or recommendation systems.
* Exposure to vector databases or retrieval systems such as Milvus, FAISS, OpenSearch, Pinecone, S3 Vectors, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with ML Ops tools, model monitoring, experiment tracking, and deployment workflows.
* Experience working with e-commerce catalog data, product attributes, brand, size, pack, and taxonomy-related problems.
* Ability to build dashboards or analysis reports

title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer
description:
### Role ### 
We're looking for a **Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer** who has experience building and operating **high-scale production systems**.

You should be someone who understands software as well as infrastructure—you can write code, debug production applications, reason about distributed systems, and design the infrastructure needed to run them reliably at scale.

You'll work closely with backend and infrastructure engineers to build the platform that enables the product to **scale reliably, deploy quickly, and operate with minimal manual intervention**.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership and technical depth.

### What You'll Own

* Design and operate **highly available, scalable production infrastructure on GCP**.
* Build the infrastructure and platform required to support rapidly growing applications and services.
* Design and maintain **CI/CD and deployment systems** that enable engineers to ship safely and frequently.
* Design and manage **CDN infrastructure** to efficiently serve high volumes of static and dynamic content.
* Work with **Google Cloud Media CDN** for high-scale delivery of video and other media-heavy workloads.
* Optimize caching, cache invalidation, origins, routing, and content delivery performance.
* Work closely with engineering teams across **PHP, Node.js, and MERN stack** applications.
* Improve system reliability, performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Build strong **observability** across infrastructure and applications—metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and meaningful alerts.
* Establish and improve **SLOs, SLIs, alerting, incident response, and disaster recovery** practices.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues spanning application, infrastructure, networking, databases, and cloud services.
* Participate in architecture discussions and help engineers design systems that are easier to deploy and operate.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and automate them away.
* Own production incidents from detection through root-cause analysis and permanent remediation.
* Build secure infrastructure using appropriate **IAM, networking, secrets management, and least-privilege practices**.
* Help make infrastructure decisions around **capacity, reliability, performance, and cloud cost**.

### What We're Looking For

* **5+ years** of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or a similar role.
* Demonstrated experience operating **large-scale production applications**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **GCP** and production cloud infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of **Docker and containerized applications**.
* Experience with Google Cloud Storage / GCS buckets and large-scale object storage.
* Strong understanding of CDN architecture, caching, cache invalidation, origins, and content delivery.
* Experience with **Google Cloud CDN and/or Media CDN** is highly desirable.
* Comfortable working with **production application code**, not just infrastructure configuration.
* Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls, and cloud networking.
* Strong programming/scripting ability in **PHP and/or Node.js**.
* Experience building and operating CI/CD systems.
* Deep understanding of production reliability, including **high availability, failure modes, capacity planning, monitoring, and disaster recovery**.
* Experience debugging difficult production problems across multiple layers of a system.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, networking, secrets, and access control.
* Strong experience with **MySQL and PostgreSQL**, including performance, backups, replication/high availability, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Experience diagnosing production issues across the full stack—from application code to database, infrastructure, storage, and CDN.
* Strong ownership—you should be comfortable taking a problem from **“this is broken” to understanding why, fixing it, and ensuring it doesn't happen again**.

### Technologies

You don't need experience with every technology listed below, but you should be strong in the fundamentals.

Our Technology Stack

Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Compute: Google Cloud Engine, Google Cloud Run
Containers: Docker
Languages: PHP, Node.js
Application stacks: PHP applications, Node.js services, MERN stack
Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL
Storage: Google Cloud Storage / GCS buckets
Content Delivery: Google Cloud CDN, Media CDN
CI/CD: Automated CI/CD pipelines
Networking: VPC, DNS, load balancing, HTTPS/TLS, firewalls, NAT, private networking
Observability: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, application monitoring, metrics, logs and alerts

### What We Value

**Engineering over tooling.**
We care less about whether you've used a particular tool and more about whether you understand the underlying problem.

**Automation over manual operations.**
If something needs to be done repeatedly, you should be thinking about how to automate it.

**Reliability over heroics.**
We want systems that don't require someone to wake up at 3 AM every week.

**Ownership over ticket completion.**
You should care about the outcome, not just whether a task was completed.

**Understanding over checklists.**
You should be able to explain why a system works the way it does—and what happens when it fails.


### Why This Role

You'll have the opportunity to work on **real distributed systems at scale**, make foundational infrastructure decisions, and have a direct impact on how reliably and quickly the engineering organization can build and ship software.

If you enjoy solving hard problems at the intersection of **software, infrastructure, cloud, and distributed systems**, we'd love to talk.

title: Family Coordinator (Remote, Caribbean)
acceptedRemoteLocations: Guyana; Trinidad and Tobago; Barbados; Jamaica
description:
At Meadow, we’re reimagining end-of-life care - a $23B industry untouched by modern software or service thinking. In under a year, we became the largest cremation provider in Los Angeles, with 80+ NPS and hundreds of families served monthly. Now we’re scaling across the U.S. and hiring globally.

We believe great people live everywhere. Our team works across continents and time zones, grounded by shared values: high standards, deep empathy, and a drive to do work that matters.

Learn more about our global teams[ _here_](https://www.meadowmemorials.com/global). If this sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the Role**   
We’re hiring Family Coordinators to compassionately guide families through our full service lifecycle - from contract signature to the safe return of their loved one's ashes.

In this highly accountable role, you will take extreme ownership of a high-volume book of around 100 concurrent cases. As the primary point of contact, you'll coordinate with internal teams to seamlessly manage transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, and ashes return.

While you fully own your caseload, we are a highly collaborative team. We work together to ensure no family experiences delays during peak volumes. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, obsessed with the client experience, and a creative problem-solver comfortable navigating multiple systems to triage work and support others during a critical time.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

- Manage a high-volume book of business, overseeing the full client life cycle from contract signature through final resolution.
- Act as the dedicated point of contact, actively handling continuous inbound and outbound calls and texts throughout the workday with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.
- Guide families through each step of the process while building trust, rapport, and an exceptional overall client experience.
- Own key case milestones - transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, ashes return - partnering with internal teams and vendors to keep cases moving.
- Keep documentation meticulous, updating all systems promptly and accurately.
- Seamlessly navigate across various platforms (HubSpot, Aircall, Slack, GSuite, internal case management system) to build case context, triage daily workflows, and solve problems efficiently.
- Collaborate with teammates to maintain continuity of care - assisting with coverage, escalations, and urgent case needs as volumes shift.
- Ensure smooth case handoffs and anticipate downstream impacts.

**Requirements & Qualifications:**

- 2+ years owning a caseload or book of accounts end-to-end - case management, patient or client coordination, claims handling, or similar.
- Strong written and spoken English.
- Exceptional capacity for high volume: you can successfully manage 100+ cases simultaneously without letting details slip, and you are meticulous about record-keeping and documentation.
- Clear, calm communicator who builds trust quickly and is completely comfortable spending the majority of the workday managing communications via phone and text.
- Highly accountable and proactive: you take extreme ownership of your cases, obsess over the client experience, close the loop, and act as a creative problem solver when escalations arise.
- Tech-savvy and highly organized: you easily work across multiple systems to piece together context and effectively triage your daily priorities.
- Energized by our mission and excited about the opportunity to help shape something new in a category that truly needs it.
- A home setup that supports the work - see our[_tech requirements_](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Iap_48WyBpiBL098Y7EC15a26syH7C9vfeXk_FAcOVI/edit?usp=sharing) for details..

**Bonus Points**

- Experience in environments where empathy and execution were equally important.
- Spanish fluency — many of the families we serve speak it.

**Details:**

- Remote, full-time
- **Compensation:** $5.50-$9/hr (USD)
- **Tools**: HubSpot (CRM), Aircall (phone), Slack, and our case management system
- **Shift**: Full-time (8 hours, consistent schedule)

  - **Days**: Monday–Friday
  - **Hours**: US Day Shift: 8 a.m. - 4:30 pm Pacific Time, including a 30-minute lunch break

### **Why You’ll Love Working With Us:**

- **We’re a real business, built to last.** We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years. We’re now going national. And plan to grow for years to come.
- **A serious employer for global teammates.** We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.
- **People stay.** Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our[_Glassdoor reviews_](https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Meadow-Memorials-EI_IE10471206.11,27.htm).
- **Fair compensation with real upside.** Base pay benchmarked globally. Top performers consistently earn the full bonuses.
- **High care, high standards.** Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.
- **Benefits:** PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid training, fully remote.
- **Purpose-driven work:** Real impact during one of life's most meaningful transitions.

description:
At Meadow, we’re reimagining end-of-life care - a $23B industry untouched by modern software or service thinking. In under a year, we became the largest cremation provider in Los Angeles, with 80+ NPS and hundreds of families served monthly. Now we’re scaling across the U.S. and hiring globally.

We believe great people live everywhere. Our team works across continents and time zones, grounded by shared values: high standards, deep empathy, and a drive to do work that matters.

Learn more about our global teams[ _here_](https://www.meadowmemorials.com/global). If this sounds like your kind of team, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the Role**   
We’re hiring Family Coordinators to compassionately guide families through our full service lifecycle - from contract signature to the safe return of their loved one's ashes.

In this highly accountable role, you will take extreme ownership of a high-volume book of around 100 concurrent cases. As the primary point of contact, you'll coordinate with internal teams to seamlessly manage transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, and ashes return.

While you fully own your caseload, we are a highly collaborative team. We work together to ensure no family experiences delays during peak volumes. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, obsessed with the client experience, and a creative problem-solver comfortable navigating multiple systems to triage work and support others during a critical time.

 

**What You’ll Do:**

- Manage a high-volume book of business, overseeing the full client life cycle from contract signature through final resolution.
- Act as the dedicated point of contact, actively handling continuous inbound and outbound calls and texts throughout the workday with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.
- Guide families through each step of the process while building trust, rapport, and an exceptional overall client experience.
- Own key case milestones - transportation, documentation, cremation scheduling, ashes return - partnering with internal teams and vendors to keep cases moving.
- Keep documentation meticulous, updating all systems promptly and accurately.
- Seamlessly navigate across various platforms (HubSpot, Aircall, Slack, GSuite, internal case management system) to build case context, triage daily workflows, and solve problems efficiently.
- Collaborate with teammates to maintain continuity of care - assisting with coverage, escalations, and urgent case needs as volumes shift.
- Ensure smooth case handoffs and anticipate downstream impacts.

**Requirements & Qualifications:**

- 2+ years owning a caseload or book of accounts end-to-end - case management, patient or client coordination, claims handling, or similar.
- Strong written and spoken English.
- Exceptional capacity for high volume: you can successfully manage 100+ cases simultaneously without letting details slip, and you are meticulous about record-keeping and documentation.
- Clear, calm communicator who builds trust quickly and is completely comfortable spending the majority of the workday managing communications via phone and text.
- Highly accountable and proactive: you take extreme ownership of your cases, obsess over the client experience, close the loop, and act as a creative problem solver when escalations arise.
- Tech-savvy and highly organized: you easily work across multiple systems to piece together context and effectively triage your daily priorities.
- Energized by our mission and excited about the opportunity to help shape something new in a category that truly needs it.
- A home setup that supports the work - see our[_tech requirements_](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Iap_48WyBpiBL098Y7EC15a26syH7C9vfeXk_FAcOVI/edit?usp=sharing) for details.

**Bonus Points**

- Experience in environments where empathy and execution were equally important.
- Spanish fluency — many of the families we serve speak it.

**Details:**

- Remote, full-time
- **Tools**: HubSpot (CRM), Aircall (phone), Slack, and our case management system
- **Shift**: Full-time (8 hours, consistent schedule)

  - **Days**: Monday–Friday
  - **Hours**: US Day Shift: 8 a.m. - 4:30 pm Pacific Time, including a 30-minute lunch break

### **Why You’ll Love Working With Us:**

- **We’re a real business, built to last.** We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years. We’re now going national. And plan to grow for years to come.
- **A serious employer for global teammates.** We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.
- **People stay.** Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our[_Glassdoor reviews_](https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Meadow-Memorials-EI_IE10471206.11,27.htm).
- **Fair compensation with real upside.** Base pay benchmarked globally. Top performers consistently earn the full bonuses.
- **High care, high standards.** Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.
- **Benefits:** PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid training, fully remote.
- **Purpose-driven work:** Real impact during one of life's most meaningful transitions.

title: Growth & Marketing Engineer
description:

description:

Tava Health is on a mission to improve mental health through better access to high-quality therapy. title: Real Estate Dispositions Specialist (Commission, Potential Equity, Base Pay)
description:
7Fifteen Developments is a growing real estate startup looking for a Dispositions Specialist with a serious drive to win. This position isn't for everyone.

We're looking for a straight shooter who can build relationships with investors, negotiate confidently, follow up relentlessly, and close. We handle the acquisitions side and get properties under contract. Your job is to get them sold.

You'll have access to our established buyer database and our advanced custom-built CRM, designed specifically around our acquisition, disposition, buyer, and closing processes. You'll use our systems to manage active deals, buyer conversations, offers, follow-ups, property marketing, and the disposition pipeline from contract through closing.

You'll start by working our existing network of active investors. But when none of our buyers are the right fit, the job doesn't stop. We expect you to go find the next buyer—calling investors, researching cash buyers, networking with agents and landlords, using investor groups, social media, and whatever legitimate strategy it takes to get the property sold.

We're not looking for someone who sends one buyer blast and waits. We want someone who takes ownership, works the phones, creates competition between buyers, negotiates within our margins, and keeps pushing until we have a qualified buyer and a path to closing.

We're a startup, which means you'll also have opportunities to help propel the business forward. We want people who bring ideas, identify weaknesses in our process, suggest improvements to our custom CRM and workflows, help strengthen our buyer network, and contribute to building a scalable dispositions operation as the company grows.

If you're competitive, resourceful, comfortable hearing “no,” and get energized by turning signed contracts into revenue, there is significant opportunity to grow with 7Fifteen as we expand.

Compensation will be negotiated based on experience, proven ability, and drive to win, with performance-based earning opportunities tied to successfully closed deals.

**Responsibilities include:**
* Manage properties from signed purchase contract through assignment to an end buyer
* Market off-market investment properties to qualified buyers
* Call, text, and follow up with investors
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cash buyers
* Actively source new buyers beyond our existing database
* Negotiate buyer offers and maximize assignment spreads
* Qualify buyers and obtain proof of funds
* Coordinate property walkthroughs and buyer access
* Assist with assignment agreements and earnest money deposits
* Maintain accurate buyer and deal activity in our CRM
* Coordinate with acquisitions, buyers, attorneys/title companies, and leadership through closing
* Maintain backup buyers and help solve problems when transactions become difficult

**Who we're looking for:**

* Strong sales and negotiation ability
* Confident and professional on the phone
* Persistent follow-up and strong closing mentality
* Highly resourceful—if our existing buyer list doesn't produce a buyer, you know how to go find one
* Organized and comfortable managing multiple active deals
* Experience with CRM and sales pipeline management
* Real estate wholesaling, investment sales, dispositions, brokerage, investor relations, or similar experience preferred
* Experience with GoHighLevel, InvestorLift, PropStream, BatchLeads, REISift, InvestorBase, or similar tools is a plus

title: Quantitative Analyst — Decision Intelligence (Equipment Finance)
description:
## About Us

We are an AI-driven analytics platform startup focused on building automated decision-making solutions. Our current focus is **Athena**, our decision intelligence product for the equipment finance industry — helping lenders turn underwriting, risk, and portfolio data into real-time, automated decisions.

---

## Role Overview

This is the core quantitative role behind Athena's decision intelligence products — not a generalist business analyst or PM role. You'll own translating complex financial and risk logic into specifications our data engineering team can build against, and validate that the resulting pipelines produce numbers that are actually correct. The bar here is quantitative reasoning and data fluency, not years of BA/PM titles. There will be a structured transition period supported by our outgoing product lead.

---

## What You'll Own

- Translate complex business and financial logic — equipment lease valuation (net investment method, true present value at contractual rate, fair value at current market rate), risk-based pricing, portfolio risk concentration, vintage curve analysis, macro-to-industry credit risk sensitivity — into specs engineers can build against
- Design and evolve data pipelines iteratively: identify and specify the derived/ancillary tables needed as logic gets built out (e.g., a present-value table that has to exist before a concentration calculation can run on top of it)
- Validate model outputs directly against the database — pull raw and transformed data, sanity-check that logic was applied correctly, and catch anomalies before they reach production (e.g., an implausible vintage projection)
- Own the implementation judgment calls — null handling, edge cases, and the steady stream of clarifying questions that surface as engineers build out the logic
- Build and maintain real working knowledge of the schema — data type quirks, which values are stored raw vs. derived — so business logic maps cleanly onto what's actually in the tables
- Work directly with the founder to turn high-level business requirements into precise, unambiguous logic

---

## Must-Have

- Strong quantitative background — applied math, statistics, economics, engineering, actuarial science, or similar
- Strong SQL — comfortable writing and debugging complex queries directly against Postgres to validate outputs, not just reading dashboards built by others
- Real comfort with quantitative financial reasoning — time value of money, risk and probability concepts (equipment/lease finance exposure is a strong plus, not required)
- Ability to break an ambiguous business problem into a precise, step-by-step logical flow
- High agency — comfortable being the primary translation layer between founder and engineering with minimal oversight

---

## Nice-to-Have

- Background in credit risk, actuarial work, or quantitative/statistical modeling within lending, NBFC, or fintech
- Exposure to data pipeline concepts (ETL, orchestration tools like Dagster, layered bronze-to-gold architecture)
- FRM/CFA (partial or full) or equivalent quantitative finance coursework — not required, but signals the right reasoning muscle

---

## What We Offer

- Full-time role with a structured transition period, supported directly by the outgoing product lead
- Direct ownership of the hardest, most central problem in the product — not ticket execution
- Direct access to the founder and outsized influence over how the product's core logic is built
- A small, sharp team solving a genuinely hard problem in equipment finance



## Compensation

₹10–12 LPA, fixed cash, based on experience and demonstrated quantitative/data fluency. No equity component for this role.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Read this part first

This is a phone job. Calling prospects is the core of this role, not a side task. You will be speaking to strangers every day, people who did not ask to hear from you. If the idea of dialing a number and pitching a decision maker makes you want to close this tab, close it. We are not going to talk you into it later.

If that part does not scare you, keep reading. This is one of the fastest ways to build a career in sales, management or operations. Everything above BD gets easier once you have done this.

What you will actually do

Reach out to prospects over the phone. This is the heart of the job
Support your calls with cold email and LinkedIn outreach
Build and clean your own prospect lists using Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and manual research
Write your own copy and iterate on it based on what gets replies
Book qualified meetings for our clients across B2B SaaS, Cybersecurity, AI, Digital Agencies, Gov-Tech, Sales Automation Tools, e-Procurement and FinOps solutions
Log every call, email and outcome in the CRM. Untracked activity did not happen
Show up to daily standups and weekly reviews with your numbers ready

First 90 days

Month 1: learn the ICP, the tools and the scripts. Ramp up on calling
Month 2: hit full activity targets, book your first meetings
Month 3: carry a meeting quota like everyone else on the team

Who should apply

Fresh graduates who want to build a career in sales, management or operations
People who can speak clearly and confidently in English on the phone
People who take feedback on their calls and copy without getting defensive
People who can self manage. Remote means nobody is standing behind you
People who want to learn modern GTM tools instead of doing manual work forever

Who should not apply

Anyone uncomfortable with picking up the phone
Anyone who wants strategy work before they have booked a single meeting
Anyone who goes quiet when the numbers are bad
Anyone looking for a comfortable desk job with no scoreboard

What you get

Fixed salary plus performance incentive per qualified meeting and per closed deal
Flexible working hours as long as output and client coverage hold
Hands-on training from operators who do this work daily, not a recorded course
Direct exposure to founders and revenue leaders at client companies
Access to the modern GTM stack: Apollo, ZoomInfo, Sales Navigator, CRM and AI tooling
A path to Senior SDR, Account Executive or Ops based on results, not tenure

Mandatory requirements

Own laptop
Own phone
Stable internet connection
A quiet place to take calls
Willing to work some overlap hours for international clients when required

How to apply

Send your CV and a 60 second voice note pitching yourself as if you were cold calling us to info@trelvo.in. The voice note matters more than the CV.

title: Content Creator Internship (Remote)
description:
About the Role
We are looking for a creative and curious Content Creator Intern to join our marketing team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning ideas, trends, and information into engaging content across social media and digital platforms.

You will work closely with the marketing team to research topics, develop content ideas, write engaging copy, and support the creation of content for different brands.

What You’ll Do
Research trending topics, industry updates, competitors, and audience interests to identify relevant content opportunities.
Develop creative content ideas for LinkedIn and other social media platforms.
Write engaging hooks, captions, post copy, and short-form content.
Assist in creating content calendars and planning upcoming posts.

Monitor social media trends and identify formats, topics, and conversations that could be relevant to our brands.
Work with the marketing team to ensure content aligns with each brand’s positioning, tone, and target audience.

Review and proofread content for clarity, grammar, accuracy, and consistency.
Track content performance and help identify what types of content are generating engagement.
Participate in brainstorming sessions and contribute new creative ideas.
What We’re Looking For
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Good understanding of social media platforms, especially LinkedIn and Instagram.
Ability to research a topic and turn information into simple, engaging content.
Creativity and willingness to experiment with different content formats.
Good grammar, attention to detail, and an eye for quality.
Curiosity about marketing, business, technology, finance, or current trends.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
Basic knowledge of Canva or other content-creation tools is a plus.
Prior experience with content creation, social media, blogging, or copywriting is a plus, but not mandatory.
What You’ll Learn
How professional brands build content strategies.
Social media content planning and execution.
Content research and trend analysis.
Copywriting and creating strong hooks.
Brand positioning and tone of voice.
Content performance analysis.
How content supports broader marketing and business goals.
Who This Internship Is For
This internship is a good fit for someone who:

Is constantly coming up with content ideas.
Enjoys writing and researching.
Notices trends and asks, “How can we turn this into content?”
Wants hands-on experience rather than just theoretical learning.
Is comfortable experimenting, taking feedback, and improving their work.
Wants to build a strong portfolio of real-world marketing content.
How to Apply
Please share your resume along with any relevant content samples, social media work, writing samples, portfolio, or personal projects.

Note: You do not need professional experience to apply. If you can demonstrate creativity, curiosity, and good communication skills, we would love to hear from you.

title: Founder & Independent Web Creator
description:
Ichizenn（⼀禅堂）is an independent digital platform based in Japan, creating accessible web experiences inspired by Japanese fortune-telling, language and cultural traditions.

Our flagship product, Koi Mikuji（[恋みくじ](https://www.ichizenn.com/koi-mikuji/)）, reimagines the traditional Japanese love-fortune experience for the digital age. Designed for mobile and desktop users, it offers daily romantic fortunes and situation-specific guidance for people experiencing unrequited love, reconciliation, uncertainty, waiting for a reply and other meaningful moments in relationships.

Rather than simply reproducing traditional visual motifs, Koi Mikuji translates the anticipation, reflection and emotional resonance of drawing an omikuji into a modern interactive experience. Clear typography, thoughtful spacing and a simple user journey allow each message to remain at the center of the experience.

Ichizenn also develops a general online Omikuji service, an animated Kanji stroke-order reference and a growing collection of quotations and words of wisdom. These products share a common purpose: making Japanese culture and language approachable through useful, carefully designed digital experiences.

The platform is independently developed and operated in Japan. It is currently supported through digital advertising, with plans to expand its original tools and interactive content over time.

Official website:一禅堂

title: Fractional Sales Cofounder (c. 20% Comm. / Equity)
description:
Maia is a teaching platform. A school, college, or company puts a course on Maia. Each student gets a tutor that actually teaches: conversation, a real syllabus, a pass bar. Staff see who sat the hour, who is stuck, and what they can do.

Live product: [maia.study](https://www.maia.study). Private schools, colleges, and companies all have the same hole: an LMS that tracks attendance, content that nobody talks through, and teachers or managers who cannot sit with every learner. Maia is the class, not another library of videos.

I am the founder. I built the product. I need a partner who owns the first revenue: schools and colleges as well as companies. Design partners, paid conversions, and the sales motion. Not a BDR who waits for inbound.

I have a day job. This is not a 40-hour role on day one. Expect ~10–15 hours a week until we have paying classrooms. Equity vests. We both go full-time when the revenue says so.

**Commission: 20% – 30% uncapped revenue share on all closed cash**

**What you will do**

- Find and close the first paying classrooms: private schools, colleges, and company learning teams.
- Run outbound, discovery, demos, pilots, and close. Write the playbook as you go.
- Sit in the sale with me when the product has to prove itself. Bring the buyer. I bring the class.
- Learn which buyer actually pays (head of school, academic dean, department chair, L&D, enablement) and drop the ones that only take meetings.
- Tell me what the market will not buy. Kill bad pitches early.

**Who this is for**

- You have closed B2B yourself, preferably as employee 1–5 or founding AE. Edtech, schools, or training sales is a plus, not a requirement.
- You can get a head of school, a college admin, or a Head of People on a call without a brand name behind you.
- You are comfortable selling a live product that is still picking its first logos.
- You care whether someone actually learned something. If you only sell seats and logos, skip this.

**Who this is not for**

- Enterprise AE hunting Fortune 500 cycles and a VP title.
- Someone who needs SDR coverage, a polished deck factory, and a defined territory on day one.
- “Advisor cofounder” who wants equity for intros.

title: Affiliate Sales Partner – SaaS | Remote | Commission-Based
description:
Build a recurring income stream by growing StoryBam.

StoryBam is a SaaS platform that helps local businesses reward customers who promote them through Instagram Stories.

We are looking for ambitious, independent sales partners who want more than a traditional fixed commission.

The opportunity

This is a 100% remote, commission-based partnership with no fixed salary.

The key difference is simple:

You don't earn only when you make the sale. You continue earning recurring commissions from the customers you bring to StoryBam for as long as they remain paying customers.

Every new business you acquire can therefore increase your monthly recurring commission base.

Bring 5 customers, and you earn from those customers.

Bring 50 customers, and you build a much larger recurring income stream.

Continue growing your portfolio over time, and your monthly commissions can continue growing with it.

There is no fixed earnings ceiling.

For someone who is genuinely good at acquiring businesses, building relationships and consistently closing customers, the long-term earning potential can become substantial.

What you'll do
* Find businesses that could benefit from StoryBam
* Contact business owners and decision-makers
* Introduce StoryBam and explain how it can help their business
* Refer interested businesses using your personal affiliate code
* Build and manage your own pipeline
* Choose your own acquisition strategy: LinkedIn, email, calls, social media, networking, direct outreach or existing relationships

You decide where, when and how you sell.

How the affiliate system works

You'll receive your own affiliate account and referral code.

When a business signs up using your code, that customer is attributed to you.

You can also choose the introductory discount you want to offer prospects, giving you an additional tool to help close deals.

Your commissions are linked to the customers you acquire, allowing you to build a portfolio of recurring subscriptions rather than constantly starting from zero.

We care much more about results than formal qualifications.

You may be a good fit if you are:

* Strong at communicating with business owners
* Confident with outreach and sales
* Independent and highly self-motivated
* Comfortable working without constant supervision
* Interested in building recurring commission income over the long term
* 
Previous experience in B2B sales, SaaS, business development, lead generation or affiliate marketing is valuable, but exceptional candidates without formal experience are also welcome.

Compensation

Commission only — no base salary.

This position is designed for people who prefer uncapped performance-based earnings over a traditional fixed salary.

The more paying customers you build into your portfolio, the larger your potential recurring monthly commissions become.

Recurring commissions continue for the lifetime of the customers you refer, subject to the StoryBam Affiliate Program terms.

* Reach out to potential candidates and invite them to audition
* Share audition information with relevant communities and organizations
* Research dance communities, performance groups, creators, and other talent networks
* Help expand KIT's reach beyond Colorado Springs
* Keep track of potential candidates and outreach
* Help develop new ideas for finding talent
* Work with the PopPostor/KIT team to improve the recruitment process
* Potentially help with outreach to dance studios, performance communities, creators, and other organizations

## Who We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

* Creative and proactive
* Comfortable searching for and discovering people online
* A strong communicator
* Organized and dependable
* Comfortable reaching out to people professionally
* Interested in music, entertainment, K-pop, dance, social media, talent scouting, or artist development
* Able to work independently
* Willing to learn
* Respectful and professional when communicating with potential applicants
* Excited about helping build something from the ground up

You **do not need previous talent-scouting experience**. If you're good at finding people, communicating with others, researching communities, or creating outreach strategies, we'd love to hear from you.

## Important: What This Role Is NOT

This role does **not** involve promising anyone a position in KIT.

Scouts and recruiters will invite potential candidates to audition, but all applicants must go through the official audition process.

Final decisions regarding KIT membership will be made by the KIT/PopPostor team.

## Location & KIT Requirements

The scouting position itself is remote, and you may be located anywhere.

However, please understand that KIT is currently being developed in **Colorado Springs, Colorado**.

The current plan includes a final in-person evaluation on **October 31, 2026**.

Selected KIT members will ultimately need to be able to relocate to Colorado Springs and arrange their own transportation, housing, and personal expenses. KIT does not currently have funding or housing available for members.

## About the Unpaid Internship

KIT/PopPostor is currently an early-stage project being built with little to no funding.

Because we do not currently have the financial ability to provide compensation, this position is being offered as an **unpaid internship**.

We want to be transparent about that from the beginning rather than making promises about compensation we cannot currently guarantee.

This opportunity is intended for someone who wants practical experience contributing to an early-stage music/entertainment project and helping build a real project from the ground up.

If the project develops funding or revenue in the future, opportunities for paid work may become available, but **future compensation is not guaranteed**.

## What You Can Gain

Depending on your responsibilities, you may gain experience in:

* Talent scouting
* Artist recruitment
* Entertainment project development
* Social media outreach
* Community building
* Recruitment strategy
* Artist development
* Working with an emerging girl group
* Building a creative project from the ground up
* Behind-the-scenes music/entertainment operations

You will also have the opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape how KIT's recruitment process develops.

## Why KIT?

This isn't an established company handing you a finished system.

We're building KIT from the ground up.

There is no huge budget, established network, or major label behind this project right now. We're figuring things out, learning, experimenting, and building as we go.

That's exactly why I'm looking for people who don't just want to complete a list of tasks — I want people who see potential in what we're building and want to be part of the process.

If you believe you can help us find the next members of KIT, I'd love to hear from you.

**Apply if you're ready to help us find them.**

title: Co-founder
description:
# I’m Not Hiring an Employee. I’m Looking for My Co-Founder.

I’m looking for the person I can build my next chapter with.

I’ve done this once before.

I built **Xcelprof** with my co-founder. We built the business, understood the market, learned things the hard way, and made it work.

Eventually, my co-founder moved into the food industry.

And now, I want to build Xcelprof again.

**Same core model. Bigger vision. Bigger ambition.**

But this time, I don’t want to build it alone.

I’m looking for **one right co-founder**.

Someone who looks at an opportunity and thinks:

**“Why not us?”**

## The Opportunity

There’s a real problem in corporate hiring that I’ve been thinking about for a long time.

And this isn’t just an idea sitting in a notebook.

**I’ve already built it.
I’ve already tested it.
I understand the problem.**

Now I want to take it much bigger.

And I’m looking for someone who wants to put their name next to mine and say:

**“Let’s build this.”**

## I Don’t Care About Your Resume

I genuinely don’t care about:

→ Your age
→ Which college you went to
→ Your degree
→ Your current designation
→ How many followers you have
→ How impressive your LinkedIn looks

I care about **what you can build when nobody is watching.**

I care if you have:

→ Business sense + *duniadaari*
→ The hunger to build from **0 → 1 → 100**
→ The courage to hear “NO” 101 times and still say, *“Chalo, next try karte hain.”*
→ A deep understanding of corporate hiring
→ The ability to sell, negotiate, execute, and figure things out
→ A strong network of corporate professionals *(huge plus)*
→ Previous startup/business experience *(even bigger plus)*
→ The mindset to take ownership, not instructions

Most importantly, I want someone who **doesn’t need to be told what to do.**

Someone who sees a problem and immediately starts thinking:

**“Isko solve kaise kar sakte hain?”**

Not:

**“Mujhe kya karna hai?”**

## I’m Looking for a Builder

Someone who:

**Talks business.
Thinks business.
Lives business.**

Someone who gets excited by:

→ A blank page
→ A crazy idea
→ A difficult problem
→ A first customer
→ A first rejection
→ A first ₹1 earned

Because that’s what building a company actually is.

Not fancy offices.

Not startup titles.

Not LinkedIn posts about entrepreneurship.

**It’s figuring shit out. Every. Single. Day.**

There will be uncertainty.

There will be rejection.

There will be days when nothing works.

There will be days when we question everything.

And then there will be that one day when we look back and say:

**“Damn. We actually built this.”**

## This Is Not a Job

There is no fixed JD.

No 9–5.

No “that’s not my responsibility.”

No waiting for someone to tell you what comes next.

If the company wins, **you win.**

If the company loses, **we figure it out together.**

I’m not looking for someone to work for me.

**I’m looking for someone to build with me.**

Someone who wants:

**Ownership.
Responsibility.
Risk.
Upside.
And the satisfaction of creating something from the ground up.**

I’m not looking for 100 people.

I’m looking for **ONE right person.**

So if you’re reading this and thinking:

**“This is exactly the kind of crazy I’ve been looking for.”**

Maybe we should talk.

**Let’s build.**

description:
Confident powers analytical testing labs — the labs that test samples on behalf of businesses and report product safety to consumers and regulators at high volume. When a lab publishes a result through our platform, businesses make decisions with it and regulators rely on it. Our technology is essential to thousands of businesses across North America, and we're scaling our product to match a growing opportunity.

We're hiring an experienced engineer to help us build it. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real ownership: you'll ship features end-to-end, shape architecture, and raise the bar for how we build.

This role is fully remote and open to candidates anywhere, as long as you can maintain at least a 4-hour overlap with U.S. Pacific Time for synchronous work.

### Our Culture

---

We're a small and mighty U.S.-based team of exceptional individuals working remotely from around the U.S. and South America. Our number one priority is building products our customers love — so we don't care where you live, whether that's the urban maze of New York or the natural expanse of Costa Rica.

Our ethos, "aligned and empowered," shapes everything we do: how we make decisions, how we support one another, and how we hold annual retreats that reinforce our bonds and mission.

Wonder if Confident is the right fit for you? Learn more about our company and culture.

### What You’ll Do

---

- Design, build, and troubleshoot features across our stack: React/TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL (via SQLAlchemy), and AWS.
- Own software development projects end-to-end, from ideation through execution, validation, and iteration.
- Collaborate with our Leadership, Engineering, Product, and Service teams on a weekly basis.
- Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful code review, mentorship, and leading by example.

### **About You**

---

- **You’re a product-minded software engineer.** You can take a project from zero to one, and you care as much about whether it solves the customer's problem as whether the code is clean.
- **You thrive in ambiguity.** Startups shift fast. You adapt as priorities change and know how to balance shipping customer value quickly with maintaining long-term stability.
- **You’re curious and a fast learner.** You naturally seek to understand the ‘why’ behind things. You enjoy figuring things out on your own and learning new skills to power up your productivity.
- **You have a track record of ownership.** You've shipped products people use, owned outcomes rather than tickets, and left every codebase you've touched better than you found it.
- **You're an excellent communicator.** You write clearly and precisely — especially with non-technical stakeholders — and you're comfortable with the demands of remote-first, written-first collaboration.
- **You're humble and you care about others.** You internalize feedback from anyone on the team, and you give direct, constructive feedback to help others improve. You believe honesty is kindness — and kindness is kindness, too.

**Your Skills:**

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building products people rely on in production
- Proficiency in modern JavaScript frameworks (React/TypeScript preferred)
- Proficiency in server-side web technologies (Python/Flask preferred)
- Proficiency with AI-development tools and best practices (Claude Code preferred)
- Bonus: experience designing/developing API for third party integrations
- Bonus: experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other regulated, data-heavy software — you'll ramp faster on our domain

### Benefits

---

- **Cash Compensation:** Competitive annual salary of $150,000-$180,000 USD, depending on experience and location.
- **Equity Compensation:** Employee-friendly stock grants with fair terms and future liquidity opportunities.
- **Flexible Work:** Work remotely from anywhere, as long as you maintain a minimum 4 hr overlap with the U.S. Pacific Time Zone for synchronous meetings.
- **Generous Time Off:** 18 company holidays, up to 20 PTO days, and 8 sick days annually.
- **Comprehensive Benefits for U.S. Employees:** 100% coverage of health insurance premiums for you and your dependents, plus dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401(k), and parental leave.
- **Home Office Equipment:** Generous budget to set up a productive workspace.
- **Professional Development:** Stipends for training, workshops, and conferences.

### About Confident

---

At Confident, we envision a world where accessible and reliable analytical testing enhances transparency across supply chains, thereby enabling businesses and policy-makers to make better decisions that foster the well-being of people and the planet.

Confident makes analytical testing efficient, accessible, and impactful by empowering labs and their clients with purpose-built technology & services. We do this by striving to build the best Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) in the world.

Today, Confident is the #1 lab testing platform in the US legal cannabis industry, and is trusted by analytical labs across several other industries, including agriculture, food & beverage, nutraceuticals, and environmental industries.

We are committed to creating software that facilitates and enhances the vital work of analytical testing laboratories. Our software is designed to be an extension of the lab itself, so seamlessly integrated into the workflow that it feels like a natural part of the scientific process.

To realize this vision, we invest in assembling a dream team, comprising individuals who are not only adept in their function, but who also have deep expertise in the specific industries we serve. This ensures that every interaction with our system and team is smooth, intuitive, and tailored to the unique needs of each lab. But beyond our technical prowess, what truly sets Confident apart is our culture — the bedrock upon which our team stands — and our ongoing commitment to evolve and grow as a team, so that we can continue being the indispensable partner that labs around the world rely on.

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
## **About the role:**

AssemblyAI runs a mature, multi-framework security and compliance program—including SOC 2 (all trust criteria), ISO 27001, and PCI 4.0—that protects the infrastructure and customer data behind our industry-leading Voice AI API. We're hiring a Security Operations Engineer to join our IT & Security team and take day-to-day ownership of the operational backbone of that program.

This role is centered on security operations and GRC: running compliance audit cycles end to end, gathering and organizing evidence, enforcing and verifying controls, executing access reviews, managing vulnerability triage and remediation follow-up, and responding to customer security questionnaires. It's the work that turns a security program on paper into one that demonstrably runs. You'll also have room to grow the technical side of the role. We automate wherever we can, and you'll be encouraged to build scripts, integrations, and tooling that reduce manual toil and improve the program.

This is a high-ownership role on a small team. You'll work closely with engineers across the company, partner with sales and legal on customer-facing security needs, and have a direct hand in how AssemblyAI enforces security across its products, infrastructure, and internal tools—including a rapidly growing landscape of agentic AI development.

## **What You'll Do:**

- Drive SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI 4.0, and other compliance audit cycles: gather and organize evidence, document, design, and build controls, coordinate directly with auditors through fieldwork, and collaborate with internal teams on remediation.
- Own the compliance automation platform (Vanta): monitor control status, chase down failing checks, keep integrations healthy, and update the risk register as the business and infrastructure evolve.
- Run vendor and third-party risk reviews, security assessments of new tools, periodic re-reviews, and track subprocessor and vendor inventories.

The Data Team is highly empowered at Quora, helping navigate complexity and influencing product and company strategy directly. Data scientists at Quora work across multiple domains, including user growth, content quality, monetization, personalization, marketplace dynamics, and long-term company strategy. title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
description:
## **About Juniper Square**

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

*Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in* [*digital-first*](https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/) *operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.*

## **About your role**

As a Senior Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you're a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and operates production systems powering core workflows for institutional financial clients. You bring deep technical expertise to your team, drive complex projects independently, and collaborate closely with Staff engineers, product, design, and QA to ship reliable, well-designed systems.

You'll join the Platform team, building the foundational infrastructure layer that powers all AI work at Juniper Square, both customer-facing (GPX) and internal automation. Every AI initiative at JSQ runs on top of this platform, spanning AI Gateway & Infrastructure, Governance & Security, Retrieval & Data Access, and Agent Framework.

## **What you'll do**

### **Build & Operate Production Systems**

- Design, build, and ship production-quality systems, APIs, and services - from foundational platform capabilities to customer-facing product experiences
- Own projects end-to-end: translating requirements into technical designs, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration
- Build reliable, scalable, and observable systems that deliver value to customers and enable other engineering teams to move faster
- Own the production health of the systems you build, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance, reliability, and issue resolution
- Build reusable infrastructure, frameworks, tooling, and developer experiences that enable teams across the organization
- Improve engineering velocity and operational quality through automation, documentation, and continuous improvements

### **Drive Technical Excellence**

- Contribute to technical design for complex projects, evaluating tradeoffs and proposing pragmatic implementation plans
- Partner with product, design, and engineering to translate requirements into well-designed technical solutions
- Help identify and reduce technical debt, reliability risks, and friction in the software development lifecycle
- Collaborate with Staff and senior engineers to establish reusable patterns and raise engineering standards
- Participate in code reviews, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and operational support

### **AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC**

- Use agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development as a primary part of your workflow, deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool
- Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, edge cases, and regressions, shipping quality output regardless of how it was produced
- Build or integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities in your domain where they add real value (e.g., evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows), with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries
- Contribute to the team's evolving practices around AI-accelerated development, testing, and code review

### **Collaborate Cross-Functionally**

- Work closely with product, design, QA, and cross-functional partners to meet timelines and align solutions to business goals
- Provide clear, accessible technical context to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

### **Domain Expertise**

- Grow into a subject-matter expert with a deep understanding of the data, workflows, and customer needs specific to that space

## **Qualifications**

### **Required**

- 7+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering
- Strong backend engineering experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Pyramid, or Django
- Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling
- Experience with cloud-native technologies such as AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code
- Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, and operating services in production
- Comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it (TypeScript/React experience a plus)
- Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver pragmatic, maintainable solutions
- Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively across teams
- Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineering and cross-functional partners
- Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment), and demonstrated AI Fluency: a deliberate point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool, adapted code review practices for AI-generated code, and safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience
- Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered systems in production (e.g., RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, evaluation workflows, guardrails, prompt/tool orchestration, or model observability)
- Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving technical territory where best practices and patterns are still being established

### **Nice to Have**

- Background in financial services or fintech
- Experience with API gateway/infrastructure, security & governance tooling, retrieval and data-access systems, or agent frameworks at production scale

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this role sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

## **Compensation**

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $220,000 and the Canadian base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $210,000 CAD. We want that to change: someone who can own the full loop from "here's an insight" to "here are 10 variations live and being tested," in hours, not days.

This isn't a "make it look nice" role. It's for someone who thinks like a marketer first — who can sit inside Meta Ads Manager, form a real opinion about why an ad is or isn't working, and turn that opinion into the next creative before being asked.

### What you'll do:

* Design high-performing ad creative for Meta, Instagram, and other paid social channels — statics, carousels, and short-form video assets
* Take one working ad and rapidly produce 10+ variations (copy, colour, format, hook) to keep testing and scaling what performs
* Handle basic video clipping - repurposing raw founder/event/product footage into short-form social and ad-ready clips
* Live inside Meta Ads Manager: track performance, study competitors and industry trends, and use that data to decide what to design next
* Turn around carousels and quick-test creative in hours, not days - speed is part of the job, not a nice-to-have
* Partner directly with founders and the marketing/design team on messaging, testing hypotheses, and creative direction
* Own visual execution end-to-end, concept to shipped ad , without needing a designer to be looped in on every asset
* Build a reusable system of ad templates and winning formats so output scales without reinventing each brief

### Who we're looking for:

1. You think like a marketer who designs, not a designer who makes ads look nice. You have a real opinion on what copy will land, what colours will work, what visual stops the scroll, and what makes a value prop instantly understandable.
2. A portfolio or reel that shows live, shipped ad creative - ideally with a sense of what performed and why, not just concept work
3. Strong graphic design fundamentals: layout, colour, typography, and an instinct for what gets attention on Meta/IG
4. Comfort with basic video editing/clipping for short-form social and ad placements
5. A bias for speed and iteration - you'd rather ship 10 variants of something that's already working today than polish one thing for a week
6. Real experience close to performance advertising - you've run ad accounts yourself, or worked tightly enough with founders/marketers to understand what the data is telling you
7. Ability to work quickly, communicate clearly over Slack, and overlap with US Pacific or European working hours

Strong plus: You've personally run or scaled an ad account, an Instagram page, or a creator/brand page from scratch — we'd rather see that than an agency résumé. We're also widening our aperture beyond typical SaaS design: backgrounds in luxury, fashion, entertainment, sports, hospitality, or agency work are all welcome. Portfolio beats pedigree.

### How to apply

Send us:
* Your portfolio or reel of ad creative
* One ad you designed that performed well - and your read on why it worked
* Your typical turnaround time for a quick-turn carousel or ad variation set

### What matters to us:

* You're a strong communicator and contribute positively to the team
* You take ownership and have an internal compass
* You value candid feedback and overcommunication
* You care about quality and design, while keeping things simple
* You measure your impact and look for ways to improve and automate
* You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and getting a little better every week
* You're customer-focused and care about the end result, not just the output
* You value fast, incremental ways of working


### Perks & benefits:

* Work remotely from anywhere in your respective country
* Flexible working hours
* Paid time off and flexible leave policy
* Ability to move laterally within the team and grow quickly
* No-boss culture
* LGBTQ+ friendly workplace
* Company offsites

At Fireflies.ai, we're changing how teams use AI in their daily work. Our culture is built around security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19M from investors including Canaan and Khosla Ventures, along with angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is a global team of 100+ people across 20+ countries and every time zone. We're building a global-first company and use our own product every day to help us work better.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
# Technical Support Engineer

**New York City · Hybrid · Engineering · Two openings**

## Welcome to Glide

Glide is the operating system that community banks and credit unions run their business on. Account opening, lending, servicing, retention.

Most of these institutions are running on cores designed in the 1980s. We are the modern software layer on top, and increasingly the agentic one. Our platform touches people at the moments that matter most to them financially: opening an account, applying for a loan, getting a decision.

We serve institutions across the country, with dozens more integrating. Our team brings engineering, product, and growth experience from Stripe, Google, and Amazon. We are backed by Pear and Acrew.

## The role

We are hiring two Technical Support Engineers to join the small team that owns production quality for the entire platform.

This is not a ticket-routing job. Our support engineers own bugs end to end: they take an ambiguous report from a financial institution, drive it to a real root cause across the frontend, backend, and a stack of banking integrations, ship the fix themselves, and prove it works.

What makes the job unusual is how it gets done. This team runs AI coding agents as a production system, not as autocomplete. A triage agent proposes a root cause. The engineer decides whether it is right, and steers it when it is not. The agent writes the code, a second agent reviews it, and the engineer reviews, tests, and records the evidence before anything ships. The team built the tooling that makes this possible: internal MCP servers, slash commands for each stage of the workflow, an auto-triage loop feeding the bug board.

The result is a very small number of people holding quality for a platform serving a lot of institutions.

So we are not hiring for typing speed. Agents are fast and often confidently wrong. We are hiring for the judgment they do not have: recognizing when a plausible answer is the wrong one, knowing what not to change, and being able to prove a fix rather than assert it.

You will report directly to our CTO.

## What you'll do

- Own bugs and production issues end to end: reproduce, diagnose, fix, verify, and confirm the fix held
- Drive ambiguous reports to a true root cause across our web apps, APIs, and banking integrations
- Orchestrate AI agents through the full diagnostic and repair loop, and catch them when they are wrong
- Ship your own fixes as reviewed pull requests, with evidence attached to every ticket
- Extend the agent tooling itself. The workflows, MCP servers, and triage agents this team runs were all built in-house, and you will build the next ones
- Write the plain-language root cause explanation that goes back to the customer
- Find and fix classes of bugs, not just instances. Strengthen alerts, runbooks, and guardrails so the same issue does not come back
- Help decide how this function scales as the team grows

## Who you are

- 2 to 6 years writing production software, ideally somewhere you were close to real customers and real incidents
- Strong TypeScript. Comfortable moving between a React frontend, a Node backend, SQL, and a third-party API in the same afternoon
- You debug by narrowing, not guessing. You can read logs, traces, and a database and form a hypothesis you then try to disprove
- You already work with AI coding agents daily, and you have opinions about where they fail. You can tell when an agent is confidently wrong, and you know what you would never hand one
- You have a bias toward proving things. You do not say a fix works, you show it
- You can explain a technical failure to someone who has never seen the code, without condescension
- You manage yourself. Nobody will assign you work hour to hour, and you will flag a slip before the deadline rather than after
- You are comfortable when the process is still being written, because you will be the one writing parts of it

## Nice to have

- Experience at a fintech, or anywhere regulated, where a bug has consequences beyond a bad user experience
- Familiarity with Next.js, tRPC, AWS, Sentry, or a structured logging platform like Axiom or Datadog
- Experience with multi-tenant systems where behavior is driven by per-customer configuration
- You have built internal tooling, MCP servers, or agent workflows that made other engineers faster

## What the interview process looks like

We tell you up front, because ours is unusual and deliberately so.

1. **Intro call, 30 minutes.** A conversation with our CTO about the hardest bug you have ever fixed, and how you actually work with AI tools.
2. **A build exercise.** We give you a spec for a small service. Expect about four hours, with a week to return it. Use whatever AI agents you like, and send us your session logs. We read your evidence and your written decisions before we read your code.
3. **In person in NYC, 2 hours.** You defend what you built, then we introduce bugs into your own codebase and you debug them live on your laptop with your own tools, with two of our support engineers watching.
4. **Founders round, 60 minutes.** A video call with our CTO, CEO and CPO, scheduled after the onsite. Not a technical round. That part is settled in step 3 and we will not re-run it.

No algorithm rounds. No whiteboard. We are not going to ask you to invert a binary tree.

## Why join now

A very small team holds production quality for a platform serving financial institutions across the country. You would be joining it early enough to inherit a genuinely good agent workflow and shape what it becomes as the team grows.

The work is also real. Bugs here reach people trying to open a bank account or apply for a loan. If that sounds like pressure rather than tedium, we would like to talk to you.

## And finally, a brief overview of Glide's benefits package

💸 **Competitive Compensation**

You'll receive a base salary of $120,000 to $140,000, determined by experience, plus a generous equity package for joining us at Glide.

❤️ **Wellbeing Credits (for US employees)**

Besides stellar health, dental, and vision insurance, we offer a $100 monthly health and wellness stipend to help you stay active and healthy.

🥗 **Lunch on us (for US employees)**

We're huge foodies, so every member of the Glide team receives a $100 weekly stipend for lunch or groceries. No one goes hungry around here :)

🌴 **Unlimited PTO and Sick Days**

We trust our team to balance their responsibilities and well-being, so our unlimited PTO and sick day policy empowers everyone to take the time they need without unnecessary red tape.

💼 **Hybrid Working Environment**

This role is based in New York City.

- **In person:** Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday at our NYC office.
- **Remote:** Monday and Friday.

Our technology stack consists of JavaScript & **TypeScript for the front end and back end**, PostgreSQL for our database, and we are completely cloud based. We also use React, Nest.js and Prisma.

- Annual professional development stipend
