We're open to multiple levels for Software Engineers in this position. We will work with you to determine and confirm where you fit within our leveling. Our Total Cash Compensation (Base+Bonus) range for this role is:

**Software Engineer 2** - $165,000 - 185,000 Base, 10% Bonus, Stock Options

The Total Cash Compensation range listed for this position is an estimate based on market data and internal benchmarking and does not guarantee a specific salary at the time of hire. Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, qualifications, performance and other factors.

## **Sydecar’s values**

***Our values are important to the way we live and work at Sydecar. They guide our priorities, behaviors and interactions.***

**Be Committed**

As a team, we rise to meet challenges and recognize that we become stronger and develop character when facing adversity.

**Be Excellent**

Humility is our key to personal and professional growth. We appreciate that great ideas can come from anywhere, regardless of seniority, pedigree, or experience. We care more about collective outcomes than who gets credit or who does what. We try to not let our ego cloud our judgment.

**Win Together**

Winning is no accident. It is the result of collective hard work, perseverance, sacrifice, and most of all, loving what we do. Winning requires that we give extra—sometimes winning calls for late nights or extra effort, and we show up for clients and each other with urgency and heart. While excellence is a journey, winning is a destination.

*Sydecar is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Sydecar are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Sydecar will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Sydecar encourages applicants of all ages.*

Most agencies treat creative as an output. We treat it as a growth lever. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who thinks in direct response: someone who understands that the best ad isn't the prettiest one, it's the one that moves people to act. You'll own creative strategy across some of the most exciting eCom brands across the USA and Canada, working closely with a cross-functional team to develop concepts, messaging, briefs, and testing roadmaps that generate real commercial results.

**This role is for you if:**

1. You're DR-native. You understand awareness levels, market sophistication, and why the same hook that works at cold traffic fails at warm. You don't need to be taught that creative is a variable in a performance system.
2. You have strong opinions on ads. You can watch a product demo and immediately know what's missing, why the hook fell flat, or what angle would have converted better.
3. You think in hypotheses. Every piece of creative you brief has a reason behind it: a customer insight, a pattern from the data, a gap in what's been tested.
4. You create your own momentum, bring clarity to ambiguous briefs, and ship fast without sacrificing strategic thinking.
5. You're confident in front of clients. You hold your space, give clear creative direction, and can guide a founder on what content to produce without losing them.
6. You separate signal from noise. You can look at campaign performance, identify what's actually working, and translate it into the next round of tests, not just a summary slide.

**Your day to day**

- Review campaign performance and build testing roadmaps based on what the data is telling you
- Develop hooks, scripts, messaging frameworks and briefs that give visual creators exactly what they need to execute
- Review creative assets (UGC, video, static, carousel) and deliver performance-focused feedback that sharpens output
- Collaborate directly with clients: monthly strategy calls, content menus, shoot guidance and narrative direction
- Work cross-functionally with media buyers and growth strategists to drive iteration at pace
- Apply and evolve the strategic frameworks and playbooks that underpin how we work

**What you bring**

- 2-3+ years work experience in Creative Strategy, Performance Creative, or Paid Social, ideally with eCommerce or CPG brands
- A trained eye for DR creative: you know what a strong hook looks like, what market sophistication stage demands, and how to brief for conversion not just engagement
- Sharp copy and messaging instincts across hooks, angles, scripts and ad copy
- Confident communication, written and verbal, with both internal teams and clients
- Bonus: agency experience, Meta and TikTok Ads, UGC, or direct-response funnel strategy

**Why Right Hook**

💸 Above market salary: USD $65,000-$75,000 depending on experience  
🌍 Remote-first: our team spans Australia, New Zealand, USA, Canada, Bali and the Philippines  
🤝 Direct mentorship from our Head of Creative Strategy and leadership team  
🔥 A team that moves fast and holds a high bar for quality, clarity and creative thinking  
💥 No fluff - this function exists to drive profitable results, not ship content

**To apply, send us:**

1. Your CV (no cover letter needed)
2. Answers to both questions:

  - What's one ad that recently caught your attention, and why? (include the link)
  - A client says "we need 10 new ads." What questions do you ask before making any recommendations, and why?

description:
# Senior Software Engineer

Latitude is an early‑stage payments fintech building modern infrastructure for global money movement. We help businesses move value instantly, securely, and with full compliance-leveraging blockchain rails while delivering a seamless, enterprise‑grade experience.

Our team has built and scaled payments and financial infrastructure at Uber, Coinbase, Stripe, Amazon, and Facebook-bringing deep experience across fintech, marketplaces, and global‑scale systems. We're looking for experienced software engineers who are excited to build critical financial infrastructure at an early-stage company with significant technical ownership and impact.

## The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help design and build the systems powering the next generation of global payments. You'll work closely with our engineering leadership to solve complex technical challenges, influence architectural decisions, and ship products that serve real customers from day one.

You'll have the opportunity to:

- Design and build scalable, production-grade backend services and distributed systems
- Develop core platform components including payment orchestration, ledgering, workflow engines, partner integrations, and public APIs
- Influence system architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction as the platform scales
- Own projects end-to-end, from technical design through deployment and long-term operation
- Collaborate closely with engineering and product to solve complex infrastructure and financial systems challenges
- Mentor teammates, raise the engineering bar, and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing culture

## What We're Looking For

### Required

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems
- Experience working in high-growth startups or fast-paced environments with significant ownership
- Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable, scalable distributed systems
- Proven ability to independently drive complex technical initiatives and make thoughtful architectural decisions
- Experience in one or more of the following areas:

  - Infrastructure / DevOps
  - Payments or financial systems
  - Blockchain / crypto infrastructure
- Product-minded approach with a willingness to work across the stack when needed
- Strong communication and collaboration skills
- Authorization to work in the United States

Our backend is primarily written in Ruby, with TypeScript powering our frontend. Our infrastructure runs on AWS using Terraform and Kubernetes. Experience with these technologies is a plus, but we value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly over expertise in any particular language or framework. We’re looking for engineers with strong character and empathy - we're building a collaborative, kind, high-achieving culture.

### Preferred

- Experience designing APIs, distributed systems, or event-driven architectures
- Experience with modern cloud infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code
- Background in fintech, payments, banking, digital assets, or other regulated industries
- Experience helping shape engineering practices, technical strategy, or scaling engineering organizations
- Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows and modern engineering tooling

## **Why Latitude?**

**Rare Opportunity:** We're backed by top investors (including NEA and Lightspeed Faction), finding significant traction, and taking on a massive market opportunity in international payments. This is a chance to join a rocketship early and help shape the future of global money movement.

**Impact**: You'll be building critical infrastructure that makes global payments faster and more accessible for businesses and individuals worldwide.

**Strong Team**: Join a high-caliber team that combines deep fintech expertise with startup execution experience. Our team has worked on the stuff that matters at companies like Stripe, Coinbase, Uber, and Facebook.

**Opportunity to join early**: As an early team member at a growing startup, you'll have significant influence over our technical direction and the opportunity to grow with the company.

## Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $230,000–$250,000, commensurate with experience, plus meaningful early-stage equity.

At Latitude, we believe success starts with our people—healthy, inspired, and empowered to thrive both in and outside of work.

We offer:

Latitude is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. title: PhD Researcher — AI & Human Behavior (Part-Time)
description:
PhD Researcher — AI & Human Behavior (Part-Time)

Squoosh.AI | Remote within the United States | $60–70/hour USD

Continue your doctorate while owning research that becomes a real product. Squoosh.AI is hiring a current full-time PhD student to work part-time with our research team. We will agree on a manageable weekly schedule around your academic commitments.

Squoosh develops AI systems that simulate how people explore and interact with digital experiences, helping commerce teams evaluate and improve websites. Our research connects machine learning, agent behavior, human decision-making, and rigorous experimentation.

What you will work on

Build and evaluate LLM-based browser agents that navigate websites, use tools, and make decisions under realistic constraints.
Investigate persona calibration and behavioral modeling: how goals, preferences, context, and individual differences affect simulated journeys.
Design benchmarks, baselines, ablations, and error analyses that compare simulations with observed behavior and real A/B-test outcomes.
Explore experimental design, causal inference, uncertainty, and generalization to understand when simulations support useful product decisions.
Write reproducible Python experiments and collaborate with researchers and engineers to turn useful findings into prototypes.

What we are looking for

Current full-time enrollment in a relevant PhD program: AI, computer science, machine learning, statistics, HCI, cognitive science, computational social science, or a related field.
Strong Python implementation skills and a solid foundation in statistics and research methods.
A research artifact you can explain in depth: a paper, preprint, repository, benchmark, or experimental write-up. Publication is helpful, not required.
Clear thinking about baselines, data leakage, failure cases, and what your evidence does and does not support.
The ability to own a focused question and communicate progress while maintaining a reliable part-time commitment.

Useful experience includes PyTorch or JAX, LLMs and agents, reinforcement learning, browser automation, synthetic data, model evaluation, and human behavior research. Deep ability in one relevant area matters more than familiarity with every tool.

How to apply

Apply with your academic CV. Include your program and research area, availability and expected graduation date, one or two shareable research artifacts, your personal contribution, and a short example of an experiment and what its failure cases taught you.

Your doctoral studies remain your primary academic commitment. This is separate part-time employment, not admission to a PhD program. US work authorization is required; applicable CPT/OPT candidates are welcome. Only share material you are permitted to share. Squoosh.AI is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Purpose Unlimited is an independent financial services company with an unrelenting focus on customer-centric innovation, delivered through technology-driven solutions. Led by entrepreneur Som Seif, the company is developing a diversified product platform aimed at addressing historically underserved segments of the market. Purpose Unlimited’s businesses include Purpose Investments, Advisor Solutions by Purpose, and Driven.

Vacancy Status: This is for a current vacancy 
 

Job Description

**Who you are**

Customer behavior is a signal. Most companies collect it. Few know how to read it.

You will be one of the early data science hires shaping how Purpose understands the clients on our wealth platform — and how the platform responds to what we learn. You'll build the measurement architecture, behavioral models, and causal infrastructure that connects product decisions to client outcomes. Not what looks like it works. What actually does.

This is a foundational role at a foundational moment. The intelligence layer you build will shape how Purpose designs, measures, and evolves its platform for years — and increasingly, how our AI systems understand and serve the clients who depend on us.

You're an engineer as much as a scientist — you own the work from raw event data to deployed system, and you hold yourself accountable for whether it changed how the business operates.

**What AI does so you don't have to**

Recurring insight generation — automated analytics workflows run on schedule with defined guardrails. You design the system and own the governance; you don't write the weekly summary.
Boilerplate feature engineering — AI coding assistants accelerate pipeline construction from event data. You define what to build and review what the tools produce.
First-pass segmentation refreshes — classification and scoring jobs re-run automatically. You set the standards and monitor for drift, you don't rerun the job.
Standard visualization and reporting — AI tools increasingly generate monitoring views from structured data. You define what signals matter; the generation is handled.

**What only you can do**

Determine what is worth measuring — in a platform generating thousands of behavioral signals, the most valuable judgment is deciding which three metrics actually reflect client value and which are vanity.
Push back on attribution that flatters — AI systems generate correlations at scale. You are the person who asks whether the relationship is causal, whether the experiment is valid, and whether the conclusion will hold when the business acts on it.
Translate behavioral reality into a measurable operating model — starting from how clients actually make financial decisions, not from how the product team assumes they do.
Design AI analytics systems with the rigor of a statistician — evaluating LLM-generated insights with the same calibration and drift standards you apply to your own models.
Build the institutional trust that makes product and business leaders act on quantitative findings, including findings they didn't want.

**What you will own**

The client intelligence architecture: the measurement model that maps how clients discover, onboard, activate, and engage with Purpose's wealth platform — with FOMs that connect platform activity to real client outcomes.
Behavioral models that change decisions: client segmentation, lifecycle classification, churn prediction, propensity scoring, and behavioral clustering — validated against real outcomes and governed for drift.
Causal measurement with discipline: experiment design and analysis, causal inference when experiments aren't possible, and a consistent standard for what counts as evidence that a product or AI intervention actually worked.
Agentic analytics governance: you set the standards for what AI-generated insight requires human review, what guardrails govern automated outputs, and how the intelligence layer stays accurate and auditable in a regulated environment.

**What you must bring**

Deep fluency in Python and SQL — owning work end-to-end from raw event data to deployed software, with production-grade testing and documentation standards.
Proven experience building and evaluating predictive models in production-like settings: classification, survival models, segmentation, scoring, calibration, and cost-sensitive decision frameworks.
Applied causal inference — A/B testing, matching/propensity, diff-in-diff, regression discontinuity. You know the difference between a valid experiment and a flattering one.
Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, or equivalent) — you treat data access controls, model auditability, and responsible use of customer data as core professional standards.

**What will set you apart**

You've been early on a data science or analytics team and built measurement and modeling foundations before the playbook existed — you know what it means to make something from scratch that others depend on.
You have experience evaluating LLMs or AI-generated outputs with statistical rigor: calibration, drift detection, bias assessment. You apply the same skepticism to AI outputs that you apply to your own models.
You've used AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) as a genuine productivity multiplier in data science workflows.
You have applied behavioral economics or behavioral finance principles to how you designed metrics or interpreted client behavior — you think about why clients make financial decisions, not just what they do.

**What success looks like in your first year**

A measurement architecture is live — FOMs that connect platform activity to client outcomes are defined, instrumented, and being used by product and business leaders to make decisions they couldn't make before.
At least two behavioral models are in production — churn prediction, propensity scoring, or lifecycle classification — with monitoring, documentation, and governance that any engineer on the team can maintain.
Causal measurement is the standard — at least one major product or AI intervention has been evaluated with a valid causal method, and the findings have changed how the team approaches attribution.
The AI analytics layer has governance — the standards for what AI-generated insight requires human review, and what guardrails govern automated output, are defined, documented, and in use.
You've become the person that product and business leaders bring their hardest measurement questions to — because they trust that what you tell them reflects reality, including when reality is inconvenient.
 

**Every role at Purpose is assessed against our five values:**

Innovation – You bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and find better ways of building. You don’t wait for permission to experiment.
Courage – You speak up when something isn’t working, take difficult stands on technical quality, and act with conviction even when it’s uncomfortable.
Owner’s Mindset – You take full accountability for your squad’s outcomes. You treat the platform, the team, and the business as your own.
Client Focus – You place client outcomes at the center of every architectural and delivery decision.
Winning Through Individual and Collective Growth – You invest in your own development and actively contribute to the growth of every engineer around you.
 

**Why should you join us?**

We are one of Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers' 2023, 2024, 2025 & 2026.
We believe in innovation and a vibrant culture - work for an innovative, people-first, financial services firm that values entrepreneurialism.
We believe in a flexible work structure – A flexible hybrid work model that empowers you to do your best work whether at home or the office.
We care about your rewards - Competitive compensation including equity program.
We care about your health – comprehensive group health and dental benefits and life insurance at little to no cost to you. We also offer a Lifestyle Spending Account for all your wellness needs.
We care about your quality of life - flexible paid time-off policy with unlimited vacation days, and flexible sick and mental health days.
We care about your family - Paid parental leave for eligible employees with a top-up.
We care about your future – Generous Group RRSP matching and an optional TFSA program.
We care about your development – We offer training opportunities and tuition support year-round.
 

Purpose Unlimited is an equal employer and we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and barrier-free work environment for all employees and candidates. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and if accommodation is required during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact any member of the People & Culture team at PeopleCultureTeam@purpose-unlimited.com. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Our work philosophy is a hybrid model allowing for flexibility and collaboration.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
## About Scopex

Scopex moves money from Europe to India for NRIs, on stablecoin rails. Transfers land in about five minutes, our rates beat mid-market, and most transfers cost nothing to send. Around 50,000 people use us today, and we are opening the US corridor next.

Small team, we ship often.

## The role

You lead QA. Right now that is one junior QA doing everything by hand, no automated tests, and a growing surface area: web app, mobile app, and the services behind them.

Your first year is about getting regression off humans. You choose the tools, you build the suite, you decide what gets tested manually and what stops being a manual step forever. The junior QA reports into you for day-to-day work, and part of your job is turning them into someone who writes tests, not just runs them.

You also get the authority to make that stick. You set the definition of done and you gate releases. If you say a build is not ready, it does not ship.

## What you will do

- Own the test strategy across web, mobile, and APIs. Decide what "tested" means here and write it down.
- Build the automated suite from nothing. Pick the stack you know works, wire it into CI so it runs on every PR.
- Test money movement properly: KYC and onboarding, payin, payout, settlement, reconciliation, and every failure and retry path in between. Most of our worst bugs live in the paths where something goes wrong halfway.
- Keep manual and exploratory testing sharp for the flows that need a human eye, and cut the ones that do not.
- Run bug triage. Set severity rules, keep the queue honest, chase the ones that matter.
- Mentor the junior QA. Review their test cases, pair with them, hand off automation work as they are ready for it.
- Tell us where our process is slow and then fix it. This is the part we actually want. We would rather hire someone who redesigns how we release than someone who works neatly inside a system nobody has questioned.

## First 90 days

Learn the product and the money flows end to end. Ship the first automated regression run against staging on every PR. Give us a written view of where quality is weakest and what you plan to do about it.

## What we are looking for

- 4+ years testing web and mobile products.
- You have worked in-house on a product you shipped and then supported over time, not project-based QA at a services company. You know what it is like to own a bug you wrote a test for two years ago.
- You have written and maintained automated tests that other people relied on. Playwright, Cypress, Appium, Maestro, whatever you have used well. We are not attached to any of it.
- Comfortable with APIs. You can read a log, reproduce from a stack trace, and check what the backend actually returned instead of what the screen showed.
- You have set up tests in CI and kept them from going flaky.
- You have held a release before and made the argument for why.
- You write clearly. We are distributed and most decisions happen in writing.

## Nice to have

- Fintech, payments, or another regulated product.
- Curiosity about blockchain and stablecoins. You do not need to know Stellar or Polygon on day one, you will learn them here.
- Mobile release process, app store review, device fragmentation.
- Basics of performance and security testing.


## Hiring process

1. A 30-minute intro call.
2. A 45-minute live session on our staging app. Find bugs, talk us through how you would test it, sketch how you would automate it. No take-home.
3. A final conversation with the team.

Scopex is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive team.

Phare Health is now part of **R1** and its AI innovation engine, **R37 Lab**, bringing Phare’s frontier clinical reasoning technology together with one of the largest healthcare platforms in the U.S.

At R37 and Phare, we are building the **first AI-native Healthcare Revenue Operating System**: a connected platform that reasons over full medical records, payer logic, and financial workflows to automate medical coding, billing, and follow-up.

Backed by real customers, real data, and real distribution, we operate on a national scale. Our agentic AI systems already power production workflows across **95 of the top 100 U.S. health systems**, processing hundreds of millions of patient encounters each year, including:

- **180M+** Claims
- **550M+** Patient encounters
- **1.2B+** Workflow actions and outcomes each year

title: Sr. Analyst, Client Success
description:
About Us
Gridline is here to redefine how private markets operate, making them faster, smarter, and more accessible. We are setting a new standard by building the Turnkey Alternatives Management Platform (TAMP) to help wealth managers run private market programs at scale. As a ledger-native system of record, Gridline provides a single source of truth that tracks the entire investment lifecycle down to the transaction layer, enabling RIAs, family offices, and private banks to manage their private markets business in one place.

Our team brings deep experience across both enterprise technology and alternative investments to build the infrastructure layer the industry has always lacked. Backed by an $18.5M Series A led by FINTOP, we are creating the systems and structuring the data required to define the next generation of private market investing. Are you up to the challenge?


The Opportunity:
As a Sr. Analyst, Client Success, you will handle day-to-day account support including remediations, complex process corrections, and ad-hoc client requests within our alternative investments portfolio. Reporting to the Sr. Associate, Fund Ops, you will serve as a core operational touchpoint, driving issue resolution, maintaining data integrity, and partnering across internal teams to deliver high-quality support for alternative investment products.
This is an amazing opportunity to join both our core Operations group and our Philippines team in their foundational stages, playing a pivotal role in shaping our global operations and culture from day one.


In this role you will...
- **Manage Investor Data & Profiles:** Lead end-to-end data gathering, validation, and profile creation in core systems including researching client details, identifying missing or inconsistent information, and proactively following up to maintain complete and accurate investor records.
- **Execute KYC & AML Onboarding:** Perform critical KYC/AML verification checks (including CDD/EDD, entity documentation, and risk assessments) during investor onboarding and ongoing profile maintenance, ensuring compliance without compromising the client experience.
- **Manage Ad-Hoc Requests:** Process complex, time-sensitive client and transaction requests across alternative investment products (e.g., private equity, real estate), including performing callback verifications, bank account checks, and wire confirmations for disbursements.
- **Drive Remediations & Issue Resolution:** Execute end-to-end account and data remediations, resolving operational bottlenecks and identifying root causes to prevent recurring exceptions across the investor portfolio.
- **Collaborate Cross-Functionally:** Partner closely with Fund Ops, Fund Controlling, Product Onboarding & Delivery, Sales, and Compliance teams to streamline service delivery and escalate operational risk or exceptions promptly.
- **Optimize Processes:** Leverage modern operational tools (such as HubSpot and ClickUp) to triage incoming workflows, refine desktop procedures, and implement process improvements that increase service efficiency.


You have...
- **3+ Years of Relevant Experience:** Proven track record in financial services operations, client support, or middle-office roles.
- **Alternative Investments Exposure:** Solid understanding of alts, private wealth, or complex commercial financial products.
- **Clear Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for seamless daily interaction with global stakeholders.
- **AI:** The willingness and ability to leverage AI tools and platforms to optimize operational workflows.


We offer...
Impact: The opportunity to join a Series A fintech at a high-growth inflection point.
Mission-Driven Work: The ability to revolutionize the private markets space and build the industry’s infrastructure layer.
Elite Collaboration: A tight-knit team of experienced operators and builders who are passionate about scaling startups.
Ownership: A high-autonomy environment where you are encouraged to take ownership and solve complex problems.
Full Suite of Benefits: Competitive salary, night differential pay, remote setup stipend, and robust medical coverage.
 
Gridline, in partnership with Rippling as our Employer of Record (EOR), is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, skills, and qualifications. title: Senior Counsel
description:
## **About Pair Team**

Pair Team is a public benefit company reimagining care for the safety net. As an AI-enabled medical group for Medicaid and Medicare, we deliver medical, behavioral, and social care by integrating shelters, pantries and other community-based organizations into our whole-person model. As California’s largest complex care provider, we’ve proven our impact to reduce avoidable emergency care, including a 52% and 26% reduction in ER visits and hospitalizations respectively. Once scaled nationally, our approach would save tax payers $150B per year.

With our years of experience and vast data collected, we are now building an AI platform that embeds social work agents across the safety net to truly unify our fragmented healthcare and welfare system. By scaling our country’s frontline medical and social services workforce, we aim to bring high-touch care to everyone.

At Pair Team, we’re not just delivering care—we’re transforming it. We’re building a future where high-touch, community-driven care is accessible to everyone, especially the most underserved.

- [**Forbes:** For Pair Team, Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It The Most](https://streaklinks.com/BoC7cKKoaE6VcHOVAgE5xHcD/https%3A%2F%2Fwww.forbes.com%2Fsites%2Fstevenaquino%2F2023%2F08%2F17%2Ffor-pair-team-accessibility-is-about-delivering-healthcare-to-those-who-need-it-the-most%2F%3Fsh%3D4d4189d2b077?email=rosina%40bamtheagency.com)
- [**TechCrunch:** Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team](https://techcrunch.com/2023/11/28/building-for-medicaids-regulatory-moment-with-neil-batlivala-from-pair-team/)
- [**Journal of General Internal Medicine:** A Novel Intervention for Medicaid Beneficiaries with Complex Needs](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11606-025-09839-2)

## **About the Opportunity**

We're hiring a Senior Legal Counsel to help Pair Team grow and scale responsibly. This is an  opportunity to be the second lawyer in the legal department and build inside a fast-moving healthcare company operating at the center of Medicaid and Medicare high needs population care management.

This role reports directly to the Head of Legal.

## **What You’ll Do**

**Legal & Regulatory Guidance**

- Lead advisor on corporate, healthcare regulatory, litigation, commercial, product, employment, and privacy matters.
- Monitor regulatory developments and translate their impact into clear, actionable guidance for product, clinical, and operations teams.
- Collaborate with operational, clinical and marketing leaders to ensure adherence to applicable laws and regulations (e.g. HIPAA, Anti-Kickback, Corporate Practice of Medicine).
- Understand and provide business friendly guidance on use and impact of artificial intelligence and other technologies in healthcare programs.

**Commercial Strategy & Contracting**

- Work on contract development and negotiation—drafting, redlining, and advising on deal terms for health plans, vendors, and partners.
- Draft templates and playbooks for contracting with partners, including service agreements, BAAs, NDAs, and other agreements..
- Provide legal and regulatory guidance related to Medicaid, Medicare, value-based care, and product development to support commercial strategy.

**Risk Identification & Building Out Legal Function**

- Act as a trusted advisor to business, product, and clinical teams — flagging legal risks early and helping design compliant solutions rather than blocking progress.
- Help develop legal processes and policies that support risk mitigation, compliance, and business enablement.
- Effectively manage outside counsel work and spend.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Partner with clinical operations on care delivery compliance, including documentation standards, authorization requirements, and billing compliance.
- Collaborate with the People team on compliance training, onboarding, and workforce policy development.
- Support company litigation needs.
- Represent Pair Team professionally and compliantly in partner, health plan, and regulatory conversations.
- Other duties as needed.

## **What You’ll Need** 

- 5+ years of healthcare legal experience with direct exposure to federal programs (Medicare, Medicaid, or both) and the regulatory frameworks governing them (CMS, OIG, HIPAA, FWA).
- 3+ years legal experience at a digital health company, health plan, provider, or managed care organization operating in Medicaid and/or Medicare programs.
- Demonstrated ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment — startup or high-growth company experience strongly preferred.
- Deep working knowledge of the healthcare regulatory environment and practical application to technology products and digital health services.
- Strong communication skills — able to explain complex regulatory requirements in plain language and make crisp risk/benefit recommendations to business leaders.
- Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage projects and tasks.
- Experience supporting building processes, procedures, and workflows that enable sustainable business scaling.
- Strong collaboration skills with thought partners from clinical, operations, finance, and leadership
- Proven ability to prioritize competing demands and make risk-proportionate decisions.
- Mission-driven and passionate about improving outcomes for underserved communities

***Bonus Points for any of the following:***

- Familiarity with value-based care contracts, capitation arrangements, or risk-bearing entities and their compliance implications.
- Direct experience in pre-litigation and litigation matters and managing outside counsel.
- Healthcare, privacy, or other relevant certification is a plus.

**Our Values**

- **Lead with integrity:** We keep our commitments and take responsibility for our actions. We are dependable and choose authenticity over perfection.
- **Embrace challenges:** We leave our egos at the door and step forward into discomfort instead of back into safety. We help each other to learn and provide feedback using candor and kindness.
- **Break through walls:** We go the extra mile for our patients, partners and one another, and we run toward hard things. We are resilient in our push for consistent improvement and challenge the status quo.
- **Act beyond yourself:** We build each other up and respect boundaries. We seek first to understand and assume positive intent.
- **Care comes first:** We hold ourselves to the highest standards for our patients. We are relentless in the pursuit of our mission, and ensure that we are taking care of ourselves in order to care for others.

## **Because We Value You**

- Competitive salary: $205,000 - $225,000
- Equity compensation package
- Medical, dental & vision with HSA/FSA and company HSA contribution
- Remote-first with equipment and $100/mo home office stipend
- Flexible PTO and 12 paid holidays
- 100% company-paid life, disability & AD&D
- Backup childcare, caregiver concierge, and financial guidance resources

description:
[Bomi Lab](https://www.bomilab.com/) is a **Venture EdTech Builder platform** that scales digital products at the intersection of education and technology. For one of our products we are looking for an expert!

[ExamHub](https://www.instagram.com/examhub.uz?stkn=MTJvYWIwaG9obnl3MA==) is an **EdTech ecosystem** for educators in Uzbekistan that fundamentally transforms how teachers work and earn. We take care of all the routine tasks and operational heavy lifting, turning independent teaching into a stable, highly profitable business. 

We provide teachers with a steady flow of students across multiple subjects, a state-of-the-art platform, complete toolsets, and guaranteed workloads.
Now, we are scaling this proven ecosystem model to **LatAm (Chile) **

We are looking for a **Product Owner & Launch Lead (LatAm)** to drive our market entry from day one — from conducting direct competitor analysis to securing our first lead teacher, testing MVP funnels, and building the foundations to step into the **Country Manager role.**

**What you will do:**
* Conduct Direct Competitor Analysis (Secret Buyer): Enroll in and experience top competitor courses (Preuniversitarios in Chile/Colombia) to analyze their pricing, scripts, sales funnels, and value propositions.
* Build the Local Teacher Network: Build a talent network of potential tutors for PAES / Saber 11 prep and engage in active dialogues. Secure a partnership with 1 lead teacher in month one to launch the pilot. Once the hypothesis is validated after 3 months, recruit the remaining full team of educators to cover all exam subjects completely.
* Drive Teacher-Led Growth: Train teachers on our methodology, prepare them for live webinars, and guide them in generating engaging conversion content.
* Test the MVP and Funnel: Collaborate with our central team to launch localized landing pages and manage lean operations (Zoom classes, WhatsApp warm-up groups, Google Sheets tracking).
* Gather User Insights: Conduct structured interviews with customers (parents and students) to collect qualitative feedback and feed product requirements directly to our central R&D team.
* Establish Initial Operations: Identify and integrate accessible local payment methods, including installment plan structures (cuotas).

**What success looks like in 3 months:**
* Comprehensive analysis of 3–5 key local competitors based on direct product experience and funnel testing.
* A structured teacher talent pipeline, with 1 lead contractor teacher onboarded for the launch.
* A validated MVP: operational localized landing page and a fully functioning funnel (Webinar ➔ WhatsApp engagement ➔ Zoom classes).
* Initial student cohorts filled while achieving the target Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Clear customer feedback and insights delivered to our central R&D team to refine the product.

**This is a perfect match if you:**
* Have hands-on experience in the EdTech or Test-Prep ecosystem in LatAm (Chile: PAES/DEMRE; Colombia: Saber 11/ICFES).
* Possess an entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset: comfortable conducting field research, attending local events, engaging competitors, and recruiting top teaching talent directly.
* Understand Teacher-Led Growth: skilled at mentoring educators to act as brand ambassadors and conversion drivers.
* Are fluent in Spanish with a deep understanding of LatAm business culture and consumer behavior.
* Thrive in early-stage environments: capable of launching operations using lean systems (Zoom, WhatsApp, Google Sheets) before full platform automation.

**What you will get:**
* Full autonomy and a dedicated budget for market research, testing, and initial hiring.
* A direct path to the Country Manager (LatAm) position upon successful pilot validation.
* Strong backing from ExamHub’s central R&D team (we handle performance marketing, lead generation, and platform infrastructure).
* Remote-first working environment with a flexible schedule.
* Unlimited days-off and sick leave policy.
* Competitive compensation package
* Stock option opportunity for long-term impact.

**Hiring Process:**
* Pre-screen with Recruiter (30 mins)
* Tech Interview with General Manager (1 hour)
* Final Interview with Founder / Investor (30 mins)
* Reference Check & Offer

description:
Upbound is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help us build and operate Upbound Spaces, the multi-control-plane management software at the heart of the Upbound Platform.

As part of the Spaces team, you’ll help us scale Upbound to reliably support thousands of control planes while extending enterprise-grade control plane management and operations across both cloud and on-premises environments. Our team is growing, and this is an opportunity to make a meaningful engineering impact across both product development and production operations.

For this particular opening, we’re focused on growing our engineering presence in the San Francisco Bay Area and Seattle, and are prioritizing candidates who are currently based in, or able to work from, one of those two markets.

### **What You'll Do**

- Actively build and operate Upbound Spaces in production, troubleshooting and resolving issues across multi-tenant SaaS environments, as well as contributing to Upbound's open-source projects, including Crossplane.
- Take ownership of building features in high demand by Upbound's customers and deliver new functionality that will delight and amaze our users.
- Investigate and debug complex issues in customer environments, including multi-control plane scenarios, resource reconciliation problems, and performance bottlenecks.
- Communicate through thoughtful and thorough design documents for new initiatives and detailed post-incident reviews that drive system improvements.
- Support the full project lifecycle for highly scalable and reliable services running in a cloud environment – discovery, analysis, architecture, design, review, documentation, building, migration, automation, deployment, production-readiness, and ongoing operational support.
- Write and maintain Go code that interfaces with the Kubernetes API, such as operators, controllers, add-ons, etc., with a focus on observability, debuggability, and operational excellence.
- Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot our Kubernetes services in production, using metrics, logs, and traces to identify and resolve issues quickly.
- Build and maintain operational tooling for debugging customer environments, analyzing control plane health, and automating incident response.
- Author documentation, user guides, runbooks, and blog posts to support and promote new features that you release.
- Support the software release cycle for Spaces self-hosted distributions, including diagnosing issues in customer-managed deployments.
- Participate in on-call rotation to support Upbound Cloud, responding to incidents and driving them to resolution.

### **What You'll Bring**

- Have experience operating production cloud services at scale: monitoring, alerting, incident response, post-mortems, and continuous improvement of service reliability.
- Have strong debugging skills across distributed systems, including experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing) and techniques for diagnosing issues in production environments.
- Have experience building and operating controllers that interact with the Kubernetes API server, including troubleshooting reconciliation loops, managing API rate limits, and optimizing controller performance.
- Are comfortable working directly with customers to understand, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues in their environments.
- Take responsibility and ownership for solving problems even if they are outside your lane, especially during incidents affecting customer workloads.
- Demonstrate excellence in your work, constantly trying to improve your skills and the operational posture of the systems you build.
- Have empathy for customers and keep them in mind as you build solutions, understanding that reliability and debuggability are features.
- Realize the importance of clear communication and effective collaboration to work as a team, deliver great results, and support customers through technical challenges.
- Help create a safe environment where everyone can contribute, learn from failures, share on-call knowledge, and help each other grow as operators and engineers.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager
description:
Upbound is building the control plane for the modern enterprise. As the company behind Crossplane, the open-source CNCF project that extends Kubernetes into an AI-native cloud control plane, Upbound enables organizations to compose, manage, and operate infrastructure and services through declarative, programmable control planes. Upbound Cloud delivers hosted, multi-tenant control planes that power platform engineering teams at scale.

The Management Plane is how customers experience all of it. It is the unified API surface, the interface they work in, the catalog they discover content through, and the systems that connect, license, and bill everything they run. As we scale into the next phase of growth, **we are hiring a Senior Manager to lead this group.**

### Areas of Ownership

- **Hub** — The Upbound Hub API, which indexes and aggregates control planes across an organization and provides unified API access, multi-tenancy, and organization context regardless of where those control planes run.
- **Console** — The primary frontend client and user experience for the entire Upbound platform, spanning single control plane views, multi-control-plane management, and organization-level operations.
- **Marketplace** — The distribution and discovery layer where users and customers find providers, functions, configurations, and extensions.
- **Middleware** — The platform services the business depends on: billing and metering, licensing and entitlements, Connect, and the identity and access plumbing that ties them together.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for growing a team, defining the architecture of the Management Plane, and ensuring these four surfaces operate as one coherent product rather than four adjacent ones.

### **In this role, you will …** 

**Management Plane Strategy**

Own the long-term technical direction for Hub, Console, Marketplace, and middleware. Ensure they present a single coherent experience to customers whether their control planes run in Upbound Cloud or in their own environment. Define the architectural direction for the Hub API, multi-tenancy, and organization-level identity and access management. Drive the reliability and performance standards these surfaces are held to.

**Middleware and Commerce**

Own the systems that turn product usage into revenue: metering, usage aggregation, billing, licensing, and entitlement enforcement. Ensure these systems are accurate, auditable, and resilient, and that they can support new packaging and pricing without a rewrite each time. Partner with Finance and Revenue on the operational side of billing correctness.

**AI-Native Access**

Ensure the Hub API is a first-class interface for autonomous agents as well as human operators, with the declarative, programmatic access agentic workflows require. Evolve the Console toward a multi-modal experience that works alongside those workflows rather than around them.

**Team Leadership**

Lead senior ICs and tech leads directly. Grow the team deliberately against the roadmap, raise the hiring bar, and develop engineers into senior and lead roles. Establish operational rigor: roadmap planning, delivery predictability, on-call ownership, and production excellence across the Management Plane surfaces.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner closely with Product, Design, GTM, Finance, and Customer Success. Translate enterprise requirements around security, multi-tenancy, packaging, and entitlements into platform capabilities. Represent the Management Plane in conversations about pricing changes, packaging, and customer-facing reliability.

### **You are a good fit if you have…**

- 7+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers directly
- Experience building and operating multi-tenant SaaS products at scale
- Strong API design fundamentals, including versioning, backward compatibility, and designing for third-party consumers
- Hands-on experience with at least one commerce or platform middleware domain: billing, metering, licensing, entitlements, or identity and access management
- Track record of owning production reliability for customer-facing services, including incident response and on-call culture
- Has built or intentionally restructured a team, not only inherited one
- Technically credible with senior and principal engineers while operating at the roadmap level

### **Skills / Traits**

- Leadership: Sets direction and quality standards for a group of senior engineers who need clarity more than supervision. Earns followership through judgment and technical credibility rather than title.
- People Management: Develops engineers deliberately toward their next level, runs consistent 1:1s and feedback loops, and addresses underperformance directly instead of waiting for a review cycle.
- Decision-Making: Makes calls with incomplete information on a surface where reversals are expensive. A published API, a data model, or a billing schema is hard to walk back, so the bar for thinking a decision through is higher here than in most teams.
- Communication: Translates fluently between engineering, Product, Design, Finance, and GTM. Writes clearly enough that a pricing change or an API deprecation can be understood by everyone it affects without a meeting.
- Problem-Solving: Drives to root cause on correctness problems rather than stopping at a mitigation. Comfortable reasoning about a discrepancy that only shows up in one tenant's invoice.
- Prioritization: Balances roadmap commitments against revenue-blocking middleware work, reliability debt, and customer escalations, and can explain the tradeoff to the people who lost the argument.
- Project Management: Delivers predictably across four tightly coupled surfaces where a Hub API change can block Console and Marketplace at the same time. Manages dependencies and sequencing without adding process for its own sake.
- Adaptability: Absorbs shifts in packaging, pricing, and agentic access requirements without rearchitecting each time. Adjusts approach when a framework or plan stops serving the team.
- Risk Management: Treats billing accuracy, entitlement enforcement, and API compatibility as areas where mistakes cost real money and customer trust. Builds the guardrails, auditability, and testing to catch problems before customers do.
- Technical Proficiency: Credible in API design, multi-tenant data modeling, and identity and access patterns, with enough frontend depth to lead Console work substantively rather than defer on it.

### It is a plus if you have…

- Familiarity with Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem
- Frontend or full-stack depth, enough to lead Console work substantively
- Experience with marketplaces, developer catalogs, or package distribution systems
- Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the systems behind them
- Startup experience in high-growth infrastructure or developer-tools companies
- Familiarity with how AI agents consume infrastructure APIs

title: Ad Operations Lead
description:
**About Marit**
Marit is an AI-native clinician community and platform that helps physicians and advanced practice clinicians find and do their best work. Founded by the same team that built Glassdoor, Marit Health is one of the fastest-growing community and job search platforms in medicine. We bring together salary transparency, job search, and community into a modern platform built specifically for clinicians. In just 18 months we've grown to over 100,000 clinicians, and our recruiting product, launched only nine months ago, has become the most popular in the category.

The product is working. Health systems are signing on, commercial demand has been strong, and we are now building the operational backbone that lets us onboard, traffic, and support those clients at scale.

**About the Role**
This is a hands-on Ad Operations Lead role and a great way to learn how a modern job marketplace runs under the hood. You'll own the day-to-day work that keeps client jobs live and performing: setups and implementations, job trafficking, employer data moderation and mapping, and ops support. You'll partner closely with Customer Success and Product to learn the platform deeply enough to spot what's slow, what breaks, and what could be automated.

The job is a mix of tactical ops where you will clear the queue accurately and on time, you document how the work actually gets done, and you use AI tools to move faster. But also includes developing playbooks, building AI tooling, and leading client conversations. This is a ground-floor seat on the team that will define how GTM Ad Ops works at Marit as we scale.

**What you'll do**
* Set up and implement new clients under the guidance of the GTM/Sales team
* Run job trafficking end to end: intake, QA, go-live, and ongoing maintenance so sponsored jobs perform
* Handle employer moderation and mapping so listings are clean and correctly categorized
* Provide ops support for client issues with speed and clear communication
* Investigate ad delivery optimization opportunities and propose and implement solutions.
* Document your work and flag recurring problems, so the process gets a little better every week
* Use AI tools in your daily workflow to cut time, reduce errors and get more done

**What we're looking for**
* 1 to 2 years of experience in online jobs, recruitment advertising, or job board / marketplace ops. You understand how jobs get trafficked, moderated, and kept live, or you can pick it up fast.
* Meaningful experience owning an ops function end-to-end, this may but does not need to include managing people.
* Comfortable working with data. You can read a spreadsheet, spot something that looks off, and ask good questions. Exposure to SQL is a plus, not a requirement, and we'll help you build it.
* You already use AI tools to work faster and are excited to lean in further.
* Strong ops habits: prioritization, attention to detail, QA discipline, and calm under volume.
* Self-starter who follows through. You clear today's queue and leave tomorrow's process a little better.
* (Preferred) Healthcare staffing or talent acquisition ops experience.

**Why this role is interesting**
* You'll work on a product that's changing the medical recruitment landscape
* You'll get a ground-floor seat as the GTM Ad Ops function is built, with a clear path to grow into tooling, playbooks, and client work
* You'll work closely with Customer Success, product, and founders, not just a support queue
* You'll learn how a fast-growing marketplace actually operates, which is rare this early in a career
* You'll help clinicians find and do their best work

title: Solutions Support Specialist
description:
**About the Company**
Mon Ami builds modern technology for the growing sector of aging and disability services. We’re a women-founded, mission-driven startup tackling the $100B+ social services market to enable the delivery of life-sustaining services for older adults and people with disabilities.

Our customers are large public agencies (think state departments on aging, or state departments of health) across the country who coordinate complex networks of care, but who are currently wasting 60% of their time on administrative paperwork that can be digitized and automated. Mon Ami’s cloud-based solutions allow them to streamline workflow, increase capacity to serve more people, and track outcomes. We have raised over $15M in capital and are backed by leading VCs in healthcare and SaaS, including Ulu Ventures, Maverick Ventures, Pivotal Ventures, and others.

**About the Role**
At Mon Ami, the Solutions Architecture (SA) team helps coordinate statewide implementation projects that require collaboration between product, engineering, data, and customer success. Using product knowledge, technical skills, and an intimate understanding of customer requirements, the team supports product configuration and data migrations end-to-end.

The Solutions Support Specialist partners closely with Solutions Architects to keep this work moving. You’ll take on the hands-on, detail-intensive tasks that make implementations succeed: designing and maintaining product configurations, building AI tools to ensure accuracy and improve efficiency, validating and transforming data in spreadsheets, performing quality assurance, and keeping technical documentation clear and current. It’s a great fit for someone who is meticulous, proactive, and comfortable learning technical tools on the job.

This role is ideal for someone who wants exposure to enterprise SaaS implementations, public-sector customers, and cross-functional product work — and who cares about the mission of improving the lives of older and disabled adults.

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Configure forms using YAML: Build and maintain product forms and configurations using YAML code, according to defined requirements and best practices (YAML can be learned on the job).
* Help build tools and processes: Help design new ways of working using AI to reduce manual tasks and improve accuracy of configurations and data migrations.
* QA: Perform quality assurance on configurations and migrations — validating accuracy, catching edge cases and inconsistencies, and partnering with Solutions Architects to resolve issues.
* Support successful customer launches: Work with cross-functional teams and customers to capture requirements, gather QA feedback, and keep implementation work on track through launch.

**About You**
* Exceptional attention to detail — you catch issues before they reach a customer and take pride in accurate, well-structured work.
* Proactive and organized, comfortable managing multiple streams of work and asking clarifying questions when requirements are unclear.
* Some familiarity with basic coding concepts; you’re comfortable working in technical tools and eager to learn (experience with YAML is a bonus, but can be learned on the job).
* Enthusiastic about integrating AI tools into daily workflows to enhance efficiency and support technical tasks (experience with Claude Code a plus).
* Proficient with spreadsheet tools such as Google Sheets, including formulas, filters, and validation checks.
* Some experience working with customers to understand requirements and gather QA feedback.
* Able to communicate clearly, verbally and in writing, with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* (Ideally) Genuine interest in Mon Ami’s mission and the aging, disability, or social services field.
* (Ideally) Exposure to enterprise SaaS products, customer onboarding, or implementation work.

**Our Culture**
We value high performance and high enjoyment. In addition to having the privilege of working hard on a mission we believe in, we get to do it on a team of people we genuinely respect and like being around. Our hybrid/remote company of ~40 gets together in person 2x per year for team-proposed activities like board games, cooking competitions, and time in nature. In between those retreats, we make time for 1-1 connections across the company. We have a flat hierarchy: ideas for innovation that come from our interns make it into the hands of our users. Founded by two women of color, we know diversity in our team leads to higher quality decisions, so we continually invest in recruiting from under-represented groups and maintaining an inclusive environment.

**Benefits**
* The expected salary range for this position is between $55,000 and $65,000. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.
* Health insurance, 15 days PTO (20 days after year two), and sick leave.
* 401K, disability insurance, FSA, and HSA.
* Generous paid family leave.
* The opportunity to do work that matters with a team that treats one another with respect and kindness.

**To Apply**
Send a resume or LinkedIn and cover letter to jobs@monami.io.

A word about cover letters: Short ones are great — we just want to know what drew you to this opportunity and why you could be a good fit.

title: Account Manager
description:
Most of what makes American healthcare expensive isn’t medical care. It’s the machinery wrapped around it: middlemen taking a cut, fraud nobody stops, and billing systems designed to fight over payment instead of deliver care. The result is higher premiums, denied claims, surprise bills, and a system patients increasingly experience as adversarial.

Arlo is rebuilding health insurance for small businesses from first principles: making sure as much of every premium dollar as possible goes to care instead of getting absorbed by the system around it. We do that by identifying fraud earlier, steering members toward higher-quality and lower-cost care, automating operational overhead, and eliminating vendors whose business exists mostly to take a cut.

AI is the foundation that makes this work. We use it across underwriting, operations, clinical programs, and member experience to build an insurer that becomes more efficient as the technology improves.

We’re already operating at meaningful scale: profitable, hundreds of millions in premiums, tens of thousands of members covered, and growing quickly through brokers, employers, and partners. Backed by Upfront Ventures, 8VC, and General Catalyst, with a team from Palantir, YC companies, and longtime healthcare operators.

### **About the Role**

As an **Account Manager**, you’ll be the first line of support for brokers and the employers they serve — answering questions, solving problems, and making sure they feel confident and well-supported at every stage of their journey with Arlo. You'll guide brokers through new plan implementations, help navigate the ins and outs of our quoting platform, and support ongoing plan management after launch. You’ll also have the opportunity to collaborate with our product team by sharing feedback and insights to help us improve the tools and systems our partners use every day.

This is a great role for someone who has experience in the health insurance space and thrives on delivering high-quality service in a fast-moving environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

- Respond promptly and professionally to broker and employer inquiries via email and phone.
- Guide brokers, and occasionally employers, through onboarding and health plan implementation, ensuring accurate setup and documentation.
- Support ongoing plan management, including tooling and answering day-to-day questions.
- Manage the renewal process from end to end.
- Coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues and provide timely, clear updates to brokers and clients.
- Partner with product and operations teams to share feedback and suggest improvements to tools, workflows, and documentation.

### **Key Focus Areas**

- **Customer Support:** Delivering reliable, empathetic support to brokers and employers.
- **Implementation Guidance:** Leading stakeholders through plan onboarding and setup.
- **Health Insurance Operations:** Navigating forms, systems, and compliance requirements with ease.
- **Ongoing Support & Renewals:** Managing post-implementation updates and guiding clients through the renewal process.

### **Qualifications**

- 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing role within the **health insurance, employee benefits, or related industry.**
- Strong understanding of health plan structures, terminology, and processes.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Comfortable using CRMs, ticketing systems, and modern workplace tools (experience with HubSpot and/or Retool a plus).

### **You’re Best Suited to This Role If You:**

- Have a working knowledge of how health plans are sold, implemented, and maintained (particularly level-funded plans).
- Take pride in delivering accurate, timely support to customers. Bonus points for customer success and/or implementation experience.
- Are a proactive communicator who can simplify complex topics.
- Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy cross-functional collaboration.

### **What We Offer:**

1. A fast-paced environment with a steep learning opportunity.
2. A collaborative team that's greatly motivated by our mission and the problems we work on.
3. The direct impact of your work on Arlo's business and operations.
4. ... and the usual tech startup benefits - 100%-paid health insurance benefits, free lunches in the office, fun company retreats, commuter benefits, etc.

### **Process:**

This is what you can expect when we like your application:

- 30-minute introductory call with Anna (Operations Lead)
- Take-home case study
- 30-minute call with Tim (VP of Sales)
- 30-minute call with Jan-Felix (CEO & Co-Founder)

**Compensation:** $70,000-80,000 annually

## **Why Join Arlo:**

- High ownership: You’ll get real responsibility from day one—our high-trust team empowers you to run with big problems and shape core parts of the company.
- Join an important mission: Your work directly influences how people access care and improves lives at scale.
- Growth & expansion: We’re moving fast, and as we grow, your scope will grow with us—new challenges, bigger opportunities, and rapid career velocity.
- Apply AI to a problem that matters: Instead of optimizing ads or cutting labor costs, you’ll use AI to fundamentally reimagine how people get healthcare.
- High pace, high collaboration: We operate with velocity, first-principles thinking, and a team that works closely, openly, and with ambition.

Exact compensation inclusive of salary and any bonuses is determined based on a number of factors including experience and skill level, location, and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process.  
  
Arlo is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on age, race, color, creed or religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military status, sex, disability, predisposing genetic characteristics, marital status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or arrest or conviction record, as defined under New York State law.  
  
🔒 **Your safety matters to us.** If you're selected to move forward in our hiring process, you'll hear directly from a member of our Recruiting team via an @joinarlo.com email address. We will never ask for personal or financial information outside of our formal onboarding process. When in doubt, please reach out to us to verify at: [recruiting@joinarlo.com](http://joinarlo.com).

title: Amazon Ads Lead
description:
## **About this Role**

We're looking for an **Amazon Lead** to own and scale Amazon as a key growth channel across Valerie's portfolio of ecommerce brands and international markets.

You'll own the overall Amazon strategy, performance, operations, and growth — from catalog and content to advertising, pricing, promotions, and marketplace expansion. You'll be responsible for ensuring our brands win on Amazon through strong execution, continuous experimentation, and commercially sound decision-making.

You'll work closely with Creative, Analytics, Paid Media, Product, Finance, AI, and Brand teams to continuously improve Amazon performance through better data, stronger execution, and faster learning. Success in this role isn't measured by how many listings are managed or campaigns are launched; it's measured by how consistently our brands grow on Amazon, how efficiently we acquire customers, and how effectively Amazon contributes to profitable business growth.

## **You could be a great fit if...**

- You naturally balance strategic ownership with being hands-on in Amazon when the business needs it.
- You enjoy making commercial decisions backed by data, balancing revenue growth, profitability, inventory, pricing, and long-term brand health.
- You have a deep understanding of how Amazon's search, retail, advertising, content, and customer experience ecosystems work together.
- You thrive in fast-moving environments where testing, learning, and adapting happen continuously.
- You enjoy building scalable Amazon playbooks, systems, and processes that can be applied across multiple brands and markets.
- You proactively identify opportunities, spot performance risks early, and solve problems before they become blockers.
- You are comfortable owning Amazon performance end-to-end rather than focusing on one part of the marketplace.
- You can confidently communicate complex Amazon insights to founders and leadership in a simple, actionable way.
- You enjoy working cross-functionally and turning insights from Creative, Analytics, Product, and Brand into better Amazon performance.

## **Requirements**

- 6+ years of experience in Amazon/ecommerce, with significant hands-on experience owning and scaling Amazon businesses.
- Proven experience managing and growing Amazon revenue across one or more ecommerce brands and international markets.
- Deep expertise in **Amazon Seller Central** and Amazon's advertising ecosystem.
- Strong experience with Amazon PPC, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant advertising formats.
- Strong understanding of Amazon growth metrics including **ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CAC, conversion rate, organic ranking, revenue, contribution margin, and profitability**.
- Proven experience with keyword research, campaign structure, bid optimisation, search-term analysis, budget allocation, and PPC scaling.
- Deep understanding of Amazon listing and catalog optimisation, including titles, bullets, imagery, A+ Content, Brand Stores, backend search terms, and variations.
- Experience developing strategies across pricing, promotions, deals, bundles, and product launches.
- Strong understanding of Amazon account health, compliance, catalog issues, and operational requirements.
- Proven ability to use Amazon data and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and make commercial decisions.
- Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Comfortable working closely with Creative, Analytics, Paid Media, Product, AI, Finance, and Brand teams.
- Ability to lead both strategically and operationally, making high-level decisions while remaining close to Amazon performance and execution.

## **Bonus Points**

- Experience scaling multiple ecommerce brands across different international Amazon marketplaces.
- Experience across the **US, UK, EU, Middle East, India**, or other international markets.
- Experience with **Vendor Central** in addition to Seller Central.
- Experience launching and scaling new ASINs from launch through meaningful revenue.
- Experience with Amazon DSP or broader Amazon upper-funnel advertising.
- Experience with FBA, inventory planning, forecasting, or supply-chain coordination.
- Experience building experimentation frameworks across creative, listings, pricing, promotions, keywords, and advertising.
- Familiarity with **Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive**, Looker Studio, automation workflows, AI-driven optimisation, or advanced reporting systems.
- Experience working within founder-led startups or high-growth ecommerce businesses.
- Experience building playbooks and operating systems that improve Amazon performance across multiple brands and teams.

## **You probably shouldn't apply if...**

- You prefer managing Amazon operations without staying close to performance, data, and commercial outcomes.
- You see Amazon primarily as a marketplace or catalog function rather than a growth channel.
- You focus only on PPC without understanding how content, pricing, reviews, inventory, and retail fundamentals influence performance.
- You rely on others to identify problems instead of proactively finding opportunities and risks.
- You're uncomfortable making decisions based on experimentation, testing, and changing priorities.
- You prefer highly structured environments where Amazon strategies rarely evolve.
- You're uncomfortable owning Amazon revenue, advertising performance, operational health, and business growth simultaneously.

*The best time to join Valerie was yesterday. The next best time is now* 🤓

👋**Our Hiring Process**

We want interviews to be valuable for both sides. Throughout the process, you'll meet the people you'll work with, learn more about the role, and get a chance to understand how we think and operate.

Our process typically includes:

- Introductory conversation with our Talent team \<\> 30 mins
- Hiring Manager interview \<\> 30-45 mins
- Role-specific assessment or practical exercise (where applicable)
- Cross-functional or stakeholder interviews \<\> 30-45 mins
- Final conversation with leadership \<\> 30-45 mins

We'll always let you know what to expect before each stage.

💪🏾**What You Can Expect**

- Meaningful work with visible impact
- High ownership from day one
- Collaboration with experienced founders, operators, and specialists
- A team that values curiosity, initiative, and continuous improvement
- Competitive compensation and the tools you need to do your best work
- Opportunities to grow as Valerie grows

### *Valerie is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We hire based on skills, potential, and the ability to contribute to our team.*

title: Founding AI/ML Engineer
description:
About Taskclan

Taskclan is a Canadian AI company building one connected ecosystem across Intelligence, Cloud, Studio, Engine, Enterprise and Lab.

Taskclan Intelligence develops our T1 model family: T1 Core, T1 Flow and T1 Max. These models will power capabilities across Taskclan Cloud, T1 Studio, our enterprise platform and products including GameNova, Nani, Forge3D and Spaces, TalentKit, ProposalAI and Ostrae.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Founding AI/ML Engineer to help build the technical foundation of Taskclan Intelligence. You will work directly with the founder on model development, evaluation, inference and deployment.

This is a hands-on founding role for someone who wants to build practical AI systems rather than simply integrate third-party APIs.

What you will own

• Advance the training and fine-tuning of T1 Core, T1 Flow and T1 Max
• Design reliable model evaluation, benchmarking and promotion pipelines
• Build high-quality training and preference datasets
• Improve inference performance, quantization and deployment efficiency
• Develop model-serving infrastructure for Taskclan Cloud and T1 Studio
• Strengthen model safety, security and production-readiness evaluations
• Monitor quality, latency, GPU usage and inference costs
• Contribute to our multimodal and agentic AI roadmap
• Document technical decisions and help shape the research culture

What we are looking for

• Strong experience with Python, PyTorch and transformer-based models
• Experience fine-tuning or evaluating open-weight language models
• Familiarity with Hugging Face, LoRA, quantization and GPU environments
• Understanding of inference systems, model serving and MLOps
• Evidence of shipped AI systems, research, open-source work or strong personal projects
• The ability to work independently and make evidence-based technical decisions
• The ability to commit approximately 15–20 hours per week initially
• At least three hours of collaboration availability with Eastern Time on agreed working days

Compensation and commitment

This is initially a part-time, equity-only founding role. There is no cash salary at present. The proposed equity range is 1.5%–2.5%, depending on experience, commitment and the final scope of the role.

Any equity grant will be governed by a formal agreement, four-year vesting, a one-year cliff and board approval. Our intention is to transition the position into a paid role once Taskclan secures sufficient financing or recurring revenue.

Why join now

You will help define Taskclan’s model architecture, evaluation standards, deployment infrastructure and long-term technical direction. Your work will influence every pillar and product across the Taskclan ecosystem.

To apply, share a model, research project, repository or production AI system you have built. Explain the problem, your specific contribution, the technical decisions you made and the results you achieved.
