title: Motion & Interaction Designer - Contract
description:
Make a real-time AI feel alive.
AtendaCare is looking for an exceptional motion and interaction designer to help define how our conversational AI moves, responds, and feels.

The product is functional. The UX works. Now we want the layer that makes people stop and go, “Whoa.”

Thoughtful motion. Subtle sound. Presence in the tiny moments. Less dashboard, more presence.


**THE CHALLENGE**

Atenda is a conversational AI designed initially for family caregivers. People can talk with her naturally through voice or text. She listens, responds, remembers and maintains context over time.

There are fascinating interaction moments throughout that experience, and that’s what you’ll be shaping.

We don't want Atenda to feel like a website or a sequence of screens.

Think environment.

One continuous place where elements appear, move, recede and respond naturally. That doesn't mean big animations or long transitions. Quite the opposite. Everything needs to be quick, subtle and exceptionally well crafted.

We want caregivers to be slightly dazzled, over and over, by moments that might last only hundreds of milliseconds.

We’re not asking you to redesign how Atenda works.

Your canvas is the milliseconds between the things that already work.

Use them to turn a functional product into an environment.



**WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON**

Motion and animation systems, screen and state transitions, launch experience, microinteractions, real-time voice states, listening/thinking/streaming/speaking behaviors, loading and latency moments, subtle sonic feedback, success and error states, and reusable motion patterns.

This isn't a beautification pass. We want you to help establish a motion and interaction language that our team can continue using as Atenda grows.

You'll work directly with the founders and our founding engineer. He can implement from spec. You bring the taste.



**TECHNICAL CONTEXT**

The caregiver experience is built from a single React Native codebase and ships across iOS, Android and web. What you design needs to feel exceptional on a phone while translating naturally to a desktop browser.

There’s no off-the-shelf component library. The existing interface uses a unified set of design tokens for color, typography and spacing, with light and dark modes and user-adjustable text sizing.

Atenda is also real-time. Responses stream word by word, voice can be interrupted mid-sentence, and the interface has distinct listening, thinking, streaming, speaking and interrupted states. Motion can't simply decorate static screens. It needs to work naturally while the experience is actively changing.

Your primary deliverables can be designs, prototypes, motion studies, tokens, assets and implementation-ready specifications. Our engineer will handle production implementation.

If you also happen to be great with React Native, TypeScript, Reanimated or Rive/Lottie-style production workflows, fantastic. But we're hiring for extraordinary interaction and motion design first.



**WHY THIS MATTERS**

We're starting with dementia caregivers, where an enormous amount of actual care happens at home.

Atenda supports the family member who's there through all of it: the changes in behavior, medications, sleep, appointments, questions, difficult days and the thousand little things that happen between physician visits.

Those conversations can also become structured longitudinal summaries clinicians can review, helping them see what's been happening at home instead of relying solely on what can be reconstructed during an office visit.

We're starting with dementia. But the opportunity is much larger.

If we get this right, millions of families could eventually interact with something you helped shape.

We want that experience to be worthy of them.




**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Your portfolio matters far more than your resume. We're looking for someone with exceptional taste in motion, interaction and micro-details. Someone who notices the transition everyone else ignores. Someone who can make something feel technologically advanced without making it flashy, intimidating or gimmicky.

You don't need healthcare experience. In fact, we'd love to see work from AI, consumer technology, automotive interfaces, gaming, fintech, spatial interfaces or anywhere else exceptional digital experiences are being created.

Show us the work where you obsessed over something everyone else would've called “good enough.”



**ENGAGEMENT**

This is initially a 2–6 week remote contract engagement, but this won't be the last time Atenda evolves. For the right person, there's real potential for ongoing work as we grow.

Send us your portfolio and tell us which piece best represents the kind of work you'd want to bring to AtendaCare.

We love people who care about 400 milliseconds.

title: Founding Full-Stack Developer Collaborator
description:
**Founding Full-Stack Developer Collaborator**

Join us as a Founding Collaborator in Software Development and be at the forefront of building innovative technology solutions from the ground up. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our platform, contribute to impactful projects, and grow alongside a passionate team dedicated to excellence. As a key member of our founding team, you will play a vital role in designing, developing, and deploying cutting-edge applications that drive real-world change. Your expertise will help lay the foundation for scalable, efficient, and robust software systems that meet evolving user needs and industry standards.

**About MR**

A comprehensive interactive Figma prototype, product vision and initial commercial model have already been developed and we are now looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Founding Full-Stack Developer Collaborator to help turn the concept into a scalable working platform.

**The Opportunity**

This is not a conventional salaried vacancy.

We are looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to become involved at the founding stage of a new venture and help shape both its technology and future direction.

You would work directly with the founder to:
* Review the existing Figma prototype
* Define a realistic MVP
* Recommend the most appropriate technology stack
* Design the platform architecture and database
* Build the front-end and backend
* Develop authentication and multi-role user accounts
* Create profiles, search, messaging and event functionality
* Establish hosting, testing, deployment and development processes
* Prepare the architecture for future payments, subscriptions, ticketing and marketplace functionality
* Help establish the technical roadmap for future development

The priority is to decide a focused, commercially viable MVP, rather than trying to deliver every proposed feature immediately (though that would be nice as it enhances the USP!)

**Skills We Are Looking For**

We would particularly like to hear from developers with experience in areas such as:
* Full-stack web application development
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React, Next.js or similar
* Node.js, NestJS, Python or comparable backend technologies
* PostgreSQL or relational databases
* REST or GraphQL APIs
* Secure authentication and role-based permissions
* Cloud deployment
* Git and collaborative development
* Responsive/mobile-first development
* Translating Figma designs into production applications
* Experience with marketplaces, Stripe, subscriptions, real-time messaging, event platforms, maps,     * Analytics or music technology would be especially useful.

This opportunity could be ideal for an:
* Experienced full-stack developer
* Technical founder looking for another venture
* Established freelancer with capacity for an entrepreneurial side project

Before substantive development begins, we would agree and document areas including:
Expected contribution
Intellectual property
Confidentiality
Responsibilities
Potential equity and/or revenue participation
How the relationship could develop as the business grows

* Influence major technology and product decisions

* Potentially progress into a senior paid technical leadership role

**Interested?**

Please send:

A short introduction
Your CV or LinkedIn profile
GitHub, portfolio or examples of previous work
Examples of full-stack applications you have helped build
Your approximate availability
Why the MR concept interests you
Initial discussions will be informal and focused on mutual suitability, expectations, availability and the vision for MR.

title: Freelance Sales Consultant – Conversational AI

**Sell conversational AI to businesses that need it. Keep 30% of everything they pay us for a year.**

No base, no cap, no schedule. If you already have relationships with business owners, this is something you can add to what you're already selling.

We build AI agents that handle real customer conversations — inbound calls, appointment scheduling, follow-up, lead qualification — across voice and messaging. They plug into how a business already runs instead of asking it to change.

Our customers are companies that live and die by the phone. They miss calls, lose leads, and can't staff a front desk around the clock. That's the pitch.

**30% of net subscription revenue we actually collect** from any customer you originate and close, for their first 12 months of paid service.

A customer at $1,000/month pays us $12,000 over the year. Your cut: **$3,600**.

Commission is paid on money collected, not invoiced. "Net Subscription Revenue" is defined in the Independent Sales Consultant Agreement and excludes items like refunds, credits, chargebacks, taxes, and non-subscription charges. No cap on qualified accounts.

- **Engagement:** Independent contractor
- **Compensation:** Commission only — 30% of net subscription revenue collected
- **Location:** Remote, anywhere
- **Schedule:** Yours

## What You'll Actually Do

- Find businesses losing money on missed or mishandled conversations
- Build your own pipeline — referrals, existing relationships, outbound, whatever works for you
- Run or coordinate product demos
- Dig into how a prospect's operation works and where AI fits
- Pull in our technical team when the conversation goes deep
- Work deals through evaluation and close them
- Keep records of the opportunities you originate

## Who This Works For

- Independent B2B sales consultants
- SaaS sales professionals
- Technology and AI consultants
- Fractional sales leaders
- Business development consultants
- Agencies serving SMB and mid-market customers

Especially if you already talk to industries built on phone calls, appointments, customer service, or lead management.

Experience selling SaaS, AI, telecom, CRM, contact center, or automation software helps. It isn't required.

## What Makes Someone Good At This

- You build real relationships, not call lists
- You're comfortable in front of owners and decision-makers
- You can hear an operational problem and see the technology fix
- You sell consultatively rather than transactionally
- You follow up, reliably
- You're curious about where conversational AI is heading

## The Independent Contractor Part

This is a contractor engagement, not employment. You:

- Set your own hours and schedule
- Choose your own prospecting and sales methods
- Can work with other businesses — no exclusivity
- Use your own equipment and business resources
- Handle your own taxes and expenses
- Get paid on customer revenue, not hours worked

We provide product information, sales materials, pricing, demos, and the support you need to represent the solution accurately.

## Why This One

Conversational AI is going from novelty to infrastructure — it's becoming how businesses handle customer communication. You're not selling another dashboard nobody logs into. You're selling something that answers the phone at 9pm and book the appointment.

And because you're paid on collected recurring revenue, you share in what your accounts actually generate over their first year, not a one-time finder's fee.

If you already advise business owners or sell technology, this slots into your portfolio without replacing anything.

title: Growth & Creator Partnerships Lead
description:
About Voxitect

Voxitect is a game-like building design tool available in the browser and as a desktop app on Steam. We're trying to make architectural design feel less like operating traditional CAD software and more like playing with a creative system — you can quickly experiment with buildings, forms, spaces, and ideas in an interactive environment.

We're now looking for someone to help turn Voxitect into a product people discover, play with, share, and subscribe to. This isn't a traditional marketing-manager role — we want someone who can actually create, experiment, contact people, publish content, measure results, and grow the product.

Your Mission

Bring new users to Voxitect and convert them into paying subscribers. You'll own two major growth channels:

1. Creator & Influencer Growth
2. Find people who already have the audience we want: architecture creators, architecture students, architects and designers, 3D artists, CAD and computational-design creators, game-design creators, indie-game YouTubers, Steam creators, creative-tech influencers, design educators, and architecture schools and communities.

You will discover relevant creators, contact them directly, build relationships, negotiate collaborations, create affiliate and commission deals, send them Voxitect, help them create interesting content around the product, track which creators actually generate users and subscriptions, and build repeatable influencer acquisition systems.

We care much more about results than follower counts — a small creator who brings 30 paying users can be much more valuable than a huge creator who brings none.

2. Content & Social Growth
3. You'll help build Voxitect's presence primarily through YouTube, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels — potentially also TikTok, Steam, Reddit, Discord, X, and other channels when useful.

You should be comfortable making the content yourself: opening Voxitect, designing something interesting, recording it, and turning it into content. Examples: designing a strange house in 60 seconds, recreating famous buildings, architecture challenges, "Can Voxitect design this?", timelapse building videos, before/after transformations, architectural experiments, game-like building challenges, tutorials, feature demonstrations, user creations, AI-assisted design experiments, and short satisfying building clips.

You don't need a production studio. We prefer high-frequency, interesting content over polished corporate marketing.

Growth Hacking

We want you to continuously experiment, using whatever legitimate tools help you work faster: AI video tools, AI editing, automated outreach, creator databases, scraping and research tools, analytics, affiliate systems, referral programs, landing-page experiments, SEO, community marketing, email campaigns, content repurposing, automation, and growth analytics.

The expectation isn't "post three times a week." The expectation is "figure out what makes Voxitect grow."

You should probably apply if you like some combination of architecture, design, games, internet culture, and startups. Ideally you can actually enjoy using Voxitect — one of the best signals for us is if you try the product and immediately start thinking "I know how I could get people interested in this." You don't need to be an architect, but being interested in architecture, spatial design, games, CAD, 3D tools, or creative software is a major advantage.

You should be comfortable with talking to creators and influencers, cold outreach, negotiating collaborations, recording your screen, editing videos, publishing frequently, looking at analytics, trying things that might fail, using AI tools heavily, working independently, and being evaluated based on measurable growth.

We care significantly less about your degree, job title, or years of marketing experience than about whether you can actually make something grow.

Compensation

This role starts without a traditional fixed salary. Instead, we want compensation strongly aligned with the value you create.

Commission: You receive commission based on subscriptions and revenue attributable to your growth efforts (influencer campaign → new subscriber → recurring revenue → commission). The exact structure can be agreed based on experience and responsibilities.

Equity / ESOP: There's also an opportunity to earn equity through clearly defined growth milestones — rather than equity purely for joining, additional ownership can unlock as meaningful targets are achieved. Potential milestones could include first 100/500/1,000 paying subscribers, MRR targets, successful creator partnerships, sustainable acquisition channels, and social audience milestones. We can define these together.

If you help make Voxitect significantly more valuable, you should participate in that value creation.

What Success Could Look Like

Within the first few months: a repeatable creator outreach process, dozens of relevant creator relationships, regular Voxitect video content, consistent YouTube and Instagram publishing, experiments across multiple acquisition channels, clear analytics around where users come from, and increasing browser users, Steam users, and paid subscriptions.

Longer term, we want this person to become the one who understands how Voxitect grows — and build the system around that answer.

How to Apply

Instead of a generic cover letter, we'd rather see something practical. Try Voxitect, then send us:
1. Three ideas for videos you'd make about Voxitect.
2. Three creators or influencers you'd contact first.
3. One growth experiment you'd run during your first week.

Bonus points if you actually create a short Voxitect video and send it to us. We care much more about what you can make happen than about how good your résumé looks.

hello@theword360.com

title: Chief Technical Officer (CTO) — Co-Founder
description:
## Before you read further
This isn't a job. It's a dare.

We're not hiring someone to "manage the tech." We're looking for a co-founder who wants
to build something so audacious it keeps you up at night — not because of deadlines, but
because you can't stop thinking about the next feature.

If that doesn't excite you, close this tab. No hard feelings.

## What is Pepcorns, anyway?
Pepcorns is building India's alternative investment platform — a place where regular
people, not just VCs and family offices, get a real shot at owning a piece of the startups and
ideas they believe in. Think community-powered funding, democratized access to private
markets, and a system that doesn't gatekeep wealth-building behind a velvet rope.

We're early. We're scrappy. We're building the plane while flying it. And honestly, that's the
fun part.

## Who we're looking for
Someone who thinks in systems, dreams in architecture diagrams, and has an almost
unreasonable itch to build things that don't exist yet.

You should be:
* **A ferociously good coder.** Not "decent at coding." Vicious. The kind of builder who'd
* rather ship an ugly working version tonight than a beautiful broken one next month.
* **Wildly creative.** We need someone who looks at "how it's normally done" and asks
* "why though?" Out-of-the-box isn't a buzzword here — it's the actual job description.
* **Comfortable wearing many, many hats**. Architect on Monday, firefighter on Tuesday,
* product thinker on Wednesday, the person explaining to an investor why the servers
* didn't fall over on Thursday. If you like staying in one lane, this isn't your road.
* **Here for the marathon, not the vibes of a paycheck.** We want someone building a legend, not logging hours. Ambition first, comfort a distant second.

## What you'll do
Own the stack end-to-end. Architect it from scratch, scale it as we grow. Make the calls we'll live with for years. Build the engineering team. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with the founder on product — co-founders here code, always.

## Eligibility criteria
There isn't one.

No checklist of years of experience, no "must have worked at X company," no pedigree
requirements. We care about exactly two things:
1. **Your skills** — can you actually build this?
2. **Our chemistry** — can we survive the chaos of building a company together, disagree
well, and still want to grab chai after a rough day?

That's it. That's the whole filter.

## Nice-to-haves (not must-haves)
* Experience in fintech, alternative investing, or anything regulation-adjacent
* Exposure to blockchain / smart contracts / tokenization concepts
* Experience building or scaling a consumer-facing platform
* A previous startup attempt — especially one that failed. We'd love to hear what you
* learned.

## The honest bit
No fat salary waiting here. What's on the table: equity, ownership, and the shot to build something that reshapes how millions of Indians invest. Chasing a paycheck? Not this. Chasing the feeling of building something real? Let's talk.

Ready? Let's go build something ridiculous.

title: 프리랜서 콘텐츠 작가 (GEO / 생성형 엔진 최적화 전문) – 한국어 원어민 (Clone)
description:

특히 한국어 원어민 작가를 찾고 있습니다.
✨ 왜 저희와 함께해야 할까요?
100% 원격 근무 및 유연한 근무 환경: 언제 어디서나 근무 가능합니다.
안정적인 작업량: 꾸준한 업무량(주당 최소 2편, 각 편당 약 1,000~2,000단어).
선도적인 AI/GEO 전략: 디지털 콘텐츠 분야의 최전선에 서세요. AI 관점을 적극적으로 수용하고 새로운 성장 방법론을 시험하는 프로젝트에 참여하게 됩니다.
장기적인 협력: 6개월 이상의 계약 기간이며, 연장 가능성이 높습니다.
간소화된 프로세스: 상세한 가이드라인 제공.
노출 기회: 기사를 게재할 사이트와 작가님만을 위한 전용 작가 페이지를 제공합니다.
🚀 지원 자격:
한국어로 1년 이상의 전문 글쓰기 경력.
탄탄한 SEO 및 GEO 지식: 전통적인 키워드 리서치를 이해하고 있을 뿐만 아니라, 무엇보다도 생성형 엔진 최적화(GEO)를 탐구하고 계신 분. (구글 검색 결과 상위 5위 안에 랭크된 기사를 보유하거나, Perplexity/ChatGPT에서 정기적으로 인용되는 기사를 작성한 경험이 있다면, 바로 저희가 찾고 있는 인재입니다).
심층적인 AI 논리 이해 및 활용 능력: 단순히 AI를 이용해 텍스트를 생성하는 데 그치지 않고, AI가 데이터를 참조하는 방식을 이해하고 계십니다. LLM이 출처를 수집하고 평가하는 원리를 파악하고, AI가 최적화하여 인용할 수 있도록 콘텐츠를 구성하는 방법을 알고 있으며, AI의 허위 정보를 방지하기 위해 전문적으로 사실 확인을 하고 AI 생성물을 다듬을 수 있어야 합니다.
CMS 및 시각 자료: 저작권이 없는 표지 이미지를 확보하고 게시물을 원활하게 업로드할 수 있는 능력.
📬 저희와 함께 디지털 콘텐츠의 다음 장을 써 나갈 준비가 되셨나요? 구인 게시판은 건너뛰고 다음 내용을 첨부하여 저에게 직접 DM을 보내주세요:
이력서.
이전에 게시한 SEO/GEO 기사 링크 2~3개.
콘텐츠를 “AI 친화적”으로 구성하거나 최적화하여 LLM이 쉽게 인용할 수 있도록 하는 방법에 대한 간략한 설명.
단어당 또는 약 800~1,500단어 분량의 기사당 표준 요금.
선발된 지원자분들께는 유료 시험 기고 기회를 드리겠습니다. 함께 협력해 봅시다! 🚀
이메일로 연락해 주세요: bihx@trip.com
모든 정보를 하나의 이메일로 보내주시기 바랍니다.
현재 받고 있는 비공개 메시지들을 정리하기가 다소 어렵습니다.

title: นักเขียนคอนเทนต์อิสระ (เน้น GEO / Generative Engine Optimization) – เจ้าของภาษาไทย
description:

✨ ทำไมต้องร่วมงานกับเรา?
ทำงานทางไกล 100% และยืดหยุ่น: ทำงานจากที่ไหนก็ได้ เวลาใดก็ได้ | ปริมาณงานมั่นคง: มีงานต่อเนื่อง (ขั้นต่ำ 2 บทความ/สัปดาห์ ความยาวประมาณ 1,000–2,000 คำต่อบทความ)
บุกเบิกกลยุทธ์ AI/GEO: ก้าวสู่แถวหน้าของวงการคอนเทนต์ดิจิทัล คุณจะได้ร่วมงานในโปรเจกต์ที่นำมุมมองของ AI มาปรับใช้จริง พร้อมทดลองวิธีการสร้างการเติบโต (Growth Methodologies) รูปแบบใหม่ๆ
ร่วมงานระยะยาว: สัญญาจ้าง 6 เดือนขึ้นไปพร้อมโอกาสในการต่อสัญญา | กระบวนการทำงานที่ชัดเจน: มีแนวทางปฏิบัติ (Guidelines) ที่ละเอียดให้ | โอกาสในการสร้างชื่อเสียง: เรามีพื้นที่ลงบทความและหน้าโปรไฟล์นักเขียน (Author Page) แยกเฉพาะสำหรับคุณ
🚀 สิ่งที่เรามองหา:
มีประสบการณ์การเขียนระดับมืออาชีพในภาษาไทยอย่างน้อย 1 ปี
มีความรู้ด้าน SEO และ GEO ที่แข็งแกร่ง: คุณเข้าใจการทำ Keyword Research แบบดั้งเดิม แต่ที่สำคัญกว่านั้นคือคุณกำลังศึกษาและทำความเข้าใจเรื่อง Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) (หากคุณเคยมีบทความติด Top 5 บน Google หรือถูกอ้างอิงโดย Perplexity/ChatGPT บ่อยครั้ง คุณคือคนที่ใช่สำหรับเรา)
เข้าใจตรรกะของ AI อย่างลึกซึ้งและเชี่ยวชาญ: คุณไม่ได้แค่ใช้ AI สร้างข้อความ แต่คุณเข้าใจวิธีที่ AI อ้างอิงข้อมูล เข้าใจตรรกะเบื้องหลังการดึงและประเมินแหล่งข้อมูลของ LLMs รู้วิธีจัดโครงสร้างคอนเทนต์เพื่อให้ AI นำไปอ้างอิงได้ดีที่สุด และสามารถตรวจสอบข้อเท็จจริง (Fact-check) รวมถึงปรับแก้เนื้อหาที่ AI สร้างขึ้นได้อย่างเชี่ยวชาญเพื่อป้องกันปัญหาข้อมูลคลาดเคลื่อน (Hallucinations)
CMS และงานภาพ: สามารถหาภาพปกที่ไม่มีปัญหาเรื่องลิขสิทธิ์และอัปโหลดโพสต์ลงระบบได้อย่างราบรื่น
📬 พร้อมที่จะเขียนบทใหม่ของคอนเทนต์ดิจิทัลไปกับเราหรือยัง? ไม่ต้องผ่านบอร์ดหางานทั่วไป แต่ส่งข้อความส่วนตัว (DM) หาเราโดยตรงพร้อมข้อมูลดังนี้: 
เรซูเม่ (Resume) ของคุณ
ลิงก์บทความ SEO/GEO ที่คุณเคยเขียนและเผยแพร่แล้ว 2-3 ลิงก์
คำอธิบายสั้นๆ เกี่ยวกับวิธีที่คุณจัดโครงสร้างหรือปรับแต่งคอนเทนต์ให้ "เป็นมิตรกับ AI" (AI-friendly) และง่ายต่อการถูกอ้างอิงโดย LLMs โปรดแจ้งอัตราค่าจ้างมาตรฐานของคุณ (คิดเป็นรายคำ หรือราคาเหมาสำหรับบทความความยาวประมาณ 800–1,500 คำ)
ผู้ที่ผ่านการคัดเลือกจะได้รับเชิญให้เขียนบทความทดลองงานโดยได้รับค่าตอบแทน มาร่วมงานกันนะครับ/คะ! 🚀

title: 프리랜서 콘텐츠 작가 (GEO / 생성형 엔진 최적화 전문) – 한국어 원어민
description:
기존 검색 엔진에서 상위 노출될 뿐만 아니라, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews와 같은 AI 생성형 엔진에서도 적극적으로 인용되는 고품질 콘텐츠를 제작하는 일을 좋아하시나요?
저희는 글로벌 콘텐츠 팀을 확장 중이며, 한국(KR) 사이트를 위해 흥미롭고 성과가 뛰어난 콘텐츠를 제작해 줄 재능 있고 선구적인 사고를 가진 프리랜서 작가를 찾고 있습니다!
특히 한국어 원어민 작가를 찾고 있습니다.
✨ 왜 저희와 함께해야 할까요?
100% 원격 근무 및 유연한 근무 환경: 언제 어디서나 근무 가능합니다.
안정적인 작업량: 꾸준한 업무량(주당 최소 2편, 각 편당 약 1,000~2,000단어).
선도적인 AI/GEO 전략: 디지털 콘텐츠 분야의 최전선에 서세요. AI 관점을 적극적으로 수용하고 새로운 성장 방법론을 시험하는 프로젝트에 참여하게 됩니다.
장기적인 협력: 6개월 이상의 계약 기간이며, 연장 가능성이 높습니다.
간소화된 프로세스: 상세한 가이드라인 제공.
노출 기회: 기사를 게재할 사이트와 작가님만을 위한 전용 작가 페이지를 제공합니다.
🚀 지원 자격:
한국어로 1년 이상의 전문 글쓰기 경력.
탄탄한 SEO 및 GEO 지식: 전통적인 키워드 리서치를 이해하고 있을 뿐만 아니라, 무엇보다도 생성형 엔진 최적화(GEO)를 탐구하고 계신 분. (구글 검색 결과 상위 5위 안에 랭크된 기사를 보유하거나, Perplexity/ChatGPT에서 정기적으로 인용되는 기사를 작성한 경험이 있다면, 바로 저희가 찾고 있는 인재입니다).
심층적인 AI 논리 이해 및 활용 능력: 단순히 AI를 이용해 텍스트를 생성하는 데 그치지 않고, AI가 데이터를 참조하는 방식을 이해하고 계십니다. LLM이 출처를 수집하고 평가하는 원리를 파악하고, AI가 최적화하여 인용할 수 있도록 콘텐츠를 구성하는 방법을 알고 있으며, AI의 허위 정보를 방지하기 위해 전문적으로 사실 확인을 하고 AI 생성물을 다듬을 수 있어야 합니다.
CMS 및 시각 자료: 저작권이 없는 표지 이미지를 확보하고 게시물을 원활하게 업로드할 수 있는 능력.
📬 저희와 함께 디지털 콘텐츠의 다음 장을 써 나갈 준비가 되셨나요? 구인 게시판은 건너뛰고 다음 내용을 첨부하여 저에게 직접 DM을 보내주세요:
이력서.
이전에 게시한 SEO/GEO 기사 링크 2~3개.
콘텐츠를 “AI 친화적”으로 구성하거나 최적화하여 LLM이 쉽게 인용할 수 있도록 하는 방법에 대한 간략한 설명.
단어당 또는 약 800~1,500단어 분량의 기사당 표준 요금.
선발된 지원자분들께는 유료 시험 기고 기회를 드리겠습니다. 함께 협력해 봅시다! 🚀
이메일로 연락해 주세요: bihx@trip.com
모든 정보를 하나의 이메일로 보내주시기 바랍니다.
현재 받고 있는 비공개 메시지들을 정리하기가 다소 어렵습니다.

title: Sales Partner
description:
**Help us take BrandBingo to more brands. 🚀**

**BrandBingo** is an early-stage advertising startup helping brands reach people through smart, affordable in-auto advertising.
We partner with auto-rickshaw drivers and turn everyday rides into engaging brand experiences using creatively designed boards, QR-enabled campaigns, and measurable customer interactions.

**We've already acquired 20+ paying brands in less than 2 months, with campaigns ranging from ₹1,250 to ₹55,000. Our largest campaign so far covers 50 autos for one month.**

We're now looking for entrepreneurial **Business Development and Sales Partners** who can help us take BrandBingo to more brands and businesses.

**What you'll do:**
* Identify brands and businesses that could benefit from BrandBingo.
* Reach out to founders, marketing teams, business owners, agencies and decision-makers.
* Introduce BrandBingo and understand their marketing requirements.
* Identify opportunities where our advertising network can add value.
* Present campaign ideas and commercial proposals.
* Build relationships and close advertising campaigns.
* Develop repeat business and long-term client relationships.

**Who we're looking for:**
We're looking for people who are good at creating opportunities, not just people who are good at applying for jobs. You could be a great fit if you:
* Have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Are comfortable approaching businesses and decision-makers.
* Have an existing network of brands, founders, agencies or local businesses.
* Have experience in sales, business development, advertising, marketing or partnerships.
* Are entrepreneurial and comfortable working independently.
* Enjoy finding opportunities and turning conversations into business.
* An existing network is a strong advantage, but it isn't mandatory. If you have the sales ability, confidence and drive to build relationships from scratch, we'd still love to hear from you.

**Your earning potential:**
This is a performance-driven opportunity.
You earn a commission on the business you successfully bring to BrandBingo. The more campaigns you close and the more value you create, the more you earn. There is no fixed ceiling on your earning potential — your upside grows with the business you bring in.
We're looking for people who want to grow alongside an early-stage company and participate directly in the value they create. You focus on building relationships and bringing great brands to BrandBingo. And BrandBingo takes care of the rest. 

**Why join us now?**
We're still early, which means you won't be joining a large sales organization with an established territory and a fixed playbook.
You'll have the opportunity to help shape how BrandBingo grows its sales network, work directly with the founders, and build meaningful earning potential as the business scales.

If you're someone who sees an opportunity and thinks "I know who I can sell this to", we'd love to talk.

**Let's build this together.**

title: Content & Design Marketing Intern

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer — AI / B2C Visual Platform
description:
**Join the Team Building the Future of AI-Powered Visual Creativity**

*Aurify* is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to work closely with our CTO and engineering team to build, scale, and continuously improve our B2C visual AI platform.
This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who enjoys building consumer-facing products end-to-end — from frontend UX to backend systems — working with rapidly evolving AI technologies, and solving challenging problems around performance, scalability, and user experience.

**About Aurify**

Aurify is a B2C platform where users upload a photo and instantly get back a high-quality AI video or avatar — no prompts, no editing, and no technical knowledge required.

We move fast, integrating the latest image generation, video synthesis, and digital human technologies. Our product lives and dies on output quality, speed, reliability, and seamless UX.

See what we're building: https://www.aurify.com

**Quick Filter — Read Before Applying**

This role is specifically for a senior full stack engineer who has built or contributed significantly to consumer-facing applications across both frontend and backend, ideally involving AI-generated images, video, avatars, media, or other content-generation experiences.
You should be equally comfortable building polished, responsive UIs and working hands-on with APIs, backend systems, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
Experience with AI/ML products is strongly preferred.

**What You'll Own**
**Full-Stack Product Development**
* Integrate image, video, avatar, and other generative AI APIs.
* Build end-to-end workflows for AI generation, processing, storage, and delivery — from UI to backend pipeline.
* Evaluate new AI models and APIs based on quality, speed, reliability, and cost.
* Help improve generation pipelines and troubleshoot production issues.

**AI Integration**
* Integrate image, video, avatar, and other generative AI APIs.
* Build workflows for AI generation, processing, storage, and delivery.
* Evaluate new AI models and APIs based on quality, speed, reliability, and cost.
* Help improve generation pipelines and troubleshoot production issues.

**Architecture & Scalability**
* Design and implement systems capable of handling increasing generation volume and user traffic.
* Improve application performance, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency across frontend and backend.
* Identify technical bottlenecks and propose practical solutions.
* Contribute to architectural decisions under the direction of the CTO.

**Engineering Excellence**
* Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code across the full stack.
* Conduct code reviews when requested by the CTO.
* Debug complex technical issues across the entire application stack.
* Improve testing, monitoring, logging, deployment, and development workflows.
* Follow engineering standards and technical direction established by the CTO


**What We're Looking For**

*Required*
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated full stack ownership.
* Proven experience building and shipping consumer-facing web or mobile applications, both frontend and backend.
* Strong experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript across frontend (React/Next.js) and backend (Node.js).
* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, cloud infrastructure, and scalable application design.
* Experience integrating and working with third-party APIs.
* Experience taking features from development through production, across the full stack.
* Ability to independently solve complex technical problems on both the client and server side.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote startup environment.
* Comfortable working under the technical direction of a CTO in a fast-moving environment.

*Strongly Preferred*
* Experience building AI-powered consumer products.
* Experience with image generation, video generation, AI avatars, digital humans, or other generative AI applications.
* Experience working with APIs from AI model providers.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, and production infrastructure.
* Experience with high-volume media processing or content-generation pipelines.
* Experience optimizing AI/API infrastructure costs.
* Startup experience with significant hands-on engineering ownership across the stack.


**You Might Have Worked On Something Like**
* An AI avatar or digital human application.
* A consumer image-generation platform.
* An AI photo or video editing application.
* A photo-to-video generation product.
* A social or UGC platform with AI-powered features.
* A consumer SaaS product with significant API and media-processing infrastructure.
* A platform handling large volumes of user-generated images or videos.

You understand that building these products isn't just about making an API call. You have experience dealing with latency, reliability, generation failures, API costs, infrastructure, user expectations, and scale.

**Tech Environment**

Our technology stack may evolve quickly as the product grows, but experience with several of the following is valuable:

* JavaScript / TypeScript
* React / Next.js
* Node.js
* Python
* REST / GraphQL APIs
* PostgreSQL / SQL
* Redis
* AWS / GCP / Azure
* Docker
* CI/CD
* AI / image / video generation APIs
* Cloud storage and media processing
* Monitoring and observability tools

You don't need to know every technology listed above. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly matter more than checking every box.

**How You'll Work With the CTO**

The CTO will own the technical vision, architecture, engineering strategy, AI technology direction, and overall engineering leadership.

As Senior Full Stack Engineer, your focus will be on hands-on technical execution and product development.

**You'll be expected to:**
* Take ownership of assigned technical projects and features, front-to-back.
* Translate product and technical requirements into working solutions.
* Make sound technical decisions within the established architecture and direction.
* Identify technical issues and communicate them proactively.
* Work closely with the CTO on implementation and technical priorities.
* Execute quickly while maintaining code quality and reliability.
* Collaborate with other developers to ensure smooth implementation.
* Take responsibility for the quality and performance of the code you ship, from UI to database.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first months, you'll be expected to:
* Become deeply familiar with the Aurify platform and architecture, frontend and backend.
* Take ownership of key areas of the product.
* Ship meaningful production features independently, end-to-end
* Improve platform reliability and performance.
* Help optimize AI generation workflows and infrastructure costs.
* Resolve technical issues efficiently across the stack
* Become a dependable senior engineering resource for the CTO.

**Who Thrives Here**

*You're probably a great fit if you're the kind of engineer who:
* Gets excited about new AI technologies and experiments with them.
* Can move between frontend and backend when a problem requires it.
* Enjoys building products that everyday users love.
* Doesn't need every task broken down into small tickets.
* Can move quickly without sacrificing engineering fundamentals.
* Think about both technology and the user experience.

We're looking for a builder — someone who can take a problem, figure out the technical path, and ship it.

**Learn More About Aurify**
Before applying, we encourage you to explore our platform and learn more about what we're building.
Website: https://aurify.com

**How to Apply**
Send your resume, cover letter, and portfolio (if available) to careers@aurify.com.
Email subject line format: Senior Full Stack Engineer – [Your Name]

title: Front-End Software Engineer
description:
As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth.

We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.

Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo — Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.

Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment — because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.

We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

**What You'll Do**

- **Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences.** Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code — we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.
- **Work across the stack.** Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.
- **Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code.** Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.
- **Prototype fast and validate with real users.** Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing — especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.
- **Build for scale and own the codebase.** Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.
- **Make automation legible and trustworthy.** Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.
- **Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability.** Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.
- **Share AI-native workflows.** Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

**Requirements**

### Requirements

A full-stack generalist who has taken a product from 0 to 1 and can apply that instinct inside a system that already has real patients on it. Entrepreneurial, willing to roll up their sleeves, and drawn to a mission that disrupts how healthcare gets delivered.

- 5+ Years of experience
- You are dangerous on the frontend of the stack.

- You are a highly skilled dev (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind and JavaScript).

- You also have backend skills (tRPC, Drizzle ORM, SQL, Node, SST).

- You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects or large areas of the codebase.

- Strong experience building paid products and services is preferred.

- React Native or Expo experience is a plus.

- You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints, and timelines.

- You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment.

- **Build for scale and own the codebase.** Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.
- **Make automation legible and trustworthy.** Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.
- **Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability.** Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.
- **Share AI-native workflows.** Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

**Requirements**

Who We're Looking For

Someone entrepreneurial who's taken products from 0 to 1, willing to roll up their sleeves, and drawn to a mission that disrupts how healthcare gets delivered.

- Shipped WebGL we can open — Three.js or React Three Fiber, live, running on a phone.

- Highly skilled with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and JavaScript.

- Real taste in motion, timing, and restraint — and the ability to defend it.

- Enough backend to be dangerous (Node, SQL) and an appetite for SST and Drizzle. Not required on day one.

- Comfortable owning entire projects and large areas of a codebase independently.

- Experience building paid products and services.

- A strong communicator — clear on technical problems, constraints, and timelines.

- Comfortable in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment.

**To apply:** send a link to something you built that we can open on a phone. That tells us more than a resume does.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Multiple Teams, North America)
description:

You’ll stay hands-on, solve complex technical problems, and work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to ship reliable agentic experiences.

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. title: Implementation Engineer, Customer Support
description:

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
## **About Astra**

Astra is building mission-critical infrastructure for moving money at scale. Our platform processes billions in annual transaction volume with 99.9%+ uptime, powering real-time transfers, bank debits, card disbursements, and complex financial compliance systems. We provide APIs and automation tools that enable businesses to move money programmatically while maintaining strict regulatory requirements.

## **The Role**

Astra is the instant payments API powering money movement for fintech, banking, and marketplace products. Every transaction that runs through our systems is real money moving in real time, and the infrastructure underneath our product is what lets our engineering team ship quickly without breaking the systems that depend on it. As a Platform Engineer at Astra, you'll build and own core infrastructure and tooling: Terraform, CI/CD, environment provisioning, and the abstractions engineers rely on to ship and run their own code. You'll work hands-on across infrastructure-as-code, deploy tooling, and observability, partnering directly with product engineers rather than sitting behind a large platform org with layers of process. This role suits someone who's energized by building leverage for other engineers, comfortable owning meaningful infrastructure surface area, and motivated by the stakes of doing this well in a regulated, real-money environment.

## **What You’ll Do**

- Own pieces of core platform infrastructure, including the Terraform migration (VPC, IAM, networking), CI/CD pipelines, and environment provisioning, as part of a growing infrastructure team
- Build and maintain the tooling and abstractions that let product engineers ship and run their own code without solving infrastructure problems from scratch
- Advance our observability foundation, including remaining service instrumentation and building out our metrics collection pipeline
- Standardize monitoring and alerting, including business and financial operations metrics and synthetic monitoring
- Harden CI/CD pipelines, including secrets migration and building self-service deployment tooling
- Support GCP infrastructure work as our platform scales, including dead-letter queue handling and other reliability pieces of our messaging system
- Help build out compliance remediation tooling, local dev/onboarding tooling, GCP cost visibility, and infra architecture documentation as these needs are validated
- Operate independently on production infrastructure changes, since most of this work is scoped execution rather than architecture-setting

## **What We’re Looking For**

**Required Experience**

- 5+ years in a platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or backend engineering role with significant infrastructure ownership
- Experience building or significantly maturing internal developer tooling, CI/CD systems, or service platforms, rather than only operating within an already-mature setup
- Experience operating in a startup or small-team environment where you own meaningful infrastructure surface area and there isn't always a playbook
- Direct experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure also relevant) in production, including infrastructure-as-code
- Track record of partnering closely with product engineering teams to unblock their work, not just maintaining infrastructure in isolation
- Comfort operating independently on production infra (Terraform, IAM, CI/CD) without heavy review

**Education**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**

- Strong proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
- Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, or similar) and building CI/CD pipelines from the ground up
- Solid backend engineering skills in at least one production language (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/Node) for building internal services and tooling
- Experience designing and maintaining internal APIs and service abstractions used by other engineers
- Familiarity with observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) and how platform decisions affect reliability and debuggability
- Understanding of secrets management, access control, and secure-by-default infrastructure patterns

**Preferred Experience**

- Prior experience in fintech, payments, banking-as-a-service, or another regulated industry where infrastructure decisions carry real financial or compliance consequences
- Experience building platform tooling that supports compliance requirements (e.g., audit logging, data retention, access controls) alongside developer velocity
- Experience with GCP specifically, and with cross-cloud (GCP/AWS) infrastructure work
- Familiarity with database platform work (provisioning, migrations tooling, backup/replication strategy) in addition to application infrastructure
- Experience scaling internal platforms through a period of rapid engineering team or transaction growth

## **Why This Role Matters**

- Every engineer at Astra ships faster or slower based on the platform underneath them, and this role adds capacity to a growing team
- You'll have direct influence over how we execute against a real, scoped backlog, without layers of process standing between you and the outcome
- This role enables Terraform migrations, CI/CD hardening, and observability work to move in parallel and helps our internal tooling as our platform scales

## **What We Offer**

- Competitive compensation with equity in a growing fintech company.
- Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements
- Small team, big impact — your work directly supports Astra’s ability to scale responsibly
- Professional growth opportunities in compliance and risk management
- Mission-driven — build infrastructure that powers financial innovation while meeting the highest regulatory standards

## **Remote Work and Culture**

Astra is a remote-first company hiring only within the U.S. We value thoughtful collaboration, clarity, and initiative. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - RCM
description:
## Flagler Health is building the clinical operating system for modern musculoskeletal care.

We partner with MSK provider groups and specialty clinics to help them grow, operate more efficiently, and deliver better longitudinal care across patient acquisition, clinical workflows, and ongoing patient engagement. Our platform sits at the intersection of care delivery and clinic operations, helping providers capture more value across the full patient lifecycle.

We’ve recently raised our [Series B](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260810011327/en/Flagler-Health-Raises-%2450-Million-Series-B-to-Build-the-AI-Operating-System-for-Musculoskeletal-Care) and are entering our next phase of growth.

Senior Fullstack Engineers own our main product surface end to end. One monorepo, one product: Vue 3 and TypeScript on the front, Express and MongoDB behind it, and a stack of shared TypeScript packages in between.

You will move across all of it rather than sit on one side.

Most of the hard problems here aren't algorithmic. Clinical data is never clean, the same patient spelled three ways, a date that means something different in every system it passes through. And the people behind the data are people: they reschedule, they don't pick up, they tell the front desk what they never told their doctor. We're looking for engineers who find that interesting rather than annoying, and who'd rather model the mess than pretend it away.

The work is contract-first. API schemas are declared once and both frontend and backend typecheck against them, so a broken endpoint is a build failure instead of a bug report. If you've spent years keeping a hand-written client in sync with a backend that kept moving, this will feel like a relief.

What You'll Do:

- Build screens against our internal component library
- Design and implement API routes contract-first, with schemas shared across frontend and backend
- Model clinical and revenue cycle data in MongoDB, and keep it queryable as collections grow
- Work inside shared TypeScript packages every app in the repo depends on
- Take features from spec to production and support them once they're live
- Work across the full revenue cycle, from pre-visit clearance through payment
- Integrate with the EHRs and external systems that our clients already run on

Required Qualifications:

- 5+ years building and shipping production web applications, including 3+ years of health care revenue cycle management experience
- Strong TypeScript across the stack
- Hands-on experience with modern front-end framework such as Vue or React
- Backend experience with Node, Express, and MongoDB/Mongoose
- You know what your queries cost. Patient, clinical, and financial data gets large and wide fast, and the difference between a query that scales and one that falls over is usually an index or a schema decision made months earlier
- You can name the shortcomings of the tools you use, not just their features
- You've designed for growth you couldn't fully predict, and can explain what you'd do differently now
- You've worked in a large codebase you didn't write and improved it rather than rewriting it
- Experience moving health data between systems: HL7, FHIR, EHR connectivity
- You've built complex yet auditable systems geared towards visibility
- Experience processing financial events while effectively managing states for each transaction
- You’ve created configurable state machines and rule engines that can be easily tweaked to handle new cases with minimal code changes and long term maintenance

Preferred Qualifications:

- Understanding of how care is delivered: clinical workflow, care pathways, how a patient moves through the system, and how a practice gets paid for it
- Familiarity with the OpenAI API or similar LLM tooling
- Monorepo experience (e.g., Turborepo, Nx)
- Realtime or streaming applications
- Durable workflow orchestration (e.g., Temporal, Cadence, AWS Step Functions)
- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
- Experience building analytics or reporting on top of transactional data
- Experience with EDI/X12 (270, 271, 835) is a plus

Work Environment:

- Distributed remote team with hybrid offices in NYC and Vancouver.
- Hybrid. Regular and consistent on-site presence is required for this position.

## **_Our Values:_**

This is what you can expect of your teammates at Flagler:

- **Owner:** We own our work like founders. We don't wait to be asked, and we pick up the problem nobody else has.
- **Builder:** We like making things from scratch. We don't need a playbook to start, and we'd rather ship a rough first version than wait on a perfect spec.
- **Fast:** We make quick decisions. We favor progress and respect process.
- **Transparent:** We communicate directly. We value merit and honesty, and we challenge assumptions, including our own.
- **Curious:** We explore new approaches and ask "why" often.

title: Senior Software Mobile App Engineer - Flutter

description:

------------------------

BONUS: 
------------------------

- Experience with React Native

You take responsibility of issues even if they weren't caused by you. An owner doesn't say, "that's not my job" or "that wasn't in the job description". You're not afraid to step up and take responsibility when the business and the team needs it. You take pride in your coding craftsmanship when owning a feature and are able to answer questions from the team when asked about a feature or system or bug.

**You're bold and take action**

You understand that speed matters in business and taking months to research a project/feature is generally not condusive to startup culture. You don't mind getting your hands dirty. You think a working proof of concept is the best way to make a point.

**You are a learner, and you're curious**

You enjoy staying up to date with current technologies, new frameworks and best practices. You bring this knowledge back to your team and incorporate it into your daily work.

**You are passionate about your work**

You arrive each day with a positive attitude. You enjoy writing code and often do so in your spare time. You go above and beyond to get the job done and delight our customers.

title: Founding Engineer / Technical Architect
description:
Founding Engineer / Technical Architect

The Tour Card — the financial operating system for touring artists

About The Tour Card

Touring is a multi-million-dollar business run on spreadsheets, separate card logins, cash envelopes, and a 24-hour lag before anyone knows what was spent. Tour managers, business managers, and tour accountants stitch together credit cards, bank payments, sales reports, international disbursements, accounting tools, folders of receipts, and manual due-date grids to move money across legs, currencies, crew, and vendors, and still can't answer "where does the tour stand right now" on demand.

We're building the single operating system for touring artists’ money end to end: business charge cards with controls that don't strand people on the road, multi-currency spend and collection, per diems, automated receipt capture, real-time reconciliation into the books, float and settlement. We are imminently closing a seven figure pre-seed round, lining up design partners, and bringing on founding team members to start building the financial OS for touring artists.

Why this role, and why now

This is the first engineering hire and the person who owns the architecture. You won't start from scratch: we're inheriting a full-stack codebase from a consumer credit card product built with a leading issuing platform, including a working rewards system, an internal ledger, an admin portal, a responsive consumer web app, and the surrounding application architecture. Your first job is to take that stack in hand, decide what carries forward, and repurpose it from a consumer card into a B2B platform for touring money operations.
That makes this a rare founding seat: the stack exists and hard decisions have already been made, but it's inherited code written for a different product and a different user, so you need the judgment to know what to keep, what to rebuild, and what to throw away — and the range to then drive the whole product forward as the technical lead.

What you'll do

Own the architecture. Take over the inherited card issuing stack, assess it honestly, and set the technical direction for the pivot to a B2B, multi-tenant, multi-currency financial platform.
Ship the MVP. Get a real product into the hands of tour managers and tour accountants fast - card issuing with spend controls, virtual cards, a multi-account/multi-card single view, receipt capture, and accounting integration (Xero and similar).
Repurpose, don't rebuild for its own sake. Decide what the existing ledger, admin portal, rewards system, and web app give us, and adapt them to the touring use case rather than starting over where you don't have to.

Handle the hard fintech surfaces as they come up: ledger reconciliation, KYC/KYB, card controls, and eventually FX/multi-currency and float/credit.
Set the engineering foundations: codebase health, testing, security, deployment, AI guardrails. Build the framework that a small team can grow on.
Work directly with the founding team on product and priorities. At pre-seed, you're close to every decision, and you'll help shape what we build next and who we hire.

What you'll be working with


The inherited stack you'll take over and evolve:
An issuing platform integration for card and program management on top of a sponsor bank’s BIN
An internal ledger and rewards system
A React-based admin portal and a consumer web app
The application architecture around all of the above
AWS
React with Tailwind CSS
NestJS with Express
PostgreSQL
GraphQL partner API integration 

Expect to extend this toward integrations the touring workflow demands like accounting systems, multi-currency accounts (collect/hold/spend), receipt and settlement data, and payments beyond cards (ACH/wire).

Who you are

A senior/staff/architect-level engineer who has owned a system end to end and shipped it. You’re comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and making the call, and still have the chops and appetite to get into the code yourself.
Strong full-stack range. You can move across backend services, data/ledger models, and a web frontend without waiting for someone else to cover a layer.
You have a strong CI/CD process that has worked well in the past, and can scale up to our needs.
Good at inheriting and assessing someone else's codebase. Reading unfamiliar code, forming a clear view of what's worth keeping, and repurposing it without endless rewrites.
Pragmatic about velocity at pre-seed. You know when to build for correctness and when to ship and iterate, and you're energized rather than daunted by an ambiguous, fast-moving early stage.
Care about correctness where money is involved. You treat ledgers, balances, and reconciliation as things that have to be right, not roughly right.
AI-informed. You know where to use AI to accelerate timelines, where and how it falls apart, and how to build systems to keep it in check.

Strongly preferred

We'll weigh fintech and payments experience heavily. The strongest candidates bring hands-on work with some of:
Card issuing platforms - Highnote, Marqeta, Lithic, Stripe Issuing, Synctera, i2c, or similar.
Ledgers and double-entry accounting systems, and the discipline of keeping them reconciled.
KYC/KYB, card program controls, or banking/payments integrations (ACH, wire, accounting platforms like Xero/QuickBooks).
Multi-currency / FX money movement.

Experience being an early or founding engineer at a startup.

Nice to have

Comfort hiring and leading a small team as we grow past the first hires.
Any connection to live music, touring, wealth management, or the artist economy.

Logistics & compensation

Location: Remote, NYC-area preferred
Compensation: $180,000 – $225,000 plus equity (to be determined). 
Reports to: CEO

title: Full Stack Engineer - Engineering Leadership Track
description:
Blank Slate is building the next generation of systems to help teams move faster, think better, and operate at scale. We create intuitive, high-impact products, leveraging data science, cognitive science, and a strong user interface, that solve real problems for modern organizations. Our team values ownership, curiosity, and speed - bringing together engineers and builders who are excited to tackle complex challenges and turn ideas into reality.

**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer who can own our product end-to-end: from the data pipeline and adaptive algorithms on the backend to the learner and manager experiences on the frontend. This is a hands-on building role, and you have the opportunity to contribute to architecture and features day to day.

With that, this role has a clear leadership trajectory. As the company scales, the right person in this seat may grow into the Chief Technology Officer. We’re looking for someone with the technical depth to build what we need today and the strategic instinct to lead an engineering organization tomorrow. You’ll have a seat at the table for product and business decisions from day one.

**What You’ll Own**

Platform & Product
* Full stack development of our adaptive learning platform, including the learner-facing application, manager dashboards, and admin tooling.
* Optimation and Implementation of multiple ML engines and databases facing increasing volume across regions.
* SSO integrations, data export pipelines (flat file and API), and LMS interoperability for enterprise clients managing compliance workflows.
* Content delivery systems (deck sequencing, certification pathways, completion tracking) that power the core learning experience.

Architecture & Scale
* Making infrastructure decisions that set us up for the next 3–5 years: cloud architecture, CI/CD, monitoring, database design, and security posture.
* Evaluating build vs. buy tradeoffs, selecting tools and frameworks, and establishing engineering standards as the team grows around you.
* Supporting enterprise deployment requirements including on-premises AI models, data residency constraints, and SOC 2 / HIPAA compliance readiness.
* Work with a fast-moving engineering team to rethink AI implementation pipelines
* Strong collaboration and consideration with cybersecurity

**What We’re Looking For**
* 5+ years of professional full stack engineering experience, with depth in at least one modern backend language and one modern frontend framework.
* You’ve built and shipped production SaaS products—not just features within them. You understand the full lifecycle: database design, API architecture, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Strong opinions on how to build reliable, maintainable systems. You care about code quality not for its own sake, but because it’s how small teams move fast without breaking things.
* Experience with data-intensive applications: working with event streams, building analytics pipelines, or integrating ML models into production systems.
* Comfort with enterprise requirements: SSO/SAML, role-based access control, audit logging, data export, and compliance frameworks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You’ll interface directly with the business, enterprise clients, and research partners.

**Strong Signals**
* **Direct Experience working with Scala or Java, SQL/noSQL databases, evaluation of AI-generated code**
* You’ve been the first or second engineer at a startup, or the tech lead of a small team where you were responsible for both building and deciding what to build.
* Experience in data science or machine learning, even if it’s not your primary role—enough to evaluate model validity, design experiments, and collaborate meaningfully with ML researchers.
* Prior experience deploying on-premises or self-hosted solutions for enterprise clients with strict data residency or security requirements.
* You’ve operated in industries where software failures have real-world consequences: aviation, healthcare, energy, financial services, or defense.
* You think about technology as a business lever. You ask “why are we building this” before “how should we build this.”

**What We Offer**
* Direct access to the CEO and a real voice in product and business strategy, not only technical execution.
* The rare combination of mission-driven work and hard technical problems: you’re building algorithms that change how people retain critical safety knowledge.
* Competitive salary, flexible remote work (NYC preferred), and the opportunity to build an engineering culture from the ground up.

title: Staff ML Platform Engineer (MLOps)
description:
**Come join our Data team!**

**High velocity, high trust, and high impact with a will to win.**

If that resonates deeply with you, this could be your next career move. We're seeking someone who leads with humility, pursues audacious goals, and is motivated by meaningful impact on people and the world.

At FutureFit AI, our core mission is to help more people get to better jobs faster and cheaper, with a specific focus on those facing barriers to opportunity. Our work helps resolve the growing issue of economic inequality, ensuring that no one is left behind in the future of work. Our AI-powered platform brings efficiency and insight to workforce development, replacing outdated systems and unlocking human potential at scale.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today.

*Important note: Data shows that men typically apply when meeting 3/10 requirements, while women often wait until it's 10/10. We encourage you to apply if you see a strong (not necessarily perfect) fit.*

**The Opportunity**

We're seeking a **Staff ML Platform Engineer (MLOps)** to build the platform our ML and LLM-powered products run on. Our ML footprint has grown fast, but the layer underneath it has not kept pace. You'll own that layer end to end: how models get built, deployed, evaluated, and served; how compute and environments get provisioned and managed; how our LLM calls get routed and optimized for cost; and how we know quickly when a recommender goes down or goes off the rails.   
  
This is a build role and an operate role: when a model regresses or a recommendation looks wrong, you can trace it back to the inputs that produced it and help fix it.

**Your Role**

Our ML footprint has grown quickly: batch models, real-time recommendation models, LLM-powered features, and daily pipelines processing every available job across the US and Canada. What we haven't built is the platform underneath it: consistent compute and environments, a disciplined path from experiment to production, cost-aware routing across LLMs, and the monitoring that tells us fast when something breaks.   
  
You'll assess our current pipelines and ML workflows with clear eyes, decide what to build and in what order, then build it. This is greenfield platform work with direct influence on production models and how our ML team operates, and it comes with real operational ownership: you will be close enough to the running systems to debug them, not one step removed.

**What You'll Own**

- **Assessment and plan:** Evaluate our current pipelines, data architecture, and ML workflows, and produce a prioritized, opinionated plan for what needs to change.
- **Platform foundations and optimization:** Own compute provisioning and environment management, keep training and serving environments reproducible, keep frameworks and packages current across services and model images, and tune latency, throughput, and spend, all without destabilizing production.
- **LLM infrastructure and smart routing:** Build the layer our LLM features run on, including smart routing that sends each request to the cheapest model that can handle it well, plus the prompt and response evaluation needed to prove quality holds when we route down.
- **Experimentation and safe rollout:** Give us a real discipline for A/B testing models before they are fully ramped: shadow deploys, canaries, holdouts, and success criteria agreed in advance, so a model earns its way into production instead of being switched on.
- **Observability and traceability:** Know within minutes when a recommender goes down or starts drifting, and be able to explain why: model and data monitoring, alerting, regression detection, lineage, and enough traceability to reproduce a questionable recommendation on demand or trace a prediction back to the inputs that produced it (we currently use Braintrust; comparable tooling counts too).
- **Hands-on operations:** Stay close enough to the running systems to operate them. You will work with the team to keep models online, but when something breaks in production you can dive in and help fix it, including models other people built.
- **Data and feature infrastructure:** Own how features are computed, stored, and served consistently between training and inference, and take on the data engineering the team needs along the way.
- **Standards, not sole ownership:** Establish the deployment and monitoring standards the rest of the team can run with. You are building shared ownership, not becoming the only person who keeps things online.

**Required Experience**

- Staff-level, hands-on experience in MLOps, ML platform, or ML infrastructure (we're also open to Data Platform Engineer, ML Infrastructure Engineer, or Data Scientist backgrounds with strong platform ownership: the title on your last resume matters less than what you actually built)
- Experience standing up MLOps practice end to end: CI/CD for models, experiment tracking, model registries, deployment workflows, and monitoring
- Production experience with LLM-based systems: serving, prompt and response evaluation, routing across models and providers, and managing cost and latency tradeoffs. If you've done this with traditional ML systems and can show you pick up LLM tooling fast, that counts too
- Experience operating models in both batch and real-time serving contexts
- Hands-on with compute provisioning and environment management: containers, reproducible training and serving environments, and keeping frameworks and packages current on a fast-moving stack without breaking production
- Experience running controlled model experiments in production: A/B tests, shadow or canary deploys, holdouts, and the judgment to set success criteria before ramping
- Depth in observability and traceability for production ML: drift and regression detection, alerting that catches a recommender going down or going off the rails, lineage, and the ability to trace a prediction back to the inputs that produced it and reproduce it after the fact
- Hands-on operational experience: you have carried the pager or its equivalent, debugged production ML incidents under time pressure, and fixed systems you did not originally build
- Comfort doing the data engineering the platform needs: pipelines, feature computation and storage, and keeping training and serving features consistent
- A track record of walking into complex, fast-grown systems, diagnosing the real problems, and materially improving them
- Strong systems design ability: you can translate product needs into durable architecture and stay close enough to the code to build it yourself

**Bonus Points**

- Interest in growing into model development yourself. This role starts on the platform side, but the line between platform and modeling is thin here, and we would rather hire someone who wants to cross it
- Feature store experience. We are early here, so you would be shaping it rather than inheriting it
- Experience evaluating AI/ML observability or LLM evaluation vendors, with judgment on when to buy versus build
- Background in mission-driven, workforce, or government-adjacent data environments
- Comfort mentoring a small data and engineering team while you build

**Our Tech Stack for Data**

- **Languages:** SQL, Python
- **Data orchestration and transformation:** Airflow, dbt
- **Data storage and warehousing:** PostgreSQL, Redshift, MongoDB
- **Machine learning and model serving:** AWS SageMaker (PyTorch models, artifact upload to S3, model registration), serving real-time and batch inference
- **Visualization and reporting:** Looker, Quicksight
- **Infrastructure:** AWS (S3, Redshift), GitHub Actions for CI/CD

**Your Education**

Your alma mater isn't our focus. Your grit, hunger, and drive are. If you learn continuously, tackle challenges head-on, and know your strengths and gaps intimately, you're our person.

**Location**

Remote (CA/US). Toronto-based candidates are welcome to work from our office at 325 Front St West if they prefer, but it's optional, not a hybrid requirement.

**Travel Expectations**

Approximately 2-3 trips per year, including our company off-site in August.

**Compensation**

**Pay Range:** USD $172,000-$215,000 (United States) / CAD $172,000-$220,000 (Canada)

As a remote-first company, we benchmark to the national market for comparable roles at institutionally-funded startups, targeting the middle of market. Bands reflect applied experience, with room to grow.

If establishing the standards a growing ML org runs on, rather than inheriting a finished one, is the kind of problem you want, let's talk.

**Hiring Journey**

At FutureFit AI, our hiring process is designed to help you assess whether this role and our culture are the right fit based on your unique skills, mindset, and experiences. We move fast and work with intensity, so we want you to get a real sense of that from the start.

Each journey includes a mix of interviews and a performance challenge. For this role, that might look like:

- Online Application
- Initial Screen with Talent Acquisition
- Interview with Hiring Manager
- Performance Challenge
- Final 1:1 Interviews
- Final Decision

Generally, this entire process takes around 6 weeks, although the timing can vary due to specific candidate circumstances.

## **Ready to shape the future of work?**

At FutureFit AI, we're not just building a company—we're transforming how talent and opportunity connect. Join our driven team united by a commitment to job seekers and the workforce ecosystems we serve.

## **Company Snapshot:**

- **Team:** 30-50 across US and Canada (hubs in NYC and Toronto)
- **Customers:** Workforce development agencies and intermediaries, government agencies, employers
- **Industry:** SaaS/AI technology
- **Funding:** Bootstrapped 0-1, then raised funding led by JP Morgan
- **Structure:** Growth, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Data, People & Culture, Finance & Operations

## **Our Core Principles**

- Be Curious
- Drive to Outcomes
- Raise the Bar
- Speed Matters
- Own It
- We Over Me

## **Use of AI in Hiring**

At FutureFit, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and equitable—never to replace human judgment. We use AI in the following ways:

- **Screening support:** AI may help us compare applications against the skills and experience required for a specific role. These skills are defined by the hiring team for each position. A human reviews each application, with the AI assessment as just one input.
- **Interview support:** In some interviews, we may use an AI notetaker to summarize the discussion so interviewers can focus on being present in the conversation.
- **Insights, not decisions:** AI provides data points to support our team’s evaluation but does not make or recommend final hiring decisions. Every hiring decision is made by people.
