We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We encourage people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply.*

title: Lead Developer — Rebuild, Modernize, & Scale (Social Good SaaS, Remote)
description:
We are looking for a lead developer to do a greenfield rebuild of our legacy SaaS app, modernize our mobile apps, and lead the tech effort to scale our app.  You will help choose the language, build the technical foundation, work with our product manager to rebuild the app, and migrate all customers over.

**About Track it Forward** Track it Forward is the leading volunteer time-tracking application for nonprofits and schools. For 15 years, we’ve helped thousands of organizations mobilize volunteers and track over 30 million hours. We are a profitable, bootstrapped team of 4 focused on great work-life balance, high-impact work, and a fun, puzzle-loving culture (daily crosswords, monthly virtual escape rooms, and annual retreats).  We are not a VC-funded startup. We grew organically, stayed profitable, and prioritize high-quality work and personal fulfillment without growth-at-all-costs pressure. The team is led by the original founder and developer.

**The Modernization Strategy** This is a structured, phased "small bang" migration—not a high-risk cutover or a strangler-fig migration. You will build a parallel greenfield system, extract legacy components step-by-step, and migrate customers over incrementally tenant-by-tenant while keeping operations running smoothly.

* **Current Tech:** Drupal 6 architecture hosted on Pantheon, paired with two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps.
* **Your Scope**: Complete ownership of the technical architecture. You will partner with our product manager, establish engineering processes, and lead the rebuild from scratch.
* **Modern AI practices:**  We want you to be on the cusp of AI workflows while also balancing human guardrails to produce quality code.
* **Team Structure: **You will be our sole developer in the short term, taking full technical helm as we scale.

**Target Stack & Responsibilities**

* **Core Tech Stack:** Core backend/frontend rebuild focused on Python/Django, Laravel, or React. You will make the final architectural call with input from the CEO/founder.
* **Database & Storage Extraction**: Deconstruct our legacy Drupal 6 / MySQL schema into a clean, domain-driven PostgreSQL database, and offload 100GB+ of media files to AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2.
* **Security & Isolation:** Implement application-layer field-level encryption (AES-256 for PII, Bcrypt/Argon2id for passwords) and build zero-trust dev environments so contractors never handle production user data.
* **CI/CD & Documentation:** Establish automated testing pipelines, clean API contracts, and clear runbooks so the codebase remains maintainable long-term.
* **Mobile App Maintenance:** Maintain and update our two Ionic/Capacitor mobile apps using AI coding tools. Mobile is a small fraction of the overall role—you just need to leverage AI to keep them functional without being a native mobile expert.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Pre-AI Engineering Foundation:** 5+ years of core software engineering and architectural experience established before generative AI existed. You hold strong first-principles opinions on database normalization and system patterns.
* **Proven Migration Experience:** You have successfully architected and led at least one legacy monolith migration. You know what inputs and scope decisions keep momentum going.
* **Modernized AI Velocity:** You actively use AI tools to multiply output, but retain strict architectural control, unit testing discipline, and manual code review standards.

**Location & Remote Flexibility**

* **US W-2 Tax Residency Required:** You must be legally authorized to work in the US and maintain primary US tax residency (for payroll, contracts, and legal/tax compliance).
* **Travel-Friendly:** We are 100% remote. As long as your primary legal/tax home remains in the US, you are welcome to travel or digital nomad—provided you can consistently hit our core sync hours.
* **Core Sync Hours**: Mandatory availability from 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM PST for daily team syncs and real-time collaboration. Flexible hours outside this window.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary:** $150,000 – $200,000 / year (commensurate with experience)
* **Benefits:** 401(k) w/ company match, Health Insurance, vacation, PTO, and holdiays
* **Culture:** High autonomy, direct project ownership, and zero venture-capital growth pressure

**How to Appl**y To filter out automated spam: include the most authentically human, non-AI reason why this specific role resonates with you.  Specifically include a short Loom video of you in the “Why should we choose you over any one else?” question.  This isn’t required but will sure stand out.  Be authentic, no need to do crazy rehearsals, just be you.

description:
# **Forward Deployed Engineer**

San Francisco or US Remote

## **About Nash**

Nash powers logistics infrastructure for major commerce brands including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, plus platforms like Shopify and Toast. We unify decisioning, execution, and capacity into a programmable platform for real-time, AI-native logistics orchestration across couriers, fleets, gig workers, and autonomous systems.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman and Aziz Alghunaim. We are backed by Y Combinator, a16z, OpenAI, and other leading investors, and headquartered in San Francisco.

## **The Role**

This is hands-on engineering at the edge — not pre-sales, not implementation. You’ll build, deploy, and operate production software directly with customers while working closely with our global product and AI teams.

You’ll be part of the foundational team defining how our North America engineering operates. Expect to move fast, own outcomes, and see your work drive real-world impact within weeks, not quarters.

## **What You’ll Do**

• Build and deploy production systems used by top enterprise retailers

• Work directly with customers’ engineering, ops, and leadership teams

• Take new products from concept to live deployments

• Design and extend core infrastructure underpinning global delivery orchestration

• Partner with product and AI teams to influence direction across North America

• Debug real-world logistics workflows across fleets, APIs, and integrations

## **Who You Are**

• 4 plus years building and shipping production software

• Strong experience with APIs, backend systems, or platform integrations

• Comfortable jumping between code, customer problems, and architecture decisions

• Bias toward speed, iteration, and ownership

• Clear communicator who can work directly with operators, CTOs, and execs

• Motivated by building software that touches the physical world at scale

## **Why This Role**

If you’ve wanted to join a high-velocity YC-backed startup redefining how logistics works worldwide — while getting to build and see your code operate inside real enterprise workflows — this is the one.

Your work will touch millions of deliveries each month and help define Nash’s engineering footprint across North America and Globally.

**More about** [**Nash**](http://Nash.AI)

### **Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.**

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

### **What You’ll Love About Us**

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!  
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates  
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity  
✅ Flexible paid time off  
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

title: Functional Consultant – SAP, Aerospace & Defense / Manufacturing CPQ
description:
Job Description
This is a fully remote positon
Functional Consultant – SAP, Aerospace & Defense / Manufacturing

Location: United States — Remote
Travel: Up to 20–30%, based on client needs
Salary Range: $90,000–$150,000 annually, based on experience
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Twenty5

Twenty5 helps project-centric organizations deliver better outcomes through AI, predictive analytics, and modern enterprise technology. We partner with clients across Aerospace & Defense, Manufacturing, Professional Services, and Capital Projects to modernize how they plan, price, cost, and run complex projects. Our platform is built natively on SAP Business Technology Platform.

We're a remote-first, globally connected team that values practical problem-solving, accountability, and real client impact.

About the Role

We're seeking an experienced Senior Functional Consultant who understands SAP-enabled manufacturing and has worked in or alongside Aerospace & Defense, government contracting, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.

This is a hands-on, client-facing functional role. You'll work directly with business stakeholders to understand their operations, document requirements, map processes, configure solutions, and support successful implementations of the Twenty5 platform and related ERP and CRM systems.

The strongest candidates understand how manufacturing organizations actually run, not just how the software works. You can hold a credible conversation about product costing, project-based manufacturing, production planning, materials, order settlement, and quality with both a shop-floor lead and a CFO.

This is not an SAP developer, ABAP, BTP, or Basis role. We're looking for a functional consultant who has owned business processes, configuration, requirements, and testing with real end users.

What You'll Do

Partner with customers to gather, analyze, and document business and system requirements.
Lead discovery sessions and translate business needs into practical functional solutions.
Analyze current-state processes and design improved future-state workflows.
Configure and support the Twenty5 platform and related enterprise solutions.
Support ERP and CRM implementations, including configuration, data mapping, integrations, testing, documentation, training, and deployment.
Lead System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT): build test scenarios, coordinate defect resolution, and confirm solutions meet requirements.
Apply manufacturing and A&D knowledge to problems involving costing, production, materials, quality, project delivery, and operational reporting.
Work across finance, manufacturing, supply chain, project management, IT, and technical teams.
Write or interpret SQL queries when needed for reporting, analysis, validation, or troubleshooting.
Produce clear functional specifications, process maps, user stories, configuration documentation, and test scripts.
Provide ongoing functional support and recommend process and system improvements.
What We're Looking For

Required:

5–10+ years of functional consulting, ERP functional analysis, or business systems analysis experience.
Hands-on experience supporting manufacturing business processes.
Experience with Aerospace & Defense, government contractors, aviation, or another complex, highly regulated manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of one or more of: product costing and cost object controlling; project-based, engineer-to-order, or make-to-order manufacturing; production planning and manufacturing execution; project accounting and order settlement; materials management and procurement; BOMs, routings, MRP, inventory, or quality processes; finance and controlling in a manufacturing context.
A track record of gathering requirements, mapping processes, configuring solutions, and supporting end users.
Demonstrated ownership of SIT and UAT.
Strong client-facing communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively in a remote environment.
Preferred SAP Experience

Strongly preferred in one or more areas:

SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC
SAP Product Costing (CO-PC)
SAP Project Systems (PS)
SAP Production Planning (PP)
SAP Materials Management (MM)
SAP Quality Management (QM)
SAP Sales and Distribution (SD)
Cross-module integration across Finance, Manufacturing, Projects, Materials, and Sales
Full-cycle SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, or transformation projects
Candidates with exceptional A&D and manufacturing-process expertise on another major ERP platform will still be considered if they can pick up new systems quickly. If you're deep on one side (domain or SAP) and lighter on the other, apply anyway and tell us where your strength is.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Direct functional experience with an A&D manufacturer, government contractor, or a consulting practice serving A&D clients.
Hands-on SAP configuration experience, not solely project coordination or technical development.
Product Costing, Controlling, or Project Systems experience in a project-driven manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of government-contract manufacturing: contract structures, project accounting, traceability, compliance, or customer-specific access requirements.
Experience leading client workshops and advising business leaders on process improvements.
What Success Looks Like

In your first several months, you'll:

Build a strong understanding of the Twenty5 platform, our customers, and our implementation approach.
Earn credibility with client stakeholders by understanding both their business and their technology.
Independently lead requirements and process-discovery conversations.
Produce clear, actionable functional documentation.
Support configuration, testing, deployment, and adoption of solutions that solve real operational problems.
Spot opportunities to improve customer processes and strengthen outcomes.
Why Join Twenty5

Visible impact at a growing enterprise software company.
Direct work with leading Aerospace & Defense and manufacturing organizations.
A role at the intersection of enterprise technology, AI, predictive analytics, and operational transformation.
A collaborative, high-performing global team and a remote-first culture.
Meaningful client-facing work with real room to grow as we scale.
Eligibility and Work Authorization

Some Twenty5 engagements involve access to technical data governed by U.S. export control laws (ITAR and EAR). For those engagements, applicants must qualify as a "U.S. person" as defined under those regulations, which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and individuals granted asylum or refugee status.

Applicants must also:

Reside in and be authorized to work in the United States.
Be able to travel up to 20–30% when required.
Be able to meet applicable client-specific, contractual, background-screening, or system-access requirements, which will be discussed during the hiring process.
Equal Opportunity

Twenty5 is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, consistent with applicable law. We do not discriminate on the basis of citizenship, immigration status, national origin, or any other protected characteristic, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: CEO
description:
SILVER FOXX COMMUNITY, INC.
Chief Executive Officer
Full-Time  |  Executive Leadership  |  Reports to the Board of Directors
ABOUT SILVER FOXX
Silver Foxx Community, Inc. is building the leading AI-powered community and marketplace where seasoned professionals transform decades of hard-earned expertise into meaningful, flexible opportunity. We connect experienced, fractional executives (“Foxxes”) with small and midsized businesses that need executive-level capability on demand.

We are a place where seasoned leaders are not sidelined but drive innovation, mentor one another, and thrive. Through proprietary curation and intelligent matching, we help individuals and businesses solve real business challenges with precision, speed, and depth. We are not simply a marketplace; we are a force multiplier for experience.

THE ROLE
Silver Foxx is seeking a Chief Executive Officer to lead the company to take us to market.  Our next chapter takes our ideas and MVP to a thriving, revenue-generating platform. This is a full-scope operating and leadership role: equal parts company builder, fundraiser, community steward, and brand voice.

The incoming CEO will inherit a Founding Team, a defined vision, a proprietary matching platform in development, a tech partner, and a marketing plan for growing the initial roster of fractional executives and SMB partners. The role reports to the Board of Directors and works in close partnership with the Founding Team.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Company Leadership & Strategy
•	Set and drive overall company strategy and culture in partnership with the founding team.
•	Own the P&L and operating plan; make the resourcing, hiring, and prioritization calls that determine what gets built and when.
•	Lead the executive team and coordinate across co-founders, advisors, and outside partners so the company moves as one.
•	Represent Silver Foxx externally as the primary spokesperson with media, partners, and the broader fractional-executive ecosystem.
GTM & Revenue Acceleration
•	Drive initial revenue growth by executing GTM strategy to acquire both SMB clients and high-caliber fractional talent.
Fundraising & Investor Relations
•	Co-own the capital raise end-to-end: investor pipeline, pitch narrative, diligence process
•	Capital & Fundraising Ownership: Lead equity financing rounds, pitch investor networks, and secure early-stage capital to fund runway and growth.
•	Maintain the investor narrative and positioning including how the company is described relative to comparable platforms in the fractional-talent space.


•	Prepare and deliver regular investor updates in partnership with the other founders and executive financial advisor.
•	Oversee the financial model, ensuring assumptions are defensible and investor-ready. 
•	Manage relationships with outside counsel, financial advisors, and other capital-raise partners.
Board & Governance
•	Serve as the primary liaison to the Board of Directors, setting agendas, driving decisions, and ensuring the board has what it needs to govern effectively.
•	Own cap table integrity and equity strategy, including option pool design and future issuances, in coordination with the Board of Directors.
•	Navigate governance milestones including valuations, SAR/equity agreements, and formal corporate actions with appropriate legal and financial support.
Community & Brand Stewardship
•	Own the Silver Foxx brand of voice and vision the standing narrative of who we are and why the community exists, across every external touchpoint.
•	Champion about the platform's community-first identity: Silver Foxx is a community with a marketplace inside it, not the reverse.
•	Host and grow flagship community programming that builds trust and visibility with both Foxxes and SMB partners.
•	Set and protect core platform principles and company culture.
Product, Platform & Operations
•	Set product strategy and priorities for the platform's marketplace, matching, and community layers, partnering closely with the Founding Team and the technical team.
•	Oversee go-to-market and launch strategy for new markets, features, and membership tiers.
•	Own vendor, technology, and legal relationships that keep the business running -- payments infrastructure, identity verification, CRM, and outside counsel.
•	Ensure the company's compliance posture (contracts, tax classification, data and privacy policies) keeps pace with growth.
Team & Talent
•	Build and lead a high-performing team, using all models available and making critical, and timely hiring as the company scales.
•	Set the operating cadence and standards for how the company plans, executes, and reports on progress.

WORKPLACE MODEL
•	Fully remote
•	Periodic in-person executive team strategy meetings

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
•	Proven senior leadership experience, including prior executive leadership or equivalent P&L ownership — startup, marketplace, or platform experience strongly preferred.

•	Demonstrated success raising institutional or angel capital and managing investor relationships through close.
•	Fluency with marketplace or two-sided platform economics, unit economics, and growth strategy.
•	A genuine affinity for community-building and for the mission of unlocking the value of experienced, seassoed professionals.
•	Strong external presence — comfortable as the face of the company with investors, press, partners, and community members.
•	Experience partnering with technical co-founders or CTOs on product strategy and roadmap.
•	Excellent judgment operating with a lean team and limited resources; bias toward results action.
•	Direct, structured communication style; comfortable giving and receiving candid feedback.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
•	Pre-seed round closed and the company appropriately capitalized to reach its next milestones.
•	A thriving, curated community of Foxxes and SMBs actively engaging on the platform.
•	A clear, differentiated brand and narrative that investors, partners, and members all recognize.

title: Founding Growth & Brand Lead
location: Los Angeles; San Francisco; Yorba Linda
description:
# Founding Growth & Brand Lead: MustDuo (Equity)

### We believe the gym experience is ready for an upgrade.

The gym hasn't fundamentally changed in decades.

The science has changed. Technology has changed. But the way we experience strength training? Not much.

You still walk into the gym, use disconnected equipment, try to keep track of your own workouts and manually log (only if you remember what you did)

We're changing that by building the next generation of fitness technology to help people train better, understand their performance, and get more out of every workout.

MustDuo is a lifting tracker paired with an iOS app and **Naya**, your fitness coach and gym buddy (she can't wait to meet you). It tracks reps, movement quality, and progress, giving lifters real data to improve performance and get results.

**Learn more:** [MustDuo.com](https://)

**Our mission:** Make the world a healthier, happier, and fitter place.

### Where We Are

* Working hardware prototype
* Beta iOS app with active users
* Launched Pre-orders

Our founding team brings hardware, firmware, and software engineering experience from Tesla and Future Fitness. 

### The Role

You'll own how MustDuo shows up in the world, from our first TikTok to launch day, working directly with the founders.

There's no agency to manage and no ad budget to spend. You get a real product, a launch window, and the freedom to write the playbook yourself.

This is a founding role for someone who wants to build from zero and help shape what the future of strength training looks like.

### What You'll Own

**Brand & Positioning**

Decide what MustDuo stands for and sharpen the message until it clicks with lifters. Help position MustDuo as a brand that's changing how people train, not just another fitness app.

**Customer Discovery**

Interview lifters, trainers, and gym-goers. Turn what you learn into insights that shape both marketing and product.

**Community**

Build real relationships in fitness communities and help launch our ambassador, referral, and beta programs.

**Founder-Led Content**

Turn prototypes, testing, milestones, customer stories, and the founder journey into content on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Reddit.

**Launch & Growth**

Plan our Q4 launch, run growth experiments, and move people from visitor → signup → pre-order → active user. Find and build creator and brand partnerships.

### Good Form Looks Like

* You've built a brand, community, or growth channel from zero, whether as an operator, creator, community builder, or founder
* You know how to create momentum without a big budget
* You enjoy talking to customers and turning conversations into insights
* You lift, train, or live in fitness culture, and you know "one more rep" is never just one more rep
* You want real ownership and don't need someone to hand you a playbook

### Bad Form Looks Like

* You want a highly structured role with a large team
* You're mainly looking for a paid-ads or performance-marketing role
* You need an established brand, audience, or marketing machine to work with
* Your idea of a launch plan is "post and pray"

### Compensation

This role is equity-only for now. We're upfront about that because we want someone excited to build from the ground floor.

* **Equity:** 0.5–3% with standard vesting
* **Remote, with flexible hours**

We'll walk through the equity structure and expectations openly during the interview process.


### How to Apply

Send us a short note covering:

1. Something you built or grew from zero
2. Why MustDuo interests you
3. One idea for getting MustDuo in front of more lifters

**Bonus:** Write the message Naya sends to someone who's skipped the gym three days in a row.

**Learn more about MustDuo:** https://MustDuo.com



Last Set: Naya counts everything, including people who scroll past this post. Don't let her get mad at you! 🐼

Who You Are

•	High Agency: You don’t ask “how do I do this?” You research it, test it, and present the results. You view chaos as an optimization problem.

What You Will NOT Be Doing

Compensation & Upside

•	Performance bonus. You hit growth targets, you get paid for it.
•	Direct access to the CEO and full ownership of the growth function.

How to Apply (Read Carefully)
We value extreme attention to detail. To be considered, submit your resume and a brief cover letter that includes:
1. The Proof: A one-paragraph breakdown of a growth system or automated flow you built that significantly impacted a business metric.
2. The Tech: Your top 3 “must-have” tools for growth (AI, data, or marketing) and why they are in your stack.
3. The Detail: Your favorite data visualization tool and one sentence on why you prefer it.
If any of these are missing, we will not move forward. This is a role for someone who reads carefully and follows through.

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
[Apply HERE!!](https://careers.reyem.tech/share/3k9p3kxh)
 
### Role Overview

You would write the software that makes Mazlite's sensors work: the cloud services behind them, the interfaces people use to read them, the computer vision and machine learning applied to the data they produce, and the integration with the PLCs and industrial controllers they sit beside. It is the uncommon software job where the thing you ship ends up running on a factory floor.

This is a hybrid technical leadership role. You would own projects end to end, shape the architecture, and mentor the developers around you, reporting directly to Mazlite's co-founder and CTO.

The salary band is published below, along with four weeks of vacation from your first year and a yearly equity award in the company share ownership plan.

### Key Responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end development of software projects, from design to deployment
- Architect and build scalable systems across cloud, front-end, and backend environments
- Contribute to industrial automation solutions, including PLC-integrated systems
- Optimize components related to computer vision, machine learning, data processing, data transfer, and other critical pipelines
- Develop and drive comprehensive testing and quality control strategies and systems
- Mentor and support junior developers through code reviews, guidance, and best practices
- Manage project timelines, priorities, and technical direction
- Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and stakeholders
- Ensure security, reliability, and performance across all systems
- Help define and maintain development standards and system architecture

### Requirements
- 5+ years of professional software development experience
- Strong understanding of software architecture and system design
- Experience across several of these:
 - Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or similar)
 - Front-end frameworks (Angular, React, or similar)
 - Backend languages (C++, Python, Rust, or similar)
 - Deployment pipelines and DevOps practices
 - Containerization (Docker, or similar)
 - Linux-based operating systems
- Experience with performance tuning, memory management, or optimizing high-throughput systems
- Solid grasp of security principles and best practices
- Experience mentoring or leading other developers
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills
- Canadian citizenship or permanent residency (see "Why this role requires Canadian citizenship or permanent residency" below)

If you meet most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. We would rather read your application and decide than have you decide for us.

[Apply HERE!!](https://careers.reyem.tech/share/3k9p3kxh)

### Nice to Have
- Familiarity with industrial automation, PLC systems, and robot programming
- Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, MODBUS, etc.)
- Experience integrating software with hardware or industrial systems, such as industrial cameras or custom circuitry
- Experience developing and deploying machine learning models
- Knowledge of networking, embedded systems, or IoT
- Background in high-reliability or real-time systems
- An existing Government of Canada security clearance, or having held one

### Work Environment
- Hybrid role based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA)
- Mix of remote work and on-site collaboration depending on project needs

### Why Join Mazlite?
- Your code runs on hardware in working plants, not only in a browser
- The team is small enough that the architecture you choose is the architecture that ships
- The work spans cleared defence programs and commercial manufacturing, which is a combination very few software roles offer
- You report to the co-founder and CTO, so a technical decision does not travel far to get made

[Apply HERE!!](https://careers.reyem.tech/share/3k9p3kxh)

### Why this role requires Canadian citizenship or permanent residency
This is a bona fide occupational requirement for this role, not a preference. Two things drive it: part of the work is carried out under an NRC IRAP grant, whose terms set this condition, and part of it is performed under security clearance for United States Department of War and Canadian military programs, which cannot be granted to someone who is not eligible to hold that clearance.

We ask about status for that reason and no other. The answer is read by a person, is never used to score or rank an application, and goes no further than the shortlist presented to Mazlite. If you are unsure whether you qualify, apply and say so — the question is there to start a conversation, not to end one.

### Compensation and Benefits
- CAD 130,000 to 140,000 a year
- A yearly equity award in the company employee share ownership plan (ESOP)
- Four weeks of vacation, starting in your first year
- Unlimited sick days. The policy is that you do not come to work when you are sick
- Travel opportunities, for those who want them

[Apply HERE!!](https://careers.reyem.tech/share/3k9p3kxh)

### How we hire
Reyem Tech runs this search for Mazlite. Every application is read by a person: a phone screen, then a structured technical interview, then a technical conversation with Mazlite's team.

### About Mazlite Inc.
Mazlite develops powerful, practical solutions at the intersection of software and industrial automation, building advanced Industrial IoT sensors used by manufacturers across essential sectors like automotive, pharmaceutical and aerospace; its tech stack integrates cloud platforms, front-end applications, computer vision, AI and industrial control systems. Reyem Tech is hiring on Mazlite's behalf as their Fractional CTO.

### How we use AI
We use AI to extract the facts from your resume and to assess how your experience relates to this job description against criteria a recruiter has reviewed. A person reads every application and makes every decision; AI never rejects you, ranks you against other candidates, or contacts you.

### Privacy and retention
Your resume and answers are stored privately by Reyem Technologies Inc. for this search only. Resume content is sent to a third-party AI model to extract the facts and relate them to the job description; a person reads the result. Nothing is shared with Mazlite beyond a presented shortlist. Applications are retained only as long as this search needs them and are then deleted.

[Apply HERE!!](https://careers.reyem.tech/share/3k9p3kxh)

title: Marketing & Sales Operations Manager (AI-First, Industrial / Rep Channel)
description:
**About Flow**

Manufacturers' reps are the sales force of the industrial supply chain — the people who sell the electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and industrial products that end up in every building in America. It's a big channel running on spreadsheets, email, and software built in 2004.

Flow is the platform that replaces all of it: CRM, quotes, orders, commissions, warehouse — plus an AI layer that cuts out most of the manual work a rep does every day.

We sell AI. We also run on it. This role is where that gets proven.

**Read this first: you have to know this industry**

Manufacturers, reps, and distributors — how the channel fits together, how each one makes money, and how they think and operate day to day. Our customers can tell in one sentence whether you've been in their world, and it changes how they respond to everything we send.

We can teach you the marketing tools. We can't teach you the channel. This is the first thing we screen for.

**Read this second: AI is the job, not a perk**

This is one seat doing what most companies staff with three or four people. That math only works one way, and it's the reason this role exists in this shape.

**We expect you to:**

Automate your own job continuously. Anything you do twice by hand is a process you should be building away. List building, research, enrichment, drafting, reporting, data cleanup, campaign QA — if you're doing it manually in month three the way you did in week one, this isn't working.

Draft at volume with AI and edit like a human. Emails, campaigns, one-pagers, social. You should be producing several times the output of a traditional marketing coordinator, and none of it should read like a robot wrote it.

Use AI on the data, not just the words. Segmenting lists, summarizing engagement, spotting which accounts went quiet, turning a messy export into a target list. Most people stop at copywriting. Don't.

Bring your own stack and keep upgrading it. We don't want to hand you a toolset. We want to see what you've already built and steal your ideas.

If your honest answer is "I use ChatGPT to help write emails sometimes," you are not going to enjoy this job. We'd rather leave the seat empty than fill it with someone working at 2019 speed.

**Why now**

We already have demand. Hundreds of firms have raised their hand, we have happy customers, and there's a community forming around the product. The marketing and sales process is up and running — it's just early, and there's more coming in than we can keep up with.

We need someone to run it day to day and make it dramatically better, fast.

**What you'd do**

Run our outbound and follow-up. Hundreds of interested firms only matter if nobody falls through. You own the sequences, the nurture, the re-engagement. Nobody goes quiet on your watch, and you'll know the number without being asked.

Write the copy. Emails, campaigns, newsletter, website updates, one-pagers, booth materials. High volume, fast turnaround, human voice.

Keep the CRM honest. Data hygiene, lead routing, lifecycle stages, reporting. You're the person who actually knows what's in the pipeline.

Target on data, not vibes. We track usage, line cards, which manufacturers each firm carries, show scans, email engagement. Use it to decide who gets contacted and when. Blasting everyone is the lazy answer and we'll notice.

Drive trade show follow-up. AIM/R, NEMRA, PTRA, MAFSI, HARDI. Build the target list before, capture during, and make sure the follow-up actually goes out — most companies drop this and waste the whole show.

Run the community calendar. FlowMakers — webinars, training sessions, user groups. Invites, reminders, guest coordination, attendance.

Collect our proof. Pull testimonials, quotes, and case studies out of customers who already love us and turn them into something the team can sell with.

**Who we're looking for**
You know this industry. You've worked at or sold to a rep agency, manufacturer, or industrial/electrical/plumbing/HVAC distributor. You know what a line card is and roughly how commissions work.

You're an AI power user, full stop. See above. This is the second hard filter and we will ask you to show your work.

You close loops. This role lives or dies on nothing slipping. If you're the person who keeps the list and finishes the thing, that's the job.

You're not afraid of data. Pulling lists, segmenting, building a simple report. You don't need to be an analyst, but "can someone send me that number" is not an option.

You move without being told. Small team, fast decisions, no detailed plan handed to you. You'll get goals and be expected to work out the steps — and to flag it early when something isn't working.

**Nice to have**
-Email marketing or CRM experience (HubSpot or similar)
-Helped run webinars, events, or a trade show booth
-Copywriting experience
-Built an automation or workflow you're actually proud of — tell us about it

title: Founding GTM Lead (Demand + Operations)
description:
**About Flow**

Manufacturers' reps are the sales force of the industrial supply chain — the people who sell the electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and industrial products that end up in every building in America. It's a multi-billion dollar channel running on spreadsheets, email, and software built in 2004.

Flow is the platform that replaces all of it: CRM, quotes, orders, commissions, warehouse, product cross-referencing — plus an AI layer that eliminates roughly 80% of the manual work a rep does every day. We're also connecting reps, manufacturers, and distributors to each other in a way this industry has never had.

**Read this first: you have to know this industry**

Manufacturers, reps, and distributors — how the channel fits together, how each one makes money, and how they think and operate day to day. We sell to people who can tell within one sentence whether you've been in their world. If you haven't, the copy won't land, the outreach won't land, and the booth conversations won't happen.

Everything else in this posting is learnable. This isn't. It's the first thing we screen for.

**Why now**

This isn't a zero-to-one job, and it isn't a mature machine either.

-Hundreds of firms have raised their hand
-Live, referenceable customers
-A community forming around the product
-Real word-of-mouth in an industry where everyone knows everyone
-A GTM engine that exists, works, and is nowhere near built out

We're at the point where founder-led GTM stops scaling and the opportunity outgrows the operation. The fire's lit. This role turns it into a bonfire.

**The role**

You're our first dedicated GTM hire, working directly with the CEO. You own the story and the system.

Demand. Own the airwaves. Newsletter, webinars, LinkedIn, podcast, guest bookings, trade press. Almost nobody in this category produces anything worth reading. Take it.

Copy. Website, email, campaigns, decks, launches, booth materials. You write it.

Conversion discipline. Hundreds of interested firms are only worth something if nobody falls through. Sequences, nurture, re-engagement, SLAs on follow-up. The gap between our interest and our revenue is operational, and closing it is the job.

Signal-driven targeting. We have real data — usage, commission volume, line cards, which manufacturers each firm carries, integration coverage, show scans, engagement history. Turn it into prioritized, evidence-based outreach instead of spray.

RevOps. CRM architecture, routing, lifecycle stages, attribution, dashboards. We've started this. You'll build it out to carry ten times the volume.

Field. AIM/R, NEMRA, PTRA, MAFSI, HARDI, STAFDA. Pre-show targeting, booth strategy, capture, follow-up that actually happens.

Community. FlowMakers — virtual events, bi-weekly training, user groups, peer matching, in-person meetups. You own the calendar, the guests, and the growth.

Proof. Build the testimonial library out of customers we already have. Case studies, video, quotes, referenceable accounts, review sites.

**Who you are**
You know this world. Rep agency, manufacturer, or industrial distributor background. You know what a line card is, how commission splits work, and why reps don't think like SaaS buyers. Hard requirement — the domain is the moat.

You're both halves. Vision and machine. You can write the copy that starts a movement and build the CRM workflow, the sequence logic, and the dashboard behind it. Most people have one. We need both.

You live in the data. You pull your own lists, segment on behavior, read a funnel, and decide who to contact based on evidence. You don't wait for someone to build you a report.

You're an AI power user, not a tourist. We expect one person with the right stack to out-produce a whole marketing team, and you should already work that way.

You're built for a startup. You move fast, learn fast, and solve problems rather than route them. You get the goal, not the instructions, and that's how you like it. You find work before it's assigned.

You want this specific shot. Founding GTM seat, whole function, a category nobody has claimed.

**Nice to have**
Ran a webinar, podcast, or community program with real attendance
Built lifecycle marketing and lead scoring inside a CRM
Sold into small business owners (rep principals are owners, not committees)
Built a case study / customer proof program sales actually used

**Why this is a good seat**
Founding GTM hire, working directly with the CEO, full ownership of the function — walking into real market pull and an engine that's already running, with room to build it into something ten times bigger and grow into leading it. If you know this industry and you know how to use AI and data to move faster than incumbents who've been asleep for a decade, this is a category you can personally own.

title: Financial Controller & Compliance Manager
description:
**About Olive**
Olive builds the card-linked loyalty infrastructure behind rewards, rounding, and matching programs for some of North America's most recognizable brands. Operating on established Visa and Mastercard network partnerships, we give our customers payment-linked loyalty capabilities without having to build them from scratch. We serve customers across employee benefits, dining, consumer loyalty, and fundraising  including US enterprise clients.

We're a small, flat team. Everyone owns outcomes, not tickets.

**The Role**
We're hiring a Financial Controller & Compliance Manager to build and own Olive's finance and compliance function.

Own is the operative word. This function doesn't exist in a finished form yet. You'll be creating the processes, not inheriting them, and you'll have room to bring in the tools and outside expertise you need to do it. You'll work directly with our CFO and the rest of the leadership team, who'll back you on the decisions that matter but the day-to-day design of how finance runs here will be yours.
Is This the Right Fit?

Startup or small-company experience. You've worked somewhere fast-moving and under-resourced, where processes were still taking shape and you were comfortable figuring things out without a playbook handed to you. You know how that differs from a structured finance department and you prefer it.

Hands-on SOC 2 experience. You've built, maintained, or carried a company through SOC 2 from the inside. This isn't something you'll be overseeing from a distance including the controls, evidence, documentation, and auditor relationships sit with this role.


Cross-border payments exposure. Olive operates a US entity and moves money across the border for US clients. Reconciling cross-border reward payments and payouts is part of the day-to-day, and experience with a rewards or rebate model is a real advantage.

**What You'll Own**
**Financial operations**
- Monthly management reporting:  accurate, on time, and useful to leadership
- Quarterly financial statements and supporting analysis for leadership and board
- CRA reporting and filings, federal and provincial, including remittances
- Reconciliation of reward payments:  matching program funding, network settlements, and merchant/partner payouts, including cross-border flows, and resolving variances
- Banking relationships, cash positioning, and related administration
- Accounts payable: supplier and partner payments
- Expense reimbursement, end to end
- Day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks (a simple, well-organized environment we intend to keep that way)

**Compliance**
- SOC 2: ongoing controls, evidence, documentation, and audit readiness
- Internal and external audits across tax, SOC 2, and partner/customer requirements
- Financial and compliance obligations tied to our network and channel partner agreements

**Process**
- Automate where it makes sense, using scripting and/or AI to cut manual work. We want someone who's AI-capable, not AI-dependent. These tools should sharpen your judgment, not stand in for it.
- Contribute beyond your lane. On a team this size, "not my job" doesn't come up.

**What You Bring
Required**
- CPA designation with 4–6 years of post-designation experience
- Hands-on SOC 2 experience gained inside an operating company
- Experience owning finance at a startup or small, fast-growing company: bookkeeping through reporting through compliance, with you as the person doing it
- Working knowledge of CRA reporting requirements for Canadian corporations
- Experience using scripting tools and/or AI to automate accounting or business processes
- Comfort with a high degree of autonomy, direct C-suite exposure, and direct accountability
- Excellent judgment, discretion, and precision
- Strong communication: you can translate financial and compliance detail into clear, actionable information for non-finance leaders
- Legally entitled to work in Canada and Canada-based (this is a Canada-only hire)

**Nice to have**
- Fintech, payments, or SaaS experience
- Exposure to other compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
- Exposure to cross-border payments and reconciliation:  reward, rebate, cashback, or similar payouts flowing between multiple parties

**How You'll Be Measured**
- Reporting timeliness:** management reports within an agreed number of business days of month-end; quarterly reporting on schedule

- Compliance performance:  on-time CRA filings, SOC 2 milestones met on schedule, zero material findings on internal or external audits

- Invoice and payment turnaround: supplier and partner invoices issued and payments processed within target

- Cash and reconciliation discipline: bank and reward payment reconciliations completed within target turnaround with no unexplained variances

- Expense reimbursement turnaround; processed within target of submission

- Automation impact: manual processes automated or streamlined, and measurable time saved

title: Deal Origination Analyst — Broker & Owner Sourcing
description:
**Job title:** Deal Origination Analyst — Broker & Owner Sourcing

**Location:** 100% remote; candidates must be based in the United Kingdom, United States, or Canada and available during North American business hours

**Employment:** Full-time

**Salary:** US$70,000–$85,000 base salary, plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000, depending on ability and experience.

Everis is hiring an early-career analyst to build the pipeline of businesses we may acquire. You will research markets and companies, build relationships with brokers, contact owners, qualify opportunities, do initial analysis, and hand the strongest deals to our acquisition team with clear notes.

This is a sourcing and relationship role, not a traditional investment-banking role. Your main responsibility is high-quality deal flow. You will see evaluation, diligence, and transactions, but the deal team owns complex modelling, diligence, negotiation, and execution.

## Why join Everis

- Work directly on acquisition strategy and see how a lead becomes a serious opportunity.
- Speak with brokers, advisers, founders, and owners while learning what makes a business attractive and why owners sell.
- Research varied industries, use modern AI and sourcing tools, take ownership quickly, and grow into broader acquisition responsibilities.

## About Everis

Everis is a software holding company with $27 million in annual recurring revenue. We buy B2B SaaS companies from the founders who built them and keep them permanently. We invest our own capital and operate without the pressure of a fund exit timeline. Our remote team strengthens engineering and product, pricing, go-to-market, retention, revenue operations, and back-office systems across the portfolio.

## What you’ll work on

### Broker and intermediary relationships

- Find and build relationships with relevant brokers, advisers, marketplaces, and other deal sources.
- Stay in regular contact, understand what they have coming to market, and follow up consistently.
- Screen brokered and marketplace opportunities against Everis’s criteria and surface the strongest ones quickly.

### Owner sourcing and outreach

- Build targeted lists of businesses and owners that may fit our criteria.
- Find and verify decision-maker contacts, then run thoughtful outreach by phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other relevant channels.
- Hold initial conversations, understand each owner’s goals, and follow up professionally over what may be a long cycle.

### Research and qualification

- Understand what each business does, how it makes money, who its customers are, and what makes it defensible.
- Gather high-level information on revenue, profit, growth, recurring revenue, customer concentration, owner involvement, asking price, sale motivation, and timing.
- Assess fit, prepare short opportunity briefs and notes, and coordinate a clean handoff to the deal team.

### Pipeline ownership and improvement

- Keep the acquisition CRM accurate, including contacts, source, stage, notes, next action, financial snippets, risks, and follow-up dates.
- Track outreach, responses, meetings, qualified opportunities, handoffs, and funnel progression. Provide concise weekly reporting.
- Use evidence and AI tools to improve research, outreach, recordkeeping, and the sourcing methods that produce the best opportunities.

## What we’re looking for

- Evidence of exceptional ability through one specific, verifiable accomplishment with unusual difficulty, selectivity, or impact—and a clear explanation of what you personally contributed.
- Alternatively, direct or transferable acquisition experience that includes analysing acquisition targets, judging their attractiveness, and engaging or negotiating with owners, founders, brokers, or advisers. Investment-analyst experience is relevant when it demonstrates these capabilities; explicit SaaS or mobile-app experience is preferred but not required.
- Strong research and commercial judgment, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and communicate credibly with brokers, advisers, owners, and founders. You are smart, curious, and able to learn quickly.
- Excellent spoken and written communication. You are comfortable making cold calls, sending outbound messages, hearing no, and following up consistently without relying on finance jargon.
- Highly organized, reliable, proactive, and resilient. You maintain accurate notes, follow through on commitments, handle confidential information with integrity, and work effectively without constant supervision.
- Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, research databases, and AI tools, with basic financial and commercial literacy or the ability to learn quickly.

This role is designed for candidates with zero to three years of professional experience. Prior acquisition or sales experience is not required when a candidate demonstrates exceptional ability. Lack of explicit SaaS or mobile-app experience is not disqualifying when transferable acquisition analysis, target judgment, and owner, founder, or broker engagement are clear. Generic sales results, outreach volume, list building, financial modelling, credentials, or employer prestige do not establish a strong match on their own.

## What we offer

- US$70,000–$85,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to US$15,000.
- 100% remote work from the United Kingdom, United States, or Canada.
- Direct exposure to founders, brokers, owners, and real acquisition opportunities.

title: Founder's Office - Tech Intern
description:

Avacasa (avacasa.life) is a fast-growing PropTech startup revolutionizing real estate investments in managed farmlands, vacation homes, and resort properties. We leverage technology to simplify property discovery, investment, and management for buyers.

This is a unique, high-impact role designed for a motivated, technically skilled, and business-savvy individual eager to dive into the core operations of a high-growth startup.

As a Founders Office Tech Intern, you won't just be coding; you will be embedded directly with the founders, working on the company's most critical, ambiguous, and high-leverage projects. You will act as a technical force multiplier for the leadership team, solving real-world problems that directly impact our business and technology strategy.

This role is perfect for a recent graduate or final-year student ready to take on ownership from day one.

**What You'll Be Doing: Key Responsibilities**
Your responsibilities will span technical execution, data insights, and process automation, prioritizing the company's most pressing needs.

**API & System Integrations:** Connect critical third-party services (e.g., CRM, marketing automation platforms, accounting software) to our core tech stack to ensure seamless data flow and business operations.

**Data Pipeline Development:** Implement scripts and automation (primarily in Python) to clean, aggregate, and manage complex datasets from various business sources.

**Operational Automation:** Identify, scope, and implement automation solutions across non-engineering functions (e.g., automated lead scoring, report generation, or internal communication workflows) to drive efficiency.

**Market & Technology Research:** Conduct deep-dive research into emerging technologies, competitor stacks, and potential third-party integrations (e.g., new AI models, cloud services) to inform the company's product and tech strategy.

**Process Improvement:** Take ownership of optimizing internal workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing simple technological solutions to make the entire company run smoother.

**Who We're Looking For**
We are seeking final year students or recent graduates who are technically proficient, highly resourceful, and have a bias for action.

**Required Skills & Experience:**
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

**Programming Proficiency:** Strong command of at least one modern programming language, preferably Python or JavaScript, with an ability to learn new technologies quickly.

**Web Development Fundamentals:** Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for building simple, functional web-based tools and dashboards and is comfortable working with Wix Velo or other CMS platforms.

**Data & Database Skills:** Comfortable working with data, including experience with SQL (or similar database language) and manipulating data using libraries like Pandas.

**Attitude:** A proactive, "can-do" attitude with proven ability to take ownership of ambiguous tasks and deliver a solution end-to-end.

**Bonus Points For:**
Prior experience with Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Experience with building simple APIs or integrating with third-party APIs (REST/GraphQL).
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Metabase).
Experience in a fast-paced internship or project-based environment.

Why Join the Founders Office?

**Direct Impact:** Work on the highest-priority problems with direct, measurable business impact. Your work will be visible to the entire company and the founders.
**Accelerated Learning:** Gain unparalleled exposure to the intersection of technology, product, and business strategy within a high-growth startup environment.
**Career Trajectory:** This is the ultimate proving ground. Exceptional performance will lead to a full-time, high-growth role within the company.

Location: Remote

title: US-Based B2B Appointment Setter & Lead Generation Specialist – Cold Calling & Outbound Sales
description:
Summary
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced US-based B2B Business Development professional to help us generate new business opportunities and build a consistent sales pipeline.

This role is focused on outbound business development and appointment setting. We need someone who can identify the right prospects, reach decision-makers, start meaningful conversations, qualify opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings with our team.

You should be comfortable using multiple prospecting methods, including cold calling, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, networking, and other creative outbound strategies.

This is an ongoing opportunity for the right person.

What You'll Be Responsible For
Research and identify relevant B2B prospects in the US
Build targeted prospect lists based on our ideal customer profile
Reach out to prospects through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and other channels
Speak directly with business owners, executives, and decision-makers
Introduce our services and identify potential business needs
Qualify prospects before scheduling meetings
Schedule qualified meetings with our team
Follow up consistently with prospects who show interest
Maintain accurate records of prospects, conversations, and follow-ups
Test different messaging and outreach approaches
Provide regular reporting on outreach activity and results
Work independently while coordinating with our team
Continuously look for new ways to generate qualified opportunities
What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate should have:

2+ years of B2B sales, business development, lead generation, or appointment-setting experience
Strong experience with US B2B prospecting
Proven cold-calling experience
Experience with cold email and LinkedIn prospecting
Excellent spoken and written English
Confidence communicating with senior decision-makers
Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills
Ability to handle objections and keep conversations moving
A results-oriented approach
Ability to work independently without constant supervision
Industry Experience

Experience in Intellectual Property, technology, professional services, consulting, legal services, or other B2B services is a plus but not required.

We are more interested in your ability to consistently generate qualified conversations and meetings than in whether you have previously worked specifically in the IP industry.

What We Consider a Strong Candidate

Please don't just tell us how many years you have worked in sales.

We want to understand your actual results.

For example:

How many qualified meetings have you generated per month?
What percentage of your work has involved cold calling?
Which types of decision-makers have you successfully reached?
What industries have you sold into?
Which outbound channels have produced the best results for you?
Have you generated opportunities for high-value B2B services?
What tools/CRMs have you used?
Application Requirements

Please include the following in your proposal:

Your updated resume/CV
Your LinkedIn profile
Your current US city and state
Years of B2B sales/business development experience
A brief description of your cold-calling experience
Your experience with cold email and LinkedIn outreach
Examples of products/services you have sold
Approximate number of qualified meetings you have generated per month
Your preferred hourly rate
Your weekly availability
A brief example of a successful outbound campaign you have personally managed

Please do not submit a generic proposal. We are specifically looking for candidates who can demonstrate hands-on experience generating B2B conversations and qualified meetings.

Engagement

We are looking for an ongoing relationship with the right consultant.

We are open to an hourly arrangement, with the possibility of additional performance-based compensation for business opportunities that successfully convert into revenue.

The exact engagement structure can be discussed based on your experience and track record.

Important Requirement

You must currently be located in the United States.

We are specifically looking for someone who understands the US B2B market, is comfortable making outbound calls to US businesses, and can confidently communicate with US-based decision-makers.

title: Sales Representative (Bilingual Spanish / English)
description:
Location: Fully remote
Hours: CET working hours


GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION
The Sales Representative answers inbound chat and phone enquiries and makes outbound follow up contact to support Axo Longevity's sales operations, in a manner that stays within the plan's approved scope for health and testing information and achieves agreed sales and response time objectives.
ABOUT AXO LONGEVITY
Axo Longevity is a longevity and biomarker testing membership company operating across multiple markets, including the UK, Netherlands, Spain and Peru. Members get a core blood panel, add on panels and ongoing guidance through membership tiers (Discovery, Care and Elite).
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty listed below.
Act as the primary point of contact for prospective and existing Axo members contacting the company with general enquiries, concerns or requests for information about panels, pricing, logistics and membership.
Develop a general understanding of all member facing materials, pricing and product communications, and be prepared to respond appropriately to follow up conversations.
Answer inbound live chat and phone enquiries and place outbound follow up contact, in Spanish and English, working directly with prospects to accurately and completely answer questions involving Axo's panels, add ons, membership tiers and market specific logistics.
Follow established guidelines and resources to respond to enquiries and resolve concerns in an accurate, timely, professional and culturally competent manner.
Qualify prospects, recommend the appropriate core panel and add ons, and close the sale.
Educate prospects on what each panel covers and how the testing process works in their market, in a manner that achieves excellent service standards and maintains high customer satisfaction.
Recognise requests that fall outside the approved scope, including requests for medical interpretation or advice, and escalate them in accordance with established guidelines. 
Use listening skills and judgment to appropriately categorise and accurately document all contacts, stage changes and follow up actions in the CRM in accordance with established guidelines.
Appropriately handle prospect requests arriving through alternative channels such as email, WhatsApp and social media direct messages, in accordance with established procedures.
Triage and route non sales enquiries to CX, Lab Ops or Product.
Hand each closed sale over to CX and Lab Ops so that onboarding, booking and the first draw proceed without gaps.
Attend and actively participate in daily, weekly and monthly team meetings, training and coaching sessions.
Identify recurring objections, pricing friction, product gaps and market specific blockers, and report relevant information to management.
Perform other related duties as required or assigned.
REQUIREMENTS
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required or desired.
Minimum one year and up to three years of experience in a sales role, preferably within longevity, diagnostics, health testing or a comparable consumer health service.
Prior experience in customer support, and familiarity with biomarkers, blood draws, test panels and related terminology.
Fully bilingual Spanish and English, written and spoken.
Ability to meet Key Performance Indicators by participating in and achieving the standards of Axo's sales quality and response time targets.
Working knowledge of and the ability to efficiently operate all applicable software, including a CRM such as Attio, Pipedrive or Close, and the collaboration tools used by the team, including Slack and Claude Cowork.
Experience with Intercom or a comparable live chat and helpdesk platform.
Ability to type with above average speed and a high level of accuracy, as most selling takes place in live chat.
Excellent communication skills including the ability to express oneself clearly and concisely when serving prospective and existing Axo members over live chat, on the telephone or in writing.
Strong work organisation and hygiene, including accurate record keeping and reliable follow up within established timeframes.
Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling member health and payment information.
Ability to work CET hours.
COMPENSATION AND TERMS
Contractor engagement to start, with the option to convert to full time.
Commission on sales.

title: Sales Developement Representative
description:

description:

Professional services
Recurring-revenue solutions

Vice President of Business Development

About InTune Marketing

Pilot compensation: revenue share only. No cash salary, upfront equity or guaranteed earnings. Equity terms to be agreed after the pilot.

About the opportunity

We are a stealth consumer venture in the dating industry, backed by Venturseed and Aortem. We are seeking a founding growth and brand partner to work directly with the founder on building the business. The app name, product concept and launch details are confidential and will be discussed privately with shortlisted candidates.

This is an opportunity to take responsibility for brand, customer acquisition, community and partnerships, and help shape the company's direction. We intend to begin with a 90–120-day pilot to assess results and how we work together. If there is a strong mutual fit, the intended next step is to agree a long-term cofounder role, potentially Co-Founder; Chief Growth Officer, with separately negotiated equity and responsibilities. Cofounder status and equity are not granted at the start of the pilot.

Remote role; NYC connection required

This is a remote role for someone in the NYC metropolitan area who currently lives in or regularly works in New York City. A strong understanding of NYC's social culture, neighborhoods and local communities is essential. You must be available for occasional in-person partner meetings and evening or weekend events.

What you will own

- Help shape brand positioning and growth strategy with the founder.
- Develop and test customer acquisition channels, including creator collaborations, referrals and relevant marketing campaigns.
- Build local relationships, evaluate partnership opportunities and manage follow-through.
- Develop community engagement and gather customer feedback.
- Track results, manage agreed budgets and turn what you learn into clear business decisions.
- Take responsibility for outcomes and contribute to the company's long-term direction.

What we are looking for

- Demonstrated results growing a consumer business, brand or community, with clear examples of your personal contribution.
- Strong NYC cultural knowledge and an ability to build trusted local relationships.
- Experience developing partnerships and executing growth initiatives from idea through measurement.
- Clear writing, commercial judgment, organization and reliable follow-through.
- Discretion with confidential business information and customer data.
- An interest in building a company long-term and working closely with the founder.

A personal creator audience is welcome; demonstrated business results matter more than follower count.

The pilot

The proposed 90–120-day pilot will assess execution, judgment, measurable progress and the working relationship. Scope, success criteria, time commitment and operating resources will be agreed before work begins. Partnership and marketing expenditure will require an agreed budget; candidates are not expected to fund the business.

Revenue-share pilot; equity after the pilot

The initial pilot is compensated through a contractual share of revenue. There is no cash salary, promised salary activation date or upfront equity grant. Revenue-share payments depend on qualifying revenue actually being generated and collected; there are no guaranteed earnings.

The pilot duration, revenue-share percentage, eligible revenue, attribution and payment schedule must be agreed in writing before work begins. For a successful transition into a long-term cofounder role, our proposed starting point for discussion is 10% equity, with scope up to 15% depending on agreed responsibility, commitment and contribution. The proposed vesting structure is four years with a one-year cliff. These are discussion parameters for a separate post-pilot agreement, not an upfront grant or guaranteed entitlement. The issuing entity, vesting start date and any credit for pilot service will be agreed explicitly. Completing the pilot does not automatically grant equity.

Apply through Wellfound

Please include:

1. Your NYC connection and availability for occasional local meetings and events.
2. A consumer business, brand or community you helped grow, your specific contribution and measurable results.
3. An example of a partnership you developed and what it achieved.
4. Why this founding-partner opportunity interests you, and acknowledgement of the revenue-share-only pilot with cofounder and equity terms addressed afterward.

Existing work examples are sufficient. No unpaid campaign or extensive take-home project is requested.

title: Product Analyst — Decision Intelligence (Equipment Finance)

title: Venture Content Analyst

description:

You report to our Head of Brand and to the co-founders directly. The org is very flat, so you learn straight from us what makes us unique, how the market is shifting, and which trends we catch early.

This seat is built to grow into a VC Analyst and content role of its own. We are looking for someone who genuinely loves the venture capital market, is obsessed with it as much as we are, and cannot wait to write longer pieces and go deeper on the areas that interest them.

**What you will own**

Remote and async.

- Learning very closely from all of us.

title: Founding Sales RevSharrk
description:
Alt. Title: Founding Sales Representative

***NOTE: We are pre-revenue so we can only operate on revenue share contract agreement at 10% revenue share + 30% if choose to help execute on content/creative service delivery.

RevSharrk is looking for a Founding Sales Representative to take ownership of our commercial engine. You will be the first commercial hire, responsible for building our sales strategy from the ground up, executing the full sales cycle, and acting as a strategic partner to the founder. This is a high-ownership role for an ambitious individual who thrives on ambiguity, values data-driven results, and wants to shape the future of a growing company.

---

What You’ll Do

* Lead Generation Strategy: Execute a tiered GTM rollout. You will start by testing and validating lead acquisition on Instagram to generate immediate traction. As the business scales and budget allows, you will operationalize and expand our outreach into a robust, high-volume cold email engine.
* Consultative Sales Execution: Lead discovery calls to diagnose business needs. You must be able to pivot the conversation to determine whether the client’s growth is best unlocked through strategic consulting or creative service execution.
* Full-Cycle Ownership: Own the entire sales cycle from the initial first touch to closing the contract. You will manage the pipeline and ensure consistent revenue growth.
* Playbook Development: Build our foundational sales infrastructure, including our playbook, outreach sequences, and objection-handling library.
* Strategic Input: Provide direct, ongoing customer feedback to shape our service offerings and market positioning.
* Cross-Functional Impact: Manage internal and external communication, including coordinating with our internal analysts or creative talent to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Operations & Culture: Act as a strategic sparring partner to the founder. You will help cultivate a resilient, high-performance culture, ensuring we remain focused even during the challenges inherent in early-stage growth.

---

What We’re Looking For
* Experience: 1–3+ years in B2B sales, business development, or account management (consulting or agency backgrounds preferred).
* Financial Acumen: Comfort discussing P&L, churn, margins, and ROI (aka selling the outcome vs. just features) directly with business owners.
* Service Versatility: Ability to sell both intangible consulting services and tangible creative deliverables based on what the client actually needs.
* Tool Proficiency: Experienced in using CRM and modern sales-enablement tools, when budget exists. You leverage AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to enhance your workflow but remain focused on quality control and verification. Can also help with direct outreach via DM or shared account inbound content on Instagram.
* Ownership Mindset: Highly self-directed. You are comfortable with startup ambiguity and are willing to take on adjacent marketing or customer success projects as needed.
* Cultural Fit: We are looking for a true "strategic partner." We value a candidate who brings high energy, acts as a coach to the leadership team, and helps build a supportive, high-performance environment. ... WE NEED YOU -- no sales, no revenue, no business.
* Bonus Qualifications: Previous experience selling consulting and/or creative services, or related consulting/creative agency work. Experience in a YC or VC-backed environment is a significant plus.

Compensation & Career Path

Our compensation model is structured to reward performance and equity. We are transparent about our growth phases:

Phase 1: 3-Month Trial (Independent Contractor)
* 10% revenue share on closed revenue (uncapped).
* Flexible hours.
* Note: Revenue share is paid out after the customer’s money-back guarantee window (14 days for Pro/Growth, 90 days for Max).
 
Phase 2: Growth Phase (Up to 12 Months, Independent Contractor)
* 15% revenue share on closed revenue (uncapped).
* Performance Accelerator: 20% revenue share on revenue closed above your quarterly target.
* Note: If milestones are not met within 12 months, the engagement will conclude or convert to W-2.

Phase 3: Employment (Revenue/Funding Milestone)
* Base Salary: ~$75k–$80k (for California-based hires).
* Revenue Share: 5% on closed revenue.
* Equity: 0.5–2% (4-year vest / 1-year cliff).
* Commitment: This phase requires an intense, high-output pace.

* Phase 4: Leadership Path
* As we scale, this role is designed to grow into a Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) position. We will formalize equity and compensation structures as the company expands to reflect your seniority and contribution.
