title: Sales / Business Development – Commercial Real Estate AI
description:
Brick AI | Remote | Commission-Based

About Brick AI

Brick AI is building an AI-powered underwriting platform for commercial real estate.

Our platform helps real estate investment teams turn property documents—including Offering Memorandums, T-12s, rent rolls, and other deal materials—into structured underwriting and investment analysis in minutes rather than hours.

We're focused initially on multifamily and are looking for an experienced, highly motivated sales professional to help us grow our customer base and build relationships across the commercial real estate industry.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a commission-based Sales / Business Development professional who can identify, approach, and close prospective customers for Brick AI.

This is an entrepreneurial role with significant flexibility. You'll work directly with the founders and have the opportunity to help shape our sales strategy as we grow.

Commercial real estate experience is strongly preferred, particularly if you already have relationships with real estate investment firms, private equity firms, owners/operators, lenders, brokers, or acquisition teams.

What You'll Do
Identify and prospect commercial real estate firms that could benefit from Brick AI
Reach out to decision-makers including principals, acquisition teams, asset managers, underwriters, and investment professionals
Leverage your existing CRE network where applicable
Generate and qualify sales opportunities
Introduce prospects to the Brick AI platform and coordinate product demonstrations
Manage opportunities from initial conversation through closing
Develop long-term relationships with customers and industry partners
Provide feedback from prospects to help us improve the product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy
Work directly with the founders on sales strategy and market expansion
Who We're Looking For

We're especially interested in candidates who have:

Sales, business development, brokerage, acquisitions, lending, or investment experience
Experience in commercial real estate, preferably multifamily
An existing network within the CRE investment ecosystem
Experience selling SaaS, PropTech, FinTech, data, or technology solutions is a plus
Strong communication and relationship-building skills
The ability to prospect independently and create opportunities
A results-oriented, entrepreneurial mindset
Comfort working with an early-stage startup

You don't necessarily need traditional SaaS sales experience. If you've spent years in commercial real estate, understand how deals are evaluated, and have strong relationships across the industry, we'd like to hear from you.

Compensation

This is a commission-based role with meaningful upside tied directly to the business you generate.

There is currently no base salary. Compensation is based on successful customer acquisition and revenue generated.

For the right person who demonstrates strong performance and becomes an important part of Brick AI's growth, there may be an opportunity to expand the relationship as the company grows.

Why Join Brick AI?

Commercial real estate underwriting is still heavily dependent on spreadsheets, manual document review, and repetitive data entry.

Brick AI is building infrastructure designed to dramatically reduce that work while giving investment teams faster, more consistent, and more traceable analysis.

You'll be joining at an early stage, working directly with the founders, and helping bring a new AI product into a massive industry.

If you know commercial real estate, enjoy building relationships, and want your compensation directly tied to the value you create, we'd love to talk.

To apply: Send us a short introduction describing your background, your experience in commercial real estate or B2B sales, and the types of CRE companies or professionals you've worked with.

description:
Prezly.com is a leading SaaS company delivering news amplification solutions for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to empower PR teams to build stronger relationships with media and influencers, manage contacts, create engaging newsrooms, and distribute stories with ease. We are a fast-growing, innovative company with a passionate team dedicated to delivering exceptional value to our global client base.

⚠️ Important: While this is a fully remote role, we only accept candidates within a 2-hour time difference from CET (Central European Timezone). A Europe-based candidate is preferred.

APPLY HERE: https://tally.so/r/mBoLrY

We're looking for a salesperson who wants to build pipeline, not just work a queue.

At Prezly, this role isn't about running through a script and logging activity. You're closing net-new business — from your own outbound work and from inbound leads — and you own the whole journey from first conversation to signed deal.

Sometimes that means a sharp cold outreach campaign that turns into a pipeline of qualified opportunities. Sometimes it means spotting that a "hot" inbound lead isn't actually a fit, and moving on fast instead of chasing it for two weeks.

If you want a role where someone else defines your target list and you just execute, this isn't it.

**What the job actually looks like**

You might spend a morning on outbound — researching accounts, writing sequences, getting conversations started from scratch.

You might run a demo that reframes how a prospect thinks about their PR workflow, not just click through features.

You might sit with someone mid-trial, figure out what's actually stopping them from converting, and fix that instead of sending another generic check-in email.

And when a deal closes, you should care about whether it was the right deal — not just whether it hit quota this month.

That's what we mean by New Business Sales Representative.

**This job is not for you if…**
- You only want to work leads that are handed to you
- You'd rather follow a script than adapt the conversation
- You consider a deal "done" the moment it's signed
- You're not comfortable being told no, a lot, and going back out anyway
- You think customer feedback is someone else's problem to relay
- You mostly measure progress by activity logged, not pipeline built
- You haven't worked in SaaS sales


There are plenty of good sales jobs built that way. Prezly isn't one of them. If you're interested, please apply using this link: https://tally.so/r/mBoLrY

title: DevOps Specialist

description:

We build business systems for executives at mid-market companies, across industries and across the executive team, through three practices: fractional CFO leadership, AI enablement, and revenue engineering. CI/CD in GitHub Actions: build, test, scan, and gated deploy, with branch protection and reviewer rules enforced in configuration rather than convention

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
acceptedRemoteLocations: North America; San Diego County, United States
description:
Why this role?

We build business systems for executives at mid-market companies. The work runs across industries and across the executive team, reaching the CEO, COO, CFO, and CRO, through three practices: fractional CFO leadership, AI enablement, and revenue engineering.

Forward deployed means what it says. You do not build in a sandbox and hand over a repository. You build in the client's environment, against their identity provider, their network rules, their data, and their approval chain, with their people watching. The analyst seat writes the specification. This seat turns it into something running, then stays until the client's own team can run it without you.

Consulting background is a strong signal here. Time at Accenture, Deloitte, McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Slalom, or a comparable delivery organization means you already know how to hold a room, drive a workstream to a date, and write a document that serves an executive sponsor and an engineer at the same time. We weigh that as heavily as the code.

What you would own

Seven areas. The first engagement is the reference rebuild. From there the pattern extends into new client work and you keep it running.

Deployment inside client environments
Stand up integrations, data pipelines, and AI workflows in systems you did not design and cannot rebuild. Work against real constraints: SSO and role models, network and residency rules, change windows, an ERP nobody has touched in four years. Ship in increments the client can see.
Solution engineering from a signed specification

Take a Functional Requirement Document and produce working software. Draw the line between platform configuration and custom code, and defend where you drew it. Write the integration, the transformation, and the service that holds it together.
Agent design and orchestration

Build agent workflows with retrieval, tool calls, and evaluation attached. Place the human approval gate deliberately and log what crosses it. Set cost and latency budgets before the build, then measure against them.

Data readiness and migration
Profile what is actually in the source system, not what the client believes is in it. Set mapping, migration, and quality rules. Nothing moves until the reconciliation ties.
Project management and delivery cadence

Own the plan, the dates, and the risk register on your workstream. Run a weekly status that a sponsor can read in ninety seconds. Raise a slip the week you see it, not the week it lands.
Executive presentation and client communication

Demonstrate working software to a CFO or COO and translate the technical tradeoff into the business decision they have to make. Run the working session that ends in a signed-off answer. Write the one-page recap the same day.

Enablement and handoff
Build runbooks, architecture documentation, and standard operating procedures. Train the client's team on the system they now own. Carry hypercare through the first close, the first quarter-end, or the first campaign cycle, whichever proves it.

Who this suits

Engineers who want the client in the room. If you would rather take a ticket, close it, and never meet the person who filed it, this is the wrong seat. You will demonstrate unfinished work to a CFO and explain what it does not do yet. You will make an architecture call on a Tuesday with incomplete information and write down why. And when a deployment goes sideways, you say so first, with the fix already drafted.

Engagement terms

Work starts on a defined scope with a written statement of work, usually one client deployment. Good work earns the next engagement. As the practice grows we expect this seat to become full-time. No date is attached to it, and we will state plainly where things stand at each renewal.

What we expect

Five years building and shipping production software, including at least two deployments run inside a client or customer environment through go-live.

Engineering
Python and TypeScript or JavaScript, REST and webhook integration patterns, source control, CI, deployment to a live environment. 5+ YEARS

AI systems
LLM application work in production. Retrieval, tool use, agent orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency control. 2+ YEARS

Data
SQL, warehouse work on Snowflake, BigQuery, or Postgres, migration and mapping, quality profiling, reconciliation. 3+ YEARS 

Platforms
API and configuration depth on Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, SAP, or comparable enterprise systems. 3+ YEARS 

Project management
Owning a workstream to a date. Scope control, dependency tracking, status reporting, early escalation. 3+ YEARS

Communication
Writing for a sponsor and an engineer in the same document. Presenting to an executive audience and defending a recommendation live. 3+ YEARS

Security and controls
Authentication, secrets handling, least-privilege access, audit logging, PII treatment inside client systems.

WORKING DEPTH
Useful, not required

Time at a consulting or systems integration firm. Delivery discipline under a client clock carries over directly, and so does the habit of writing things down.

Forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or professional services at a software company.
Control mapping against NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, or SOC 2, and comfort talking to an assessor.

Finance or revenue systems depth: quote-to-cash, revenue recognition under ASC 606, the monthly close, CRM and CPQ architecture.

How to apply:

Send the following to gena@f3insights.com with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer".

One thing you built and deployed inside somebody else's environment. A repository, an architecture diagram, or a written account. Redact client names and figures.

A resume or profile link. No cover letter.

A short note on one deployment that went wrong: what broke, what you changed, and what you now do differently.

Selection process:

01
Screening call, 30 minutes. Scope of the first engagement, your availability, and rate.

02
Working session, 60 minutes. Walk us through a deployment you led, then a live architecture and scoping conversation against a sample client situation. Expect to present, not just answer. No take-home project.

03
References and paperwork. Two references, then a statement of work for the first scope.
We aim to give a decision within a week of the working session. Questions about the role before applying go to the same address.

description:
We build digital twins of the animals people love, for every chapter of the bond: the pet curled up beside you today, and the one you carry in your heart.

### About basil & friends
### 
basil & friends (Paws Limited) is an AI-enabled emotional tech company, incubated by the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation (HKSTP).

It starts with something physical. The Spotlight, our custom pet collar projector, earned the trust of pet parents in 26+ countries within weeks of launching in June 2026. We reached that with zero paid acquisition, 7M+ organic views, and profitability from month one. Every order adds to a growing, structured, owner-verified library of pet identity data.

That data powers Project Ember, our digital twin engine, and our Mobile Companion: a pet that lives on your phone with a life of its own, and sends you word from it. What you bring home in the physical world unlocks something parallel in the digital one. And soon, the bond will have a place in your home, too.

### The Problem We Are Solving
###
Today's generative AI can render a pet easily. But it cannot render YOUR pet, consistently, across time, with the habits and quirks only you would recognize. Identity fidelity and believable autonomy are the hard problems, and they are the ones we work on.

### The Role

You will work directly with our CTO and CEO to build the core of Project Ember: a generative engine that turns a few photos and clips into a living digital twin, and the companion experience that brings it to a phone.

### What You Will Build
### 
* **Identity-preserving generation**: pipelines built on frontier video foundation models and depth-based motion capture, tuned so one specific animal stays recognizably itself across scenes and motion.
* **A behavioral layer**: world-model-driven behavior that gives each twin its own routines, moods, and moments of surprise. Closer to a life lived offscreen than to a chatbot.
* **The Mobile Companion**: zero-download delivery to the lock screen and everyday apps, with progressive, lightweight interactions that teach the twin who your pet really is.
* **The physical-digital bridge**: systems that connect what people own in the real world to what their twin collects and unlocks in the digital one.

### Who You Are
### 
* You are a pet parent, now or once. You know what it feels like to care for an animal like family, and you believe that's one of the most human things about us.
* Deep experience with generative video or image models, and a strong sense of what separates a convincing result from an uncanny one.
* Comfortable shipping: you move from research paper to working demo fast.
*  You believe the best technology feels like magic.

### Why This Role
### 
*  **A real product with real demand**. Organic global traction in 26+ countries, profitable from month one.
* **A proprietary pet identity dataset** that few teams in the world have access to.
* **Founding-level ownership** of the engine the whole company is built around.
* **A team that answers to customers.** We grew without paid acquisition, so we build for the people who actually use the product. 
* **Remote-first, pet-friendly by design. **Work from wherever you do your best thinking, with your dog asleep on your feet or your cat on the keyboard.

title: AI SaaS Product Owner & Founding Leader
description:
AI SaaS Product Owner & Founding Leader



Position: Founding AI SaaS Product Owner / Head of Product & Technology Location: Fully Remote (India Preferred) Commitment: Full-time Equity: Significant equity ownership from Day One Compensation: Post successful Go-To-Market (GTM) — Competitive fixed salary + additional equity



About the Opportunity



Hypotenuse Analytics is building the world’s most advanced multi-modal inference platform that converts fragmented real-world signals into operational truth.

Our core dimensions include:

•	Critical Infrastructure Intelligence — AI-powered Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) using satellite InSAR, CCTV, sensors, and hybrid physics-informed models for predictive maintenance and failure prevention.

•	Surveillance Intelligence Lab™ — Advanced surveillance ecosystems with computer vision, audio intelligence, and behavioral analytics for real-time threat detection across multi-camera feeds.

•	Reality Trust Center™ — Digital trust systems that detect deepfakes, synthetic media, voice cloning, and impersonation attacks through multi-modal authenticity verification.

We are creating a unified intelligence operating system that fuses video, audio, sensor telemetry, and contextual data to answer three critical questions: Is my infrastructure safe? Is this event a real threat? Is this person or media authentic?

Our mission is bold: Solve India’s massive infrastructure and security challenges first through Make in India innovation, then scale globally. We aim to build a ₹1000 Cr+ valued deep-tech platform by 2030.

We are not hiring an employee. We are seeking a technical co-founder-level Product Owner who will own the complete product and technical journey — from zero to scale — and treat this as their own company.



Role Overview

As the Founding AI SaaS Product Owner, you will own the end-to-end product strategy, architecture, development, and GTM execution across our three pillars: AI SHM (Critical Infrastructure Intelligence), Surveillance Intelligence, and Digital Trust Systems (Reality Trust Center). You will shape a scalable, multi-modal SaaS platform that delivers production-grade inference, digital twins, and actionable insights for government, infrastructure owners, smart cities, and enterprises.



Key Responsibilities

•	Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own the complete product vision, prioritization, and roadmap for the Hypotenuse Intelligence Platform — integrating SHM, surveillance, and digital trust capabilities.

•	Zero to Scale Execution: Lead full-stack technical implementation covering Cloud infrastructure, scalable architecture, databases, APIs, testing, CI/CD, security, and performance.

•	AI/ML Integration: Ensure seamless productionization of multi-modal AI models (PINNs, computer vision, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, and fusion engines) across all three dimensions.

•	Technical Ownership: Architect and oversee:

•	Cost-optimized Cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure)

•	Backend/frontend development, robust APIs, and microservices

•	Databases (SQL, TimescaleDB, vector DBs for embeddings)

•	MLOps, edge + cloud model deployment, automated testing, and high-reliability systems

•	GTM Leadership: Drive Go-To-Market strategy, pilot programs with Indian infrastructure and security stakeholders, pricing models, customer onboarding, and early revenue traction.

•	Innovation & Scalability: Build a unified platform that handles thousands of assets and signals with high uptime while maintaining low operational costs.

•	Compliance & Standards: Ensure alignment with Indian standards (ISHMS, IRC, IS codes for SHM) and global best practices for surveillance and digital trust.

•	Team Building: Hire and mentor early engineers; maintain highest engineering and product standards.



Requirements

Must Have:

•	Experience: 8–12+ years in building and scaling AI/ML SaaS or PaaS platforms from early stage to significant growth.

•	Deep Expertise: Hands-on across the full stack — Cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, databases, APIs, testing frameworks, MLOps, and GTM execution in multi-modal AI or inference platforms.

•	Education: B.Tech / B.E in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field from a top-tier institution (IIT, NIT, BITS, or equivalent A++ college). Advanced degree is a plus.

•	Proven Track Record: Successfully taken complex AI-powered SaaS products from 0→1 and then to scale, ideally in infrastructure monitoring, surveillance, IoT, or digital trust domains.

•	AI & SaaS Depth: Strong understanding of productionizing multi-modal systems, digital twins, sensor fusion, and building enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.



Mindset & Culture Fit (Non-Negotiable):

•	Strong ownership approach — you think and act like a co-founder, not an employee.

•	Deep passion for building something meaningful and being part of the New Age Revolution in AI-based SHM, Surveillance, and Digital Trust.

•	Committed to Make in India for the World and creating a ₹1000 Cr+ platform by 2030.

•	High agency, comfort with ambiguity, and long-term vision.

•	Excited to solve India’s infrastructure safety, security, and trust challenges first, then expand globally.



What We Offer

•	Equity from Day One: Substantial founder-level equity stake (exact percentage to be discussed based on profile and commitment).

•	Post-GTM Compensation: Competitive fixed salary + performance-based equity refreshers and incentives.

•	Fully Remote Work with flexible schedule.

•	Direct influence on product, technology, and company direction.

•	Opportunity to build a transformative platform that prevents infrastructure failures, strengthens national security, and restores digital trust at scale.

•	Fast-track growth into leadership roles (CTO, CPO, or Co-founder equivalent) as we scale.

Who Will Thrive Here

•	A battle-tested SaaS builder who has shipped complex multi-modal AI products and wants to solve critical real-world problems in infrastructure, surveillance, and digital authenticity.

•	Someone with an ownership DNA who gets excited by equity, societal impact, and building a generational Make in India company.



To Apply

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScFM3RS4mVsnkieuJXPJCjPJCgm_dv011DjgZNcj8-v0sI31w/viewform?usp=publish-editor



Include in form:

1.	Updated CV / LinkedIn profile

2.	Short note (max 300 words) explaining why you want to build Hypotenuse Analytics’ multi-modal platform for India and what you bring to this mission

3.	Links to SaaS products you have built/scaled, GitHub, or notable achievements

4.	Your thoughts on reaching ₹1000 Cr valuation by 2030

We move fast. High-potential candidates will receive priority and early discussions.

This is a founding opportunity to co-create a Make in India deep-tech success story that redefines how the world achieves operational truth through AI.

If you have the expertise, the ownership mindset, and the hunger to build a generational company, we want to hear from you.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:

title: Game Engineer at Spawn
description:
## About Spawn

Spawn lets anyone make **multiplayer games from words**.

Describe the game you want, and our AI companion **Savi** helps build the world, rules, and interactions. Seconds later, you’re playing it with friends.

We’re a small, senior team building a custom real-time multiplayer engine, an AI-native authoring system, and the runtime that ties creation to play together.

---

We need someone who gets excited about the chaos of making games that didn't exist 30 seconds ago feel great to play for thousands of players.

title: Visual Designer (Paid Social Ads) - LATAM
description:
### 👋 Important note! All applications must be submitted through [this application link](https://forms.clickup.com/6943975/f/6kx77-852296/I4JYXCOVR4FJFGG99N)

**Location:** Remote - LATAM (time zone overlap required for EST)

**Start Date:** September/October

**Type:** Full-time

About Right Hook

Right Hook Digital is a performance growth team helping eCommerce founders and DTC brands scale. Our creative team produces paid social ads across a wide range of brands, products and categories. That means the work needs to move fast, but volume isn't an excuse for average creative.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Visual Designer to join our award-winning team, where your creative vision directly impacts the success of exciting brands across Meta, Instagram, and TikTok.

You’ll work closely with your dedicated Creative Strategist, who provides the strategy and thinking behind what we're testing. Your job is to turn that creative strategy into high-quality performance ads across static, video and social-first formats.

That means making smart decisions about hierarchy, composition, typography, imagery, pacing, hooks, product visibility, movement and how an ad actually lands in-feed. **We expect you to bring that judgment to the work, not wait for every executional decision to be prescribed in the brief.**

Some ads might need to be beautifully polished. Others should feel native, raw or creator-led. A Right Hook Visual Designer understands the difference and knows how to execute both based on the brief.

What You'll Do Day to Day

### 1. Turn strategy into ads built to perform 

You'll take creative briefs and translate them into paid social ads across Meta, Instagram, TikTok and other digital platforms. You won't just ask, “Did I follow the brief?” You'll think about whether the execution actually communicates the idea clearly and whether there is a stronger way to bring it to life.

### 2. Create across formats

You'll work across a mix of:

- Static ads and carousels
- Branded video
- UGC and creator-led edits
- Motion graphics and GIFs
- Product-led creative
- Promotional and offer creative
- Native social formats
- Creative iterations based on existing winners

You don't need to have exactly the same strength across every format, but you should have strong fundamentals and be capable of developing range.

### 3. Own the executional details

You care about the things that separate average creative from strong creative. This includes things like:

- Visual hierarchy and composition
- Typography and branding
- Asset selection for messaging congruency
- Pacing, frame selection, and transitions (video)
- Sound design (video)
- Product prominence

You know when something is technically finished but still isn't good enough to ship.

### 4. Iterate from performance & feedback

Performance creative isn't one-and-done. You'll work with your Creative Strategist and the wider team to understand what is working, what isn't and what we should do next.

Sometimes that means developing something completely new. Sometimes it means taking a winning idea and making the next version better.

### 5. Meet volume requirements without dropping the quality

We're an agency, there are deadlines, multiple brands and a consistent volume of creative moving through Production. You'll need to work efficiently and manage your time well. But speed isn't an excuse for sloppy execution.

We care about both **creative quality** ***and*** **creative velocity**.

What You Bring to the Team

- 1-2 years of experience creating paid social, direct-response or conversion-focused creative.
- A strong portfolio demonstrating paid social digital creative you've personally produced, ideally showing range across brands, formats and visual styles.
- Experience creating paid social creative, particularly across Meta and TikTok. **Experience with Google, Pinterest and other digital advertising platforms is a bonus.*
- Experience working with eCommerce, DTC or performance marketing brands, and/or working inside a performance marketing agency.
- Strong visual design fundamentals including hierarchy, typography, composition and layout
- Video editing and/or motion design capability
- Strong understanding of social-first creative and digital advertising formats
- Ability to interpret creative briefs and turn strategy into execution
- Strong attention to detail
- Comfortable receiving and implementing creative feedback
- Ability to work across multiple brands, priorities and deadlines
- Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
- Reliable high-speed internet and your own working setup

**Priority tools:** Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and/or After Effects.

Other key software our team uses includes Figma, CapCut, Higgsfield, Magnific, and ElevenLabs.

*We're more interested in the quality of your work than collecting software badges.

**Bonus if you have**

- UGC / creator-content editing experience
- Experience using AI tools as part of your creative workflow
- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager or Shopify
- Experience interpreting creative performance data
- Knowledge of project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, etc.)

Why Join Right Hook?

🌍 **Fully remote:** Work as part of an international team across multiple time zones.

📈 **Performance exposure:** Learn how the creative you produce actually performs. You'll see what wins, what doesn't, and use those learnings to make better creative.

🎨 **Creative range:** Work across eCommerce brands, categories, formats and creative styles. You'll constantly flex between different audiences, visual identities and creative problems.

🧠 **Develop your craft:** Your development is built into how we work.

- Dedicated 1:1 monthly coaching with your Creative Strategist
- Access to our monthly Ad Lab learning hub
- Regular workshops and training focused specifically on developing your creative craft.
- A Creative function led by our Head of Creative Strategy, with a strong focus on continuously raising both strategic and executional capability.

🤝 **Work as part of a Growth Squad:** You won't create in a silo. You'll work alongside a Growth Strategist, Creative Strategist, Media Buyer, Copywriter, and Campaign Coordinator, with each person owning a different part of how we grow our clients. You'll have visibility into the strategy behind your work, how it performs once live, and what the team learns from it.

🔥 **A team serious about creative quality:** We're actively investing in raising our creative standard. You'll work in an environment where good creative is recognised, average work is challenged, and feedback is part of getting better.

Think You’re the Right Fit?

We're looking for someone who cares about making **genuinely strong ads that perform** and wants to keep getting better at it. If you have strong creative instincts, care about craft and like the challenge of making creative that has a commercial job to do, we'd love to see your work. 👉 Apply through [this application link](https://forms.clickup.com/6943975/f/6kx77-852296/I4JYXCOVR4FJFGG99N)

**About Skip**
Skip is building AI for entrepreneurs. More than 1 million entrepreneurs and small business owners use Skip to find funding, build websites, create business plans, generate content, sell products, and grow their businesses.

Our mission is simple: Build AI that helps millions of entrepreneurs and small businesses succeed. Skip wants to be the largest company in the world helping entrepreneurs and small business owners.

* Growth, activation, retention, and monetization
* AI product quality and performance
* Experiments, cohorts, patterns, and anomalies
* Funding and grant behavior

* Turning qualitative feedback into quantitative investigation

**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**

title: Founding Sales Lead
description:
# Sapien is building Proof of Quality, an evaluation system for AI work

As AI moves from generating answers to doing real work, teams need confidence in the quality of everything their AI systems rely on and produce.

AI work includes the data going in, the reasoning in the middle, the outputs coming back, and the decisions and actions agents take. Quality matters at every step.

Proof of Quality, or PoQ, measures that work against the customer's own standard.

The customer's rubric defines quality. Agents handle the volume. Qualified experts judge what requires judgment. Consensus turns independent assessments into a measure reliable enough to act on.

Every evaluation produces a record the customer keeps. Teams can see what passed, what failed, why, and what needs to improve.

We've spent two years and 195 million tasks learning how hard it is to measure quality at scale.

Now we're hiring our first dedicated sales lead to take PoQ to market.

## Why now

AI made work abundant. Judgment did not scale with it.

Models are becoming agents. Agents are moving into production. AI systems increasingly depend on complex data, perform multi-step reasoning, generate open ended work, and make decisions that affect real products and workflows.

Some quality can be checked automatically. Much of it depends on context, expertise, or judgment.

The answer cannot be to put an expert behind every piece of AI work.

Reliable judgment needs a process, and scarce expertise has to be deployed where it actually adds value.

That is the problem PoQ is built to solve.

You'll join while this market is taking shape, with direct access to the founders, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to help define how PoQ reaches it.

## The role

You'll own sales end to end: prospecting, discovery, demos, pilots, pricing, negotiation, and close.

Sales today is founder led. We've opened the first doors, run the first demos, and learned where PoQ gets the strongest reaction.

Your job is to take that baseline and build from it.

**There is no proven ICP to inherit.**

We have strong hypotheses and early signals, but we're still mapping the buyers, use cases, segments, and price points where PoQ has the strongest pull.

That means you're selling and discovering the market at the same time.

Revenue matters. So does signal.

Every customer conversation should make us smarter about:

- who feels the problem most acutely
- what AI work they need confidence in
- where quality is easy to test and where judgment becomes necessary
- what gets them to run a pilot
- what they will pay
- which objections repeat
- what they compare us to
- where PoQ clearly wins, and where it does not

Your job is to run enough good conversations to find those patterns quickly, turn the strongest ones into pilots and revenue, and feed what you learn back into product, pricing, and positioning.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature pipeline and execute an established playbook.

If you need a locked pitch deck, settled price book, and fixed ICP before you can sell, this is probably the wrong role.

If discovering the market while selling into it sounds like the fun part, keep reading.

## Credibility matters

You'll often be selling to technical buyers: AI labs, agent companies, data teams, and engineering leaders.

You should be able to run a technical demo yourself, understand the buyer's problem beyond the surface level, and handle the second and third question, not just the first.

Your outbound should sound like you understand the company you're writing to.

You should know when bringing in a founder or engineer materially improves a deal, and when you should handle it yourself.

And you should be comfortable disqualifying quickly when there isn't a real fit.

We care more about strong conversations that create real signal and business than a CRM full of polite meetings.

## Who this is for

We care more about what you've actually done than where you've worked.

You don't need ten years of enterprise sales or a famous logo on your résumé.

You do need evidence that you can create opportunities and close them.

You'll likely be a strong fit if you:

- have personally sourced and closed real business
- are comfortable selling technical products to technical buyers
- are excellent at discovery and getting to the real customer problem
- use AI tools heavily in your daily work
- think in numbers and patterns
- work quickly and independently
- are comfortable operating without a rigid sales playbook
- can turn customer feedback into useful signal for product and positioning

Experience in AI, data, developer tools, infrastructure, or crypto is a strong plus.

## What you'll own

### Market discovery

Build a steady flow of qualified customer conversations through outbound, networks, communities, and other channels.

The goal isn't activity for its own sake. It's enough high quality market contact to learn quickly where PoQ has real pull.

Volume matters, but so does relevance. Your outreach should feel informed because it is.

### Sales, end to end

Own the deal from first conversation through discovery, demo, pilot, negotiation, and signed customer.

Bring in founders and engineers when they materially improve the deal.

### Pilots

Get strong prospects into useful pilots quickly.

PoQ pilots run in days rather than quarters. The rubric, panel, expected effort, and cost are defined up front, and the first Proof Report lands while the decision it informs is still open.

You'll help define success, keep pilots moving, and turn successful ones into customers, references, case studies, and expansion opportunities.

Pilots are commercial opportunities, but they are also one of the fastest ways for us to learn where PoQ creates the most value.

### ICP and pricing

Treat every conversation as data.

Track use cases, objections, pricing reactions, buyer profiles, and why deals move or stall.

Use that information to sharpen our ICP, positioning, packaging, and pricing.

You'll help decide where PoQ wins, not just sell where you're told.

### Network

Make intelligent use of Sapien's existing network of founders, investors, advisors, partners, and communities.

Turn warm introductions into a repeatable channel rather than an advantage spent once.

### Sales operations

Own the CRM, pipeline, forecast, and the systems required to understand what's working.

Every stage should be visible. Every meaningful conversion rate should be known.

As the motion becomes repeatable, you'll help shape the sales team we build around it.

## What we look for

**Proof over polish.**

Show us deals, pilots, partnerships, or revenue you personally helped create.

We want to understand:

- where the opportunity started
- what you personally owned
- what made the deal difficult
- what the result was
- what the numbers looked like

We also expect:

- daily fluency with tools like ChatGPT and Claude
- strong research and prospecting instincts
- enough technical aptitude to learn PoQ deeply and demo it credibly
- comfort with modern CRM, sequencing, enrichment, and automation tools
- a habit of measuring what works and changing what doesn't
- speed

## How you'll be measured

This role has a scoreboard, but it isn't just revenue.

Targets will be set together each quarter and evolve as we learn. They'll fall into four areas:

**1. Qualified conversations.** Are you consistently creating conversations with companies that have a real reason to buy?

**2. Pilots.** Are strong prospects moving into structured evaluations of PoQ?

**3. Revenue.** Are pilots and conversations turning into paying customers?

**4. Market signal.** Are we learning faster because of the conversations you're running? Are those insights changing who we target, what we build, how we price, or how we position PoQ?

If those numbers and signals improve quarter over quarter, you're succeeding.

## Your first 90 days

By the end of your first 90 days, we expect you to have:

- learned PoQ well enough to sell and demo it independently
- absorbed the customer conversations and sales work already done
- launched and iterated on your own outbound motion
- built a meaningful pipeline of qualified opportunities
- moved multiple strong prospects toward or into pilots
- developed an evidence backed view of which segments, buyers, and use cases show the strongest pull
- made meaningful commercial progress toward a repeatable sales motion

We expect speed, but we care more about learning the market correctly than manufacturing activity.

## How to apply

Send us your résumé plus two or three examples of deals or pipelines you actually built.

For each, tell us:

- the starting point
- the result
- the timeframe
- what you personally owned

Screenshots of pipelines, sequences, dashboards, or other real work are welcome.

Then do one more thing:

**Pick a company you think should buy Proof of Quality. Tell us why, and write the exact outbound you'd send them.**

That matters more to us than a polished cover letter.

**About Swans**

Our Company: We are a fast-moving consulting & implementation agency that improves the way US law firms use technology to deliver better services to their clients.
Our Team: We are a team of around a dozen people today, and planning to grow significantly over the next 18 months.
Our Culture: We are energetic, no-BS, intense, results-oriented, and driven to change our industry forever.

**Day in the life**

Hands-on operational and administrative work daily. The split will initially be 75% administrative/executive support and 25% strategic project management, with the goal of reversing that split as you master the role and the company grows.

Because we are expanding the team, hiring runs through this role. We have already built much of our hiring process, so this is about keeping it moving rather than designing it from scratch, and it will weigh most heavily in your first few months while you learn the company and the team. It is one part of a broader executive support and company coordination role, not a recruiting track.

**Your core responsibilities will include:**

Manage the founders' calendars, inboxes, and travel logistics.
Prepare for and run leadership meetings, tracking all action items to completion.
Source candidates for priority roles and run initial screening conversations.
Coordinate interviews and candidate communication, and keep our ATS and candidate pipelines organized.
Support hiring research and outreach and other People Ops logistics.
Coordinate with the bookkeeper to keep finances up-to-date.
Conduct market research and support marketing initiatives.
Handle a constant stream of ad-hoc projects.
As you progress and demonstrate mastery, your responsibilities will expand to include:

Initiate, manage, and complete more complex projects across marketing, recruitment, finance, legal, and other functions.
Work directly with the CEO and CTO to execute strategic initiatives.
Design and implement new processes to "organize chaos".
This is a high-autonomy, "on your feet" role. You will be expected to think independently and solve problems proactively.

**Why this changes everything for you**

If you're tired of slow corporate progression, this is where you earn your seat at the table. This is a "Chief of Staff in-training" role. You'll gain unprecedented exposure by mastering the fundamentals directly alongside the CEO and CTO of a fast-growing startup.

You will make a meaningful operational impact from month one by handling the critical details that keep the company running, freeing up the founders to focus on growth. In return, you get a direct line to strategic projects and a clear, merit-based path to a senior operational role within 12 to 18 months.

**What we need**

Judgment and triage. You can tell the difference between an idea, a decision, a priority, and something genuinely urgent, and you act accordingly without being told which is which.
Discretion. You will sit inside the founders' inboxes, our finances, and our hiring conversations. You treat what you see as confidential by default.
Ownership and follow-through. If you take something on, it gets to completion without a reminder. You are measured on outcomes, not effort.
Executive communication. You write clearly and concisely for the CEO and CTO, and you are the first impression Swans makes on a candidate or a client on the phone.
Practical intelligence. You can work out a sensible way forward in an unfamiliar situation, and come back with a recommendation rather than a question.
You already use AI to do your own work faster. We build AI operations for law firms. We expect you to automate your own admin, not just execute it.

**Ideal background**

2-5 years of experience in similar roles.
Experience as a Project Manager, Executive Assistant, or a similar operational role in a fast-paced environment.
Experience working in a startup or a similar high-growth, "chaotic" environment.
(Alternatively) Experience in a bigger company if you were responsible for managing projects end-to-end.
Proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously across different functions (e.g., marketing, finance, HR).

**This role will NOT be a fit if**

You are looking for a relaxed 40-hours job environment; this job is INTENSE, chaotic, and fast-paced.
You want to be assessed on your inputs; this role will require you to own your OUTPUTS and project outcomes.
You view administrative work as "beneath you." For the first year, mastering the admin and operational details is the job and the non-negotiable key to your growth in this role.
You need significant guidance or "babysitting"; this role requires high autonomy and proactive initiation.
You prefer a specialized role focused on one function (e.g., only marketing, only finance, or only recruiting); you will be working across all functions.
You get overwhelmed by chaos; your job is to organize the chaos.

**Location & schedule**

This is a fully remote role. Because this position works closely with the founders and coordinates activity across the company throughout the day, full working-day overlap with European business hours is essential. Applicants outside this time zone range won't be considered, given that the role requires real-time overlap with the team.

We are primarily looking for candidates working within the GMT+1 to GMT+4 time zones. You should be available Monday to Friday throughout normal European business hours, rather than working primarily asynchronously or on a significantly different schedule.

We also hold in-person team meetups several times a year in different locations around the world, chosen by the team. Potential locations for the coming year include the USA, Tokyo, Dubai, and Bangkok.

**Compensation**

Competitive salary
Performance-based bonus & promotion path
Flexible benefits
Career-defining growth investment: we spent over $200,000 on team development last year, executive coaching, certifications, and training that accelerates your career beyond any traditional path

**Our Mission**

The legal industry is broken: outdated, overpriced, and structurally rigged against innovation and access. Today, 92% of low-income households can't afford legal help, and meaningful reform is blocked by laws that prohibit non-lawyers from owning or operating law firms.

Our mission is to change that. By equipping law firms with cutting-edge tech and world-class operations, we will push the industry 10 years forward: delivering faster, better, and more affordable legal services at scale.

**Swans Core Values**

Value alignment is non-negotiable. Because of the close collaboration with the founding team and the direct impact on clients, it's essential that you genuinely connect with and embody our commitment to our core values:

Relentless Excellence: "We pursue mastery in every detail, not for perfection's sake, but because success with our clients and mission requires it."
Radical Integrity: "We choose transparency, honesty, and accountability, not for virtue's sake, but because trust is the only way our work succeeds."
Sincere Care: "We care enough to anticipate needs and act with empathy and intention, because genuine connection drives everything we build."
Our standards are high: historically, less than 0.5% of candidates possess the rare combination of aptitude, skills, and cultural alignment we require.

Please apply through the following link, only applications submitted through this link will be considered: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/swans/5a7b7302-48d4-450a-ab8e-af51a18b2ca8?utm_source=inbound_swans_website_listings

title: Founding GTM Lead - Sales Team, Outbound & Partner Success (Clone)
acceptedRemoteLocations: Argentina; Chile; South Africa; Colombia; Mexico City, Mexico; Mexico City, Mexico
description:
Afterward is a physician-owned medical practice licensed across the US. Our B2B arm is the licensed medical layer for wellness businesses - gyms, medspas, chiropractors, recovery studios, coaches - that want to offer physician-supervised weight management, peptide, and hormone programs to their own clients without becoming a medical practice. Partners pay a monthly platform fee, and our reps are paid on that fee when it collects. Simply put, we help those type of companies make more money as they're able to offer medical programs through us and mark it up.

We are hiring the first person to own that sales machine.

THE JOB

- Recruit, onboard, and coach a commission-only rep team. Keep them producing in month two. Cut the ones who do not.
- Build and run outbound: list building, texting and calling cadences, LinkedIn plays, pipeline hygiene, weekly reporting. You inherit a 10,000-prospect lead pool and a tracker that already runs on scripts.
- Sit in on demos with the founder, learn the partner P&L build, then take overflow demos.
- Onboard signed partners through our launch kit and run the 30- and 90-day check-ins. You are who a partner calls when something is confusing.
- Turn our existing drafts (rep playbook, scripts, partner onboarding, education modules) into finished materials and Loom walkthroughs. You are shipping what is half-written, not starting blank.

- Base: $2,000 to $2,500 per month
- 10 percent of collected first platform fees from partners closed by reps you recruited
- 5 percent of all collected recurring platform fees, 12 months per partner
- $100 per partner still active at day 90
- Milestone bonuses: $2,000 at $10,000 collected partner MRR, $5,000 at $25,000, $10,000 at $50,000

All variable pay is on money actually collected and attaches only to the platform fee, never to prescriptions or product volume. At a working rep floor this role earns $5,000 to $6,000 per month. The first 60 days are a paid trial at base, with a $1,000 bonus for five reps onboarded with two producing demos, one outbound sequence live, and two partners through onboarding.

YOU

- 3+ years in B2B sales or sales ops, at least 1 year managing reps or SDRs. Commission-only or 1099 teams a plus.
- You have built and shipped a playbook or onboarding. No portfolio, no interview.
- Native-quality written and spoken English.
- At least 5 working hours overlapping US Central time.
- Comfortable as the first hire, reporting to a founder, owning outcomes.

title: SEO Account Strategist
acceptedRemoteLocations: Turkey; Eastern Europe; South Africa; Greece; Latin America; Balkans
description:
## Apply here

**https://app.dover.com/apply/discoveredlabs/6f56de02-0252-471d-a909-acb1015b1874**

Applications are only reviewed through that form. Applying on Wellfound alone will not reach us.

## About Discovered Labs

Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.

We are trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident.io and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want to get more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT.

We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at discoveredlabs.com/case-studies

**High-level overview of our approach:**

- **AI automation and workflows:** We build marketing programs as we would a product. Rather than waste several hours per week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers create workflows with custom technology that let us focus on the high-impact stuff.
- **Senior expertise:** To ensure everything is done to a high standard and differentiated, everything we do is managed and elevated by a team of experts. We don't let automation get in the way of quality.
- **Full-stack:** SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surface areas to ensure we own the outcome and clients win.

*Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it!*

## This role

We're looking for an AI-pilled SEO Account Strategist to run their own book of B2B SaaS client accounts end to end: the client relationship, the strategy and the commercial result.

This is a career-making seat. You set the direction and own the numbers, an SEO Analyst & Data Scientist executes the deep analysis under you, and you work alongside a team of quants with sophisticated in-house systems you'll build into and on top of. Your time goes to strategy and clients, not production.

You don't need a deep SEO background. The bar is data fluency plus marketing sense: you run your own analysis, hold your own on stats, and think like a marketer. We teach the SEO.

This role is fully remote, ideally your timezone is within +/- 4 hours of GMT.

## This role is not for you if…

- **You're afraid of the work.** High tempo and high agency are the seat: if you wait for perfect instructions or route work away, this won't fit.
- **You can't live with data.** You don't need to be an engineer, but you must run your own analysis and reason about numbers under pressure. Spreadsheets, SQL, Python and AI tooling all count.
- **You've never owned a marketing outcome:** a funnel, a budget or a number with your name on it.
- **You're uncomfortable being client-facing:** leading calls, presenting monthly results, handling hard conversations.
- **You lead reviews with rankings and task lists.** We lead with the business story: pipeline, revenue and what we do next.

## What you'll do

- Own a portfolio of B2B SaaS accounts as the directly responsible individual: objectives, commercial sequencing, and sign-off on each account's 90-day plan.
- Run the client communication: weekly updates, bi-weekly check-ins, and the monthly report and review, led with the ROI story. You build the report; your analyst supplies the data behind it.
- Direct the pod: convert strategy into the next 30 days of work, keep your analyst's queue full and unblocked, and QA everything client-facing.
- Challenge the work from the data: kill or reshape anything that doesn't ladder to the client's number. Sign-off means interrogation, not a rubber stamp.
- Protect and grow the accounts: catch at-risk clients early and run the save; open the expansion conversation when the numbers are good.
- Improve the system as you go: templates, reporting and cadences get better because you touched them.

## The ideal person for this role

- **You live with your clients.** In the comms daily, fast to respond, and you always know where every account stands and where it needs to go next.
- **You hold the room.** Presentable, trusted on calls, and able to walk a VP through the numbers and land the story.
- **You live with data.** You run your own analysis, hold your own on stats, and present findings cleanly. Tools are flexible: spreadsheets, SQL, Python, Claude and agents all count.
- **You think like a marketer.** Funnels, channels and buyers, not just one channel's tactics.
- **High tempo, high agency.** Things move because you never wait to be asked, and you willingly get into the weeds when the account needs it.
- **You raise the bar.** You send back work that isn't client-grade and upgrade the process so it doesn't recur.

## Requirements

- Data fluency plus either a marketing or an SEO background (we teach the SEO specifics): you run your own analysis and hold your own on stats, in whatever stack.
- Experience owning external client relationships or marketing outcomes with real numbers attached.
- Experience running multiple accounts, clients or projects simultaneously.
- Near-native English, spoken and written.
- Timezone within +/- 4 hours of GMT.
- AI-native operating: you use AI tools daily as a force multiplier and still own the final, validated output.

**Nice-to-haves (not required)**

- A CRO, experimentation, performance marketing or SEO background
- Familiarity with B2B SaaS
- Code (SQL, Python, scripts): a plus, not the gate

## Culture fit

You should ideally believe:

- **Search has fundamentally changed.** Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture. AI search is a new frontier and you're excited about that shift.
- **AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch.** You're actively using (or willing to use) AI tools daily: prompt engineering, context files, projects. You build workflows, not just type into ChatGPT.
- **Speed and quality are both achievable.** Everyone on our team operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership of their work. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs.

**You'll thrive here if:** You get energy from doing excellent work that makes clients successful. You see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked. You proactively communicate and move fast.

**You won't thrive here if:** You need heavy management. You wait for perfect instructions before acting. You think SEO is still just about keywords and links.

## What's in it for you

- $45,000 - $70,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience
- Fully remote position
- We're small but growing, which means opportunities (financial, experience, job roles), including real scope growth as your book of accounts and the team scale
- Paid leave
- Autonomy to perform your role
- Access to the best in-house SEO/AEO tools that have been built by top engineers

## Work in a new type of agency

We're not a typical SEO agency. You'll get a front-row seat in a company that's truly tech-forward. Here's what makes us different:

- **AI-native from day one.** One of our co-founders is ex-Stanford AI. We don't bolt AI onto old processes, we build around it. We're building a tech-first agency.
- **We build our own tools.** We're constantly designing systems that scale quality without shipping AI slop. Engineering and ops thinking is part of the culture.
- **Going against the norm.** Most SEO agencies move slow, get bogged down in audits and wait for perfection. We move unreasonably fast, prioritise commercial impact and have objective data to show our operating model works.
- **Everyone has a scorecard.** We're relentlessly data-driven. Every person tracks leading metrics so we catch problems early and stay aligned.
- **Small team, big ownership.** No layers of middle management. You'll have direct access to founders and real influence on how we operate.
- **We share what we learn.** We publish our methodologies (like the CITABLE framework) because we believe transparency builds trust and a rising tide lifts all boats.

We look forward to seeing your application.

## How to apply

**Please apply through our application form here:** https://app.dover.com/apply/discoveredlabs/6f56de02-0252-471d-a909-acb1015b1874

That form is where we review every application, and it includes a few short questions plus a 2-minute Loom that we read and watch properly. Applying there is the fastest way to get a decision from us.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Century Health** is a clinical data intelligence company turning messy real-world clinical data into structured, analysis-ready insights for researchers and pharma teams.

---

## The Role
We're looking for a ** Data Engineer (3–5 years)** to be a core builder on our data platform — designing ETL pipelines, profiling raw clinical datasets, and ensuring data flowing through our systems is clean and reliable.

---

## What You'll Do
- Design, build, and maintain **ETL/ELT pipelines** ingesting data from CSVs, Parquet, XLSX, APIs, and databases
- **Optimize pipeline performance** — tune queries, manage compute, reduce latency and cost
- Profile raw datasets to identify quality issues: missing values, duplicates, schema drift, outliers
- Build and maintain **dbt models** for clean, documented, analysis-ready data layers
- Orchestrate workflows using **Apache Airflow on AWS MWAA**
- Process large-scale data using **PySpark on EMR**
- Collaborate with ML engineers and GTM teams on downstream use cases
- Document pipelines, models, assumptions, and known issues clearly

---

## What We're Looking For

**Must-Have**
- 3–5 years of professional data engineering experience
- Strong **SQL** — window functions, CTEs, query optimization
- Solid **Python** — clean, modular, production-grade code
- Hands-on **PySpark** for large-scale processing
- Experience with **dbt**, **Snowflake**, and cloud-based ETL/ELT
- Familiarity with **AWS**: S3, MWAA, ECS Fargate, EMR, RDS, Bedrock
- Strong data intuition and ability to work independently in ambiguous environments
- Experience with test suites — pytest, Great Expectations, dbt tests
- Active use of **AI coding tools** (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)
- Immediate Joiners only (1 month notice period). We can be flexible for exceptional candidates.

**Nice to Have**
- Healthcare data experience (HIPAA, FHIR, HL7, OMOP)
- Data science background (statistical modeling, ML pipelines, feature engineering)
- DevOps exposure (CI/CD, Docker, Terraform/CDK)

---

## Tech Stack
- **Cloud:** AWS (MWAA, ECS Fargate, EMR, RDS, S3, Bedrock)
- **Data Warehouse:** Snowflake
- **Transformation:** dbt
- **Processing:** PySpark, Python
- **Orchestration:** Apache Airflow (MWAA)
- **AI Tools:** Cursor, Claude Code

---

## Hiring Process
1. Application Review
2. Take-Home Assignment (~3 hours, real clinical data)
3. Technical Interview
4. Managerial Interview

---

## Why Century Health
- Hard data problems with real clinical impact
- Small, high-ownership team — your work ships and matters
- Modern cloud-native stack with architectural influence
- AI-first engineering culture

Our platform enables organizations to move beyond static, point-in-time assessments toward continuous, real-world security testing that identifies and remediates vulnerabilities before they can be exploited.

Founded by a globally recognized team of cybersecurity researchers with Hall of Fame acknowledgements from Google, Apple, Meta, Tesla, and other leading technology companies, CredShields combines deep offensive security expertise with AI-native automation. Backed by leading investors including Draper Associates, Amand Ventures, and BoostVC, we are redefining how modern software is secured.

Our mission is to build autonomous, continuous, and developer-native security infrastructure that integrates directly into modern engineering workflows enabling security to scale at the speed of software development.

**The Role**

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at CredShields, you will be responsible for generating and qualifying outbound pipeline across target accounts globally. You will identify, engage, and qualify prospective customers while representing an AI-powered offensive security platform built for modern engineering and security teams.

This is a high-impact, execution-focused role designed for ambitious sales professionals who thrive in outbound prospecting, enjoy engaging with technical buyers, and want to build their career at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and manage outbound pipeline through structured prospecting across email, LinkedIn, cold calling, events, and other channels.
* Research target accounts and identify key stakeholders across Security, Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and Technology leadership teams.
* Execute highly personalized outbound campaigns designed to generate qualified meetings and opportunities.
* Qualify prospects by understanding their security challenges, infrastructure environment, current testing processes, and business priorities.
* Collaborate closely with Account Executives to convert qualified prospects into high-quality sales opportunities.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, activity tracking, pipeline visibility, and reporting discipline.
* Partner with Marketing to optimize messaging, targeting strategies, and outbound performance.
* Continuously refine outreach strategies using data, feedback, and market insights.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3-4 years of experience in B2B outbound sales, business development, lead generation, or SDR roles.
* Experience selling or prospecting into cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, or technology-focused organizations is highly preferred.
* Proven ability to generate qualified pipelines through cold outreach and multi-channel prospecting.
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational skills and a disciplined approach to activity management and execution.
* Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, target-driven environments.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience engaging technical buyers including CISOs, Security Leaders, Engineering Managers, DevOps Leaders, and CTOs.
* Strong curiosity and willingness to learn cybersecurity concepts, cloud security, API security, application security, and DevSecOps.

* Ownership mindset with the ability to independently build and manage pipelines.
* Strong execution discipline and consistency in high-growth, high-velocity GTM environments.

* Be part of one of the fastest-growing AI-native security companies.

title: Sales Manager
description:

Location: Bangalore

fields

Our work brings together architecture, interiors, and thoughtfully integrated technology to 
shape how homes are experienced—quietly elevating everyday living. 
Our approach is guided by a refined understanding of ambience—how light, climate, and

design vision is not only preserved, but consistently expressed and enhanced.

identifying opportunities, engaging clients, and driving meaningful sales outcomes.

Channel & Network Development

residential focus.

value of eGlu’s offerings.

decision-making process.

Sales Performance

required.

Relationship Management & Retention 
● Maintain strong, long-term relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction and 
repeat engagement. 
● Handle escalations professionally, ensuring timely resolution and trust retention. 

Team Collaboration 
● Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth coordination and delivery. 
● Share market insights and support collective learning within the sales function. 
Requirements 

Sales Experience 
● Proven experience in sales, preferably within premium residential, luxury interiors, or 
related sectors. 
● A consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. 
Relationship-Building 
● Strong ability to build credibility and trust with architects, designers, and 
consultants. 
● Existing networks in the premium residential ecosystem are a strong advantage. 
Market & Industry Understanding 
● Awareness of client expectations within high-end residential markets. 
● Familiarity with design-led selling and consultative sales approaches. 

Communication 
● Fluency in English, Hindi, and Kannada. 
● Strong presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

title: Growth Associate - Early Team
description:
# Growth Associate - Early Team

**Location:** Delhi NCR / Hybrid
**Experience:** 0-2 years | Exceptional freshers welcome
**Commitment:** Full-time
**Compensation:** Monthly stipend + equity

## About Recofrend

The internet has made finding options easy. Deciding what's actually worth your time hasn't become any easier.

Recofrend is building a decision layer for everyday discovery - helping people decide what to watch, read, eat and where to go based on **taste and trust**, instead of endless options, generic ratings and sponsored recommendations.

We're live on iOS and Android and are now looking for someone to help us figure out the next big challenge: **growth.**

## The Role

This isn't an internship. And we're not looking for a Head of Growth.

We're looking for someone early in their career who wants to **grow into a much bigger role by building from the ground up.**

You'll work directly with the founder and help figure out how Recofrend goes from its first few hundred users to its first few thousand - and eventually much beyond that.

There isn't a growth playbook waiting for you.

**You'll help build it.**

## What You'll Do

You'll work across the growth funnel : **acquisition, activation and retention** rather than being restricted to one marketing channel.

You'll:

* Identify and test new ways to acquire users across communities, referrals, creators, campuses, partnerships and other channels.
* Run growth experiments end-to-end: **hypothesis → execution → measurement → learning → iteration.**
* Understand what makes new users activate and what prevents them from doing so.
* Talk directly to users to understand why they join, engage, return or don't.
* Track growth metrics and identify where we're losing users across the funnel.
* Experiment with referral, social and community-led growth loops.
* Work closely with product and engineering to turn growth insights into product experiments.
* Double down on channels and experiments that work and quickly move on from those that don't.

## Who We're Looking For

You might be a good fit if you:

* Have 0-2 years of experience, or are a fresh graduate with strong evidence of initiative.
* Are curious about **consumer products, growth and user behaviour.**
* Can look at numbers and ask *why?*
* Are comfortable picking up the phone and talking to users.
* Don't need a large budget or team before you start experimenting.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and figuring things out along the way.
* Take ownership rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
* Want to build something early rather than join once everything has already been figured out.

We care less about your degree or job title and more about evidence that you've **made something happen** - built a community, grown a page, launched a side project, organised something from scratch, driven adoption, sold something, or simply pursued an idea relentlessly.

## What This Role Isn't

This isn't primarily a social media management role.

It isn't a performance marketing role centred around increasing ad spend.

And it isn't a role where you'll be handed a marketing calendar and asked to execute it.

We're looking for someone interested in the intersection of **product, distribution, users and growth.**

## Why Join Now?

Because we're early.

That means less structure but significantly more ownership.

You'll work directly with the founder, see how product and business decisions get made, and have the opportunity to shape how Recofrend grows from the beginning.

The role starts with a **monthly stipend + equity**, with compensation, ownership and responsibility evolving as Recofrend grows.

If you become the person who can consistently figure out how Recofrend grows, we want you to **grow into the person who owns growth here.**

### One question we'd love you to answer

**If you had 14 days and a small budget to get 50 people to not just download Recofrend, but actually use it what would you try first?**
